name: Sales Agent: Meet Your Digital Employee
title: Sales Agent: Meet Your Digital Employee
body:
Introduction

Sales Agent has evolved. Rather than configuring a generic AI tool, you now hire a Digital Employee — a named AI specialist with a defined role, skill set, and follow-up strategy tailored to the types of leads you work with most.

You can choose from three pre-built agents or build your own from scratch. Once hired, your Digital Employee goes to work immediately: engaging new leads, sending follow-ups, and keeping your pipeline moving — without you having to lift a finger.

Note: The digital employee is currently only available to newly purchased Sales Agent packages. If you have already set up your Sales Agent, you are working with Anna!

Meet Your Digital Employees

Three specialized agents are available in the Marketplace. Each one is designed around a different lead type and follow-up focus:

 

 

 

Getting Started

Step 1: Open the Sales Agent Marketplace

Navigate to Sales Agent in your Lofty account. If you have not yet hired an agent, you will land on the Marketplace — a page displaying the three available Digital Employees, plus a Build Your Own option.

Each agent card shows the agent's name, role, and a short description. Hover over any card to see the agent's first-person pitch and a list of their skill tags.

Step 2: View an Agent Profile

Click any agent card to open their full Agent Profile. This page gives you everything you need to evaluate whether the agent is the right fit before committing.

Left panel:

  • Agent name, role, and supported communication channels (Email, Text/SMS, Website Chat)
  • Key performance stats
  • A Hire button
  • Your available follow-up quota (shown before hiring)
  • A count of how many other agents have hired this Digital Employee

Right panel:

  • About — a description of the agent's approach and methodology
  • Skills — a list of specific capabilities the agent uses during follow-up

Step 3: Hire Your Agent

When you are ready, click Hire on the Agent Profile page. A brief deployment sequence will run, confirming your agent is fully configured and connected:

 

 

The entire process takes about 4 seconds. Once complete, your agent's follow-up quota is activated and you are taken to the Overview page where you can monitor activity.

Build Your Own Agent

Prefer a fully customized approach? Select Build Your Own from the Marketplace to create an agent tailored to your specific communication style and business needs.

You will define:

  • Agent name — give your agent a name that feels right for your brand
  • Description — this becomes the agent's persona and guides how it communicates with leads
  • Channels — choose which of Email, Text/SMS, and Website Chat your agent uses (all three are enabled by default)

Click Create & Hire Agent to launch the same deployment flow as the pre-built agents. Your custom agent will be ready in seconds.

 

 

Understanding Auto-Enrollment

Each pre-built agent comes pre-configured with a default Auto-Enrollment setting that determines which new leads are automatically enrolled for AI follow-up after hiring.

  • Anna enrolls all new leads — Buyer, Seller, Renter, and Other.
  • Lucas enrolls Buyer leads only.
  • Lily enrolls Seller leads only.

You can adjust these defaults at any time in your agent's Settings after hiring. Auto-enrollment only applies to new leads created after your agent is hired — existing leads are not automatically enrolled.

 

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I hire more than one agent?

Currently, one Digital Employee can be active at a time. If you hire a different agent, it replaces your current one. Your previous agent's settings and activity history are preserved.

 

What communication channels does my agent use?

By default, all three channels are active: Email, Text/SMS, and Website Chat. You can adjust which channels are enabled in your agent's Settings at any time after hiring.

 

Is my agent active immediately after hiring?

Yes. Once the 4-second deployment completes, your agent is live and will begin engaging newly enrolled leads right away.

 

What is the follow-up quota?

Your quota determines how many AI-powered follow-ups your agent can send per billing period. The quota amount shown on the Agent Profile reflects your current plan. Freemium accounts include 10 free follow-ups. Paid plan quotas vary by bundle.

 

Can I edit my agent's settings after hiring?

Yes. After hiring, you can update your agent's name, description, channels, and Auto-Enrollment defaults from the Settings page within Sales Agent.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by a chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Transaction Lead Portal
title: Transaction Lead Portal
body:
Introduction

The Transaction Lead Portal lets you bring your clients into the transaction process without giving them access to your back-office tools. Once you activate the portal for a transaction, selected Leads can log into the Closely app to view the current stage of their transaction, access shared documents, e-sign required forms, and even upload their own files — all in one place.

This feature helps you keep clients informed and engaged while reducing back-and-forth communication throughout the deal.

 

Getting Started

Step 1: Open the Lead Portal Tab

Navigate to the transaction you want to share with your client. On the Transaction detail page, select the Lead Portal tab.

Step 2: Activate the Portal

Use the Portal Active toggle to turn the portal on. When active, the transaction becomes visible to the selected Leads inside the Closely app.

  • Toggling Portal Active ON makes the transaction visible to all added Leads in Closely.
  • Toggling it OFF immediately hides the transaction from all Leads — no content is deleted, just hidden until you turn it back on.

Step 3: Add Leads

Click Add Lead to go to the Contacts module and select the clients you want to include. Any Leads you add there will automatically sync to the Lead list in the Lead Portal.

 

Step 4: Preview the Portal

Click Preview to see a web-based simulation of exactly what the Lead sees on the Closely mobile app. Use this to review the experience before sending an invite to your client.

 

Sharing Documents with Leads

Once the portal is active, you can share specific documents from the transaction's Documents module directly to your Leads' view in Closely.

  • Go to Transaction → Documents.
  • With Portal Active turned on, a Share to Lead action will appear next to each document.
  • Shared documents will show a Shared tag next to the document name.
  • To stop sharing a document, remove the share — the Shared tag will disappear and the document will no longer be visible to Leads.

Shared documents are visible to all Leads who have access to that transaction, so only share documents intended for all involved parties.

Configuring Which Stages Leads Can See

You can control which pipeline stages are displayed to your clients. This lets you show progress at a high level without exposing every internal step of the transaction.

How to set stage visibility:

  • Open the Transaction List page and click into the Stage Settings popup.
  • For each stage, enable the Visible to Lead option to include it in the client-facing view.
  • Stages without this option enabled will be hidden from Leads in Closely.

 

What Your Client Sees in Closely

When a Lead logs into the Closely app, they will find a My Transactions section under the My Home tab. This section lists all transactions that have been shared with them, with the most recent appearing first. If no transactions are shared, this section is hidden.

Progress Tab

The Progress tab shows the Lead their current transaction stage, along with the completion dates of all previous stages. This gives clients a clear, timeline-style view of where things stand without any additional explanation needed from you.

Documents Tab

The Documents tab is divided into three sections.

 

E-Signatures

Any documents requiring the Lead's signature — or already signed by them — appear here. If there are no signature-related documents, this section is hidden automatically.

Documents

Files shared by you (the agent) from the Documents module appear here. Leads can view these documents at any time. If no documents have been shared, this section is hidden.

Upload

Leads can also upload their own files directly from Closely. Any file a Lead uploads will:

  • Automatically sync to the Documents module on the Transaction detail page in Lofty.
  • Be visible to all other Leads who have access to the same transaction.

 

Staying Notified of Lead Document Activity

Lofty will automatically notify you when a Lead uploads or deletes a document in the Lead Portal, so you always know when new materials are ready to review.

How to manage this notification:

  • Go to Personal Settings → Notifications.
  • Find the Document Action by Lead (Upload/Delete) notification type.
  • Email and push notifications are turned on by default.
  • Toggle either notification method off if you prefer a different cadence.

📌  Note: Only the Transaction Owner receives these notifications.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I share the portal with multiple clients on the same transaction?

Yes. You can add multiple Leads to the portal. All added Leads with their Visible toggle active will be able to see the transaction and any shared documents.

 

What happens if I turn off Portal Active?

The transaction will be immediately hidden from all Leads in Closely. No data is deleted — simply toggle it back on to restore visibility.

 

Can a Lead see documents uploaded by other Leads?

Yes. Any document uploaded through the Lead Portal is visible to all Leads who have access to that transaction, so make sure Leads are aware of this if privacy is a concern.

 

What if my client hasn't downloaded Closely yet?

When you activate visibility for a Lead who has never logged into Closely, Lofty will prompt you to send them an automated text message with a link to download the app.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Feature Updates for Lofty 4.40
title: Feature Updates for Lofty 4.40
body:
Introduction

Be sure to subscribe here to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!

Important: Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons that you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/standard user). These features are subject to change at any time.

 

Summary

  • Transaction Role Default Person Setting
  • Vendor/Partner Optimization
  • Transaction Lead Portal
  • Sales Agent: Digital Employee
  • Sales Agent: Smarter AI Conversations
  • Smart Plan Performance

Transaction Role Default Person Setting

You can now save time on every transaction by pre-configuring default contacts for specific roles. Once set up, designated contacts are automatically added to every new transaction you create, in the role you specify. Company admins can set defaults for the entire team, and individual agents can also configure their own personal defaults.

Highlights:

  • Set default contacts for Vendor/Partner, Agent, and Lender roles at the company or personal level.
  • Defaults are applied automatically to every new transaction, eliminating repetitive manual setup.
  • Tasks are automatically assigned to the default person in a role (when only one exists), reducing unassigned tasks.

Learn more here: Transaction Management Introduction

 

Vendor/Partner Optimization

Managing vendors and partners in your transactions is now easier. You can assign multiple roles to a single vendor or partner in Settings, and when you add them to a transaction, their roles are automatically pre-filled for you.

Highlights:

  • Assign multiple roles to a single vendor or partner in one step (for example, Inspector and Contractor).
  • Roles are automatically pre-filled when adding a configured vendor or partner to a transaction.
  • Pre-filled roles can be modified before saving.

Learn more here: Vendor and Partner Management

Transaction Lead Portal

A new Transaction Lead Portal lets you share real-time transaction progress with your leads through the Closely app. You choose exactly which stages and documents are visible, and leads can view their transaction status, review and e-sign documents, and upload files directly back to you.

Highlights:

  • Activate the Lead Portal from the Transaction detail page and choose which leads can see the transaction.
  • Control which transaction stages and individual documents are visible to leads.
  • Leads can view progress, e-sign required documents, and upload files from the Closely app.
  • Lead-uploaded documents sync automatically to the Transaction Documents module.
  • Receive email and push notifications when a lead uploads or deletes a document.

Learn more here: Transaction Lead Portal

Sales Agent: Digital Employee

Sales Agent has been redesigned as a Digital Employee you can hire. Browse a Marketplace of specialized AI agents, choose one that fits your business, and hire them with a single click. Three pre-built agents are available, or you can build your own.

Highlights:

  • Browse three pre-built Digital Employees: Anna (Speed-to-Lead), Lucas (Buyer Specialist), and Lily (Seller Specialist).
  • Each agent has a unique profile showing their role, skills, and performance stats.
  • Hire your chosen agent in one click with an automated setup that takes about 4 seconds.
  • Prefer something custom? Use "Build Your Own" to create a personalized agent with your own name, description, and channel preferences.
  • The Sales Agent Digital Employee utilizes your existing Sales Agent quota.

Learn more here: Sales Agent: Meet Your Digital Employee

Sales Agent: Smarter AI Conversations

Sales Agent's underlying AI has been significantly upgraded to deliver smarter, more adaptive lead conversations. The AI now evaluates the full context of each lead before deciding when and how to reach out, coordinates with your own outreach to avoid overlap, and changes strategy when a lead stops responding.

Highlights:

  • Sales Agent now decides when to wait rather than send, reducing the chance of over-messaging leads.
  • The AI tracks your calls and texts and adjusts its outreach to avoid redundant contact.
  • Lead preferences, constraints, and intent signals are identified and used to personalize conversations in real time.
  • When a lead stops responding, Sales Agent shifts strategy rather than repeating the same messages.

Learn more here: Sales Agent Smart Leads & Playbook Settings

Smart Plan Performance

Smart Plan Performance adds analytics directly to the Smart Plan edit experience so agents and admins can monitor the results of automated follow-up communications. Switch between Email and Text views, review status trends over a selected time range, and use filters such as time range and email subject to narrow results. The edit view now includes two tabs: Builder for the existing workflow canvas and Performance for analytics.

Highlights:

  • Open any Smart Plan, select Edit, and click the Performance tab to view analytics
  • See how automated emails and text messages are performing, with chart and table views plus filtering options.

Learn more here: Smart Plan Builder

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

Be sure to subscribe here to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!

name: User Guided Setup: Getting Started Step-by-Step
title: User Guided Setup: Getting Started Step-by-Step
body:
Welcome to Lofty and to your guided setup experience! This process is designed to help users quickly configure your account and unlock all core features of the platform. Follow along step-by-step to get fully up and running.

1. Introduction Video

When you begin, you’ll be presented with a short introduction video.

This video provides:

  • An overview of items to have ready
  • What you’ll accomplish during setup 
  • Tips to move through the process efficiently 

We recommend watching this before proceeding, so you understand the full journey.

2. Setup Experience Launches

After the introduction, the guided setup will automatically open.

This is your central checklist where:

  • Each step is clearly outlined 
  • Progress is tracked 
  • New sections unlock as you complete earlier steps 

3. Profile Setup 

Your first actionable step is Profile Setup.

This section unlocks immediately and must be completed before moving forward.

Profile Setup Steps

In this stage, you’ll configure your marketing portfolio. 

  1. Marketing Profile - Select your position within your business and upload a headshot image that will be used to build your marketing profile.
  2. Social Media - Link your social media accounts to Lofty to harness social posting features within the platform.

Completing this ensures your account is properly personalized.

 

4. Website Setup 

Once your profile is complete, Agent Website Setup and the rest of your account setup become available.

Here, you’ll establish your online presence.

Agent Website Setup Steps

  1. Set Your Website Prefix - To help you get started, we’ll create a free website that inherits your parent site’s content, MLS settings, and branding—saving you time on setup and paperwork. Just enter your preferred subdomain prefix (PREFIX.website.com)
  2. Connect MLS(s) - Verify your MLS membership to activate your site and unlock tools like property alerts, home valuations, and more. You will only be able to connect to the MLS(s) your account owner has connected at the company level. If you upgrade to a Full Agent Website, you will have the ability to apply to your own MLS(s)

5. Communication Setup 

Next, configure how you connect with your audience.

  1. Connect Email - Connecting your email to Lofty will allow you to (a) synchronize email communication between your email application and Lofty and (b) automatically parse third-party new lead information from emails into Lofty.
  2. Connect Calendar - Manage your schedule in Lofty. Connect your calendars to ensure you never miss a meeting.

This ensures you can send and receive messages seamlessly.

6. Build Database Setup 

Now it’s time to prepare your database.

  1. Guide Video – Lead import video to guide you on the next steps
  2. Existing Leads - Add your existing contacts and clients to your Lofty platform.
  3. Zillow - Automatically synchronize your leads between Zillow and Lofty. Learn more here: Zillow Two-Way Integration
  4. Realtor.com - Automatically import your leads from Realtor.com to Lofty. Learn more here: Realtor.com Integration
  5. Lead Channel - Use your integrated email or lofty.me email address (below) to bring in leads from your third-party providers. 
  6. Automation Campaign - Utilize automated communication to engage your leads and provide them with valuable property/listing details.

A well-structured database is key to managing relationships effectively.

 

7. Congratulations — You’re All Set!

Once all steps are complete, your setup is finished 🎉

You now have:

  • A fully configured profile 
  • Website foundations
  • Communication tools ready 
  • A structured database 

You’re ready to start using the platform to its full potential.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your CRM.

name: Company Owner Guided Setup: Getting Started Step-by-Step
title: Company Owner Guided Setup: Getting Started Step-by-Step
body:
Welcome to Lofty and to your guided setup experience! This process is designed to help you quickly configure your account and unlock all core features of the platform. Follow along step-by-step to get fully up and running.

1. Introduction Video

When you begin, you’ll be presented with a short introduction video.

This video provides:

  • An overview of items to have ready
  • What you’ll accomplish during setup
  • Tips to move through the process efficiently

We recommend watching this before proceeding, so you understand the full journey.

 

2. Setup Experience Launches

After the introduction, the guided setup will automatically open.

This is your central checklist where:

  • Each step is clearly outlined
  • Progress is tracked
  • New sections unlock as you complete earlier steps

 

3. Profile Setup

Your first actionable step is Profile Setup.

This section unlocks immediately and must be completed before moving forward.

Profile Setup Steps

In this stage, you’ll configure your business and marketing portfolio.

  1. Business Profile - Complete your business profile by providing the business name and logo you use to promote and run your business.

2. Marketing Profile - Select your position within your business and upload a headshot image that will be used to build your marketing profile.

3. Social Media - Link your social media accounts to Lofty to harness social posting features within the platform.

￼

Completing this ensures your account is properly personalized.

 

4. Website Setup

Once your profile is complete, Website Setup becomes available.

Here, you’ll establish your online presence.

Website Setup Steps

1. Choose a Website Template - Select a website template that will be used to populate your website. You can edit designs and content at any point in the future.

2. Provide Website Domain - Provide the website domain you use for your real estate business--the one you want connected to your Lofty platform. This information will be used to submit MLS applications. You will be prompted later to configure the domain at the right time.

3. Connect MLS(s) - Lofty connects to hundreds of MLS feeds in North America. Click the button below to start your MLS application(s). You will need your broker's name and contact information in order to submit.

 

5. Remaining Setup Unlocks and Full CRM Access

After completing the initial steps, the rest of the setup sections unlock.

At this point:

  • You gain access to the full CRM by pressing “Explore Lofty” in the top right
  • Additional configuration options become available
  • You can begin managing contacts, communication, and workflows

6. Communication Setup

Next, configure how you connect with your audience.

  1. Company Number - Your Lofty platform includes a "Company Number" which is a virtual number that is shared with all other users on your account. Choose a local area code to start. Learn more here: Company Number
  2. Texting Approval - U.S. phone carriers require texts sent via platforms such as Lofty to be registered traffic only. Registering for A2P 10DLC is required to send texts via Lofty.  Learn more here: A2P 10DLC - What It Is & Which Plan to Choose
  3. Connect Email - Connecting your email to Lofty will allow you to (a) synchronize email communication between your email application and Lofty and (b) automatically parse third-party new lead information from emails into Lofty.
  4. Connect Calendar -  Manage your schedule in Lofty. Connect your calendars to ensure you never miss a meeting.
  5. Email Domain - Configure your email address domain to send automated and mass emails to promote your business. Learn More here: Sending Email Domain

This ensures you can send and receive messages seamlessly.

7. User Management Setup

If you’re working with a team, this step allows you to add and manage users.

You can:

  • Send an invite link
  • Send an invite via email
  • Mass Import

8. Build Database Setup

Now it’s time to prepare your database.

  1. Guide Video – Lead import video to guide you on the next steps
  2. Lead Ownership - Lead ownership defines who the Owner of a lead is based on how it entered the system. Learn more here: Lead Ownership
  3. Existing Leads - Add your existing contacts and clients to your Lofty platform.
  4. Zillow - Automatically synchronize your leads between Zillow and Lofty. Learn more here: Zillow Two-Way Integration
  5. Realtor.com - Automatically import your leads from Realtor.com to Lofty. Learn more here: Realtor.com Integration
  6. Lead Channel - Use your integrated email or lofty.me email address (below) to bring in leads from your third-party providers. Learn more here: Lead Capture/Email Parsing
  7. Automation Campaign - Utilize automated communication to engage your leads and provide them with valuable property/listing details.

A well-structured database is key to managing relationships effectively.

 

11. Congratulations — You’re All Set!

Once all steps are complete, your setup is finished 🎉

You now have:

  • A fully configured profile
  • Website foundations
  • Communication tools ready
  • Users and permissions set
  • A structured database

You’re ready to start using the platform to its full potential.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your CRM.

name: Feature Updates for Lofty 4.39.5
title: Feature Updates for Lofty 4.39.5
body:
Introduction

Be sure to subscribe here to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!

Important: Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons that you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/standard user). These features are subject to change at any time.

 

Summary

  • Sales Agent Dedicated Email Address & Updated Unsubscribe Logic
  • Exclude Do Not Contact Pipeline Leads from Sales Agent Communications
  • Smart Plan Updates

Sales Agent Dedicated Email Address & Updated Unsubscribe Logic

Note: This update has been delayed.

Your Sales Agent now has its own dedicated email address, ensuring the sender name and email address always match when reaching out to leads. Every Sales Agent email also now includes an unsubscribe option, giving leads a clear and compliant way to opt out if they choose.

Highlights:

  • The Sales Agent uses a dedicated email address that is separate from your own sending address. If you have a custom email domain, the Sales gentA automatically uses it.
  • The sender name and email address always match, eliminating the confusion that can come from a mismatch.
  • Every Sales Agent email includes a footer unsubscribe link. Leads who unsubscribe are removed from Sales Agent email only; the Sales Agent can still reach them via text and chat.
  • You can edit the Sales Agent email prefix in Settings under the Profile tab. You will see a warning if changing the prefix would break ongoing reply threads.

Learn more here: Getting Started with AI Sales Agent

Exclude Do Not Contact Pipeline Leads from Sales Agent Communications

The Sales Agent now fully respects the Do Not Contact pipeline. When a lead is moved into DNC, the Sales Agent immediately stops all follow-up across email, text, and chat. DNC leads also cannot be re-activated by the Sales Agent by any method, ensuring your Do Not Contact list is always honored.

Highlights:

  • The Sales Agent stops all outreach (email, text, chat) the moment a lead is moved to the Do Not Contact pipeline.
  • DNC leads cannot be re-activated by the Sales Agent through any method, including auto-enrollment rules and bulk activation.
  • Moving a lead out of DNC restores their eligibility for the Sales Agent. You can then manually re-activate them when ready.
  • A timeline entry is logged whenever the Sales Agent is stopped due to a DNC pipeline change, so you always have a clear record.

Learn more here: Sales Agent Smart Leads & Playbook Settings

Smart Plan Updates

If you have the new Smart Plan UI, we've added back the option to add due dates to Smart Plan manual tasks, like Email, Text, Call, Other, and Checklist actions. Due dates can be set to trigger immediately, after a defined number of hours or minutes, or after a defined number of days at a specific time. 

The limit for date-based Smart Plan triggers has been increased from 10 to 50, and six new United States holiday triggers are available for annual campaigns. Holidays with variable dates, including Easter, Memorial Day, and Thanksgiving, are calculated automatically each year. 

Highlights:

  • Smart Plans now support due dates for all manual task types in the new experience, and recurring date-based triggers now support up to 50 recurrences. 
  • Smart Plans also include six new holiday-based date triggers to help automate annual outreach: St. Patrick’s Day, Easter, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Halloween, and Thanksgiving.
Learn more here: Managing Smart Plans
 

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

Be sure to subscribe here to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!

name: Docusign Room Integration
title: Docusign Room Integration
body:
Overview

DocuSign Rooms is a DocuSign product designed specifically for real estate transactions. It gives you a centralized workspace to store all deal-related documents, collaborate with other parties (buyers, sellers, title, etc.), and track the progress of a transaction from start to close.

Lofty integrates with Docusign Rooms, allowing you to connect your transactions in Lofty directly to your DocuSign Rooms workspace. This keeps your deal information organized and in sync across both platforms, without switching back and forth or duplicating work.

Note: DocuSign Rooms is a separate product from DocuSign eSignature. If you are looking for information on the Docusign e-signature integration, check out Docusign E-Signature Integration.

 

Getting Started

Connect Your DocuSign Account

Before you can use the integration, you'll need to link your DocuSign account to Lofty. Navigate to Personal Settings > Integrations > DocuSign.

You can either connect your exiting DocuSign account or sign up for a new one. 

 

Linking a Transaction to a DocuSign Room

You can link a Lofty transaction to a DocuSign Room from three places:

  • A lead's detail page
  • The Transaction List
  • A transaction's detail page

 

Option 1: Link to an Existing Room

If you already have a DocuSign Room created for the deal:

  1. Open the transaction in Lofty
  2. Select the option to connect to a DocuSign Room
  3. Search for and select the existing room
  4. On first-time mapping, you'll be prompted to choose which values to keep if there are any conflicts between the two

Option 2: Create a Room While Creating a Transaction

If you're starting fresh:

  1. Create a new transaction in Lofty
  2. Select the option to also create a DocuSign Room at the same time
  3. Lofty will create the transaction on its side and a new Room in DocuSign, then link them together automatically

Claiming Unclaimed Rooms

If you have existing DocuSign Rooms that aren't yet linked to a Lofty transaction, you can claim them from the Transaction List. A drawer will display all unclaimed rooms, and you can map each one to an existing transaction or create a new one.

Syncing Between Lofty and DocuSign

Once a transaction and a Room are linked, changes stay in sync automatically:

  • Lofty → DocuSign: Syncs in real time
  • DocuSign → Lofty: Syncs within 5 minutes

Viewing Folders and Files

Once a transaction is linked to a DocuSign Room, the folders and files from that Room are visible directly inside the transaction in Lofty. This gives you a read-only view of all your deal documents without leaving the platform.

Sending for E-Signature

From within a linked transaction, you have two options for document signing:

  • DocuSign eSignature – Send an envelope for signing directly from Lofty (same as the existing eSignature feature)
  • DocuSign Rooms – Click to open the full DocuSign Room in a new tab for more advanced document management

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need a DocuSign Rooms subscription? Yes, DocuSign Rooms is a separate DocuSign product. You'll need an active DocuSign Rooms account to use this integration. Contact DocuSign directly for pricing and plan details.

Will this affect my existing DocuSign eSignature setup in Lofty? No. Your existing eSignature workflow is unchanged. This integration adds Rooms functionality alongside it.

Can I link one Room to multiple transactions? Each DocuSign Room maps to one Lofty transaction.

What happens if there's a conflict when linking for the first time? Lofty will prompt you to choose which values to keep, so nothing is overwritten without your input.

name: 10DLC Best Practices
title: 10DLC Best Practices
body:
Introduction

This guide walks through the steps required to successfully register a 10DLC brand and campaign through Lofty, in the order you will actually complete them. Start by preparing your website before registering anything — reviewers will verify your website as part of the approval process, so it needs to be ready first.

  • Phase 1: Prepare Your Website
  • Phase 2: Determine Your Brand Type and Register Your Brand
  • Phase 3: Configure Your Campaign

 

Phase 1: Prepare Your Website

Before starting any registration, make sure your website meets Twilio’s requirements. This is the foundation that reviewers will check against everything else you submit.

Step 1 — Website and Consent Requirements

Before setting up your checkboxes, verify the following on your website first. These items will be cross-checked against your brand and campaign registration during review.

 

Consent checkboxes: All SMS consent checkboxes must be unchecked by default and must not be required to submit the form. The phone number field must also be optional. A user must be able to enter their phone number and submit the form without checking the SMS consent checkbox — checking it is always the user’s choice. Use the exact wording below for your campaign use case.

 

The exact wording of your checkboxes will be quoted verbatim in your campaign’s opt-in description (Step 4). Finalize the wording before moving on.

 

Policies: Your website must include both a Privacy Policy and Terms of Service, with working links to both. See Step 2 for the specific SMS-related content each policy must contain.

 

Step 2 — Privacy Policy and Terms of Service: SMS Requirements

Your Privacy Policy and Terms of Service must each contain specific SMS-related language. Add a dedicated “SMS / Text Messaging” section to your Privacy Policy with the following content:

Privacy Policy — required SMS section:

  • A statement that users can opt out by replying STOP to any text message. This must be specific to SMS — a general “opt out of advertising” clause does not count.

  • The following data-sharing clause: “Text messaging originator opt-in data and consent will not be shared with any third parties.”

Terms of Service — required SMS additions:

  • “Carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages.”

  • Instructions for STOP (to opt out) and HELP (for assistance).

  • “Message and data rates may apply.”

 

Phase 2: Determine Your Brand Type and Register Your Brand

Your brand type determines everything downstream — including which campaign type you will register and what kind of messages you can send. The key question is whether your business has an EIN (Employer Identification Number).

 

Step 3 — Choose Your Brand Type and Complete Registration

Use the decision below to identify which path applies to you, then fill in your registration information accordingly.

 

Once you know your brand type, complete your registration using the following information requirements. All information must be real, consistent, and verifiable — reviewers cross-check submissions against public records.

 

Phase 3: Configure Your Campaign

Once your brand is registered, you will configure your campaign. The following steps cover what Twilio reviewers specifically check during campaign approval.

 

Step 4 — Opt-in Description

Your “How do consumers opt in?” description must accurately reflect your actual website flow and be verifiable by reviewers. Clearly state where the opt-in happens, describe the consent action (the checkbox), and paste the checkbox text exactly as it appears on your website — do not paraphrase. If you send recurring messages, note that frequency varies.

If the opt-in occurs behind a login or offline, provide a public URL with screenshots of the relevant pages.

The opt-in description should follow one of these two formats depending on your form type:

One-step form (all fields including phone appear on a single form):

“Consumers opt in by completing the contact form at {WEBSITE_URL}. The form displays a checkbox stating: ‘[EXACT MARKETING CHECKBOX TEXT FROM WEBSITE]’. Checking this box is optional. Phone number is optional.”

 

Two-step form (email entered first, then full form with phone and checkboxes on step 2):

“Consumers opt in by completing the two-step contact form at {WEBSITE_URL}. On the first step, they enter their email address and click Continue. The second step displays their full contact details along with a checkbox stating: ‘[EXACT MARKETING CHECKBOX TEXT FROM WEBSITE]’. Checking this box is optional. Phone number is optional.”

 

All checkboxes are unchecked by default and are not required. The phone number field is optional. Message frequency varies. Message & data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out and HELP for help.

 

Step 5 — Writing Sample Messages

Twilio requires 2–5 sample messages. Each sample should reflect what you actually send, identify the sender by brand name, and use square brackets for variable content such as [First Name] or [City]. At least one sample should contain an opt-out instruction such as “Reply STOP to opt out.”

Important: A system opt-out message is automatically appended to every message by the platform. Do not include it inside your sample messages.

Use the description and sample templates below for your campaign type:

 

Step 6 — STOP and HELP Keywords

Users must always be able to text STOP to opt out of messages and HELP to receive assistance. If you send a welcome or confirmation message as part of a recurring program, that message should include your brand name, a note on message frequency, instructions for STOP and HELP, and a data rates disclosure.

 

Step 7 — Consistency Check Before Submitting

One of the most common reasons campaigns are rejected is inconsistency across the submission. Before submitting, verify that all of the following match each other:

 
If you use a DBA or display name that differs from your legal entity name, explain the relationship in your campaign description and make sure the name is visible on the website. Before submitting, prepare your evidence as one package: opt-in screenshots, checkbox text, Privacy Policy and Terms of Service links, and sample messages.

 

Reference resources from Twilio

The following Twilio documentation pages contain useful diagrams and expanded guidance. Open each page and click “Expand image” to view the relevant screenshots:

  • Brand type selection flowchart — Programmable Messaging and A2P 10DLC

  • Campaign registration page sections — Direct Sole Proprietor Registration Overview

  • Opt-in mechanism requirements and hosted screenshots guidance — Gather the Required Business Information

name: Lofty OAuth 2.0 API Reference
title: Lofty OAuth 2.0 API Reference
body:
This article covers the technical implementation of OAuth 2.0 for vendors who have been approved on the Lofty Developer Platform. If you have not yet set up your developer account and registered an application, see Getting Started with the Lofty Developer Platform.

You will need your Client ID and Client Secret from the My Authorization tab of the Developer Platform to proceed.

Summary

  • How OAuth 2.0 Works
  • Step 1: User Authentication
  • Step 2: Exchange Authorization Code for Tokens
  • Step 3: Make API Calls
  • Refresh an Access Token
  • How It Works for Lofty Users

 

How OAuth 2.0 Works

OAuth 2.0 allows your application to access Lofty user data without requiring users to share their passwords. The flow works as follows:

  1. Your application redirects the Lofty user to an authorization page.
  2. The user logs in to Lofty and grants permission.
  3. Lofty sends an authorization code to your Redirect URL.
  4. Your server exchanges the code for an access token and refresh token.

  5. You use the access token to call the Lofty API on behalf of the user.



     

Step 1: User Authentication

 

Redirect the user to the Lofty authorization page using your Client ID:

https://lofty.com/page/vendor-auth.html?clientId={your_client_id}

The user will log in to their Lofty account and choose whether to authorize your application.

 

If the user grants permission, Lofty redirects to your Authorized Redirect URL with an authorization code:

https://yourapp.com/redirect?code=XXXXXXXXXXXXX

If the user denies permission, Lofty redirects with an error:

https://yourapp.com/redirect?error=access_denied

 

 

Step 2: Exchange Authorization Code for Tokens

Use the authorization code to request an access token and refresh token.

Endpoint:

POST https://crm.lofty.com/api/user-web/oauth/token

Request parameters:

Request header:

Sample curl:

curl --location 'https://crm.lofty.com/api/user-web/oauth/token?code=XXXXX&client_id=XXXX&redirect_uri=XXXXXX&grant_type=authorization_code' 
--header 'Authorization: Basic {Base64 of client_id:client_secret}' 
--header 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded'

Response fields:

 

Step 3: Make API Calls

Once you have an access token, include it in the Authorization header when calling Lofty API endpoints:

Full endpoint documentation is available at https://api.lofty.com/docs/index.html

 

Refresh an Access Token

Access tokens expire periodically. Use the refresh token to obtain a new access token without prompting the user again.

curl --location 'https://crm.lofty.com/api/user-web/oauth/token?refresh_token={your_refresh_token}&grant_type=refresh_token' 
--header 'Authorization: Basic {Base64 of client_id:client_secret}' 
--header 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded'

The response fields are the same as the initial token exchange.

 

How It Works for Lofty Users

Once your application is approved, Lofty users can connect to your app as follows:

  1. The user must be logged in to Lofty in their browser.
  2. The user visits your authorization link: https://crm.lofty.com/page/vendor-auth.html?clientId={your_client_id}
  3. The user clicks Authorize to connect your app.
  4. Lofty validates the user's account and your vendor ID, then sends an authorization code to your callback URL (not to the user).
  5. Your server exchanges the code for a bearer token and can then access the user's data via the API.

Vendors cannot pull data from any Lofty user unless the user initiates the integration themselves. The bearer token is issued to the vendor directly. Users can disconnect at any time by clicking Disconnect in their Lofty account.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at support@lofty.com, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat through your Lofty CRM.

name: Feature Updates for Lofty 4.39
title: Feature Updates for Lofty 4.39
body:
Introduction

Be sure to subscribe here to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!

Important: Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons that you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/standard user). These features are subject to change at any time.

 

Summary

  • Docusign Room Integration
  • Vendor/Partner Management
  • Add Contacts into Transactions
  • Source, Segment, and Tag Optimization
  • Sales Agent: Smarter, More Coordinated Lead Outreach
  • Sales Agent: Updates for Ads Clients
  • Sales Agent: AI Task Notification Optimization

 

DocuSign Room Integration

Lofty now integrates with DocuSign Rooms, allowing agents to link their DocuSign account directly to Lofty and keep transactions in sync between both platforms. 

For more information, see Docusign Room Integration

 

Vendor/Partner Management

Your vendors and partners in Lofty are now organized by visibility level, giving you control over who can see each one. You can set a vendor to be visible across your entire company, within your office, or just for yourself, so your list stays relevant and easy to manage regardless of how large your team is.

Highlights:

  • Three scope levels: Company (all users), Office/Team (your office and sub-offices), and Personal (only you).
  • A new Scope field is available when adding or editing a vendor or partner.
  • The scopes available to you are based on your permission profile.
  • Existing vendors and partners are automatically migrated to the new scope system at release based on who created them. No action is required.

Learn more here: Vendor and Partner Management

Add Contacts into Transactions

You can now add multiple Leads, Agents, Vendors/Partners, and Lenders all to a single transaction, giving you a complete picture of everyone involved in a deal from one place. The associated lead is automatically added when you create a transaction, and any other leads you add will have the transaction linked to their profile.

Highlights:

  • Add any contact type to a transaction's Contacts panel by clicking the "+" button and searching by name or email.
  • Vendor/Partner Contacts can hold multiple roles within the same transaction. Leads can only hold one role.
  • Add a new lead directly from the transaction without navigating away.
  • Add a vendor or partner from a transaction and choose whether to save them to your system for future use or link them to this transaction only.

Learn more here: Transaction Management Introduction

 

Source, Segment, and Tag Optimization

Managing sources, segments, and tags in large databases just got easier. You can now transfer or bulk-delete lead sources, control who can see your saved segments, and filter tags by creation level. For accounts with thousands of records, these updates make your CRM significantly easier to maintain.

Highlights:

  • Transfer leads from one source to another in bulk, with a simple popup flow. Requires the Lead Sources permission.
  • Sources with associated leads cannot be deleted until leads have been transferred, protecting your data.
  • When saving a segment, choose who can access it: just you, your office, or your entire company.
  • Filter your segment and tag lists by Personal, Office, or Company level for faster navigation.
  • Your five most recently used sources and tags now appear at the top of selection lists, labeled for easy identification.

Learn more here: Lead Organization with Sources, Lead Organization with Segments, Lead Organization with Tags

 

Sales Agent: Smarter, More Coordinated Lead Outreach

The Sales Agent has been updated to make more informed decisions about how and when it reaches out to your leads. It now has full visibility into each lead's complete history and recent activity before taking any action. This means it can better determine:

  • Whether a lead needs follow-up — the Sales Agent won't continue outreach to a lead it has already recently engaged, preventing the experience of receiving back-to-back messages that feel disconnected or repetitive
  • Which channel to use — email, text, or call selection is based on the lead's history and behavior, not just a fixed sequence
  • What to say — message content is informed by what the lead has actually done recently, making outreach more relevant

Previously, the Sales Agent could send a follow-up without awareness that the lead had just been responded to through another channel. This could make the experience feel disjointed — more like automated blasts than a real, attentive conversation. With this update, the Sales Agent maintains a coherent, context-aware thread of communication with each lead.

 

Sales Agent: Updates for Ads Clients

If you currently use the Sales Agent with your Lofty ad services, the Sales Agent is moving from an automatic, unlimited model for ad leads to an opt-in, quota-based model that works across all your leads, not just advertising leads. This change gives you more flexibility and a clear quota you can manage.

Highlights:

  • Ads clients who have never activated Sales Agent will receive a notification with their Sales Agent quota to claim. Complete the Onboarding to activate.
  • Ads clients who already have Sales Agent active will receive an automatic +100 quota increase. No action needed.
  • Sales Agent can now follow all leads in your database, not just your ad leads.

Learn more here: Getting Started with AI Sales Agent

Sales Agent: AI Task Notification Optimization

Notification channels for AI-generated tasks are no longer controlled by a single shared setting. Each task type - AI Call Created, AI Appointment Created, and AI Other Task Created - can now be configured independently within Notification Settings. Enable or disable Push, SMS, and Email notifications for each task type separately, allowing more precise control over how you receive alerts.

Highlights:

  • Notification settings for AI-generated tasks can now be configured independently by task type.

  • Agents gain more control over how they receive alerts for AI Calls, Appointments, and Other tasks.

Learn more here: Lofty Notifications

 

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

Be sure to subscribe here to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!

name: Hyperlocal Website
title: Hyperlocal Website
body:
Introduction

The Lofty Hyperlocal Website is a premium website package designed to establish you as the go-to real estate expert in your local market. This article walks you through what the package includes, how to purchase it, and what to expect after you do.

Summary

  • What Is a Hyperlocal Website?
  • Why Choose a Hyperlocal Website?
  • How to Purchase a Hyperlocal Website
  • What Happens After You Purchase?
  • What Your Hyperlocal Website Includes
  • Frequently Asked Questions

What Is a Hyperlocal Website?

A Lofty Hyperlocal Website is a professionally designed, AI-powered website built specifically around your specialized area. Unlike a standard real estate website, a Hyperlocal Website focuses deeply on the neighborhoods and communities where you work, giving buyers and sellers a reason to see you as their local authority.

The package combines two things: a hyperlocal website plan and a done-for-you design service. That means Lofty's team handles the setup for you. You do not need to build anything yourself.

 

Why Choose a Hyperlocal Website?

  • Establish yourself as the neighborhood expert with a site built around your specific farm areas, not generic content.
  • AI generates your site content using your marketing profile, including area pages, neighborhood guides, and blog posts designed to rank in local search results.
  • An interactive Click Map lets visitors explore your farm areas visually, driving engagement and capturing lead information.
  • A premium homepage showcases your brand, active listings, and social proof in a polished, professional design.
  • Three SEO-optimized blog posts are published automatically to help build your online presence from day one.
  • The done-for-you service means a Lofty team member handles the site setup process with you directly, so you are not on your own.

How to Purchase a Hyperlocal Website

Go to the Marketplace

From the main navigation, click Marketplace. Under the Branding and Marketing section, you will see the Hyperlocal Website card listed first.

Review the package and click "Get Website Now" 

On the product detail page, review the package details and pricing. The "We do it all for you" bundle will be pre-selected. This is the only available option. When you are ready, click Order Now to continue.

Select the website owner 

If you are an Account Owner purchasing on behalf of a team member, select the member's name from the list on the next screen. 

Review and Pay

Review your order summary and complete payment using your saved payment method.

Confirm your purchase

After payment is processed, a confirmation message will appear. Click to close it. You will receive a confirmation email shortly after purchase. A member of the Lofty team will reach out within 24 business hours to begin your site setup.

What Happens After You Purchase?

Here is what to expect after completing your purchase:

1.  You receive a confirmation email

A confirmation email is sent immediately after purchase. It confirms your purchase and introduces your new Hyperlocal Website. Keep this email for your records.

2.  Lofty reaches out within 24 business hours

A Lofty team member will contact you to kick off the setup process. They will work with you to confirm your farm areas, preferences, and any additional details needed to personalize your site.

3.  AI builds your site

Once setup begins, Lofty's AI analyzes your marketing profile and builds your complete Hyperlocal Website automatically. The AI-generated site includes everything listed in the next section.

What Your Hyperlocal Website Includes

Once your site is built, you will have a complete, ready-to-launch website with the following:

Premium Homepage

A professionally designed homepage that showcases your brand, your active listings, and social proof like reviews and endorsements. This is the first thing visitors see when they land on your site.

Interactive Click Map

An interactive map of your specialized areas is embedded directly on your site. Visitors can click on individual neighborhoods to explore area information, which drives engagement and prompts visitors to submit their contact information.

Hyperlocal Area Pages

Each of your areas gets its own dedicated page with neighborhood-specific content, local market data, and community insights. These pages are designed to rank in local search results and give visitors a reason to stay on your site.

Four SEO-Optimized Blog Posts

Four blog articles are written and published to your site automatically. Each article is optimized for search engines around keywords relevant to your farm area, helping you build organic visibility online.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: I already have a website on my account. Can I still purchase a Hyperlocal Website?

A: Yes, you can purchase a Hyperlocal website, but it will not replace your existing website. You will now own two websites. 

Q: Can I purchase a Hyperlocal Website for someone on my team?

A: Yes, if you are an Account Owner you can purchase a Hyperlocal Website for any team member. During the purchase flow, you will be asked to select which member the website is for.

Q: How long does it take to get my website set up?

A: A Lofty team member will reach out within 24 business hours after your purchase to begin the setup process. The time to complete the full build will depend on the details confirmed during onboarding.

Q: Can I buy just the hyperlocal website without the design service?

A: No. The hyperlocal website plan is only available as a bundle with the done-for-you design service. 

Q: Can I edit my site content after it is live?

A: Yes. Once your site is live, you can log in to Lofty CMS to update content, add new blog posts, edit area pages, and make other changes at any time.

Q: Will the blog posts and area pages be updated automatically over time?

A: The four blog posts and area pages are generated at the time your site is built. Ongoing updates to content are your responsibility through Lofty CMS. Contact the Lofty support team if you have questions about adding or refreshing content.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: API Key Management
title: API Key Management
body:
Introduction

Lofty has transitioned from auto-generated API keys to a fully user-managed API key system. This update improves security, auditability, and user control over API access. Existing API keys have been migrated and labeled as legacy. Users must now explicitly create and manage all API keys going forward. While API keys can still be shared, OAuth is the recommended and documented method for all new vendor integrations (see HERE).

 

API Key Settings

API Keys are managed from Personal Settings > Integrations > API Keys:

 

How It Works

Legacy API Key Migration

All existing auto-generated API keys have been migrated into the new API Key list with an "Active" status. Each migrated key is labeled as a “Legacy Token” with no expiration date. Legacy keys remain available until manually revoked by the user.

 

API Key Auto-Generation Disabled

API keys are no longer auto-generated. After this update, users must explicitly create each API key through the UI by clicking + Create API Key:

 

API Key Statuses

Each API key now carries one of three statuses:

 

Maximum Active Keys

Users can have a maximum of 10 API keys in "Active" status at any time. Keys in Expired or Revoked status do not count toward this limit.

 

Creating an API Key

Users must provide the following when creating a new API key:

  • Name (Required)
  • Description (Optional)
  • Expiration Date (Optional) — API key status changes to "Expired" on the indicated date at 12:01 AM and access is disabled at that time.
  • API Usage Acknowledgment (Required) — Users must read and accept the terms via checkbox before the key can be created. The checkbox event is recorded in the database with IP address, device information, date/time, and linked to the API key.

 

2FA-Protected API Key Reveal & Revocation

Users are presented with the API key once at the time of creation. Any subsequent attempt to view the key requires two-factor authentication. Revoking an API key also requires the user to complete two-factor authentication before the action is processed.

 

Available Edit Actions for Active API Keys

Users can perform the following actions on any API key with "Active" status:

  • Change name
  • Add or edit description
  • Add or edit expiration date — Status changes to "Expired" at 12:01 AM on the expiration date. The expiration date and time are recorded in the database. Recovery is not permitted.
  • Revoke Access — Status changes from "Active" to "Revoked" immediately and API access is disabled. The revocation date and time are recorded in the database. Recovery is not permitted.

 

Expiration Reminder Emails

A reminder email is sent to the user at 30, 15, 7, and 1 day(s) before the API key expiration date at 8:00 AM. If the expiration date is updated, the reminder schedule adjusts automatically.

 

Why This Matters

  • Users now have full control over API key creation, visibility, and lifecycle instead of relying on auto-generated keys
  • 2FA requirements for key reveal and revocation add a critical layer of security against unauthorized access
  • Legacy keys are preserved and functional, so existing integrations are not disrupted
  • Expiration reminders help prevent unexpected API access disruptions by giving users advance notice

 

Potential Issues

  • Users who previously relied on auto-generated API keys will now need to manually create new keys through the UI
  • Legacy API keys have no expiration date by default; users should review and set expiration dates on legacy keys if appropriate for their security requirements
  • If a user reaches the 10 active key limit, they must revoke or allow an existing key to expire before creating a new one
  • Expired and revoked keys cannot be reactivated; users will need to create a new key if access is needed again

 

FAQs

Q: What happened to my existing API key? 

A: Your existing API key has been migrated into the new system as a "Legacy API Key" with Active status. It will continue to work as before until you choose to revoke it.

 

Q: Can I reactivate an expired or revoked API key? 

A: No. Expired and revoked keys are permanently deactivated and preserved for audit purposes only. You will need to create a new API key.

 

Q: Why do I need 2FA to view or revoke my API key? 

A: Two-factor authentication adds an extra layer of security to protect sensitive actions. This prevents unauthorized users from accessing or disabling your API keys.

 

Q: What happens when my API key expires? 

A: At 12:01 AM on the expiration date, the key status changes to "Expired" and API access is immediately disabled. You will receive reminder emails at 30, 15, 7, and 1 day(s) before expiration.

 

Q: How many API keys can I have? 

A: You can have up to 10 active API keys at a time. Expired and revoked keys do not count toward this limit.

 

Q: Should I use API keys or OAuth for vendor integrations? 

A: OAuth is the recommended and supported method for all vendor integrations (see HERE). API keys are still available but OAuth provides better security and access control.

name: Feature Updates for Lofty 4.38
title: Feature Updates for Lofty 4.38
body:
Introduction

Be sure to subscribe here to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!

Important: Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons that you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/standard user). These features are subject to change at any time.

 

Summary

  • Sales Agent Updates
  • AI Assistant Updates
  • Personal Number Variable
  • Custom Date Filter Optimization
  • Hyperlocal Website
  • API Key Enhancements

Sales Agent Updates

The Sales Agent has received a series of updates this release covering expanded access, smarter automation, a cleaner interface, and more control over your account. The Playbook and Smart Leads view are now open to all users, quota alert emails have been reduced to once every 7 days, the Lead Timeline has been streamlined with new activation and stop messages, unnecessary Playbook Call Tasks have been reduced, and you can now cancel or opt out directly in the platform. New users will also find activation faster with no credit card required and a one-step setup with smart defaults pre-configured.

The Sales Agent was initially being beta tested, but is now available to all! 

Highlights:

  • All Sales Agent users now have access to Playbook settings and the Smart Leads view on the People Page, no special access needed
  • The Lead Timeline now hides low-value system events by default and shows clear messages explaining when and why Sales Agent activated or stopped on a lead
  • The "Call Task Assigned" Playbook Goal default has been turned OFF; existing accounts were updated automatically, and the setting can be re-enabled at any time
  • Activating Sales Agent no longer requires a credit card, and setup now takes one step with smart defaults already configured

Learn more here: Sales Agent Smart Leads & Playbook Settings

AI Assistant Updates

The AI Assistant has received two significant updates this release. It now understands which page you are on and remembers your past conversations, making responses more relevant to your current workflow. If you are using the free trial version of the AI Assistant, the daily conversation limit has been removed. Upgrade to the AI Assistant Pro version to access Deep Research searches.

Highlights:

  • Page context awareness: the AI Assistant detects your current page and can reference it in responses
  • All conversations are automatically saved and organized by date (Today, Yesterday, and earlier)
  • A redesigned Prompt Library helps you discover what the AI Assistant can do, organized by task type
  • A Back button lets you return to the welcome screen and start a new chat at any time

Learn more here: AI Assistant

Personal Number Variable

A new message template variable, #agent_personal_number#, lets you automatically insert your Personal Virtual Number (PVN) into any email or text template. No more manually updating templates when your number changes.

Highlights:

  • Add #agent_personal_number# anywhere in a message template to insert your PVN at send time
  • If your PVN changes, all templates using this variable update automatically
  • Works across both email and text message templates

Learn more here: Email and Text Variables

Custom Date Filter Optimization

The "is less than X days ago" condition in the Custom Date filter has been updated to use the current time as the end of the date range instead of midnight. Activities from earlier today are now included in your filter results.

Highlights:

  • "Is less than X days ago" now counts from the current moment, not from midnight
  • Today's activity is included in results, eliminating the previous "one day behind" issue
  • Existing saved filters using this condition update automatically, no reconfiguration needed
  • All other date filter conditions are unchanged

Learn more here: Lead Organization with Filters

 

Hyperlocal Website

A new website package is now available in the Lofty Marketplace, designed to position you as the go-to expert in your local market. The Hyperlocal Website package pairs a premium hyperlocal website with a done-for-you design service, so your site is built and ready to generate leads without the heavy lifting on your end. Once purchased, Lofty's team will reach out within 24 business hours to kick off your setup.

Highlights:

  • Purchase your new Hyperlocal Website directly from the Marketplace under Branding and Marketing, where it's now featured as the top website option
  • Your site is built by AI using your marketing profile and includes a premium homepage, in-depth neighborhood area pages, and an interactive click map that drives engagement and captures leads
  • Three SEO-optimized blog posts are automatically generated for your farm area to help establish your local expertise from day one

Learn more here: Hyperlocal Website

API Key Enhancements

You now have full control over your API keys directly from your Lofty account settings. The API key management system has been updated so you can create, name, and manage keys with built-in security protections, expiration reminders, and a clear audit trail. Your existing API keys have been automatically migrated and will continue to work without any action required on your part.

Highlights:

  • Create and manage API keys from Personal Settings > Integrations > API Keys, with the ability to add a name, description, and optional expiration date to each key.
  • Your existing API keys have been migrated automatically and remain active with no disruption to existing integrations.
  • Set optional expiration dates on any key and receive email reminders at 30, 15, 7, and 1 day(s) before it expires so you can plan ahead and avoid unexpected access disruptions.
  • Keep up to 10 active keys at a time. Expired or revoked keys are preserved in your history for reference and do not count toward the limit.

Learn more here: API Key Management

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

Be sure to subscribe here to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!

name: Lead Preference Profiles
title: Lead Preference Profiles
body:
Introduction

Lofty CRM now logs Preference Profile activity in a lead's activity timeline. When a lead's property search preferences are created or updated, either by the lead through the website or by an agent in the CRM, a timeline event is recorded so you have a complete history of how their search criteria have changed over time.

Summary

  • What Are Preference Profiles?
  • Preference Profile Timeline Events
  • How to View Preference Profile History
  • Why This Matters

What Are Preference Profiles?

A Preference Profile captures a lead's property search criteria, including:

  • Property type (single family, condo, townhouse, etc.)
  • Price range (min/max)
  • Bedrooms and bathrooms
  • Location (cities, ZIP codes, neighborhoods)
  • Other filters (garage, pool, lot size, etc.)

Leads can update their preferences directly on the Lofty-powered website, or an agent can update them manually in the CRM.

 

Preference Profile Timeline Events

The following events are now recorded in the lead's activity timeline:

How to View Preference Profile History

  1. Open the lead's profile
  2. Look at the Activity Overview Timeline
  3. Update to the search Preferences will be available on the overview
  4. Click any preference event to expand it and see the full details of what changed

Why This Matters

Tracking preference changes gives you powerful insight into where a lead is in their search:

  • Price range expanded → lead may be getting more serious and exploring more options
  • Location narrowed → lead is zeroing in on a specific area — great time to send targeted listings
  • Preferences not updated in 60+ days → lead may have gone cold or found a property

Use this data to time your outreach and personalize your follow-up based on what the lead is actually searching for.

Questions?

name: Group Texting
title: Group Texting
body:
Introduction

Group Text in Lofty allows you to create a shared SMS thread with multiple participants, including leads, vendors, and team members. All replies are visible to everyone in the thread, making it easy to coordinate follow-up and keep conversations organized.

Summary

  • How to Create a Group Text
  • Managing a Group Text Thread
  • Group Text Billing

How to Create a Group Text

  1. Go to a lead's profile and click Text
  2. Click the + icon to create a New Group Text
  3. Add leads: the lead and family members you want to include in the thread
    1. Only the selected lead and their family members can be included in the group text. 
  4. Add agent virtual numbers: select one or more agent virtual numbers to include in the conversation 
  5. Type your message and click Send

Tip: All agents whose virtual numbers are included in the thread will be able to see and respond to messages in the conversation.

 

Managing a Group Text Thread

  • Viewing the thread: All participants (leads and agents) can see the full message history
  • Replying: Any agent in the thread can reply on behalf of their virtual number
  • Adding participants: Currently, participants must be added when the thread is created
  • Leaving a thread: Contact Lofty Support if you need to remove a participant from an active group text

 

Group Text Billing

Each Lofty text message package has an allocated number of text messages that are available to be sent each month. Learn more about this here: Billing, Usage, and Availability for Call/Text Packages. Please be mindful that you may hit your allocated number of text messages sooner than you typically do. The number of text messages sent each month is calculated as follows:

  • Each text message sent counts towards your monthly allocation.
    • Example 1: If you send one (1) text message to one (1) number, this counts as one (1) towards your allocation.
    • Example 2: If you send one (1) text message to a group text with three (3) other numbers, this will count as three (3) towards your allocation. 
      • Now, if one of the numbers involved in the group text responds to the group text, you will have three (3) more text messages towards your monthly allocation. This is because you were the group text initiator, so you are responsible for all text messages sent by yourself and by the others in the group text.
    • Example 3: If you are involved in a group text, but did not initiate the group text, only the text messages that you send will count towards your monthly allocation. This is because you are not the initiator of the group text.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.
