name: Sales Agent Virtual Number
title: Sales Agent Virtual Number
body:
Introduction

The Sales Agent uses a dedicated virtual phone number to send texts. The Sales Agent displays a reminder when the virtual number has not been selected or cannot be used, so you can take action right away.

How to Identify a Problem with the Sales Agent's Number

You may see an "AI virtual number unavailable" notice in the following situations:

  • The virtual number has not yet been provisioned for your account
  • There is an active porting or carrier registration issue with the number
  • Your calling/texting package has expired or reached its usage limit
  • The number is temporarily suspended due to a billing issue
  • The number is not linked to a 10DLC campaign

 

What the Notice Looks Like

When the AI virtual number is unavailable, you will see a yellow warning banner at the top of the Sales Agent panel:

"Your AI virtual number is currently unavailable. Sales Agent calling and texting are paused. Please contact support or check your account settings to resolve this."

 

How to Resolve the Issue

Depending on the cause, take one of the following steps:

  • Provisioning issue: Select a virtual phone number for the Sales Agent.
  • Billing issue:Go to Billing Center → Payment Methods, update your payment information, then click the banner to restore service.
  • Porting/carrier issue:Contact Lofty Support and reference your virtual number or account ID.
  • 10DLC Campaign Issue: If a campaign is available, select it from the drop down menu. If there is no campaign, one must be created. Learn more here: How to Register for A2P 10DLC

 

Will Sales Agent Continue Working Without a Virtual Number?

Partially. Sales Agent requires a valid virtual number to send texts on behalf of the agent. While the number is unavailable:

  • Sales Agent texting will be disabled
  • Email outreach through Sales Agent will continue normally (email does not require a virtual number)

Frequently Asked Questions

My virtual number was working before, why is it suddenly unavailable?

The most common causes are a lapsed billing cycle, a package upgrade that requires a new number assignment, or a carrier-level registration renewal. Contact Lofty Support with your account ID and we will investigate.

Can my leads still reach me while the virtual number is unavailable?

Yes. Leads can still contact you through your personal agent number. Only Sales Agent's AI-initiated calls and texts are affected.

How long does it take to restore a virtual number?

Most provisioning and billing issues are resolved within 1 business day. Carrier-level porting issues may take 2–5 business days.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Property Alerts: Automatically Send Relevant Listings to Your Leads
title: Property Alerts: Automatically Send Relevant Listings to Your Leads
body:
Property Alerts help you keep buyers and sellers engaged by automatically sending timely, relevant listing updates, without manual follow‑up. Once enabled, Property Alerts work in the background to nurture leads, drive repeat website visits, and surface high‑intent activity so you can take action at the right moment.
 

Summary

  • What Are Property Alerts?
  • How Property Alerts Work
  • Auto Property Alerts vs. Manual Property Alerts
  • Alert Frequency & Automatic Frequency Control
  • Duplicate Listing Prevention
  • Where to Manage Property Alerts
  • Why Property Alerts Matter

 

What Are Property Alerts?

Property Alerts are automated listing emails sent to your leads based on their search preferences and behavior. These alerts help buyers stay informed about new and relevant homes, while giving sellers insight into listings in their area.

Property Alerts are designed to:

  • Deliver timely, relevant listings automatically
  • Keep leads engaged with your website
  • Surface meaningful engagement signals (opens, clicks, listing views)
  • Reduce manual follow‑up while improving conversions

 

How Property Alerts Work

Once enabled, Property Alerts use saved search criteria and ongoing lead behavior to determine which listings are sent and when.

For Buyers

  • Buyers receive property alerts with listings that match their preferences
  • Alerts can include new listings, price changes, or status updates
  • Buyer activity (opens, clicks, saves) is tracked in Lofty to help identify high‑interest leads

For Sellers

  • Sellers can receive alerts showing active listings in their area
  • These alerts provide real‑time market visibility beyond traditional market reports

 

Auto Property Alerts vs. Manual Property Alerts

Auto Property Alerts

  • Automatically created for new leads based on their initial inquiry and activity
  • Use global settings configured in Automation > Auto Property Alerts
  • Designed for scale and consistency across your database
  • Update dynamically as lead behavior changes

Manual Property Alerts

  • Created directly on an individual lead in the Automations tab
  • Allow for more customized criteria and timing
  • Commonly used for high‑intent or active buyers
  • Can be adjusted independently from auto alerts

 

Alert Frequency & Automatic Frequency Control

Property Alerts are sent on a cadence you define (such as daily or weekly). Lofty also includes Automatic Frequency Control, which optimizes how often alerts are sent based on each lead’s engagement.

How Automatic Frequency Control Works

  • Leads who regularly open or click alerts may receive them more frequently
  • Leads who don’t engage will receive alerts less often
  • Leads remain subscribed, but at a cadence that matches their interest level
  • This behavior helps improve engagement and protect email deliverability

No manual setup is required. This adjustment happens automatically.

Duplicate Listing Prevention

To ensure alerts stay relevant, Lofty automatically prevents the same property from being sent repeatedly to the same lead within a defined time window.

A listing is considered a duplicate only if the Property ID, Price, and Listing status are all the same. This means that if the price has changed, it is considered a new property and will be resent via a property alert.

This deduplication happens automatically and requires no agent configuration.

 

Where to Manage Property Alerts

You can manage Property Alerts in several places:

  • Automation > Auto Property Alerts for global settings
  • Lead Profile > Automations for individual lead alerts
  • Smart Plans to automatically apply alerts based on tags or triggers

 

Why Property Alerts Matter

Property Alerts are one of the most effective ways to keep leads engaged over time. By delivering consistent, relevant updates automatically, you stay top‑of‑mind while focusing your time on the most engaged opportunities.

Benefits include:

  • Increased repeat website visits
  • Stronger lead engagement
  • Timely follow‑up opportunities
  • Less manual work for agents

Questions?

AI Copilots

We've launched a fleet of AI Agents to help you work smarter by automating everyday tasks, surfacing timely insights, and keeping data organized across your workflow. By handling repetitive actions, like lead updates, follow‑ups, and data syncing, these tools free you to focus on building relationships and closing deals. The result is faster response times, better visibility into client intent, and a more efficient, consistent experience from lead to close.

Navigate to the Copilots tab to launch the agents that you have access to and request access to those in beta. Learn more about these AI Agents here: Lofty AI Copilots

AI Lead Analysis

AI Lead Analysis gives you a fast, AI-powered way to understand the health and quality of your lead database, identify high-priority opportunities, and take action immediately. With clear segmentation, data health insights, and built-in next steps, you can focus on what matters most.

Highlights:

  • Analyze imported or existing leads directly from your AI Assistant
  • Clear lead segmentation to prioritize high-value opportunities
  • Data health checks that surface missing or incomplete information
  • One-click actions to activate Sales Agent or continue with the AI Assistant

Learn more here: AI Lead Health Analysis: Understand and Prioritize Your Leads

Sales Agent Task Notifications

The Sales Agents now sends immediate, AI-powered notifications when important tasks are created, ensuring calls, appointments, and follow-ups happen at the right moment. These notifications and reminders include AI-generated context and direct actions, helping you quickly understand what matters and prepare more effectively—so no opportunity is missed.

Highlights:

  • Instant notifications when Sales Agent creates a call, appointment, or task (via push, SMS, and/or email)
  • AI-generated reminders before scheduled calls and meetings with task-specific guidance
  • One-click access to actions like generating a tailored call script or reviewing appointment insights
  • Available to all sales agent users

Learn more here: Getting Started with AI Sales Agent

Sales Agent AI Suggestion Optimization

When the Sales Agent recommends that you call a lead, the call script is now created in just one click!

Click Call with AI Script to generate a call script and have the lead's number ready to dial! This is only available with the Sales Agent beta version. Learn more here: Sales Agent Smart Leads & Playbook Settings (Beta)

Property Alerts: Automatic Frequency Control

Property Alerts are now smarter and more personalized. With Automatic Frequency Control, Lofty adjusts how often alerts are sent based on each lead’s real engagement—helping you reach clients at the right time without overwhelming them.

What’s new:

  • Alert frequency automatically adjusts based on opens and clicks
  • Highly engaged leads receive updates more frequently when interest is high
  • Less‑engaged leads receive fewer emails while staying subscribed

This update helps improve engagement, protect email deliverability, and create a more relevant experience for every lead—without requiring any manual setup. Learn more here: Property Alerts: Automatically Send Relevant Listings to Your Leads

 

Group Text, Now More Flexible

Group Text has been enhanced to support richer conversations with multiple agents and leads in the same thread. These updates make it easier to collaborate, reply seamlessly, and understand who’s involved—without breaking text workflows.

Highlights:

  • Add multiple agents (using virtual numbers) and multiple leads to one group
  • Agents can reliably reply in Lofty chat
  • Clear ownership and text usage rules
  • Role labels for better visibility of group members

Learn more here: Texting via Lofty

 

AI‑Powered Filters and Segments

You can now use AI to build filters and segments faster across People Lists and Segments. These updates make it easier to turn your ideas into accurate filters and segments with less manual setup.

Highlights:

  • Use natural language to find and apply filters on the People List
  • Create and edit segments with AI‑generated filter suggestions
  • Review and confirm filters before applying them

Learn more here: Lead Organization with Filters and Lead Organization with Segments

 

Zapier Optimization

Two new fields have been added to the configuration forms for the Create Lead and Update Lead actions in Zapier:

  • TimeFrame (Buyer)
  • TimeFrame (Seller)

When values are entered into these fields, the mapped data will sync directly to the corresponding Lofty lead. This enhancement improves Zapier integration flexibility by allowing buyer and seller timelines to be accurately captured and kept in sync.

These new TimeFrame fields are available in both the Create Lead and Update Lead Zap actions. Learn more here: Zapier Integration

name: Office Virtual Number
title: Office Virtual Number
body:
Introduction

An "Office Number" is a virtual number that is shared by all users in a Lofty office. This is different from the Company Number, which is utilized by all users in the Lofty account, and different from what is referred to as a Personal Virtual Number, which is the virtual number that belongs to and is utilized by an individual user. 

An Office Number is simply a virtual number and does not have its own allocated usage. Usage (call minutes or text messages) is still pulled from an individual user's associated call/text package (included or added-on). Each account can have only one personal number, but it can purchase multiple office numbers and be associated with the numbers it bought.

Please also note that in order to have a Personal Number, you will need to upgrade your text/call package which includes the use of a Personal Number.

Choosing Your Office Number

The Office number settings are managed by the Office Owner/Admin by navigating to Settings > Office > Communication > Call & Text and selecting the Company Number tab.

Click Select a Number to pick a virtual number to be used as the Office Number. Click Configure Rule in the Unknown Inbound Call & Text Routing Rule to determine how calls and text messages from phone numbers that do not belong to a lead are routed to users on your office. More information on the configuration logic is here: Unknown Leads

What Happens After Setup

 
After completing the Office Number setup, your Office Number functions the same way as Company Numbers. To learn more about how numbers behave after setup—including outbound and inbound logic—see the Company Number article for details on:

  • Purchasing additional Office Numbers
  • Source and Tag for your Office Number
  • Outbound Logic
  • Inbound Logic

name: Configure Your Office AI Sales Agent
title: Configure Your Office AI Sales Agent
body:
Introduction

Lofty's AI Sales Agent, powered by ChatGPT and Claude, is your dedicated lead capture, nurture, and conversion powerhouse in Lofty. In this Help Center article, we will go over the configuration of your Office AI Sales Agent.

To configure your Office AI Sales Agent settings, go to Office Settings > Sales Agent > Sales Agent Settings.

The Office AI Sales Agent is  at the Office level for all office / team add-ons. The Office-Level Sales Agent will power the chat box on the office Lofty website, and agent websites within the office, as well as text all visible leads matching the criteria you set. The Office-Level AI Sales Agent cannot work on agents' hidden leads. 

Assistant Profile

In the Settings, you can adjust the appearance of your Sales Agent and the way that it interacts with leads. Please keep in mind that this AI is at the Office level, meaning these settings will be in effect for all agents within your office. 

  1. Communication Persona
    • We recommend utilizing “as an assistant” for office settings to ensure the assistant is communicating as an assistant for all agents, not as you, the office owner or admin. 
  2. Assistant Photo
    • Upload a photo to represent your assistant. We recommend a company logo or stock photo. 
    • If you do not, the photo will auto populate with the image of whoever's website it is. So, if this was on agent A’s website it would show agent A’s photo but the assistant's name.
  3. Assistant Name
    • We recommend giving your Sales Agent a different name from anyone on your team. This will help prevent confusion when it hands off warm leads to the actual agent.
  4. Virtual Number
    • This is the phone number the Sales Agent will use when it is communicating via text with your leads. Texts sent from the AI's Virtual Number will not count against your text limit.
    • Assigning the number to a 10DLC campaign is critical for ensuring text deliverability.

Call Forwarding

  • Call Forwarding gives you the option to connect leads who call the Sales Agent to a live person. You can choose to disable, forward to the lead’s assigned agent, or forward to a dedicated number. 

Sales Agent Working Strategy

The Assistant Working Strategy determines how your Sales Agent will communicate with your leads. 

  • Engage Style
    • The Engage Style determines how frequently the AI will reach out to your leads.
    • You can choose between Proactive, Balanced, and Reserved.
    • If you'd like to learn more about how the AI interacts with leads, check out the AI Assistant / Chatbot Qualification Process.
  • Handle Rental Inquiries
    • Use this dropdown to enable or disable rental inquiries.
      • When enabled, Sales Agent will attempt to complete the renter profile of the lead and recommend rental properties.
      • When disabled, the Sales Agent will gently let the lead know that your business does not handle rental inquiries. These leads will not count against your total lead quota.
  • Real Estate Experience
    • Use this box to enter a prompt to customize or coach your Sales Agent. Include information about yourself, your company, how long you've been in business, the tone you'd like your Sales Agent to use, and any other relevant information. 

Sales Agent Enrollment

Leads Enrollment

These settings determine which leads the AI Sales Agent will engage.

  1. Auto Enrollment
    • Automatically start the AI Sales Agent for eligible leads. Sales agent will be active when a lead is created to match the conditions.
  2. Manual Enrollment
    • Manually start the AI Sales Agent for existing leads. You can select specific leads and activate the AI Sales Agent when you want more control over when follow-up beings. 

Channel Enrollment

You can enable or disable individual channels, like chat or text, here. 

All channels are turned ON by default. Use the radio button on the right side to toggle off or on different channels of communication for the AI Sales Agent:

  • Website Channel
    • This powers the chat experience on your Office website and all connected Agent Websites beneath it.
    • If the website chatbot is enabled, it will be installed on the website.
    • The AI Assistant replaces the Chat Box on your website, but it does not share settings. If you need to edit the Chat Box settings, please see this article.
  • Text Channel
    • This enables the AI Sales Agent to text new and existing leads in your Lofty CRM.
  • Email Channel
    • This enables the Sales Agent to reply to emails sent to your Sending Email. For more information on Sending Email, check out Sending Email Address.

  • Facebook Channel
    • Connect your Facebook account to the AI Sales Agent to start receiving Facebook messages by your Sales Agent. Click here to learn more.

 

Team Enrollment

All teams are turned to ANY by default. Use the drop-down options to add or remove different members. 

  1. Agent
    • Use this dropdown to enable/disable the AI Sales Agent for specific Agents in your office.
  2. Office
    • Use this dropdown to enable/disable the AI Sales Agent for specific Teams/Offices in your organization.
  3. Lead Pond
    • Use this dropdown to enable/disable the AI Sales Agent for specific Lead Ponds in your office. 

Assistant Voice

  1. Unknown Inbound Calls
    • If checked - the Inbound Call Handler will answer phone calls from phone numbers that do not belong to a lead in your CRM. Create your conversation strategy and let AI do the rest!
  2. Voice Type
    • Choose your voice type (female or male) and hear a preview of the voice before settling
  3. Receiving Number
    • Choose which number the AI will answer ( AI number, or personal number)
  4. Applied Numbers
    • Choose between unknown callers, untouched leads, or both. 
  5. Active Hours
    • You can choose what hours the AI Sales Agent will be able to text your leads.
    • Note: Most communication from the AI Sales Agent is triggered by lead activities. Meaning, it will text leads when they take action on your website. Reducing the Active Hours could prevent the AI Sales Agent from texting your leads when they have website activity.
  6. Active Days
    • You can choose which days the Sales Agent will be able to text your leads.

Interactive Steps 

  1. Actions & Conditions

  • Welcome Script - Create a welcome script for the AI Sales Agent to use when answering the call.
  • Actions – Choose what actions you want the AI to take under specific conditions

  1. AI Prompts

  • Provide some prompts to help the AI Sales Agent communicate with callers

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: How to Create Your Website with the Website Building Agent
title: How to Create Your Website with the Website Building Agent
body:
Introduction

Lofty's Website Building Agent makes it easy to create a professional website in minutes. Simply chat with the AI, review your information, and let it build a fully customized site for you.

 

Introduction Video

 

Getting Started

When you begin creating a new website, you'll see three options:

  • Generated With AI – Build your website through a guided, chat-based experience (covered in this article)
  • Choose a Template – Select and customize a template manually
  • Create a Free Agent Website – Create a free website (available to members only)

Select Generated With AI to get started.

 

Review Your Marketing Profile

The AI automatically searches public sources to build your marketing profile. It looks for information such as:

  • Your headshot
  • Bio
  • MLS details
  • Specialties
  • Sales performance
  • Featured areas
  • Reviews

You'll see a preview of everything the AI finds on the left side of your screen.

Already have profile information saved? Don't worry—the AI won't overwrite anything you've already entered. It only fills in the gaps.

Need to make changes? You can edit any field by typing your request in the chat. For example, you might say "Update my bio to mention my 10 years of experience" or "Remove the specialties section."

When everything looks good, click Approve to continue.

 

Generate Your Website

After you approve your profile, the AI gets to work. It will:

  • Select a template that fits your brand and profile
  • Plan your site's menu and structure
  • Write all your website content
  • Add images throughout your site

Once your site is generated, you can preview the design. Want a different look? You can switch to another template at this stage.

When you're happy with the design, click Approve to finalize.

 

What's Next

After approving your design, you'll be taken to your CMS dashboard where you can:

  • Configure your custom domain
  • Connect your MLS

These final steps work the same way as the standard website setup process.

 

Questions?

name: Getting Started with Lofty Agent Studio
title: Getting Started with Lofty Agent Studio
body:
Introduction

Lofty Agent Studio is a platform that enables you to create custom AI agents with tailored behaviors, tools, and capabilities. Build agents designed for your specific workflows and share them across your team.

Note: This feature is currently being Beta tested. You may or may not have access.

Summary

  • What is Agent Studio?
  • How to Access Agent Studio
  • Customization Options
  • Publishing and Using Custom Agents
  • Team Access and Permissions
  • FAQs

What is Agent Studio?

Agent Studio is a tool for creating dedicated AI agents that can be customized to fit your specific needs. With Agent Studio, you can:

  • Build AI agents tailored to specific workflows
  • Configure AI models, prompts, and tools
  • Test and debug agents before publishing
  • Share agents across your team

How to Access Agent Studio

There are two ways to access Agent Studio:

  1. From the Lofty AI page: Click the Agent Studio card on the Lofty AI page.
  2. Direct login: Log in directly via the platform URL using your Lofty account credentials.

Customization Options

Agent Studio provides seven key customization capabilities for your AI agents:

1. AI Models

Choose from multiple AI providers to power your custom agent:

  • OpenAI: GPT-4, GPT-4o, GPT-3.5
  • Anthropic: Claude 3.5, Claude 3
  • Google: Gemini Pro, Gemini

Different models have different strengths. GPT-4 excels at reasoning, Claude is known for nuanced conversations, and Gemini integrates well with Google services. Choose the model that best fits your agent's intended use case.

2. AI Prompts

Define your agent's personality, instructions, and behavioral guidelines through custom prompts. Use prompts to configure:

  • Role definition (e.g., "You are a real estate assistant...")
  • Response style guidelines
  • Domain-specific knowledge
  • Constraints and guardrails

3. AI Tools

Enable your agent to perform actions and access external data through preconfigured tools. Select which tools your agent can use from the available options.

Tip: Prompts define what your agent says. Tools define what your agent can do.

4. System Variables

Give your agent access to contextual data through preconfigured system variables, including:

  • Lead information
  • Property data
  • User context variables

5. Memory Depth

Configure how many conversation turns your agent remembers. More turns provide better context but may increase processing costs. Adjust based on your agent's needs.

6. Web Search

Enable or disable your agent's ability to search the web for real-time information. This is useful for agents that need current market data, news, or other external information.

7. Preview & Debug

Test your agent before publishing to ensure it behaves as expected. The preview interface allows you to:

  • Test conversations in real-time
  • View tool execution results
  • Refine prompts iteratively

Publishing and Using Custom Agents

Follow these steps to publish and use your custom agent:

  1. Create: Build your agent in Agent Studio using the customization options above.
  2. Test: Use the preview interface to debug and refine your agent.
  3. Publish: Make your agent available to users.
  4. Use: Access your agent in the Lofty AI chat window.

After publishing:

  • Add the custom agent to your Lofty AI chat window
  • Switch between different AI agents during conversations
  • Each agent retains its unique configuration and capabilities

Best Practice: Always thoroughly test your agent in the preview interface before publishing. Test edge cases, error scenarios, and typical user interactions to ensure quality.

Team Access and Permissions

Agent Studio uses team-level data permissions. Here's what this means:

  • All team members can see and use agents created by anyone on the team
  • Agents created by any team member are automatically shared with the team
  • Data permissions are based on team-level access controls

Recommended practices:

  • Use clear naming conventions for your agents
  • Document the purpose of each agent
  • Coordinate with your team before publishing new agents

FAQs

Can I create custom tools for my agent?

Not at this time. Tools are preconfigured by the Lofty AI team. You can select which preconfigured tools your agent can use.

Can I create custom system variables?

Custom variables are not supported yet. You can use the preconfigured system variables available in Agent Studio.

Who can see the agents I create?

All members of your team can see and use agents created by any team member. Individual-level agent permissions are not available at this time.

How do I choose the right AI model?

Consider your agent's primary use case. GPT-4 is strong at complex reasoning, Claude handles nuanced conversations well, and Gemini integrates with Google services. Test different models in the preview interface to see which works best for your needs.

What should I do if my agent isn't behaving as expected?

Use the preview and debug interface to test your agent's responses. Refine your prompts iteratively and test edge cases. If issues persist, contact the Lofty AI team for support.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

Email Overview Dashboard
