name: AI Smart Plans Workflow
title: AI Smart Plans Workflow
body:
Introduction

AI action workflows add intelligence to your smart plans by automatically classifying, generating, summarizing, and extracting data from your communications. Here’s how each AI action works, how to set them up, and why they’re valuable when managing leads and automating follow-up.

This feature is currently being Beta tested. You may or may not have access as this time.

Summary

  • Introduction Video
  • AI Classifier
  • AI Generator
  • AI Summarizer
  • AI Extractor

 

Introduction Video

 

AI Classifier

The classifier helps you understand the intent of your leads by analyzing their latest email and automatically categorizing them as "interested" or "not interested."

In your smart plan, select Actions to open the action categories. Then select AI Actions -> AI Classifier.

Configure the classifier to analyze your preferred lead content. This could be any lead, agent, listing, or transaction variable or any previous communication with a lead.

This setting is telling the AI which information to look at to classify the lead appropriately. For this example, we will look at the latest text message sent from the lead. Next, we need to provide the categorization options, such as "Positive", "Negative", "Interested", or "Not Interested".  Toggle Single Category on if you want the information to be categorized as one or the other, but not both/all categories. 

Next, test your categorization by giving the AI some sample information. Provide a test lead or a test content for the AI to classify for you. Additional instructions are optional, but can help the AI with its classification efforts. 

The AI Classifier can be used to create branch conditions in your Smart Plan. For example, if the lead's previous text message was perceived to be positive, you could send one text message template and if the lead's previous text message was perceived to be negative, you could send a different communication. 

AI Generator

The generator writes emails for you based on instructions and tone you set, using information from the lead’s messages. Navigate to your Smart Plan actions and select AI Actions -> AI Generator.

Set the tone, such as "Friendly" and provide detailed instructions for how the AI should generate a Smart Plan communication. Select a variable for the AI to use to get started. This could be any lead, agent, listing, transaction, or general variable as well as past lead communication or previous AI Action Output. Select a lead to test the AI output and see the content the AI has generated. 

Once you are satisfied with the test AI response, click Save. This will create an Action in your Smart Plan for the AI to follow your instructions and generate a response to the lead.

AI Summarizer

The summarizer condenses long messages or conversations into clear, concise bullet points. Select the AI Summarize AI action in your workflow.

Next, choose the content to summarize—this could be an email, text, call, or another AI action output. Enter sample content to test the summary.

If you are satisfied with the test results, save the action. The summarizer helps you quickly grasp the key points from lengthy emails, making follow-up easier and more efficient.

AI Extractor

The extractor pulls key data from your communications, such as name, budget, location, or time frame. Add the AI Extractor action to your smart plan.

Specify which details to extract from incoming emails, texts, calls, or previous AI outputs. Test the extraction to verify it pulls the correct information.

If you are satisfied with the results, save the action. The extractor automates data entry and ensures you never miss important lead details.

 

AI actions simplify your workflows and make your smart plans more responsive and powerful. Use classifiers for better lead management, generators for personalized communication, summarizers for quick insights, and extractors for pulling key details—all in one automated sequence. This saves you time and ensures every lead gets the right attention.

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Sales Agent Smart Leads & Playbook Settings
title: Sales Agent Smart Leads & Playbook Settings
body:
Introduction

 

Summary

  • Playbook Settings
  • Smart Leads View on People Page
  • How to monitor the Sales Agent

Playbook Settings

The Playbook defines how Sales Agent engages with leads at each stage of their journey. Unlike one-size-fits-all automation, the Playbook uses a goal-based methodology similar to how experienced real estate agents work. Sales Agent adapts its strategy based on where each lead is in their decision-making process.

Where to Find Playbook Settings

  1. Navigate to AI Copilots in the main menu
  2. Select Sales Agent
  3. Click on Settings
  4. Select the Playbook tab

 

The Four Playbook Goals

The Playbook is organized around four sequential goals. Each goal represents a stage in the lead qualification and conversion process:

 

Goal 1: Capture Contact Details

Objective: Convert anonymous website visitors into known leads by capturing their name and contact information.

When leads enter this goal: New visitors who land on your website and haven't yet been created as leads in your CRM.

How Sales Agent works:

  • Proactive Welcome Message: Uses website chat box to send a friendly welcome message on the visitor's first visit
  • Instant Auto Reply: Answers visitor messages and asks for their name and contact information

What this goal delivers:

  • New Lead Created in CRM
  • Tag Applied to identify the lead
  • Call Task Assigned for agent follow-up

Goal 2: Clarify Intent & Preferences

Objective: Turn vague interest into clear, actionable signals about what the lead is looking for.

Information gathered:

  • Buyer or seller intent
  • Timeline for purchase/sale
  • Budget range
  • Location or property criteria

How Sales Agent works:

  • Sends structured follow-up messages
  • Adjusts cadence based on lead engagement
  • Creates call tasks when human conversation would be valuable

Benefit: When you step in to call the lead, you have full context on their preferences instead of starting from zero.

Goal 3: Win Appointment

Objective: Make it easy for qualified leads to say "yes" to a meeting with you.

How Sales Agent works:

  • Appointment-focused outreach
  • Clear next-step suggestions
  • Stops automatically once an appointment is booked

Key point: Sales Agent gets the lead ready and qualified; you close the loop by conducting the appointment.

Goal 4: Grow Long-Term Trust

Objective: Maintain relationships with leads who aren't ready to act immediately, keeping you top-of-mind for when they are.

How Sales Agent works:

  • Low-touch, long-term follow-up sequences
  • Periodic check-ins to gauge readiness
  • Re-engages leads when they show renewed interest

 

Opportunity Behavior Playbook

In addition to the four goals, Sales Agent detects Opportunity behaviors—signals of strong interest or intent—and engages appropriately. These settings determine how the AI Sales Agent reacts to specific lead behaviors.

 

Behavior categories:

  • Missed Call: Lead attempted to call but didn't connect
  • Buyer Interest: Property views, saved listings, share listing requests, tour requests, saved searches, mortgage usage, form submissions
  • Seller Interest: Home evaluation requests
  • Back on Market: Return visits, new inquiries from past leads

How Each Goal Works

Each goal in the Playbook answers three key questions:

  1. How does Sales Agent work in this stage? Is it doing proactive outreach or auto-reply only? What cadence and tone?
  2. What does Sales Agent deliver? Tags, call tasks, appointments, and clear signals for agent intervention.
  3. When does the lead move forward? What qualifies the lead for the next goal? What information must be clarified first?

This structure makes Sales Agent's behavior predictable and explainable—you always know what the AI is doing and why.

Customization Options

Within each goal, you can configure:

  • Whether proactive messaging is enabled
  • Which communication channels to use (text, email, website chat)
  • What tags are applied at each stage
  • When call tasks are created for agent follow-up

 

Smart Leads View on People Page

The Smart Leads view is a new tab on the People page that provides at-a-glance visibility into all leads being managed by Sales Agent. This view organizes leads into three priority categories, making it easy to understand which leads need your immediate attention and which ones are being actively nurtured by AI.

Where to Find Smart Leads

Navigate to the People page and look for the Smart Leads tab. The tab displays a count of leads in each category and is marked with an AI indicator.

  1. Go to Sales in the main navigation
  2. Click on All Leads or My Leads
  3. Select the Smart Leads tab

 

Lead Status Categories

Smart Leads organizes leads into three categories based on their engagement level and required actions:

High Priority

What it means: These are leads actively managed by Sales Agent that require your immediate action. The AI has identified an opportunity or task that needs human intervention.

Examples of required actions:

  • Making a phone call to a qualified lead
  • Handling an offline appointment
  • Updating lead information or preferences

What you see in this view:

  • Name, Inquiries, Tags: Same as the standard CRM Lead List
  • AI-Generated Summary: Quick context on the lead and their current status
  • Tasks: The most recent incomplete task (Call, Appointment, or Lead Update) created by AI
  • AI Suggestion: Helpful call-to-action buttons based on task type

 

AI Prospecting

What it means: These are leads actively managed by Sales Agent that require no immediate action from you. The AI is actively working these leads through the qualification process.

Criteria: Leads have shown activity within the past 30 days.

What you see in this view:

  • Name, Last Visit, Activities: Same as the standard CRM Lead List
  • AI-Generated Summary: Context on recent engagement and lead preferences
  • AI Next Step: The most recent incomplete task in the AI's follow-up plan
  • AI Goal: The Playbook goal the AI is currently working toward
  • AI Suggestions: Always shows "Call with AI Script" CTA

Tip: Clicking "Call with AI Script" generates a custom call script based on the lead summary and current AI goal.

 

AI Monitoring

What it means: These are leads that require no immediate action and have not shown activity in the last 30 days. Sales Agent continues low-touch, long-term follow-up to re-engage these leads.

Criteria: Leads have had no activity within the past 30 days.

What you see in this view:

  • Name, Score, Last Touch: Same as the standard CRM Lead List
  • AI-Generated Summary: Overview of the lead's current status
  • AI Nurturing Plan: Shows how the AI is re-engaging inactive leads
  • Calls Made: Number of calls already made to the lead

 

Benefits of Smart Leads View

  • Clarity: Instantly see which leads need your attention versus which ones are being handled by AI
  • Efficiency: Understand what needs to be done without digging through lead details
  • Actionable: Complete tasks right away using AI-generated suggestions and scripts

Best Practices

  1. Prioritize High Priority leads: These leads have been qualified by AI and are ready for human engagement. Responding promptly avoids missed opportunities.
  2. Monitor AI Prospecting progress: Check in on these leads periodically to see how the AI is progressing toward appointment setting.
  3. Use the AI Script feature: When calling leads, use the AI-generated script for context-aware talking points.
  4. Let AI handle monitoring: Leads in AI Monitoring don't need your attention unless they re-engage or are escalated to High Priority.

How to monitor the Sales Agent

The Sales Agent is designed to notify you when a conversation is out of their scope or is making great progress and ready for your involvement. If you want to make sure things are going well, you can monitor the active leads that the Sales Agent is working on, qualifying. 

A few notes regarding permissions: 

  • All users have access to monitor conversations on the chat list and the lead detail page of leads assigned to them.
  • The Team Owner/Admin and users with the “Access All Team Leads” permission (see Team permissions) are only able to monitor conversations on the lead detail page, but it is not visible on their chat list unless the leads are assigned to them.

To monitor conversations, click the Workspace icon, then click AI

This will take you to the AI Sales Assistant Following conversations. 

In this section, you can:

  • View all active text and website chat conversations the AI is having
  • "Mute" the conversation (keep the Sales Agent from qualifying the lead)
  • Type in your own message to take over the conversation

*IMPORTANT: Please note the following:

  • When clicking the "Mute" option, you are stopping the Sales Agent. You can unmute the Sales Agent at any time by clicking on the ellipses in the lead's profile, followed by Unmute AI Sales Assistant.
  • Please also note that any form of manual communication (making a phone call, sending a text message, or sending an email) will also take over from the Sales Agent. This does not include automatic content sent out via Smart Plans.

What if a lead unsubscribes on a Sales Agent email?

If a lead clicks the unsubscribe option on an email sent by the Sales Agent, they will only unsubscribe from emails sent from the sales agent's email address. The lead can still be sent other automated emails, smart plan emails, and manual emails. The Sales Agent can also still send text messages to the lead. 

If the lead is moved into the Do Not Contact (DNC) pipeline stage, they will automatically be unsubscribed from all communications from the Sales Agent.

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Smart Plan Builder
title: Smart Plan Builder
body:
Introduction

A Lofty Smart Plan is a robust lead-nurturing feature that combines email drip campaigns with tasks to help you communicate with your leads continuously. This article will review how to create, edit, and manage your Smart Plans. 

 

Summary

  • Where are the Smart Plans?
  • Smart Plan Organization
  • How to Create a New Smart Plan
  • Smart Plan Steps
  • Editing Smart Plans
  • Applying and Removing Smart Plans

Where are the Smart Plans?

Navigate to Automation > Smart Plans.


 

Smart Plan Organization

Smart Plans

Depending on the type of Lofty account you are on, you may see options for My Smart Plans, Office Smart Plans, or Company Smart Plans. These are Smart Plans that have been created on your Lofty account, for use with your leads.

If Auto-Apply is turned ON, then the Smart Plan will automatically run for any applicable leads in your Lofty CRM. Auto-Apply can be enabled on your own Smart Plans, as well as on Office/Company Smart Plans.

Smart Plan Library

The Smart Plan Library is full of templates that can be imported into "My Smart Plans" or "Office/Company Smart Plans".

To find the Library, navigate to Automation > Smart Plans > Library.

How to Create a New Smart Plan

When creating a new Smart Plan, you have two options:

  • Start From Scratch: Build your plan step‑by‑step on the flow canvas.
  • Start From a Template: Choose from pre‑built templates and customize as needed.

After choosing your starting point, you simply select a plan scope, then you are taken directly into the visual canvas to begin building. This eliminates the old multi‑step setup process and gets you into the builder immediately.

 

Smart Plan Settings Panel

The first step when creating a new Smart Plan is the settings.

Here, you will give the Smart Plan a name, determine which leads the plan should apply to, set the Smart Plan scope, and set the conditions that will pause the Smart Plan.

Plan Scope

All Lofty users will have the option to create My Smart Plans. My Smart Plans can only be viewed, edited, and applied by the Agent who created them. 

Company Smart Plans can be applied to the entire account. They are visible to all users. Users with the "Manage Template —— Entire Company" permission (see Organization - Permission Profiles) can manage any Company Smart Plans.

Office Smart plans are visible to all users under the office and any sub-offices (if applicable). Users with the "Manage Template —— User's Office" permission can manage the Smart Plans for their office and any sub-offices. 

Target Lead Type

This setting will determine what type of leads the Smart Plan will apply to. You can find the Lead Type in the leads profile details: 

Multiple lead types can be selected. Be sure to set the application rules to capture the leads you are targeting with this Smart Plan. Here's how those settings work:

  • Equals To: The Smart Plan will only apply to leads who have exactly the lead types selected.
    • Example: Smart Plans with Lead Type set to "Equals to Buyer and Seller leads" will ONLY apply to leads that are both buyer and seller lead type.
  • Include All: The Smart Plan will only apply to leads that have all of the selected lead types, even if they also have some other lead types.
    • Example: Smart Plans with Lead Type set to "Include All Buyer leads" will apply to all leads with a buyer lead type and also include leads with a seller or other lead type. 
  • Include One Of: The Smart Plan will apply to leads who have one of the selected lead types. 
    • Example: Smart Plans with Lead Type set to "Include One Of Buyer, Seller, Investor Leads" will apply to any leads who have just one of those lead types. 

Auto-Apply and Auto-Reapply

Enable auto-apply to have the Smart Plan automatically apply to any leads that meet the criteria. If auto-apply is not enabled, the Smart Plan will have to be manually applied every time you want to use it. 

If Auto-Apply is enabled, you also have the option to enable "Auto Re-apply". The auto-reapply setting will allow this Smart Plan to automatically be re-applied to a lead that the Smart Plan has already run for if that lead meets the trigger conditions again.

Auto Pause

This setting automatically pauses the Smart Plan when the lead meets certain conditions. 

  • The lead responds/reaches out: This includes the lead sending an email to a Lofty user, calling a Lofty number, sending a text message to a Lofty number, and replying to the AI. 
  • The lead is added to a Segment: Add the Segment in this setting, and any leads who are added to this Segment will have the Smart Plan paused automatically.
  • An outbound call is logged as "talked.": A call was made to the lead, and the call was marked as "talked" after the call in the dialer window. 
  • The lead's pipeline changes: The lead's pipeline was changed. Please note that the Smart Plan step action to "change pipeline" will also result in the pausing of this Smart Plan, in addition to manually changing a lead's pipeline stage.
  • The tags that triggered the Smart Plan are deleted: When the tags are added to trigger the Smart Plan in the application conditions are removed/deleted
  • The "source" of the lead changes: When the source of the lead is changed after the Smart Plan is applied

Smart Plan Steps

Triggers

The Triggers indicate how/when the Smart Plan will be applied and to what leads. 


Triggers fall into two main categories:

Lead‑Based Triggers

Examples include:

  • Lead Created: The Smart Plan will run automatically when the lead is newly created in the CRM
  • Lead Assignment Changed: The Smart Plan will run automatically when any lead role is manually assigned or reassigned
  • Pipeline Changed: The Smart Plan will run automatically when the lead's pipeline is changed
  • Tag Changed: The Smart Plan will run automatically when tags are added or removed from the lead
  • Segment Changed: The Smart Plan will run automatically when the lead is added or removed from a Segment
  • Contact Permission Changed: The Smart Plan will run automatically when the lead contact permission is changed
  • Website Activity: The Smart Plan will run automatically, dependent on the lead's website behavior
  • Lead Meets Specified Criteria: This is a flexible trigger that allows you to set specific criteria

Event or Date‑Based Triggers

  • Communication Event (formerly “Instant Interaction”)
  • Holidays (e.g., New Year, Christmas, Valentine’s Day)
  • Lead Date
  • Transaction Date
  • Other Dates, including fixed calendar dates

These triggers give you options to automate communication at exactly the right time.

Triggers can be set anytime in the Smart Plan to give you control over when each action takes place.

Conditions

Conditions set the timing logic in your Smart Plan. Actions run immediately, so all delays and branching behavior are added through conditions.

Available Conditions

Wait a Period of Time: Determine how long to wait before the action takes place

Wait Until a Specific Date: Provides precise timing control for important messages. Choose from:

  • A specific calendar date
  • Lead Date
  • Transaction Date
  • Holiday
  • Day of week or month
  • Specific time

Branch (Multi‑Path Logic): Allows your plan to follow different paths based on lead criteria.

Key features of Branch Conditions:

  • Supports AND/OR logic
  • Conditions checked in order
  • Default “Not Met” branch included
  • Enables advanced filtering and personalization

 

Wait Until an Event (Advanced): This condition pauses the plan until a specific event occurs, such as:

  • Email Events: opened, replied, bounced
  • Text Events: replied
  • Call Events: inbound/outbound behaviors
  • Lead Meets a Condition: custom criteria with optional fallback timeout

The system can automatically create “Event Met” and “Event Not Met” branches based on what happens.

 

Actions

Smart Plan Actions are the texts, emails, and tasks that are generated by your Smart Plan. All available Smart Plan actions are defined below:

Communication Actions

  • Auto Email: Automatically sends an email to the lead.
  • Auto Text: Automatically sends a text to the lead.
  • Postcard: Design and automatically send a postcard to leads. You can design and pay for the postcard here as well. Learn More: Self-Service Mail / Mailers
  • Letter: Design and automatically send a letter to leads. You can design and pay for the letter here as well. Learn More: Self-Service Mail / Mailers
  • Notification: Sends an email to a specified email address or Lofty user
  • Buyer Property Alert: To set up a property alert, you will need to set the search criteria while creating the Smart Plan.

Manage Tasks and Plans

  • Email: Create a task to email the lead.
  • Text: Creates a task to text the lead.
  • Call: Create a task to call the lead.
  • Custom Task (Other): Creates a general task. You can choose what the task is for.
  • Checklist: Creates a list of tasks to be completed. You can assign tasks to any role that is under the lead.

Update Lead

  • Change Pipeline: Automatically moves the lead to the pipeline selected.
  • Change Segment: Automatically add/remove the lead from a segment.
  • Change Tag: Automatically add/remove a tag from a lead. 
  • Reassignment Group: This is a great option for any Lofty users who want to mass reassign their leads. As a refresher, the Reassignment Groups Help Center article is here: Reassignment Groups
  • Add Note: Add a note to the lead's profile, with the option to pin the note to the top of the page.

AI Actions

  • Sales Agent Action: Choose an action you want the AI Sales Agent to take (monitor the lead's behavior or mute the Sales Agent). 

Automate and Integrate

  • Start Smart Plan: Automatically start a new Smart Plan. You can have multiple Smart Plans running so if there are additional steps after the "start Smart Plan" step, the current Smart Plan will continue. 
  • Zapier Zap: Triggers a Zapier Zap.  Learn More: Zapier Zaps + Smart Plans
  • Slybroadcast: Slybroadcast is a service that can be used to send pre-recorded “ringless voicemails”. You will only see this option if you are subscribed to Slybroadcast. Learn More: Slybroadcast Integration 

 

Editing Smart Plans

To edit any Smart Plan, click on the settings gear to the right. 

 

Keep in mind that you can only edit Company or Office Smart Plans if you have the correct permissions enabled. This is because changing the Company or Office Smart Plans will affect the whole account.

Editing a Smart Plan that is currently applied to a lead

When editing Smart Plans, keep in mind how this will affect the leads that are actively enrolled in the Smart Plan. Please see these scenarios below:

The edited section has not been completed by the lead

  • The Smart Plan will resume as normal and the lead will encounter the newly edited portion of the Smart Plan

The edited section has been completed/The section added has been passed by the lead

  • The lead will not encounter to the newly edited section of the Smart Plan. The Smart Plan will not start over and the edited section will only apply to new leads or leads who have not reached this section yet. 

If the Smart Plan you edited was removed from any lead

  • The Smart Plan will not auto-apply to that lead again. It will need to be manually added. 

Applying and Removing Smart Plans

Smart Plans can be automatically or manually applied to leads.

Auto-Apply

Any Smart Plan that has "auto-apply" enabled will automatically apply to leads who meet the criteria. If auto-apply is disabled, you will need to manually apply the Smart Plan to leads. 

Manually Applying

To manually apply a smart plan for multiple leads (not using auto-apply), navigate to the People Page and check the box next to the leads you want to apply a Smart Plan to. Select the More menu > Smart Plan > Add Smart Plan

Next, select the Smart Plan and click Apply


Smart Plans can also be manually applied from the lead's profile:


 

Removing

To remove a Smart Plan from all leads, click the Settings Cog Wheel > Remove from leads

Smart Plans can also be removed from multiple leads on the people page, using the same process as mass adding a Smart Plan.

Remove/delete the Smart Plan for an individual lead by hovering over the Smart Plan and clicking the trash can icon.

Pausing and Resuming Smart Plans

Pause any Smart Plans that you want to stop for a period of time so that you do not want the automations to continue. This could be if you are out of the office or taking time away from work. When you resume the Smart Plan, it will pick up right where it left off.

There are two ways to pause and resume your Smart Plans. 

1) Pause/Resume from the Smart Plan page

Navigate to Marketing → Automation → Smart Plans. Check the box next to the Smart Plan(s) you want to pause or resume. An option will be available at the top of the Smart Plan list to either pause or resume the selected Smart Plan(s).

The Smart Plans will pause/resume for all of the leads that are enrolled in that plan.

2) Pause/Resume from the People page

Navigate to People Page → select the leads you want to pause/resume a Smart Plan → Click More → Select Smart Plan → Select the option you want.

The Smart Plans that are applied to the selected leads will be available in the pop-up. Select the plans that you want to pause/resume. This will pause/resume the selected Smart Plans only for the selected leads.

 

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Feature Updates for Lofty 4.36
title: Feature Updates for Lofty 4.36
body:
Introduction

Be sure to subscribe here to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!

Important: Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons that you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/standard user). These features are subject to change at any time.

 

Summary

  • Transaction Page Update
  • New Marketplace and Integration Center
  • Property Alert Optimization (Beta Release)
  • Updated Smart Plan Builder (Beta Release)

Transaction Page Update

  • Updated the Transaction List Page layout to improve visibility and ease of use.

  • Enhanced filtering behavior to make transaction counts clearer and more interactive.

The Transaction List Page has been updated with layout and interaction improvements designed to make managing transactions more intuitive. The Transaction Type switch is now centered on the page for better visibility, and the Dashboard Number remains prominently displayed at the top of the Kanban view for quick reference.

Filtering behavior has also been refined. When you first open the page, all transaction stages are selected by default, and the “All Transactions” count reflects the total across all stages. If you deselect one or more stages, the “All Transactions” number is greyed out and updates to exclude those stages. You can also click the Dashboard Number to toggle selection on or off, which stays in sync with the stage filters below.

 

New Marketplace and Integration Center

  • Separated the Marketplace and Integration Center to clearly distinguish Lofty products from third-party integrations.

The Marketplace and Integration Center are now split into two distinct destinations to improve clarity and navigation. The Marketplace displays only Lofty products and retains the existing layout, excluding third-party offerings. Users with customized Marketplaces will see their pages preserved as much as possible. 

 

Property Alert Optimization (Beta Release)

Note: This feature is being beta tested. You may or may not have access at this time. 

  • Property Alerts now automatically adjust sending frequency based on real lead engagement.

  • Property Alert emails have been refreshed to highlight key search criteria and improve click-through to listings.

Property Alerts now use Automatic Frequency Control to optimize how often alerts are sent to each lead. Leads who do not open or click alerts over time will automatically receive them less frequently (for example, daily to weekly or monthly), helping prevent inbox fatigue and protect email deliverability. Engaged leads who regularly interact with alerts will automatically receive them more frequently, ensuring timely delivery of relevant listings when interest is highest. Alert frequency also stays in sync with saved search changes to keep recommendations accurate.

In addition, the Property Alert email design has been updated to surface core search details, such as location, price, bedrooms, and bathrooms, directly in the email body. Listing cards now better highlight key property features, and quick links make it easier for leads to jump from the email to the website. Alert frequency is visible on each lead’s profile for added transparency. 

 

Updated Smart Plan Builder (Beta Release)

Note: This feature is being beta tested. You may or may not have access at this time. 

  • Introduced a new flow-based Smart Plan builder that makes creating and managing automation easier and more visual.

  • Added powerful new condition logic, including advanced timing and branching, to support more complex automation.

The Smart Plan builder has been redesigned from a segmented, multi-step setup into a flow-based canvas. You can now start from scratch or from a template, choose a plan scope up front, and immediately begin building your automation visually. A new expandable settings panel allows you to rename plans, adjust scope, update target lead type, and manage auto-apply and auto-pause settings without leaving the canvas, reducing interruptions during setup.

The new flow introduces major upgrades to conditions and triggers. Timing is now controlled through dedicated condition nodes, such as waiting a period of time, waiting until a specific date, or waiting for an event, rather than being embedded in actions. Multi-path branching supports AND/OR logic with fallback paths, enabling more precise automation. Existing Smart Plans with time or date-based delays will be migrated automatically to the new structure. All existing actions remain available and now run immediately when reached in the flow. Learn more here: Smart Plan Builder – New Flow Guide (Beta)

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

Be sure to subscribe here to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!

name: How to Connect Your MLS to Your IDX Website
title: How to Connect Your MLS to Your IDX Website
body:
Introduction

Connecting your MLS to your IDX website is a critical first step when building your site. This process allows listings to display correctly and ensures your website stays up to date with MLS data.

Follow the steps below to successfully connect one or more MLSs to your website.

Step 1: Access the MLS Setup

  1. In your CRM navigation bar, click the Content option and choose Website

 

2. In the Site List, click the SEO site you need to add the MLS to 

Navigate to the Listings tab and choose + Add New MLS 

 

Step 2: Select Your MLS

Search for your MLS by name.

 

Can’t Find Your MLS?

If your MLS does not appear in the dropdown list:

  • Click the link at the bottom of the list to provide additional information.
  • Our MLS Support Team will use this information to contact the MLS and work toward becoming a vendor.

 

Step 3: Enter Your MLS Membership Information

Once an MLS is selected, you’ll need to provide your membership details.

You can search for your membership using:

  • MLS subscriber name
  • Email address
  • Agent ID

 

Alternative Option: Search by Listing

You may also identify your membership by entering:

  • An active MLS listing that belongs to you
  • MLS number or property address (if available)

The system will pull the associated agent information from the listing.

 

 

Step 4: Provide Required Details

To ensure a smooth application process, you’ll need to provide:

  • Agent information
  • Broker information
  • Office information

Some fields may already be auto-filled based on the MLS data you provided.

 

Important Notes:

  • Enter the best email address to reach you. This is where we’ll send updates or requests for additional information.
  • Make sure your phone number does not include hyphens (ex. 8569566574)
  • Your broker’s information is required, as your broker must also sign the application.
  • Do not confuse broker information with brokerage office information—both are required and entered separately.

 

Step 5: Submit the Application

After clicking Submit, one of the following will occur:

Application Received

Your application is successfully submitted and under review.

Action Required

You may be required to:

  • Download and sign PDF documents, or
  • Follow instructions sent to your email.

In some cases:

  • You may need to initiate the application directly with your MLS board.
  • Forward any feedback or confirmation to our MLS Support Team.

All required instructions will be sent to your email—be sure to check it promptly.

E-Signature Required

If an agreement must be signed:

  • The document will be emailed to you.
  • Sign it via e-signature or PDF.
  • Send the signed document back as instructed.

 

Step 6: Add Another MLS (Optional)

If you need to connect another MLS:

  • Click + Add New MLS in the top-right corner.
  • Repeat steps 2-5.

 

Step 7: Check Your MLS Application Status

After submission, you can monitor your MLS status in the CMS – Listings.

You can view the status and next required actions directly in Listings.

Where to Check:

  • CMS Dashboard → Listings

 

Next Steps

Lofty manages four (4) types of MLS application processes: Agreement, Instruction, Online, and Vendor. These processes are designed to streamline your MLS applications and provide you with updates on their progress, as each MLS processes their application differently. Depending on the MLS you are applying to, you will go through one of the four processes.

 

Important Reminders

  • Watch for emails from our MLS Support Team and your MLS board.
  • Respond as quickly as possible to avoid delays.
  • MLS approvals can take time, especially during the MLS review phase.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by a chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Homeowner Agent
title: Homeowner Agent
body:
Introduction

Homeowner Agent is designed to help you stay connected with your homeowner leads, understand their readiness to sell, and nurture relationships with timely market and property insights. This feature is currently available to all accounts that previously purchased Home Reports—your existing reports have already been upgraded to Homeowner Reports.

This feature is currently being beta tested. Please reach out to support@lofty.com to request access.

Summary

  • Introduction Video
  • Who Can Be Added to Homeowner Agent?
  • Which Properties Can Be Monitored?
  • Creating a Smart Homeowner Report
  • Understanding Nurturing Status
  • Homeowner Page
  • Campaigns
  • Settings
  • Upgrading Your Property Quota

 

Introduction Video

 

Who Can Be Added to Homeowner Agent?

A lead is eligible if:

  • The lead is visible to you (the agent)
  • The lead type is Seller or Homeowner
  • There is at least one valid property associated
  • The primary email is valid and opted in
  • The lead is not in the trash
  • The lead is subscribed to the Homeowner Agent report
  • The lead matches your Homeowner Agent filters (Source, Pipeline, Tags, Primary agent assignment)

 

Which Properties Can Be Monitored?

A property qualifies if:

  • It is labeled as Home, Lease, or Investment
  • It is not listed in the MLS (active or sold) or as a pocket listing
  • It has a valid Automated Valuation Model (AVM)

 

Creating a Homeowner Agent Report

  1. Go to a Seller or Homeowner Lead and select “Automations.”
  2. Find “Homeowner Agent Report” and click “+ New Report.”
    • If the lead doesn’t meet the criteria above, this option will be unavailable.
  3. Select the property from the location text box. If the property is not eligible, you will be notified.

 

Understanding Nurturing Status

Nurturing status shows how close a homeowner is to reaching out. You can view details for each lead in the Automation → Homeowner Agent section.

  • Warming Up: Newly added leads, first 4 weeks in the program
  • Long-Term Nurturing: No selling interest after 4 weeks, or previous sales attempts didn’t close
  • Engaged: Lead takes meaningful actions (e.g., clicks in emails, requests more info)
  • Hand-Off (Sales-Ready): Lead shows strong intent (e.g., requests a CMA, schedules an appointment, or AI detects high selling intent). Automated campaigns stop for these leads.

 

Monitoring Quota

  • Your quota is based on the number of properties being monitored, not just the number of leads.
  • One lead may have multiple reports for multiple properties.

 

Homeowner Intent 

Homeowner Agent uses property data and ownership behavior to categorize leads:

  • Likely Sellers (High Intent): Owned 10+ years with ≥50% equity, or 3–10 years with significant appreciation and equity
  • Newer/Long-Term Nurture: Less appreciation/equity or ownership under 3 years
  • Foreclosure/Pre-Foreclosure: Property marked as pre-foreclosure
  • Absentee Owner/Investor: Not owner-occupied
  • Other/General Homeowner: Does not meet the above criteria

 

Homeowner Page

For each monitored lead, you’ll see:

  • Lead name
  • Nurturing status
  • Properties under monitoring
  • Activity timeline
  • Emails sent and opened

Actions you can take:

  • Pause or restart monitoring
  • Remove a lead from Smart Homeowner

 

Campaigns

Email campaigns are tailored to each homeowner’s status:

  • Welcome Campaign: Sent immediately when a lead is added (one-time email)
  • Warming Up Campaign: Weekly emails during the first 4 weeks
  • Long-Term Campaign: Monthly emails (alternating Home and Market Reports)

Other campaign options include Facebook marketing, postcards, and text messages. Lead engagement and email performance metrics are available on the Overview Page.

 

Settings

Default settings are optimized for best results but can be customized. Choose which leads qualify using filters like Source, Pipeline, Tags, and Assignee.

 

Create customizable “Cash Offer Cards” on the Home Report to promote special offers.

 

The welcome email sent when a Homeowner Agent Report is created is fully editable.

Upgrading Your Property Quota

If you would like to monitor additional properties, navigate to Automation > Homeowner Agent and select Upgrade. 

 
The minimum quota is $50 for 1,000 properties. The quota can be adjusted in increments of 10. 

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by a chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: SEO Performance Overview: Understand What’s Driving Your Online Growth
title: SEO Performance Overview: Understand What’s Driving Your Online Growth
body:
Introduction

Your SEO Performance Overview is designed to give you a clear, fast understanding of how your website is performing and what’s helping (or hurting) your visibility online. You don’t need to be an SEO expert to use it. This page highlights what matters most so you can make smarter decisions, faster.

Summary

  • Introduction Video
  • AI Insight Summary (At a Glance)
  • Traffic & Growth Overview
  • Top Agents in Your Market
  • What’s Driving Your Growth?
    • How People Find You (Top Searches)
    • How Often AI Recommends You
    • How Your Website Performs
  • What We Monitor (Behind the Scenes)

 

Introduction Video

 

Performance Dashboard

At the top of your dashboard, you’ll see an AI-generated summary of your overall performance. This snapshot looks across all your data and answers one simple question:

Is your online presence growing, declining, or staying flat — and why?

Think of this as your weekly “state of the business” update for SEO and AI visibility. Click Ask AI to open the AI Assistant panel or click View SEO Report to see your report. 

 

Traffic & Growth Overview

This section shows how people are finding your website and whether your efforts are paying off.

You can quickly review:

  • Total website traffic

  • Growth or decline compared to the previous period

  • Where your traffic is coming from, including:

    • Search engines (Google, Bing, etc.)

    • AI search (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude)

    • Social media

    • Other referral sources

This helps you immediately understand whether recent marketing, SEO, or content updates are driving real results.

Top Agents in Your Market

Wondering how you stack up against other agents and brokerages in your area? This panel shows you exactly that.

You’ll see:

  • Your ranking position in your local market

  • Top-performing competitors

  • Number of keywords you rank for
    Keywords where your site appears within the top 100 search results

  • AI Mention Rate
    How often AI tools reference or recommend each brand

This makes it easy to understand your competitive position, not just on Google, but inside AI-powered search tools too.

What’s Driving Your Growth?

How People Find You (Top Searches)

This section highlights the top 10 search terms bringing people to your website.

For each keyword, you’ll see:

  • Your current ranking position

  • Whether your ranking is moving up or down

  • Traffic generated from that keyword

  • Monthly search volume

Pro tip:
Pay special attention to high-volume keywords that are trending downward. Those are often your biggest opportunities for improvement.

If you’re unsure what a keyword means or how to improve it, you can ask AI to explain it in plain language.

How Often AI Recommends You

Search isn’t just about Google anymore. Buyers and sellers are asking AI tools for agent recommendations and this section shows how often you show up.

You’ll see:

  • Your AI Mention Rate

  • Real example prompts people are using in AI searches

  • Which AI platforms are returning results, including:

    • ChatGPT

    • Gemini

    • Claude

This helps you understand your visibility in the fastest-growing search channel today.

How Your Website Performs

This section shows a comprehensive SEO & AI-readiness audit of your website, all automatically monitored for you.

You’ll see:

  • Total pages analyzed

  • Overall site health score (0–100)

  • Issues automatically fixed by the system

  • Issues that need your review or action

The audit looks at things like:

  • Website technical health

  • Page speed and performance

  • Structured data

  • AI visibility and crawlability

You don’t need to understand the technical details, the system tracks them for you and flags only what matters. If you want a clearer explanation, you can ask AI to walk you through the report in simple terms.

What We Monitor (Behind the Scenes)

We run hundreds of technical checks behind the scenes to keep your website healthy and competitive.

You don’t need to manage or understand these individually.

What matters to you is:

  • Whether your site is healthy

  • What’s already been handled automatically

  • What (if anything) needs manual optimization

Your dashboard always focuses on status and action, not technical noise.

Bottom Line

Your SEO Performance Overview is your single source of truth for:

  • Website traffic

  • Local competition

  • Keyword performance

  • AI visibility

  • Website health

Use it to spot trends, identify opportunities, and stay ahead without needing to become an SEO expert. If you ever have questions, just ask the AI built into your dashboard. It’s there to help you every step of the way.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your CRM.

name: Feature Updates for Lofty 4.35
title: Feature Updates for Lofty 4.35
body:
Introduction

Be sure to subscribe here to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!

Important: Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons that you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/standard user). These features are subject to change at any time.

 

Summary

  • Lofty AI Assistant New Features
  • New AI Assistant Welcome Message
  • Personal Disclaimer Update
  • AI Listing Search
  • Smart Plan UI Updates
  • VoIP on Mobile (iOS Only)

Lofty AI Assistant New Features

  • Introducing new Lofty AI Assistant features that improve research, file-based work, and long-running requests.

  • Enhancements focus on transparency, productivity, and flexibility, and are available to all AI Assistant users.

The Lofty AI Assistant now includes an enhanced Web Search experience, file uploads, and offline tasks. Web Search allows the Assistant to retrieve up-to-date information and clearly display clickable source links, improving transparency and trust. File uploads are now supported on web and mobile, enabling you to ask questions and complete tasks using your own documents, images, or data files. For complex or time-consuming requests, the Assistant can run tasks in the background and notify you when they are complete. 

Learn more here: AI Assistant

 

New AI Assistant Welcome Message

  • Introducing a new, context-aware welcome message in the Lofty AI Assistant to help you get started faster.

  • Provides one-click suggested actions tailored to the specific page that you are on.

The Lofty AI Assistant now displays a welcome message the first time it’s opened on each page. This message adapts to your current location—such as the Dashboard, People page, Lead Detail pages, Calendar, or Transactions—to offer relevant guidance and suggested next steps. Below the message, you'll see a short list of recommended, high-value actions. Selecting one automatically starts the AI conversation, while you can still enter your own requests at any time.

 

Personal Disclaimer Update

  • Added an additional personal disclaimer.

You can now add more than one personal disclaimer to your profile. The disclaimers added here will automatically sync to your website's footer. Learn more here: Personal Disclaimer

AI Listing Search 

This feature is being beta tested. You may or may not have access to this feature. Please reach out to support@lofty.com to request access.

  • AI Listing Search is a new natural language search experience for finding listings faster.

  • Automatically converts plain-language requests into structured search filters.

AI Listing Search allows both you and visitors to your website to search for listings using natural language instead of manually setting filters. Switch to AI Search Mode and describe what you're looking for. The system automatically interprets the request, applies relevant filters, and updates results in real time. Manual filters remain available and can be adjusted after the AI search is applied. This feature is available on both the Listing Discovery page and on your Lofty website listing search. 

Smart Plan UI Updates

  • Redesign of the Smart Plan experience with a cleaner layout and improved organization.

  • Makes it easier to browse, manage, and preview Smart Plans and templates.

The Smart Plan experience has been updated with a modern, streamlined interface. Personal, office, and company Smart Plans are now combined into a single page, with a new Scope filter to quickly switch views. Smart Plans and library templates can be displayed in a card-based layout, making them easier to scan and compare, while the updated list view offers a cleaner design with filters moved to the top for faster access. As part of this update, the legacy Smart Plan Report has been temporarily removed while more detailed, plan-level performance insights are being developed. No Smart Plans or templates were removed as part of this change.

VoIP on Mobile (iOS Only)

  • We've added an Enable VoIP Calls setting in the Lofty iOS app to manage how incoming calls are delivered.

  • Helps prevent duplicate incoming call notifications when receiving calls through bridge mode.

This update introduces an Enable VoIP Calls setting for Lofty mobile app (iOS) users. When turned on (default), incoming calls are shown using Apple’s native call screen. When turned off, notifications are suppressed, allowing calls to be handled through bridge mode only. 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

Be sure to subscribe here to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!

name: Follow Up Boss Port In Process
title: Follow Up Boss Port In Process
body:
Introduction


If you are moving your phone numbers from Follow Up Boss (FUB) to Lofty, the process is streamlined because both platforms use Twilio as their phone service provider. This is referred to as a "Twilio to Twilio internal transfer."


What You Need to Provide

To begin the porting process, please provide the following information to your Lofty onboarding specialist or support contact:

  1. FUB Twilio Account SID:
    The unique identifier for your FUB Twilio account (your onboarding specialist can help you obtain this if needed).

  2. Phone Numbers to Port:
    List all phone numbers you wish to move, in E164 format (e.g., +12134773317).

  3. Country:
    Indicate whether each number is a US or Canadian number.

  4. Assignment Details: (to be collected by the assisting Lofty point of contact)
    Please provide the following information:

    1. ID Type

    2. Number

    3. Number Type

    4. Office Name

    5. Country

  5. Approval Email:
    An email from the current account holder (FUB) approving the transfer of the numbers to Lofty.

What Happens Next

  • Lofty Support Submits the Request:
    Lofty’s support team will submit a porting request to Twilio, referencing your FUB account and the numbers you want to move.

  • Twilio Approval:
    Twilio will contact FUB (the current account holder) for approval. Once approved, Twilio will transfer the numbers to Lofty’s Twilio account.

  • Assignment in Lofty:
    After the transfer is complete, Lofty will assign the numbers as you requested (personal, team, or AI numbers).

  • Reconfigure Messaging Campaigns:
    You will need to reconfigure your brand and messaging campaigns in Lofty’s 10DLC system after the port is complete.

How Long Does It Take?

  • The porting process typically takes at least 1 week from the time all information is submitted and approvals are received.

Important Notes

  • Please make sure all required information is provided up front to avoid delays.

  • If you need to escalate the process, contact your Lofty onboarding specialist or support representative.


Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: AI Lead Health Analysis: Understand and Prioritize Your Leads
title: AI Lead Health Analysis: Understand and Prioritize Your Leads
body:
Introduction


AI Lead Health Analysis helps you quickly evaluate the quality of your lead database and identify which leads deserve immediate attention. In just a few clicks (or a simple AI Assistant prompt), you’ll get a clear report covering data completeness, lead segmentation, and personalized recommendations.

Summary

  • What AI Lead Health Analysis Does
  • Where to Start the Analysis (Entry Points)
  • How to View the Report
  • Understanding Your Lead Analysis Report
  • Usage Limits
  • Best Practices

What AI Lead Health Analysis Does

When you run an analysis, AI reviews your leads and generates a structured report that includes:

  • An overview of your full lead set

  • A data health check to spot missing or incomplete fields

  • Lead segmentation into actionable priority groups

  • Dynamic, AI-generated insights tailored to your data

This report is designed to help you clean up your database, focus on the best opportunities, and build an efficient follow-up plan.

Where to Start the Analysis (Entry Points)

You can run AI Lead Health Analysis in two ways:

1) After Lead Import

Once your lead import completes:

  1. You’ll see a Call to Action: “Start Analyzing My Imported Leads.”

  2. Click to open AI Assistant, which automatically starts the analysis.

  3. You’ll also receive an email notification prompting you to run the health check.

This is the recommended path right after bringing in a new batch of leads.

2) Through AI Assistant Anytime

You can trigger lead analysis directly from AI Assistant using natural language, for example:

  • “Analyze all my leads”

  • “Check my lead quality”

  • “Find my high-priority leads”

The AI Assistant will begin analyzing your leads and generate the report in the same format.

 

How to View the Report

After analysis completes, you can open the report from:

  • Notification Center - In the Action section

  • AI Assistant - In the AI Assistant chat panel

 

Understanding Your Lead Analysis Report

Your report is divided into four main sections:

1) Overview & Key Insights

A high-level snapshot of your database, including:

  • Total number of leads analyzed

  • Distribution across lead categories

  • Key insights highlighting the most important takeaways

Use this section to get an immediate sense of your overall lead quality and where your focus should go.

2) Data Health Check

A detailed review of data completeness. AI flags issues like:

  • Missing phone number or email

  • Missing budget

  • Missing location

You’ll also see charts and percentages that help you quickly assess data quality at a glance.

Why it matters: clean data improves routing, prioritization, and conversion rates.

3) Lead Segmentation

AI organizes leads into clear, actionable groups:

  • High-Value Leads
    Leads with strong potential and complete enough data to act on now.

  • Need Review Leads
    Leads that show promise but require a quick check or clarification.

  • Require Nurturing Leads
    Leads that aren’t ready yet but could convert with consistent follow-up.

  • Dormant / No-Data Leads
    Leads missing critical basic information and likely needing data enrichment before they can be used.

Each segment includes explanations and examples so you understand why leads landed there and what to do next.

4) Dynamic Insights

This is the “smart” part of the report: AI generates insights based on your leads, such as:

  • Source Insights
    Which lead sources perform best, and which tend to bring incomplete or lower-quality data.

  • Action Plan
    Recommended next steps, including quick fixes, longer-term improvements, and automation opportunities.

Note: This section varies per user and per analysis, depending on what AI finds in your data.

 

Usage Limits

To keep performance fast and insights fresh:

  • You can run Lead Health Analysis once per day.

  • Each run can analyze up to 500 leads at a time.

 

Best Practices

For the most value from AI Lead Health Analysis:

  • Run it right after importing new leads to confirm quality before outreach.

  • Use it for periodic database cleanups, especially if your lead sources change.

  • Address Data Health Check gaps first to improve segmentation accuracy.

  • Follow the Action Plan in Dynamic Insights to build a sustainable lead workflow.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

body:
Introduction

Be sure to subscribe here to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!

Summary

  • New Navigation Bar

New Navigation Bar

Overview

  • Lofty’s navigation bar has been redesigned for faster access and an easier onboarding experience.

  • Core product functionality remains unchanged; only menu locations have been updated.

Release Details

The updated navigation bar reorganizes features into clearer, more intuitive menu groups, helping you move through the CRM with fewer clicks. All existing tools and capabilities are still available, but several items have been moved to new locations. Notably, the Settings page has been removed from the main navigation and is now located in the Avatar menu.

Lead Detail Page Update

Overview

  • The Lead Detail Page has been redesigned to better match real-world lead management workflows.

  • New tabs, streamlined note types, and reorganized data make it easier to manage properties, searches, transactions, documents, and automations.

Release Details

The updated Lead Detail Page introduces new tabs: Seller Properties, Buyer Searches, Transactions, Documents, and Automations to provide clear separation of lead activities. Insight data now appears above the Details section, and all search-related history has been moved into Preference Profiles under the Searches tab. New note types support faster showing logging and document uploads, each creating a corresponding timeline entry. All existing smart plans and alerts remain unchanged, and historical Search Criteria data has been migrated automatically to the new structure.

Learn more here: Lead Profile Page
 

Transaction Management & Offer Comparison

Overview

  • New AI-powered tools now enable you to search, create, and update transactions using natural language.

  • A new Offer Comparison feature provides side-by-side offer reviews with an auto-generated summary.

Release Details

AI Transaction Management allows you to manage transactions through conversational inputs, including searching by criteria such as stage, property address, associated lead, and close dates; creating new transactions with basic details; and updating existing transactions through natural language commands.
The new Offer Comparison feature lets you compare multiple offers from a listing or transaction. AI generates a summary and a visual side-by-side report to help sellers understand key differences between competing offers. Learn more here: Offer Management
 

Buyer Lead Offer Management

Overview

  • Create and manage buyer-side offers directly from the Lead Detail Page.

  • All offers tied to a lead are centralized for easier review, editing, and transaction creation.

Release Details

A new offer workflow is available in the Searches tab of the Lead Detail Page, where you can manually add offers and track the status (Submitted, Accepted, Declined, Lost, or Withdrawn). Each offer includes actions such as deleting, adding notes, viewing details, or creating a transaction. When a transaction is created from an offer, the property information from the offer is automatically applied. All offers created in this area are buyer-side only, and associated lead and transaction type settings remain fixed for data consistency. 

Sales Tab Offer Management


Overview

  • A new Offer List view in Sales → Offer centralizes all listing-side and buyer-side offers.

  • Offers are automatically grouped based on how and where they were created, reducing duplicates and simplifying review.

Release Details

The new Offer List view provides a unified location for managing offers created from listings, transactions, or buyer leads. Listing-side offers are grouped when they originate from the same listing or listing-side transaction, while buyer-side offers are grouped by lead. Each row displays key information such as address, offer count, and highest/lowest offer amounts. Open any offer group to view or edit individual offers. This update streamlines offer organization and improves visibility across all active and historical offer activity.
 

New Marketing Tab → Email

Overview

Note: This feature is being beta tested. You may or may not have access to this feature.

  • The Marketing → Email module now provides a centralized view of all mass-email activity.

  • Three updated sections—Overview, Campaigns, and Templates—deliver clearer analytics, improved campaign management, and enhanced template organization.

Release Details

The new Email Overview Dashboard consolidates performance metrics, including sends, opens, replies, bounces, and time-based trends. Campaigns now feature improved filtering, clearer audience details, and a two-tab Campaign Detail page for email previews and analytics. Sent campaigns include recipient-level behavior with export options. The Templates area has been redesigned with folder navigation, search, card/list views, and bulk actions. Users can create templates using either the Classic Email Editor or the Drag-and-Drop Email Editor. Learn more here: Email Templates
 

New Marketing Tab → Text Messages

Note: This feature is being beta tested. You may or may not have access to this feature.

Overview

  • The new Marketing → Text Messages module provides centralized analytics and management for all text-message activity.

  • The module includes Overview, Campaigns, and Templates sections, with tools for performance tracking, compliance alerts, and text-package monitoring. Text sending will be added in a future release.

Release Details

The Overview Dashboard consolidates metrics such as texts sent, delivered, delivery rate, replies, and historical trends. A My Text License panel shows package usage with alerts when limits are exceeded. The Campaigns section lists all text campaigns with search, filtering, delivery insights, and detailed engagement data. Templates remain consistent with existing text-template functionality. New system notifications alert you when required compliance settings—such as 10DLC registration or quiet hours—are missing. Learn more here: Text Templates

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Understanding the AI Copilots Ecosystem: Assistant and Agents
title: Understanding the AI Copilots Ecosystem: Assistant and Agents
body:
Overview

We have restructured the AI Copilots platform to function as a comprehensive professional ecosystem. This new architecture distinguishes between the interface you interact with (the "Brain") and the specialized tools that execute tasks (the "Hands").

This guide explains the difference between the AI Assistant and the AI Agents, outlines the specific roles of each agent, clarifies recent naming changes, and details the pricing structure.

 

1. The Core Structure: Brain vs. Hands

The AI Copilots ecosystem is designed to replicate a real-world human team structure:

The AI Assistant (The "Brain")

The AI Assistant is your primary interface and orchestrator. It is the central point of contact that listens to your requests, understands your context, and manages administrative workflows.

  • Role: Personal Assistant & Project Manager.
  • Interaction Channels: Direct interaction via Chat, Email, SMS, and Voice (future release).
  • Key Capabilities:
    • Calendar Management: Scheduling, reminders, and coordination.
    • Inbox Management: Organizing emails, surfacing priorities, and automating responses.
    • Web Search: Retrieves real-time information from internet sources to aid decision-making.
    • Document Handling: Intelligently uploads, categorizes, and retrieves files.

The AI Agents (The "Hands")

Under the supervision of the AI Assistant operates a team of Specialized AI Agents. These are virtual experts trained in specific domains (such as sales, marketing, or design). When the Assistant receives a complex request, it delegates the execution to the appropriate Agent.

 

2. Comprehensive Breakdown of AI Agents

Each AI Agent is designed to automate and optimize a specific vertical of your real estate business.

Sales Agent (previously "Sales Assistant")

Status: Available Now

The Sales Agent functions as your dedicated, 24/7 virtual Inside Sales Agent (ISA). Its primary goal is to capture, qualify, and convert leads into appointments.

  • Website Visitor Capture & Lead Qualification: Automatically engages traffic on your website, profiling visitors and qualifying their intent in real-time.
  • Automated Lead Nurturing & Follow-up: Executes consistent follow-up campaigns via text and email to ensure no lead falls through the cracks.
  • Smart Appointment Setting: Identifies when a lead is ready to meet and handles the scheduling logistics to book appointments directly on your calendar.
  • Personalized Lead Responses: Uses advanced context understanding to provide natural, human-like responses tailored to the lead's specific inquiries.

Social Agent (previously "AI Marketer")

Status: Available Now

The Social Agent acts as your automated social media manager, building brand presence and engagement without manual oversight.

  • Market and Competitor Insight: Analyzes market trends and competitor activity to inform strategy.
  • Weekly Social Planning: Automatically creates and schedules consistent content calendars.
  • AI-Generated Listing Captions: Instantly drafts engaging, professional captions for property listings.
  • Automatic Posting: Publishes content simultaneously across multiple channels (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, etc.).

SEO Agent (New)

Status: Currently Beta Testing

The SEO Agent serves as a technical marketing expert, ensuring your digital presence is optimized for both traditional search engines and AI-driven search tools.

  • Traffic Analysis: Identifies specific keywords and content strategies driving traffic.
  • AI Search Optimization: Optimizes content to ensure visibility in AI chatbot recommendations.
  • Site Optimization: Enhances website content structure and metadata.
  • Competitor Analysis: Provides actionable insights to outrank local competitors.

Homeowner Agent (New)

Status: Coming Soon

More details coming soon. 

Transaction Agent (New)

Status: Coming Soon

More details coming soon. 

Website Building Agent (New)

Status: Coming Soon

More details coming soon. 

 

3. Workflow Example: The Multi-Agent Ecosystem

The true power of the platform lies in the collaboration between the Assistant and the Agents.

Scenario: A user asks, "Hi, could you please follow up with all my new Zillow leads automatically?"

  1. Input: The user speaks or types to the AI Assistant.
  2. Processing: The AI Assistant (The Brain) interprets the intent, identifies the target audience (Zillow leads), and determines the required action (follow-up).
  3. Delegation: The Assistant assigns the task to the Sales Agent.
  4. Execution: The Sales Agent (The Hands) executes the specific automation scripts to text or email those leads.

 

4. Product Renaming & Terminology

To align with this new structure, previous product names have been updated:

name: Canva Integration
title: Canva Integration
body:
Introduction

Note: This feature is expected to be available soon!

The Lofty × Canva Integration allows you to create high-quality marketing materials faster and more accurately, without manual data entry. With this integration, you can:

  • Access your Lofty property listings and agent profiles directly inside Canva.

  • Drag and drop real-time Lofty data, including text and photos, into any Canva design.

  • Export completed Canva designs back into Lofty → Design Center → My Designs for easy storage and reuse.

Best of all, a paid Canva plan is not required. You can take advantage of the integration with a free Canva account.

How to Access the Integration

Step 1: Install the Lofty App in Canva

  1. Open the Canva App Marketplace.

  2. Search for “Lofty”.

  3. Click Install and follow the prompts to connect your Lofty account.

Step 2: Open the Lofty App in the Canva Editor

  1. Open any Canva design.

  2. Click Apps in the left sidebar.

  3. Select Lofty to open the Listings, Agents, and Export tabs.

How to Use the Integration

Importing Lofty Listings into Canva

  1. Open the Listings tab.

  2. Search or browse your listings.

  3. Click any listing to view its available details.

  4. Drag text or photos into your design.

Importing Agent Information into Canva

  1. Open the Agents tab.

  2. Search or browse the agents you have permission to view.

  3. Drag any detail you need directly onto your canvas.

Exporting Canva Designs Back to Lofty

  1. Open the Export tab.

  2. Optionally rename the design.

  3. Click Export to Lofty.

Your design will appear in:
Lofty → Design Center → My Designs → Canva Designs

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

Social Studio Auto-Post Logic Optimization

  • Redesigned auto-post controls make “My/Team/Other” toggles the single source of truth.

  • Prevents unwanted or duplicate social posts.


Each category toggle (My, Team, Other) now independently determines whether listings in that category auto-post on status change based on your triggers. Turning a toggle OFF stops future auto-posts regardless of existing feed records; turning it ON allows auto-posts when conditions match. “Clear All” still resets feed records, triggers, and connected profiles.

Actions for You
Review and set desired toggles. Use Clear All to restart setup if needed. Learn more here: AI Marketer

 

Goal Setting Optimization

  • Activity Goals are now separate from Business Goals.

  • New Activity Goal report under Reporting → Agent Activity.


You can set call/appointment objectives without creating transaction goals. Reporting adds a dedicated Activity Goal view for tracking progress, improving clarity for roles such as inside sales agents.

No action required. Optionally review goal configurations and use Reporting → Agent Activity → Activity Goal. Learn more here: Goal Setting Portal

Transaction Page Update & New Offer Page

In Listing-type Transactions, the Offer tab supports link-based submissions from buyer agents and manual entry by listing agents. You can mark, edit, delete, and note offers. The History page is now called Activities; controls for type switching, List/Board view, and Stage Settings are streamlined.

Revamped Dotloop Integration

Connect Dotloop in Personal Settings to enable real-time updates both directions. Send to Dotloop from Lead/Transaction, map existing loops, choose data precedence during claim, and view synced documents in a dedicated folder. Disconnecting does not remove historical data.

Install the Lofty app in Canva to drag-and-drop Listings or Agent details into templates. Exports are saved to Design Center → My Designs → Canva Designs (auto-created). Works with free Canva accounts.

Actions for You

The Assistant centralizes chat, email/SMS, reminders, and web search, while domain-specific Agents execute tasks (e.g., sales follow-up, marketing). Users interact with one Assistant that coordinates underlying automations.

name: Partner with Lofty
title: Partner with Lofty
body:
Introduction

Lofty welcomes partnership opportunities that align with our mission to empower real estate professionals through technology and marketing innovation. This page outlines how partnership requests are submitted, evaluated, and processed, including our commitment to response timelines and collaboration expectations.

 

Summary

  • Submitting a Partnership Request
  • Evaluation and Initial Response Process
  • Internal Review and Deliberation
  • Triage and Assessment
  • Stakeholder Presentation
  • Decision and Notification
  • Partnership Timelines

 

Submitting a Partnership Request

Want to explore working together? Submit your request using our official form:

Lofty Partnership Request Form

When filling it out, please highlight:

  • The business value your integration or partnership would deliver (to Lofty, to your users, and to our mutual customers)

  • A high-level vision of how this would work (technical, functional, or go-to-market)

  • Any customer champions, metrics, references, or use case examples you have.

We appreciate you giving these details upfront - you help us move faster by giving us what we need to evaluate and get back to you sooner.

 

Evaluation and Initial Response Process

Once your submission hits our inbox, we will:

  • Acknowledge receipt

  • Ask clarifying questions (if needed)

We commit to doing that within 5 business days of your submission. Think of this as your first touchpoint with our team. 

 

Internal Review and Deliberation

Here's what happens next,  behind the scenes:

Triage and Assessment

  • Our Partnerships team inspects the proposal for fit: strategic alignment, technical feasibility, business value, and risk. 

Stakeholder Presentation

  • If it clears triage, we present to our key decision-makers in Product and Business Leadership. We aim for speed - but recognize that deeper reviews (especially for complex integrations or financial models) will take more time. 

Decision and Notification

  • We'll let you know where things land:

    • ✅ Approved to proceed

    • 🚧 Needs more information

    • ❌ Declined (with reasoning, if possible)

  • If we move forward, we kick off a discussion to determine what (if any) formal agreement framework is needed.

 

Partnership Timelines

 

 

We strive to move quickly, but delays are inevitable—especially where legal, compliance, or partner-side engineering is involved. We’ll be transparent about changes in timeline and deliver updates regularly.

name: Cloze Integration
title: Cloze Integration
body:
Introduction

The Cloze integration empowers you to connect Lofty's IDX website activity and lead information to your Cloze CRM, without the need for third-party connection tools like Zapier. 

 

About the Integration

This is a one-way integration that syncs your website activity and lead information from Lofty to Cloze.

The following data will be synced automatically from Lofty to Cloze:

 

Basic Lead Information 

  • First Name
  • Last Name
  • Phone Numbers
  • Email Addresses
  • Tags
  • Mailing Addresses

 

Lofty Website Activities

  • A lead views a listing 3+ times
  • A lead saves a listing on the site
  • A lead requests a showing from a listing page
  • A lead saves a message from the fields on the website
  • A lead saves a search on the website
  • A lead uses the mortgage calculator 3+ times in one day
  • A lead submits a form on your website when logged in
  • A lead returns to your website who has not visited for at least 5 days before
  • A lead indicates that they intend to sell via the "Sell My Home" or "Home Evaluation" forms on your Lofty website
  • Back on Market - a lead re-registers through a third-party source
  • Back on Market - a lead sends in a text code

 

Manual Notes

  • Any manually-added notes will sync from Lofty to Cloze

 

Connect your Lofty and Cloze accounts

To connect Cloze and Lofty, open your Lofty account and navigate to Personal Settings > Integrations. Scroll down until you find the Cloze option, then click Connect.

*Note: this integration connects your accounts via Oauth. Please make sure that you are logged into your desired Cloze account in the same browser. 

 

Clicking Connect opens a pop-up that will ask you to confirm the one-way integration:

 

Then you will be asked to authorize Lofty to access your Cloze account. At the bottom of the window, you will see which Cloze account you are currently logged into. Confirm that this is correct before you approve the integration. If you need to switch accounts, close out of the integration window.

 

Lead Syncing Logic

After you authorize the integration, all leads where you are the primary agent will be synced to Cloze. 

We will call Cloze's API to determine whether you are on a team or individual account.

  • In Individual Mode:
    • When there is a new or updated lead, we will create/update the person in Cloze
  • In Team Mode:
    • In addition to creating/updating the person in Cloze, we will set the defaultAssignTo attribute to the assignee's email

name: Sunsetting of LoftyWorks (Property Management Add-On)
