name: Realtor.com Integration
title: Realtor.com Integration
body:
Introduction

In this article, we will review how to set up email parsing in Lofty for Realtor.com leads or a direct/automatic lead import into Lofty of Connections℠ Plus or Market VIP leads from Realtor.com via API.

  • Email Parsing Method 
  • Connections℠ Plus Leads via API
  • Market VIP Leads via API

Email Parsing Method

What kind of Email will be parsed?

Lofty can parse a new lead into your CRM based on an email alert that comes from Realtor.com to your Lofty-integrated email. Here are the common items that Lofty searches for in Email Parsing:

From address: leads@email.realtor.com


How to Set it Up

Go to https://dashboard.realtor.com/ and use your agent login details to sign in. This will take you to the Realtor.com agent dashboard.

 

 

Click the Settings in the dropdown menu of your profile photo.

 

Click Lead Settings.

 

In ConnectionsSM for Buyers, Profile leads and Courtesy leads, click on Change to open the Send leads to the dropdown menu.

 

In the dropdown menu, select CRM. To the right, enter your integrated email address (with Lofty) or your unique Lofty email address.

 

In Email format, please choose HTML emails. Finally, click Save, and your Realtor.com leads will now be forwarded directly into your CRM.

Note: We suggest that you also add your email to Realtor.com to receive leads. In this way, you can test whether a lead has been imported to your CRM after you receive the lead notification email.  

 

How to find your unique lofty email address in Lofty

Go to the Settings page, and under the Features section on the right of the page, click Lead Capture.

At the bottom of this page, you will find the option to auto-import leads via third-party providers. Here, you will see your Lofty email, which you will use to auto-import leads from Realtor.com. In this section, click the Copy. 

 

Connections℠ Plus Leads via API

This connection is only for Connections℠ Plus Leads and works via Realtor.com's lead delivery API (eLeads). If you have a Pro account with Realtor.com, you can have your Connections℠ Plus leads imported into Lofty automatically when a new lead is generated. 

Any lead added to Lofty via the API will have a tag added to it of "Realtor API". 

*IMPORTANT: Please note that this connection method is available for Connections℠ Plus leads only. It is not currently available for other leads, including Advantage℠ Pro and Profile leads. These kinds of leads can only be imported through the email parsing mentioned previously.

 

Lofty Setup

This connection is found under Settings >Lead Settings > Lead Capture > Lofty CRM Preferred Lead Providers: 

The "Imported as Company Leads" option can be used to bring the lead in as either a Company Lead or a Personal Lead (see Lead Ownership). If turned off, the lead will come in as a Personal Lead and will not be distributed via lead routing.

If the lead comes in as a Company Lead, it will be distributed according to lead routing as long as "Third Party Providers" is checked under Settings > Lead Distribution > Lead Routing: 

 

 

If you would like to send a Welcome Email to the leads imported via this method, you can do so via the option seen below. You can always manually invite these leads to view your website later, so this is not a requirement. See Set Up the Welcome Email for more information.

 

Realtor.com Setup

This setup is mainly done in the settings of your Realtor Pro account. Navigate to Realtor.com and log in via your Pro account. Then, in your Realtor.com account, go to Settings > Lead Settings > ConnectionsSM Plus > Add Lead Delivery API. You can also click THIS link to go there directly. 

In this section, you have to complete the four different fields seen in the screenshot below:

1. Under "API source application," choose "Other application" 
2. For "Application URL," copy the URL found in Lofty under Settings > Features > Lead Capture Lofty CRM Preferred Lead Providers > Realtor.com > Webhook Link. 

3. For "API Key," copy the key found in Lofty under Settings > Features > Integrations > API (at the bottom):

name: Slybroadcast Integration
title: Slybroadcast Integration
body:
Introduction

Slybroadcast is a service that can be used to send pre-recorded “ringless voicemails” one at a time, in batches, or via a Smart Plan schedule. You can subscribe to Slybroadcast through THIS LINK. 

After you get your Slybroadcast account information, follow the steps below to integrate Slybroadcast with Lofty.

First, you need to go to the Integration Section to bind your account. Navigate to Settings > Integrations to find the option to connect Slybroadcast.

*The same single Slybroadcast account can be connected to multiple Lofty accounts.

After clicking “Connect,” enter the account login and password to complete the integration. Remember to update your account info if you ever change the account or password at Slybroadcast, otherwise, the integration will break and you will be unable to send pre-recorded voice messages through Lofty. 


Click “Disconnect” and re-enter your account login and password if you want to update your account if needed.

After the integration is complete, you can send pre-recorded voice messages in mass via the People Page--the process is basically the same as sending mass texts/emails using Lofty. Please note that Lofty will automatically remove leads with invalid numbers.

Be aware that you are not able to send an individual message directly from a lead profile, but you can still do so from the People page (by selecting only one lead instead of multiple) as described here.


When using the integration, the system requires a “Caller ID” to be selected as well as the selection of a pre-recorded voice message to work. The “Caller ID” will be shown as the number on the lead’s voicemail thus a business number would be ideal.


If you do not have any voice recordings ready to use, you can create one with this link: https://www.slybroadcast.com/addnewrecording.php.

Once you send the pre-recorded voice messages, the activity will be documented on the timeline of the lead(s). The system will update the status of the delivery of the voice message(s) as feedback is provided by Slybroadcast.

Lofty also supports sending pre-recorded voice messages with Smart Plans, but only for the “My Smart Plan” type.

The voice message(s) will be sent to the lead according to the Smart Plan steps. If the voice message delivery fails (based on the feedback from Slybroadcast), the system will convert the step to a “Call” task for manual completion.

Finally, it’s important to remember that the sending of pre-recorded voice messages can produce a variety of errors--especially when related to doing so via an automated Smart Plan. Lofty has added an email notification for abnormal situations such as incorrect account info, insufficient usage, and unavailable voice templates. Each email will outline the error for further follow-up. Please follow the suggestions when receiving the email.

*IMPORTANT: The Slybroadcast account should not be charged for failed deliveries. 

 

Questions?

name: Dubb Integration
title: Dubb Integration
body:
+

 

Introduction

One of the most powerful ways to communicate with your leads is with video messaging and one of the best tools out there to do this is Dubb. 

 

*IMPORTANT: This integration only works with the Chrome browser. You will need to access Lofty via Chrome in order to use Dubb directly on our platform. On the mobile side, you can use the Dubb mobile app to produce content and create sharable links that are sent out via SMS messages using the Lofty mobile app, but there is no direct integration at that level currently.

 

Summary

  • Video Introduction
  • Sign Up with Dubb
  • Dubb + Lofty Setup
    • (1) Chrome Extension
    • (2) API 
  • How the Integration Works
    • Adding Videos
    • Activity Tracking
      • Mass Email / Smart Plan Logic
      • One-Off Emails

 

Video Introduction

 

Sign Up with Dubb

To use Dubb with Lofty, you must first have a Dubb account. You can set up an account by clicking on the following link: CLICK HERE.

 

You can also navigate to your Marketplace > Marketing Tools > Dubb:

 

You will use your Dubb account credentials later during the setup process so keep them available.

 

Dubb + Lofty Setup

Two separate connections need to be made to have the full functionality. Both are outlined below.

 

(1) Chrome Extension

This connection is important because it is via this one that you will record and select videos on the Lofty platform.

 

Navigate to the following link to install the Dubb Chrome Extension:

 

Link = Screen Recorder, Webcam Recorder - Dubb Video

 

Click on the Add to Chrome button to add this extension to your Chrome browser:

 

Confirm that you would like to add the extension by clicking the Add extension button:

 

You should then see a screen from Dubb explaining the basics of how to use the Dubb. Once you have reviewed and followed the indicated steps, go ahead and click on the green Continue button at the bottom.

If you have any issues in giving Dubb microphone and webcam access please review How to Allow Webcam and Mic Access to the Dubb Chrome Extension.

 

Next, click on the Dubb icon that is part of your Chrome extensions, and then click on the log-in hyperlink.

 

You will be redirected to the Dubb login page where you will sign in with the credentials that you created in the first step of this process.

 

Once you are logged in you should be redirected to the Dubb dashboard which will look something like this:

 

Click on the Dubb icon again in your menu bar and it should automatically recognize that you are signed in.

 

You have now connected Dubb to your Chrome browser via the extension which allows for it to be used in a variety of platforms, including Lofty.

 

(2) API 

This part of the connection is important because it allows for activity on your Dubb videos to feedback on the lead profiles within Lofty.

 

Sign in to Dubb, click your profile picture in the top-right, and then select Your Settings:

 

On the menu at the left, select Team and then Marketplace:

 

Scroll down until you find Dubb Lofty Extension and click the Install button:

 

You will see a pop-up appear like this:

 

To find your Lofty API key, navigate to the Lofty CRM, click on Settings > Integrations > API, and then click on the Copy button to copy your unique Lofty API Key.

Go back to the Dubb pop-up, paste the Lofty API Key into the API Key field, and then click on the blue Submit button.

 

How the Integration Works

There are two main parts to using the integration. The first is the actual embedding of videos into communication sent via the Lofty platform. The second is the activity tracking.

 

Adding Videos

In the Lofty platform, navigate to any of the tools you typically use to either send emails or text messages. Within each of these tools, you should see the Dubb icon present. If the icon is present, it means you can use Dubb to access any pre-recorded videos or record another one that can then be sent out via text or email in Lofty.

  • When sent via email, a clickable GIF will be embedded in the email.
  • When sent via text, a Dubb link will be added to the text message.

Below we will review two examples to show how this works, but the integration can be used wherever you send texts/emails in the Lofty platform including all of the following locations:

  • Email Templates
  • Text Templates
  • Smart Plans
    • Auto Emails
    • Auto Texts
  • Text Codes
  • Mass Email
  • Mass Text

 

Example 1 - Email Template

In a Smart Plan auto-email, you will see the Dubb icon here:

When you click that icon, you will see the Dubb application pop-up appear with access to videos you have already recorded or the ability to record a new one if you would like to do so.

 

Once you have selected a video that you would like to insert, you will see this screen appear. Click on the Insert Video button to add the video to the email.

 

The video will then be added directly to the email with a GIF to show a video can be clicked when the email is received by the recipient. 

 

Example 2 - Text Template

In a Smart Plan auto-text, you will see the Dubb icon here:

When you click that icon, you will see the Dubb application pop-up appear with access to videos you have already recorded or the ability to record a new one if you would like to do so.

 

Once you have selected a video that you would like to insert, you will see this screen appear. Click on the Insert Video button to add the video to the text.

 

The video will then be added directly to the text. The difference from an email is that this will just insert a link that can be sent via text, no image, etc. 

 

Activity Tracking

When we talk about "Activity Tracking" for Dubb videos, we are referring to the ability to have all of the following actions feed a log back into each corresponding Lofty lead profile:

  • CTA Clicks
  • Email Clicks
  • Emoji Reactions
  • Form Submissions
  • Email Opens
  • Video Replies
  • Page Views
  • Video Views

 

When tracked in Lofty, the logs will be documented as notes added by Dubb:

The tracking logic works slightly differently for mass emails and emails sent via Smart Plans vs. those that are one-off emails to one specific person.

 

Mass Email / Smart Plan Logic

Any emails sent via Lofty in mass or via Smart Plans will automatically have tracking data produced for everything listed above and directly in the corresponding lead profiles in Lofty.

 

One-Off Emails

For one-off emails sent via a lead profile page, it works slightly differently.

 

The very first thing that you will want to do is copy the lead's email address from their lead profile:

A one-off email is sent by navigating to a lead profile and clicking the Email button:

Click the Dubb button:

 

Choose a video that you would like to add to your email:

 

Once you select a video, you should see another pop-up appear that asks for you to enter the lead's email address. You can now paste in the email address that you copied before which will allow for Dubb to find this lead in the future and feed in the tracking details. Click on the Insert Video button to add the video to the email and proceed.

 

Questions?

name: Accessibility / ADA / WCAG Solution
title: Accessibility / ADA / WCAG Solution
body:
Lofty’s Commitment to Accessibility

Lofty is committed to ensuring our platform is accessible to all users. We take digital accessibility seriously and continuously update our system to align with WCAG 2.1 Level AA standards, which are widely recognized as the benchmark for digital accessibility.

While digital accessibility is an evolving landscape, our goal is to provide a platform that supports inclusive access for all potential home

Understanding ADA Requirements for Real Estate

Real estate professionals need to understand where they fit in the current regulatory landscape. Based on recent Department of Justice (DOJ) rulings, there are key distinctions between government and private entities:

· Private Businesses (Title III): Most real estate brokerages and agents fall under Title III of the ADA. Currently, there is no specific published rule with a technical standard or deadline for private businesses. However, courts increasingly use WCAG 2.1 Level AA as the benchmark in accessibility litigation, making voluntary compliance a best practice.

Government Entities (Title II): Recent rules establish strict compliance deadlines (April 2026 or 2027) for state and local government entities. While this applies to the public sector, it has raised the standard for accessibility expectations across the web.

Platform Accessibility Features

Lofty builds accessibility directly into the foundation of your website rather than relying on superficial fixes.
 

Default Website Template Features: The following technical features are automatically implemented and currently live in Lofty's default website template. This ensures that your site starts with a strong baseline for accessibility without requiring manual coding on your part.

· Semantic Markup: Added semantic markup to designate page elements, including text whose appearance conveys meaning.

· ARIA Implementation: Using ARIA landmarks and labels to identify regions of a page.

· Data Tables: Using tables with captions and headers to show tabular data properly.

· Tagging: Adding corresponding tags for all different page elements.

· Code Cleanliness: Removing unnecessary whitespace characters to streamline screen reader performance.

· Link Descriptions: Adding the title property or the aria-label property to labels to describe link purposes.

· Form Validation: Automatically detects input errors and provides correction suggestions to the user.

· Location Awareness: Information about the user's location is available.

· Enhanced Properties: Adding the titles property for iframes and the ALT property for images.

· Background Images: Displaying descriptive pictures as background images.

· Tooltips: Adding role="tooltip" for hover or focus content.

· Keyboard Operability: Scripting to guarantee keyboard operability for a site's basic functions.

· Focus Management: Ensuring keyboard focus can move freely on the web page.

· Accessible Naming: Providing accessible names for forms, buttons, tags, and links.

· Component Transparency: Disclosing information about components.

· Status Messages: Announcing status messages for screen reader users.

Native Compliance vs. Widgets We frequently receive requests for "accessibility icons" or "widgets." Currently, the Lofty CMS does not include a built-in accessibility widget because native accessibility (like the features listed above) is superior to "overlays." Accessibility experts often criticize overlays for creating a false sense of security while failing to resolve underlying structural issues.

---

Your Responsibility: Best Practices for Content

While Lofty provides the technical framework, the content you upload must also be accessible. Customizations can impact your compliance score. Please follow these best practices to maintain a high standard of accessibility:

· Use Alt Text: Always add descriptive alternative text to any images you upload to your website.

· Ensure Color Contrast: When customizing your theme, use sufficient color contrast between text and background colors to ensure readability.

· Structure Content: Use proper heading hierarchy (H1, H2, H3) to organize content logically. Do not just bold text to look like a header; use the correct heading tags.

· Provide Video Captions: Add captions to any video content embedded on your website.

 

Verification & Third-Party Tools

We encourage clients to verify their own website's accessibility or use additional tools if they prefer visible compliance badges.

How to Verify Accessibility: You can experience your website the way assistive technology users do by using the following tools:

  • Screen Reader Plugins: Install browser extensions (such as the Screen Reader for Chrome) to test how your content is read aloud.
  • Native Screen Readers: Use built-in tools like VoiceOver (Mac) or Narrator (Windows).

Third-Party Accessibility Widgets: If you prefer to add a visible accessibility menu or icon to your site, the Lofty CMS supports the integration of third-party tools via our "Custom Code" feature. Popular options used by real estate professionals include: 

  • AccessiBe (https://accessibe.com/ ) 
  • UserWay (https://userway.org/)

Note: These are third-party services. Clients are responsible for any associated costs and for verifying that the tool meets their specific compliance needs.

 

Audit Support

If you receive a third-party accessibility audit report, please know that many automated tests catch only about 30% of potential issues and may produce false positives.

Lofty is here to help. If you have specific findings from an audit:

  1. Contact Support: Send the report to our team.
  2. Review: We will review the findings to identify which items can be addressed through platform updates versus content adjustments you can make

We are dedicated to monitoring regulatory developments to ensure your website remains inclusive and compliant.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

Related terms: accessibility, ADA compliance, WCAG

name: Using AI Assistant Multi-Step Tasks
title: Using AI Assistant Multi-Step Tasks
body:
Introduction

The AI Assistant can create multi-step task plans to help you stay on top of lead follow-ups. Instead of setting each reminder manually, the AI Assistant generates a sequence of emails, texts, and call tasks based on your needs so you can focus more on building relationships.

This feature is currently being BETA tested! You may or may not have this feature available to you.

Summary

  • What Are Multi-Step Tasks?
  • How to Create a Multi-Step Task Plan
  • How Task Plans Work
  • Why Use Multi-Step Tasks?
  • FAQs

What Are Multi-Step Tasks?

Multi-step tasks are automated follow-up plans created by AI. Each plan can include:

  • AI Emails – Personalized emails drafted and sent automatically.

  • AI Texts – Messages drafted and sent automatically.

  • Call Tasks – Reminders for you to make important calls.

These tasks appear in two places for easy access:

  • The Lofty AI Calendar View (can be turned on/off).

  • The Lead Detail Timeline (visible on the lead’s page).

How to Create a Multi-Step Task Plan

You can start a task plan in two ways:

  1. When viewing a new lead, AI Assistant will automatically suggest a follow-up plan.

  2. By asking the AI Assistant directly – Type a request such as “send weekly emails” or “set up a 3-step follow-up,” and Copilot will draft the plan for you.

Once a plan is created, you’ll be able to:

  • Review the suggested tasks.

  • Adjust timing or message content.

  • Activate the plan once you’re happy with it.

How Task Plans Work

  • When activated, the AI Assistant will automatically schedule the tasks for you.

  • If the lead replies during the plan, all remaining tasks stop, and you’ll be notified so you can respond personally.

  • You can edit or cancel tasks at any time in the calendar view or lead timeline.

Why Use Multi-Step Tasks?

  • I encourage you to stay organized with structured follow-ups.

  • Save time by letting AI handle repetitive communication.

  • Reduce missed opportunities with consistent outreach.

  • Keep control — you can edit or stop any plan at any time.


FAQs

Can I edit AI-generated tasks?
Yes. You can adjust timing, wording, or remove steps before activating the plan.

Do I have to use AI tasks?
No. You can continue using your manual task workflow if you prefer.

What if my lead replies during a plan?
The AI Assistant immediately pauses all remaining tasks and alerts you to respond directly.

 

Questions?

Introduction

Be sure to subscribe here to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!

Important: Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons that you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/standard user). These features are subject to change at any time.

Release Date

Monday, September 8, 2025

Summary

  • Lead Ownership Simplification
  • PandaDoc Integration
  • Sales Assistant Chat Box Update
  • AI Marketer Update - September 24th Release
  • AI Copilot Generated Multi-Step Tasks (BETA)
  • Lofty Bloom Self-Purchase

 

Lead Ownership Simplification

We’ve simplified lead ownership for accounts with the Only allow Company-Owned Leads advanced setting enabled. When this setting is enabled, all leads are automatically company-owned, and ownership fields are hidden across the platform (lead profiles, people pages, and imports. This reduces complexity and confusion for agents that manage leads at the company level.

If your company needs individual lead ownership, it can be enabled anytime under Settings → Permission Profiles → Advanced Settings. Existing ownership data is preserved and will reappear if Flexible Lead Ownership is turned back on.

Learn more here: Lead Ownership

 

PandaDoc Integration

Lofty now supports PandaDoc for electronic signatures. Connect your existing PandaDoc account or create a new one directly from Lofty via the Marketplace, Personal Settings → Integrations, or the Transaction Detail Page → Documents → E-Sign. Once connected, documents (PDF, DOCX, RTF) can be bundled, sent for signature, and tracked in Lofty, while edits and signature setup are completed in PandaDoc.

The Send for E-Sign menu now shows all connected providers, giving users flexibility to choose between DocuSign and PandaDoc. Please note: PandaDoc does not support passing email subject or message content from Lofty, and you must allow browser pop-ups for the editor to open.

Learn more here: PandaDoc Integration

Sales Assistant Chat Box Update

The Sales Assistant website chat box now supports common markdown formatting, making conversations clearer and more professional. Messages can include line breaks, bold text, lists, hyperlinks, and other frequently used styles, improving readability and presentation compared to the previous plain-text format.

Learn more here: Getting Started with AI Sales Assistant

 

AI Marketer Update - September 24th Release

The following features will release on September 24th.

AI Marketer's capabilities are expanding to include an AI Competitor Analysis that informs your personalized Social Strategy. 

 

AI Social content will be generated 1 week at a time and does not require email authentication to post any more. 

 

We've improved the post list and engagement timeline so you can be better connected with the activity that takes place across your connected channels!

 

We now support AI-generated captions for listing auto-posts! These unique captions are optimized for engagement and social media algorithms. 

 

For more information on AI Marketer, visit AI Marketer.

 

AI Copilot Generated Multi-Step Tasks (BETA)

AI Copilot can now create multi-step task plans to help you stay on top of lead follow-ups. When viewing a lead or asking Copilot to handle multi-step actions (like sending weekly emails), it will generate a suggested plan with emails, texts, and call reminders. Once you review, adjust, and activate the plan, it will show up in the new “Lofty AI” calendar view as well as on the Lead Detail Timeline.

If a lead replies while a plan is running, Copilot automatically stops the remaining tasks and notifies you to take over. This makes follow-ups more consistent and less manual, while still giving you full control!

This feature is currently being BETA tested. Learn more here: Using AI Copilot Multi-Step Tasks

 

Lofty Bloom Self-Purchase

Bloom self-purchase is available, allowing you to purchase directly from the Bloom intro or zip code check page. The guided flow allows you to select up to 6 zip codes and configure the campaigns yourself. Each service area requires its own Property Monitor setup, along with postcard approval and lead capture settings.

This update eliminates the need for manual assistance from Lofty, giving you full control to purchase and launch Bloom campaigns quickly and independently. Learn more here: Lofty Bloom

name: Agent Opt-In Model: Pay By Entity
title: Agent Opt-In Model: Pay By Entity
body:
Introduction

The Agent Opt-In setting allows account admins to add agents without immediately using available seats. Agents will only activate their seat by clicking a link in the invitation email. If there aren’t enough seats available when an agent activates, your account will automatically be upgraded.

Note: This feature is not enabled by default. To request it, contact your CSM (if applicable) or our Support Team at support@lofty.com. It’s available only for Enterprise tier accounts and may not be compatible with all account types.

 

Overview

  • Platform User Vs. Display Only
  • How It Works
  • Agent Experience / Point of View
  • FAQs

 

Platform User Vs. Display Only

First, it's important to understand the difference between a Platform User and a Display Only user.

  • Platform Users are active agents on your account, who have a Lofty account that they can access, and are sitting in one of the seats you are paying for on your account.
  • Display Only Users do not have access to Lofty, are not occupying a seat on your account, and cost you nothing. They can be displayed on your website to show that they are a part of the team. 

The Agent Opt-In model is another option available to activate Platform Users on your account.

How It Works

Configure Invitation Email

The Agent Opt-in invitation is sent to the user after they are invited to join your account. The first step is to customize this invitation email. Navigate to Settings > Company > Users > + Manage Invitation Emails. The new option is the 'Opt-in Invitation Email.'

 

Here is what the default email looks like but you can return to this setting to edit its appearance at any time.

 

Send Invitation Email

Now that you have customized the invitation email, let's go over how to send it. You can send the invitation email to new users you are adding to your account or to existing display only users, to invite them to be a platform user.

When adding a new individual user

Navigate to Company Settings > Users > + Add Agent > Add A Member. The Agent Opt-In invitation is not currently available when inviting agents via csv upload.

The Add a Member window allows you to enter all of the agent's personal information. A new setting gives you the option to activate the agent right away or to send the opt-in invitation email. 

  • Activated Once Added: This is the same as our default logic where the account will be activated immediately and the invite to access the account sent to the agent. This uses one of your available seats.
  • Activated by Self Opt-in: This is the agent opt-in option. With this setting, the seat remains as 'Pending Opt-In' until the agent actually activates their account. 

 

When activating existing display only agents.

To sent the opt-in invitation to an existing Display Only user, click the Three Dots icon and select Convert to Platform User. Here, you have the exact same options as if you were adding a brand new user. 

When activating inactive agents.

If an agent's account has been deactivated, when they are reactivated, the reactivation will follow the same process that was in place when they were initially invited to the account. That is, the agent may be activated immediately or sent an opt-in invitation, depending on how they were initially added to the account. 

Agent Experience / Point of View

Once the opt-in email is triggered to the agent, it will look like the below on their end. As mentioned above, this email template can be customized prior to being sent.

 

Until the agent clicks the button, their status will show as "Pending Opt-In" on the agent list as shown below. At this point, a seat has not been used yet.

Once the agent clicks Launch CRM in the invitation email, their seat will be activated and the status will change from "Pending Opt-In" to "Pending Activation", while the user completes their account onboarding. At this point, the seat has been activated and will count against total account seat usage.

 

Once the activation step (as shown above) has been completed, the account will show as "Active" on the agent list. This mean the user has fully activated their account with a phone number, password, etc. and is now using Lofty.

 

FAQs

If the seat total automatically increases based on opt-in activations, what will be the cost for that seat?

This cost will be the same as all the other seats on your account. Navigate to ? icon > Billing Center > Subscriptions to see your seat cost. 

If an agent is opting in, how do I get them to the right team/office in the hierarchy?

The user's account hierarchy level is selected when you invite them, in the Add a Member window.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

AI Sales Assistant Official Relaunch - August 25th

We’re thrilled to announce the official relaunch of Sales Assistant, a massive leap forward in AI-powered lead engagement. After months of development, migration, and listening to your feedback, we’ve rebuilt our Sales Assistant from the ground up to be smarter, more human, and incredibly effective — and it’s now available to every Lofty user.

Building on the foundation you know, the new Sales Assistant is now:

 

Speak your Client's Language: Multilingual Support!

Break down communication barriers and connect with every lead in your community. The new Sales Assistant can now automatically detect the lead's language and communicate fluently in multiple languages.

Whether your lead prefers to text in their native tongue or you're expanding into diverse markets, your AI is now your personal translator and engagement expert, ensuring no opportunity is lost in translation.

name: Recruiting Templates
title: Recruiting Templates
body:
Introduction

Lofty users often ask for ways they can improve their recruiting efforts. To make it easier out of the box, we built recruiting landing page and website page templates. 

Landing Page Templates

We frequently get asked for resources that will help companies recruit new agents. To address this request, we have built two new recruiting page templates for users to choose from. These page templates are available in the CMS editor and in the Landing Page library.

To get to the Recruiting Landing Pages, go to Marketing > Landing Pages > Add a New Landing Page

 

 

Scroll down to the bottom or click on the Careers tab. Why Join Us and Your Career Journey are both landing pages designed to support recruiting efforts. 

Here is a sample of Why Join Us: https://salesdemo.lofty.com/recruiting-page-1 

Here is a sample of Your Career Journey: https://salesdemo.lofty.com/your-career-journey 

Leads who register on a Recruiting landing page will enter Lofty with the lead type of Agent.

Webpage Templates

If you want to add recruiting pages directly to your Lofty website, go to Pages > Add Page > Recruiting.

 

Tips and Tricks

Here are some tips to make your recruiting efforts stand out:

  • Easy Application Submission Form: End with a form for prospective agents to enter their contact information, upload a resume, or express their interest. This step initiates the application process, making it seamless for interested candidates.
  • Booking Link for Introductory Chat: Include a scheduling link where interested agents can set up an informal coffee chat or meeting with someone from your brokerage to learn more.
  • Competitive Commission Splits:
    • Highlight clear details of commission splits, showcasing any unique advantages that set your brokerage apart.
    • Clearly explain commission plans (e.g., 100% commission options or split plans). A chart or table can be particularly effective in breaking down the options, allowing agents to quickly understand their earning potential.
  • Advanced Systems & Real Estate Technology: Emphasize the technology tools provided, such as a CRM, lead management, and marketing automation, that help agents streamline their work.
  • Comprehensive Coaching & Mentorship Programs:
    • Describe personalized coaching options, mentorship for new agents, and development pathways that foster growth and career advancement.
    • Outline the 1:1 coaching and mentorship options, as well as any group training sessions, continuing education, or development programs offered to help agents build their skills and grow their careers.
  • Full-Service Support & Professional Workshops: Mention the dedicated support staff and regular workshops that provide ongoing training and help with day-to-day tasks.
  • Culture & Team Environment:
    • Illustrate your company’s culture—whether it’s collaborative, innovative, or supportive—and share team photos or a short video.
    • Highlight the amenities available, such as meeting spaces, technology tools, or any on-site conveniences like a dedicated work cafe, gym access, or private workstations.
    • List any health or retirement plans, wellness programs, and financial perks that make joining your brokerage attractive beyond commission.
  • Authentic Agent Testimonials: Include quotes or short videos from current agents who can speak to the impact the brokerage has had on their careers.
  • Dedicated Support Roles:
    • Detail the services provided by roles like the ISA for lead qualification, a Marketing Manager for content support, and a Transaction Coordinator for seamless transaction management.
    • Showcase the in-house support available, like practicing brokers for mentorship, a photographer or videographer, a real estate attorney, title company, and partnerships with lenders and vendors. This support can make agents feel equipped to succeed.
  • Leads Provided:
    • Highlight any partnerships with lenders that provide agents with vetted, ready-to-go leads through preferred lenders.
    • Mention if and how the brokerage provides leads, whether through a lead generation program/ads or preferred partners, to show agents you’re invested in helping them build their business.
  • Independence & Flexibility: Emphasize the freedom agents have to build their businesses and control their schedules.
  • Emphasis on Work-Life Balance: Showcase how the brokerage supports agents in balancing work commitments with personal life, an attractive aspect for both experienced and new agents.
  • Opportunities for New vs. Experienced Agents: Include specific benefits for both brand-new agents (such as training and support) and experienced agents (like high commission splits and leadership opportunities).

name: Getting Started with AI Sales Agent
title: Getting Started with AI Sales Agent
body:
Lofty's AI Sales Agent, powered by ChatGPT and Claude, is your dedicated lead capture, nurture, and conversion powerhouse in Lofty. In this Help Center article, we will go over setup-related topics such as purchase, configuration, and billing. 

Summary

  • How does the AI Sales Agent Work?
  • Activating Your AI Sales Agent
  • Configuring Your AI Sales Agent
  • How do Sales Agent Emails work?
  • Sales Agent Overview Page
  • How does Pricing work?
  • Managing your Sales Agent Quota

How does the AI Sales Agent Work?

The Sales Agent is a multi-channel AI assistant that works across three channels simultaneously:

The Sales Agent’s goal is to qualify leads, complete their profile, and hand off warm, ready-to-talk leads to the assigned agent.

 

The Sales Agent will not work on leads in the following situations:

  • The lead is a Hidden Lead (see Lead Privacy: Company Leads vs. Personal Leads), unless the individual agent has their own Sales Agent subscription.
  • The lead has a wrong number, DNC number, or landline phone number.
  • The lead had no phone number when first added to Lofty, even if a number is added later.

For more information on the Lofty Sales Agent qualification process, check out: Sales Agent / Chatbot Qualification Process

 

Activating Your AI Sales Agent

The Sales Agent is activated through a streamlined one-step setup card. Here’s how to get started:

Step 1: Access the Sales Agent Page

Navigate to AI Copilots > Sales Agent in your Lofty CRM. If you have not yet activated Sales Agent, you will see a Branding Page with an activation card.

Step 2: Review the Digital Employees

Select the Sales Agent that best meets your needs.

Anna: Speed to Lead Specialist

  • Anna has been the default Lofty Sales Agent - if you already set up your Sales Agent, you are working with Anna! Anna reaches out to all lead types.

Lucas: Buyer Specialist

  • Lucas only auto-enrolls Buyer and Renter leads.

Lily: Seller Specialist

  • Lily only auto-enrolls Seller leads.

Note: Currently, the only difference between the digital employees are the auto-enrollment options. Their working strategies are the same.

Step 3: Activate

Once you’ve made your selection, click Hire. Your Sales Agent will begin working immediately according to their enrollment rules. 

Company vs. Individual Sales Agent

Sales Agent is available at both the Company level and the individual Agent level.

Company-Level SA: Works on all visible leads across your account. Powers the chat box on all Lofty websites and texts leads matching your enrollment criteria. Cannot access agents’ hidden leads.

Individual Agent SA: Purchased by individual agents. Can work on their personal (hidden) leads.

 

Configuring Your AI Sales Agent

After initial activation, you can update any setting at any time by going to AI Copilots > Sales Agent > Settings.

Assistant Profile

The Assistant Profile controls how your Sales Agent appears and communicates.

  1. Assistant Name: Give your Sales Agent a name that is different from any real team member. This prevents confusion when leads are handed off.
  2. Virtual Number: The phone number Sales Agent uses to text leads. Texts from this number do not count against your text limit. Assigning the number to a 10DLC campaign is critical for SMS deliverability.
  3. Call Forwarding: Optionally connect leads who call the virtual number to a live person. Options: Disabled, Forward to Assigned Agent, or Forward to a Custom Number.
  4. Email Address: The Sales Agent sends email from it's own email address that matches the Sales Agent's name and uses your sending domain.
  5. Handle Rental Inquiries: Enable to have Sales Agent qualify renters and recommend rental properties. Disable to have it politely decline rental inquiries — these leads will not count toward your quota.
  6. Real Estate Experience: Enter a custom prompt to coach the Sales Agent’s tone and personality. Include details like your market, years in business, team name, and communication style preferences.

 

Enrollment

Leads Enrollment

Enrollment settings define which leads the Sales Agent will work on. You can filter by:

  1. Lead Source — Default is “Any.” Toggle individual sources to limit the Sales Agent to specific lead origins.
  2. Lead Type — Default includes all types. Narrow to Buyers, Sellers, Renters, or Other.
  3. Pipeline — Select which pipeline stages are eligible. All stages are included by default.
  4. Agent — Enable or disable Sales Agent for specific agents in your organization.
  5. Office — Enable or disable Sales Agent for specific teams or offices.
  6. Lead Pond — Enable or disable Sales Agent for specific Lead Ponds.

Channel Enrollment

Toggle individual communication channels on or off. All channels are enabled by default.

  1. Website Chat Box — Powers the chat experience on your Company website and all connected Agent websites. Note: The Sales Agent replaces the standard Chat Box widget but has its own independent settings.
  2. Text Channel — Enables SMS follow-up for new and existing leads. You can set Active Hours (the time window SMS can be sent) and Active Days. Reducing active hours may limit the Sales Agent’s ability to respond to real-time lead activity.
  3. Email Channel — Enables the Sales Agent to send and reply to emails.
  4. Facebook Channel — Allows the Sales Agent to communicate via Facebook Messenger

Team Enrollment

  • Agent: Use this dropdown to enable/disable Sales Agent for specific Agents in your organization.
  • Office: Use this dropdown to enable/disable Sales Agent for specific Teams/Offices in your organization.
  • Lead Pond: Use this dropdown to enable/disable Sales Agent for specific Lead Ponds in your organization. 

How do Sales Agent Emails work?

Sales Agent has full context of your lead - from their search preferences, to any communication you or the Sales Agent have had with the lead. When a lead reaches out by email, the Sales Agent can reply to continue the conversation on your behalf. Sales Agent can respond to emails in 15 seconds.

You can enable or disable the email channel in Sales Agent Settings. The Sales Agent will read and respond to emails sent to the Sales Agent email address that is configured in its settings. 

 

Here is a sample email sent from the Sales Agent:

 

Sales Agent Overview Page

The Sales Agent overview gives you clear insights into how AI is helping your business. You can also see all leads Sales Agent is actively working on and mute them directly on this page. 

  • Total Engaged: Number of leads contacted via text, chat, or email
  • Total Contacted: Total outreach messages sent
  • Total Updated: Number of times the Sales Agent automatically updated a lead’s information.
  • Saved Time & Cost: See how much time and money you’ve saved
  • Lead Handoffs: Track when Sales Agent flags leads for your attention
  • Lead Management: View and mute leads directly from the reporting page

 

How does Pricing work?

You can choose the number of leads - or quota - that you would like the Sales Agent to be able to work. This simplifies the experience and gives you control over your cost and opportunities. 

Your quota does not reset monthly. It is a running total of the leads that the Sales Agent is working on your behalf. You can increase or decrease your quota at any time. 

The AI Sales Agent starts with 200 leads at $60 per month. Additional coverage can be added in increments of 100 leads ($30 per month).

Pricing is prorated based on the day of the month, but you will always receive the full lead amount. You will be charged the full amount in the following month.

How is usage calculated?

Any lead the AI Sales Agent has messaged is considered an engaged lead. 

  • If you mute Sales Agent for a lead, either manually or using a Smart Plan, the lead will no longer be counted in the quota.

  • If the lead does not respond after 6 months of automatic follow-up, the lead will no longer be counted in the quota. 

Managing your Sales Agent Quota

Any lead Sales Agent has messaged is considered an engaged lead. The Sales Agent will follow up with leads for 6 months by default. During this period, the lead will continue to count towards your quota (because the Sales Agent is still working on that lead). 

  • If you mute the Sales Agent for a lead, either manually or using a Smart Plan, the lead will no longer be counted in the quota.

  • If the lead does not respond after 6 months of automatic follow-up, the lead will no longer be counted in the quota. 

     

How to Apply or Mute Sales Agent

In the Lead Profile

You can click on the ellipses (...) to open the action menu and either mute or unmute the Sales Agent in the lead's profile. 

 

Via Smart Plan

You can use a Smart Plan action to mass enable or disable the Sales Agent. 

 

In Sales Agent Settings

You can view all leads the Sales Agent is engaged with, as well as recommended leads, in Sales Agent Settings. From here, you can mute currently-engaged leads and activate the Sales Agent on recommended leads. 

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

Related terms: Sales Agent Settings, AI Sales Agent

Sales Assistant already helps leads discover homes by understanding their preferences and recommending listings. Now, it can close the loop by saving those listings directly to the lead’s search portal. 


Learn more about the AI Sales Assistant here: AI Sales Assistant / Chatbot FAQ

New Branding Bundles

We've introduced two (2) new branding bundles to help you launch your business!

Here’s what’s included:

  • Customizable Agent Website

    • Launch a sleek, modern website using professionally designed templates and a personalized domain, making it easy to showcase your brand and listings.

  • Virtual Phone Number

    • Maintain a professional presence and build brand recognition when calling or texting clients directly from the platform.

  • Call Package

    • Ensures every conversation is automatically recorded and logged on the lead’s profile, giving you a clear view of their last touchpoint and helping them stay organized and responsive.

  • Text Package (Elite Branding Bundle only)

    • Share listings and keep conversations going, with every message saved to the lead’s profile for easy follow-up.

  • Lofty Present

    • A dynamic, custom-branded CMA tool that delivers detailed market insights, property comparisons, and a polished presentation experience for clients.

  • AI Marketer

    • A fully automated social media marketing tool that boosts brand awareness, promotes listings, and generates high-quality, low-cost leads.

Learn more here: Branding Bundle

Agent Website Optimizations

This optimization allows for greater control over your Lofty website, so you can tailor your messaging, visuals, and layout to resonate with your local markets and personal style, without compromising the overall brand integrity set by the brokerage. 

What can be edited?

If you are the account admin, you can control how agent websites sync with the parent website. The default is an ongoing sync, which will make any changes to the parent site sync to the agent sites. A new setting is a one-time sync, which unlocks the above editing capabilities for the agent websites. To enable this setting, navigate to Company Settings > Organization Hierarchy > ellipses > Agent Website Sync Mode.

Learn more about agent websites here: Agent Websites

name: Goal Setting Portal
title: Goal Setting Portal
body:
Introduction

The goal setting portal allows an account owner to set goals for their entire company, all the down to individual agents setting goals for themselves. One the goals are set, you will be able to track your monthly cadence to ensure success at the end of the year!

 

Summary

  • Permissions
  • Setting Your Annual Goals
  • Goal Calculator

 

Permissions

All agents will be able to set their own personal goals. Within the Permission Profiles, those with the Entire Company permission can set goals in the Company scope. Those with the User’s Office permission can set goals for their own Office/Team and sub-offices/teams.

 

Setting Your Annual Goals

Your annual goals will help you determine what your monthly goals should be to keep you on track. To set a goal, navigate to Settings -> Reporting. Goals are available in Company, Office, Team, and Personal settings. The first step is to select the year the goal applies to and the goal scope. 

  • Company goals will be visible to everyone in the company
  • Office/Team goals will be visible to those in that office/team
  • Agent goals will be visible to that agent only

The scope that is available to you will be determined by your permission, as outlined above.

Goals are separated into Business Goals and Activity Goals. Click Start to create a goal.

 

If you need help creating business goals, we have provided a calculator, which can help you determine what your goals should be, to reach a certain income amount.

After setting your annual goals, the system will break the numbers down into even monthly goals. You can edit these fields to reflect a busier or slower season.

After saving the goals, you can see the overall goals, as well as the monthly breakdown on the goals tab. You can create multiple goals.

Goal Calculator

It can be difficult to know exactly what you need to do to make the amount of money you want to this year. The goal calculator can help you determine the total volume and closings needed to reach your revenue goal. 

Depending on if you are setting up an individual goal or a company/office/team goal, the questions ask may be in a different order. 

Revenue Goal

The revenue goal is the amount of money you want to make this year. This is a great place to start, and the calculator will help you determine the number of closings needed to hit this goal.

Revenue by Transaction Type

Revenue by transaction type allows you to select the percentage of your transactions that are expected to come from buyers, sellers, leases, or others, broken down by lead ownership. 

If the commission split depends on the lead ownership, this page will be important in determining if most of your transactions originate from your own leads or company/office leads. If you do not expect any transactions from a particular lead type, enter 0 in that field. 

Estimated Price and GCI Split Rate

The estimated price and GCI split allows you to provide the average sales price, along with your commission rate. There is also an option to include leases. We recommend being conservative with the average sales price, as the market is always changing and it's better to overestimate the number of closings, than underestimate and miss your goal.

GCI Split for Transaction Type

Similar to revenue by transaction type, here you will add your GCI for those transaction types. Each field does need to be completed, however, if you did not specify a particular transaction type earlier in the goal calculator, it will not be a factor in calculating the goal.


The results will be added to the Business Goals section. They are editable, if they don't look quite right or if you want to make a change. All Activity Goals will need to be completed, it order to save the goal.

 

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Websites on Lofty
title: Websites on Lofty
body:
Introduction

Whether you're a Company, Team, Office, or Agent, your website plays a key role in showcasing your brand and supporting your business goals. It is where your leads start to build trust with you, find their dream home, 

In this guide, we’ll walk you through how our website system works, how your site is built, and how you can unlock powerful packages to take your online presence to the next level. From custom domains to full SEO control, we’ve got the tools to help you stand out and stay on brand.

Summary

  • Website Types
    • Company Website
    • Agent Website
    • Team Website
    • Office Website
  • Website Packages
    • Vanity Domain Website
    • Full SEO Website
  • Purchase a Website Package

 

Website Types

Website Type refers to who the package is for. There are Company Websites, Agent Websites, Team Websites, and Office Websites. In the section below, we’ll walk through what each type includes right out of the box. After that, we’ll explore the available upgrade paths so you can see how to expand your site as your goals grow.

 

Company Website

  •  
    • 1 Company Website is included with each Lofty package.
    • Site Owner: Lofty Account Owner
    • Site Level: Company
    • Site Type: Full Site
      • Able to configure a vanity domain. Has full SEO capabilities and unlimited personalization.
      • Must go through an individual MLS application to get the data connected
      • Websites nestled beneath a Company website will be copies of the Company website.

Agent Website

  •  
    • 1 Agent Website is included per user (except the Company Owner). Additional Agent Websites can be purchased if you want different branding or work in different areas.
      • Site Owner: Lofty Users, except Account, Office, or Team owners.
      • Site Level: Individual User
      • Site Type: Basic
        • Has limited customization and feature access
        • Based on the Company, Office, or Team website above it.
        • Does not need to go through an individual MLS application. Listings are provided by the Company, Office, or Team website.
        • Always a third-level domain (firstname.website.com)

Team Website

  •  
    • 1 Team website is included with the purchase of a Team Add-On.
    • Site Owner: Team Owner
    • Site Level: Team
    • Site Type: Full Site
      • Able to configure a vanity domain. Has full SEO capabilities and unlimited personalization.
      • Must go through an individual MLS application to get the data connected
      • Websites nestled beneath a Team website will be copies of the Team website.

Office Website

  •  
    • 1 Office website is included with the purchase of an Office Add-On.
    • Site Owner: Office Owner
    • Site Level: Office
    • Site Type: Basic
      • Has limited customization and feature access
      • Based on the Company or Office website above.
      • Does not need to go through an individual MLS application. Listings are provided by the Company or another office website.
      • Always a third-level domain (firstname.website.com)

 

Website Packages

The Company Website is the core structure that other websites are built on. This setup ensures consistency across your brand while giving you the flexibility to grow.

To go beyond the basics, you can unlock additional features through Website Packages:

 

Vanity Domain Website

Unlocks the ability to set a custom domain name for your website, giving you a branded, professional web address.

  • You can bring your domain, or you can purchase one through Lofty.

 

Full SEO Website

Enables full customization of your website content and structure, along with advanced tools to optimize your site for search engines.

What to choose? If you're an agent who wants to stand out with a fully customized site, you'd start with your Agent Website and unlock Full SEO. Or if you're part of a team looking for a branded domain, Team Website + Vanity Domain is the perfect fit.

You can tell what package you have in the CMS site list.

 

Purchase a Website Package

In the Marketplace under Branding and Marketing, you will see Vanity Domain Website and Full SEO Website. 

 

If you are a Company, Team, or Office Owner, you have the option to purchase for your Agents or your Team/Office(s). 

If you are an Agent, you will only have the option to purchase for yourself. 

 

Go to your Lofty Website

To find your Lofty website, go to Website in the top menu navigation.

This will take you to the Site List. Here, you will be presented with a list of the websites to which you have access. This will vary based on permissions, but if you are the Company Owner/Admin, you will be able to see all websites, and if you are a Team or Office Owner/Admin, then you will see all websites within the team or office that you manage.

 

Clicking on the site you would like to manage will take you to the CMS editor. Here, you can manage the appearance of your website, your website settings, listing filters, blog posts, and more. 

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at support@lofty.com, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat through your Lofty CRM.

name: Reporting Page Metrics
title: Reporting Page Metrics
body:
Introduction

This article outlines the metrics available on the Lofty Reporting Page. Here, we will define the metrics included on each default report so you can decide which metrics are important to you. Learn how to navigate the reporting page here: How to Navigate the Reporting Page

 

Summary

  • Agent Activity Overview
  • Leads Not Acted On
  • Follow-up Speed & Effort
  • Lead Response Performance
  • Call Accountability
  • Text Accountability
  • Email Accountability

Agent Activity Overview

This report focuses on the activity count for each agent, regardless of whether leads are assigned to them. Here are the metrics available on this report:

Metric Name Definition
New leads assigned The number of leads created within the selected timeframe and currently assigned to that agent.
Initial leads assigned The historical number of leads created within the selected timeframe, who were first assigned to that agent.
- This metric could be used to complete a lead distribution analysis - that is, track the fairness or balance in lead distribution/routing
 
Current leads assigned This is the same calculation as the current ‘total leads assigned', but is now renamed to 'current leads assigned’ to provide a distinction between currently assigned leads and initially assigned leads.
- That is, this metric provides the number of leads assigned within the selected timeframe that are currently are still assigned to that agent
 
Total leads previously worked The historical number of leads assigned within the selected timeframe, but may not still be assigned to that agent
- This metric could be used to measure the overall workload for agents
 
Contacts made (Manual only) The sum of all outbound communications, including calls made, texts sent, and emails sent, including logged activity. This metric is only counting manual activity.
Contacts made (Include auto) This metric includes all the data as Contacts made (Manual only) but also includes automated communications, like Smart Plans.
Calls made The number of outbound calls, including logged calls
Call connect rate This metric calculates the percentage of ‘Talked Calls’ from the total number of calls made. This does not include inbound calls.
Texts sent (Manual only) The number of outbound texts sent, including logged texts
- This metric only includes manually sent text messages. Automated texts are excluded.
 
Texts sent (Include auto) This metric includes the number of all texts sent, including automated texts.
Emails sent (Manual only) The number of outbound emails sent, including logged emails
- This metric only includes manually sent emails. Automated emails are excluded.
 
Emails sent (Include auto) This metric includes the number of all emails sent, including automated emails.
Tasks completed The number of tasks completed by the agent during the selected timeframe
- This metric includes smart plan tasks that are completed manually by the agent
 
Total appts The number of appointments created during the selected timeframe that are either owned by the agent or the agent is a participant
Appts set The number of appointments created by that agent during the selected timeframe
Appts completed The number of appointments with the status of 'completed’
No show rate This metrics is calculated as:
(Total appts - Appts completed)/Total appts
 

 

Leads Not Acted On

This report focuses on the number of new leads that have not received any follow-up, regardless of whether the follow-up is done by their assigned agent. Here are the metrics available on this report:

Metric Name Definition
New leads assigned The number of leads created within the selected timeframe and currently assigned to that agent.
Leads not acted on The number of ‘New leads assigned’ who have not been contacted in the selected timeframe
Leads not called The number of ‘New leads assigned’ who have not been called in the selected timeframe
Leads not texted The number of ‘New leads assigned’ who have not been texted in the selected timeframe
Leads not emailed The number of ‘New leads assigned’ who have not been emailed in the selected timeframe

 

Follow-up Speed & Effort

This report analyzes the follow-up speed and effort of the agents on their new leads. Communications made by team members other than the assigned agent will not be included in this report. Here are the metrics available on this report:

Metric Name Definition
New leads assigned The number of leads created within the selected timeframe and currently assigned to that agent.
Avg. response time The average amount of time (in days:hours:minutes) taken from the lead creation to the first contact (call/text/email) by the lead’s assigned agent
Avg. speed to first call The average amount of time (in days:hours:minutes) taken from the lead creation to the first call by the lead’s assigned agent
Avg. speed to first text (manual only) The average amount of time (in days:hours:minutes) taken from the lead creation to the first manual text message sent by the lead’s assigned agent
Avg. speed to first email (manual only) The average amount of time (in days:hours:minutes) taken from the lead creation to the first manual email sent by the lead’s assigned agent
Avg. contact attempts The average number of contacts (calls/texts/emails) to new leads by the lead’s assigned agent
Avg. call attempts The average number of calls to new leads by the lead’s assigned agent
Avg. text attempts (manual only) The average number of manual text messages sent to new leads by the lead’s assigned agent
Avg. email attempts (manual only) The average number of manual emails sent to new leads by the lead’s assigned agent

 

Lead Response Performance

This report analyzes lead responses to communications initiated by agents. Automated communications are excluded from this report. Here are the metrics available on this report:

Metric Name Definition
New leads assigned The number of leads created within the selected timeframe and currently assigned to that agent.
Leads contacted The number of leads contacted by the agent during the selected timeframe
Leads responded The number of leads that have responded to the agent during the selected timeframe
Lead response rate This metric is calculated as Leads responded/Leads contacted
Leads called The number of leads called by the agent during the selected timeframe
Leads responding by call The number of leads who picked up the outbound calls from the agent during the selected timeframe
% of leads responding by call This metric is calculated as Leads responding by call/Leads called
Leads texted (manual only) The number of leads texted manually by the agent during the selected timeframe
Leads responding by text The number of leads sending inbound text message to the agent during the selected timeframe
% of leads responding by text This metric is calculated as Leads responding by text/Leads texted (manual only)
Leads emailed (manual only) The number of leads emailed manually by the agent during the selected timeframe
Leads responding by email The number of leads that have replied to an email from the agent during the selected timeframe
% of leads responding by email This metric is calculated as Leads responding by email/Leads emailed (manual only)

 

Call Accountability

This report analyzes the calling data of the agents, teams, and offices for a specified period of time. Here are the metrics available on this report:

Metric Name Definition
Calls made The number of outbound calls made, including logged calls, in the selected timeframe
Calls received The number of inbound calls from leads and unknown numbers, excluding missed calls, in the selected timeframe
Leads called The number of unique leads called by the agent in the selected timeframe
Talked calls The number of calls with the call result of 'talked’ in the selected timeframe
Convos more than 2 mins The number of calls with the call result of 'talked’ and the call duration is more than 2 minutes, in the selected timeframe
Voicemails The number of calls with the call result of 'voice message’ in the selected timeframe
Bad numbers The number of calls with the call result of 'bad numbers’ in the selected timeframe
No answer The number of calls with the call result of 'no answer’ in the selected timeframe
DNC The number of calls with the call result of 'DNC’ in the selected timeframe
Calls missed The number of inbound calls missed by the agent in the selected timeframe
Total call duration The total time of talked calls

 

Text Accountability

This report analyzes the text messaging data of the agents, teams, and offices for a specified period of time. Here are the metrics available on this report:

Metric Name Definition
Texts sent The number of texts sent by the agent during the selected timeframe
Leads texted The number of unique leads sent any text messages during the selected timeframe
Texts delivered The number of texts successfully sent during the selected timeframe
Leads delivered The number of unique leads that have successfully received any text messages in the selected timeframe
Texts delivery rate This metric is calculated as Texts delivered/Texts sent
Texts received The number of inbound text messages that the agent received in the selected timeframe
Opt-outs The number of unique leads that unsubscribed from text messages in the selected timeframe
Carrier filtered The number of texts that have been directly blocked by carriers in the selected timeframe
Other errors The number of text messages failed to be sent by other errors, such as sending to an invalid/landline number. 
Note: A high number of "Other Errors" can damage your sender reputation with carriers, making it more likely for future messages to be flagged as spam.

 

Email Accountability

This report analyzes the emailing data of the agents, teams, and offices for a specified period of time. Here are the metrics available on this report:

Metric Name Definition
Emails sent The number of emails sent by the agent during the selected timeframe
Leads sent The number of unique leads sent any emails during the selected timeframe
Emails delivered The number of emails successfully sent during the selected timeframe
Leads delivered The number of unique leads that have successfully received any emails in the selected timeframe
Emails opened The number of emails opened by leads in the selected timeframe
Leads opened The number of unique leads opening emails in the selected timeframe
Emails replied to The number of emails replied to by leads in the selected timeframe
Leads replied to The number of unique leads replying to emails in the selected timeframe
Emails bounced The number of emails bounced in the selected timeframe
Leads unsubscribed The number of unique leads who have unsubscribed from emails in the selected timeframe

 

 

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by a chat with us through your CRM.

name: How to Navigate the Reporting Page
title: How to Navigate the Reporting Page
body:
Introduction

Lofty offers several default reports as well as the option to create your own customized reporting. Use this article as a guide to navigating the Reporting Page.

 

Summary

  • Default Reports
  • Navigating the Agent Accountability Reports

Default Reports

Your Lofty account will have the following reports set up, by default. Please note, the visibility into each of these reports will be dependent on your permission profile. If you are not seeing your needed reports, please contact your account admin. Learn more about the metrics included on each of these reports here: Reporting Page Metrics

Agent Accountability

The Agent Accountability section includes reports that allow you to evaluate the activity of the agents, teams, and offices on your Lofty account. The reports available in this section are:

  1. Agent Activity Overview
  2. Leads Not Acted On
  3. Follow-up Speed & Effort
  4. Lead Response Performance
  5. Call Accountability
  6. Email Accountability
  7. Text Accountability
  8. Team Guided Setup
  9. Agent Scorecard

Business

The Business section includes reports that allow you to evaluate how the agents, teams, and offices are performing financially according to your business goals. The reports available in this section are:

  1. Summary
  2. Performance by Agent
  3. Revenue Share

Marketing

The Marketing section includes reports that allow you to evaluate the marketing efforts and website performance of your agents, teams, and offices. The reports available in this section are:

  1. Source 
  2. Site Traffic
  3. Activities

Navigating the Agent Accountability Reports

Reporting Filters

The filters are the same for all reports. However, you will only be able to see the data of agents, teams, and offices that are visible to you.

Time Filters

  1. Custom
  2. Today/yesterday/last 7 days to 12 months
  3. XTD: Week/Month/Quarter/Year to Date
  4. Default Filter is 'Month to Date'

Office Filter

  1. Office tab: All Offices and Teams in the account
  2. Agent tab: All of the agents in the account. Me is you!

Leads Filter

  1. Lead Type
  2. Segment
  3. Lead Privacy
  4. Source
  5. Tag

More Filters

  1. Account Type: Active/Deactivated users
  2. Activity Reporting: select a specific time period in hours

Report Actions

These actions allow you to customize your reports.

(1) Refresh the report: This will refresh the data so it is up to date

(2) Save the current view: Save your applied filters to this report

(3) Save as a new (custom) report: Create a new report

(4) Manage columns

  • Check the boxes next to the metrics to add them to the table
  • Star the metrics to add them to the KPI cards

(5) Edit: Update the report name (only available for custom reports)

(6) Download as:

  • csv (table only)
  • pdf (chart only)
  • excel (table only)

(7) Change Time zone: The default is the browser time zone

(8) Delete: Delete a custom report. You cannot delete the standard reports

Report Components

The reports are organized into three (3) sections:

  1. KPI Cards
  2. Business Growth Trend Line Chart
  3. Table

KPI Cards

The KPI cards allow you to select specific data that you want to see at the top of the report.

Star the metrics you want to have as a KPI card. Click on the card to drag it to another location. A maximum of 10 KPI cards can be added to each report.

Business Growth Trend Line Chart

The line chart allows you to look at specific data over selected time periods, as well as compare data.

Compare time periods:

The time scope will match the selection at the top of the report. The time period cannot be edited here. Breakdown the chart further by daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly data.

View Values:

All available metrics can be selected, but only one can be showed in the line chart.

Compare:

Toggle the Compare feature to compare one time period against another or one agent/office/team against another. 

Time period comparison

  • Compare the performance of selected timeframe with the previous period
    • That is, if you are looking at data from the last 30 days, it will compare against the data from the 30 days before that.
  • Data of previous time will be showed in dotted line

Agent/Office performance comparison

  • Compare the selected Offices/Teams/Agents by the selected data sum, average, maximum, minimum, or count
  • Parties will be showed in different colors (blue & green)

Table

The table allows you to scroll through all of the available metrics in both an Agent and Office view.

Check the boxes next to the metrics in the Manage Columns setting to add them to the table. Click the tabs to switch between Office and Agent views.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by a chat with us through your CRM.

name: Transaction Document Templates
title: Transaction Document Templates
body:
Introduction

We know that real estate transactions often use the same documents. This feature lets you add those documents into Lofty and use them over and over on your transactions.

Note: All Lofty users can access Transaction Document Templates in their personal settings, but you must have the templates permission to add or edit these templates. Please reach out to your account owner for assistance creating a Transaction Document Template.

Summary

  • How to Create a Transaction Document Template
  • Adding a Document Template to a Transaction

How to Create a Transaction Document Template

To get started, navigate to Company/Office Settings > Transactions > Document Templates. The template must be created for the specific transaction type - Purchase, Listing, Lease, or Other. Existing templates will be available here or click + Add Template to create a template.

Give your template a name, select the transaction type, then upload your documents.

Once you have uploaded the template documents, click the Edit icon to add text fields, check boxes, and radio buttons to your document.

Double click a Text box to add an autofill field from the standard and custom transaction fields.

 

Document Limitations

  1. Documents must be in pdf format
  2. Up to 40 documents can be added to each template
  3. Each document can be up to 30MB

Template Limitations

  1. Enterprise Lofty accounts can create an unlimited number of document templates
  2. Non-Enterprise Lofty accounts can create up to 50 templates in the Company scope and up to 20 templates in each Office/Team scope

Editable Elements Limitations

Each document up to the following amount of editable elements:

  1. Up to 200 Text boxes
  2. Up to 50 Checkboxes
  3. Up to 50 Radio buttons

Adding a Document Template to a Transaction

To apply the template to a transaction, navigate to Transactions > Select a transaction > Documents > Add New > Upload a document > Document Template.

Here, you can add as many templates and as many documents from each template as is appropriate for the transaction. 

 

If you have added autofill fields to your template, edit the document to make sure that the autofill fields are sync correctly.

You have the option to sync these fields to the transaction.
