name: Getting Started with the WordPress + Lofty IDX Plugin
title: Getting Started with the WordPress + Lofty IDX Plugin
body:
Summary

  • Who is this for?
  • How does this compare to ____?
  • Setup Instructions

 

Who is this for?

  • Agents, teams, and brokerages who want to take advantage of all the capabilities in the Lofty Platform but wish to retain their existing WordPress website.
  • Existing Lofty customers who already have a disconnected WordPress site that want to significantly improve the value they’re getting from Lofty while also improving the browsing experience for their clients.

 

How does this compare to ____?

A majority of other tools on the market only offer IDX connections (the MLS feeds) to WordPress websites. What's missing from this equation? 

  1. Actionable, insightful data on which activities the leads are performing on the agent's website
  2. A seamless Property Alert experience for your leads
  3. The ability to trigger Smart Plans based on website activity
  4. + the multitude of other powerful features that the Lofty platform provides

 

What do you need to know?

  • The WordPress Plugin connects one WordPress website to one Lofty user. 
    • It cannot auto-create agent websites or send property alerts for multiple users. 
  • If you occupy the Account Owner seat in Lofty, your Property Alerts will send from your Lofty Company site.
    • If you would like a dedicated site for your agent activities, we recommend configuring a separate Lofty seat and linking the WordPress plugin to that seat. 

Setup Instructions

Step 1: Purchase the IDX Plugin

The Lofty IDX Plugin can be purchased in the Lofty Marketplace.

 

Step 2: Connect Your WordPress Website with Lofty IDX

Note: This step does not make the WordPress site go live. This just tells Lofty which WordPress site will eventually be connected, so it can use that domain for MLS feeds. 

 

Once the purchase is complete, go to the CMS editor and select the Connect your WordPress Site option. 

Clicking this link will take you to the WordPress Site connector. The domain that you enter here will be used for MLS applications and connected to your Lofty account.

Once this step is done, your WordPress site will be visible in Lofty. The domain will be listed in the domain section, and the Package will show WordPress Plugin. Your next step will be applying for your MLS feed(s)

Step 3: Enable the IDX Plugin on your WordPress website

There are two options to enable the IDX Plugin in WordPress. You can either download from the Lofty CMS Editor, or from the WordPress Marketplace. 

Download from Lofty

Go to CMS Editor > Settings > Plugin Installation File

 

Download from the WordPress Marketplace

Step 4: Connect the Lofty API Key

Head into the CMS Editor > Settings to find your API key. 

*note: this is different from the API Key in your Lofty Settings. Please make sure that you are copying from the right place.

Copy the API Key from Lofty, then log into Wordpress > Settings > Lofty IDX Settings. Paste the API Key and hit save.

At this point, you have completed the connection of Lofty and your WordPress site. Now you can start configuring your IDX pages to your liking. 

 

Step 5: Apply MLS to your Lofty Site

Once the WordPress site is linked, you will need to go to the CMS Editor > Listings and apply to your MLS board(s). This is a regular MLS application, so it may take some time for the board to approve.

The WordPress Plugin comes with sample IDX data so you can configure your website while you wait for their MLS feed to go live. Once the feed goes live, the sample listings will be replaced with your live feed. 

 

 

When the MLS is approved, the status will be Active and the sample listings on your WordPress site will be replaced with live listings.

 

Questions?

name: Lofty Market Reports Playbook
title: Lofty Market Reports Playbook
body:
Purpose of Market Reports

Market Reports are a powerful tool within Lofty to keep leads informed and engaged with relevant real estate activity in their desired areas. By setting up Market Reports, agents can provide value, establish trust, and nurture leads by offering timely, data-driven insights. This positions the agent as a market expert, increasing the likelihood of converting leads into clients.

Key Benefits of Market Reports:

  1. Stay Top of Mind: Regular updates ensure your name stays in front of your leads consistently.
  2. Provide Value: Offering insights into local market trends showcases your expertise and keeps leads informed.
  3. Foster Engagement: Leads are more likely to interact with you when they see useful, relevant information.
  4. Increase Conversion Rates: Well-informed leads are more likely to take action, such as scheduling a consultation or viewing a property.

How to Set Up Market Reports in Lofty

Step 1: Access the Lead’s Profile

  1. Log in to your Lofty account.
  2. Navigate to your Contacts section.
  3. Search for and select the desired lead’s profile.

Step 2: Open Engagement Settings

  1. Within the lead’s profile, click on the Engagement tab.
  2. Locate and select Market Reports from the dropdown menu.

Step 3: Customize the Market Report

  1. Select the Area: Choose the zip code(s) or region your lead is interested in. You can search by city, neighborhood, or specific postal codes.
  2. Set the Frequency: Determine how often the Market Report should be sent (e.g., weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly).

Step 4: Activate the Market Report

  1. Review all the details to ensure accuracy.
  2. Click Save to confirm the setup.

Tips for Maximizing Market Reports

  1. Leverage Personalization: Always include a personalized note to make the communication feel tailored and genuine.
  2. Monitor Engagement: Check how often your leads are opening or interacting with the Market Reports. Follow up with those showing high engagement.
  3. Segment Your Database: Use filters to group leads by area of interest and send hyper-targeted reports.
  4. Be Proactive: When a lead engages with a Market Report, use it as an opportunity to reach out with additional insights or a consultation offer.
  5. Stay Consistent: Regular updates build trust and keep your leads connected to the market—and to you.

By effectively utilizing Market Reports, Lofty agents can deliver exceptional value, strengthen relationships, and convert more leads into clients. Start setting up Market Reports today to showcase your expertise and help your leads stay informed about the real estate market!

 

Questions?

name: Lofty Newsletter Playbook for Realtors
title: Lofty Newsletter Playbook for Realtors
body:
Why Realtors Should Send Newsletters

Sending newsletters to your contacts is an excellent way to stay top-of-mind and build long-term relationships. Here are the top reasons why realtors should consistently send newsletters:

  1. Stay Connected with Past Clients – Keep your name in front of past buyers and sellers, increasing the likelihood of referrals and repeat business.
  2. Demonstrate Market Expertise – Provide valuable insights into the local real estate market, positioning yourself as a go-to expert.
  3. Promote Local Events & Businesses – Strengthen your community presence by sharing local happenings, restaurants, and businesses.
  4. Generate Leads & Engagement – Keep potential buyers and sellers engaged with relevant content, prompting them to reach out when ready.
  5. Showcase Recent Transactions – Highlight homes you've helped buy or sell to build credibility and social proof.

Creating a Newsletter with Lofty

Lofty offers multiple ways to create and send engaging newsletters:

1. Using the Design Center

  • Access the Advanced Editor in the Design Center to create visually appealing newsletter templates.
  • Customize layouts, images, and branding to maintain consistency across your communications.
  • Once finalized, send the newsletter directly to your contact list within Lofty.

2. Using the Source Code Editor

  • Import templates from external sources like Mailchimp or Constant Contact using the Source Code Editor.
  • Modify the HTML as needed to personalize the newsletter for your audience.
  • Save templates for future use to maintain branding and streamline the process.

Best Practices for High-Engagement Newsletters

To maximize engagement and effectiveness, consider these best practices:

  • Segment Your Audience – Tailor newsletters based on client types (buyers, sellers, investors, past clients, etc.).
  • Include Local Content – Share upcoming events, new eateries, or neighborhood news to add value beyond real estate.
  • Use Engaging Subject Lines – Capture attention with compelling and curiosity-driven subject lines.
  • Keep It Visual – Use high-quality images and a clean design to make your newsletter visually appealing.
  • Call to Action (CTA) – Encourage readers to take action, such as visiting your website, scheduling a consultation, or following you on social media.

Example of an Engaging Newsletter

A well-performing newsletter could include:

  • A section highlighting clients you've helped buy/sell in the past.
  • Market updates, such as changes in interest rates or new listings.
  • A spotlight on local businesses, restaurants, or community events.
  • A personal touch, such as a brief update on your latest activities or industry insights.

By consistently sending newsletters through Lofty, realtors can nurture relationships, establish authority, and ultimately drive more business.

Questions?

name: Lofty Property Alerts Playbook
title: Lofty Property Alerts Playbook
body:
Why Property Alerts Matter

Property alerts are an essential tool for both buyers and sellers, helping them stay informed about the market and making better real estate decisions.

For Sellers

  • Sellers who are considering listing their home often want to understand their competition.
  • While market reports provide general data, property alerts give sellers real-time insights into homes listed in their area.
  • With alerts, sellers can see listing details, photos, pricing, and more, allowing them to make strategic pricing and listing decisions.

For Buyers

  • Property alerts provide buyers with up-to-date listings that match their criteria, enabling informed decision-making.
  • Alerts can be customized based on key factors such as:
    • Number of bedrooms and bathrooms
    • Square footage
    • Price range
    • Year built
    • And more
  • By keeping buyers engaged with your website, you reduce the likelihood of them browsing competitor sites like Zillow or Realtor.com.
  • All buyer activity is tracked within Lofty, making it easier to monitor engagement and conversion opportunities.

How to Set Up a Property Alert in Lofty

  1. Navigate to the People Section
    • Locate the contact you want to assign a property alert to.
  2. Assign a Property Alert
    • Click on the Engagement tab.
    • Select Property Alerts from the menu.
    • If you do not see Property Alerts, check the lead type—some leads may be categorized as sellers or another type that does not support property alerts.
  3. Leverage Smart Plans for Automation
    • Smart Plans can automate property alert assignments based on specific triggers.
    • If you have uploaded contacts with a specific hashtag, you can create a Smart Plan that automatically assigns a pre-built property alert when the hashtag is applied.
    • For existing leads in the People section, perform a search by hashtag and apply the Smart Plan in bulk.

Maximizing Property Alerts for Lead Conversion

  • Ensure all buyers have property alerts set up to keep them engaged with your platform.
  • Regularly review lead activity within Lofty to track engagement and follow up strategically.
  • Use Smart Plans to streamline the process and ensure no potential client is overlooked.

By effectively leveraging Lofty Property Alerts, you position yourself as the primary source of real estate information, enhancing client relationships and increasing conversion rates.

name: Do Not Contact Settings
title: Do Not Contact Settings
body:
Introduction

*IMPORTANT: This article is for informational purposes only and does not substitute consultation with appropriate legal counsel regarding this topic. It is your responsibility to comply with federal, state, local, or other laws and regulations related to all outgoing communication. 

The Do Not Contact setting page allows you to organize your Internal Do Not Contact list, as well as upload any National or State DNC lists that you subscribe to. This article outlines how Lofty treats the phone numbers that are on these lists.

Summary

  • Adding Numbers to a Do Not Contact List
  • Do Not Contact Lists
  • Calling or Texting a Number on a DNC List
  • DNC Scrub Integrations

Adding Numbers to a Do Not Contact List

Lofty offers the ability to add both Internal Do Not Contact numbers as well as National and State DNC lists. To access the Do Not Contact list navigate to Settings → Call & Text → Do Not Contact Settings. 

Click + Add New to manually add a number to the Internal DNC list. When you manually add a number, it can only be added to the Internal DNC list.

Click Import a List to upload a file with numbers to the Internal DNC list, the National DNC list, or to the State DNC list.

  • Note: When uploading a list, the maximum file size is 1GB. Please contact support@lofty.com to upload a larger list.

Only the account admin is able to add or remove numbers from the DNC lists.

When uploading a DNC list, a pop-up will ask what type of DNC list you are importing and how you want these numbers to display in your account. You have the option to override existing consent statuses for the phone numbers that belong to leads in your system.

Selecting 'Yes' on any of these existing consent statuses will change the current phone number consent status to Do Not Call. If a lead is added and their phone number is on a DNC list, their phone consent status will automatically be Do Not Call.

 

Do Not Contact Lists

Lofty offers four (4) different options for Do Not Contact Lists: Internal, National, State, and Other.

Internal Do Not Contact List

The internal DNC list includes phone numbers who have opted out of being contacted by you or your business specifically. These numbers may or may not be included on a national or state DNC registry.

National, State, or Other DNC Lists

Phone numbers that are on a National, State, or Other DNC list have registered their phone number with a DNC registry. It's important to scrub numbers against these databases, as the owners of these phone numbers have expressed that they do not want to be contacted by businesses that they have not given consent to be contacted by.

Calling or Texting a Number on a DNC List

Phone numbers that are on a DNC list cannot be called or texted. These numbers will have their call & text communication consent set to Do Not Call and can be filtered on the people page using the TCPA Number Consent filter.

While only the account admin can fully remove a phone number from the DNC lists, if you have consent to contact a lead who's phone number is on a DNC list, you can change the phone number consent status to something other than Do Not Call to call or text that lead. This action will not affect any other leads that may have the same phone number on their profile.

 

DNC Scrub Integrations

Lofty integrates directly with DNC.com. Learn more here: DNC.com (Contact Center Compliance) Integration

name: DNC.com (Contact Center Compliance) Integration
title: DNC.com (Contact Center Compliance) Integration
body:
Introduction

Lofty has a direct integration with DNC.com (also known as Contact Center Compliance) that you can utilize to to connect the National DNC, state DNCs, and known litigator lists into the Lofty platform. In order to do so, you must meet both of these requirements:

  1. You must have a SAN generated by the National Do Not Call Registry. You can learn more about this here: https://telemarketing.donotcall.gov/ . You will need this before subscribing to DNC.com.
  2. You must have a separate subscription with DNC.com. Schedule an appointment with them or review their website to learn more. DNC.com will provide you with a certain number of "scrubs" and these will be utilized in Lofty to scrub phone numbers (see details below for how it works).

*IMPORTANT: All the information shared in this article represents product functionality information only. This is not legal advice. You must obtain your own legal advice regarding all federal and local laws/regulations for call and text compliance.

Summary

  • DNC.com Integration Settings
  • How the Integration Works
  • Internal DNC List Sync
  • Best Practices During a Government Shutdown

DNC.com Integration Settings

To integrate your DNC.com account with Lofty, click 'Connect' on the integrations or marketplace page:

Here, you will need to provide your DNC.com account name, API key, and the Project ID. Note, the Project ID is only required if you want to link a specific project. If this field is left empty, your master project will be configured.

Once you have finished integrating your DNC.com account with Lofty, you will be asked to choose how you would like DNC.com results codes to behave in Lofty. The DNC.com integration with Lofty will return a status code when a number is checked. Please contact support@dnc.com regarding any questions for these status codes.

When the 'Safe' toggle is turned ON for a specific status, Lofty will NOT warn you prior to calling or texting these numbers because it has been marked as "safe."

You can edit these preferences at any time by selecting "Configure DNC.com settings"

How the Integration Works

Once integrated, a "DNC.com Status" will be listed with every phone number (see screenshot below). This will provide the status returned by DNC.com, but only if the number has been checked. It will also list the last time that status is updated.

 

For any call or text you are making to a phone number in your system with the status of "Unknown Consent," the DNC.com integration will process a "scrub" to determine if there are any results from DNC.com that you want to be aware of.  All other statuses representing consent received (System Recorded Consent, User Recorded Consent, Business Relationship) will not trigger the DNC.com scrub. 

 

If the phone number has been scrubbed already within the last 30 days, it will not be scrubbed again if you are trying to make a phone call or send a text. The system will check the "Last Updated" field to check this. Most DNC lists must be checked every 30 days for any changes which is why this logic exists.

 

If the status returned from DNC.com is considered 'unsafe,' Lofty will present you with a warning. One example can be seen in the following screenshot. You can still choose to proceed with the call/text but should pay attention to the warning and how it applies to your situation before doing so. 

 

If a phone number has been determined by the integration to be 'unsafe,' all Smart Plan (or other) auto texts in the Lofty platform will be converted into manual text tasks for manual review to avoid automated texts being sent to someone on a DNC list. 

Internal DNC List Sync

Lofty will automatically sync your Internal DNC list to your DNC.com project. Important note - only numbers with a +1 country code will be synced.

Best Practices During a Government Shutdown

During a government shutdown, the FTC may not be actively maintaining the federal Do Not Call Registry. Outlined below are some best practice compliance steps you can take to protect yourself. 

1. Continue scrubbing against the most recent national DNC data available

  • Use your last updated FTC registry file from before the outage.
  • Maintain integration with DNC.com so you still remove known DNC numbers.

2. Scrub against state-specific DNC lists as usual

  • State registries remain operational unless separately affected.
  • Many state lists include additional DNC numbers not in the federal list.

3. Honor your internal DNC list

  • Always suppress numbers where the lead has directly opted out with you, regardless of national or state database access.

4. Apply extra caution with cold prospecting

  • If your risk tolerance is low, consider limiting calls to only those who have consented to be contacted by you. 

5. Document compliance actions during the outage

  • Keep records showing you scrubbed with the most recent available data from the FTC.
  • Note dates of your last download and any operational limitations caused by the shutdown.
  • Maintain calling logs and suppression reports.

6. Monitor for FTC service restoration

  • As soon as the FTC DNC Registry comes back online, update your data immediately.
  • Refresh integrations with the new copy to catch any numbers registered during the outage period.

7. Train calling staff on modified compliance rules during the shutdown

  • Explain that new leads may have registered but are not yet in your suppression lists.
  • Reinforce opt-out handling and prompt honoring of any DNC requests received live.

Bottom line:
You can keep running your scrubs via DNC.com integrations using the last available dataset, but you should treat the outage as a heightened-risk period and tighten calling criteria until the national list is refreshed.

name: Data Subject Access Request (DSAR)
title: Data Subject Access Request (DSAR)
body:
Introduction

DSAR stands for Data Subject Access Request. DSAR is a request that individuals (data subjects) can make to an organization to access the personal data that the organization holds about them. DSARs are a key part of data protection laws.

The Data Subject Access Request page offers your website visitors several options to protect their data. These are outlined below.

Note: This is currently a beta that is only available on California based websites.

Summary

  • Right to Opt Out of Data Sharing
  • Right to Access Their Data
  • Right to Delete Their Account
  • How will I know if my lead has made a request?

Right to Opt Out of Data Sharing

Website visitors have the right to opt out of having their data shared with any other parties. If a website visitor requests this, we will notify them that opting out of data sharing may impact their user experience when visiting your website.

  • If the website visitor is not logged in to the Lofty built website, they will need to opt-out again of having their data shared if they use a different device, browser, or if they clear their cookies.
  • If the website visitor is logged into the Lofty built website, their opt-out preference will be associated with their account. This means that they will not need to opt-out again when switching devices, browsers, or clearing cookies — their preference will be automatically applied. 

 

Right to Access Their Data

Website visitors can request a copy of their personal data that has been collected by using your website. If this is requested, we will first verify the website visitor's email address. Upon successful verification, they will gain access to the data of the lead that is associated with their email address.

This data includes the timeline log of searches, views, favorites, and requests that they have made on your website.

 

Right to Delete Their Account

Website visitors have the right to request that their personal data be deleted. A ‘Delete Account’ button will be added to the website account settings, when a website visitor is logged in to your Lofty built account. Deletion requests will trigger email verification, like the ‘Right to Access’ option, to verify that the requestor is who they say they are.

When a website visitor requests to delete their account, their lead profile will be placed into the deleted pipeline. The lead will no longer receive any email or text communication. At the same time, the lead's assigned agent will be notified, informing them of the lead's request to delete their account and reminding them to manually erase the lead to meet the lead's requirements. 

Lofty will not directly erase leads. It is your responsibility to fully comply with the deletion request.

 

How will I know if my lead has made a request?

All Data Subject Access Requests will be logged on the lead's timeline. You will also receive an email notification if action is required by you, such as a deletion request.

 

Questions?

name: Just Sold
title: Just Sold
body:
Congratulations on your successful sale! Now that you've closed the deal, it's time to leverage Lofty CRM’s powerful tools to showcase your achievement and maintain visibility in your market. By running a well-coordinated "Just Sold" campaign, you can build your reputation, engage past clients, and attract potential buyers for future listings.

This playbook outlines the steps you need to follow to use Lofty CRM's features to promote your recent sale effectively.


1. Just Sold Landing Page

We recommend creating a landing page for your "Just Sold" property. This page provides social proof of your success and serves as a valuable marketing tool for generating future business.

Steps:

  • Create Your Just Sold Landing Page:

    Go to Marketing > Landing Pages > Add a Landing Page. Select the Feature a Listing landing page. Switch the Property Type to Just Sold. 

  • Share the Landing Page:

    Use the landing page URL to highlight your successful sale in email, social media, and digital ads. The page typically includes:

    • Photos of the property
    • A message about the successful sale
    • The closing price (if desired)
    • Your contact information for future listings

2. Lofty Blast: Run a Just Sold Ad

Lofty CRM's Lofty Blast is an excellent tool for running targeted ads about your recent sale. It helps you engage your current network and reach new potential clients.

Steps:

2.1. Create Your Just Sold Ad:

  • Go to the Marketing tab in Lofty CRM and select Lofty Blast.
  • Choose the "Just Sold" option and customize your ad with the following details:
    • Property Address
    • Sale Price (if you wish to share this information)
    • Property Highlights (e.g., number of bedrooms, features, and key selling points)
    • A call-to-action like: “Thinking of selling? Call me today!”

2.2. Target Your Audience:

  • Use Lofty CRM’s segmentation tools to target specific buyer or seller groups, such as people who have previously shown interest in the area, or potential sellers who may be looking to list their properties.

2.3. Launch Your Campaign:

  • Once you’ve customized your ad, schedule or launch your campaign. Lofty Blast allows you to monitor how well your ad performs, so you can tweak and optimize future campaigns.

3. Social Studio: Share Your Just Sold Property Across Social Media

Social media is a powerful tool for building your brand and engaging your community. Lofty CRM's Social Studio makes it easy to share your success with your audience.

Steps:

3.1. Manual Social Media Sharing:

  • After your "Just Sold" landing page is set up, manually share it on your social media platforms. Here are some example captions to use:
    • “Another one SOLD! [Property Address] closed today! If you're thinking of selling, let’s chat!”
    • “Excited to announce this beautiful home has sold! Congrats to the new owners at [Property Address].”
    • “We did it again! [Property Address] is officially SOLD. Interested in selling? Reach out!”

3.2. Use Lofty Social Studio to Automate Posts:

  • Navigate to Marketing → Social Studio → Create Post.
  • Select the "Just Sold" option, choose the property, and customize the post with your messaging.
  • Choose your social media channels (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn) and schedule the post to go live at optimal times.

3.3. Social Auto-Post:

If you’d like to automate the process further, enable social auto-posting in Lofty CRM so that new listings and sales are automatically shared to your social media accounts.

4. Send Just Sold Postcards: Market Locally with Print Center

Using postcards to announce your recent sale is a fantastic way to create local buzz and maintain a strong presence in the community. Lofty CRM's Print Center allows you to send high-quality postcards to potential sellers and buyers.

Steps:

4.1. Design Your Just Sold Postcard:

  • Go to Marketing → Design Center and select a "Just Sold" postcard template.
  • Add property photos, the sale price (optional), and a short message that highlights the successful sale.

4.2. Customize Your Postcard:

  • Include relevant details such as:
    • “Just Sold! [Property Address] at [Sale Price]. Thinking of selling? Let’s talk!”
    • Encourage recipients to contact you if they’re interested in selling their home or buying in the area.

4.3. Print and Distribute:

  • Once your design is ready, you can easily order the postcards through Lofty CRM and have them printed and mailed to nearby homeowners.
  • Tip: Target homes in the same neighborhood or similar communities to generate the best local interest.

Bonus Tips for Maximizing Exposure:

  • Send a Thank-You Email to Your Clients:

    After closing the deal, send a personalized thank-you email to the buyers and sellers, expressing appreciation for their trust in your services. You can also encourage them to refer friends or family who might need your help in the future.

  • Leverage Your Database:

    Use Lofty CRM to send a “Just Sold” email blast to your entire database. Highlight your recent sale, and remind them of the services you offer for both buying and selling.

  • Track Your Success:

    Utilize Lofty CRM’s reporting tools to monitor the effectiveness of your "Just Sold" campaign. Track how many leads and new clients you’re generating, and adjust your strategy as necessary.

By following these steps, you can turn your recent success into a powerful marketing tool to attract new clients and build your real estate business. With Lofty CRM’s suite of tools, you can ensure your "Just Sold" campaigns are effective, efficient, and impactful.

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Buyer Lead Generation Playbook: Maximizing Lofty’s Tools for Client Acquisition
title: Buyer Lead Generation Playbook: Maximizing Lofty’s Tools for Client Acquisition
body:
As a real estate agent primarily working with buyers, generating and converting leads is essential to growing your business. Lofty’s CRM offers powerful tools that allow you to manage, and nurture leads more efficiently. This playbook will walk you through the process of setting up automated lead capture forms, running targeted ads, and utilizing CRM tools to engage and convert potential buyers into clients.

 

1. Setting Up Landing Pages for Specific Property Types or Buyer Demographics

Why It Matters:

Landing pages are a powerful tool for attracting and converting leads. By tailoring your landing pages to specific property types or buyer demographics, you can target the right audience and collect their contact information, which feeds directly into your Lofty CRM.

Steps:

  1. Log into Lofty CRM and navigate to the Landing Pages section.
  2. Create a New Landing Page:
    • Title the landing page according to your target audience (e.g., "Dream Homes for First-Time Buyers," or "Luxury Properties in [Area]").
    • Add high-quality images and detailed property descriptions that match the interests of your targeted buyer demographic.
  3. Promote the Landing Page:
    • Use Lofty’s social media integration tools (like Social Studio) to share the landing page on your social channels.
    • Run ads or use email campaigns to drive traffic to the landing page.

2. Using Zip Code Blasts to Target Buyers in Specific Areas

Why It Matters:

Zip Code Blasts allow you to run hyper-targeted ads to potential buyers within specific geographic areas. This ensures that you’re reaching people who are actively interested in homes within those areas.

Steps:

  1. Navigate to the Zip Code Blast Tool within Lofty CRM.
  2. Select Your Target Area:
    • Choose the zip code(s) or neighborhoods you want to target. You can use Lofty’s data tools to select high-demand areas or neighborhoods you specialize in.
  3. Create Your Ad Campaign:
    • Set the budget and duration for your ad campaign.
    • Craft a compelling message like, “Looking for Your Dream Home in [Area]? Contact Me for Exclusive Listings!”
    • Add a Lead Capture Form (same as in Step 1) or direct users to your landing page.
  4. Monitor and Optimize:
    • Use Lofty’s analytics to track the effectiveness of your ad campaign.
    • Adjust targeting or messaging based on the performance data (e.g., high CTR in certain neighborhoods means you can further narrow down your audience).

3. Automating Email Campaigns to Follow Up with Leads

Why It Matters:

Staying in touch with leads is crucial to building a relationship and keeping them engaged. Automating your follow-up emails saves you time and ensures that no lead slips through the cracks.

Steps:

  1. Set Up an Email Campaign in Lofty CRM:
    • Go to the Email Marketing section of Lofty and select Create New Campaign.
    • Choose a campaign template focused on buyer leads or start from scratch.
  2. Craft Your Email Sequence:
    • Welcome Email: “Thank you for inquiring about homes in [Area]. Let’s schedule a consultation to discuss your needs!”
    • Follow-Up Email: “Did you find the perfect home yet? Here are some homes that might interest you.”
    • Value Email: Provide insights into the buying process, market trends, or tips for first-time buyers.
  3. Set Automation:
    • Choose when emails should be sent based on lead behavior (e.g., 1 day after initial inquiry, 3 days after a showing, etc.).
    • Personalize the emails using CRM tags like first name, property preferences, and location.
  4. Track Engagement:
    • Monitor open rates, click-through rates, and responses to your emails.
    • Adjust your email copy based on lead interactions.

4. Setting Up Property Alerts and Market Reports to Provide Valuable Updates

Why It Matters:

Buyers appreciate up-to-date information on the market. By setting up property alerts and automated market reports, you can keep your leads engaged and encourage them to return to your website regularly.

Steps:

  1. Set Up Property Alerts for Leads:
    • Go to the Lead Profile in Lofty CRM and click on Property Alerts.
    • Set the criteria for the alerts based on your buyer’s preferences, such as location, price range, and property features.
    • Enable automatic alerts to notify buyers when a new property that matches their criteria is listed.
  2. Set Up Automated Market Reports:
    • Go to the Marketing tab in Lofty and select Auto Market Reports.
    • Choose the area or zip code for the reports and select the frequency (e.g., weekly, bi-weekly).
    • Include useful data like average home prices, inventory trends, and property appreciation rates.
  3. Deliver Value:
    • Send regular updates about homes in their target area.
    • Share insights about the local market that could influence their decision to buy.
  4. Monitor Engagement:
    • Track how often buyers open and engage with these alerts and reports.
    • Use this data to refine your approach or follow up with leads who are actively engaging.

Conclusion

By following these steps, you can fully leverage Lofty CRM to generate and convert more leads, nurture your buyer pipeline, and ultimately close more deals. From landing pages and Zip Code Blasts to automated emails, property alerts, and AI-powered engagement, Lofty’s tools will help you stay organized, engaged, and on top of your business.

Stay consistent with your marketing efforts, monitor results, and continuously optimize your approach to ensure long-term success.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Price Reduced
title: Price Reduced
body:
When a price reduction occurs, it’s important to notify potential buyers who have shown interest in the listing by saving or viewing the property.

 

1. Notify Contacts Who Saved or Watched the Property

When a price reduction occurs, it’s important to notify potential buyers who have shown interest in the listing by saving or viewing the property.

  • Go to the Listings Tab in Lofty CRM:
    • Log in to your Lofty CRM account and navigate to the Listings tab.
    • Find and select the listing that has had a price reduction.
  • View Matched Buyers:
    • Inside the “My Listings” section, click on Matched Buyers. This will display all the contacts who have shown interest in the property by saving or watching it.
  • Select Buyers to Notify:
    • Choose the buyers who are most likely to be interested in the new, lower price.
  • Send a Personalized Message:

    • Send a message to your selected buyers using the following template:

      "Hi [#lead_first_name#], I wanted to let you know that the price of this home has just been reduced! If you’re still interested, let me know when you’d like to schedule a showing. [Link to the listing]"

    • This approach is personalized and highlights the price reduction in a clear, direct manner.

2. Message Realtors in your office

Realtors who have previously shown your listing to their clients are key potential partners in spreading the word about the price reduction.

  1. Access Settings in Lofty CRM:
    • Click on the Settings tab within your Lofty CRM dashboard.
  2. Select Realtors in your office:
    • Find and filter the list of realtors who have previously shown or inquired about the property.
    • You can do this by reviewing the Activity History in your listing details to identify these agents.
  3. Craft your message

    • Send an email or text message to the realtors, such as:

      "Hi [Agent’s Name], I wanted to let you know that the price of [property address] has just been reduced. This might be of interest to your clients. Let me know if you’d like to schedule another showing!"

    • This step ensures that other agents are aware of the new pricing and can update their buyers accordingly.

3. Send Out Mailers with the New Updated Price

Traditional mailers can be a powerful tool to keep your listing in front of potential buyers, especially when a price reduction makes it more attractive.

  1. Go to the Marketing Tab:
    • Inside Lofty CRM, navigate to the Marketing tab.
  2. Access the Design Center:
    • Under Design Center, you’ll find several template options, including a “Price Reduced” template.
  3. Customize and Send the Mailer:
    • Customize the template with the updated price, property details, and a compelling call to action.
    • Ensure you include the new price and highlight the reduced amount.
    • Once you're satisfied with the design, select your mailing list and send out the postcards to targeted recipients.

4. Run a Digital Ad Campaign Highlighting the Price Reduction

Running digital ads on platforms like Facebook or Instagram can be an effective way to get the word out to a broader audience.

  1. Create a Facebook Ad Campaign:

    • Go to your Facebook Ads Manager and create a new ad campaign.

    • For the ad copy, use a call to action like:

      “This home’s price was just updated! See more details by clicking Learn More below.”

    • Include attractive images of the property and emphasize the new, lower price.

  2. Leverage Listing Blast:
    • Alternatively, use the Listing Blast feature in Lofty CRM.
    • Choose the duration for the ad campaign and select “Price Reduced” as your ad option.
    • This will automatically adjust your listing’s promotion to focus on the price reduction, ensuring it reaches the right audience.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Open House
title: Open House
body:
Hosting an open house is one of the most effective ways to attract potential buyers, showcase a listing, and generate interest. To make the most out of your open house, it’s important to have a solid strategy in place, ensuring that you're reaching the right audience both online and offline. Lofty CRM provides several tools to help you organize, market, and promote your open house. Here’s a step-by-step playbook to guide you through the process.

 

1. Print Open House Flyers

Printed materials, such as flyers, are key to marketing your open house effectively. They provide a tangible takeaway for attendees and can be distributed in the neighborhood or at local businesses to attract more traffic.

  1. Go to the Marketing Tab in Lofty CRM:
    • Log into your Lofty CRM account and navigate to the Marketing tab.
  2. Access the Design Center:
    • Click on Design Center from the options in the Marketing tab.
  3. Select “Open House” Template:
    • In the Design Center, choose the “Open House” filter to access ready-to-use templates specifically for open houses.
  4. Choose Your Design:
    • Browse through the available designs and choose one that best matches the style and branding of your listing.
  5. Customize Your Flyer:
    • Add specific details about the open house, such as the date, time, property features, and contact information. Make sure the flyer is eye-catching and highlights the key selling points of the property.
  6. Print and Distribute:
    • Once you’re satisfied with the design, click Print. You can then distribute the flyers at the open house, local businesses, or door-to-door in the neighborhood.

2. Notify Neighbors of the Open House

It’s essential to engage the neighborhood where the property is located. Neighbors may have friends, family, or colleagues looking for a home in the area. Reaching out to them can generate additional leads.

  1. Door Knocking:
    • If appropriate, consider personally visiting neighbors to inform them of the upcoming open house. This more personal approach can help you establish rapport with local residents. Be sure to have a few flyers on hand to distribute.
  2. Send Mailers:
    • For a more widespread notification, send out postcards or mailers to nearby homes. You can use Lofty CRM’s Design Center to create a custom mailer that highlights the open house and the benefits of the property.
    • Steps for Mailers:
      1. Access Design Center as described above.
      2. Select a template for mailers or postcards.
      3. Customize it with the open house details.
      4. Choose your mailing list or targeted area.
      5. Print and send the mailers.

By notifying the neighbors, you’re giving them the chance to spread the word, which can help attract more potential buyers.

3. Start Digital Ads Advertising the Open House

Running digital ads on platforms like Facebook and Instagram is a great way to expand your open house’s reach. These ads allow you to target specific demographics and location-based audiences, ensuring you get in front of the right people.

  1. Create a Digital Ad Campaign:
    • Use Lofty CRM’s Listing Blast feature or your Facebook Ads Manager to set up an ad campaign.
  2. Target the Right Audience:
    • When creating your ad, target users who are in the local area or in nearby cities, and those who have shown interest in similar properties.
  3. Ad Copy and Design:

    • Craft a compelling message for your ad, such as:

      “Join us this [day] from [time] for an exclusive tour of this stunning home at [property address]. Don’t miss out on the opportunity to see this gorgeous property in person!”

    • Include high-quality images of the home and highlight key features that make it stand out.

  4. Choose the Duration:
    • Set the ad to run a few days leading up to the open house and adjust the budget accordingly to ensure enough exposure.
  5. Monitor and Adjust:
    • Track the performance of your ad and make adjustments as needed to optimize the reach and engagement.

4. Notify Office Agents of the Scheduled Open House

Communication with your fellow agents is crucial, especially if you work in a busy office. Letting them know about the open house allows them to inform their buyers and increase the chances of a successful sale.

  1. Email or Messaging Notification:

    • Use Lofty CRM’s communication tools to send an email or message to all agents in your office, letting them know about the scheduled open house. Include key details such as date, time, and any special offers.

    • Sample message:

      “Hey everyone, I’m hosting an open house this [day] at [property address]. Feel free to bring your clients by! The home has [feature highlights] and is listed at [price]. Let me know if you have any questions.”

  2. Leverage Office Networks:
    • Encourage your colleagues to share the open house information with their networks. You can even create an internal calendar or reminder to keep everyone in the loop.

5. Create a Facebook Event

A Facebook event is a great way to increase visibility and build anticipation for your open house. By inviting potential buyers and sharing the event with local groups, you can generate buzz and encourage more people to attend.

  1. Create a Facebook Event:
    • Go to your Facebook profile or business page and create a new event.
    • Add all the details about the open house, such as the date, time, location, and a brief description of the property.
  2. Promote the Event:
    • Share the event on your business page, personal profile, and in local groups to increase visibility. Be sure to invite your contacts and encourage them to RSVP.
  3. Engage Attendees:
    • As the event approaches, engage with attendees by posting updates, sharing additional photos of the property, or answering any questions in the event’s discussion thread.
  4. Reminder Posts:
    • In the days leading up to the open house, post reminders about the event and highlight any special features or reasons why people shouldn’t miss the opportunity.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Just Listed
title: Just Listed
body:
Congratulations on your new listing! The key to a successful sale starts with how you market the property, and using Lofty CRM's powerful tools to their fullest potential can ensure your listing gets the attention it deserves. This playbook outlines a comprehensive, step-by-step strategy for leveraging Lofty’s features to promote your newly listed property effectively.

By following these steps, you will increase your chances of generating more showings, attracting the right buyers, and closing deals faster.


1. Create a Listing Landing Page

Lofty automatically generates a landing page for every new listing, and this page is an invaluable tool for driving traffic and providing potential buyers with the information they need. Here's how to use it:

Steps:

  • Access Your Listing Landing Page:

    When you add a new listing to Lofty CRM, the platform will automatically create a customized landing page for it. This page is your go-to link to share across all marketing channels.

  • Share the Landing Page:

    Use this landing page URL to promote the listing through email, social media, and digital ads. This page typically includes:

    • Property photos and virtual tours
    • Detailed listing description
    • Contact information for scheduling showings
    • A clear call-to-action (e.g., "Schedule a Showing", "Learn More").

2. Segment Buyer Lists

Targeted marketing is key to a successful listing campaign. Lofty CRM makes it easy to filter your existing database to find contacts who are most likely to be interested in your new listing.

Steps:

2.1. Segment Your Contact Database:

  • Navigate to the Contacts tab in Lofty CRM.
  • Use filters to segment your database based on criteria such as location, price range, home type, or previous interactions.
  • Select your new listing and choose the “Matched Buyers” option to focus on contacts who may be most interested in this particular property.

2.2. Send a Mass Text:

  • Once you’ve segmented your list, use Lofty’s mass texting tool to send a personalized message to your contacts. Example text:

    “Hi [#lead_first_name#], check out our newest listing at [Property Address]! I think it’s a perfect match for you. Let me know if you'd like to schedule a showing or get more details.”

2.3. Send a Mass Email:

  • You can also send a personalized email to the same group of contacts using Lofty’s mass email tool. Example email:

    “Hi [#lead_first_name#], I wanted to share our newest listing at [Property Address] with you! This property is exactly what you’ve been looking for. Click below to see more details and let me know if you’d like to schedule a showing.”

    • Make sure to include a link to the listing landing page and a clear CTA.

3. Notify Office Agents

Getting your colleagues involved in promoting the listing can significantly increase its visibility and the number of showings. Involve your office agents and encourage them to share the listing with their buyers.

Steps:

3.1. Send a Mass Email to Office Agents:

  • Go to Settings in Lofty CRM and select My Organization.
  • Select All Agents and use the Mass Email option to notify your team about the new listing.

3.2. Craft the Email: Here’s a sample email template to send to your office:

Subject: New Listing Alert – [Property Address or Name]

Dear Team,

I’m excited to announce a brand-new listing that just hit the market – [Property Address or Name]! This property is a fantastic opportunity for our buyers, and I’d love for you to have all the details so you can share it with your clients.

Property Highlights:

  • Address: [Insert Address]
  • Price: $[Insert Price]
  • Bedrooms/Bathrooms: [Insert number of beds/baths]
  • Square Footage: [Insert square footage]
  • Key Features: [List unique selling points, e.g., "Updated kitchen, spacious backyard, finished basement, etc."]

I’ve attached the listing details, photos, and MLS number for your reference. If you have any clients who might be interested, feel free to reach out to me directly for more information or to schedule a showing.

Let’s get this great property in front of the right buyers!

4. Social Sharing: Leverage Your Social Media Channels

Social media is one of the most effective ways to generate interest and drive traffic to your listing—plus, it’s free! Lofty CRM’s social media tools make it easy to share your new listing with your followers. Here’s how to get started:

Steps:

4.1. Manual Social Media Sharing:

  • Using the auto-generated landing page for your listing, copy the URL and post it manually on your social media accounts. Here are some example captions to include:
    • “You don’t want to miss this property! Click below to see more photos and details.”
    • “1234 Main St – Just Listed for Sale! Check out this beautiful new home on the market.”
    • “New Property Alert! [Property Address] just hit the market! Click to get more info.”

4.2. Using Lofty Social Studio (if available):

  • Access Social Studio: Go to the Marketing tab and click on Social Studio in the bottom left corner.
  • Create a Post: Select the Create Post button and choose the Listing option.
  • Select Your Listing: Choose the property you want to promote.
  • Choose Your Channels: Select the social media platforms where you want to post the listing (e.g., Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn).
  • Auto Post: You can schedule your posts to go live at optimal times.

4.3. Social Auto-Post: If you want Lofty CRM to automatically share your listings, set up auto-posting in your Social Studio settings for maximum convenience.

 

5. Postcards: Market Your Listing Locally

One of the best ways to create a local buzz around a new listing is by sending postcards to nearby homes. Neighbors may know someone who’s looking to move to the area, or they may be thinking about selling soon themselves.

Steps:

5.1. Design Your Postcard:

  • Go to Design Center in Lofty CRM under the Marketing tab.
  • Select a “Just Listed” postcard template that fits your brand and the property’s style.

5.2. Customize Your Postcard:

  • Add property details, including photos, the listing price, and key selling points.

  • Include a call-to-action like:

    “Know someone looking for a home in the area? Share this postcard with them!”

    • Or, add: “Interested in selling your home? Let me know how I can help!”

5.3. Print and Distribute:

  • After customizing your design, you can print and distribute the postcards to nearby homes.
  • Tip: Focus on delivering postcards to homes within a few blocks or in nearby neighborhoods to maximize your impact.

Bonus Tips for Maximizing Exposure:

  • Host an Open House: Consider hosting an open house and promoting it through the same channels (email, social media, postcards) to increase foot traffic and visibility.
  • Partner with Local Influencers: If you have any connections with local bloggers, social media influencers, or community figures, ask them to share your listing with their followers.
  • Track Results: Use Lofty CRM’s tracking tools to monitor the success of your marketing efforts, including how much traffic your landing page is getting and how many leads convert into showings or sales.

By following this Just Listed Playbook, you can leverage Lofty CRM’s powerful tools to get your listing in front of more buyers, generate more interest, and ultimately close faster. Consistency, creativity, and strategic use of these resources will make you stand out as a highly effective real estate agent in your market.

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Cookie Preference Settings
title: Cookie Preference Settings
body:
Introduction

If you have a Lofty website, your site visitors have the option to adjust their website cookies. Learn more about website cookies here: Website Cookies. The default preference settings opts out of non-essential cookies. 

Privacy laws emphasize that users must have clear choices regarding data collection, particularly for advertising and tracking cookies.

Summary

  • How Do Cookie Settings Impact Google Analytics?
  • Does This Affect Website Lead Collection and Conversion Rates?
  • How is Lofty Addressing the Data Reduction?
  • Conclusion

How Do Cookie Settings Impact Google Analytics?

Based on our testing across multiple websites, implementing an opt-out default setting has resulted in the following GA data changes:

  • Event count decreased by approximately 40%
  • Total users decreased by approximately 60%
  • Registration data remained unaffected

This suggests:

  1. Less meaningful traffic is filtered out – Visitors who briefly land on your website and leave without engaging typically do not consent to cookies, so GA cannot track their activity.
  2. Users genuinely interested in browsing your website tend to accept cookie consent, ensuring their activity is still tracked. This is why registration data remains stable despite the decrease in total users and event counts.

Does This Affect Website Lead Collection and Conversion Rates?

No. An opt-out default cookie preference does not impact your website’s lead collection or conversion rates. As seen in our data, registration numbers remain stable, meaning that visitors willing to engage with your business are still consenting to cookies, allowing their actions to be tracked and recorded.

How is Lofty Addressing the Data Reduction?

To mitigate data loss, we have implemented Google Consent Mode.

What Is Google Consent Mode?

Google Consent Mode allows Google Analytics and Google Ads to continue collecting anonymous modeled data, even when visitors opt out of cookies, helping to reduce data loss.

Learn more here: Google Consent Mode

Data Volume Requirements for Consent Mode

Google Consent Mode requires sufficient website traffic to enable effective data modeling. However, many smaller websites may not meet the required threshold. Specifically:

  1. Google requires at least 1,000 consented visitor interactions (e.g., page views) to begin data modeling.
  2. If a website has low traffic, Google may not generate modeled data, meaning opted-out user behavior will be completely absent from Google Analytics.

As a result, websites with lower traffic may see a more significant reduction in Google Analytics data.

Conclusion

  • Defaulting to opt-out aligns with global privacy trends and ensures compliance.
  • Google Analytics data will decrease, but registration data remains unchanged, indicating that interested users still opt in.
  • Google Consent Mode has been implemented to mitigate data loss, but its effectiveness depends on website traffic volume.
  • The cookie opt-out setting does not impact website lead collection or conversion rates.

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please get in touch with our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your CRM.

name: Social Agent
title: Social Agent
body:
Social Agent is Lofty’s social media automation tool designed specifically for real estate professionals. Unlike general-purpose social media automation platforms, Social Agent is deeply integrated with your MLS and Lofty website. This makes it effortless to showcase your listings, boost your website SEO, and capture leads hands-free.

 

With Social Agent, you can:

  • Automatically share new listings to your social media feeds.
  • Drive traffic directly back to your Lofty website.
  • View and track engagements inside Lofty, no extra logins required.
  • Gain insights into top-performing social account strategies.
  • Build a personalized social strategy tailored to your business goals.

 

Summary

  • Planner
    • Competitor Analysis
    • AI-Powered Social Strategy
  • Posts
  • Listing Feed
    • Set Your Auto-Post Profiles
    • Set Your Listing Auto-Post Captions
  • Create a Post
  • FAQs

You can find Social Agent in Marketing > Social Studio. Social Studio is broken up into 3 tabs - Planner, Posts, and Listing Feed.

If you do not have the Social Agent subscription, you get 3 AI-generated posts for free. 

Planner

Our intelligent AI agents can help you build a winning social media strategy from the ground up. On the Planner tab, you can create a new plan or edit an existing post plan and review your upcoming AI-generated posts.

The Post Planner uses the competitor analysis and your business goals to create a tailored content strategy and calendar.

  • How to use: The AI will gather information based on your website's featured areas and your connected social media profiles and automatically generate a suggested content calendar. You can then review, edit, and schedule the posts directly from the planner.

  • Seamless Integration: Once activated, this feature integrates with your connected social profiles, allowing you to go from a strategic idea to a scheduled post in a few clicks.

  • Content Type:

    • Market Insights

    • Home Designs

    • Consumer Guides

    • Investments

    • Holiday Posts

You can use this feature to plan posts for the week ahead. On day 5 of the current cycle, Post Planner will automatically generate next week's content. 

 

Competitor Analysis

 

Social Agent uses the featured areas you've set on your website, and your connected social accounts, and scans top-performing social media accounts in your area to generate a report on:

  • Follower counts
  • Service areas
  • Posting frequency
  • Content distribution (types of posts they share)
  • Engagement levels
  • Commonly used hashtags

This report highlights the differences between you and top-performing agents in your area, and suggests ways to improve your social media performance. Alongside the data, you’ll receive a summary and insights section with practical recommendations you can apply to strengthen your own social media strategy.

 

 

AI-Powered Social Strategy

Using insights from the Competitor Analysis, Social Agent builds a customized content plan for you. These fields will be filled by Social Agent, but you can adjust them to your liking. 

 

 

This includes:

  • Suggested posting frequency per week.

  • Ideal content mix, including:

    • Property showcases

      • Highlight your properties

    • Market analysis

      • Local and national housing trends, including prices, inventory, and mortgage rates
      • Hyperlocal community highlights, such as schools, development, and demographics

    • Buyer and seller guides

      • These guides include actionable tips from 'First-time homebuyer checklists' to 'Seller prep hacks.'
      • Builds trust and nurtures buyer and seller leads

    • Investment insights

      • Target investor clients with ROI breakdowns, tax strategies, and emerging market spotlights.

    • Home staging and design tips

      • Highly visual and shareable, low-budget, high-impact staging and renovation ideas

    • Holiday greetings

      • The Holiday greetings that are supported are:

        • New Year's Day
        • National Realtors' Day
        • Memorial Day
        • Independence Day
        • Labor Day
        • Halloween
        • Thanksgiving
        • Christmas
        • Valentine's Day
        • Labor Day

         

You can also fine-tune your posts with the Strategy Prompt, giving instructions for tone, style, or content. For example:

  • “Write this in a friendly, approachable tone.”

  • “Add a call-to-action for scheduling a showing.”

Manage your Planned Posts

Once you have completed the Competitor Analysis and Social Strategy, Social Agent will generate a week's worth of recommended posts. You can view, edit, and delete upcoming AI-generated posts in the Planner tab. 

 

The content will post automatically on the scheduled date. 

 

Posts

Use this tab to view posts that have gone out, review post activity like comments and likes, and manage your connected social channels.

  • Social Profiles

    • This is where you connect and manage all of your social media accounts.

      • How to use: Click the Social Channels button to add new social media accounts. You can easily refresh an account's data or remove a profile if needed.

  • Post Engagements
    • This is a real-time inbox of all engagements (view, likes, comments, registrations) across your connected social media accounts.
      • Currently, only Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube are supported in the live post engagement feed. 
      • You may need to reconnect your social profile to reauthorize Lofty to access your live engagement feed. The profile list will display a red exclamation point (!) next to your profile if it needs to be reauthorized. 
  • Post List
    • The post list displays all of your scheduled and past posts from every connected social profile. You can switch to calendar view to see the whole post calendar.

 

Listing Feed

Use this tab to manage your listing auto-post rules and captions.

Once activated, Social Agent monitors your new listings and suggests relevant content to post. You can configure it to automatically create posts for key updates, including: Coming Soon, New Listing, Open House, Price Reduced, Under Contract, Sold, Back to Market.

 

Set Your Auto-Post Profiles

Social Agent can be configured to automatically generate posts for your and your team's listings. You can configure the auto-post settings to trigger based on listing status changes. 

The available listing statuses are:

  • Coming Soon
  • New Listings
  • Open House
  • Price Reduced
  • Under Contract
  • Sold
  • Back To Market

To enable or disable property auto-posting, click on the three horizontal lines. 

 

To configure the social media profiles and property statuses you would like to auto-post, click Setting > Triggers & Profiles.

 

Switch between property statuses at the top of the Auto-Post Profile window. Check or uncheck the boxes next to the profile under each status type to enable or disable auto-posting. 

 

You can control which types of properties auto-post using the Property Filter tool in My Listings or Office Listings. 

 

Set Your Listing Auto-Post Captions

There are two caption options for listing auto-posts: status-based templates and AI-generated. 

 

To set up your captions, click on Settings in the bottom left-hand corner, then Default Captions. 

 

 You can choose between templated captions that you write or AI-generated captions. 

 

AI-generated captions are dynamic and adapt to each listing. They are optimized for engagement and social media length. 

 

Create a Post

Click on the blue +New button on any tab in Social Studio to enter the post creator. You can also 

This will take you to the Create a Post screen, where you can craft content with Social Agent or type your own post. 

 

Social Agent will generate 2-3 post options for you to choose from. You can also continue to refine the post options using the chat or the enhancement buttons.

Once you are happy with one of the recommendations, click the Use It button to bring the content into your post editor. 

If you have a post idea that needs refinement, you can click the Create a Post button and start having a conversation about the post you want to make. Social Agent will generate post options, complete with hashtags or relevant URLs, for you to choose from. 

 

 

You can also manually create post content using the Edit Post section.

 

 

FAQs
 


Q: I have a 3-seat account. If I buy Social Agent on 1 Lofty seat, is that access shared with my two other Lofty seats? 
A: It is not shared.

Q: It says you can connect six social media profiles. What does it mean?

A: It means you can link up to six different social media accounts to your Social Studio dashboard. These can include accounts from supported platforms such as:

  • Facebook Pages
  • Instagram Business accounts
  • Twitter profiles
  • LinkedIn profiles
  • Youtube profiles
  • Google Business Profile

Q: Can I have more than 6 social media profiles?

A: The Social Ag package allows users to connect 6 social media profiles. If you need more, you can purchase through the Marketplace>Lofty Products> Branding and Marketing> Social Studio.
($2 per extra profile)

 

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

Related terms: Social Agent, social media profiles

name: Sales Tax
title: Sales Tax
body:
Introduction

Lofty charges applicable sales tax. The sales tax rate may vary, depending on the products purchased and the purchaser's location. Please verify your billing address in the Billing Center and update accordingly.

FAQs

Why are you charging sales tax?
We are required to collect and remit sales tax in certain states to comply with changes in tax regulations.

 

How do you calculate the sales tax amount?

Sales tax is determined based on your billing address, the products being purchased, and applicable state or local tax laws. We are using a software called Avalara. 

 

Will sales tax apply to all of your products and services?
Sales tax generally applies to our software subscriptions, but it may not apply to all services. Tax applicability depends on your state and local regulations.

 

Is sales tax included in my subscription price or added on top?
Sales tax is added on top of your subscription price and displayed as a separate line item on your invoice.

 

How will sales tax appear on my invoice or billing statement?
Sales tax will be listed as a separate charge on your invoice under "Taxes" or "Sales Tax." You will see the tax amount and rate applied.

 

I live in a state/country without sales tax. Do I still have to pay?
If your billing address is in a state or country without sales tax, we will not charge sales tax on your invoice.

 

My business is registered in a tax-free state, but I use the software in a taxable state. Which tax rules apply?
Tax is determined based on your billing address. If your billing address is in a tax-free state but your usage is in a taxable state, you may still be responsible for self-reporting use tax.

 

Do I have to pay sales tax if I am outside the United States?
Sales tax generally applies to those in the United States. If you are outside the U.S., VAT or GST may apply, depending on your country’s tax laws.

 

What if my business is tax-exempt? How do I provide a resale or exemption certificate?
If your business is tax-exempt, please provide a valid exemption certificate to your CSM or contact our support team. Once verified, sales tax will no longer be charged.

 

What if I believe I was incorrectly charged sales tax? How do I dispute it?
If you believe you were incorrectly charged sales tax, contact our support team with details. We will review and correct any errors if applicable.

 

Will sales tax be charged on prorated or discounted invoices?
Yes, sales tax will be applied to prorated or discounted invoices based on the final taxable amount.

 

What happens if I don’t pay the sales tax portion of my invoice?
Failure to pay the full invoice amount, including sales tax, may result in account suspension or service interruption.

 

Will I receive a sales tax report for my records or tax filings?
Yes, sales tax details will be included on your invoices, which you can access in your billing portal for tax reporting purposes.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your CRM.

name: Android Notification Setup Guide
title: Android Notification Setup Guide
body:
Since an Android software update in 2024, activity restrictions on background applications have become stricter, preventing users from receiving Lofty app notifications unless they have chosen specific settings.

This is a guide on how to configure your settings on your Android phone to ensure you can continue to receive reliable notifications from Lofty.

 

Overview

  • Samsung series
  • Google series
  • Huawei series

Samsung series 

1. Open Lofty notification settings and toggle on “Show notifications”

2. Go to Settings > Applications > find Lofty

  • Enter the Lofty info page > find Battery
  • Enter Battery
  • Change to Unrestricted

3. Go to Settings>General management>Battery

  • Turn off "Power saving"

4. In Battery, go to “Background usage limits”

  • Go to “Deep sleeping apps”
  • In “Deep sleeping apps”, if Lofty is in the list of Deep sleeping apps, tap the three dots on the top right, then select Lofty to remove it from the list.

5. Navigate back to “Background usage limits” and enter “Auto run apps”

  • Find Lofty and toggle on

 

Google series

1. Open Lofty notification settings and toggle on “All Lofty notifications”

2. In Settings > Apps > find Lofty

  • Enter the Lofty application details page > find "App battery usage"
  • Change the battery usage to “Unrestricted”

3. In Settings, go to “Battery”

  • In Battery, enter “Battery Saver”
  • Toggle off “Use Battery Saver”

Huawei series

1. In Settings, find Lofty in your Notifications. Turn on the “Allow notifications” switch

2. In Settings, go to Battery, toggle off “Power Saving Mode”

3. In Settings > Apps & services > App launch > find Lofty

  • Turn OFF automatic management for Lofty
  • In the resulting pop-up, turn on “Auto Launch” and “Run in background”, then tap “Ok”

name: How to Register for A2P 10DLC
title: How to Register for A2P 10DLC
body:
Introduction

If you or your AI Assistant sends text messages to United States phone numbers, your virtual phone numbers must be linked to a verified A2P 10DLC (Application to Person, 10 digit long code) campaign. This article will walk you through preparing your website, registering in Lofty, campaign setup, and common error codes. 

Not sure what A2P 10DLC is? Learn more here: A2P 10DLC - What It Is & Which Plan to Choose

Summary

  • Phase 1: Prepare Your Website (Do This Before Registering)
  • Phase 2: Register Your Brand in Lofty
  • Phase 3: Configure Your Campaign
  • Pricing & Payment
  • Common Error Codes & How to Fix Them

Phase 1: Prepare Your Website (Do This Before Registering)

Reviewers at The Campaign Registry will check your website against your registration. Get this right first — fixing it after a rejection means paying to resubmit.

1A. Website Basics

 

1B. Consent Checkboxes

All SMS consent checkboxes must be:

  • Unchecked by default
  • Optional (not required to submit the form)
  • Allow users to submit without checking them

Use the exact wording below — your campaign's opt-in description will quote it verbatim:

Sole Proprietor

  • Checkbox 1 (optional): "By checking this box, I agree to receive text messages from [agentName] regarding real estate services, property inquiries, scheduling, and related communications. Message frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply. Reply HELP for help or STOP to opt out."
  • Checkbox 2: "By checking this box, I agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy of this website."

Standard Brand (Marketing)

  • Checkbox 1 (optional): "By checking this box, I agree to receive recurring marketing communication from [CompanyName], including auto-dialed calls, texts, and artificial/prerecorded voice messages (message frequency varies; data rates may apply; reply 'STOP' to opt-out of texts or 'HELP' for assistance); Consent not required to make a purchase. I understand that I can call XXX-XXX-XXXX to obtain direct assistance."
  • Checkbox 2: "By checking this box, I agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy of this website."

Note: Finalize this wording before moving on — you'll paste it directly into the registration form.

1C. Privacy Policy & Terms of Service

Your site needs both, with working links. Each must include specific SMS language:

  • Privacy Policy — Add a dedicated "SMS / Text Messaging" section with:
    • A statement that users can opt out by replying STOP to any text (must be SMS-specific, not a general opt-out clause)
    • "Text messaging originator opt-in data and consent will not be shared with any third parties."
  • Terms of Service — Add the following:
    • "Carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages."
    • Instructions for STOP (opt out) and HELP (assistance)
    • "Message and data rates may apply."

Phase 2: Register Your Brand in Lofty

Navigate to Personal Settings → Communication → Call & Text → 10DLC Compliance and click Register Now.

Step 1: Select whether you have a Tax ID (EIN/CBN).

  • Yes → Standard Brand
  • No → Sole Proprietor Brand

Note: Selecting the wrong type will almost certainly fail — you'll pay again to resubmit.

Step 2: Fill in your business information. All information must be real, verifiable, and match public records.

 

Phase 3: Configure Your Campaign

3A. Opt-In Description

This must accurately reflect your actual website flow. Reviewers will verify it. Paste your checkbox wording verbatim — do not paraphrase.

One-step form (all fields on one page):

"Consumers opt in by completing the contact form at {WEBSITE_URL}. The form displays a checkbox stating: '[EXACT CHECKBOX TEXT]'. Checking this box is optional. Phone number is optional. All checkboxes are unchecked by default and are not required. Message frequency varies. Message & data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out and HELP for help."

Two-step form (email first, then full form):

"Consumers opt in by completing the two-step contact form at {WEBSITE_URL}. On the first step, they enter their email address and click Continue. The second step displays their full contact details along with a checkbox stating: '[EXACT CHECKBOX TEXT]'. Checking this box is optional. Phone number is optional. All checkboxes are unchecked by default. Message frequency varies. Message & data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out and HELP for help."

3B. Campaign Description

 

3C. Sample Messages

Provide 2–5 samples. Each should:

  • Identify the sender by brand/agent name
  • Use [square brackets] for variable content like [First Name] or [City]
  • Include an opt-out instruction in at least one message

Note: The platform automatically appends a system opt-out message to every text. Do not include that in your samples.

Standard Brand examples:

  • "Hi [First Name], new listing alert in [City]! A [X]-bed home just hit the market at $[Price]. Want to schedule a showing? — [Agent] with [COMPANY_NAME]. Reply with 'unsubscribe' to opt-out of future text communication. This message is sent from [COMPANY_NAME]."
  • "Hi [First Name], a home matching your search just dropped $[X]K in price this week. Interested in taking a look? — [Agent] with [COMPANY_NAME]. Reply with 'unsubscribe' to opt-out of future text communication. This message is sent from [COMPANY_NAME]."

Sole Proprietor examples:

  • "Hi [First Name], this is [Agent Name]. I saw you were looking at properties in the area — do you have a few minutes to chat? Reply with 'unsubscribe' to opt-out of future text communication. This message is sent from [Agent Name]."
  • "Hi [First Name], just following up on the property you inquired about. Are you still interested? Happy to answer any questions. — [Agent Name]. Reply with 'unsubscribe' to opt-out of future text communication. This message is sent from [Agent Name]."

3D. Pre-Submission Consistency Check

Rejections most often happen because of mismatches. Before submitting, verify:

 

Pricing & Payment

Payment goes directly to The Campaign Registry — not to Lofty. All fees are non-refundable, including if the registration fails.

 

Monthly fees are charged on the 1st. The first charge is the month after your campaign is verified.

Common Error Codes & How to Fix Them
