name: MLS Application - Vendor Process
title: MLS Application - Vendor Process
body:
Introduction

Lofty manages four types of MLS application processes: Agreement, Instruction, Online, and Vendor. These processes are designed to streamline your MLS applications and provide you with updates on their progress, as each MLS processes their application differently. Depending on the MLS you are applying to, you will go through one of the four processes.

Vendor

This article covers the Vendor process, which starts when you submit an MLS application through the CMS. The Vendor process involves verification steps by specific MLS vendors to confirm your MLS membership before approving your application.

Once you submit your MLS application in CMS, you will go through the following two stages:

  1. Lofty Checks MLS Membership
  2. Data Integration

 

1. Lofty Checks MLS Membership

Once you submit your application, Lofty will review your MLS membership automatically with MLS records. If the process passes, the MLS data will be integrated to your website immediately. If it fails, we will manually verify your membership details within 48 hours.

Estimated Time: Two (2) business days.

What Happens: Lofty checks the information you provided and verifies your MLS membership. If anything is missing or needs further clarification, we will reach out to you. Once the auto-verification passes, the MLS will automatically update to "Active".

What You Can Do: If your application remains pending at this stage for more than two (2) business days, click the “Request Update” button in the CMS. Our MLS Support team will prioritize your request and provide an update.

 

2. Data Integration

Once your MLS membership is verified, we will proceed with the data integration process to sync the MLS data with your CMS.

Estimated Time: One (1) business day.

What Happens: Your listing data will be integrated to your CMS, allowing you to manage your listings for your website and CRM.

 

Need More Help?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: MLS Application - Online Process
title: MLS Application - Online Process
body:
Introduction

Lofty manages four types of MLS application processes: Agreement, Instruction, Online, and Vendor. These processes are designed to streamline your MLS applications and provide you with updates on their progress, as each MLS processes their application differently. Depending on the MLS you are applying to, you will go through one of the four processes.

Online

This article covers the Online process, which begins when you submit an MLS application through the CMS. The process involves creating an online application and submitting the necessary details to move your application forward.

Once you submit an MLS application in CMS, you will go through the following four stages:

  1. Lofty Reviews the Application
  2. Waiting on the Client
  3. MLS Reviews the Application
  4. Data Integration

1. Lofty Reviews the Application

Once you submit your online application, Lofty will review the information to ensure all required details are complete and then submit an online application on third-party vendor platform on your behalf.

 

Estimated Time: This process typically takes up to two (2) business days.

What Happens: Lofty will verify your application for completeness and accuracy. Then, we will submit your online application on the third-party vendor platform on your behalf.

What You Can Do: If your application is pending for more than two (2) business days, click the "Request Update" button in CMS. Our MLS Support team will prioritize your request and deal with your application as soon as possible.

 

2. Waiting on the Client

At this stage, you will receive an online invitation in your email, prompting you and your broker to sign the agreement. Or, you may be required to provide additional information or take further action to complete your application. The status is marked as "Pending on Client's Info."

Estimated Time: This process can vary depending on how quickly you can provide the required information, but typically two (2) business days.

What Happens: You will be contacted by Lofty if more details are needed. Please keep an eye on your email and phone for any updates.

What You Can Do: If you need assistance or have questions, click the "Contact Lofty" button in CMS to reach our support team. Your email will automatically be sent to mls_support@lofty.com.

 

3. MLS Reviews the Application

Once Lofty submits your completed application, the MLS will review it to ensure compliance with their standards. This may include checks on your website.

Estimated Time: The review process typically takes two (2) business days, but can vary depending on the MLS board.

What Happens: The MLS will review your application, including any necessary compliance checks. If approved, your application status will update to "MLS Approved." If any issues arise, Lofty will notify you with next steps.

What You Can Do: If the application is pending for over two (2) business days at this stage, click "Request Update" in CMS to notify our MLS Support team. We will follow up with the MLS to check the status.

 

4. Data Integration

Once the MLS approves your application, we will begin integrating the listing data into your CMS.

Estimated Time: This process typically completes within one (1) business day after MLS approval and may take up to 10 business days for new MLSs.

 

FAQ

Q: How would I know if my Trestle Application process has been initiated?
A: Once the MLS Team successfully submits the application in the Trestle platform, an auto email will be sent to you advising that your signature is required to proceed with the rest of the steps.

 


Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: AI Assistant
title: AI Assistant
body:
Introduction

AI Assistant is Lofty's first integrated AI chatbot that is designed to help you streamline your day. AI Assistant can help you identify top-priority leads, craft engaging messages, and answer product questions, anywhere you are in Lofty. 

Summary

  • AI Call Summaries
  • Daily Recommended Actions
  • Contextual Conversations
  • Task Management
  • Lead Communication
  • Lead Management
  • Search for Properties
  • AI-Powered Follow-Up Recommendations
  • Generate New, or Reply to, Emails or Texts
  • Insert Property Listings
  • Text Rewriting and Optimization
  • Ask Product Questions
  • Check Open Tickets
  • Report lssues
  • Submit Feedback
  • Web Search
  • File Upload
  • Offline Tasks

AI Assistant Introduction Video

 

 

 

What can your AI Assistant do?

To put it simply, the AI Assistant is a built-in Lofty assistant that takes all of the brainwork out of using the system. Instead of fiddling with filters or notifications to find your high-priority leads for the day, you can just ask the AI Assistant, "Show me the leads who were on my website this week that have a valid phone number", then ask it to draft a mass text to all of those leads. This can be completed in seconds, instead of the minutes to hours it could take to manually complete this task. 

 

AI Call Summaries

An AI Assistant can summarize key points from call recordings and suggest next steps after a call ends! 

*Note: Call Summaries are only available on calls made from the AI Assistant chat window. Call recording must be enabled. 

Daily Recommended Actions

AI Assistant is designed to take the thought work out of how you plan to spend your day in Lofty. One way it accomplishes this is with its Contextual Recommendations.

Here is an example of a recommendation that you might see when you first sign in to Lofty: 

 

It reviews your highest-priority leads and tasks. You can continue the conversation to respond to your high-priority leads, review your inbox, and start working through your daily task list. Starting your day by clearing out your highest-priority items with AI Assistant ensures you are set up for success. 

 

The AI Assistant can also give you specific recommendations based on where you are in the platform. In the example below, you'll find the recommendations AI Assistant gives when on a specific lead's profile. Instead of needing to go back through your notes and activities, you have a helpful summary and action items right at the top of the page.

 

 

Contextual Conversations

The AI Assistant can use past conversations and lead activities as context to craft more relevant responses. 

What does this mean? It can see the past activities, text, emails, etc., and craft messages based on what you've talked about with that lead. 

 

Task Management

The AI Assistant is directly connected to your tasks, putting your priorities front and center. It helps you quickly identify what needs your attention most, schedule new tasks with ease, and even recommends next steps to keep you on track.

You can use natural - language conversations to enable the AI to manage your daily work tasks more efficiently. This includes the following:

  • Check Today's To-Do's
    • “Do I have any tasks today?”
  • Check Unanswered Messages
    • “What messages do I have that I haven't replied to today?
  • Create New Task
    • “Create a task for me to send a follow-up email to the lead tomorrow.
  • Schedule Appointment
    • “Please schedule an appointment with the lead at 3 PM tomorrow.”
  • Show Priority Messages
    • “What important messages do I need to focus on today?”

 

 

Lead Communication

  • Draft Email
    • “Could you draft a follow-up email to the lead to find out which property they are interested in?”
  • Draft Text
    • “Can you compose a welcome message for the new lead to introduce me?”
  • Send Mass Email
    • “Please send a mass email to all leads wishing them a Merry Christmas.”
  • Send Mass Text
    • “Please send a mass text to all leads wishing them a Happy Independence Day.”
  • Set up a Call
    • “Can you set up a call with the lead?”

 

 

Lead Management

You love Lofty because of how much data you can see about your lead. But we understand that it can be overwhelming! If you are getting ready to call a lead, you don't want to scroll through their entire profile to get context. Now, the AI Assistant is built into the lead's profile to give you helpful insights and help you manage that relationship. 

Leverage AI to better manage lead profile information, including the following:

  • Add Note to Lead
    • Add a note to the lead for me.
  • Create New Lead
    • Create a new lead for me with their contact details.
  • Find New Leads
    • Do I have any new leads today?
  • Check Lead Counts
    • How many buyer leads do I have?
  • Filter Lead by Interests
    • Help me find leads with high budgets and high value.
  • Identify Leads Needing Attention
    • Do I have any leads I haven't contacted in the past month?
  • Provide Contact Advice
    • What leads have I not called in a while that I should contact?
  • Summarize Call Recording
    • Summarize my latest call with the lead.

 

 

Search for Properties

The AI Assistant is connected to your Listings tab, so you can enter your search criteria in the AI chat prompt, and it will return all of the listings that match. 

Retrieve property information via natural-language conversations and forward it to the lead. For instance, "Find properties between 2,500 and 3,000 square feet, priced below $800,000".

 

 

AI-Powered Follow-Up Recommendations

The AI Assistant can help identify which leads need your attention, or which leads you haven't reached out to in a while that deserve a call. Then, it can help you draft the messages to those leads. 

 

 

If you're responding to a text or an email, and want the AI to help you craft a message, you can click on the AI Magic button to open the prompt. It can help you with a variety of messages, such as:

  • Schedule Viewing: Recommend a personalized property viewing experience
  • Provide More Similar Properties: Suggest additional properties similar to the lead’s interests.
  • Introduce Myself: Craft a professional self-introduction message tailored to the lead.
  • Follow-Up Message: Generate timely follow-up messages to maintain engagement.

 

Generate New, or Reply to, Emails or Texts

You can use the AI Assistant to draft one-off or mass texts and emails. Instead of opening your lead's profile, you can type the message and send it directly in the AI chat prompt.

 

You can also use AI to reply to a previous email or text message. When you click the AI button to activate the AI capabilities, the AI will review the previous email or text message and offer a corresponding response. After clicking on a suggestion, a customized email or text message can be directly generated.

 

 

Insert Property Listings

The AI Assistant can search for and insert listings into the messages it helps you craft.

 

Text Rewriting and Optimization

The AI Assistant can help you rewrite and optimize multiple formats of text - SMS, email, blog, social, etc. 

 

 

Ask Product Questions

Get instant answers to your questions about Lofty. For example, "How do I create a CMA in Lofty?" 

 

Check Open Tickets

Instead of calling into Lofty Support or sending an email requesting an update, you can get an instant update from the AI Assistant. All you have to do is say "I'd like to request an update on my open tickets" in the AI chat prompt. 

 

Report lssues

Now you can report issues directly with the AI Assistant. Simply type your issue in the AI Prompt, and it will assist you.

Submit Feedback

You can use the AI Assistant to submit feedback about the Lofty product. Type "I have some suggestions for Lofty", then your feedback, and it will go straight to our Product Managers. 

Web Search

The AI Assistant can find general information for you off the web. Enable Web Search by clicking the “+” button in chat. The Assistant can automatically perform web searches when needed, even if the toggle is not enabled. When Web Search is used, the Assistant displays source links directly in its response to improve transparency and trust. Click sources to view the original web content.

File Upload

Upload a file so the Assistant can answer questions and complete tasks using your own documents and files.

Supported File Types

  • Images: JPG, PNG

  • Documents: PDF, Word, Text

  • Data: CSV, Excel

File Limits: Up to 5 files per conversation.

Offline Tasks

Long or complex requests are automatically converted into offline tasks. The Assistant will notify you when the task is complete.


 

How can I buy the Lofty AI Assistant?

Lofty AI Assistant is available in the Lofty Marketplace.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.


Related terms: Lofty AI Assistant, AI Assistant

name: Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA) Guide
title: Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA) Guide
body:
Introduction

The Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA) provides requirements on who you can and cannot call or text. There are many different resources available on the topic and changes are introduced by regulators every year. TCPA may not be the only regulation you need to follow, but it is likely the most talked about. Remember, it is your responsibility to use Lofty in a way that is compliant with your local and federal regulations and the details presented here may or may not be a complete guide on complying to all of these regulations. 

 

*IMPORTANT: All the information shared in this article represents best practices determined by Lofty's own research. This is not legal advice. You must obtain your own legal advice regarding all federal and local laws/regulations for call and text compliance.

 

Summary

  • Background Information
    • (1) What is "Regulated Technology"?
    • (2) What is "DNC"?
  • How is Lofty Changing?
    • Phone Number Consent Statuses
    • Regulated Technology Configuration
    • Updated Lofty Website Registration Language
    • Lead Consent Records
    • Third Party Lead Consent Configuration
    • Consent Request Email
  • Final Notes & Your Checklist

 

Background Information

In general, the following should be your responsibilities related to TCPA:

  1. Make sure you have "express written consent" for any consumers (leads) you will be calling or texting with "regulated technology" (defined in the context of Lofty below). 
  2. Ensure that you are not calling or texting consumers (leads) who have not given consent and do not have a business relationship with you, without checking the National and State DNC registries. If a phone number is on the National and/or State DNC and you do not have consent, you should not be calling or texting that number.

 

(1) What is "Regulated Technology"?

In Lofty, we understand regulated technology to be the following two features:

  1. Pre-recorded Outbound Voice Messages
  2. Slybroadcast Ringless Voicemails

This regulated technology should only be used after obtaining express written consent from your consumers. This means you should not use these features without express written consent being obtained first. Lofty will help obtain express written consent for newly registering leads with updated form language, but you will be responsible for obtaining that express written consent for any existing leads if you would like to communicate with them using express written consent.

 

(2) What is "DNC"?

Technically, there are multiple DNC (Do Not Call) lists that are worth noting:

  • National DNC. This is maintained at the national level and it is a requirement to scrub numbers against it if you lack consent to call those numbers.
  • Internal DNC. This refers to Lofty's DNC that will prohibit outgoing calls and texts from the Lofty platform to any number that is placed on it. This is maintained at the account level.
  • State DNCs. Many states have their own DNC lists that should be used to scrub numbers similar to the Federal DNC.

IMPORTANT: Lofty does not currently scrub your numbers against any external DNC registry (national or state) and only prohibits calls/texts for numbers on your Internal DNC (tied to your Lofty account). It is your responsibility to scrub phone numbers against external DNCs--though this scrub should be unnecessary if you have received consent from either the Lofty lead registration form or an external source that is syncing to Lofty.

For the sake of example, the flowchart below explains more about what your obligations are regarding the National DNC. 

 

 

 

How is Lofty Changing?

Phone Number Consent Statuses

Lofty has added phone number consent statuses so that you can easily categorize phone numbers by the different levels of consent that you have obtained. Here is where that is displayed and edited on an individual lead record:

 

The following phone number consent statuses are available:

  1. System Recorded Consent
    • Phone numbers will have this consent status when the lead provided their phone number and registered via a Lofty-built webform (one with Lofty's default consent language). We have implemented what we believe to be industry best practices and disclaimer language that should allow you to obtain express written consent.
  2. User Recorded Consent
    • Phone numbers will only have this consent status if you choose to categorize them in this way. This is different from 'System Recorded Consent' because Lofty is not generating the initial consent record demonstrating express written consent. If you have express written consent from wherever this lead and phone number were sourced, you can use this category to label those phone numbers. *IMPORTANT: You are response for maintaining a record of their written consent if you plan to use regulated technologies to communicate with these leads.
  3. Business Relationship
    • This consent status is for phone numbers of leads who have not given express written consent to be contacted, but you have determined that you can contact them due to your existing business relationship. You can still communicate with them, just not using regulated technology.
    • The exact definition of "established business relationship" will vary from state to state so please research your requirements. Use this label for phone numbers that fit within this definition. 
  4. Unknown
    • This is the default consent status for phone numbers that are not designated into the above categories. When we introduce phone number consent statuses, all your existing leads' phone numbers (except those on the Internal DNC list) will be labeled as 'Unknown' consent.
    • This will also be the default consent status for manually added leads and leads obtained from third party sources. You can change this setting later if you would like to do so.
  5. Internal DNC
    • Phone numbers with this status are on your Lofty account's "Internal DNC" list. Any leads who opt out of receiving text message communication from you will also be added to your internal DNC list and their phone number status will be marked as Internal DNC. You cannot call or text these phone numbers.

 

Regulated Technology Configuration

If you use the Slybroadcast integration or Lofty's pre-recorded voice message feature, by default these features can only be used on phone numbers that have "System Recorded Consent." These features can also be used on phone numbers with "User Recorded Consent" status, but you will need to configure some settings first.

Navigate to Settings > Integrations (for Slybroadcast) or Settings > Call & Text > Voice Messages (for Outbound Call Voice Messages) to access these settings.

Both features will have a Configure Consent Settings button, which will give you the option to allow pre-recorded outbound voice messages and Slybroadcast ringless voicemails to be sent to phone numbers that have the User Recorded Consent status. If you do not touch these settings, these features can only be used on phone numbers with System Recorded Consent status.

Note: These features are considered Regulated Technology, and they cannot be used to send a pre-recorded message to any phone numbers that do not have System Recorded or User Recorded Consent. You can change a lead's phone number consent status to User Recorded Consent, but please do so only if you have express written consent for that phone number recorded elsewhere in your own records.

 

Updated Lofty Website Registration Language

The default website registration language has been updated to better capture express written consent from leads who register via a Lofty webform. The disclaimer language has been optimized to be able to obtain consent from multiple parties, if necessary.

Navigate to Website > Settings > Lead Capture > Disclaimer to see the updated registration box language and add any parties that need to collect consent from leads who register via your website.

If you use the default language we provide on your Lofty website registration form, the phone numbers provided by those leads will have the System Recorded Consent status.

If you have previously customized the webform registration language, we will not alter your customization, but the phone numbers provided by leads that register via your custom webform will have the User Recorded Consent status. If you aren't sure if you have previously edited this language, please check your website settings. More information on this topic can be found here: Registration Pop-up Style & Settings. 

 

Lead Consent Records

A consent record will be generated for each new lead who registers after this update is published. The consent record provides a history of how the lead came into your system and shows what consent language they agreed to. The consent record will update automatically if the lead's consent status changes. The consent record can be downloaded as a PDF file.

 

Third Party Lead Consent Configuration

As mentioned above, leads from third party sources will have their consent status marked as Unknown Consent by default. However, if you do receive proof of written consent from that lead provider, you can set the consent status to User Recorded Consent. This means you should have a consent record for on hand for every phone number that you label as "User Recorded Consent."

To update the consent status for individual lead providers, navigate to Settings > Lead Capture. The consent status options can be set on this page for Zillow, Realtor.com, and Facebook Ads, if you are connected with those providers. Select Lead Capture Settings to set a consent status for all email parsing lead providers. 

Select 'User Recorded Consent' or 'Business Relationship' from the drop down menu, if this lead provider also provides that kind of information to you. Otherwise, the default consent status for phone numbers provided by leads from these sources will be Unknown Consent.

 

Consent Request Email

TCPA is a regulation that impacts phone calls and text messages. It does not impact the emails that you send. You can send an email to obtain System Recorded Consent. From a lead's profile or as a mass action on the People Page, an email can be triggered to your leads that will direct them to a webform where they will provide their phone number and agree to the updated consent language. This means that you can request written consent from your existing database. Phone numbers provided by leads that follow this process will be marked as System Recorded Consent.

 

Here's an example of what the email template and lead experience will look like:

 

Final Notes & Your Checklist

Please review the following tasks: 

  1. Consult your legal resources regarding call and text compliance at the local and federal levels. It is your responsibility to ensure that you have permission to call and text anyone via the Lofty platform.
  2. Ensure that you have a process in place to scrub phone numbers against federal and local DNC lists if you do not have consent to call or text those phone numbers. This is described more in detail earlier in this article. 
  3. If you plan to use regulated technologies within Lofty (defined above) to contact your existing database, you will need to:
    • (a) categorize these existing leads as "User Recorded Consent" individually or on the People page.
    • (b) edit your settings to ensure that you have enabled these features to work with "User Recorded Consent."

Lofty has implemented best practices that should give you flexibility to categorize and manage your consent of differing levels. A few final notes: 

  • 'System Recorded Consent' and 'User Recorded Consent', if configured, will allow you to use regulated technology (defined above) in the Lofty platform. 
  • You can still use click-to-call, call lists, etc. for leads with phone numbers labeled with the 'Business Relationship' or 'Unknown' statuses.
  • Leads with phone numbers marked as "Internal DNC" cannot be called or texted at those phone numbers unless they are removed from the Internal DNC.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by a chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: How to Use the Drag-and-Drop Email Editor
title: How to Use the Drag-and-Drop Email Editor
body:
Introduction

Lofty offers two (2) ways to create email templates, our classic, text-based email editor, and our rich-text drag-and-drop email editor. This article shows you in detail how to create a stunning email template using the drag-and-drop email editor.

  • Content Blocks
  • Layout
  • Preview

Step-by-Step Instructions

Find your email settings by navigating to Settings > Communication > Email. Next, select the Folder the email template belongs in or create a new folder.

Click + Add Template and select Drag-and-Drop Email Editor.

The drag-and-drop email editor offers several blocks to fully customize your email templates with text, images, buttons, and more! Each block is outlined below. A tutorial is available to watch in the editor.

Content Blocks

Text

Drag the Text block to the editing panel to add text to the email template.

There are a few tools to adjust the text. You can change the font, change the text format, highlight, add a clickable link to the text, and insert system variables. The right-side panel allows you to customize the text attributes. We support format brush to copy format and support eraser to erase all effects that are applied to the text.



The email editor also supports emoji.

Image

Drag the Image block to the editing panel to insert a single image into the email template.

Upload the image in the right side panel. If you want the image to be an agent's photo, toggle on the Mark this picture as agent photo setting in the right side panel. This will automatically make the image of the agent's headshot that they uploaded to their Lofty profile.

Button

Drag the Button block to the editing panel to insert a clickable button that will redirect to the URL provided in the right side panel.

The button text can be customized in the right side panel and you have the option to open the URL in a new tab or redirect from the email itself. 

Social

Drag the Social block to the editing panel to insert links to your integrated social media accounts.

Update the layout and design style in the right side panel. The social media icons and redirect URLs can also be edited.

Divider

Drag the Divider block to add a dividing line between blocks.

Spacer

Drag the Spacer block to add a space between blocks.

Table

Drag the Table block to add a table to the email body.

Listing

Drag the Listing block to insert a listing card into the email body.

You can edit the font, layout, and background color of the Listing Card. 

 

Attachment

When saving the template, you can add attachment files to a template. The attachment file will be automatically inserted into the email when using this template. 

Video

The Video block allows you to embed a YouTube video in the email. At this time, we only support YouTube URLs.



Layout

Your email template can have up to three (3) columns. Drag and drop the content blocks outlined above to customize the email layout.

Template

The Drag & Drop email editor supports the following template options: 

  • Agent Template
  • Listing Template
  • Graph Template


Preview

Click the Computer or Phone icons to view the email template as it will look on desktop or mobile. Navigate back to the editor to make any edits to the template.

Save the template to add the subject line for the email, a name to find the template quickly, and a folder to keep your email template organized!

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please get in touch with our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your CRM.

name: Lofty Bloom
title: Lofty Bloom
body:
Lofty Bloom is designed to help you build recognition as the go-to real estate agent in your community. It combines both traditional and digital marketing strategies to ensure that you're always in front of the right people, at the right time.

Note: This feature is not available in Canada

 

Summary

  • Key Features
  • Getting Started with Lofty Bloom
  • Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's)

Key Features

Automated Postcard Campaigns

  • Each month, Lofty Bloom sends up to 300 professionally designed postcards with your personalized branding. These postcards are timed with new listings or sales in your selected zip code, ensuring they’re highly relevant to homeowners in the area.

Digital Advertising to Boost Visibility

  • At the same time, Lofty Bloom runs digital ads targeting the same homeowners. This creates omnipresent visibility for you, keeping your name front and center online and offline, and positioning you as the go-to agent in your market.

Lead Capture and Automated Follow-Up

  • Bloom postcards include QR codes that enable homeowners to view the property that has just been listed or just sold. On your website, users can opt in for communication while ensuring TCPA  compliance.
    • Each postcard has its own dedicated QR code, allowing you to track who is engaging with your content, even if they do not complete the registration form on your website. 

Exclusivity in Your Zip Code

  • Lofty Bloom gives you exclusive rights to your chosen zip code, so no other agents can target the same homeowners. This helps you dominate your market without competition.

Real-Time Analytics

  • The dashboard provides real-time insights into your postcards’ performance, digital ad engagement, and lead activity. These analytics help you track results and optimize your strategy for even greater success.

Self-Purchase Option

The self-purchase entry for bloom in both the intro page and the zipcode check page.

  1. By clicking the "purchase now" button, you will be guided to sign the Lofty Agreement.
  2. A new line called "service area - zip code" will be added. You may enter up to 6 zip codes.
    Each area will charge $699 monthly budget and $200 setup fee.

     
  3. After submitting the agreement, you can review and pay for the order.

     
  4. You need to set up your campaign preference in the CRM. 
    If you purchase more than 1 area at once, you need to set up property monitor settings for each area. You need to fill out all the personal info and return address for the postcard variables, and approve the design. You need to confirm the tracking number and the lead capture settings. After submitting the settings, the bloom campaign will start running.

Getting Started with Lofty Bloom

Step 1: Select Your Zip Code

  • Choose the area you want to dominate. Each zip code is exclusive to one agent.
  • Lofty analyzes the selected zip code, providing turnover rate, sales volume, and average sales price data to confirm its viability.

Step 2: Campaign Customization

  • Work with a marketing expert to define target price ranges and confirm campaign parameters.

Step 3: Launch Your Campaign

  • Commit to a one-year agreement. Postcards and digital ads run automatically, targeting homeowners in your selected zip code.

Why Choose Lofty Bloom?

  • Seamless Automation: Once set up, campaigns run on autopilot with minimal agent involvement.
  • Holistic Branding: Integrates direct mail and digital advertising for maximum market impact.
  • Exclusive Territories: Secure your zip code to eliminate overlap with other agents.

Campaign Details

  • Monthly Postcards: Approximately 300 postcards are sent monthly, aligned with 15–25 listing events.
  • Digital Ads: Target the same audience, ensuring consistent brand visibility.
  • Lead Notifications: Receive alerts for new registrations and QR code interactions.

Availability

Lofty Bloom is available to U.S.-based agents only. Support for Canadian users may be added in future updates.

 

Frequently Asked Questions

What does Lofty Bloom cost? Lofty Bloom costs $699 per month. 

What is circle prospecting? Circle prospecting is a strategy where real estate agents target homeowners in a specific geographic area (neighborhood or zip code) to generate leads. It helps build brand recognition and increases the chances of finding buyers or sellers.

Can I customize my postcards? No, customization is not available. Lofty Bloom uses market-proven dynamic postcard designs to maximize engagement, maintain compliance, and highlight your branding.

Are ads run from my business page? No. Lofty Bloom creates and manages the pages to ensure maximum brand visibility within your target area.

Why am I getting leads registered as buyers? Postcards and ads attract a range of homeowners and potential buyers. Leads are categorized as buyers based on engagement with property-related content or market inquiries.

Is there a specific Smart Plan for Lofty Bloom? Yes. Lofty Bloom offers a tailored Smart Plan with automated email sequences, text messages, and reminders to nurture leads and encourage timely follow-ups.

Can I change the verbiage on my postcards? The messaging is predefined and optimized for strategy. For special requests, contact Lofty support to discuss potential adjustments.

Where is the agent information for my postcards pulled from? Agent details (contact info, logo, headshot) are drawn from your Lofty account. Contact support if updates are needed.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your CRM.

name: Minimize SEO Setbacks when Changing your Site Domain
title: Minimize SEO Setbacks when Changing your Site Domain
body:
Introduction

If you've change your website's domain, it's important to notify Google Search Console to ensure that your site's performance, indexing, and SEO are properly tracked under the new domain. Follow these steps to update your website's domain in Google Search Console:

Step 1: Verify Ownership of the New Domain

Before making any changes in Google Search Console, make sure you've verified ownership of your new domain. 

  1. Log in to Google Search Console: Go to Google Search Console and log in with your Google account.
  2. Add Property for the New Domain: 
    1. Click on the "Add Property" button in the top-left corner.
    2. Enter the URL of your new domain (including the https://) and follow the verification steps provided by Google. 

Step 2: Set Up a Domain Change Request

Google provides a special tool called Change of Address to inform Google of your website domain change.

  1. Navigate to the Old Domain's Property:
    1. In Google Search Console, select the property for your old domain.
  2. Go to the Settings:
    1. Click on the "Settings" option in the left sidebar.
    2. Under "Property Settings," select the "Change of Address" option.
  3. Follow the Change of Address Wizard:
    1. Google will ask you to select the new domain that you've verified in Google Search Console.
    2. Choose the correct new domain from the list of verified properties. 
    3. Google will walk you through confirming that the domain move is permanent and that you've set up proper redirects on your old site.

Step 3: Implement 301 Redirects

Ensure that you've set up 301 redirects on your old website domain to direct all traffic (and search engine crawlers) to the corresponding pages on your new domain. This is essential for transferring SEO value to the new domain.

  1. Set Up 301 Redirects on your Old Domain:
    1. Implement 301 redirects for each page of your old domain to the equivalent page on the new domain.
    2. If you're using a CMS like WordPress, there are plugins that can help with this process.

Note: 301 redirects tell Google that the page has permanently moved to a new location, helping preserve your SEO rankings.

Step 4: Update Sitemaps in Google Search Console

After your domain change, update your sitemaps to reflect the new URLs.

  1. Submit a New Sitemap for the New Domain
    1. In Google Search Console, go to the property for your new domain.
    2. Under the "Sitemaps" section, click "Add/Text Sitemap" and submit the updated sitemap for your new domain.
    3. Make sure that the sitemap includes URLs of the new domain and reflects all the pages that should be indexed.

Step 5: Monitor the Transition

Once the domain change is complete, monitor your site's performance and indexing to ensure everything is working correctly.

  1. Check Coverage Reports: In the "Coverage" section of Google Search Console, keep an eye on any errors related to indexing or redirect issues.
  2. Track Traffic: Use the "Performance" section to monitor how search traffic is evolving on your new domain.
  3. Check for Crawling Errors: Regularly check for crawling errors in the "Crawl Errors" section to ensure that Google is able to access your pages without issues.

Step 6: Update External Links

If possible, reach out to websites that link to your old domain and request that they update their links to your new domain. This helps to maintain link equity and improve your SEO performance.

Additional Tips

  • Update Google Analytics
    • Make sure that your Google Analytics account reflects the new domain for accurate tracking.
  • Notify Social Media and Marketing Channels
    • Update your domain on all external platforms like social media profiles, email newsletters, and marketing materials.

By following these steps, you'll ensure that your website's SEO performance and indexing are properly maintained after changing domains. Google Search Console will help you manage the transition, but remember to monitor the results and fix any potential issues that arise during the process.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Website Cookies
title: Website Cookies
body:
Introduction

Website cookies are small text files stored on a user's device when they visit a website. This is how a website might remember your settings or history when you visit it multiple times.

A cookie policy is a document or section of a website that explains how cookies are used on the site. They can serve various purposes, such as improving user experience, tracking user behavior, or storing preferences.

Types of Cookies

  1. Strictly Necessary Cookies
    1. Strictly necessary cookies are vital for the operation of the website. These must be enabled in order for the website to load correctly.
    2. These cookies are used to identify and authenticate users, ensure users have access to the correct site features, and maintain website security.
  2. Performance Cookies
    1. Performance cookies collect information about how site visitors use the website, including the pages visited and errors they encounter. 
    2. Performance cookies do not collect personal information.
    3. These cookies are used to provide statistical information and web analytics, track affiliate links, and help improve website performance by identifying errors.
  3. Functional Cookies
    1. Functional cookies allow the website to remember a site visitor's preferences and provide enhanced features. 
    2. These cookies are used to remember settings like layout, text size, and language preferences, indicate if the site visitor has already participated in surveys or completed forms, and display embedded videos and other multimedia.
  4. Targeting Cookies
    1. Targeting cookies collect information on a site visitor's browsing habits across multiple websites.
    2. These cookies display relevant advertisements, measure marketing campaign success, and provide personalized content recommendations.

Key Elements of a Cookie Policy

Lofty has a cookie policy both for lofty.com as well as for all websites hosted by Lofty. The cookie policy outlines the following, so all site visitors understand how their data may be collected and used.

  1. Definition of Cookies: Explains what cookies are and why they are used.
  2. Types of Cookies Used:
    • Essential/Strictly Necessary Cookies: Required for the website to function (e.g., login sessions, shopping cart functionality).
    • Performance Cookies: Collect data on how users interact with the site to improve performance (e.g., analytics).
    • Functional Cookies: Store user preferences (e.g., language settings).
    • Targeting/Advertising Cookies: Track user behavior for advertising purposes.
  3. Purpose of Cookies: Details how the data collected is used, such as improving user experience or delivering personalized ads.
  4. Consent Management: Explains how users can accept or reject cookies, often through a cookie banner or settings menu.
  5. Third-Party Cookies: Information about cookies placed by external services or advertisers.
  6. Cookie Retention: Describes how long cookies are stored on a user's device.
  7. User Rights and Control: Explains how users can manage or delete cookies through browser settings or opt-out mechanisms.

Why is a Cookie Policy Important?

  • Legal Compliance: Many jurisdictions require websites to disclose their use of cookies and obtain user consent.
  • Transparency: Builds trust with users by clearly explaining how their data is handled.
  • User Control: Helps users make informed decisions about their privacy and data preferences.

Lofty manages your cookie policy, so you don't have to worry about it! Visitors to Lofty hosted website have the option to opt in or out of all cookie types, except for the strictly necessary cookies.

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please get in touch with our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your CRM.

name: Feature Updates for Lofty 4.18
title: Feature Updates for Lofty 4.18
body:
Introduction

Lofty's v4.18 release is packed with useful updates designed to enhance usability, improve workflows, and empower you! Highlights include the introduction of the Standard Agent Website, Bulk task removal for canceled transactions, enhanced transaction search capabilities, and a new drag-and-drop option to create stunning email templates! Read on below as this release offers powerful tools to elevate your experience across the platform.

Be sure to subscribe here to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!

Important: Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons that you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/standard user). These features are subject to change at any time.

Release Date

Monday, December 2, 2024

Summary

  • Standard Agent Websites
  • Bulk Transaction Task Actions
  • Transaction Search Optimization
  • Lead Types in the CMS Match the CRM
  • Drag and Drop Email Templates
  • Account User Status
  • Show Co-Listings Agents on Listing Pages
  • Updated Cookie Policy

 

Standard Agent Websites

Lofty is adding a new agent website package called “Standard Agent Website”. The Standard Agent Website does NOT replace any Agent Websites. The Standard Agent Website looks and feels like an Agent Subdomain with one simple difference: It allows for the configuration of a vanity/branded domain WITHOUT the need for a Lofty User to complete an additional MLS Application.

A Standard Agent Website costs $19 per month, and can be paid for by the account owner or the website owner. 

In the CMS, this website will be listed as an Agent Website Standard. It is effectively the same as an agent subdomain, but has the benefit of having it's own customized vanity domain. Learn more about the types of website Lofty offers here: Agent Websites

Bulk Transaction Task Actions

If you have a transaction that ends up getting canceled, this can result in unfinished transaction tasks remaining on your calendar and task list. Removing the tasks from the calendar and task list has until now, been a manual process. With this update, if a transaction is cancelled and there are tasks attached to the transaction that are still in a status of “To Do” or “Doing,” a pop-up window will appear. 

This pop-up both notifies you that there are outstanding tasks associated with this cancelled transaction and allows you to either change the task status to "Not Applicable", which will remove the task from your task list or remove the tasks due date, which will remove and reminders and remove the task from your calendar. Removing the due date will still keep the task in your task list.

Learn more about Transaction Checklists here: Transaction Management Checklists

Transaction Search Optimization

You are always able to view the transactions that are associated with leads that you are assigned to in the primary “Agent” role. With this update, as long as you are assigned to the lead in any of the available Role Types, you can search for their transaction on the Transaction Dashboard by selecting the option “Include Unowned Transactions”. 

This makes it simple for Assistants, Transaction Coordinators, Co-agents, etc. to find transactions. Learn more about Transaction Management with Lofty here: Transaction Management Introduction

Lead Types in the CMS Match the CRM

In Feature Updates for Lofty 4.8 we added several new Lead Type options and the ability to combine Lead Type options as needed. With this update, the CMS (Website Editor) has been update to align with the CRM. This means that lead capture forms and registration pop-ups can now be set to label a lead with any of the available lead type options.

Learn more about lead capture forms on your Lofty website here: Form Block

 

Drag and Drop Email Templates

With this update, when creating email templates, you will be given the option to create one of two types of templates: 

  1. Plain Text
  2. Rich Text

Plain Text will look familiar, as it uses the old editor

The Rich Text editor is an all-new interface that allows for more dynamic, modern designs. You can now add text, images, buttons, social media, dividers, tables, and listings to your templates.

When adding a new template, you will now be offered a choice between two types: Plain Text and Rich Text.

If you choose to create a Rich-Text template, you will be able to build a template with many more formatting options and elements like buttons, tables, social media, etc. 

Learn more about email templates here: Email Templates

Account User Status

Lofty offers both Platform Users and Display Only users. Platform users occupy a seat on the platform and can log in to their account. Display Only users are exactly that - they can be displayed on your website but do not have any Lofty account to log in to. 

Platform users can have the following statuses: 

  • Active: Account setup complete. The user has chosen their login email and password.
  • Pending Activation: A welcome email has been sent, but the agent has not activated their account.  
  • Invitation Scheduled: mm/dd/yy: The agent's welcome email is scheduled to be sent.
  • Pending Opt-in : This status only applies to teams who choose the Agent Opt-in Process whose agents have not yet opted in. 
  • Inactive: This status is limited to active users that have been deactivated.  

Deactivating a user allows you to temporarily pause a user's Lofty account. That user's leads will need to be transferred to another user and their Lofty account is effectively disabled. They can be reactivated at any time and their account information is retained.

Learn more about managing your account here: Add or Remove Team Members on Lofty

Show Co-Listings Agents on Listing Pages

Lofty websites will now be capable of displaying multiple “co-listing” agents on Listing Detail pages.

Agents who are listed as the 2nd or 3rd agent on a listing can be made visible, if that setting is enabled. Learn more about listing management with Lofty here: Listing Pages

Updated Cookie Policy

Lofty has updated the cookie preferences that visitors to your website have access to. Cookies are the trackers that remind a website visitor's device that they've visited a website previously. Visitor to your Lofty website will see one of the following options, depending on their location.

Learn more about website cookies here: Website Cookies

name: MLS Application - Agreement Process
title: MLS Application - Agreement Process
body:
Introduction

Lofty manages four types of MLS application processes: Agreement, Instruction, Online, and Vendor. These processes are designed to streamline your MLS applications and provide you with updates on their progress, as each MLS processes their application differently. Depending on the MLS you are applying to, you will go through one of the four processes.

Agreement

This article covers the Agreement process, which begins when you submit an MLS application in the CMS. The agreement is a document that outlines the terms and conditions between you (the agent and broker) and the MLS. To move forward with your application, both you and your broker need to sign this agreement.

Once you submit an MLS application in the CMS, you will go through the following four (4) stages:

  1. Sign the MLS Agreement
  2. Lofty Reviews the Agreement
  3. MLS Reviews the Agreement
  4. Data Integration

1. Sign the MLS Agreement

Once you submit your MLS application, both you (the agent) and your broker must sign the MLS agreement for your application to proceed.

For Agents: You will receive a link to electronically sign the MLS agreement via email. You may also see a "Sign Here" button in your CMS. Simply click the link, review the document, and sign it.

For Brokers: Simultaneously, your broker will also receive a link to sign the agreement. Once both parties have signed, the agreement is complete and the application will proceed to the next stage.

 

2. Lofty Reviews the Agreement

After both parties sign the agreement, Lofty will review the document to ensure everything is accurate and ready for submission to the MLS.

Estimated Time: This process typically takes about two (2) business days.

What Happens: Lofty verifies the agreement and checks for any issues. If everything is in order, the agreement is submitted to the MLS for review. If more information is needed, Lofty will reach out to you for clarification.

What You Can Do:

  • If the application is pending at this stage for over two (2) business days, click the "Request Update" button in the CMS to notify our MLS Support Team.
  • Our Support team will prioritize your request and address it as soon as possible.

 

3. MLS Reviews the Agreement

Once Lofty submits the signed agreement to the MLS, the MLS will review it to ensure it complies with their standards.

Estimated Time: This review usually takes two (2) business days, though timelines may vary by MLS board.

What Happens: 

  • The MLS reviews your application, which may include website compliance checks.
  • If approved, your application status will update to "MLS Approved."
  • If there are any issues, Lofty will notify you with next steps.

What You Can Do:

  • If the application is pending at this stage for over two (2) business days, click "Request Update" in the CMS.
  • Our MLS Support Team will contact the MLS directly to confirm the status and provide you with an update.

 

4. Data Integration

Once the MLS approves your agreement, we will begin integrating the listing data into your CMS.

Estimated Time: This process typically completes within one (1) business day after MLS approval and may take up to ten (10) business days for new MLSs.

 

Need More Help?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.
