name: Short Call Duration
title: Short Call Duration
body:
Introduction

Telecom carriers closely monitor the length of phone calls, often tagging phone numbers associated with short calls as low trust. This can result in being flagged as potential spam and prevent you from reaching your intended recipients. While Lofty will not prevent you from making calls, this article will outline how Lofty informs you of your short call duration percentage and why that is important.

What is a Short Call?

Per Lofty's service provider Twilio, a short call is any phone call that lasts less than six (6) seconds. Lofty offers two (2) calling methods, Bridge and Voice over IP (VoIP). Learn more about Lofty's call functionality here: “Click to Call” Function

How can I decrease my short call duration percentage?

The best way to decrease your short call percentage is to have prepared Call Scripts when making outbound calls to leads and by manually leaving a voice message, rather than automatically dropping a voice message to a lead's voicemail box, such as the Slybroadcast Integration. 

When an inbound phone call is routed to your bridge number, this will count towards your short call duration percentage, so the best practice is to answer that call, whenever possible.

Here are a few other best practices:

  1. Use Strong, Personalized Openers
    1. Hook them fast so they don't hang up. Rather than asking, "Hi, is this John?" start the call with "Hey John, it's Mary from ABC Realty. I just saw you were looking at 123 Main St online. Do you have a minute?"
      1. This makes the call feel relevant, not robotic.
  2. Don't Sound Like a Robot
    1. Avoid sounding like a robot by using a natural pace, smiling when you talk (it works!), and keeping your energy upbeat and warm.
  3. Avoid Leaving Dead Air
    1. Even a half a second of lag can lead sometime to believe they are being auto-dialed, and they hang up. Be prepared to speak the moment the call connects.
  4. Leave Manual Voicemails
    1. Voicemail drops can lead to ultra-short calls. Deliver manual voicemails and keep them personal and useful. Remember, the goal is to get them to call you back!
  5. Focus on Answered Calls
    1. If your call list has not been vetted, you may have a lot of bad phone numbers. Keep a clean call list by only calling verified numbers and prioritize leads who have opted in to be contacted.
  6. Text Before You Call
    1. A quick text will let the recipient know who is calling and why, making it more likely they will answer and stay on the line.

I got an email about my short call duration, what do I need to do?

If you received an email notification from Lofty about your short call duration percentage, we recommend taking action to increase the length of your phone calls. This email will also have a spreadsheet of your short call data, so you can take a look to see if there are any patterns that are contributing to your short call duration percentage.

Lofty will not turn off or diminish your calling ability, the email is just sent as a notice that your short call duration is higher than recommended and action should be taken to protect the integrity of your phone number. 

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by a chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Feature Updates for Lofty 4.17
title: Feature Updates for Lofty 4.17
body:
Introduction

Be sure to subscribe here to stay up to date on all Lofty product news! 

Important: Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons that you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/standard user). These features are subject to change at any time.

 

Release Date

Monday, November 11th, 2024

Summary

  • Office Add-On
  • Platform Design Standardization
  • Website Block Reorganization
  • Multiple Websites per User (Available November 25)
  • BETA - Lofty AI New Features

Office Add-On

Lofty's Office Add-On empowers account owners and admins to transform their individual Lofty platform into a cohesive, team-driven solution with enhanced marketing and management tools.

Why is this great?

  1. The Office Add-On offers a more cost-effective solution for smaller accounts compared to Enterprise.
  2. The Office Add-On includes all of the features that will help an Office brand and market themselves, in addition to enhanced management tools.
  3. Lofty has standardized its platform design so that both single-Team and Enterprise packages share the same structure, simplifying the learning curve.
  •  

 

Check out our Help Center article to learn more about how the Office Add-On can help maximize your business: Office Add-On

 

Platform Design Standardization

Lofty has taken strides to standardize our platform across all account types. This means our internal teams are better able to support you, and your data is compatible as you grow.

Permission Profiles for Team-Type Accounts

Permission Profiles have been loved by our Enterprise customers since we launched them. This update brings Permission Profiles to Team-Type accounts, so you can easily manage permissions across your Lofty users. 

 

Learn more about permission profiles here: Permissions

Replace "Team" with "Company"

On single-Team accounts, all “Team” verbiage will be replaced with “Company”. 

 

Website Block Reorganization

We have recategorized our website blocks to make it easier for you to find the blocks that you want to use. The 6 categories are:

Custom: Any Custom blocks you have created

Company: Company Intro (used to be Team), Agent Blocks (Featured or All), Contact, Reviews, Logo Wall (used to be Partners), Vendor, Featured Area, and Group

Content: Hero, Media (video or photo content), Content, CTA

Listings: Listings (Featured or All), Search Bar, Quick Search, Market Snapshot, Market Trends, List Your Home

Lead Capture: Form, Home Valuation, Guide, 

Tools: Tools (Calendar, Calculators), Embed, Blog, Social Feed

Previous UI - No categories New UI - Blocks are grouped by category

Learn more here: Lofty Website Block Library

Multiple Websites per User (Available November 25)

Drumroll, please! This has been one of our top-requested features since the dawn of Lofty's time. With this update, Lofty users can purchase multiple Agent Websites, allowing for combinations like a Group Website alongside one or more Agent Websites. However, multiple Group Websites cannot be purchased by one user at this time. Learn more here: Agent Websites – Lofty Help Center

Why would someone want multiple websites?

  1. You might be a Lofty Account or Office Owner and want your own branded sales website, separate from the Company branded site.
  2. You might be an Agent who works under multiple brands and wants to enhance your marketing. 
  3. You might be an Agent who works in multiple states and wants to focus your online presence on key distinct areas.

More information is coming soon!

 

BETA - Lofty AI New Features

This beta version of the AI Assistant was aunched to a select group of users on November 4th. 

Inbox Prioritization

Lofty AI will analyze your inbox and summarize the highest-priority messages, making it easy for you to identify what you need to do to start your day off successfully. 

 

Call Summary

Lofty AI can provide a call summary and next steps, as long as the call is made using the AI Voice Prompt ("Hey Lofty, call Jacob") AND call recording is turned on.

 

Email and Text Writing

The AI Assistant consolidates the AI Writing Assistant and the Lofty AI Assistant. With this update, the AI can draft emails and texts specific to your leads' communication history and past activities.

Product Guidance

Ask the AI how to use certain features in Lofty and it will guide you through the process.

Learn more here: Service Bot

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

 

Be sure to subscribe here to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!

name: Inbound Voicemail
title: Inbound Voicemail
body:
Introduction

When a lead calls your Lofty virtual number, they have the option to leave a message on your voicemail box. This article shows you how to personalize your voicemail greeting message and check your messages.

Note: When you configure your voicemail settings, these settings are on the personal level, not the phone number level. This means that if your lead calls you on either a personal virtual number or the company number, they will reach the same voicemail box.

Summary

  • Set up your Voicemail Greeting
  • Check your Voicemails

Set up your Voicemail Greeting

Navigate to your Personal Settings page and select Communication > Call & Text > Voice Messages.

By default, an automated voice greeting message with a male voice will be enabled. If you would prefer the female voice, toggle the male default off and toggle the female default on.

Alternatively, you can record your own personalized voicemail greeting message. To do so, click Add to get started. You will be prompted to provide your cell phone number or any number where you are able to receive a phone call. When you answer the call, instructions will tell you exactly what to do. The recording will save to your Inbound Call Voice Message Options.

Check your Voicemails

There are several places to check your voicemails.

(1) Navigate to the Dialer Pad and sort by Voice Messages. Note: The dialer pad is only available with some call packages.

(2) The voicemail can be accessed directly from a lead detail page's Activity Timeline.

(3) Voice messages are available in the Workspace.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Feature Updates for Lofty 4.16
title: Feature Updates for Lofty 4.16
body:
Introduction

Be sure to subscribe here to stay up to date on all Lofty product news! 

Important: Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons that you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/standard user). These features are subject to change at any time.

Release Date

Monday, October 28, 2024

Summary

  • Service Bot Update
  • Lofty Present: Team and Personal Spaces
  • Transaction Variables
  • Transaction Checklist Updates
  • Add a Lead in a Transaction
  • Document Management Update
  • Inbound Voicemail Update
  • Company Number Unknown Inbound Routing Optimization
  • Mass Create Mailing Labels
  • SEO: AI Generated Meta Data

 

Service Bot Update

The Service Bot has been updated so you can clearly see who is assisting you in the chat.  This will make it easier for you to know when it's the Service Bot, and when it's one of Lofty's support team members. In many cases, the issue can be resolved with just the Service Bot. You will see "Service Bot" at the top of the chat. It isn't perfect, so it can make mistakes, but it is getting better all the time.  

Learn more about Service Bot here: Service Bot

Lofty Present: Team and Personal Spaces

Lofty Present (formerly the CMA Tool) has been updated to support Team and Personal spaces to enhance collaboration and Listing Presentation management. 

Account/Office/Group Owners have the option to buy Lofty Present Team, which will allow them to create Listing Presentation templates for their team. If you already purchased the Listing Presentation add-on, you have access to Lofty Present Team.

Everyone will also have access to their own Personal space, where you can track your own CMAs and Listing Presentations. 

Still have questions? Learn more in the Help Center Article: How to Create a CMA and Listing Presentation

 

Transaction Variables

When sending an email, text, or drafting a Smart Plan, you can now use transaction related variables in those messages. This will work just like using other Variables in messages, whether it's an email or text message.

 

Automated Emails, Mass Emails, Text Messages:

When sending a mass email, mass text, smart plan email/text, or a single text, by default, the transaction variable will pull data from the most recently created transaction. We'll show you a disclaimer when sending one of these messages or creating one.

No Transactions

If you're sending a one-off email, and your lead does not yet have any transactions, you can add one right from the email that you are drafting. Once it the transaction is added, you can continue drafting the email using transaction variables. 

 

Want to know more about variables? Learn about Email and Text Variables

 

Transaction Checklist Updates

Look for NINE updates to Transaction Checklists in this update: 

1. Private Transaction Checklists

You can now create, edit and delete your own private Transaction Checklists.

  • Limit: 20/user
  • Visibility: Only visible to the checklists' creator.

2. Kanban Layout

Transaction Checklists now have a "Kanban" (card) layout.

  • Transaction tasks can be dragged and dropped to a new place in the checklist. 
  • Tasks will display a bell icon when a due date is applied to the task.
  • This update is permanent and the list view has been retired.

3. Assigning Tasks to Vendors

Transaction Tasks can be assigned to one assignee per task. The assignee can be:

  • Transaction owner
  • Another agent involved in the transaction
  • Any available vendor or lender

4. Multiple Checklists added to a single transaction

There is now no limit to the number of transaction checklists that can be added to a transaction. This means you can have a standard checklist template, and one specific to a particular situation that comes up regularly. 

Note: An individual task can be added to a transaction, and, if not already added to the system, the assignee can be added manually. 

 

5. Updates to the Task View

Search - Users can search for tasks by task name or by assignee.

Add Filters -  Filters have been added to tasks to make finding them easier.

  • Filter by Task Status
  • Filter by due Date (Due Today, Due in 3 days, Overdue. These are not editable.)

Task Ordering  - Within each stage, tasks are displayed in the following order:

  1. Undetermined Due Date (A due date linked to a transaction date that hasn't been set.)
  2. Specific Due Date
  3. Tasks with no Due Date

Assignee - Assignee can now be changed directly from the task list

Overdue Tasks -  A notification will be displayed for overdue tasks

Reminder Icon - Just like in the Kanban view, a bell icon will appear on tasks with a due date set.

Checklist Template - The name of the checklist template for each task will be displayed in the list. 

 

6. New Kanban view for tasks in a single transaction. 

You can view the tasks for a single transaction using a Kanban view. 



7. Send Emails and Texts to any contact associated with the transaction. 

Previously, emails and texts could only be sent to the lead.

Now, all contacts associated with the transaction can be texted or emailed.

When you click the text or email icon, the message will be directed to the lead associated with the transaction, by default, and all associated contacts can also be included.

 

8. Update Tasks in the Calendar

Before, clicking on an unfinished task would automatically mark the task as complete. This is an issue if you were trying to look at the task or if you clicked it accidentally.



Now, clicking the task name will give you the option to mark the task as Done or Not Applicable.

Clicking the due date allows you to manually update the task status.

 

9. Task Ownership Display

If the assignee on the task does not have an active Lofty account (a Vendor, for example), the task will appear on the transaction owner's calendar.



 

Want to do a deep dive on Transaction Checklists? Learn more in the Help Center in Transaction Management Checklists

 

Add a Lead in a Transaction

Previously, the lead would need to be added before a transaction can be created for them. Now, you can create the lead at the same time you create the transaction.



Learn how to create a transaction here: Transaction Management Introduction

Document Management Update

Look for four (4) updates to documentation in the platform:

1. Transaction Document Folders

You can now organize transaction documents in folders and add new document folders. Each transaction will have a Default folder that cannot be deleted. This folder CAN be renamed.



2. New ways to Upload Documents

Drag and Drop - You can now drag and drop single or multiple documents to Transaction Document Folders.



Upload from email attachments - You can email attachments directly to a Transaction Document Folder. Copy the provided email address and send the document to the copied email address. After sending the email, refresh the documents page and the document will have been added to the appropriate folder.

 

3. Bulk Actions

You can now perform bulk actions on Transaction Documents.



Check the box next to one document to access these actions:

  • Preview: This allows you to peek at the document without downloading it.
  • Rename: This allows you to change the name of the document in the folder

Check the box next to one or more documents to access these actions:

  • Download
  • Delete
  • Move: Moves the document(s) to another folder.
  • Send Email: Attaches the document(s) to an email for sending
  • Send to Docusign: Send the document for signature directly from the transaction. Requires an integrated DocuSign account.

4. Integrate DocuSign directly in the transaction documents page

You can now integrate with DocuSign directly in the transaction documents page, keeping you in one spot so you don't have to navigate to the integrations page to connect.

 

Inbound Voicemail Update

This update adds two default Inbound Call Voice Messages (one male, one female) and the option to record (Add) your own inbound call voicemail greeting message. 

Learn more about setting up your voicemail box and checking your messages here: Inbound Voicemail

Company Number Unknown Inbound Routing Optimization

This is an expansion on the call routing for unknown inbound numbers originally introduced in v4.15.

Routing Rules

Like Lead Routing for non-call lead sources, you can create custom rules to decide how to route inbound calls and texts from numbers that are not associated with any lead in the platform. You can add up to 10 custom rules. Rules can be numbered Rule #1, Rule #2, Rule #3, etc. Rules will apply to the first rule for which the call/text meets the criteria. If no rule's criteria are met, the call/text would be routed to the Default Rule, which is set to catch any remaining call/text. 

 

Learn more about routing unknown inbound calls to the Company number here: Company Number 

Mass Create Mailing Labels

Ever wanted to turn your Lofty leads into mailing labels? You can do that from the People page of the platform now! This one is really easy. Just select the leads (up to 250) you are planning on mailing. Then, click the "More" option, and select Mailing Label. 

Learn more here: Print House: Mailers

SEO: AI Generated Meta Data

This update allows you to automatically generate page Meta titles and Meta descriptions using AI. The content generated meets keyword inclusion, brand name requirements, and character limits, all while saving the time that would be used writing these yourself.

Learn more about Lofty's SEO tools here: SEO Checklist and Page Report

Questions?

There's a lot in this update, so you might need to refer back to it as you use these features. If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

 

Be sure to subscribe here to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!

name: Office and Team Add-Ons
title: Office and Team Add-Ons
body:
Introduction

The Office and Team Add-Ons empower Lofty users to transform an individual Lofty platform into a cohesive, team-driven solution with enhanced marketing and management tools. These add-ons come packed with features like a dedicated website, lead routing rules, reporting, and more to improve efficiency and performance. Learn more about how Lofty supports Organizational Hierarchy here: Organizational Hierarchy in Lofty

Summary

    • Who can purchase an Office add-on?
    • Who can purchase a Team add-on?
    • Add-On Features
      • Branded Website
      • Lead Capture
      • Lead Routing
      • AI Assistant
      • Lead Pond
      • Smart Plans
      • Dedicated Reporting
      • Email Templates

 

Who can purchase an Office add-on?

Company and Office Owners can purchase an Office add-on. The Office Add-On can be purchased for $299/month per office. The office add-on allows you to create your company structure and place your agents in the correct offices. To purchase, navigate to Marketplace > Account Upgrades > Office Add-On.

 

Who can purchase a Team add-on?

Any user who is not the Company Owner or Office Owner can purchase a Team Add-On. The Team Add-On can be purchased for $299/month per Team. To purchase, navigate to Marketplace > Account Upgrades > Team Add-On. 

 

Change Office/Team Payer

Only the Payer himself can change the Offce/Team Payer.
To change the payer, go to Organization Hierarchy> Office/Team Detail Page> Change Payer.


Select the new office payer. 

  • If you are the company owner and the original payer, then you can select the members of the current, upper and lower offices, plus the owner of the current and upper office as your new payer.
  • If you are the office owner and the original payer, then you can select the members of the current and lower offices, plus the office owners of the current and upper office, plus company owner.

Select the New Team Payer.

  • You can select from the members of the current and lower team.

Acceptance Process of New Payer

  • New Payer will receive a notification email.
  • Click the accept button in the email and be directed to the payment page.
  • Pay for the Office and Seats in the office or pay for the Team. (Note: For the new payer, seat is charged immediately, while office is charged the next month).

 

Add-On Features

Dedicated Website

The Office and Team Add-Ons come with a dedicated website that is branded to the Office or Team's identity. The site will require its own MLS approval to display data. This website will be managed by the Office or Team owner.  

Learn more here: Enterprise Websites

 

Lead Capture

Lead Capture channels can set the lead ownership to the Office or Team. Learn more about Lead Capture settings here: Lead Capture

 

Lead Routing

Lead routing can be set up to assign leads from your office sources to the agents in your office. Navigate to Settings > Office > Lead Routing to access the Office specific lead routing rules. Learn more here: Enterprise Lead Routing

 

AI Assistant

The Office or Team will get their own AI Assistant to follow up with leads that are owned by the Office or Team. 

Learn more here: AI Assistant / Chatbot FAQ

 

Lead Pond

Lead Ponds can be created at the office or team level. A lead pond is a place to store leads that are not assigned to any specific agent. The pond can also be used as an alternative lead distribution method, outside of your lead routing rules. Learn more here: Lead Pond

 

Smart Plans

Set Smart Plans at the office or team level to automated lead follow-ups and improve business conversation rates for the agents in your office. Learn more here: Managing Smart Plans

 

Dedicated Reporting

Business data reporting is generated at the office or team level. This data can be used for business analysis, observing lead behavior, and monitoring the performance of agents in your office or team. Learn more here: Reporting

 

Email Templates

Configure office or team-level email templates that your members can use to efficiently communicate with leads. Learn more here: Email Templates

 

Moving or Deleting Users in a Team or Office

Because websites are associated with specific user accounts/seats, moving users in your organization can result in changes to their websites. Below, the logic is outlined for the scenarios that might occur from the perspective of either (1) the Office Owner or (2) an Office Member/Agent.

Essentially, the question being addressed here is: "What will happen with the Office Website or Agent Subdomains when we delete or move users?"

 

(1) Office Owner & Office Website

The logic below explains what will happen when editing a Team or Office Owner's account and their Team or Office Website.

 

(a) Deleting an Office Owner's Account

Scenario 1

Other members of the office do not have an upgraded website package (Vanity Domain or Full SEO) associated with their accounts which means one of them can take over the Office Website.

A drop-down list will be available to change the owner of the Office Website and choose from those who do not already have a website tied to their account (only one website per seat). 

If the one paying for the Office Website is the Office Owner, the bill for that Office Website will be changed to the Company Owner's billing account.

 

Scenario 2

All members of the office already have an upgraded website package (Vanity Domain or Full SEO) associated with their accounts which means no one can take over the Office Website.

The Office Website will be deleted when the Office Owner is deleted.

 

(b) Moving an Office Owner to another Office

This can be done via Settings > Profile or Organization Hierarchy.

 

Scenario 1

Other members of the group do not have an upgraded website package (Vanity Domain or Full SEO) associated with their accounts which means one of them can take over the Office Website.

A drop-down list will be available to change the owner of the Office Website and choose from those who do not already have a website tied to their account (only one website per seat). 

If the one paying for the Office Website is the Office Owner, the bill for that Office Website will be changed to the Account Owner's billing account.

 

Scenario 2

All members of the office already have an upgraded website package (Vanity Domain or Full SEO) associated with their accounts which means no one can take over the Office Website.

A prompt will be made available that can be used to add an office member that does not have their website.

 

(2) Agent & Agent Website

The logic below is what will happen when editing an Agent's account. It explains what will happen to their Agent Website.

 

(a) Moving an Office Member/Agent to another Office

 

Scenario 1

The agent who is being moved already has an Agent Website that is associated with and syncing from the Office Website and the destination office has an Office Website as well.

The current Agent Website will be deleted and the system will create a new Agent Website based on the destination Office Website.

 

Scenario 2

The agent who is being moved already has an Agent Website that is associated with and syncing from the Office or Team Website and the destination office does not have an Office or Team Website set up.

The current Agent Website will be deleted when the user is transferred to the new office.

 

Scenario 3

The agent who is being moved already has an Agent Website that is associated with and syncing from the Office or Team Website.

title: Global Listing Filters
body:
Overview

Some MLSs operate across multiple states, while you may only service a specific area and prefer to exclude listings outside of those regions from being displayed on your website or sent in your Lofty Property Alerts. 

The Global Listing Filters feature allows you to customize the area in which which listings are displayed on your website, in the Listings tab, and sent in your Property Alerts. This is important to help you ensure compliance with local regulations and improving the overall user experience for yourself and your clients. 

 

  • Key Features
  • How to Configure Global Listing Filters
  • Important Notes
  • Troubleshooting

 

Key Features

 

  • Customizable Listing Display: You can select which Office or State listings you would like to have displayed or sent. Listings not meeting the selection criteria will not be accessible through Google search. 
  • Unified Settings: The configuration applies across all listing modules in both the CMS and CRM, streamlining the management process.

 

How to Configure Global Listing Filters

 

Step 1: Access the Edit Global Filters button

Log into Lofty, then click Website >  Listings > MLS Integration.

If you encounter any issues while configuring the Global Listing Filters, consider the following:

1. Ensure that you have active or pending MLS listings. The module will not display if there are none.

2. Double-check your selection criteria for accuracy.

name: How Lofty Secures Your Website
title: How Lofty Secures Your Website
body:
At Lofty, we prioritize the security of your website and the protection of your business. Our team is continuously working to enhance the security of all websites hosted on our platform to ensure that you, your clients, and your leads are protected from potential threats such as spam and fraudulent activities.

While no website can be 100% immune to unwanted traffic, Lofty has taken several important measures to safeguard your site. This article outlines what Lofty is doing to secure your website and provides tips on how you can defend against fraudulent lead registrations and other malicious activities.

 

Summary

  • Lofty's Two-Layer Security Approach
      • Front-End Security Layer
      • Back-End Security Layer
  • How You Can Defend Against Fraudulent Leads
  • Be Cautious with Off-Platform Communication
  • Lofty’s Commitment to Your Security

 

Lofty's Two-Layer Security Approach

Lofty implements a robust two-layer approach to protect your website, comprising both front-end and back-end security measures. These layers work together to mitigate potential threats while ensuring that your website remains accessible to legitimate visitors.

Front-End Security Layer

In the front-end security layer, Lofty configures a set of Web Application Firewall (WAF) rules designed to filter out unwanted traffic, including spam crawlers and junk requests. These rules help prevent malicious activities before they even reach your website's core systems.

  • Blocking Unauthorized Access: Traffic from certain regions or countries unlikely to have a legitimate interest in U.S. or Canadian real estate is blocked, reducing exposure to spam and fraudulent leads.
  • Preventing Exploits: Lofty blocks illegal requests attempting to exploit system vulnerabilities or disrupt operations. This includes shielding your site from common web-based attacks, such as SQL injection or cross-site scripting (XSS).
  • Mitigating DDoS Attacks: If a request matches the criteria of a Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attack, it is immediately blocked, preventing attackers from overwhelming your site with a flood of illegitimate traffic.

When a request is flagged by our WAF, it is responded to with a 403 Forbidden status, effectively preventing the traffic from proceeding further. 

 

Back-End Security Layer

In the back-end security layer, Lofty performs thorough analysis and filtering of traffic that passes through the initial front-end defenses. This layer involves:

  • Monitoring Access Logs: We continuously monitor access logs to identify suspicious IP addresses that may be attempting to disguise themselves as legitimate users. If a potential threat is detected, users from these IPs are blocked.
  • Regular Rule Updates: Our security engineers periodically review and update our WAF rules based on new findings and trends, ensuring that our defenses remain effective against evolving threats.

This two-layered approach ensures that for the most part, only legitimate traffic gains access to your website, while suspicious activity is filtered out and handled appropriately.

 

SSL Encryption

All Lofty websites come with SSL (Secure Sockets Layer) encryption, which secures the transmission of data between your website and its visitors. This encryption ensures that sensitive information, such as login credentials and personal details, is protected from interception by unauthorized parties.

Secure Hosting on AWS

Lofty websites are hosted on Amazon Web Services (AWS), a leading cloud platform known for its robust security infrastructure. Hosting on AWS ensures that your website benefits from industry-leading measures that prioritize data integrity, availability, and security.

 

How You Can Defend Against Fraudulent Leads

Even with these security measures in place, fraudulent leads may still find their way through. Here are some steps you can take to protect your business from potential threats:

Be Cautious with Off-Platform Communication

If a lead requests communication via non-traditional methods, such as WhatsApp, take extra care to verify their identity. Fraudsters often use off-platform channels to avoid detection.

Watch for Red Flags

Fake leads often include incomplete or suspicious information. Pay attention to:

  • Names that seem generic or fake.
  • Emails from suspicious or random domains.
  • Phone numbers that don’t correspond to the expected area or country code.

Validate Lead Intent

Some fraudulent leads may appear interested in your services but quickly shift the conversation to irrelevant topics, like personal information or financial details. Be cautious and always verify a lead’s intent before engaging further. 

 

What to Do If You Encounter a Fraudulent Lead

If you suspect that a lead is fraudulent, follow these steps to protect your business:

  • Do Not Engage: Avoid responding to the lead or providing additional information.
  • Report the Lead to Lofty: Notify Lofty support immediately. Provide us with the lead’s details so that we can investigate and take action.
  • Flag Suspicious Emails: If you receive a phishing attempt through your website, mark the email as spam in your email client to prevent future attempts.

Lofty’s Commitment to Your Security

Lofty is committed to keeping your website secure by continually monitoring and enhancing our platform's defenses. By following these best practices and staying vigilant, you can help protect your website from fraudulent activities.

 

 

Questions?

10DLC Registration Optimizations

Text Subscription Message Update

If your virtual phone number has been ported to Twilio, you have likely noticed the new Text Subscription Message setting:

We have optimized this setting so that it will now be sent in the following scenarios:

  1. The first time the lead is texted
  2. When the lead is texted after having not communicated via text message in the last three (3) months. This is a rolling 3 months, so for example, if the lead is texted for the first time on August 1, they will receive the text subscription message. 
    1. If the lead is texted regularly, they will never see this message again. 
    2. If the lead is not texted again until after November 1, they will receive the text subscription message again.

We realize the text subscription message may be annoying, but it has been implemented to ensure you are compliant with TCPA requirements. Learn more about TCPA here: Twilio TCPA Overview

name: SEO Setup Checklist
title: SEO Setup Checklist
body:
Introduction

The SEO Setup Checklist is the first tab within the CMS SEO settings. This feature will help you maximize your site SEO with the help of a simple checklist.

The SEO Checklist is only available if you have a full Lofty website. 

The SEO Checklist outlines the steps required to optimize your website's SEO. Click the Go to Fix button next to each step to see why this step is important and how to optimize this step.
 

Basic Info

This section allows you to set your core SEO inputs, such as Brand Name, Service Area(s), and high performing website keywords.



Integrations

Here, connect your search engine integrations, like Google Search Console. This is also where you can set up your custom website domain and your service area pages. 

Page SEO

This section lists the pages on your website and alerts you to missing SEO information. Those details can be edited here.

 

Schema & Technical

This section controls advanced SEO and structured data. Most sites don’t need to change anything here. ‘Not Found’ just means no custom schema or files have been added yet — it doesn’t mean anything is broken.

Schema markup is structured data added to your site’s code that helps search engines understand:

  • What type of page this is (homepage, listings, reviews, location page, etc.)
  • What entities exist (real estate agent, city, property, reviews)

Think of schema as labels for Google, not text for visitors.

Techincal files control how search engines crawl and index your website. Lofty provides safe defaults, so most sites won’t need to upload anything here unless directed by an SEO professional.

  • robots.txt – Tells search engines which pages they can and can’t crawl. Lofty includes a default file automatically.
  • sitemap.xml – Helps search engines discover your pages. Lofty generates a sitemap for you; upload one only if you have a custom version.
  • .htaccess – Advanced server rules for redirects and security. Only upload this if explicitly instructed, as incorrect files can impact site performance.

Tip: If you’re unsure, it’s best to leave these settings unchanged.

 

Questions?

name: Enhancing Real Estate SEO through Strategic Backlink Building
title: Enhancing Real Estate SEO through Strategic Backlink Building
body:
Introduction

This guide explores the significance of backlinks in SEO, providing real estate professionals with actionable strategies to improve their online visibility and search engine rankings.

Summary

  • What are Backlinks
  • Understanding the Importance of Backlinks
  • Strategies for Building Backlinks
    • Building Backlinks with Local Citations
    • Link Building on Social Media 
    • Consistent Content Creation
    • Establishing Yourself as the Local Real Estate Expert: Building Trust and Backlinks

What are Backlinks

Backlinks are links from one website to another, acting as endorsements that affirm the credibility and relevance of your content to search engines such as Google. Backlinks are essential to SEO.

A top-tier backlink typically comes from a respected site within the same or a related industry, greatly enhancing the search engine ranking of the linked site.

The greater the number of high-quality backlinks from pertinent sources like real estate websites, news outlets, or local directories, the better your website's ranking in search results for local homebuyers and sellers. This results in heightened online visibility, drawing more qualified leads and ultimately expanding your real estate business.

Understanding the Importance of Backlinks

Backlinks are a major piece of the SEO (search engine optimization) puzzle.  You need one to complement and elevate the other.

High-level, here are some quick reasons why it’s important to have a good backlink strategy:

  1. Backlinks are how Google (and other search engines) discover your pages.
  2. They demonstrate to Google that your website has a trustworthy reputation, which encourages search engines to direct users to reliable sites.
  3. Relevant backlinks can enhance your website's authority within your industry or niche.
  4. Backlinks drive more traffic to your website, increasing your visibility and potential customer base.

In essence, a well-executed backlink strategy not only improves your SEO but also establishes your site as a credible source of information, driving organic traffic and ultimately contributing to the growth and success of your online presence.

Here’s an example. When someone types “how to sell my house in [feature area]” or “real estate agent in [city]” into Google, you want your website to come up on the first page.

If your website does appear on the first page, you're tapping into significant website traffic, generating leads, and closing crucial deals. A staggering 93% of internet experiences start with a search engine, a trend that holds true in the real estate industry. When potential clients—your target market—are seeking assistance, they turn to Google.

Appearing on the first page of search results is paramount for business success.

Strategies for Building Backlinks

Building Backlinks with Local Citations

Getting listed in relevant directories is crucial for building your online presence and enhancing local SEO, not just for acquiring backlinks. Here’s why citations are essential and how to identify the best directories for your real estate business:

What are Citations?

Citations are online mentions of your real estate business that typically include your Name, Address, and Phone Number (NAP). These mentions can appear on various online platforms such as:

  • Local Business Directories: Yelp, Google My Business, Bing Places for Business, etc.
  • Industry-Specific Directories: Realtor.com, Zillow, Trulia, etc.
  • Local Government Websites: City or county government websites often list licensed real estate agents.
  • Chamber of Commerce Listings: Joining your local chamber can provide valuable directory listings.

Benefits of Citations for Real Estate Businesses:

  • Improved Local Search Ranking:
    • Search engines such as Google use consistent NAP citations (Name, Address, Phone Number) across various websites to verify the legitimacy and location of your business.
    • Consistent and accurate citations can significantly boost your website's ranking in local search results for relevant real estate keywords.

  • Increased Online Visibility:

    • Citations help potential clients discover your real estate business when they search for agents or properties online.
    • Listings on directories often include basic contact information, reviews, and sometimes links to your website, enhancing your visibility and directing more traffic to your site.

  • Backlink Potential:

    • Many reputable directories provide backlinks to your website along with your citation.
    • These backlinks contribute to your overall SEO efforts, improving your website's authority and potentially increasing its ranking in search engine results pages (SERPs).

Finding the Right Directories:

  • Focus on Relevance: Don’t just submit your website to every directory you find. Prioritize directories relevant to your location, the real estate niche you serve, and those trusted by potential clients.
  • Local Directories First: Start with local business directories and industry-specific real estate platforms.
  • Use Online Tools: Several online tools like Moz Local or Yext can help you find high-quality directories and manage your citations across different platforms.

Maintaining Accuracy:

Once you’ve claimed your listings on relevant directories, ensure your NAP information is consistent across all platforms. Any inconsistencies can negatively impact your local SEO. Regularly monitor and update your listings as needed.

By building a strong citation profile through local directories, you establish your real estate business online, improve your local search rankings, and potentially earn valuable backlinks to your website. This comprehensive approach strengthens your online presence and attracts more qualified leads.

The Lofty SEO tab provides the tool to add and check online platform backlinks. 

Learn more here: Search Engine Optimization (SEO) Tool

Link Building on Social Media 

While social media links themselves do not directly impact SEO, the visibility and engagement they foster can lead to natural backlinks from various online sources.

Lofty's Social Studio offers a powerful tool to promote your real estate content and attract backlinks.

Here’s how to maximize your efforts:

  1. Identify Your Target Audience:
    1. Platforms: Not all social media platforms are created equal. Focus on platforms where your target audience spends their time (e.g., Facebook groups for local residents, LinkedIn for industry professionals).
    2. Communities: Join relevant Facebook groups, online forums, and subreddits focused on real estate in your area or niche.
  2. Content Strategy for Backlinks:
    1. Post Consistently: Regularly share valuable content like listing posts, blog posts, local market updates, home buying tips, or visually appealing property listings.
    2. Optimize for Sharing: Include clear calls to action, encouraging viewers to share your content. Use relevant hashtags and engaging visuals to increase share ability.
  3. Engage and Build Relationships:
    1. Be a Valuable Contributor: Don’t just post your content and disappear. Participate in discussions, answer questions, and offer helpful advice. Establish yourself as a trusted resource within the community.
    2. Collaborate with Others: Look for opportunities to collaborate with other real estate agents, lenders, or local businesses on social media campaigns. Cross-promotion can expand your reach and attract backlinks from their audience.

Consistent Content Creation

Produce detailed guides on local real estate trends and informative posts about market dynamics to attract backlinks from local news sites and community blogs.

Think of every piece of content like a door to your website. The more doors you have, the more people can visit your website, and the more opportunities you have to rank in Google. A good rule of thumb, though, is to create only one piece of content for each keyword phrase you’re targeting.

With the right strategies, your piece of content can become the show everyone’s talking about.

Informative Real Estate Guides

Informative guides are the map, making the journey easier and the destination clearer.

  • Easy-to-Digest: Provide clear and concise guides that break down complex real estate topics.
  • Helpful Tips: Include actionable advice for both new and seasoned property seekers or sellers.
  • Up-to-date: Regularly update guides to reflect the current market trends and regulations.

Visual Content

Imagine diving into a property without even stepping in! That’s the magic of visual content in the real estate industry. It brings properties to life right on the screens of potential buyers.

  • Virtual Tours: Give a 360-degree view of properties, letting viewers feel the space without a physical visit. You can create the perfect virtual tour with WPVR.
  • Engaging Imagery: Use high-quality photos of properties, making them irresistible to viewers.
  • Infographics: Break down real estate data into simple visual stories, making it easier to grasp.
  • Video Content: Showcase properties with dynamic videos, offering viewers a cinematic experience of homes on sale.

Geo-targeted Content

Geo-targeted content in real estate is like having a local guide in a foreign city. It offers insights specific to a location, ensuring your piece of content hits home—quite literally!

  • Local Market Reports: Dive into specifics about a city, suburb, or even a street. What’s hot and what’s not?
  • Cultural Highlights: Showcase local festivals, traditions, or events. Give a feel of the community spirit.
  • Area Profiles: Detail amenities, schools, parks, and transport links in a particular region.
  • Property Spotlights: Highlight properties in specific areas, giving potential buyers or renters a focused look.

Establishing Yourself as the Local Real Estate Expert: Building Trust and Backlinks

Becoming a local resource in the real estate market isn’t just about generating leads; it’s about building trust, establishing expertise, and attracting backlinks through valuable community engagement. By getting involved in community activities, you can increase your visibility and earn backlinks from event organizers and media outlets. Here are some strategic ways to position yourself as the go-to expert:

  1. Offer Free Consultations and Resources:
    1. Free Consultations: Provide potential clients with free consultations to discuss their buying or selling needs. This allows you to showcase your knowledge, build rapport, and demonstrate your commitment to their success.
    2. Host Educational Seminars: Organize workshops or seminars on topics relevant to your target audience, such as “First-Time Homebuyer Tips” or “The Benefits of Selling Your Home in Today’s Market.” This establishes you as a thought leader and positions your website as a resource for valuable information.
    3. Create Free Downloadable Resources: Develop downloadable guides, checklists, or market reports that provide valuable insights for buyers and sellers. Make these resources freely available on your website with clear calls to action encouraging visitors to explore your services. 
  2. Participate in Local Events:
    1. Industry Events: Network with other professionals at real estate conferences, workshops, or association meetings. These events provide opportunities to build relationships, exchange knowledge, and potentially collaborate on future projects.
    2. Community Events: Actively participate in local community events like charity fundraisers, neighborhood clean-up initiatives, or local festivals. This demonstrates your commitment to the community and fosters positive brand recognition. Sponsor local events to gain further visibility and establish your brand as a trusted local partner.
  3. Partner with Local Businesses:
    1. Strategic Collaborations: Partner with businesses that complement your real estate services, such as mortgage lenders, title companies, or home inspectors. Cross-promote each other’s services and leverage each other’s audience reach.
    2. Local Publications: Connect with local newspapers, online publications, or radio stations. Offer your expertise as a guest speaker or interviewee on topics related to the real estate market. This provides valuable exposure and potential backlinks when your website is mentioned as a resource.
    3. Offer Free Content to Local Websites: Contribute informative articles or blog posts to local publications or neighborhood websites. These guest posts establish you as an expert and can include backlinks to your website for further information.

Conclusion

Effective backlink building is a crucial, ongoing strategy for enhancing the digital presence and SEO of real estate websites. Each strategy outlined not only broadens the reach of your website but also solidifies its reputation and authority in the real estate industry.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Navigating Common SEO Pitfalls in Real Estate
title: Navigating Common SEO Pitfalls in Real Estate
body:
Introduction

This article delves into common SEO challenges faced by real estate professionals and provides practical advice on enhancing online visibility effectively, drawing on successful industry practices.

Summary

  • High-Difficulty and Overused Keywords
  • Keyword Stuffing
  • Missing Meta Descriptions and Title Tags
  • Not Utilizing Social Media
  • Inconsistent NAP Information
  • Duplicate Content

High-Difficulty and Overused Keywords

In real estate, highly competitive keywords like "real estate", "MLS", "realtor", or "luxury homes" are difficult to rank for due to their broad appeal. For instance, a small agency trying to compete for these terms might find itself overshadowed by larger, national companies. A more effective strategy is to focus on local and long-tail keywords that have less competition and higher conversion rates, such as "eco-friendly condos in Boulder" or "historic homes for sale in Savannah." These keywords are not only easier to rank for but also attract a more targeted audience.

Keyword Stuffing

The practice of keyword stuffing can severely impact the user experience and diminish a website's credibility. For example, a webpage overly saturated with the phrase "affordable Miami apartments" can become difficult to read and may be penalized by search engines, leading to lower rankings. Instead, it is recommended to integrate keywords naturally into the content, ensuring it remains informative and engaging. This approach aligns with Google’s emphasis on content quality, which rewards websites that provide value to their users.

Missing Meta Descriptions and Title Tags

Often overlooked, meta descriptions and title tags are essential for improving click-through rates from SERPs. For example, a well-crafted title tag and meta description for a listing page could be "Modern Seattle Waterfront Homes | Browse Listings and Tours," with a compelling description that outlines what to expect on the page. Ignoring these elements can result in missed opportunities to capture interest at the crucial moment when potential clients are deciding which link to click on in their search results.

Not Utilizing Social Media

Ignoring the power of social media can limit a real estate agency’s ability to reach a broader audience. For instance, sharing a post about a new property listing on platforms like Instagram and Facebook can lead to increased engagement and website traffic. Moreover, real estate professionals who actively engage with their followers through comments and shares typically build a stronger online presence, which indirectly supports SEO through increased brand visibility and the generation of organic backlinks.

Lofty providesa  powerful social management tool to keep your site alive on social media and gain engagement with automatic social posts. 

Learn more about Social Studio: Social Studio

Inconsistent NAP Information

NAP (Name, Address, Phone Number) inconsistencies across the internet can confuse both users and search engines, potentially harming local SEO efforts. For instance, if a real estate company’s Google My Business profile has a different phone number than its website, it might reduce the business's credibility and search engine ranking. Ensuring consistency in NAP information across all platforms is crucial for boosting local search visibility.

Duplicate Content

Real estate websites often inadvertently feature duplicate content, such as similar listings posted across multiple pages or websites. This can dilute the website's SEO value, as search engines might struggle to determine which content to prioritize. For example, two property listings described in nearly identical language but posted in separate sections can compete against each other in search rankings. Using unique, original content for each listing enhances SEO by clearly distinguishing each page as unique and relevant.

Conclusion

Understanding and addressing these SEO pitfalls with strategic adjustments can significantly enhance a real estate website's search engine visibility and user engagement. By focusing on tailored keyword strategies, refining meta tags, leveraging social media, ensuring data consistency, and maintaining unique content, real estate professionals can drive more targeted traffic and generate valuable leads effectively. For more detailed strategies and examples, How Lofty Supports SEO offers further insights and recommendations tailored to real estate marketing.

name: Strategy for handling DNS issues
title: Strategy for handling DNS issues
body:
Introduction

This article will help you understand DNS errors and provide guidance on how to resolve them. 

What is a DNS Error?

DNS (Domain Name System) errors occur when your domain's DNS settings are incorrect or incomplete, preventing your website from being accessed properly. DNS errors can arise from various issues, including misconfigured records or failed domain renewals.

DNS Errors and their Impact

  1. DNS Record is empty
    • Impact: Your website cannot be reached because there are no DNS records configured for your domain.
    • Explanation: Without DNS records, the domain has no direction on how to connect to the server hosting your website.
  2. DNS Record has an error
    • Impact: Your domain points to incorrect addresses, leading to various issues like 404 errors, 5xx errors, or being directed to another platform.
    • Explanation: This occurs when all existing A and CNAME records are incorrect and need to be reconfigured.
  3. CNAME DNS Record has an error
    • Impact: Your domain points to incorrect addresses, leading to various issues like 404 errors, 5xx errors, or being directed to another platform.
    • Explanation: The specified CNAME records are incorrect and need reconfiguration.
  4. Lofty Domain Payment Failed
    • Impact: Your domain purchased through Lofty hasn't been renewed due to a failed payment or cancelled order, so the website is inaccessible. 
    • Explanation: Without renewing the domain, it cannot be accessed.
  5. Partial DNS Error
    • Impact: A mix of correct and incorrect DNS records can lead to unpredictable behavior, such as sometimes accessing the site correctly or being directed to incorrect pages.
    • Explanation: The DNS records contain both correct Lofty A records and incorrect records, causing conflicts.
  6. Cloudflare DNS Issues
    • Impact: DNS issues with Cloudflare can cause partial or complete inaccessibility of your site.
    • Explanation: The Lofty system cannot access domains with DNS records hosted on Cloudflare. This makes it impossible to pinpoint specific DNS issues. Verify your DNS records to ensure the configuration is correct.

 

How to Proceed

To resolve these issues, follow the steps below:

  1. Identify Your DNS Error:

    • Understand the specific DNS error affecting your domain.

  2. Update DNS Settings:
    • Follow the guidance to verify and update your DNS settings in our Domain Configuration Guide
    • Verify that all A and CNAME records are correctly configured, as per the instructions.
  3. Renew Domain (If Applicable):

    • Confirm if you need the domain linked to your Lofty website.

      • If you do, check that your payment card details are up to date and contact our support team to verify your domain order and attempt to renew it.
      • If you do not, to ensure your Lofty website remains accessible, please configure a different domain. Follow the guide here: Domain Configuration Guide
  4. Seek Assistance:
    • If you encounter any issues or need assistance, please submit a support ticket. We are here to help you correct your DNS settings. 

By following these steps, you can ensure that your website remains accessible and free from DNS errors. If you have any questions or need additional support, please reach out to our support team.

name: Virtual Business Cards
title: Virtual Business Cards
body:
Introduction

A Virtual Business Card allows you to quickly send your contact information to a lead via text. Your contact information can be imported directly into the lead's address book or contact management system.

 

Summary

  • Creating Your Virtual Business Card
  • Sharing Your Virtual Business Card

Creating Your Virtual Business Card

Your virtual business card will already be created for you, using the information on your Lofty user profile. If you edit the business card, it will not edit your Lofty account information. This means you can add a different photo, phone number, email address, etc. to your virtual business card, and that information will not automatically be available on your Lofty user profile.

Navigate to Settings > Profile and click Manage My Virtual Business Card to get started.

The Virtual Business Card will automatically import your information from your user profile. Here, you can edit that information or add additional information that you want to share with your contacts. Anything you add or alter on the Virtual Business Card will stay on the Virtual Business Card and will not be added or altered on your user profile or website.

Click Edit to update your Virtual Business Card. The card can only be edited on the web.

The only required information on the Virtual Business Card is your first and last name. All other information is optional. The address, URLs, and notes will be blank and allow you the freedom to complete this information if necessary.

 

Sharing Your Virtual Business Card

Your Virtual Business Card can only be shared with leads. You can share your card or the Virtual Business Card of any other Lofty users that you can see on your account. This makes it easy to refer your leads to your colleagues. 

To send the Virtual Business Card, open a text with the lead and select the business card icon. A list of all of the agents on your account will appear, with your own Virtual Business Card at the top. Use the search bar to find a specific agent's card to send. This functionality is available in both the web and mobile apps.

When the lead receives the Virtual Business Card, it will look like this:

The card is available to view in your chat history with the lead.

You can also add a Business Card to the smart plan (Auto Text). If the selected agent is inactive or deleted, then the smart plan will be suspended.

name: How Lofty Supports SEO
title: How Lofty Supports SEO
body:
Introduction

In the highly competitive real estate market, standing out online is not just an advantage; it's a necessity. Lofty is meticulously designed to elevate your real estate website's visibility, drive more traffic, and generate leads effectively. At Lofty, we understand that SEO is not a one-time task, but a continuous effort that requires a holistic approach. From the initial setup to ongoing optimization, this article outlines how Lofty supports your website's SEO journey.

Summary

 

Setup and Initial Optimization

Navigate to the CMS, select your website, and click SEO. 

The SEO settings provide you with the opportunity to input critical information such as your business or brand name, specify your location, and select targeted, high-performing keywords relevant to your offerings. With advanced features like setting up a Google Business Profile, integrating a sitemap into Google Search Console, and conducting detailed on-page SEO assessments, Lofty offers all the essential tools to build a strong SEO foundation. We'd like to encourage you to explore these resources and start optimizing your site effectively for increased online visibility and traffic.

 

Domain Connection

Navigate to your website and click the Settings tab. Select Basic Info > Domain to configure your website domain.

Establishing third-party domains that include relevant keywords or your brand name can positively impact your SEO. These domains can create additional entry points for users to find your content and services. However, it's important to ensure these domains are well-integrated into your main website to avoid fragmentation of SEO efforts. 

Please see our domain configuration guide here: Domain Configuration Guide

Google Business Profile Integration

Navigate to your website and click the Settings tab. Select Tools > Integrations to connect your Google My Business account.

By connecting your Google Business Profile to Lofty, you can view your business information directly and monitor reviews all from one centralized dashboard.

Learn more about Lofty's integration with Google Business here: Google, Zillow, and RateMyAgent Reviews Integration

Content Generation and Management

Blog Editors

Lofty's blog editor is designed to enhance your real estate IDX website by providing tools for creating, categorizing, and styling blog posts. It includes advanced options for SEO and content scheduling, allowing for a dynamic approach to content management. The editor supports various content types such as text, images, videos, and even embedded source code, making it versatile for different kinds of posts. You can customize meta titles, descriptions, and keywords for each post, which is essential for optimizing search engine visibility. Additionally, the blog editor has a built-in RSS aggregator, enabling the integration of external blog feeds to keep your site's content fresh and updated.

Learn more about the Lofty blog editor here: Blog Page

 

Adding Featured Area Pages

Navigate to your website and click the Areas tab. Click the blue button +Add New Area/Neighborhood to add the cities and neighborhoods where you specialize.

Lofty's CMS provides a range of page templates, including ones specifically designed for adding featured areas on your website. These templates allow real estate agents to showcase specific neighborhoods or regions, enhancing the user experience and focusing on areas of interest. The process of adding these pages involves selecting the appropriate template and configuring various settings such as the page name, URL, and SEO elements. This feature is integral for agents looking to highlight key features and sell properties in specific locations. The CMS also allows for detailed customization of page content and layout, ensuring that each featured area page can be tailored to meet specific marketing and presentation needs. 

These features combine to provide a robust platform for managing and optimizing real estate content, ensuring that agents can effectively target and engage their audience. 

Learn how to add or edit your featured areas here: Add / Edit Featured Areas

Engaging with Listings Videos

Lofty provides an innovative feature for creating Auto-Generated Listing Videos, enhancing how real estate professionals can market properties. Select up to six (6) images from the listing to create a video. These videos can be customized with different templates and aspect ratios to optimize visibility across various social media platforms. 

Lofty offers this capability directly from the Social Studio, which also allows you to schedule and manage posts. This feature is particularly valuable for engaging potential clients and increasing the visibility of listings online.

Collecting and Displaying Reviews

The Reviews Block is a dynamic tool that allows integration with various third-party review platforms like Google My Business, Zillow, and RateMyAgent. These integrations facilitate showcasing client testimonials directly on your site, which can be configured to display all or selected reviews from these services. You can edit the Reviews Block to determine which reviews are displayed and in what order. This is crucial for highlighting the most positive experiences on your site.

This feature is particularly useful not only for displaying positive feedback but also for enhancing SEO, as fresh, relevant content like customer reviews can improve search engine visibility.

For more detailed instructions and settings related to managing and displaying reviews on Lofty, including step-by-step guides on integrating reviews from Zillow, Google, and RateMyAgent, please refer to our Help Center articles here: Reviews Block and Google, Zillow, and RateMyAgent Reviews Integration.

Sharing Content Regularly

Navigate to the Marketing page and select Tools > Social Studio to access Lofty's Social Studio.

Social Studio offers comprehensive tools to streamline this process. Here's how it helps you manage and share your content consistently.

Content Scheduling and Management: Social Studio allows you to plan and schedule your social media posts in advance. This ensures that your content is distributed evenly over time, keeping your audience engaged without overwhelming them with too many updates at once. You can create a content calendar that outlines what and when to post, making it easier to manage your social media strategy systematically.

Post Creation and Customization: The platform provides a robust editor to create and customize your posts. You can include various types of media, such as images, videos, and links, to enhance the appeal of your posts. The editor supports different styles and formats, allowing you to tailor each post to suit the specific platform you are targeting.

Learn more about the Social Studio here: Social Studio

Link Building and Social Proof

Social Backlinks Generation

High-quality backlinks from reputable sites and social media platforms significantly enhance your domain authority. Engage with your community on social media, share valuable content, and participate in local events to build a robust backlink profile. Backlinks signal to search engines that your content is valuable and trustworthy, which can improve your rankings.

The Social Agent features are designed to seamlessly integrate your real estate website with various social platforms, facilitating efficient backlink generation. By connecting your Lofty account to your social media profiles, you can effortlessly share you content across multiple channels. This not only drives traffic to your site but also boosts your SEO through increased backlinks. The platform supports integration with major social networks, enabling automatic posting of new content and updates. This integration ensures that your audience on platforms like Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn stays informed and engaged, while also enhancing your site's visibility and credibility through consistent social signals.

Performance and Monitoring

Conducting Site Audits

Built-in audit tools: Conducting regular site audits is essential to maintaining a healthy and optimized website. Lofty's platform simplifies this process by offering built-in audit tools that analyze various aspects of your site, including page speed, mobile responsiveness, and SEO elements. These audits help identify areas that need improvement, such as broken links, missing meta descriptions, or slow-loading pages. Addressing these issues promptly can significantly enhance your site's performance and search engine visibility. Learn more about Lofty's SEO tools here: Search Engine Optimization (SEO) Tool

Utilizing Google Search Console (GSC): Integrating Google Search Console with your Lofty website allows you to monitor your site's presence in Google search results. For a comprehensive guide on SEO optimization and GSC integration, see SEO Optimization and Google Search Console Integration

Optimizing on-page elements: On-page optimization is a crucial aspect of SEO that involves fine-tuning individual pages to rank higher and earn more relevant traffic in search engines. Lofty provides an easy to use interface for optimizing key on-page elements such as titles, meta descriptions, headers, and image alt texts. By ensuring that each page is optimized with relevant keywords and compelling content, you can improve your site's SEO and provide a better user experience. 

Technical Page Speed Improvements

Page speed is a vital factor in both user experience and SEO. Slow-loading pages can lead to higher bounce rates and lower search rankings. Test your website page speed here: PageSpeed Insight

name: Google & Microsoft Bing PPC Search Ads
title: Google & Microsoft Bing PPC Search Ads
body:
Introduction

Pay-Per-Click (PPC) Search Ads are a type of online advertising that allows Lofty's professional Digital Marketing Analysts to create campaigns and bid on keywords to appear in search engine result pages.

Lofty's PPC Search Ads aim to show your customized ads to the potential customers who are proactively searching for relevant keywords on Google's and/or Microsoft Bing's search engines and related websites and attract them to click on the Final URLs (Landing Pages) and jump to your website. When they finish the registration form, their information will be captured, thus new leads will be generated and synced to your Lofty CRM.

 

Summary

  • Self-Purchase PPC Search Ads 
  • Purchase Page
    • Purchasing Google PPC Search Ads
      • Budget and Payment
      • Potential Results
    • Source and Tag for PPC Search Ads
  • FAQ

 

Self-Purchase PPC Search Ads 

PPC Search Ads are available on both the Lofty Marketplace and Marketing pages.

The message here may vary:

  • If you have never purchased PPC Ads:
    • Buttons: See How Many Leads I Can Get and Buy Now
    • You will be directed to the purchase page
  • If you have previously purchased PPC Ads:
    • Button: View Data
    • You will be directed to the Report page. From here, you can change your existing budget or purchase other marketing channels. 

Purchase Page

A new page will be added to the Marketing section, which includes a preview of the ads and the purchase options.

 

Purchasing Google PPC Search Ads

Budget and Payment

The lowest monthly budget is $600 per month, with a 20% Management Fee. The setup fee for the first-time purchase is $79.

If your lead generation budget is below $750 per month, an AI Assistant package is included for free. If your lead generation budget is above $750 per month, an AI Assistant package, Social Studio Pro, and CMA are included for free.

When purchasing the ads, you do have the option to share the costs with your lender. Per RESPA, as the agent, you must pay at least 50% of the total budget.

Potential Results

The potential leads and cost per lead (CPL) estimated results are calculated based on the last 6 months of data. Leads generated from these ads can be set to be team leads or private leads. 

Once submitted, the information entered on the purchase page cannot be changed. Once you submit, the information is given to Lofty's Ads Team to set up the ads.

Source and Tag for PPC Search Ads

The Source and Tag that is applied to leads generated from these ads will be:

  • Source: Lofty Paid Lead
  • Tag: LoftyPaid-Google or LoftyPaid-Microsoft, depending on which marketing channel you select.

These sources and tags cannot be edited.

FAQs

Q: How long does it take to get my PPC Search Ads activated and running?

A: It usually takes 24 hours for professional Digital Marketing Analysts to create the ads. If there are no factors that prevent your ads from being created successfully, you should expect your ads previews within 48 hours.

 

Q: How many targeting cities/zip codes should I set?

A: We have found that $300 is enough for a mid-sized city or zip code area. Too many targeting locations will not reach the audience, as the daily budget is fixed at around $10 per day. Zip codes generate little traffic on search engines in the real estate industry, so we will convert zip codes to cities and towns for the best performance.

 

Q: Can I know the preference of the leads from Lofty's PPC Search Ads?

A: Yes! We offer search keyword tags for the Lofty Paid Leads from Google and Bing. Their on-site activities will be recorded on the leads' detail pages, such as what listings they viewed and saved, what area, price, and listing types they searched, and their communication history with the AI Assistant. These records will be helpful for you to analyze the lead's intention on home buying or selling.

 

Questions?

name: How to Create a Listing Presentation Template

body:
Introduction

A Comparative Market Analysis is a tool that is used by real estate agents to get seller business. This is done by providing a report, called a CMA or Listing Presentation, that includes an estimate of the value of a specific property based on comparable listings that have sold, are pending, or are still active on the market. Learn more about Lofty Present here.
The Listing Presentation Templates allow you to quickly create Listing Presentations without needing to make the same adjustments every time. 


Summary

  •  
  • Template Basics
  • Creating a Template

Template Basics

Navigate to Marketing > Lofty Present and select Listing Presentation

A pop-up box shows the template options. Click + New Template to create a Listing Presentation template. The template options are Seller, Buyer, and Agent Presentation.

My Templates

My Templates are Listing Presentation templates that only you can see. These are only available if you have purchased Lofty Present Personal. 

Shared Templates

Shared Templates are Listing Presentation templates that everyone on your Lofty Present Team can see and use. The shared templates can only be edited by the template creator.

Recommended Templates

The recommended templates were created by Lofty. If you choose to use one of these templates, they can be edited when the Listing Presentation is created.

Creating a Template

Creating the template is very similar to the customization page of the Listing Presentation report. 

Hover over the page that you want to edit and click the edit icon. Move the pages around by clicking the hamburger icon. Pages can be deleted by clicking the trash can icon.

Once your edits are complete, click Save. Give the template a name so you can easily find it in the future.

After saving the template, it will be available to use in your templates list. Delete or edit the template by clicking the ... icon.

Learn more about creating a Listing Presentation report here: How to Create a CMA and Listing Presentation
