Introduction

The buyer's agent fee is the commission fee that the real estate brokerage that represents the buyer is paid as compensation for completing the transaction. Historically, the buyer's agent fee was paid by the seller, however this is changing due to the NAR settlement.

Note: Some MLSs do not allow you to add this information to a listing. When the Buyer Compensation field is added, it will be visible on your IDX website. This information will not be added to other websites or to the MLS, it will only be visible on IDX websites on your Lofty account. This field will be removed if the listing is sold. Please be aware of your MLS requirements.

 

Summary

  • Add Buyer Agent Compensation
    • Compensation Label
    • Compensation Amount
  • Compensation Visibility

Add Buyer Agent Compensation

The Buyer's Agent Compensation field can only be added to My Listings or Team Listings. To add to one of your listings, navigate to the Smart Listing page and select Add Buyer Compensation from the Actions menu.

To add to one of your Team Listings, navigate to the Listing Discovery page and add via the ... menu.

After selecting Add Buyer Compensation, the information is added in a pop-up box:

Compensation Label

The Compensation Label is the field label that is shown on the listing page on your IDX website. By default, the field is called "Buyer Agency Compensation".

You can only edit this label if you have the Manage Website permission enabled on your Lofty account.

Compensation Amount

The Compensation Amount is the buyer agent compensation amount that will be displayed on the listing page on all of the IDX websites on your Lofty account. You can add this field to any of your own listings.

If you have the Manage Website permission enabled, you can add this field to your Team Listings.

 

Compensation Visibility

  1. Once a listing is marked as Sold, the Buyer Agent Compensation field will be removed from the listing detail page.
  2. The Buyer Agent Compensation field is only being added to your Lofty account websites. This data is not being added to the MLS or any other website.
  3. This field can only be added to your own listings or your team's listings. You cannot add this field to listings that do not belong to you or your team.

Comparative Market Analysis

The buyer's agent compensation can also be added to a CMA report. This is a great way to share this information with a lead, without displaying it on your website. 

There is also a block available that can be used to explain why the buyer's agent commission is important. 

Questions?

name: Google Search Console: Understanding Index Coverage Issues
title: Google Search Console: Understanding Index Coverage Issues
body:
Introduction

Google Search Console (GSC) is a powerful tool that helps website owners monitor and maintain their website's presence in Google search results. One of the most crucial features is the Index Coverage Report, which identifies issues preventing pages from being indexed by Google. 

This article explains the most common indexing issues reported by GCS and provides guidance on how to address them. 

 

Understanding Common Index Issues

In most cases, you will not need to take any action. Many issues are related to problems on Google's end. These issues can be ignored while Google resolves them, generally within two weeks. 

Issues that Google attributes to the website do not necessarily need to be corrected, as they are related to the website's indexing strategy. Please refer to the table below for details:

Issue Explanation
Alternate page with proper canonical tag

This page is an alternate version (Accelerated Mobile Pages/AMP or mobile) of another indexed page and correctly points to the canonical version.

No action is needed. This issue arises from using canonical tags for AMP pages, which are designed for faster loading on mobile devices. Google does not index AMP pages separately, so this issue does not affect the overall website ranking.
Discovered - currently not indexed

The page was found by Google, but has not been crawled yet. Google wanted to crawl the URL, but this action was expected to overload the site. Therefore, Google rescheduled the crawl.

No action is necessary, but keep monitoring the trend.
Crawled - currently not indexed

The page was crawled by Google, but not indexed. It may or may not be indexed in the future. There is no need to resubmit the URL for crawling. This issue can occur for various reasons, and there is no specific operation that will make sure the page is indexed.

We recommend checking the page content and adding internal links to enhance the page's value for further indexing.
Excluded by 'no index' tag

The 'no index' tag is applied to pages that should not be indexed by search engines. In most cases, this exclusion is intentional to enhance the website's SEO effectiveness. These excluded pages are often unavailable property listings or pages with no search results. 

No action is needed. The purpose of the exclusion is to instruct Google not to index these content-less pages, allowing it to prioritize and give more SEO weight to pages with valuable content.
Server error (5xx)

5xx errors can occasionally occur during periods of overload or maintenance, such as when Lofty releases feature updates or when web crawlers like Googlebot attempt to access the site too frequently. When this occurs, Google's crawler may not be able to retrieve content. 

When this happens, Googlebot will attempt to to crawl the page again during its next visit. Additionally, Google keeps a record of pages that fail to load due to 5xx errors. This means that even after our servers stabilize, some pages may still show 5xx error until Google successfully crawls and indexes them.

No action is needed. These issues typically resolve themselves within 2-5 weeks as Google re-crawls affected pages. Lofty monitors these situations closely to avoid issue.
Page with redirect/Not Found (404)/Soft 404

When properties are taken off the market or if indexed pages are deleted in the CMS, different server responses may occur. These include pages that no longer exist, pages with no content, or pages that redirect elsewhere. As a result, you may see issues like Soft 404s, Not Found 404s, or pages with redirects in their reports.

In most cases, these issues do not require specific actions, as removing listings or deleting pages is a normal operation. Search engines like Google gradually update their indexes to recognize these changes and adjust accordingly. 
Duplicate, Google chose a different canonical than the user

Canonical tags are HTML tags used to instruct search engines on the primary version of a page. We use this to specify which page should be indexed as the main content version. Google sometimes chooses a different canonical tag. This decision may be based on Google's algorithms determining a page with higher content quality or better user experience. 

Generally, this does not significantly impact overall website ranking or SEO, as Google handles these conflicts appropriately. 
Duplicate without a user-selected canonical

For highly similar pages, we've implemented canonical tags to specify the primary version. If you still see these issues in reports, it may be due to Google not yet updating its index. 

If you need confirmation of the canonical tag settings for these pages, please contact support@lofty.com for assistance.
Blocked by robots.txt

Lofty has blocked URLs in the format of "https://#domain#/house-listing..." using robots.txt, as these pages are intended for listing recommendation associations and hold no SEO value.

Please ignore this issue.

For more information, please see Google's Page Indexing Report

 

Conclusion

We advise that you not overly fixate on the reasons for individual pages not being indexed. Instead, we recommend focusing on the broader trends of the indexed pages. You should find that as the number of pages discovered by search engines rises steadily, the count of indexed pages is also gradually increasing. 

We are dedicated to continuously enhancing your website's SEO. Here are some recent optimizations we have made: SEO Updates Timeline

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Cancel, Reset, or Downgrade Website
title: Cancel, Reset, or Downgrade Website
body:
Introduction

Lofty offers many types of IDX websites, each having its own settings and abilities. This article explains how to cancel, reset, or downgrade your Lofty-built website.


Definitions

Reset: Resetting the website will remove all customized content and revert the website to the blank template.

Downgrade: Downgrading the website will revert the website to a subdomain of another website.

Cancel: Cancelling the website will cancel the entire website package and delete the website, as well as any subdomains built off of this website.

 

Requirements and Limitations

While all Lofty-built websites can be reset, there is a limitation on what websites can be downgraded or canceled. Please take a look at the chart below to figure out which actions can be taken on your website. If you aren't sure what kind of website you have, you can just go to the Website tab in the CRM and check the Type column.

Website Type Can it be reset? Can it be downgraded? Can it be cancelled?
Company Website + Full SEO Yes No No
Team Website + Full SEO Yes No Yes
Office Website + Full SEO Yes No Yes
Agent Website + Full SEO Yes Yes Yes
Agent Website (Original) Yes Yes No
Agent Website Yes No No

Websites can only be downgraded if their parent site has a vanity domain. If the parent site domain has not been configured, the website cannot be downgraded.

 

At this time, only Office Website + SEO and Agent website + SEO can be canceled. Once the website is canceled, the website and any subdomains built off of the website will be deleted. 

 

Instructions

Navigate to Website and select the website that you want to take action on. You are only able to reset, downgrade, or cancel websites that you are paying for. You cannot take these actions on a website that is paid for by another Lofty user.

Click the ... icon to see the available options.

Once the action is selected, a pop-up box will confirm that you wish to continue. To complete the action, a verification code will be sent to the email address associated with the website owner. The code must be verified to complete the action.

When canceling a website, you can opt to cancel now or cancel at the end of the month.

A final confirmation will verify that the action will take place. Once complete, the action is irreversible. If a website is canceled, reset, or downgraded, Lofty cannot undo this action.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: WordPress + Lofty IDX Plugin
title: WordPress + Lofty IDX Plugin
body:
Introduction

43% of websites on the internet are built with WordPress. 

The Lofty IDX Plugin integrates the power of Lofty with your existing (or new!) WordPress site. This Help Center article will walk you through the different pages and features that are available in a Lofty<>WordPress integrated website. 

If you're looking for steps to set up your WordPress IDX Plugin, head over to Getting Started with the WordPress + Lofty IDX Plugin.

 

Summary

  • Summary
  • Which Lofty pages will be available in WordPress?
    • Search Pages
    • Featured Listings
    • Listing Detail Pages
    • Sold Listings
    • Sold Listing Detail
    • Market Report
    • Home Valuation
  • What non-page tools are available?
    • Dynamic Variables
    • Lead Activity Tracking
    • Lead Portal
    • Property Alerts
    • Custom Lead Capture and Registration Form
  • What is NOT available on the WordPress Plugin?
    • AI Chat Bot
    • WordPress Website as a Company Website
    • Automatic Subdomain Creation
    • Market Report Emails
    • Account Owner - WordPress Site for Property Alerts

Which Lofty pages will be available in WordPress?

Search Pages

The WordPress Plugin supports two Search Page views - Grid View, or Map View. You can select which view you would like in the Layout section.


Search functionality is also available as a Shortcode. If you want to embed the Search functionality on a different page, like a Featured Neighborhood page, you will use the Shortcode functionality. 

 

WordPress Backend:

 

Map + Grid on a live website:

 

Grid on a live website:

 

Featured Listings

You can set a filter, such as price or office, to display a curated selection of featured properties on your website. There are three (3) different Featured Listing views: Grid, Slider, and Gallery.

 

WordPress Backend:

 

Grid on a live website:

 

 

Slider on a live website:

 

Gallery on a live website:

 

Listing Detail Pages

These are the pages that open when someone clicks on a listing. Since this is a template page that changes depending on which listing is selected, the edits are limited. You can use the WordPress backend to update your SEO meta tags for these pages. We recommend using the dynamic Variable tags.

 

WordPress Backend:

 

Listing Detail Page on a live website:

 

Sold Listings

The WordPress Plugin supports two Sold Listings Page views - Grid View, or Map View. You can select which view you would like in the Layout section.

 

WordPress Backend:

 

Sold Grid:

 

Sold Map + Grid:

 

Sold Listing Detail

These are the pages that open when someone clicks on a Sold listing. Since this is a template page that changes depending on which listing is selected, the edits are limited. You can use the WordPress backend to update your SEO meta tags. We recommend using the dynamic variable tags.

 

WordPress Backend:

 

Sold detail page on a live website:

 

Market Report

Market Reports are valuable pages that showcase data about a specific area. The Market Report shortcode allows you to embed this data on your desired pages and capture leads. You will need to set the criteria for the area you would like to cover with the Market Report. 

 

WordPress backend:

 

Market Report on a live website:

 

Home Valuation

The Home Valuation tool is a great way to capture seller leads by giving them a free home valuation estimate for their property. 

 

You can configure each of these pages in the WordPress Backend. 

Step 1: The site visitor will input their home address into the address box

 

 

Step 2: After submitting the address, the visitor is required to provide their contact info to view the home valuation estimate for their property. 

 

 

Step 3: When the lead completes the previous step (#2), a home valuation report will be sent to their email and an estimated price of the address will be shown on the screen.

 

 

What non-page tools are available?

Dynamic Variables

A dynamic variable is a tag that can be modified based on the content or data of the article, website, or in real time. This is crucial when setting up pages for SEO. Instead of hardcoding information, these adaptable variables enable the creation of reusable page templates with minimal adjustments.

 

Lead Activity & Tracking

When a lead has registered on the WordPress site, their activities will be tracked in the Lofty CRM similarly to the activities that are tracked on the Lofty website. This means that you can see what listings the lead is looking at, saving, and searching on the WordPress site in the lead's timeline in Lofty. The WordPress plugin does not currently track any activity beyond the WordPress listing pages. Only listing page activity is tracked.

The source of any lead registering on the WordPress website should be "WordPress Website" and cannot be customized.

 

Lead Portal

Leads will be able to sign in to WordPress<>Lofty websites to view their saved listings and saved searches. 

The portal experience on a WordPress<>Lofty website is different from a Lofty website. 

 

Lofty Website:

  • My Homes
  • Property Tours
  • Favorites
  • Saved Searches
  • Account

 

WordPress Website:

  • Saved Listings
  • Saved Searches
  • Account

Leads on a WordPress<>Lofty website are able to give properties a star rating and add notes that get sent to their Agent. 

 

Property Alerts

Lead-Created Alert

Leads who register on a WordPress<>Lofty website can save their preferred search criteria and set up a property alert.

 

 

They can view and edit their saved searches in their lead portal.

 

 

All lead activity that happens on a Lofty-synced WordPress page will be passed back to Lofty CRM, so you can be informed of the lead’s activities.

 

 

Agent-Created Alert

You can create property alerts for your leads in the Engagement tab of the lead’s profile.

 

 

 

The following outlines the property alert sending logic for different website scenarios:

  • WordPress site only: Property alerts will send from the WordPress website
  • Lofty site + WordPress site: The Lofty website will be the default sending site for property alerts.
  • Multiple Lofty sites: The user can select their preferred Primary website

If you have purchased the WordPress<>Lofty Plugin, but has not completed the setup steps, the functions in the Engagement tab will be locked.

 

 

Custom Lead Capture and Registration Form

WordPress+Lofty users can customize the lead capture and registration form that triggers on Lofty-synced pages. 

 

Go to WordPress > Lofty IDX Plugin > Lead Capture Settings

 

 

 

You can also customize your Disclaimer Language

 

 

Lastly, you can customize the trigger rules for the Lead Capture form.

 

 

 

Important to note: the Lead Capture form will only trigger on Lofty-synced pages. This includes all Listing and Sold detail pages, Search pages, Featured Listing pages, and Sold Listings pages.

 

 

What is NOT available on a Lofty<>WordPress website?

AI Chat Bot

Lofty's AI Sales Assistant can only work on websites that are hosted on Lofty. There will be no AI Chat Bot on a WordPress<>Lofty website. Sales Assistant will still be able to text leads who register on a WordPress<>Lofty website, since they will sync to lofty immediately. 

 

WordPress Website as a Company Website

The WordPress Plugin connects the Lofty search experience to 1 WordPress website. At this time, it is not possible to set a WordPress<>Lofty website as a Lofty Company website. 

 

Automatic Subdomain Creation

Lofty websites are closely connected to the Lofty platform and can create subdomains for agents to use with tools like Property Alerts, CMAs, Market Reports, and Market Snapshots. However, a WordPress website connected to Lofty cannot automatically create these subdomains.

 

Market Report Emails

We do not currently support the ability to set a recurring Market Report email using a WordPress<>Lofty site. You can create a Market Report webpage and drive traffic to that page. 

 

Account Owner - WordPress Site for Property Alerts

For users with a Lofty site + WordPress site, the Lofty website will be used as the default for Property Alerts. If you are a Lofty account owner, your Company site will be used as the default for Property Alerts. 

  • In the meantime, we recommend configuring a second seat as your "agent" seat and purchasing the WordPress plugin under that account. This will allow you to use the WordPress website as your primary website. 

 

 

FAQs

Q: How are the listings displayed? Are they iFramed?

A: The Plugin connects to the MLS database(s) using IDX protocols to pull real-time property listing data. The properties are not iFramed.

It fetches property details, including descriptions, images, prices, and locations, via API or direct data feeds in real-time.

The Lofty IDX plugin also supports WordPress shortcodes and widgets to display IDX data in various formats, such as search forms, property grids, and market reports.

Shortcodes like [idx-listings], [idx-search], and others allow you to embed dynamic real estate content on a page without manually coding the listings.

 

Q: How do you create the Listing and Sold Detail pages? Is it going to take up a lot of bandwidth?

The listing and sold detail pages are dynamically generated by pulling property data from your MLS (Multiple Listing Service). We use the Lofty IDX(Internet Data Exchange) plugin to create these IDX pages automatically.

Each property typically has its own dedicated page, which means every listing will have a unique URL. However, the impact on bandwidth and server resources depends on the size and number of media files (such as images and videos) on each page. If you have many listings, we can ensure that resources are optimized to avoid slow loading times and excessive bandwidth usage.

 

Q: Do I have to have a Lofty website and a WordPress website to use this plugin?

A: No. Purchasing the WordPress Plugin in the Lofty Marketplace and completing the setup steps connects the Lofty platform to your WordPress website. 

 

Q: Will the WordPress plugin push data on what the site visitor is looking at on the WordPress site back to the CRM?

A:  Yes, but only for Lofty-synced pages (not for any of the other pages on the WordPress website.) The data provided is similar to the data provided when a lead is browsing a Lofty-built website. After the lead registers on the WordPress site, you will have the lead name, listing, time, etc. synced to the activities timeline. 

 

Q: Are both active and sold listing pages supported?

A: Yes, the Lofty IDX Plugin automatically supports both active and sold listing pages being displayed on your WordPress website.

 

Q: Is the API key used for the plugin the same one on my integrations page?

A: No, it is a unique API key generated only for the WordPress plugin.

 

Q: Can I edit the listing layout?

A: No.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: SEO Optimization and Google Search Console Integration
title: SEO Optimization and Google Search Console Integration
body:
Introduction

Lofty is performing SEO optimization for all active Company, Team, and Agent websites. This process involves monitoring the indexing status of these websites using Google Search Console (GSC). 

GSC allows Lofty to monitor your website's indexing status and provide data support for SEO optimization. Please be assured that Lofty will not make any unauthorized changes to your website and we do not have ownership of your website domain. Integrating your website with Lofty's Google Search Console account is a crucial step in enhancing your website's SEO performance. 

Summary

  • Adding Your Site to Google Search Console
  • Purpose and Benefits
  • Control and Permissions

 

Adding Your Site to Google Search Console

To effectively track and optimize your website's performance, Lofty will need to add your website to our public Google Search Console account. Once your site has been added, you will receive an email notification with the subject line New Owner Notice, that is letting you know that an email address with the format siteanalytics#number#@lofty.com has been added as an owner of your website in GSC. Please see an example of this email below:

 

Purpose and Benefits

The primary goal of the GSC integration is overall SEO optimization. While immediate benefits may not be noticeable, having owner permissions allows Lofty to use the official GSC API to gain insights into your website's ranking and indexing status. Here are the key advantages:

  • Issue Resolution: Lofty will prioritize fixing issues for websites with no traffic first, followed by optimizing overall traffic.
  • Monitoring and Insights: Regular insights into your website's performance will help us identify and resolve indexing issues.
  • Prompt Assistance: If you have already verified ownership in GSC, you may receive periodic emails about indexing issues. With access to your GSC account, Lofty can quickly assist in resolving or explaining these issues.

Control and Permissions

Lofty respects your control over your website. We will not make any changes to your website without your permission. If you prefer not to have Lofty has the owner of your website on Google Search Console, simply follow these steps to remove our account (siteanalytics#number#@lofty.com) from your GSC settings.

  1. Log in to your Google Search Console account
  2. Select your website
  3. Navigate to the Settings section
  4. Under Users and Permissions, locate Lofty's account: siteanalytics#number#@lofty.com
  5. Remove the account by clicking the remove icon

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: How to Create a CMA and Listing Presentation
title: How to Create a CMA and Listing Presentation
body:
Introduction

A Comparative Market Analysis is a tool that is used by real estate agents to get seller business. This is done by providing a report, called a CMA or Listing Presentation, that includes an estimate of the value of a specific property based on comparable listings that have sold, are pending, or are still active on the market. Lofty Present allows agents to use basic search filters in Lofty to find comparable listings and then revise the results using their expertise in their specific real estate market. 

Learn how to purchase the Listing Presentation Add-On Here: How to Purchase the Lofty Present Add-On

 

Summary

    • Introduction to Lofty Present
    • Create a New Report
      • Create a CMA
      • Create a Listing Presentation
    • Editing and Deleting a Report
    • CMA Identity Verification

Introduction to Lofty Present

Lofty Present includes two (2) types of reports that can be created to gain the confidence of your potential clients. 

  1. Comparative Market Analysis (CMA)
    1. Free for all Lofty users to create unlimited CMAs
    2. Two (2) CMA options:
      1. Seller CMA
      2. Buyer CMA
    3. Limited customization:
      1. Subject property address
      2. Comparable listings
      3. Estimated costs associated with buying/selling the subject property
      4. Final report that can be emailed or texted to a lead
  2. Listing Presentation
    1. Unlimited Listing Presentations available for $19.99/month
    2. Six (6) default templates and the option to create your templates:
      1. Four (4) Seller presentation templates
      2. One (1) Buyer presentation template
      3. One (1) Agent presentation template
    3. Full Customization:
      1. Subject property address
      2. Comparable listings
      3. Estimated costs associated with buying/selling the subject property
      4. Ability to add, remove, or rearrange the report pages
      5. Final report that can be emailed or texted to a lead or downloaded as a PDF

Create a New Report

Navigate to Marketing > Tools > Lofty Present to get started.

We offer two (2) types of presentations:

  1. CMA (Comparative Market Analysis)
  2. Listing Presentation

The primary differences are described above, but basically, the CMA is free for all Lofty users, but is a limited experience. Listing Presentations offer further customizations and create a downloadable PDF, but cost $19.99/month. For both, there is no limit to the number of reports you can create.

Create a CMA

First, let's create a CMA report. Click CMA and select the type: Seller or Buyer.

Whether you are creating a Buyer or Seller CMA, the first step is to select the lead the CMA is being created for and give the CMA report a name. This name will help you find the report easily.

Next, choose the subject property. This property will be used to generate the other data for the report. The fields that are required to create the CMA report will have an *. 

  • Featured Image. This can be an image of the property or a generic image, depending on what you would like to present.
  • Address*. This is the address for the property that is being compared to others to determine an initial selling price.
  • Location Point*. This will auto-generate with the address, but you can use the button on the right to adjust if needed. This will be important in finding nearby listings later.
  • Property Type*
  • Beds
  • Baths
  • Living Area
  • Additional Info
    • Lot Size
    • Style
    • Year Built
    • Annual Taxes

Note: Due to browser settings in Chrome, some Canadian Lofty users may have issues inputting correct street addresses due to postal codes. Please check this article for more information: Post Codes Browser Settings - Canadian Users

Click Continue to select comparable listings. Apply filters, adjust the radius, or draw a polygon to find listings for the report. These listings should be similar to your subject listing, so the report can provide accurate estimates.

Note: You can only add a maximum of 30 listings to be compared to the subject property.

The Estimate section provides an estimate of the listing price for the subject property and includes estimated costs of buying or selling this property. These fields are editable. You can also add a custom field if relevant data is not included in the template.

Scroll down to adjust the included comparable listings. Click Continue to view the final report.

The final report can be emailed or texted to a lead. This will direct the lead to a landing page created for this report. The CMA does not create a downloadable PDF.

Create a Listing Presentation

Next, we'll create a Listing Presentation. The process is nearly identical to creating a CMA, however, you do have a few more options and customization opportunities. First, click Listing Presentation, then select a template or create a new template. Learn more about Listing Presentation Templates here: How to Create a CMA Template

Regardless of the template selected, the process for creating the Listing Presentation is the same. There are some differences in the customizations within the templates, so please check each template out to find the one you want to use.

After you've selected your template, the first section is to provide the Lead's name, name the report, and select the subject property - this is the same as the CMA report. What is different is that you can see that you have the option to customize the report as well as create a Quick Presentation. 

The quick presentation option fast-tracks the Listing Presentation creation process to select comparable listings for you, set the pricing estimates, and automatically generate the report for you.

To set up the report manually, click Continue to select the comparable listings yourself. 

Apply filters, adjust the radius, or draw a polygon to find listings for the report. These listings should be similar to your subject listing, so the report can provide accurate estimates.  Check the box next to the property to include it on your report.

Note: You can only add a maximum of 30 listings to be compared to the subject property.

Once you are satisfied with the comparable listings, click Continue to set up the pricing estimates.

The Estimate section provides an estimate of the listing price for the subject property and includes estimated costs of buying or selling this property. These fields are editable. You can also add a custom field if the relevant data is not included in the template.

Click Continue to customize the Listing Presentation.

The Customize section is similar to the Lofty website editor. Use the Move icon to reorganize the page order. The + icon allows you to add a page. The edit icon allows you to edit the section. The trash can icon will delete the section.

Here, you can adjust how the final report will look. It will already have your specific branding from your Lofty profile. The Listing Presentation can be viewed on desktop, mobile, and PDF. Select each option to view the report in each format.

Once the report is done, click Continue to email or text the report directly to the lead or download the PDF. The report can be adjusted and edited anytime.

Agent Presentation

We offer an agent presentation template for Listing Presentations. This report is not lead or property specific.

There are only two (2) sections: Customize and Presentation. The Customized section is edited similarly to the Lofty website and already has your branding from your Lofty profile.

 

When the report is complete, send the link or download the pdf to anyone you want to present yourself to.

CMAs and Listing Presentations can also be created from the following locations:

Lead detail page

Listing Discovery Page

 

Editing and Deleting a Report

You can Edit, View, Download, or Delete any reports that you have created via Marketing > Lofty Present

When an edit is made to the following pages, that edit will be saved for the next time that page is utilized in a new report built in the future. Those changes will not affect previous reports created or their content.

  • Title Page
  • About Company
  • Agent Resume
  • Marketing Action Plan
  • Testimonials

Identity Verification

Identity verification is designed to prevent reports from generating false positives for views. That is, the lead never actually looked at the report, but the notifications were triggering, and timeline logs were being documented incorrectly. Our system will recognize the Lofty user's log-in cookies via the browser, so that when CMA reports are viewed, it will not trigger as a notification event even when logged in as a lead.

If a lead is logged into a Lofty-built IDX website and clicks on a CMA link intended for someone else, they will see a pop-up message informing them that the link is private and they do not have access to view it. 

 

FAQ

Q: Which source does Lofty use for the CMA?
A: Lofty’s provider for CMA (Comparative Market Analysis) data is primarily the MLS (Multiple Listing Service) databases.


Questions

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

Switch Between Old and New People Page UI

You may have been included in the beta released new People Page UI. Learn more about the updated People Page here: Updated People Page UI 

Now, you can easily switch between the new and old People Page UI. We recommend getting used to the new UI, as it has several new features and automations to keep up with your leads.

Simply click the green update button to go to the new UI and click the revert option in the Avatar menu to go back to the old UI.

 

Note: The new UI does include Segment automations. These automations will still run if you switch to the old UI, but you cannot see or edit the automations unless you are in the new UI.

 

Segment Reports

The updated People Page UI includes several new options for your Segments. In this release, we are introducing Segment Reports.

Switch to the New People Page UI and select Segments. Click on a Segment and select the Performance tab. Here, you will have access to reports on the website activities of the leads in this segment.

Learn more about Segments here: Lead Organization with Segments

 

Lead Type Filter Updates

The Lead Type filter has been updated in the following locations to include an Equals To filter:

  • People Page
  • Lead Routing Rules
  • Smart Plan Settings

Here's a quick summary of how these filters work:

Include All

  • People Page:
    • The People Page will filter for leads who have all of the selected lead types and will include leads that have other lead types as well.

  • Smart Plan:

    • The Smart Plan will only apply to leads who have all of the selected lead types and will apply if the lead has other lead types as well.

  • Lead Routing:

    • The Lead Routing rule will only apply to leads who have all of the selected lead types and will apply if the lead has other lead types as well.

Include One Of

  • People Page:
    • The People Page will filter for leads who have one of the selected lead types and will include leads that have other lead types as well.
  • Smart Plan:
    • The Smart Plan will apply to leads who have one of the selected lead types and will apply if the lead has other lead types as well.
  • Lead Routing:
    • The Lead Routing rule will apply to leads who have one of the selected lead types and will apply if the lead has other lead types as well.

Equals To

  • People Page:
    • The People Page will filter for leads who have all of the selected lead types and will not include leads that have other lead types as well.
  • Smart Plan:
    • The Smart Plan will only apply to leads who have all of the selected lead types and will not apply if the lead has other lead types as well.
  • Lead Routing:
    • The Lead Routing rule will only apply to leads who have all of the selected lead types and will not apply if the lead has other lead types as well.

name: REBNY Listing Management Partner
title: REBNY Listing Management Partner
body:
Introduction

The Real Estate Board of New York (REBNY) has added Lofty as a Listing Management Partner (LMP). This feature allows REBNY members to upload a manual listing from Lofty to the MLS. 

This is a whitelisted feature. If you are a member of REBNY MLS and would like access, please reach out to support@lofty.com.

In order to access this feature, you must follow these steps:

  1. You must be a member of REBNY MLS. This feature is not available to any other MLSs.
  2. You must request access to this feature by reaching out to Lofty support.
  3. You must sign an agreement with REBNY to switch your LMP to Lofty. 

 

Instructions

To get started, navigate to Listings and click + Add Manual Listing. Learn more about manual listings here: Manual Listings

Step 1: Basic Information

The first step is to provide the listing address. You have the option to select the Entire Building for the listing. If Entire Building a toggled off, there is a field for the Unit number.

Step 2: Listing Information

The next step is to add the listing information:

  1. Basics:
    1. Listing Type
    2. Listing Status
      1. Active
      2. Coming Soon
    3. Property Type
  2.  Agents:
      1. Up to four (4) listing agents may be added

Step 3: More Information

This section contains the detailed information about the property, as well as listing photos:

  1. Building Info
    1. Borough
    2. Neighborhood
    3. Number of Units
    4. Built Year
  2. Unit Info
    1. Ownership Type
    2. Floor of Unit
    3. Bedrooms
    4. Bathrooms
    5. Total Rooms
    6. Sq Ft
    7. Unit Exposure
    8. Unit Condition
    9. Unit View
  3. Sale Info
    1. Listing Price
      1. This includes a toggle for Non-Disclosure
    2. Date Available
    3. CC/Maintenance
    4. RE Taxes
    5. Taxes
    6. Financing
    7. Co-broker Agreement
    8. Exclusive Type
    9. Commission Type
    10. Buyer's Broker Commission
  4. Features
    1. Pet Policy
    2. Apartment Amenities
    3. Building Amenities
    4. Detailed Description
  5. Open House
    1. Option to add Open House information, as well as select 'Broker Only' or 'Appointment Only'
  6. Access Info
    1. Broker Viewing Instructions
    2. First Showing Date
  7. Media
    1. Photos
    2. Video
    3. Virtual Tour link
  8. Syndication:
    1. This is where this listing will be populated. The listing can be added to RLS IDX, RLS Vow, your Lofty built website, or just to the CRM. Multiple options can be selected.

The final step is to click Launch. This will publish the listing in the locations selected in the Syndication step.

Coming Soon Listing Upload Rules

Maximum Duration:

  • Listings may remain in Coming Soon for up to 14 calendar days from submission.
  • Listings exceeding 14 days in this status are marked non-compliant.

Showing Start Date Requirement:

  • Must be set within 14 days of the submission date when uploading the listing.
  • After the Showing Start Date passes, if the listing remains Coming Soon, the system automatically changes its status to Temporary Off Market (TOM).

After Auto-Transition to TOM:

  • You can edit and resubmit the listing as Active when ready for public display.

 

Remember:

This is a whitelisted feature. If you are a member of REBNY MLS and would like access, please reach out to support@lofty.com.

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

Group Texting

A group text is a text message that is sent to multiple recipients, and all the recipients can see and reply to each other. 

Group texting will allow you to send a text message to both a lead as well as another agent, another lead, or the lead's family member. Up to 9 numbers can be added to a group text, for a total of 10 numbers, including the original sender. 

IMPORTANT!

Group texting access will be rolled out gradually. If you want to get access quickly, please follow these steps:

A2P 10DLC Registration Updates

Starting in March, we will begin enforcing the A2P 10DLC regulations. For more information on this topic, please see our Help Center article: A2P 10DLC Registration

  • As a reminder, A2P 10DLC will only apply to you if you send text messages to United States based phone numbers. If you do not send text messages to US phone numbers, you will not need to register.

If you are a new Lofty user or have acquired your virtual phone number since December 2023, your virtual number needs to be registered to a 10DLC campaign in order to send text messages to US based phone numbers. 

 

If your Lofty account and virtual phone numbers were acquired before December 2023, you have been able to send text messages without registering. Starting this month, we will be enforcing 10DLC registration and you will soon lose your ability to send text messages to US based phone numbers.

Please begin your A2P 10DLC registration as soon as possible to avoid any outage in your ability to send text messages. As long as you have submitted registration, you will be able to continue sending text messages.

 

Mobile App Lead Assignee Optimization

This update allows you to assign a lead to another agent, any other role, or to a lead pond via the Lofty mobile app. 

Learn more about managing your leads in the Lofty app here: Managing Leads in the Mobile App

Mass Action Upgrade 2.0

This update increased the limit of leads that mass action can be taken on from 200 leads to 5,000 leads for the following actions:

  • Send Postcard
  • Send Letter
  • Delete 
  • Erase
  • Recover

Remember, you can see the results of your mass actions by checking the Actions notification in the notification bell. Learn more about notifications in the CRM here: Lofty Notifications

Agent Import Optimization

Enterprise Lofty accounts can add agents to their account via a csv file import. We have made three improvements to this process.

  1. The Hierarchy Groups can be assigned on agent import
  2. The users' account types can be set on import:
    1. Full users with a seat should have one of the following fields:
      1. Blank Field/No data
      2. Normal
      3. Standard
    2. Display only users, who do not occupy a seat, should have one of the following fields:
      1. Display Only
      2. Roster Only
      3. Display
      4. Roster
      5. Inactive

Learn more about setting up your Enterprise Lofty account here: Enterprise Organization and Hierarchy Overview

Listing Ads Call to Action

The Listings Promotion Dashboard UI has been updated and we have added a notification to let you know when one of your listings has been active for 24 hours.

Learn more about Listing Promotion Ads here: Listing Promotions

Customize the Payer on Smart Plan Steps

This update allows Lofty users, other than the Smart Plan creator, to pay the fees for Smart Plan steps that incur a cost, like mailing a physical letter or postcard.

A payer setting is available on Smart Plans that include a paid for step in the Smart Plan Actions that allow the responsible payer to be either the Smart Plan creator or the Lofty user who is applying this Smart Plan to their leads. 

Learn more about sending mailers here: Print House: Mailers

Landing Page Form Optimization

By default, when a form is filled out on a landing page, the provided details are saved and the person who completed the form is now logged in to your website.

With this update, you can have a form on a landing page reset after each time is it completed, without keeping the person logged in. This is useful if you want to have leads or other contacts provide their information via a landing page form at an open house or other networking event.

Transaction Page UI Optimization

We have made some updates to the CRM Transaction Detail Page UI. Overall, the functionality is not changing, but the UI will look a bit different.

Before After

Please see our Help Center article Transaction Management Introduction for more information.

 

Transaction Owner Optimization

We have optimized transaction ownership so that the primary owner of the transaction no longer has to be the primary agent who is assigned to the lead.

As a reminder, each transaction must be assigned to a lead, and each transaction must have an owner. The update here is that the transaction owner can be any agent on the team, and not just the lead's primary assigned agent.

Lofty Enterprise Accounts Only

If you are on a Lofty Enterprise account, you will have an additional permission added to the permission profiles advanced settings. Transaction Roles:

By default, Enterprise accounts will be set to "Allow users to assign transactions to any other user within the account." These settings will allow you to limit Transaction ownership to only users within that user's own Hierarchy group.  You can also set an exception, where certain agents or groups can assign transaction ownership to other agents or groups.

 

Commission Updates

We have made some general updates to the commission portion of a transaction. Please see those details in the Closing a Transaction section of our Help Center article: Transaction Management Introduction

We have also updated our Commission Disbursement Authorization (CDA) form. Please see our Help Center article: Commission Disbursement Authorization (CDA) Generation

Available on Wednesday, January 31, 2024

Lead Mailing Address Optimization

Previously, the lead's entire mailing address was stored in the same field on the lead detail page, as seen below:

We have separated the lead's mailing address into different fields, so you can be confident that the lead's mailing address is correct when you want to send them a letter or postcard via the mail.

Existing leads with a mailing address will be updated automatically. We do recommend that you double check the mailing address before sending a letter or postcard, to ensure that the mailing address format is correct.

 

Showing Notification Improvements

We have made some improvements to showing notifications, so you never miss a showing request. The notifications tab in the web CRM now has a section for Showing Request related notifications:

We have also implemented email notifications that will be sent when a request has been pending for a few days, as well as notifications in the Lofty mobile app. 

Please see our Help Center article on the Showing Tool for more information about scheduling your showings with Lofty: Listing Showing Management

 

Social Studio Pro Auto-Post Listing Filter

We have added filters to the Automatic Listing Posts. These are social media posts that will post to the selected channels automatically when the listing status changes. More information on this feature can be found in the Social Studio Pro Help Center article, linked above. 

With this update, you can decide exactly which listings are posted automatically. Click the Filter icon to filter out some listings from being posted automatically.

name: Search Engine Optimization (SEO) Tool
title: Search Engine Optimization (SEO) Tool
body:
Introduction

The SEO Tool now includes a powerful tool that allows you to directly assess the indexing performance of the pages on your Lofty build website. With this feature, you can easily identify areas for improvement in your website's search engine optimization (SEO) and make updates accordingly. This will ultimately help you acquire organic traffic and enhance the visibility of your website.

Note: The SEO Tool is not available for subdomain websites. 

Summary

    • Key Benefits
    • Getting Started
    • SEO Report Content
      • SEO Analysis
      • Keyword Relevance
    • Implementing Suggestions
    • SEO Checklist
      • SEO Permission Overview

 

Key Benefits

  1. Easy Assessment: This feature enables you to conveniently analyze and understand how well each page is indexed by search engines, making it easier for you to identify any gaps or areas for improvement in your SEO strategy.
  2. Optimization Suggestions: Based on the assessment, the SEO Tool provides suggestions on how to optimize your pages for better search engine ranking. These suggestions are tailored specifically for each page, giving you actionable insights.
  3. Increased Organic Traffic: By implementing these optimization suggestions, you can enhance the visibility of your website in search engine results pages (SERPs), attracting more organic traffic and potential customers. 

Getting Started

To use this feature, navigate to CMS -> Editor -> Select the Page -> SEO Tool

Before using the SEO tool, be sure to choose the page that you want to test. Next, input the keyword. If the page has a set keyword, the keyword will already be entered in the keyword field. Click Get Analysis to get the page's SEO report.

SEO Report Content

The SEO plugin was developed based on Yoast's open source code, so we only provide guidance for each test item. This guidance includes a link directly to the Yoast help center, which will provide detailed information on how to improve the SEO on your website.

SEO Analysis

  •  

The SEO Analysis tab guides the following aspects of your website:

  • Subheading Length
  • Title Length
  • Description Length
  • Text Length
  • Text Images
  • Internal Links
  • Mobile Page Performance
  • Desktop Page Performance

Keyword Relevance

The Keyword Relevance tab analyzes the keywords on the selected page and provides improvement suggestions for the following:

  • Key Phrase Length
  • Title Keyword
  • Subheading Keyword
  • Keyword Density
  • Description Keyword

Select Click to improve to implement the suggestions.

Implementing Suggestions

After getting the report, it's time to implement the optimization suggestions provided by the plugin:

  1. Review each suggestion carefully and understand how it can improve your page's SEO.
  2. Make necessary changes accordingly, such as updating meta tags and optimizing content elements.
  3. Utilize the built-in tools (such as our blog or SEO settings) for assistance in implementing these changes effectively.

Please note that after making changes to your website's SEO, it may take some time for search engines to crawl and reindex your pages. The timing of these updates depends on Google's crawling schedule. To speed up the process, you can manually request re-indexing through Google Search Console.

 

SEO Checklist

On the Overview page, click the SEO setup & checklist on the right-hand side of the page to complete your SEO tasks. Clicking "Continue" will take users to the SEO tab. Once the checklist is completed, this section will disappear from the Overview page, but you can still check the settings by clicking the SEO tab up on top.

Below are the new modules added to SEO to offer suggestions for sustained SEO growth.

  • Share Your Social Posts:
    • Click "Share Now" to be redirected to the Social Studio creation page.

  • Write Original Blogs:

    • Click "Create Now" to be redirected to the Blog Editor page.

  • Add Backlinks:

    • Click "Learn More" to access the Help Center document about backlinks.

  • Track Page Performance:

    • Click "Test Now" to be redirected to the Google Page Speed Testing page.

Access Restrictions: This new module is only accessible to company websites(Growth group website), group websites(Basic group website), and team websites, Growth Agent website, same as the Page Report module above.

SEO Permission Overview

Questions?

Call Package Optimization

The Delete logic is not changing. When a package is deleted, it can only be used by its current owner until the expiration date, when the package is deleted.

The Transfer option will allow you to transfer a package to another user on your account.

  • Packages that can be transferred:

  • Who can the package be transferred to?

The character limit for Notes on the lead's profile is increasing from 4,020 to 20,000 characters. You will also be able to export the most recent 100 notes on a lead's profile.

name: How to set up the Closely mobile app
title: How to set up the Closely mobile app
body:
Introduction

Closely is a consumer app designed to streamline the entire home buying or selling process, serving both buyers and sellers. It helps you better manage and facilitate real estate transactions, deliver personalized service, and enhance the client experience. Closely is offered to Lofty clients with a website at no additional cost. 

For an introduction to the consumer facing Closely app, please see Introduction to Closely Mobile App

Summary

  • Setting up the Closely App
    • How do leads log in or register for the Closely app?
    • How do I know if my leads are using the Closely app?
    • How do I guide my leads to the Closely app?
    • What does the Closely app download page look like?
    • Is there an agent version of the Closely app?
  • Setting the Closely App Map Search

Setting up the Closely App

After integrating your MLS and setting up your Lofty built website, the Closely mobile app will automatically be configured for you.  

Navigate to CMS -> Settings -> Lead Capture.

Here, you will find the Closely toggle switch, which is turned on by default. By enabling the Closely app, your website, welcome email, and email alerts will display the QR Code for your leads to download the Closely app.

Toggling off the Closely app switch will remove the Closely app download QR Code from your website and email notifications, however your users can still access the Closely app independently.

How do leads log in or register for the Closely app?

Closely app accounts and Lofty built websites are interconnected. The lead's activity in the Closely app will tracked in the same way their activity is tracked on your Lofty built website.

If your leads have registered on your website, they can use their website credentials to log in to the Closely app.

If a lead has not registered on your Lofty built website, but they do exist in your CRM, they can download the Closely app through the QR code on your website or email notifications or from the invitation link you sent them, and Lofty will connect the existing lead in your CRM with the account they just created on the Closely app.

If a new lead downloads the Closely app via your QR code, and they do not exist in your CRM, they will be created as a new lead in your CRM with the Source listed as Closely App.

How do I know if my leads are using the Closely app?

If your lead registered through the Closely app, their source will be marked as "Closely app", as shown above. Any activity performed by your leads using the Closely app will be tagged as "via Closely" in the lead's activity log.

You can also identify Closely users by using the Advanced Filter in the Leads list.

 

How do I guide my leads to the Closely app?

If the Closely app toggle in the CMS settings is enabled, your website's footer, mobile site's bottom bar, welcome email, alert emails, and home reports will automatically include your Closely app's download QR code or download link.

You can also invite your leads to download Closely manually by sending the Closely app download link via text message. This text message can be sent in mass:

The Closely app download invitation can also be sent to an individual lead:

Please note, the download links on your website, emails, and invitations will contain your agentId parameter to ensure that your leads are matched with you when they log in or register. If a lead downloads the Closely app from the app store, and not from the code or link you provide, Lofty will not be able to identify that this lead belongs to you and the lead will be matched with whichever agent has most recently had this lead register on their Lofty built website. 

What does the Closely app download page look like?

After scanning a Closely app download QR code or clicking on the download invitation link, the following download page will open.

The link will automatically detect whether the Closely App has been installed on the device. If Closely is installed, it will prompt to open the app. If it is not downloaded, the system will guide the user to the App Store or Google Play for installation.

Is there an agent version of the Closely app?

No, the Closely app is a consumer facing app, designed to be used by your leads. To experience the Closely app yourself, register as a lead on your website and log in or download the app via your download link.

If your leads send you messages through the Closely app, you can still receive and chat with them through the CRM or the Lofty mobile app.

 

Setting the Closely App Map Search

The Closely app will by default use the map center point you have set up for your Lofty built website. Navigate to CMS -> Editor -> All Listings page -> Listing Search -> Map Center Point to configure the point the map search centers on for both your website and the Closely app.

Questions?

name: People Page
title: People Page
body:
Introduction

The People Page is where you see and manage your leads within Lofty. This article will review each section within this page.
 

Summary

  • General Information
  • The People Page
  • The Segment Page

General Information

Navigate to the People Page by clicking People. A drop-down menu will allow you to select a People view, which will show all of your leads, or a Segments view, which will allow you to see all of your Segments.

The People Page

You can easily navigate between All Leads, your Leads, Leads in a Lead Pond, Partial Leads, and you can create a custom lead view. 

Click + View to add a custom view. These views replicate the Saved Filters in the previous UI.

 

The Pipeline is located at the top of the page. Click the Settings Cog Wheel (#1) to edit the pipeline. Click Filters (#2) to add a filter to the leads page. Click the Graph icon (#3) to edit the columns.

#1 - Lead Pipeline

For more information on organizing the lead pipeline, please see Lead Organization with Pipeline Stages

#2 - Filters

When adding Filters, the viewable leads will automatically update based on the selected filters. Click Create View to save this view to the top of the page for future use.

#3 - Column Organization

Here, you can customize the order and visible columns on the lead page. 

How to Create a View

The View feature allows you to see a specific selection of leads with one click. To create a View, click the + View button and click Create a View

You have the option to create a fully custom view or use one of our pre-built templates.

  • Not Replied to Today:
    • The Lead has replied by Email, Call, or Text, but has not been in contact in the last 24 hours.
  • Not Replied to This Week:
    • The Lead has replied by Email, Call, or Text, but has not been in contact in the last 7 days.
  • Email Activity
    • The lead has replied by Email in the last 7 days
  • Call Activity
    • The lead has replied by Call in the last 7 days
  • Text Activity:
    • The lead has replied by Text in the last 7 days
  • Active Website Browsing:
    • The lead has visited the website in the last 7 days and browsed more than 5 properties
  • Birthday is this month:
    • The lead's birthday is this month
  • Lofty Paid Lead:
    • The lead's Source is Lofty Paid Lead
  1.  

The Segment Page

Select Segments from the drop-down menu to see the Segments.

The Action column allows you to edit the Segment name and reminder period, change the Segment order, delete the Segment, send a mass email to the leads in a segment, send letters and postcards to all the leads in the Segment, and pin a Segment to the top of the list.

How to Create a Segment

Segment creation ability is determined by permission. Your Account Owner or Admin can toggle on the Segments permission in Settings > Permission Profiles > System Configuration > Segments. While there, they can decide if you should have the ability to create segments that are visible to everyone on the Lofty account, or only those members in your Office or Team. 

 

If you have the Create Segments permission, you can create a Segment by going to the Segments page and clicking the + Add New button.

When creating a new Segment, you will immediately be asked if you want to add leads to the Segment right away. If so, you can add filters to select the appropriate leads for the segment.

The Automation section streamlines the process of contacting and viewing data for all leads in a Segment. If a segment does not have any automations set up, you can easily see the available automations to get started. 

Once you have set up the automations, you will be able to see some reporting data. Here, we can easily see the email response rate for the leads in this segment.

Email Automation supports the following:

  • Send mass email to all leads in the segment
  • Send scheduled email
  • Data report of every email that is sent
    • This report can also be downloaded
  • Data report of all of the mass emails sent to leads in this segment

You can manually add a smart plan to all of the leads in a Segment via the segment detail page or in the segment list. Note: You are only able to add a Company/Team Smart Plan.

If a Smart Plan is manually added to a Segment, then all of the existing leads in the segment and new leads that are added to the segment will automatically have this Smart Plan applied to them. 

If a Smart Plan trigger is set to this segment in the Smart Plan settings, then the Smart Plan will only apply to leads who meet all of the triggers and conditions.

 

Physical letters and postcards can be sent to all of the leads in a Segment. Here, we support the following:

  • Data reporting for direct mail sent to leads in the Segment 
  • Send postcards and letters to all the leads in the segment
  • Data reporting of every campaign sent to leads in the Segment
  • Record the total date of all campaigns set for this segment

The Reminder Period automation lets you set up the period during which a lead should be contacted. This automation will show you how many leads have missed their reminder period.

 

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your CRM.

name: Google My Business, Zillow, and RateMyAgent Reviews Integration
title: Google My Business, Zillow, and RateMyAgent Reviews Integration
body:
Introduction

The "Reviews Block" can be used to present client testimonials/reviews that you would like to feature on your site. You can integrate multiple review sources into each Reviews Block. Instructions on integrating your reviews from Zillow, Google, and RateMyAgent are included here. Subdomain websites are not able to integrate their reviews.

 

IMPORTANT:

Reviews from third party sources (RMA, Zillow, Google) cannot be edited and you cannot pick and choose which reviews are visible, however, you can choose to not show reviews from a source.

Summary

  • Integration Settings
  • Google Review Integration
  • Zillow Review Integration
  • RateMyAgent Review Integration
  • Adding Reviews to your Website

Integration Settings

Navigate to the CMS -> Settings -> Tools -> Integration to access the integration settings. While you can integrate Google, Zillow, and RateMyAgent, you can only connect one account to each. That is, you can integrate one (1) Google account, one (1) Zillow account, and one (1) RateMyAgent account. Google Review Integration

To add your Google reviews to your Lofty website, navigate to CMS -> Settings -> Tools -> Integration and select Google My Business.

Click Connect and log in with your Google credentials.

Authorize the integration to your Google My Business account.

 

Zillow Review Integration

To add your Zillow reviews to your Lofty website, navigate to CMS -> Settings -> Tools -> Integration and select Zillow.

Input your Zillow screen name into the field and click Save. 

If you do not know your Zillow screen name, navigate to your Zillow profile https://www.zillow.com/profile, select Professional Information → ScreenName.

 

RateMyAgent Review Integration

To add your RateMyAgent reviews to your Lofty website, navigate to CMS -> Settings -> Tools -> Integration and select RateMyAgent.

Navigate to your RateMyAgent account profile to obtain your AgentCode.

Input the AgentCode into the field to complete integration.

Adding Reviews to your Website

Navigate to the website editor to select the visible review source(s). Detailed instructions can be found here: Reviews Block
