  • Appointment Time Zone Update
  • Option to Require Login by SSO
  • Transaction Custom Field: Multi-Select Option
  • Commission Disbursement Authorization Generation
    • CDA Form Components
  • Transaction Based Smart Plan Steps
  • New Smart Plan Notification Action
  • New AI Writing Assistant Scenarios
  • AI Assistant Open House Conversations
  • Closely App Notification Center
  • Closely App Download Invitation
    • Closely App Filter
  • Website Footer Custom Content

Buyer Tour Edit Optimization

The Buyer Tour can now be edited. Previously, if a buyer tour required modifications, it had to be deleted and rescheduled.

When a buyer tour has been scheduled with a lead, the tour will be available in the Appointments section of the lead profile.

Click the '...' menu to see the Buyer Tour Options.

Click Edit to change the Buyer Tour. This will open the tour and you have the ability to rearrange the tour order, delete the listing from the tour, and add another listing to the tour.

Showing Request Optimization

To access the Showings Dashboard navigate to Calendar → Task View → My Showings → Showings. Showings that leads have requested will be located in the Showing Request column.

Clicking on the Showing Request will open a side panel with actions that can be taken:

  • Accept the Showing
  • Call Lead (if the lead has a valid phone number, opted in to calls)
  • Text Lead (if the lead has a valid phone number, opted in to texts)
  • Email Lead (if the lead has a valid email address, opted in to emails)

The showing can also be accepted on the lead's profile:

When accepting the showing, the first step is to select the date and time. This is optimized to match the lead's requested showing date:

The next step is to contact the Listing Agent to acquire the access code. Once acquired, enter in the Access Instructions box to confirm the showing:

Once the showing is approved, it will move to the Approved column.

If the requested showing listing has been Sold, it will be marked with a red Sold banner and the option to accept the showing request will be removed. If the showing was approved, it will automatically be cancelled and all participants will be notified via email. 

Scheduled showings will appear on the Lofty calendar, as well as synchronize to integrated third-party calendars.

Appointment Time Zone Update

When adding a new appointment, the Time Zone will automatically sync to the appointment creator's time zone. With this update, the appointment creator has the option to change the Time Zone:

When Appointment participants view the Appointment, the time of the Appointment will be automatically converted according to the viewer's system time zone. This is also available in the mobile app:

When setting the appointment time, we have changed the UI from 3 independent Drop-downs to one input box. This makes it easier for the user to set the appointment time for a round number. The time can also be manually adjusted.

Before After

Option to Require Login by SSO

This feature is only available to Lofty Enterprise and Multi-Team accounts.

This update provides a setting that would require all Lofty users to sign into their Lofty account, both website and mobile app, using Single Sign On (SSO). This will protect the account, as the only option to log in will be via SSO, and not via the email address and password. 

By default, if you have already set up SSO for your Lofty account, the Login Method will be set to Any Method.

The permission to enable SSO is called SSO Setting. You must have this permission enabled in order to enable or disable the SSO requirement. Again, by default, the SSO requirement will be disabled.

 

Transaction Custom Field: Multi-Select Option

This update provides a new Transaction Custom field. Navigate to Settings → Transactions → Transaction Forms → Transaction Custom Field Management → Custom Fields → + Add New.

The new transaction custom field is an option to provide a list, where multiple items can be selected. The single-select option is still available and has been changed from Drop-down to Single-Select.

Select Multi-Select as the data type:

Add as many options as are needed (maximum of 20 options):

Click the edit icon to edit the custom transaction field. New options can be added or the current options can be deleted or re-ordered:

When completing this field on a transaction, tick the boxes next to each option that must be selected:

Commission Disbursement Authorization Generation

CDA stands for "Commission Disbursement Authorization". It is used to confirm the commission payment arrangements of individuals involved in a transaction, typically signed by the buyer, seller, and agent/brokerage.

 

You will be able to generate a CDA for any transaction that you have access to. To create a CDA, navigate to the transaction and click the '...' icon in the upper right corner and select Generate CDA.

  • Important: The transaction must have a close price and GCI set before the CDA can be generated.

The CDA can also be generated by navigating to the transaction, clicking Accounting, then clicking Generate CDA.

CDA Form Components

There are 5 sections in the CDA form.

1. Form Name:

  • The default Name is "Commission Disbursement Authorization and Current Date"

2. Transaction Details

  • This section displays the Property Address, Property Type, Closed Date, Sales Price, Close Price, and GCI.
3. Contacts:
  • All transaction roles involved in the transaction are available to be selected.
  • The "Escrow / Title" transaction role will be included by default, whether is has a contact or not, because it is typically a contact in the CDA.

4. Payouts

  • This section displays the commission details.

5. Instruction:

  • This is an optional field that may include additional instructions for the CDA. 

Once the CDA is complete, click Next to preview the document.

If anything needs to be changed, click Cancel to go back to the CDA editor. If the CDA is complete, click Next to save the CDA. 

The CDA will automatically be saved to the Transaction. Here, you have the option to email the CDA to the contacts on the transaction. The email will attach a pdf copy of the CDA, but will not contain any other content. The Subject Line and Email Body will need to be completed by the user sending the email.

The CDA will be saved to the transaction, in the Document section.

 

Transaction-Based Smart Plan Steps

We have a new option for recurring Smart Plans, related to Transaction Dates.

The standard transaction dates and any custom transaction date fields will be available.

To select the date to base the Smart Plan on, click the drop-down and select the date, then click Start:

Here, you can select a one-time reminder on a specific date, like a reminder to the buyer when the home inspection is occurring, or a yearly reminder on the anniversary of the closed date.

 

New Smart Plan Notification Action

This update also introduces a new action, which is available for both Recurring and Standard Smart Plans: Notifications

This action will send an email notification to the selected party. This can be the agent, assistant, or other role that is assigned to the lead, or an email address may be provided to receive the notification. This could be helpful if someone who is not a user of the Lofty account needs to be notified when this step in the Smart Plan occurs.

Multiple roles and email addresses can be provided. The email subject line and body will be blank.

For recurring Transaction based date Smart Plans, additional roles will be available to select, like Seller, Buyer, Renter, Listing Agent, Buyer's Agent, Utilities, Home Improvement, Home Warranty, Escrow/Title, Home Insurance, Home Inspection, and Agent:

New AI Writing Assistant Scenarios

This update adds two more options for the AI Writing Assistant to help create content for emails and texts:

  • "Property Needs"
    • The AI Writing Assistant will help write some content to ask what kind of properties the lead is looking for.
  • "Pre-Approval" 
    • The AI Writing Assistant will help write some content to ask whether the lead has gotten loan pre-approval and if the lead needs a lender.

AI Assistant Open House Conversations

This update adds a special conversation flow for the AI Assistant for leads who register from the Open House Form. 

  • The welcome script: 
    • Hi #lead_first_name, It was great seeing you at the open house at #openhouse_address. Hope you had a wonderful time! Were you happy with this property? Or, would you like to talk more about your current needs? 
  • When the lead replies with No: 
    • No problem. Can you tell me what you are looking for so that I can send you some homes to look at during your free time? Any other locations you are interested in? 
  • When the lead replies with Yes: 
    • Happy to hear that! Do you want to talk more about your needs? Would a quick 15-minute phone call be helpful for you?

Closely App Notification Center

We have added a notification center in the Closely app to send leads push notifications. This is convenient for leads to view updated listings, and may also improve lead activity and the Closely app retention rate. Please note the following:

  1. This update currently only supports sending property alerts. It does not support sending market snapshot notifications.
  2. The listing data for the alert push is exactly the same as the alert email. When sending an email, a push notification will also be sent to leads who use Closely.

The first listing information from the property alert is used for the push notification content.  Leads can click on the push notification to open the Closely app to view other listings.

All push notifications can be viewed within Closely, in the Chat list.

This is the notification detail page. When leads click on the push notification and open Closely, this page will open and they can see the entire message history of all alert notifications.

If any saved search has listing updates, there will be a red tag notification in the Closely app profile page.

Closely App Download Invitation

This update allows you to send a lead a text message, inviting them to download the Closely app. The invitation can be sent from the lead's profile by clicking the '...' menu and selecting Closely App Invitation.

This option is only available if:

  1. The lead has a valid phone number
  2. The lead has opted in to receiving text messages
  3. The lead has not already downloaded the Closely app

A sample text has already been written and includes the app download link. This text can be edited prior to sending.

The Closely invitation can also be sent in a mass text to all leads that meet the criteria.

This update also adds the Closely app download link to all Property Alert and Home Report emails.

Closely App Filter

This update also adds an Advanced Filter, so Lofty users can filter by leads who have or have not logged in to the Closely app.

Website Footer Custom Content

This update allows the option to add custom content to a Loftywebsite footer. This is available on any editable Lofty website.

The content added here will sync to any subdomains that are created off of this Lofty website.

 

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM

name: Lofty Real Estate App
title: Lofty Real Estate App
body:
Introduction

This article provides an overview of the features available in the Lofty Real Estate App.

Overview

  • Login Page
  • Settings
  • Mobile Dashboard
  • Chat Page
  • People Page
  • Listings Page
  • All Other Features

 

Login Page

We added two login methods for mobile users: Biometric and Pattern Lock.

Navigate to the app settings → Account & Security to modify the login method. You can enable either FaceID/TouchID or Pattern Lock.

Face ID (iOS only)

If you have not already set up FaceID on your device, there will be a pop-up that guides you through configuring FaceID. Once this is done, you can then go back to the Lofty app and turn on Face ID.

Notes: If you have a phone that does not support FaceID, you can set up Touch ID in the same way.
An iPhone can have either FaceID or Touch ID, not both.

Fingerprint Unlock (Android)

Face Unlock is not currently supported for Android phones. If you have not already set up a fingerprint unlock on your device, enabling this option will walk you through setting it up first, just like FaceID for iOS.

Pattern Lock

When turning on the Pattern Lock switch, you will need to choose a pattern, then verify it. If you have set up a pattern lock for your phone before, you will need to set up another pattern lock for the Lofty app. The app will not unlock with your phone's pattern unlock by default. You can, however, set up the same pattern lock if you want to.

 

Settings

The Settings icon will take you to your Lofty mobile app settings. Here, you can make any needed changes to your Lofty mobile app experience.

Navigate to Account & Security to set up alternative login methods, two-factor authentication, or to reset your password.

 

Mobile Dashboard

A notification chat called "Your Priorities" can be muted or pinned. Every day at 8 a.m. in your time zone, we will push a notification through the chat to guide you to go into the mobile dashboard.

  • We support new leads, opportunities, need to follow-up, tasks, transactions, appointments, and showings.
  • You can switch to different categories to view your work.
  • And can switch the time filter between “today” and “this week”.
  • For leads, swipe left can either text, email, or call the leads
  • For appointments, swiping left can complete or postpone the appointment.




Chat Page

Use this page to manage and respond to messages. 

  • Text communication with leads
  • AI Assistant messages (if applicable)
  • Individual and group messages with other users on your same Lofty account

You can use the search feature to easily find specific messages.

 

All notifications will also be located on this page:

  • Unknown Inbound
  • Showing Assistant
  • Opportunity
  • New leads
  • Reassigned leads
  • Task Reminders
  • AI Assistant notifications
  • Community
  • Transaction

 

People Page

The Lofty app categorizes your people into two categories: Leads and Contacts.

  • "Leads" are Buyers, Sellers, Renters, or Others. These people sync with the web app.
    • Leads can be shared with Contacts. 
  • "Contacts" are other agents on your team or in your MLS. The Lofty app makes it easy to communicate with your peers. 

Listings Page

The listing page will be identical to the web version of Lofty. The Discover tab will have the same functionality as the web app's All Listings page.

 

You can view and share your listings in the My Listings tab.

 

Listings can be shared with other agents, leads, or you can generate a showing link. 

 

When sharing listings with a lead, you have the option to filter by leads who are Matched Buyers or by All Leads. You can also copy the URL to the listing to share on social, or send via email by clicking on the arrow in the bottom right-hand corner. Using this option will generate a short URL that is friendly for sharing. 

 

Add Property in Mobile Email Sending Process

 

In the mobile app, when sending an email to leads;

  1. You can select multiple listings.
  2. After insertion, the listing appears as a variable on the editing page. But after sending, it will become a listing card in the email body.

Social Studio

Currently, this version only includes the basic functions of Social Studio, including:

  • Authorizing social accounts
  • Posting/ scheduling posts
  • Tracking engagement data of posts

Excludes feature:

  • Automatic post settings and display
  • Package upgrade
  • Boost post-related functions

To access the Social Studio, click the More menu next to the website icon.

Social Accounts Authorization

If you are a new user, you will first see the authorization page. 

Authorized users can access the Account Management page through the icon in the top right corner. From this page, you can perform actions such as connecting, removing, or refreshing the social accounts. The authorization status is synchronized between the web and mobile.

Post Dashboard
When there are no sent posts, an empty state will be displayed to guide users to create posts.

When there is content available, it will be divided into two tabs: one for sent posts and another for scheduled posts.

Sent: from the most recent to the earliest.

  • Post time
  • Post content: text, image, video, or link preview
  • Engagement data: same as web, including impressions, clicks, and engaged leads
  • Post channel: The grey icon means it failed to send the post to a specific channel.
  • Action: 
    • View post content on a social channel
    • Delete
  • Scheduled: from future to most recent 
    • Scheduled post time
    • Post content
    • Post channel
    • Action:
      • Edit
      • Delete

Create Post

Operations are close to the web version.

  • Click the Social Studio icon
  • AI will provide a prompt
  • Edit content
  • Choose social channels
  • Click the Publish button



All Other Features

All other features will be identical to the web version of Lofty. 

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat through your Lofty CRM.

title: Feature Updates for Lofty 3.67
body:
Introduction

Important: Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons that you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/standard user). These features are subject to change at any time. Please see our Learning Center course on this update HERE.

Having trouble accessing the course? This article will show you how to access the Lofty Learning Center: How to Access the Lofty Learning Center

 

Release Date

Wednesday, August 2nd, 2023

 

Summary

  • Print Center
  • Lead Groups Renamed Segments
  • Schedule a Meeting Optimization
  • Showing Appointment Optimization
  • Showing Appointment Automated Reminders
  • View Support Tickets in the CRM
  • Updated MLS Application Dashboard
  • Lead Routing: Open API Lead Options
  • AI Assistant Free Trial Upgrade

Print Center

The Print Center is located in Campaigns > Print Center. Here, you have the option to create a One-time, Monthly Recurring, and Smart Plan campaign. Your "Personal Info" can be added/edited by clicking the button in the top right corner. Personal information for the mailers will utilize variables and gain their information from this section.

Click "Print Mailers" to start the purchase process.

STEP 1: Select the Mailer Type.

We currently offer Postcard or Letter. Click "Discard" to exit and "Next" to continue to the next step.

STEP 2: Select the Design.

Note: Postcards have a Front and Back design, while Letters only have a Front design.

  1. Click upload to add your own photos
  2. Click "Edit Design" to adjust the design
  3. Select different themes to see all available designs

STEP 3: If sending Postcards, choose the back design and set up the tracking tool.

STEP 4: Set up the Recipients.

Here, you can select leads from the CRM, upload a mailing list, or purchase homeowner data from Geographic Farming.

STEP 5: Review the order and pay:

Lead Groups Renamed Segments

With this update, we are renaming the Lead Group feature "Segment". This change will be universal through the CRM. The API will have both Group and Segment available for a period of time, and we will notify all Lofty clients utilizing the API before we discontinue the use of Lead Group in the API.

The functionality is not changing, just the name. 

Schedule a Meeting Optimization

This optimization allows you to require information from a lead, or potential lead when the lead is scheduling a meeting through your Lofty Meeting Link.

By default, Lofty will require the First Name and Email Address of the lead booking the meeting. The client can also opt to require the following information:

  • Last Name
  • Phone Number
  • Description (A reason for booking the meeting)

Showing Appointment Optimization

Showing appointments in the Lead Detail page are optimized to give more options when a lead has requested a showing.

For Requested Showings, you have the option to schedule the showing or delete the request:

For Schedule Showings, you have the option to view the showing details or cancel the appointment:

 

Showing Appointment Automated Reminders

Automated reminder text messages will be sent to agents and leads before the showing appointment starts. These messages are automatic, there are no settings to disable or edit these messages. The message is sent both 24 hours before and 30 minutes before the scheduled appointment.

Buyer Tour Reminder: 

  • Hi! Just a friendly reminder that we have a buyer tour appointment scheduled for #date# at #time#. Our first location is #meeting location or listing street address#

Showing Appointment Reminder:

  • Hi! Just a friendly reminder that we have a showing appointment scheduled for #date# at #time#. The listing is #street address#

 

View Support Tickets in the CRM

You will be able to view your support tickets directly in the CRM and see the ticket status. The "My Tickets" entrance has been added to the "? " menu in the CRM:

 

Updated MLS Application Dashboard

The MLS application setting has been moved to the Listings tab in the CMS. The current MLS status will be displayed, so you can quickly see what is needed for the MLS application. 

 

Lead Routing: Open API Lead Options

This is an optimization to the Open API source leads in the Lead Routing Lead Options. Your Open API Lead Routing Lead Options will not change, but you may have additional lead sources available, where you may customize the Lead Options. To update the Open API Lead Options, navigate to Settings → Lead Routing → Lead Options:

Next, click Click to set next to Leads Imported from Open API:

Here, you can set specific lead routing for each source, rather than one option for all Open API source leads:

AI Assistant Free Trial Upgrade

With this update, we are notifying Lofty users when the AI Assistant Free Trial Allotment has been met, and also giving them the option to upgrade to the paid version of the AI Assistant, so the AI Assistant can continue to engage new leads for them.

 

When you are on the Free Trial AI Assistant, you can see how many days are left on the trial, as well as the lead allotment and how many leads have been engaged.

 

In this screenshot, the user has an allotment of 200 leads. That means that once the AI Assistant has engaged 200 leads, it will continue to work those 200, but will not engage any leads beyond that.

The user can click "Upgrade Package" to purchase the AI Assistant end the free trial period, and allow the AI Assistant to engage additional new leads.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM

name: A2P 10DLC - What It Is & Which Plan to Choose
title: A2P 10DLC - What It Is & Which Plan to Choose
body:
Introduction

This article explains what A2P 10DLC is, who needs to register, types of brands and campaign, pricing, trust scores, and includes some frequently asked questions.

Summary

  • What is A2P 10DLC?
  • Brands and Campaigns — The Two Parts of Registration
  • Step 1: Choose Your Brand Type
    • Sole Proprietor Brand
    • Standard Brand
  • Managing Your Registration After Approval
  • FAQs

What is A2P 10DLC?

A2P (Application to Person) 10DLC is the US carrier standard for business text messaging. All texts sent from Lofty are considered A2P — they come from software, not a personal phone. Carriers require registration to verify who is messaging consumers and why, reduce spam, and enable reliable delivery.

  • You must register if You send text messages to US phone numbers via Lofty (including AI Assistant texts).
  • You do not need to register if You never text US phone numbers.
  • If You're outside the US/Canada but text US numbers — you must first set up a US LLC. Contact support@lofty.com for help.

Note: Toll-free numbers are not part of the A2P 10DLC system. Contact Lofty Support separately.

Brands and Campaigns — The Two Parts of Registration

 

Your virtual phone numbers get linked to a campaign. The brand + campaign together tell carriers your messages are legitimate.

Step 1: Choose Your Brand Type

Do you have an EIN (Employer Identification Number)?

  • Yes → Standard Brand
  • No → Sole Proprietor Brand

Note: If you have a Sole Proprietorship LLC, you have an EIN — register a Standard Brand.

Sole Proprietor Brand

For individuals without a Tax ID (EIN/CBN).

 

Note: If you have multiple virtual numbers (e.g., personal + AI Assistant), you must register a separate Sole Proprietor Brand for each — using a different personal mobile number each time.

Standard Brand

For businesses or individuals with a Tax ID (EIN/CBN). Choose a plan based on your daily send volume:

 

Note: *Based on Trust Score after secondary vetting.

Tip: Tip: If you expect to exceed 6,000 messages/day in the future, register Plan B now. Campaign use cases can't be changed after approval, and resubmission costs another fee.

Secondary Vetting & Trust Scores (Standard Plans B & C)

Secondary vetting is a one-time $40/brand carrier review. It produces a Trust Score (0–100) that determines your T-Mobile limits and message speed. Trust Scores don't change automatically — if yours is too low, you must submit a new secondary vetting request.

 

Managing Your Registration After Approval

Go to Settings → Call/Text Settings → 10DLC Compliance to:

  • View all brands, their status, type, and creation date
  • Click a brand to see its campaigns and linked phone numbers
  • Move phone numbers between campaigns
  • Share a campaign with other Lofty users via the permissions cog

FAQs

Do I need a separate 10DLC campaign for each Lofty drip campaign?

No. Most users only need one 10DLC campaign. A 10DLC campaign represents your reason for texting, not a specific Smart Plan or drip sequence.

I already registered through another vendor. Do I need to register again in Lofty?

Yes. Brands and campaigns are vendor-specific and cannot be transferred. Registering via Lofty sets Lofty as your vendor automatically.

I'm in Canada — does this apply to me?

Only if your virtual numbers text US phone numbers. Canadian-only texting doesn't require 10DLC registration.

How long does approval take?

Typically 3–5 business days, but can take up to 4–5 weeks.

When am I charged the monthly fee?

On the 1st of each month. The fee is waived during your registration month — you first pay it the month after your campaign is verified. If the campaign fails, no monthly fee is charged.

Can I get a refund if my registration fails?

No. Payment goes directly to The Campaign Registry, not to Lofty. Fees are non-refundable.

Which address should I use?

Use the address on your EIN/Tax ID letter.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

Related term: A2P, phone regulation, 10DLC

name: Feature Updates for Lofty 3.66
title: Feature Updates for Lofty 3.66
body:
Introduction

Important: Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons that you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/standard user). These features are subject to change at any time. Please see our Learning Center course on this update HERE.

Having trouble accessing the course? This article will show you how to access the Lofty Learning Center: How to Access the Lofty Learning Center

Release Date

Wednesday, July 12th, 2023. 

Summary

  • Lead Sharing Link
  • Enterprise Group Level Transaction Checklists
  • Commission Optimization
  • Book a Meeting Link Optimization
  • Lead Pond Email Signature Optimization
  • Calendar Alert Optimization
  • AI Writing Assistant Optimizations
  • Closely App Login Update
  • Enterprise Agent Page URL Update
  • Onboarding Dashboard Optimization
  • Listing Showing Management Update
  • Social Media Account Status Update

Lead Sharing Link

This new feature allows you to quickly share a lead with another Lofty user on your account, by sending them a link to the lead. In order to view this lead, the user the link is shared with be able to view this lead.

To share a lead, click the "..." icon on the lead's profile and click "Share Lead"

Next, a pop-up window allows you to copy the link to share

This functionality is also available in the Lofty mobile app

 

Enterprise Group Level Transaction Checklists

This update allows for group-level Transaction Checklists on Enterprise Lofty accounts. If a Lofty user has Company Templates - Entire Company, they can create a Transaction Checklist for any group. If they have Company Templates - User's Group, they can create a Transaction Checklist for their own group.

The type of Checklist (Company or Group) will be listed next to the Transaction Checklist name. Checklists may be filtered by Company or Group by clicking Scope.

When applying a Transaction Checklist to a transaction, you will have tabs for both Company and Group transaction checklists. Here, you may select a transaction checklist from either the Company level or your own Group level.

Commission Optimization

This update allows Vendors, or anyone who is not a member of the Lofty account, to be included in the commission split on a transaction.

When clicking the "Paid To/From" box, the dropdown menu will display some suggestion, which includes the following: 

  • The transaction owner's Team
  • The party that was Recently searched (displaying a maximum of 6)
  • A “Temporary Entity” that can be added to this transaction

If the party who should be included in the Commission split is not a Team member or a Vendor on the account, they may be added:

A summary has been added after each Split, so you can see the commission split results in real time, as you are closing the transaction.

Book a Meeting Link Optimization

Several Optimizations have been made to the Book a Meeting link.

We have added a "Meeting_Link" variable, that can be added to an email or signature, which will automatically add a link to your Lofty meeting booking page.

This variable will add a clickable link to your personal Lofty booking page.

When viewing the appointment on the Lofty Calendar, the following fields will be visible:

  • Location
  • Participants
  • Email
  • Phone

The default prefix logic for Meeting Link has been updated to the Lofty user's own website. If you do not have your own website or subdomain, the meeting link will show either your Group website, Team website, or Company website.

Within the Meeting Link settings, you have the option to automatically create new leads if a non-lead books a meeting via your Meeting Link. All meetings scheduled by the lead will be displayed on the lead's Appointments section.

When the lead books a meetings, the calendar will automatically offer the first available time.

Lead Pond Email Signature Optimization

The lead pond was recently updated so that emails were sent from the lead pond owner, rather than the required virtual agent. With this update, all automatic emails can be sent from a customized email signature.

  • If the switch is turned off, all automatic emails sent to leads in the lead pond will use the email signature of the Pond Owner 
  • If the switch is turned on, the Lead Pond owner can set a custom email signature for the Pond. All automatic emails sent to the pond lead will use this custom email signature instead of the Pond Owner's email signature

Calendar Alert Optimization

We have made an optimization to third-party integrated calendars. 

The following notes are added to the Integrated Calendar section on the Calendar page.

Google Calendar Note: 

  • If the LoftyAppointment's owner or participant includes you, the appointment will be synced to your Google Calendar
  • When the Lofty Appointment participant's email is Gmail, Google Calendar will automatically recognize and sync the appointment to this participant's Google Calendar.

Outlook Calendar Note:

  • If the Lofty Appointment's owner is you, then the appointment will be synced to your Outlook Calendar

If you do not have any third-party calendar integrated:

  • If the participant is a Lofty user, this appointment will automatically be displayed on their Lofty calendar and they may choose to accept or reject this appointment.
  • The LoftyAppointment invitation email can be sent to all participants by either Google Calendar or Outlook Calendar if connected. Go to Settings->Integrations to connect either of them.

If you have integrated your Google Calendar or Outlook Calendar:

  • If the participant is a Lofty user, this appointment will automatically be displayed on their Lofty calendar and they may choose to accept or reject this appointment.
  • The Lofty Appointment invitation email will be sent to all participants, per #OwnerName's calendar notification settings. The reminder will only be sent to the owner.

When the appointment is saved, if you have integrated your Google Calendar and turned on the setting sync appointments to your Google Calendar:

  • This appointment will automatically sync to the Google Calendar of any participant who uses Gmail. This is Google's automatic recognition mechanism, which may be adjusted in your Google Calendar settings. 

AI Writing Assistant Optimizations

The next time you utilize the AI Writing Assistant, you will be prompted to acknowledge a disclaimer pop-up. If you do not click "Okay", the AI writing assistant features will be disabled. 

We have also optimized the AI Writing Assistant so that you can highlight a section of content and prompt the AI Writer to assist with that specific content.

Closely App Login Update

The login options for the Closely app have been updated.

  1. We have added the “Email Verification Code” login method.
  2. Leads whose agents did not have a website were unable to log in to the Closely app. Now, if the agent does not have a website, the Closely app will utilize the agent's group, team, or company website.
  3. The "Select Agent" step has been updated.
  4. This update supports leads from non-website sources in the CRM to use the Closely app.

If the user is a website registered lead, after entering their email, the login options will be provided.

Logging in with the password (Default)

  1. The login process is split into two steps:
    1. Step 1: User enters their email address to match with an agent.
    2. Step 2: The matched assigned agent is displayed and the user is prompted to enter the corresponding password to log in.
  2. If there are multiple assigned agents for this user, the "Not Your Agent" entry will be displayed in the upper right corner, and users can click here to switch to other agents.
  3. If the matched assigned agent does not have a website, the upper-level websites will be used instead.

Other Login Methods:

  1. Email Verification Code: Click “Email Verification Code” to use this login method
    1. Step 1: The user enters their email address
    2. Step 2: If they are matched an agent and the agent has a website, the verification code email will be sent to the user's email address.
    3. Step 3: Enter the verification code to log in.
  2. Login with Facebook
  3. Login with Google

If the user is not a website-registered lead, but they are a CRM lead, they will enter the account creation process. They only needs to fill out the password during this process. After confirming the password, the user will automatically be logged in.

If the user does not exist in the CRM, the user will be prompted to contact their agent to create an account.

If the user needs to change their agent, they may do so via the menu on their profile in the Closely app.

Enterprise Agent Page URL Update

For Enterprise account users, we are providing the option for both a short and long URL to direct to the user's Agent Detail page. The short URL redirects to the long URL, so they may use the shorter, simplified URL for marketing materials. 

These fields will be empty by default.

Onboarding Dashboard Optimization

When a new Lofty user completes all the steps in the Onboarding Dashboard, they will be directed to set up the automated Welcome Email. Since they have imported their leads, as part of the Onboarding process, they will also have the option to send a Welcome Email to these leads.

 

Next, if the user's account includes the AI Assistant, Text Message Qualification will be disabled. The user has the option to turn this feature on now. If the user has the AI Assistant Free Trial or is utilizing the AI Assistant with a Lead Gen package, Text Message Qualification will be enabled already.

On the Team Dashboard, a green icon will appear next to team members who have completed Onboarding. For users who have not completed the onboarding process, the icon will be grey.

 

Listing Showing Management Update

Note: This feature will be released on Friday, July 14.

We have made some UI modifications to the Listing Showing Management tool. 

The Requested Showings will appear on the same dashboard as the Pending, Approved, Completed, and Rejected showing requests.

A new category has been added to the filter by Showing Appointments in the Lofty calendar. 

Social Media Account Status Update

A status will be added next to your connected social media profiles. If the social media account has expired, for example if you have changed the password or other account details, you will be prompted to reauthorize the account.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by a chat with us through your Lofty CRM

name: Feature Updates for Lofty 3.65
title: Feature Updates for Lofty 3.65
body:
Introduction

Important: Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons that you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/standard user). These features are subject to change at any time. Please see our Learning Center course on this update HERE.

Having trouble accessing the course? This article will show you how to access the Lofty Learning Center: How to Access the Lofty Learning Center

Release Date

Monday, June 26th, 2023. 

Summary

  • Agent List Page Optimization
  • Agent Tag Management
  • Lead Appointment Optimization
  • Calendar Optimization
  • Enterprise Agent Filter on People Page Optimization
  • Lead Pond Mobile App Optimization
  • Multilingual URL Structure
  • AI Social Post Writing Assistant
  • New Onboarding Dashboard
  • Enterprise API Optimization

Agent List Page Optimization

A number has been added next to the Agent List, representing the total number of agents, both users and display only, in the Lofty account's agent list. If a filter is applied, the number will update to reflect the number of agents available in the filtered list.

In order to see the number of Agents in the list, you must have the Manage User permission enabled for Team accounts or the User Management - Entire Company permission enabled for Enterprise accounts.

Agent Tag Management

This update adds a tab to both Team and Enterprise Lofty accounts to view/add/edit the Agent Tags. 

In order to access this tab, the user must have the Manage User permission enabled for a Team account or User Management - Agent Tag enabled or an Enterprise account.

Within this tab, the user can see the list of Agent Tags, the number of agents with that tag applied, the user who created the tag, the last modified date, and the option to edit or delete the Agent Tag.

Lead Appointment Optimization

With this update, if the Lofty user can see the lead, they can edit or delete an appointment on the lead's profile. If the user has Access All Team/Company Leads permission enabled, they do not have to be assigned to the lead in any role.

Here, the assigned assistant has the option to edit or delete the appointment scheduled by the primary agent assigned to the lead.

Calendar Optimization

If you have integrated a third-party calendar, such as Google or Outlook Calendar, into your Lofty account, appointments scheduled via the Meeting Link will now sync to your third-party calendar.

Enterprise Agent Filter on People Page Optimization

For Enterprise Lofty Accounts, when filtering by Agents on the People Page:

  • For Company Owner/Admin, Group Owner/Admin, and users with "Access All Company Lead" permission:
    • The users themselves will always be displayed at the top of the list
    • All users within their own group and sub-groups will be shown in the list
  • For other members:
    • The users themselves will always be displayed at the top of the list
    • All users within their own group will be shown.
  • Note: Any Lofty user can search for another user within the company, and those users' names will appear, but only the users in their own Hierarchy group will appear by default

 

Lead Pond Mobile App Optimization

With this update, we are adding Lead Pond functionality to the Lofty mobile app. If you have access to a Lead Pond, you can filter by the lead pond on the app Lead page:

This also supports claiming a lead from the lead pond, via the mobile app:

 

Phone Number Country Code

With this update, the country code will automatically display with your phone number on your Lofty website. The country code is provided in the profile settings. There is no option to disable this update.

Multilingual URL Structure

If you have enabled the Language Translation and Currency Conversion Add-On, the website URL will include the parameter "lang=**" when website visitors switch to a non-English language on the Lofty website. This allows you to set a default language for your website through the URL when promoting the website externally.

AI Social Post Writing Assistant

This is an expansion on the other AI-generated content features we have released recently. This update adds the AI Writing Assistant to the Social Studio, so Lofty users can utilize AI to write and edit social media post captions.

Screenshot Description

All social studio users will have access to this feature:

  • Freemium: 10 credits per week
    • Credits are applied when selecting "Generate" or "Continue Writing"
  • Pro/Team/Free Trial: Unlimited

Actions:

  • Generate
  • Rephrase
  • Summarize
  • Expand
  • Simplify
  • Change Tone
    1. Professional
    2. Casual
    3. Straightforward
    4. Confident
    5. Friendly
  • Continue Writing

New Onboarding Dashboard

An Onboarding Dashboard will be available to all new Lofty users for the first 90 days of their account being opened.

Screenshot Description

When a new Lofty user logs in to their CRM, they will be automatically redirected to this page.

  • They can exit the Onboarding Dashboard page at any time by clicking "Explore CRM"
  • They can navigate back to the Onboarding Dashboard for the first 90 days of their account being opened.

Onboarding Dashboard Entrance：

The Onboarding Progress can be accessed via the account's Avatar menu

New Lofty account owners are prompted to complete an Onboarding Questionnaire.

This questionnaire allows the Lofty Onboarding Team to get to know you and your business goals.

Stage 1: Digital Brand

The first section will help you set up the following features:

  • Company Number： This is only available for the Account Owner. The Company Number is the virtual phone number used by all members on the account. 
  • Email Integration：Prompts you to connect your email account
  • Social Media：Prompts you to connect your social media accounts, which will sync to your agent detail page 

Stage 2: Leads Database

The second section will help the you set up the following features:

  • Lead Import： You will be directed to the lead import page via this CTA button. If you have already imported your leads or requested assistance to import leads from the onboarding questionnaire, this section will be marked as complete.
  • Zillow Integration：You will be directed to Zillow to connect your Zillow account.
  • Lead Capture Settings: You will be directed to the Lead Capture section to connect your third-party leads.

Stage 3: Automations

  • Import Smart Plan Templates：You will be directed to the Smart Plan section to create a Smart Plan 
  • Set Transaction Checklist：You will be directed to the Transaction Checklist section to create a Transaction Checklist
  • AI Assistant：If the CRM package comes with an AI Assistant, you will be directed to the settings. If not, you will have the option to start a Free Trial and review the order page.

Stage 4: Marketing Profile

  • Strategy to Accomplish Goals: Based on the your choices, we will suggest different marketing plans.
    • Commission-driven lead closure: Lead generation 
    • Enhance CRM leads Nurturing: Remarketing ads
    • Dominate the Market: Seller ads and Geofarming 

 

Here, you can confirm the suggested plan now, but you will not be charged until your website has been set up and a member of Lofty's Marketing Team has contacted you.

Team Dashboard

The Team Dashboard allows the account owner to review the onboarding progress of all the users on the account.

 

New users can be added directly on this page.

Reminders can be sent to users who have not completed the onboarding process.

Enterprise API Optimization

The API has been updated to reflect the following optimizations for Enterprise Lofty Accounts:

Module Optimization
Get member information interface
  • The following four API endpoints can be used to obtain the Group ID and Group Name of enterprise users.

    • 5.6.1. Get current user’s info
      GET /v1.0/me

    • 5.6.2. Get team members  
      GET /v1.0/members

    • 5.6.3. Get member by account
      GET /v1.0/members/{account}

    • 5.6.4. Get user by Id
      GET /v1.0/users/{userId}
Create lead interface
  • Add "assignGroupId" field which is used to designate the lead to follow the routing rules of the specific scope.

Our API documentation can be found here: https://api.lofty.me/docs/index.html

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Supercharging Real Estate Advertising: Boosting Lead Quality with Facebook's Conversion API and Google's OCI
title: Supercharging Real Estate Advertising: Boosting Lead Quality with Facebook's Conversion API and Google's OCI
body:
Introduction

As an advertising agency that caters to real estate agents, we are continuously seeking ways to improve our services and deliver higher-quality leads to our clients. One of the most recent and effective tools we have implemented is Facebook's Conversion API, which offers significant advantages over traditional pixel-based tracking.

 

In this article, we will explain what the Conversion API is and share some exciting results from our recent tests which demonstrate how using this tool has improved lead quality for our clients in the real estate industry.

Summary

  • What is the Facebook Conversion API?
  • Impressive Results: How the Conversion API Significantly Elevates Lead Quality
  • Implementing Google OCI for Enhanced PPC Lead Quality

What is the Facebook Conversion API?

The Conversion API is a utility offered by Facebook that enables advertisers to send web and offline events directly to Facebook's server, bypassing the need for browser cookies or pixel tracking. This not only allows for more accurate tracking and measurement of ad performance but also opens up the possibility of personalizing ad experiences based on user behavior.

 

Impressive Results: How the Conversion API Significantly Elevates Lead Quality

To assess the effectiveness of the Conversion API, we conducted a controlled study in which we compared the engagement and purchase intent of leads generated using our conversion API-based campaigns to those without the Conversion API.

 

The leads were scored based on the quality of interactions in our AI-driven communication system. We classified the lead tags as "Good Tags" (indicating a strong interest in buying or selling property) and "Bad Tags" (indicating a lack of interest).

 

Our findings revealed that real estate advertisements using the Conversion API resulted in:

  1. A substantial increase in high-quality leads, with a 47% higher Good Tag rate (16.6%) for leads generated from ads with the Conversion API as compared to ads without the Conversion API (11.3%).
  2. A significantly higher email open rate of 23.2% for leads generated from ads with the Conversion API, as opposed to a 13.3% email open rate for leads generated from ads without the Conversion API.

Based on these compelling results, we are confident in the value of the Facebook Conversion API as a powerful tool for enhancing lead quality in the real estate advertising landscape. By implementing this advanced utility, we are not only better equipped to serve our clients but also able to help them achieve greater success in an increasingly competitive market.

 

Implementing Google OCI for Enhanced PPC Lead Quality

As part of our ongoing commitment to providing our clients with the best possible results, we are excited to announce that we will soon begin implementing Google's Offline Conversion Import (OCI) to further enhance the quality of leads generated through our Google Pay-Per-Click (PPC) campaigns.

 

Similar to Facebook's Conversion API, Google OCI enables advertisers to import offline conversions and provide feedback on lead quality based on each client's unique pipeline criteria. By utilizing this feature, we will be able to tailor our PPC campaigns better to cater to specific client needs, optimize our marketing strategies, and ultimately deliver even higher-quality leads to our real estate clients.

 

Stay tuned for updates on our progress and future success stories as we leverage the best available technologies to help our clients succeed in the ever-evolving world of real estate advertising.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Google My Business Setup Guide for Google Local Service Ads (LSA)
title: Google My Business Setup Guide for Google Local Service Ads (LSA)
body:
Introduction

This guide is designed for businesses planning to utilize Google Local Services Ads (LSA). Follow the simple steps below to set up and optimize your Google My Business (GMB). 

Instructions

Step 1

Visit the Google My Business website. Go to https://www.google.com/business/ and click the "Manage Now" button. 

Step 2

Sign in to your Google Account. Use your existing Google Account or create a new one associated with your business. It's recommended to have a Google Account specifically for your business.

Step 3

Enter your business name. If your business name does not appear in the suggestions, select "Add your business to Google." Use your exact, legal business name.

Step 4

Choose your business category. Select the category that best represents your business. This helps Google understand and display your business correctly in search results. As a real estate agent, it is important to set up your Google My Business page as a Service business to rank for city searches outside of your address city.

Step 5

Provide your business location. Enter your business address or specify your service area. If you're a service-area business or don't have a physical location, you have the option to hide your address. if you set up your page as an individual, you will compete with your office for local search results. In this case, you may need to use your home address instead of your office address.

Step 6

Confirm if you serve customers outside your location. Specify if you provide services at customers' locations or if they need to visit your location.

Step 7

Add contact information. Include your business phone number and website URL for display on your Google My Business page.

Step 8

Choose a verification method. Select from the available verification options (mail, phone, or email), depending on your eligibility and location. None of the new information that you entered will publicly show up until you are verified, so please complete as soon as possible.

Step 9

Optimize your business profile. After verification, enhance your Google My Business page by adding business hours, photos, a description, and services or products offered. This helps to make your page more appealing to potential customers.

 

Step 10

Update your profile regularly. Maintain an accurate and engaging online presence by adding new photos, responding to customer reviews, and updating your business information whenever necessary.

 

By following these straightforward steps, your business will be well-prepared for success with Google Local Services Ads.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by a chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Feature Updates for Lofty 3.64
title: Feature Updates for Lofty 3.64
body:
Introduction

Important: Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons that you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/standard user). These features are subject to change at any time. Please see our Learning Center course on this update HERE.

Having trouble accessing the course? This article will show you how to access the Lofty Learning Center: How to Access the Lofty Learning Center

Release Date

Wednesday, May 31st, 2023. 

Summary

  • Enterprise Permission Update
  • Transaction Commission Optimization
  • Google Local Service Ads - Call Package Adjustment
  • Google Local Service Ads - AI Assistant Adjustment
  • Reporting Section - Lead Privacy Filter
  • Reporting Section - Data Update Alert
  • Listing Detail - Schools Tab
  • Lofty Mobile App - AI Email and Text Generator
  • Social Studio - Coming Soon Listing Auto Post
  • Social Studio - YouTube
  • Listing Showing Management and Showing Invitations
  • AI Assistant Chat Box Logic Update
  • Enterprise Group Owner - Group Website Purchase
  • Enterprise Company Website - Custom Registration Disclaimer

Enterprise Permission Update

We have updated Lofty Enterprise account permissions so there are more options when setting up permission profiles.

Manage User

Previously, several features were included in one single "Manage User" permission. Now, permission may be individually enabled for the following:

  • Organization Hierarchy:
    • Allows the user to edit the organization hierarchy, either for the entire company or just their own group and sub-groups
  • Permission Profile:
    • Allows the user to edit/add/delete permission profiles for the entire company
  • User Management:
    • Allows the user to add/edit/delete users, either in the entire company or just their own group and sub-groups

System Configuration

Previously, several permissions were included in the single "Company Feature" and "Company Filter" permissions. Now, permission may be individually enabled for the following:

  • Custom Fields:
    • Allows the user to create Custom Fields for the lead profile
  • Transaction Forms:
    • Allows the user to add/edit/delete transaction forms, as released in Feature Updates for Lofty 3.63
  • AI Assistant:
    • Allows the user access to the AI Assistant settings
  • Reporting Goals:
    • Allows the user access to Reporting Goals for either the entire company or their own group and sub-groups
  • SSO Setting:
    • Allows the user access to the Single Sign On settings for the entire company, as released in Feature Updates for Lofty 3.56

Lead Privacy Permissions

All lead privacy settings have been moved to the same section. Previously, 'Access All Company Leads' was at the top of the list and other lead privacy settings were towards the bottom.

 

The permissions themselves have not changed, but there is additional options for the 'Delete Leads' and 'Export Leads' permissions:

  • Visible by User:
    • This allows the user to delete or export any leads they can see.
    • That is, they may not own these leads, if they have permission to view the leads
  • Owned Only:
    • This allows the user to delete or export and leads they are assigned to, as the primary agent.
  • Private Only:
    • This allows the user to delete or export and of their own private leads.

Website Permissions

Similar to Lead Privacy Permissions, the Website Permissions have been grouped together at the bottom of the permissions list. 

Transaction Commission Optimization

This feature builds in commission splits to the Lofty transaction section. When a transaction closes, there are three (3) stages of commission splits:

  • Pre-Split Adjustments:
    • These are additions to or deductions from the total amount anyone is paid, before the commission split.
    • Pre-split adjustments affect the amount everyone is able to be paid.
  • Split:
    • This is where the commission splits are entered.
  • Post-Split Adjustments:
    • These are additions to or deductions from the total amount paid to those included in the commission split. 
    • Post Split Adjustments only affect those outlined in this section.

This features comes into play when a transaction is closed. Navigate to the Transaction section and mark the transaction stage as closed. A form will pop-up to fill in the Close Price, calculate GCI and enter the Splits:

A GCI (Gross Commission Income) calculator has been added, to quickly calculate the amount for the GCI field:

Next, add the Pre-Split Adjustments by clicking + Add/Deduct. Up to ten (10) may be added. Here, you have the opportunity to add or deduct other expenses from the GCI. Here, see that we added $50, which then added that $50 to the total GCI:

When Deduct is selected, note that the total GCI has been reduced by $50:

Scroll to the bottom at any time to see the current state of the commission payment. After the Pre-Split Adjustment, here is the current commission payment:

Next, add the commission Splits by clicking + Add/Deduct. Up to ten (10) may be added. In the Paid To section, you may select the Team, and Agent on the account, or any Vendor/Partner who has been added to the account. Note, the calculator assists with percentage splits:

Scroll to the bottom to see the updated state of the commission payment. After the Commission Split, here is the current commission payment:

The final section is the Post-Split Adjustments. Up to five (5) post-split adjustments may be added for each Commission Split. Since we only included the Test Agent in the Commission Split, we only have the option to make Post-Split Adjustments to their commission amount. In this example, we will say that fellow agent Group Owner owes them $5 for coffee:

Scrolling to the bottom, we see that Group Owner's payment decreased by $5 and Test Agent's increased by $5, while the Team Net Commission remained unchanged:

 

Google Local Service Ads - Call Package Adjustment

Google Local Service Ads, released in Feature Updates for Lofty 3.61, requires a calling package to function. If you do not have a calling package, you will be required to select one when self-purchasing Google Local Service Ads:

Google Local Service Ads - AI Assistant Adjustment

This update provides a free AI Assistant to Google LSA users, which will work to qualify new leads from these ads. When a new lead registers via the Google Local Services Ads, the AI Assistant will reach out with the following message:

Hi there! I am {Assistant_name} from {company_name}. Thanks for reaching out from our Local Service Ads! We are happy to help you! Do you mind if I ask about your needs? Are you looking to buy or sell a home?

Reporting Section - Lead Privacy Filter

This update adds a filter for lead privacy, which will allow you to better calculate agent performance and reporting goals, while still obscuring details on lead privacy. The lead privacy filter has been added to the reporting tab:

Reporting Section - Data Update Alert

If you have a large amount of data in your Lofty account, you may experience delays when updating the Reporting page. This update adds a warning when data is taking some time to update, and informs you that you may leave the page while the data loads. 

 

If you close the window and close the pop-up, the data will not load, so you may exit the page without refreshing the data.

Listing Detail - Schools Tab

This update adds a "Schools" tab on the listing detail page, as well as ratings provided by greatschools.org. We currently only support this feature for US based MLSs.

Lofty Mobile App - AI Email and Text Generator

This is an update to the AI Email and Text Generator, released in Feature Updates for Lofty 3.63. This feature is now available in the Lofty mobile app. The functionality is the same, and the weekly quotas are also the same. That is, all Lofty users will have the ability to draft 50 AI-generated text messages and 25 AI-generated emails, regardless of whether they are using the web or mobile app.

The icon and AI options for this feature are the same in the mobile app as in the web app:

Social Studio - Coming Soon Listing Auto Post

This update provides a new Social Studio Auto Post; Coming Soon Listings. Auto Post listings are available to all Lofty users who have purchased Advanced Social Studio

 

Currently, "coming soon" listings are treated as "new listings", however, some MLSs prohibit the promotion of "coming soon" listings. With this update, you can enable or disable auto-posts for listing with a status of "coming soon". By default, this type of auto-post will be toggled OFF.

This auto-post option may be enabled and the default content may be edited in the "Auto-Post Settings":

Social Studio - YouTube

YouTube is now an available social media option for all Social Studio users. To connect a YouTube profile, navigate to Campaigns → Social Studio → Settings → Manage Profiles

YouTube only supports video posts and there is a 50 MB file size limit. When creating the YouTube post, the following settings are available:

  • Title
  • Tag
  • Category
  • Privacy

When a YouTube post fails to upload, you will receive an email notification. Typically, posts will fail due to the account not meeting YouTube's requirements or the authorization has expired.

Listing Showing Management and Showing Invitations

The Listing Showing Configuration tool is a new feature that allows Lofty and non-Lofty users to configure showing times, schedule showings, and manage to show requests and appointments.

Lofty User Listing Agents

Listing Showing Configuration

To configure the showing options for your listing, first, navigate to Listings → My Listings → Manage Listing:

If this is the first time setting up the Showing Configuration for this listing, click the Showing Configuration button in the upper right corner. If you are editing the showing configuration, click Actions → Showing Configuration:

Here, you may set up the showing details, such as the available times, whether approvals are done manually or automatically, and any information the buyer's agent will need to access the property:

When complete, click Save to confirm the showing details.

The scheduling link is located in the upper right corner of the Showing Configuration page. Click the icon to copy the link. This link may be shared in the MLS private notes for interested buyers' agents to access. When clicking the showing request link, all agents, whether they are Lofty users or not, may request to show the listing. Here is an example showing the request page:

Managing Showing Requests

You may approve or deny any showing requests on the Smart Listing page for the listing:

Scheduled showings can also be viewed in the Lofty Calendar, on the Tasks view:

Non-Lofty User Listing Agents

Listing Showing Configuration

When non-Lofty users request a showing time via the link, they will be prompted to sign up for Lofty's property showing feature:

Once an account has been created, non-Lofty users can create their own showing links, by clicking + Create Showing Link:

Next, they may add the listing details and set up the showing details, just like the feature for Lofty users:

Managing Showing Requests

Non-Lofty users also have a dashboard to approve and deny showing requests, as well as track their own scheduled showings:

Lofty User Buyer Agents

Scheduling Showings

When requesting a showing, Lofty users will be prompted to sign in to their Lofty account to continue:

Managing Showing Requests

Lofty users may access their requested showings via the Calendar Tasks view:

Non-Lofty User Buyer Agents

Scheduling Showings

Non-Lofty users will be prompted to create an account to log in to the showings tool. If they have previously created an account, they may sign in to request a showing and view their other requests.

  • Note: This is not a log-in to a Lofty account. This only allows them to manage their showings and showing requests.

Managing Showing Requests

Non-Lofty users may access their requested showings via the link they will receive via email after registering on a Lofty user's showing request link.

AI Assistant Chat Box Logic Update

With this update, the AI Assistant chatbox on the Lofty website can only be disabled in the CRM. In the CMS chatbox settings, you will see the following message, if the AI Assistant has been enabled:

The setting is located in the CRM Settings → AI Assistant → Live Chat on Website:

If you do not own the AI Assistant, you will see the following message in the CMS chatbox settings, which directs you to reach out to the AI Assistant owner:

Enterprise Group Owner - Group Website Purchase

This update allows Enterprise Group Owners to purchase Group Websites for their own Hierarchy Group and any Sub-Groups within that Hierarchy Group.

Enterprise Company Website - Custom Registration Disclaimer

This update allows up to three (3) custom disclaimers to be added to the Lofty website lead registration pop-up. This is a setting on the Company website and, when enabled, will also be enabled for all group/agent/subdomain websites on the account. Leads will be required to check the box next to the disclaimer to complete registration on the Lofty website.

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Instagram Connection Troubleshooting
title: Instagram Connection Troubleshooting
body:
Introduction

This article is meant to assist you with connecting your Instagram profile to Lofty's Social Studio.

Summary

  • Important
  • How to identify your Instagram Account Type 
  • Convert to Instagram Business Account
    • Via Instagram 
    • Via Facebook
  • Troubleshooting Checklist
  • Frequently Asked Questions
    • Q: How can I make sure that my Facebook page is connected to an Instagram business account?
    • Q: How do I connect to the Facebook page via Instagram?
    • Q: What if my Facebook page is not listed?

Important

Please note the following key points:

  • Your Instagram account must be a Business account and it must be connected to a Facebook Page. 
  • Your Facebook Profile must be an Admin for that Facebook Page.
  • If you have a Creator account, you will not be able to connect your Instagram to Social Studio. Instagram only supports publishing to business accounts at this time.

How to identify your Instagram Account Type 

Unsure what type of Instagram account you have? Follow these steps to find out!

  1. Open the Instagram app on your mobile device and go to your profile.
  2. Tap on the hamburger menu (three horizontal lines) in the upper right corner of the app and select Settings and Privacy.
  3. Select Account Type and Tools. Here, you will see the following options, depending on your current account type:
  • If you currently have an Instagram personal profile, you'll see these two options:
    • Switch to Professional account
    • Add new Professional account
  •  If you currently have an Instagram business account, you'll see these two options:
    • Switch to Personal Account
    • Switch to Creator Account
  •  If you currently have an Instagram creator account, you'll see these two options:
    • Switch to Personal Account
    • Switch to Business Account

Convert to Instagram Business Account

Via Instagram 

  1. Open the Instagram app on your mobile device and navigate to Settings and Privacy.
  2. Select Account Type and Tools.
  3. Tap Switch to Professional account.
  4. Follow the on-screen prompts, ensuring you choose the business account type, not the creator account type. You'll also need to select a Facebook Page (or create a new one) to link your Instagram business account to. You will see a "Don't Connect to Facebook Now" option, but if you don't connect a Facebook Page to your Instagram account, you won't be able to connect your account to Lofty Social Studio.
  5. Your Instagram account should now have been converted to a business account. https://business.instagram.com/getting-started

Via Facebook

  1. Head over to Facebook and navigate to the list of Pages you have access to (or click this link). Click on the Page that you'll associate with your Instagram account, or create a new Page if you don't already have one.
  2. Once you're on your Page, click Settings in the left-hand sidebar.
  3. Click Linked Account→Instagram on the left-hand side and then click Connect Account towards the top of the screen.
  4. Enter your Instagram login credentials and click Log In. (If you're already signed into Instagram, or your login credentials are saved within your browser, you'll just need to click Continue.)
  5. You'll see a pop-up window prompting you to set up your Instagram business account. Follow the on-screen instructions, be sure to enter your contact info, and then click Done.

Troubleshooting Checklist

  1. Head over to Facebook and navigate to the list of Pages you have access to (or click this link). Click on the Page that is linked to your Instagram business account.

  2. Once you're on your Page, switch to the page account and click Settings in the left-hand sidebar.
  3. Once in settings, you should see your Linked Account connected to the Page. You should also see a section that says "Business contact information". In this case, please continue to the next step.
  4. If you see a screen that differs from the image above, it means your Instagram account is either not connected to your Facebook Page, or it hasn't been converted to a business account. The following outlines some of the options you might see and the steps you should take. 
    1. If you see a button that says Connect Account, it means your Instagram account is not linked to your Facebook Page.
    2. If you see a button that says Get Started, it means your Instagram account is linked to your Facebook Page, but it hasn't been converted to a business account.
      1. Click Get Started and follow the on-screen prompts to convert your Instagram account to a business account. Then, try connecting your Instagram account again
    3. If you see a button that says Review Connection, it means that the account must be confirmed before third-party applications are able to verify the connection.
      1. Please click the button and follow the prompts to confirm. Note: If you encounter issues with this process, you may need to reach out to Facebook Support in order to confirm the connection.
  5. Finally, we need to check that Social Studio has all of the permissions required to access your Facebook account. Click on the small drop-down arrow at the top right of your screen and then click Settings & privacy > Settings. From there, click Business Integrations on the left-hand side (or click this link).
  6. Find Social Studio in the list of integrations and click View and edit.

  7. In the pop-up window, ensure that all Facebook Pages are checked in all sections.

    1. Note: If you don’t see any individual Pages listed in the following screens, it means that you’ve previously granted Social Studio permissions to access all Pages, which is the ideal setup. In this case, you won’t need to check any Pages here, and instead, you’ll need to reestablish the authorization: on the same page above, click Remove Lofty Social Studio and complete the steps on the popup window.

  8. Once that's done, try connecting your Instagram account to Social Studio again.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How can I make sure that my Facebook page is connected to an Instagram business account?

A: You will need to log in to the personal Facebook profile that has the admin role on the Facebook Page connected to your Instagram account. If you log into a Facebook profile that does not have the admin role on the Page, or if your profile isn't correctly set up as an admin within Facebook Business Suite, you will not see your Instagram business account listed in the next step. For more information on how to see your Facebook page role or access, please visit:  https://www.facebook.com/help/510247025775149


Q: How do I connect to the Facebook page via Instagram?

A: Follow the steps below:

  1. Go to your Instagram profile.
  2. Select Edit Profile.
  3. Under Public Business Information, select Page.
  4. Tap Create Facebook Page or Connect an Existing Page.
  5. Choose a Page from your Pages that you'd like to connect to or select Create a New Facebook Page.
  6. Tap Done after you've selected a Page or created a new Page.
    For more information, please see: https://help.instagram.com/570895513091465

Q: What if my Facebook page is not listed?

A: First, verify that your personal Facebook profile has the admin role for the page. If you page is part of a Facebook Business Suite account, make sure that your permissions are fully set up.

  1. In Facebook, open your page and check that you've logged in as your Facebook Page, not your profile.
  2. Open the menu on the left and select Professional Dashboard
  3. Click Page Access
  4. When you select your name, a pop-up will appear. It should say "This person has full control."

Please note that you cannot connect a Facebook page if your profile is an admin via inheritance from a parent page. To check this visit your Facebook page, navigate to the Page Roles section within the settings, and look for your name under Admin (inherited from parent Page). If you see this, you will not be able to authorize the connection between the Facebook Page and Lofty.

Next, ensure that you have authorized all page permissions. If you have the correct page role, but the page is still not listed, it means that Lofty does not have the necessary permissions from Facebook. Here are the steps to check your permissions:

  1. Log into the Facebook personal profile that has admin access with Full Control on the Facebook Page.
  2. Click on the small drop-down arrow at the top right corner and select Settings & Privacy > Settings
  3. Head to Business Integrations in Facebook. Please note that these settings are found on your Facebook profile, not within the Facebook Page settings, so you must be using Facebook as your profile to access them.
  4. Find Lofty in the list and select View and Edit
  5. Scroll down to the list of Pages and verify that ALL boxes are selected. You may need to click See all pages to expand the list of pages and see the ones that permissions to be granted. Here, tick all of the empty boxes.
  6. After selecting all of your accounts, click Save.
    1. If you are connecting a Facebook Page, head back to Lofty and try connecting the page again.
    2. If you are connecting an Instagram account, try connecting the account to Lofty. If it still doesn't work, please try the next steps.

Checking the connection between Facebook and Instagram

Once you have verified that your Instagram account is a business or creator account, next check that your Facebook Page is properly connected to Instagram within your Page settings and Meta Business Suite.

  1. Log into the Facebook Page linked to Instagram
  2. Click on Professional Dashboard
  3. Click Linked Accounts
  4. You should see your Instagram account connected:
    2. If your Instagram account is connected properly, the options will be View Details and Disconnect Account, as shown in the screenshot above.
  5. If you see a button that says Connect Account, your Instagram account is not linked to your Facebook Page
  6. If you see a button that says Get Started, it means that your Instagram account is linked to your Facebook Page, but it has not been converted to a business or creator account.
    1. Click Get Started and follow the on-screen prompts to convert your Instagram account to a business account. Then, try connecting your Instagram account again.
  7. If you see a button that says Review Connection, it means that the account must be confirmed before third-party applications are able to verify the connection.
    1. Please click the button and follow the prompts to confirm. 
    2. Note: If you encounter issues with this process, you may need to reach out to Facebook Support in order to confirm the connection.

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Feature Updates for Lofty 3.63
title: Feature Updates for Lofty 3.63
body:
Introduction

Important: Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons that you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/standard user). These features are subject to change at any time. Please see our Learning Center course on this update HERE. Having trouble accessing the course? This article will show you how to access the Lofty Learning Center: How to Access the Lofty Learning Center

 

Release Date

Friday, May 5th, 2023. 

 

Summary

  • Transaction Custom Field Update
  • Transaction Forms
    • Creating a New Form
    • Viewing the Form on a Transaction
  • Lead Pond Task Optimization
  • Featured Listing Tag on Lofty Websites
