Introduction

*** NO LONGER OFFERED***

The Private Instance Add-On is an option available to Lofty users on an Enterprise account and allows them to set up their own lead organization, such as the Pipeline and Segments, as well as set up their own lead routing rules. The Private Instance owner may invite other users to collaborate, as long as they are already members of the primary Enterprise account.

Summary

  • Purchasing a Private Instance Add-on
  • Utilizing the Private Instance Add-On
    • Adding Members
    • Lead Organization
    • Lead Capture and Lead Routing
      • Lead Capture
      • Lead Routing
    • Notifications

    • Call and Text Packages

    • Email
    • Other Add-Ons

    • Third-Party Integrations

    • Open API

Purchasing a Private Instance Add-on

The Private Instance Add-On is available in the Lofty Marketplace for all Lofty users who are members of an Enterprise platform Lofty account. To purchase a private instance, navigate to the Lofty Marketplace > Account Upgrades. This is available to all enterprise Lofty users, regardless of the permission profile on the primary account.

There are three (3) packages available. CRM Only option does not have a limit to the number of users that can be invited from the Enterprise instance, and does not have any website capabilities. We offer two (2) options for CRM+IDX. The first allows for only one user, so it does not include any lead routing capability. The other allows for unlimited users to be invited from the Enterprise instance and includes lead routing. Both CRM+IDX options offer a Lofty website and one 1 MLS.

The private instance will be available immediately after purchase, and a pro-rated amount will be charged.

Once the private instance add-on has been purchased, it may be opened both in the marketplace as well as in the Avatar menu.

 

You can change the private instance's name by changing the Company Name.

Please Note:

  • Any Lofty user under an Enterprise instance can have their private instance
  • Each user can only own one private instance
  • Each user may be invited to multiple other users' private instances
  • Only users in your Enterprise instance may be invited to your private instance. 

 

Utilizing the Private Instance Add-On

The private instance add-on is an extension of your primary Lofty account. There is only one login, and you may switch between the two accounts seamlessly. However, while your primary Lofty account is the Enterprise platform, the private instance add-on will be a single-team account. The main difference is that there is no Organization Hierarchy on the Private Instance Add-on, but if you did not have an admin permission level in the primary account, you will see some additional features in your private instance add-on.

 

Adding Members

You may add as many members as you would like, however, they must already be Members on your primary Enterprise Lofty account. To add a member, open the private instance add-on and navigate to Team Settings > Team User Settings > Users and click + Add Member

Next, a pop-up window will allow you to add members from your primary Enterprise Lofty account. You may add any user to that account, even if they are in a different hierarchy group than yourself. They will receive an email invitation to join your private instance. Lofty users may be members of multiple private instances.

As the owner of this private instance, you may set up the permissions for the members you invite. Please see this article for more information on user permissions on a single-team platform Lofty account:

  • Permissions

The private instance will be a team that you are managing. Please be mindful as you invite others to the account.

Lead Organization

Your private instance add-on allows you full control of the lead organization. That is, you may not have had access to edit Lead Pipelines, Segments, or Sources in your primary account, but you do in your private instance. Please note that any leads that are in your primary account will not transfer to your private instance. While the accounts are connected via one login, they are treated as if they are completely separate accounts. For more information on the lead organization, please see the following Help Center articles:

  • Lead Organization with Tags
  • Lead Organization with Segments
  • Lead Organization with Filters
  • Lead Organization with Sources
  • Lead Organization with Pipeline Stages

Lead Capture and Lead Routing

If you have purchased the Private Instance Add-On with an IDX website, the website will be different from the website on your primary Enterprise Lofty account. When capturing leads via the Lofty website, the leads will be routed to the corresponding instance. That is, if a lead is captured on your Enterprise account website, the lead will be routed to your Enterprise instance. If a lead is captured on your private instance website, the lead will be routed to the private instance.

Lead Capture

For Zillow lead capture, you may select the instance in which new leads will be imported.

Your Unique Parsing Email Address will be different on each instance, so you may use that to send leads to a particular instance.

Primary Account:

Private Instance:

Lead Routing

You can also set up lead routing rules for your private instance. Please see our Help Center article for more information on setting up this feature:

  • Lead Routing Rules

Notifications

When accessing the account via lofty.com

  • Push notifications may be received from any instance
    • If the notification belongs to the currently logged-in instance, clicking the notification will direct to the destination
    • If the notification belongs to the instance that the user is not currently logged into, the notification will display the source information. Clicking the notification will direct the user to the destination
  • Notification Center:
    • The Lofty user can see the number of unread notifications for all non-logged-in instances
  • Mobile App
    • Push notifications will only be sent for the instance that the user is currently logged into
    • If non-logged-in instances have notifications, the number of unread notifications can be seen. The Lofty user must be logged in to that instance to see the notification details

Call and Text Packages

  • Calling/Texting Package
    • If the Calling/Texting Package buyer is also the Calling/Texting Package assigned agent, the Calling Package may be used on any instance the Lofty user has access to
    • If the Calling/Texting Package buyer is not the Calling/Texting Package assigned agent, the Calling Package may only be used on the Buyer's Lofty account instance
      • For example, if the Company Owner purchased the Calling/Texting Package for the Lofty user, it can only be used on the Company instance, not on a private instance
  • Company Number
    • The Company Number can only be used on the instance the Company Number belongs to
  • Personal Number
    • The Person Number can be used on any instance the Lofty User has access to
  • Call Package Settings
    • The bridge number and personal number are the same in any instance the Lofty user has access to
    • All other Call settings are independent of the different instances and are not synced with each other

Email

  • The user's Lofty Sending Email Address and Lead Capture Email Address will not be the same for different Lofty account instances
  • The integrated email address will be used on any instance the Lofty user has access to. We do not support integrating a different email address for a different instance
  • There will be no changes to the logic of sending/receiving emails
  • There will be no changes to the logic of syncing emails from the integrated emails

Other Add-Ons

All of the below add-ons will need to be re-purchased in different instances:

  • AI Assistant
  • Home Report
  • CMA
  • Social Studio Pro
  • Revaluate
  • Direct Mail
  • Agent Website
  • Vanity Domain
  • Lead Generation

Third-Party Integrations

Once the integration is complete, the following third-party accounts can be used in any instance:

  • Gmail, Office 365, IMAP/SMTP
  • Google Calendar, Outlook Calendar, Calendly
  • Slybroadcast
  • Google Contacts
  • BombBomb
  • Dotloop, Skyslope, Brokermint
  • Cloud CMA

Open API

Different instances have their API key. This key allows the Lofty user to get/create/update data in the specific instance

 

FAQs

Q: Can I purchase a Private Instance Add-on if I am using a Team structured Package?
A: No, Private Instance Add-On is an option available to Lofty users on an Enterprise account.

 

Q: How many Lead Pond is included in the Private Add-on?

A: One Lead Pond only.


Q: Is there an easy way to transfer a lead from a private instance add-on to the main account CRM?

A: Manual transfer.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

 

Related terms: Enterprise Private Instance Add-on, Private Instance Add-on

name: Feature Updates for Lofty 3.61
title: Feature Updates for Lofty 3.61
body:
Introduction

Important: Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons that you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/standard user). These features are subject to change at any time. Please see our Learning Center course on this update HERE. Having trouble accessing the course? This article will show you how to access the Lofty Learning Center: How to Access the Lofty Learning Center

Release Date

Monday, March 20th, 2023.

 

Summary

  • Lofty Private Instance Team Add-On
  • Language and Currency Add-On
  • Rename Appointment Organizer to Owner
  • Default Lead Routing Rule Optimization
  • Increase Lead and Transaction Note Fields
  • Company Number Source and Tag Addition
  • AI Blog Assistant (Beta Release)
  • Vimeo and Facebook Video Integration
  • New Lofty Website Template
  • Radius Search on Maps
  • Auto Property Alert Source Settings
  • Improved Home Report Cost Splitting
  • Lofty Support Lead Import Improvement
  • Zapier Transaction Integration

Lofty Private Instance Team Add-On

The Private Instance Team Add-On is an option available to Lofty users on an Enterprise account, which allows them to set up their own lead organization, such as the Pipeline and Segments, as well as set up their own lead routing rules. The Private Instance owner may invite other users to collaborate, as long as they are already members on the primary Enterprise account. Please see our article, Private Instance Team Add On, for more information. 

 

Language and Currency Add-On

The Language Translation and Currency Conversion add-on will allow you to automatically translate the language and convert the currency shown on your Lofty website and in your CRM. This is especially helpful if you service an international client base. The feature is a paid add-on that can be found in the Lofty Marketplace. This article will show you how it works and what it looks like for visitors to your Lofty website. Please see our article, Language Translation and Currency Conversion Add On, for more information. 

Rename Appointment Organizer to Owner

We have renamed the "Organizer" on the appointment to "Owner". This allows another Lofty user to "Organize" the appointment, without being the "Owner" of the appointment. For example, an assistant might be contacting leads and setting appointments, but the agent will be the owner of the appointment.

Default Lead Routing Rule Optimization

This update allows for the Default Lead Routing rule to assign leads to the Company Owner, Group Owner, Specific Agent, or Lead Pond. The options available will depend on the scope for which the lead routing rule is set. Reminder, Lofty users must have the Enterprise platform "Manage Lead Distribution" permission or the Team platform "Team Features" permission enabled to access the Lead Routing Rules.

Increase Lead and Transaction Note Fields

When adding notes to the lead profile or transaction, the notes field will expand for longer notes. Previously, a user could add 3 lines of text before needing to scroll to read more. With this optimization, the note field will expand to show 7 lines at once.

Company Number Source and Tag Addition

This new feature adds a Source and Tag that will display when an unknown number calls the account's Company Number and will list that Source and Tag for new leads who are captured via incoming call to the Company Number. An unlimited amount of Company Numbers may be purchased, but only one (1) Source and Tag may be added to the Company Number. This feature also allows the Ads team to create a Company Number to service Google Ads.

Adding a Source and Tag to the Company Number

To add a Source and Tag to the Company Number, first edit the Company Number

When a phone number that is not associated with a lead calls the Company Number, and is not answered by the Agent, the notification will have the following information:

  • Source: (Source added to Company Number)
  • Phone Number:(Phone number that called)
  • An option to click to add as a new lead or associate with an existing lead
    • If this is being added as a New Lead, the lead's Source will be the Source applied to the Company Number and the Tag will be added to the lead's profile
    • If this is being associated with an existing lead, which already has a Source, the Source applied to the Company Number will be added to the lead's profile as a Tag and the Tag will be also be added to the lead's profile as a Tag
      • Reminder: A Lead may have many Tags, but only one (1) Source

Please see Company Number for more information on the Company Number.

Google Local Service Ads (Google LSA)

When a Lofty user purchases Google Local Service Ads, they need a company number to receive calls. Lofty will provide a company number for free with the purchase of the LSA service. After purchasing the ad service, Lofty will apply the Company Number to the account. Each user may only purchase one (1) Google LSA Ads package at a time.

When the Company Number is added, there are certain limitations on that Company Number in the User's CRM:

  • Any Lofty user may purchase the Google LSA service. However, only Admins have access to navigate to Settings → Dialer → Manage Dialer. Once the Company Number has been added for the user in Admin Backend, the Company Number interface will be visible, but the list will show only the applied Company Number, not any other Company Numbers, and this Company Number will only be visible to this user.
  • If the Lofty user can see the Company Number interface (i.e. is an Admin), the Google LSA Company Number will be at the bottom of the list of all visible Company Numbers, and this Company Number will only be visible to this user.
  • The Source and Tag applied on the admin backend will be :
    • Source: Lofty Paid Lead 
    • Tag: Google LSA
  • When the Source and Tag are filled in the Admin Backend, they cannot be edited by the user. 

AI Blog Assistant (Beta Release)

We are excited to announce the launch of our latest feature, the ChatGPT-powered AI Blog Assistant, specifically designed for real estate professionals. This powerful tool harnesses the capabilities of ChatGPT to help you create engaging blog posts to promote your listings and reach your target audience.

Effortless Blog Generation

With this new feature, you can effortlessly generate a blog post to promote a listing by simply selecting a property. The AI Blog Assistant will create a well-crafted blog post with a title, emphasizing the property's key features and appealing to potential buyers.

Tailor-Made Content

If you prefer a more customized approach, you can request Blog Assistant to write a blog post by providing a title, tags, and bullet points. Our AI system will use the information you provide to create a professional and engaging blog post that resonates with your target audience.

Continuous Development

This is the first feature we've released that utilizes ChatGPT, and our team is actively researching and developing additional tools to further enhance your real estate efforts. Keep an eye out for updates and improvements as we continue to innovate in this space.

 

We are offering 10 free trial uses for every website owner. This limited-time offer allows you to experience the benefits of AI-driven content creation and evaluate the tool's effectiveness in promoting your listings.

There are two (2) ways to access this feature:

  1. CMS Overview
  2. Blog Page

We offer two (2) different types of blogs:

  1. Feature a Listing
    1. The user selects a listing to market and the related listing information will be used to generate a blog post.
  2. General Blog
    1. The user provides a title and a few keywords, and the AI will write a blog post based on that information.

For both blog types, the user will select a length. The lengths are rough estimates, not an exact number of words:

  • Short = ~ 300 words
  • Medium = ~ 500 words
  • Long = ~ 700 words

Important: The window cannot be closed while the blog is being written. It takes 15-20 seconds to generate a blog post. If the user closes the window before it is complete, the blog will not be written and they will have used up one of their ten (10) allowed blog posts

Note: For WordPress Blog users we are not offering AI Blog Writing Assistant service so we encourage our users to try Lofty Blog. 

Vimeo and Facebook Video Integration

This update supports Vimeo and Facebook videos in the Lofty website video block.

New Lofty Website Template

Lofty's 7th website template was launched on March 7. This template is a simple black-and-white theme. This template features new Home and About pages and is largely the 5th template, re-done in black and white. Editing this template is the same as any other website template.

 

Radius Search on Maps

This feature will allow a Lofty user or a visitor to a Lofty website to select a search area by radius, in addition to the polygon search. When "Radius" is selected, the user provides an address and a 1-mile radius will appear by default. The radius may be expanded up to 10 miles.

The radius search is also available in the Listings Discovery page:

As well as on the Lofty website listing pages:

Auto Property Alert Source Settings

The new setting allows users to deactivate Automated Property Alerts, Market Snapshots, and Market Reports, based on the lead's Source. Checking the box next to the source will deactivate that Source for these automated alerts. That is, leads from that Source will not receive the alert emails. The user can select different Sources for each of these three types of alerts. That is, if a Source is excluded from Property Alerts, it will not automatically be excluded from Market Snapshots or Market Reports.

Improved Home Report Cost Splitting

This update allows Lofty users to split the cost of Home Report with a lender via the marketplace when the Lofty user has already bought the package on their own.

Splitting Costs with a Lender

  • When the cost split request is made, the Lender has 2 days to approve of the cost split. If the Lender does not approve, the agent will be charged the full amount.
  • If the agent is upgrading the package and inviting a Lender to split costs, the package will be upgraded immediately and the agent will pay the difference themselves. For example:
    1. If the Agent is on the Starter Home Report package and paying themselves, they are currently paying $59/month
    2. If this Agent wants to upgrade to the Basic Home Report package and split the cost with a Lender, the Agent will pay $40 now to upgrade ($99 - $59)
    3. Next pay period (the first of the next month), if the Lender has approved, the Agent and the Lender will each pay $49.50

Lofty Support Lead Import Improvement

This update allows all Lofty users to request Lofty tech support assistance with Lead Import for the first 30 days they are a member of their Lofty account.

Zapier Transaction Integration

This update supports Transaction-related synchronization with third parties via Zapier.

Lofty → Zapier Use Lofty as a Trigger

Lofty can synchronize the following fields to other third-party providers:

  • Basic Information

    • Transaction Name

    • Transaction Type
    • Transaction Stage
    • Associated Lead's Name
    • Associated Lead's Email
    • Associated Lead's Phone
    • Transaction Owner's ID
    • Transaction Owner's Name
    • Transaction Owner's Email
    • Close Price
    • Commission Rate
    • GCI
    • Team Revenue
    • Agent Revenue
  • Property Details
    • Property Address
    • Property Unit
    • Property Listing Status
    • Property MLS Listing ID
    • Property Label
    • Property List Price
    • Property Property Type
    • Property Bedrooms
    • Property Bathrooms
    • Property Square Feet
    • Property Lot Size (Sqft)
    • Property Note
  • Dates (Format: mm/dd/yyyy)
    • Close Date
    • Expected Close
    • Appointment Date
    • Agreement Signed Date
    • Offer Date
    • Contract Date
    • Appraisal Date
    • Home Inspection Date
    • Escrow Date
    • Expiration Date
  • Custom Fields

Zapier → Lofty Use Lofty as an Action

Lofty will add a “Create Transaction” Action to allow third-party providers to create and update the following Transaction fields on Lofty:

  • Transaction Name(Required)
  • Lead First Name(Required)
  • Lead Last Name
  • Associated Lead Email
  • Transaction Owner Email(Required)
  • Transaction Type(Required)
  • Transaction Stage
  • Close Price
  • GCI
  • Team Revenue
  • Agent Revenue
  • Timezone(Date will be converted to the set of time zone)
  • System Dates：
    • Closed Date
    • Expected Close
    • Appointment Date
    • Agreement Signed Date
    • Offer Date
    • Contract Date
    • Appraisal Date
    • Home Inspection Date
    • Escrow Date
    • Expiration Date
  • Custom Fields
  • Property
    • Property Address
    • Property Unit
    • Property Listing Status
    • Property MLS Listing ID  
    • Property Label
    • Property List Price
    • Property Type
    • Property Bedrooms
    • Property Bathrooms
    • Property Square Feet
    • Property Lot Size (Sqft)
    • Property Note

Logic

  • Parsing is supported for the following date format：

    • yyyy-mm-dd：2001-08-24

    • mm/dd/yy：08/24/01

    • mm-dd-yy：08-24-01

    • dd/mm/yyyy：24/08/2001

    • Apr 11, 2022

    • dd.mm.yyyy ：24.08.2001

  • Sync Logic:
    • First, find whether the transaction owner's email is an existing team member
      • If not, the transaction sync will fail
      • If yes, then check to see if the same lead (by email) is assigned to the transaction owner.
        • If yes, then the transaction will be created for this lead, or if this transaction already exists on this lead, update the transaction.
        • If not, Lofty will create the lead as a team lead, assign it to the transaction owner first, and then create the transaction for the lead. 

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Property Tour
title: Property Tour
body:
Introduction

The Property Tour tool allows Lofty users to create listing showing itineraries for potential home buyers and renters. This tool allows you to set the meeting time and location, as well as all the homes on the tour, and calculates the estimated travel time between each stop. If the lead has created a profile on your Lofty website, they are able to view the tour itinerary there and leave feedback for all of the homes they tour.

 

Summary

  • Setting up the Property Tour
    • From the Calendar
    • From the Listings Page
    • From the Lead Profile
  • Edit Property Tour
  • The Lead Experience

Setting up the Property Tour

From the Calendar

Navigate to the Lofty calendar, click + Create, and select Add Property Tour

A pop-up will prompt you to select the lead that is taking the tour. Enter their information here to find the lead in the CRM.

Once the lead has been selected, you may start planning the tour. Click Start Planning to begin.

Click Add Listing to add homes to the property tour. Don't forget to also set a meeting location and time. If you need to change the order of the listings on the tour, click and hold the three-line icons to drag and drop the listings into their new order.


You can freely adjust the arrival time at each listing for more flexible planning. The tool will only prompt you when there is a time gap or overlap. Additionally, the refresh button has been enabled to recalculate the shortest time.

Click the three dots icon to contact the listing agent, view the listing details, or delete the listing from the tour.

By default, the tour will begin at 8 AM the following day. The tour will be added to your Lofty calendar, so please remember to schedule the correct time and date. The default time spent at each listing is 30 minutes, but can be as long as 2 hours. The tour will fail to generate if there are more than 10 listings on the tour and if the tour lasts longer than 24 hours.

Once the tour has been saved, you have the option to view the tour and email the tour to the lead. When sending the email, the template is pre-written and can be edited before sending. Be sure to click Confirm to save the tour.

From the Listings Page

Navigate to Listings and check the box next to at least one listing. Once the box is checked, click Create Property Tour to get started.

Next, the selected listings will be added to the tour and you will be prompted to select the lead for the tour.

Once the lead is selected, you have the opportunity to edit the tour. Again, remember to set your starting location, time, and date.

From the Lead Profile

Navigate to the lead's profile and select Create Property Tour from the menu in the three-dot icon.

Next, you may begin building the tour, the same as described above.

 

Edit Property Tour

When a property tour has been scheduled with a lead, the tour will be available in the Appointments section of the lead profile.

Click the '...' menu to see the Property Tour Options.

Click Edit to change the Property Tour. This will open the tour and you can rearrange the tour order, delete the listing from the tour, and add another listing to the tour. 

The Lead Experience

If the lead has set up a profile on your Lofty website, they can view any scheduled and completed tours in the My Tours & Showings section of their account. The lead is also able to provide feedback on the listings they tour. This feedback will be available to view on the lead's profile in the Lofty CRM.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Feature Updates for Lofty 3.60
title: Feature Updates for Lofty 3.60
body:
Introduction

Important: Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons that you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/standard user). These features are subject to change at any time.

 

Please view our training content for these updates in our Learning Center

 

For any questions related to your Lofty package or feature availability, please contact Lofty Support (support@lofty.com). 

 

Release Date

Monday, February 27th, 2023.

 

Summary

  • Listing Video Optimization
  • 2 Factor Authentication
  • MLS Agent ID Optimization
  • Buyer Tour
  • Social Studio Team
  • New Automated Email Templates
  • Email Template Folders
  • AI Assistant Cooling Period
  • Website Subdomain Creation
  • Re-marketing Ads
  • Closely App Optimization

All Features

Listing Video Optimization

This is an update to the Auto-Generated Listing Video feature, which was released in beta with Lofty v3.54, noted HERE. With this update, we have increased the number of listing videos that can be created:

  • Social Studio Pro users: Generate unlimited listing videos without watermarks

  • All other Lofty users: Generate unlimited listing videos with watermarks

  • A maximum of 10 listing videos can be generated per user per day

The watermark will look like this:

 

MLS Agent ID Optimization

We have optimized the user experience when adding the MLS agent ID to the user profile. This is different from the MLS application. This is for agents that need to add their own MLS ID for MLSs that have already been approved and are active on their accounts.

After clicking 'Add Agent ID', a pop-up will prompt the user to select the MLS they are providing the Agent Id for. MLSs that are approved and active on the Lofty account will be available.

After selecting the MLS, the user will be prompted to enter their Agent Id.

Buyer Tour

This is a new feature that allows Lofty users to set up a listing tour for home buyers. There are three (3) ways to set up the Buyer Tour:

1. Calendar

2. Listings

3. Lead Profile

For complete instructions on how to set up a Buyer Tour, please see this Help Center article.

Social Studio Team

Social Studio Team is a new additional to our Social Studio. This package offers all the benefits of Social Studio Pro, and also allows you to connect up to 5 social media profiles per channel. For an additional $10/month, you can connect 5 more social studio profiles. There is no limit to the number of profiles that can be added.

To upgrade to the Social Studio Team package, navigate to Campaigns -> Social Studio, click the "Settings" icon, and select "Manage Package".

Here, you will see your current Social Studio package, as well as the packages that are available for upgrade. If you would like to downgrade your Social Studio package, please reach out to Lofty support.

Once upgraded to Social Studio Team, that user can connect multiple social media profiles to one account. This does not extend a social studio license to other members on their accounts. If the user wants to post to others' social media, it will need to be connected to the Lofty account with Social Studio Team enabled.

When creating a social media post, the user is able to select which profile to post to:

New Automated Email Templates

This update introduces a few more email templates to the Automated Email section of the Lofty CRM. To view these templates, navigate to the Automated Email Templates by clicking Settings → Email → Automated Emails. They have been added to the Welcome Email and Double Opt-In Email sections and address automated emails for lead type Buyer & Seller, Renter, and Other. 

Welcome Emails

Click "Show All" to see the new email templates.

Double Opt-In Emails

Email Template Folders

We have restructured the email template section by adding folders, which will make it easier to organize your email templates. This can be found by navigating to Settings → Email → My Email Templates.

All Lofty users have the ability to add 'My Folder', but users must have the following permission enabled to create a 'Team Folder' or a 'Group Folder':

  • Enterprise:
    • Manage Templates - Entire Company: Can create Folders for the entire company
    • Manage Templates - User's Group: Can create Folders for their group
  • Team platforms:
    • Manage Templates: Can create Team Folders

Enterprise Platform:

Team Platform:

If users do not have the permission enabled, they can only create 'My Folder':

All users can see and search by folders that they have created in 'My Folders' as well as 'Team Folders' that have been shared with them, by clicking the dropdown menu:

When creating a new email template, you have the option to select which folder the template belongs in. The template does not have to be put in a folder.

Users may also click the Settings Cog Wheel next to an existing template to move it into a folder:

When adding an email template to a Smart Plan or when emailing a lead, the email template can be searched by Folder:

AI Assistant Cooling Period

The AI Assistant has been adjusted to be less pushy to leads that are less responsive. 

Old Logic:

If a new lead registered on the Lofty website, the AI Assistant would send a welcome text message to the lead. If the lead did not reply to the AI Assistant's text message, but still is active on the website, such as saving a listing, the AI Assistant would send another text message immediately.

New Logic:

If a new lead registers on the Lofty website, the AI Assistant will send a welcome text message to the lead. However, if the lead does not reply to the AI Assistant's text message, but still is active on the website, such as saving a listing, the AI Assistant will wait one hour before sending another text message.

Website Subdomain Creation

This update applies to Enterprise accounts that are creating Subdomain websites. A Subdomain website is a carbon copy of its parent website, which is either a Company or Group website. When a change is made to the parent website, it is also made to the Subdomains that are built from that website. This update allows a user to change the Subdomain website's parent site. This will change not only the domain itself but will also change the look of the Subdomain site to mirror its new parent site.

 

To update the Subdomain's parent website, navigate to CMS Tool → Select the Subdomain website → Settings → Subdomain

Re-marketing Ads

A new marketing option to market specifically to leads that are already in your database will be available in the Marketplace:

You must have an active Lofty website to utilize the Re-marketing ads. When purchasing the ads, you

will set up your monthly budget, listing areas, and billing start date. You will also see your potential results, similar to any lead gen campaign. There are two options to select the target audience:

  1. Select the lead conditions: 
    1. Filter leads by pipeline, segment, source, or tag
  2. Upload a csv file
    1. The file must contain first name, last name, phone number, e-mail address for the leads.

These ads run through Facebook, so you will be prompted to connect to your Facebook page.

The management fee = 20% of the budget

Closely App Optimization

A few optimizations are launching for the Closely app.

  1. Leads can provide Closely app feedback by navigating to the Profile Tab → Feedback. The feedback will be sent directly to Lofty to help us improve the app's functionality. 

  2. The center point of the map will default to a location based on the MLS configuration on the Lofty site.

  3. Supports switching the display mode of saved searches from List to Map.

name: Text Subscription Message and Permission to Contact
title: Text Subscription Message and Permission to Contact
body:
Introduction

*IMPORTANT: This article is for informational purposes only and does not substitute consultation with appropriate legal counsel regarding this topic. It is your responsibility to comply with federal, state, local, or other laws and regulations related to all outgoing communication. 

The Text Subscription Message and Permission to Contact features are tools that exist on the Lofty platform to assist you in complying with regulations governing telephone communication. 

Lofty has these features to help you avoid sending unwanted communications to your leads. This article addresses how a lead's Call and Text opt-in status is determined.

Summary

  • Text Subscription Message
  • Permission to Contact

Text Subscription Message

Lofty users can only send text messages from Lofty via a virtual phone number. Regulations require that consumers should be able to easily opt-out or unsubscribe from receiving text messages from a business.

Navigate to Personal Settings > Communication > Call & Text > Info & Settings and scroll to the bottom of the page to see the text subscription message.

You are only able to edit your name and your business name.

Text Subscription Logic

The Text Subscription Message will be sent to leads following a text message that meets the following criteria:

  1. The first time the lead is texted
  2. When the lead is texted after having not communicated via text message in the last three (3) months.
    • This is a rolling 3 months, so for example, if the lead is texted for the first time on August 1, they will receive the text subscription message.
    • If the lead is texted or texting back regularly, they will never see this message again.
    • If the lead is not texted again until after November 1, they will receive the text subscription message again.

The lead will be unsubscribed from receiving text messages and they will be opted out of receiving text messages if the lead responds at any time with the following in a message alone (i.e. not if these words are contained in a sentence):

  • Unsubscribe
  • Stop
  • Cancel
  • End
  • Quit

The lead can be manually opted back into receiving text messages by you.

Unsubscribe Confirmation Text

Once the lead has unsubscribed, the following confirmation message will be auto-sent:

  • "You have successfully been unsubscribed. You will not receive any more messages from this number. Reply START to resubscribe.”

If the lead responds with "Start", they will be opted back into receiving text messages.

 

Permission to Contact

The permission to contact is a separate feature from the Do Not Contact List, however, it does provide a similar function. If a lead has opted out of allowing contact via call or text, you will not be able to call or text the lead.

Permission to Contact Settings

The Permission to Contact setting is located in the pop-up when a new lead is added and also in the pop-up when a lead is edited.

By default, when you manually add a new lead, the Permission to Contact is set to No for calling, texting, and emailing.

Lead Import

When importing leads, you may select to match the Call Opt-in and Text Opt-in status in the mapping stage. You can also set the Call and Text Opt-in status for all leads being imported, on the final screen. By default, when leads are imported, the Permission to Contact will be set to No. 

Call/Text/Email Opt-In Status in Lead Capture Settings

Navigate to Settings → Lead Capture → Lead Capture Settings

This setting will allow the user to decide if leads coming from certain sources should be opted in or out of calls, texts, and emails:

Note: This setting does not verify that the leads' information is valid. By default, this setting will be toggled On for all sources. If there is a source that is not providing reliable lead data, we recommend toggling Off for that source.


Updating Contact Permission

You can update the Permission to Contact settings manually. When you do, you will be asked to double confirm when changing the status from Opt-Out to Opt-In. When the AI Assistant detects a DNC hint in the conversations with leads, it will stop texting the lead, but will not update the Text Opt-in Status to Opt-Out.

 

Default Contact Permission Value for Lead Channels

We have set default Contact Permission settings for lead capture channels

  • Lofty website, Open House Forms, Text Codes, and QR Codes:
    • Call Opt-in, Text Opt-in： ON （Allows calling and texting by default)
  • Manually Adding Leads and Lead Import:
    • Call Opt-in, Text Opt-in： OFF (Does not allow calling and texting by default)
  • Third-Party Lead Capture, Email Parsing, and Open API:
    • Call Opt-in, Text Opt-in： ON （Allows calling and texting by default)

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

 

Related terms: Do not Contact, DNC, Opt-in, Opt-out

name: Feature Updates for Lofty 3.59
title: Feature Updates for Lofty 3.59
body:
Introduction

Important: Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons that you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/standard user). These features are subject to change at any time.

 

Please view our training content for these updates in our Learning Center

 

For any questions related to your Lofty package or feature availability, please contact Lofty Support (support@lofty.com). 

 

Release Date

Tuesday, January 17th, 2023.

 

Summary

  • Enterprise Account Permission Update
  • Lead Source Logic Update
    • Sources Auto-Creation Logic
    • Sources Filter Changes
  • Lead Segment Logic Update
    • Editing the Lead Segments
    • Reminder Period
  • Lead Tag Management
    • Standard User Tag Library
    • Team/Company Filter Enabled Tag Library
  • Agent Time Last Active Optimization
  • AI Assistant Notification Optimization
  • Listing Ads Budget Upgrade
    • Editing the budget after purchase but before setting up the listing ads
    • Editing the budget when an ad is active
  • Boost Post Retargeting Audience
  • Website Integration Configuration Optimization
  • Closely App Download Guides
    • What is the Closely App?
    • How to Enable

 

All Features

Enterprise Account Permission Update

For Enterprise accounts, the "Company Filter" feature is now split to allow access to Sources, Tags, Pipelines, and Lead Segments separately.

 

Lead Source Logic Update

We have removed the option to Edit sources. Instead, users should create a new Source and when deleting the old source, assign the leads under that Source to the newly created Source.

Sources Auto-Creation Logic

  • Affect Scope

    • Enterprise Structure

    • Team Structure

  • Auto assigns system sources for leads that are created by Users who do not have the source manage permission

    • Default System Source

      • Open API

      • Email Parsing

      • Lead Import

      • Lead Capture

      • Text Code

      • Other

    • The customized sources attached with the leads will be added as tags.

Sources Filter Changes

  • Changes the "All Source" option to "Any Source" in the following:

    • AI Assistant

    • Revaluate

    • Auto home report

    • Lead Routing

    • Smart plan source

  • Keeps the "All Source" option as a quick selection for all current sources in the following:

    • People page/Source Filter

    • Listing discover/Select leads/Source Filter

    • Transaction/More Filter/Source

    • Lead Export

This may seem like a simple language change, however, this will capture Any Source, regardless of what Enterprise Account Group the user is in.

Lead Segment Logic Update

 

For Enterprise accounts, this permission update will allow users to create and manage Lead Segments for their individual Account Groups.

Selecting 'Entire Company' allows the user to create/edit/delete Company level lead segments.

Selecting 'User's Group' allows the user to create/edit/delete lead segments at that user's Group level.

Note: The lead segment cannot be used at the subgroup level.

Editing the Lead Segments

The logic for editing the Lead Segments has changed a bit for all Lofty account types. 

Any user with the 'Segments & Tags' permission enabled will now have a settings cog wheel icon to edit the Segments. Company level segments have the building icon next to them. Group level segments have no icon.

Note: The Company Admin/Owner can only see the Segments that are in the Company level. They cannot see Group level segments. Any segments the Company admins create will be Company level segments. Group Admin/Owners can see the Company level segments, as well as their own Group level segments. They cannot see other Group's segments.

Example of the Segment editing page, from a Group Owner perspective:

Rather than a pop-up screen, the entire screen is now available for editing Lead Segments for all Lofty account types.

Adding a new Segment looks the same, regardless of the type of Lofty account:

If a user is deleted from the Lofty account, or changes User Groups, any Lead Segments they have previously created will not be affected and can still be used by the User Group the Lead Segment was created for.

Reminder Period

We have also optimized the Reminder Period. The Reminder Period is that red dot that will appear next to leads. This is meant to be a reminder that the lead has not been contacted in the specified period of time. 

  1. When unchecked: Only manual actions will count as lead contacts

  2. When checked: Both automatic and manual actions will count as lead contacts

Lead Tag Management

This feature allows Enterprise users to create and manage lead tags for their groups. The permissions are the same as the Segment permission, outlined above.

This is also an update to Tag Logic: Private and Shared tags are no more!

  1. Selecting 'Entire Company' means the users:

    1. Have Company Tag Management library

    2. Can create/delete/lock Company level Lead Tag Library.

  2. Selecting 'User's Group' means the users:

    1. Have Group Tag Management library

    2. Can create/delete/lock Group level Lead Tag Library.

  3. Every agent has their own tag library, and only they can add/edit/delete the tag themselves.

    1. The tags in the personal library will sync from the user's group and all higher-level groups' tag library.

  4. For Non-Enterprise accounts, the permission to access Tag Management is 'Team Filter'
  5. If a Tag already exists in Tag Management, it cannot be duplicated, regardless of who initially created the Tag.

Standard User Tag Library

Lofty users who do not have a Team/Company Filter enabled will see the above Tag Library. Here, they can see their own Tags, as well as Tags in the Company/Group Levels above them. They also have the option to edit or delete any unlocked tags. This will only affect the Tag on their own account.

Team/Company Filter Enabled Tag Library

Lofty users who do have the Team/Company Filter enabled will see the above Tag Library. Here, they can add their own personal Tags in the Tag library by clicking "+Add New" above. When clicking Tag Management, they can manage Tags that are seen by the Entire Company or their own User Group, depending on their permission level.

The lock icon keeps users from editing or deleting this Tag from their own libraries. By default, when new Lead Tags are added, they will be unlocked, so make sure you lock any Lead Tags that you do not want to be edited in your users' own Tag Libraries.

 

Agent Time Last Active Optimization

This feature allows admins to see when users on their account have last logged into Lofty.

The user's last log in time has been recalculated to be more accurate and we have added a filter, so admins can sort by when users last logged in.

Permissions:

In order to see the Last Active filter, a user must have the following permission enabled.

  • Enterprise: Manage User, Entire Company
  • Enterprise: Manage User, User's Group
  • Non-Enterprise: Manage User

AI Assistant Notification Optimization

This feature allows users to receive a push notification when a lead responds to the AI Assistant.

This notification is only sent once if the same lead replies multiple times within the same day.


Notification Content:
Your lead [lead's name] ([lead's number]) has responded to a message from the AI Assistant: [message]"

 

Listing Ads Budget Upgrade

This feature allows users to increase their ad budget within their Lofty CRM.

Editing the budget after purchase but before setting up the listing ads

  • If the user updates the budget, the amount of the difference between the new and old budgets will be charged.

    1. Only allows upgrade (no lower than original budget)

  • For the $99 package, we allow edits to both the start and end date

  • For $199 package, do not allow choosing end date. The end date should be start date + 14 days

Editing the budget when an ad is active

  • Click the edit icon, jump out the pop-up window

  • If the user upgrades the budget, the amount of the difference between the new and old budgets will be charged.

    1. Only allow upgrade (no lower than original budget)

    2. The budget should be no lower than $5 per day for both packages

Boost Post Retargeting Audience

This feature allows users to select existing leads for Boost Post retargeting.

The user process is：

  • Click "Select Existing Leads"

  • Jump to lead list

  • Filter the target leads

  • Navigate back to boost post popup

  • Show the chosen lead count

 

Website Integration Configuration Optimization

This is an improved user interface on the website integrations page. Now, all website Integrations will be listed on one page, with a bit of information about each one.

Consumer Account Page Updates

We have updated the Lead interface when they have registered as a Seller Lead on the Lofty website.

  1. Add Lead Image
    1. A random background color will be added, with the lead's first name initial
  2. My Home
    1. Here, the lead will provide information about the home they currently own

There are four display cards for the different stages of a home:

  1. Home Valuation Card (Stage 1)
    1. Display Condition: There is a search record from the lead on the Home Valuation page or My Home page.

    2. Display information: The basic info (home image, address, etc.) and the estimated home price.

    3. Actions:

      1. Click the card: Open the home valuation result page

      2. See my home equity: Open the home valuation result page and pop up a questionnaire to let the lead fill in the mortgage details.

      3. Request a CMA

      4. Sell my home

      5. Delete
  2. Home Valuation Card (Stage 2)

    1. Display Condition: The lead had completed the mortgage questionnaire in stage 1.

    2. Display information: The basic info(home image, address, etc.), the estimated home price, home equity, monthly payment.

    3. Actions:

      1. Click the card: Open the home valuation result page

      2. Request Home Report

      3. Request a CMA

      4. Sell my home

      5. Delete
  3. Home Report Card

      1. Display Condition: The agent added a home report to the lead.

      2. Display information: The basic info(home image, address, etc.), the estimated home price, home equity, monthly payment, rises and falls.

      3. Actions:

        1. Request a CMA

        2. Sell my home

        3. See Value Trend: Open the Home Report page and anchor to the Value Trend part.

        4. Financial Options: Open the Home Report page and anchor to the Mortgage part.

        5. Delete
  4. Seller Report

    1. Display Condition: Can only be synchronized in, leads cannot add it.

    2. Display information: The basic info(home image, address, etc.), Listing status, Traffic data(View, favorite, potential buyers, matched buyers), listing price, listed date.

    3. Actions:

      1. Chat with agent: Open the chatbox (If the site enables the chatbox)

      2. Check listing traffic: Open the Seller Report page and anchor to the traffic part.

      3. View sales activity: Open the Seller Report page and anchor to the activity part.

      4. Public view: Open the listing detail page.

      5. Delete

Closely App Download Guides

Closely App download links added to Lofty websites and welcome emails

What is the Closely App?

Closely is a lead-facing mobile app that can be used to search for houses. Anyone can download the Closely app, but the login credentials are the same as what a lead would use to log into a Lofty website. Closely is currently in Beta for the following MLSs:

  1. RealTracs IDX
  2. Knoxville Area Association of Realtors (KAAR MLS)
  3. Rim County MLS (RCMLS)
  4. Greater Chattanooga Association of Realtors (GCAR MLS)
  5. Georgia MLS (GAMLS)
  6. REBNY
  7. Real Estate Information Network (REIN)
  8. North Texas Real Estate Info Systems (NTREIS)
  9. Bright
  10. Realtors Association of Edmonton (RAE)
  11. Canadian Real Estate Association (CREA)
  12. Real Estate Board of Greater Vancouver (REBGV VOW)
  13. Real Estate Board of Greater Vancouver (REBGV)

How to Enable

To set this up on a Lofty website, navigate to CMS→ Settings → Closely App

This setting controls all Closely App download links/QR codes on the website and in the welcome email.

The Closely App download guides will appear in several places. This is an all or nothing option and the wording is not editable.

Footer

Header

Widget

Welcome Email

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Sending Email Domain
title: Sending Email Domain
body:
Introduction

Team/Group/Company Owners with the "Manage User" permission can now choose to manage the sending email domain to ensure it has higher chances of deliverability and/or better reflects their brand. The default option that is assigned as the sending domain is __________@lofty.house but because so many people are using this domain, its deliverability can be hit or miss. Most users who have configured a domain on their website will be using that domain as their sending domain as well. After changing from the _________@lofty.house domain, that domain cannot be used again in the future.


Summary

  • [Onboarding] Email Domain Step
  • Email Domain Management and Self- Purchase 
  • Sending Email Domain Configuration
  • FAQs

 

[Onboarding] Email Domain Step

Add the “Email Domain” Step on Goal 3 Communication Setup, only if you are the owner.

If your Email domain vendor is Godaddy, when you click “Configure now”, will display this popup. You can choose whether to use this email domain to receive Emails.

 

If you want to use this email domain to receive Emails, there will pop up a one-click integration window.

If not, will pop up an instruction window. 

If your Email domain vendor is another third party, when you click “Configure now”, we will display this instruction pop-up, which will remind you whether to use this email domain to receive Emails.

 

Email Domain Management and Self-Purchase 

This feature is accessed by navigating to Settings> Communication> Email> Email Settings> Manage. 

You will then have access to choose from the following:

  1. Domains available for no additional cost
  2. Domains already configured for your Lofty website
  3. Domains purchased from Lofty

When accessing this setting from a Team-type account, you will see the following two options:

  1. Apply to the entire team
  2. Apply to just yourself



When accessing this setting from an Enterprise-type account, you will see the following two options:

  1. Apply to specific group hierarchy at the current level or below
  2. Apply to just yourself

 

SET UP PROCESS: 

  • YOUR DOMAIN

1. Click the NEW DOMAIN button on the upper right corner, then select the option "Already own your domain?" and click next.


2. Enter your preferred domain without "www", click the "Next" button, then "Continue".

 

3. Follow the steps as shown below simultaneously with the configuration steps provided in the Domain Configuration Guide.

  • NEW DOMAIN

1. Click the NEW DOMAIN button in the upper right corner, then select the option "Want to purchase a new domain?" and click next.

2. Enter your preferred domain without "www" and click the search button.

3. Available domain/s will be shown if there are any. Click the confirm button to proceed after choosing your preferred result.

4. You will be directed to the Review and Pay page where you need to agree to the Terms and Conditions and Privacy Policy to place the order.

If you want to configure a new domain, you can choose to use one you already have or purchase a new one via Lofty. You will then be guided through the next steps provided in the Sending Email Domain Configuration section below. If a member wants to set up a new email domain similar to his/her domain. You can also check this article for more information: Sending Email Address

 

After adding a new domain, it may require some time before it will be listed as "Active" and therefore usable. Until it is usable, it will be listed as "Pending." Come back to this setting later to finish selecting your new domain.

 

Sending Email Domain Configuration

If you want to configure a new sending email domain, you can choose to use one you already have or purchase a new one via Lofty. You will then be guided through the next steps.

 

  1. Log in to your domain provider's portal. (Not sure who your provider is? Click here.)
  2. Go to the domains page on your domain host's site.
  3. Find where you manage the domain's settings. (Look for a button or link with the words manage, manage settings, domain settings, or something similar.)
  4. In your domain settings, find the area where you manage or edit DNS server records.

5. Add our records to your DNS

  • A Records

Enter the information as shown below:

Then choose Yes, then click Save.
The name will be parsed into the correct format by the system.
Then add another A Record.
This completes the A records part.

Tips: If your DNS contains the A records below, you don't need to add the A records above, just keep it as is.

MX Records 

NOTE: SKIP THIS STEP IF YOU HAVE ALREADY PAID FOR THE EMAIL FOR THIS DOMAIN

Tips: If your DNS contains other platforms' MX records something like the below image, then we strongly DO NOT recommend configuring this domain as your sending email domain anymore. Doing so may break your original email service.




  • Add the MX Records as shown below:
  •  Enter the values as shown below:
  • Then choose Yes, then click Save.
  • The name will be parsed into the correct format by the system.
  • Then add another MX Record.
  • Your MX records are now all set.

CNAME Records

  • Add the CNAME as shown below:
  • Add all CNAMES

Then choose Yes, then click Save.

Your CNAME is now all set.

TXT Records

  • Add the TXT Record as shown below: 
  • Add all records.


  • Then choose Yes, and click Save.  Add All TXT Records.
  1. Congratulations, you have completed all the configuration processes！ Propagation time may vary depending on the provider, then you may use this domain.

 

 

FAQs

Q: Why am I not seeing the values of each record required when I click the steps for configuration?

A: Each record sample should auto-populate once you click the step in the configuration guide if this is not happening, contact Support to fix the bug.

 

Q: How long does it take for the email configuration to take effect?

A: The sending email domain configuration typically takes effect within 24 to 48 hours after adding the necessary DNS records. The exact time can vary depending on the DNS propagation.

 

Q: My domain doesn't have the necessary SPF record, or I need to combine records. What do I do?
A: Great question! 

SPF & Email Deliverability Overview

If you're using Lofty to send property alerts, drip campaigns, or other automated emails to leads, your domain must be properly authorized. Without the correct SPF setup, your emails may be blocked, bounced, or sent to spam folders — hurting deliverability and engagement.

 

Why SPF Matters

SPF (Sender Policy Framework) is a DNS record that tells receiving mail servers which systems are allowed to send email on behalf of your domain.

When Lofty sends emails using Amazon SES, you need to explicitly authorize it via your domain’s SPF record.

 

If You Use Lofty + Business Email (e.g., Gmail or Microsoft)

Most teams use their domain for both:

  • Business email (Google Workspace or Microsoft 365)
  • Marketing email via Lofty (Amazon SES)

Because only one SPF TXT record is allowed per domain, you’ll need to combine both systems into a single record.

Examples:

Using Google Workspace + Lofty:

v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com include:amazonses.com ~all

Using Microsoft 365 + Lofty:

v=spf1 include:spf.protection.outlook.com include:amazonses.com ~all

Start with your existing SPF record and merge in include:amazonses.com before the ending tag (~all or -all).

 

How to Update Your DNS TXT Record

name: Scheduled Emails
title: Scheduled Emails
body:
Introduction

Lofty allows users to schedule both individual and mass emails in the CRM. This is not available in the mobile app. 

 

How to schedule an email

Whenever any email is being sent via the Lofty web app platform, there is a button to schedule the email:

When clicked, a menu will appear to select when the email is sent:

  • Tomorrow morning
  • Tomorrow afternoon
  • Custom date/time

Once an email has been scheduled, it can be accessed in the top-right of a lead profile by hovering over Scheduled Tasks. From here, you can either edit a scheduled email or you can delete it.

Important Notes

  • This is currently only supported for emails, but texting will be supported in future releases
  • Emails can only be scheduled for at least 5 minutes from the current time
  • If an email is being edited while the originally scheduled time has already passed, the previously scheduled email will be sent without the edits.
  • A maximum of 10 emails can be scheduled per lead
  • A timeline log will be made every time an email is scheduled or edited
  • Recipients can only be leads, not other users or external individuals. However, external recipients can still be added as CC or BCC when sending a scheduled email.
  • The default time zone will be the one set in your settings/preferences, but it can be edited when scheduling each email
  • If you are sending an email in bulk and need to make changes before it's scheduled, for more information, please check Send Mass Emails & Texts. 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

body:
Introduction

For any questions related to your Lofty package or feature availability, please contact Lofty Support (support@lofty.com). 

 

Release Date

Wednesday, December 28th, 2022.

 

Summary

  • Schedule Emails
  • AI Assistant - Group Name in AI Settings
  • Social Studio Pro
    • Account License Purchasing
    • Boosted Post Enhancement

All Features

Schedule Emails

You now have the ability to schedule individual emails via the Lofty platform. Please note the following:

  • This is currently only supported for emails, but texting will be supported in future releases
  • Emails can only be scheduled for at least 5 minutes from the current time
  • If an email is being edited while the originally scheduled time has already passed, the previously scheduled email will be sent without the edits.
  • A maximum of 10 emails can be scheduled per lead
  • A timeline log will be made every time an email is scheduled or edited
  • This is supported for mass email
  • Recipients can only be leads, not other users or external individuals. However external recipients can still be added as CC or BCC when sending a scheduled email.
  • The default time zone will be the one set in the user's settings/preferences but can be edited when scheduling each email

 

Whenever an individual email is being sent via the Lofty platform, there will now be a new button to schedule email:

 

When clicked, a new menu will appear to choose between the following:

  • Tomorrow morning
  • Tomorrow afternoon
  • Custom date/time

 

Once an email has been scheduled, it can be accessed in the top-right of a lead profile by hovering over Scheduled Tasks. From here, you can either edit a scheduled email or you can delete it.

 

 

AI Assistant - Group Name in AI Settings

A new option has been added in the AI Assistant settings within Enterprise accounts. This field will allow you to configure the organization Name that the AI Assistant will present itself as being part of. Prior to this update, the AI Assistant would use the organization name for the whole account/company but this was not always applicable in an Enterprise hierarchy where organization names can vary to be different offices, teams, etc.

Examples:

  • Hi #lead_name, I'm Anna with #company_name.

  • Hi #lead_name, I'm Anna with #group_name.

To edit this setting, navigate to Settings> AI Assistant> Organization Name:

 

Social Studio Pro

Account License Purchasing

If you are an account owner on Lofty, you can now purchase Social Studio Pro from the Lofty Marketplace for others within your account. To do so, navigate to Marketplace> Social Studio Pro> Learn More.

 

Boosted Post Enhancements

The Social Studio Pro feature to boost posts has now been enhanced in the following ways with this update:

(a) When a lead is captured from a boosted post, it will be tagged with the following tag: Boosted Post

*NOTE: The source is "Boost Post"

(b) A new notification has been created for when an existing lead engages with a boosted post. You can configure this notification under Settings > Notifications > Opportunities > Lead views social post:

(c) The following will be logged on a lead's timeline:

  • New Lead: #Lead_full_name# was captured by a boosted social post.
  • Existing Lead: #Lead_full_name# viewed a boosted social post.

 

Home Report Added to Home Valuation

The Home Valuation page has been enhanced.

  • The page is now more compact and displays better on more devices.
  • Additional CTAs for leads to be able to create and request an ongoing Home Report
  • A CTA for a CMA to be requested is also visible on the left side.



When a lead clicks the CTA to track the property value, etc. they will be taken to a form where they have to provide basic information. This will then result in a form that looks just like the Home Report. This does not require you to pay for this feature because the lead is providing all of the information. But if they request to subscribe to updates for that property, it will create a Home Report in the lead profile. This Home Report will be paused and can be enabled if you would like to send it to that lead. You will receive a notification making you aware of this request from the lead. 




Email Domain Management and Self-Purchase 

See Email Domain Management and Self-Purchase for more information.

name: Re-Run Lead Routing
title: Re-Run Lead Routing
body:
Introduction

Note: This feature is only available for Enterprise Lofty accounts. 

This feature allows an Agent to send a company lead through another group's lead routing. Private leads must be changed to a Company lead to Re-run lead routing. This is a helpful tool is a lead is assigned to the wrong group and must be sent through another group's lead routing rules.

Setting

This feature is located in the quick action menu in the lead profile.

When selected, the agent can re-run lead routing, which will send the lead through the selected Group or Subgroup's lead routing rules.

 

Permissions

name: Assignment Group
title: Assignment Group
body:
Introduction

The Assignment Group allows teammates in the Lofty CRM to work together to follow up with leads. When leads enter the system, agents and their working partners will be assigned to leads at the same time. 

 

Summary

  • Usage Scenarios
  • Setting up an Assignment Group
    • Agent Preferences
    • Lead Routing

 

Usage Scenarios

  • Usage Scenario 1: When the leads assigned to an agent have roles that have not been assigned through lead routing, the assignment group will be applied to assign other roles.
    • i.e. Lead Routing rules will take priority over assignment groups
  • Usage Scenario 2: When leads are manually added, imported, or entered into the system in any way and directly assigned to the agent, the assignment group will be applied to assign other roles.

Important: The Assignment Group will not apply to Private Leads.

Setting up an Assignment Group

There are two ways to set up the assignment group, via an Agent's preferences or the Lead Routing Section.

Agent Preferences

All Lofty users, regardless of permission profile, can set their Assignment Group in the upper right hand in the 3 dots of Settings > Lead Routing.

By default, the Agent setting up the assignment group here will be the Agent on the lead profile. Any custom roles that may have been created on the Lofty CRM will be available to assign here.

The range of team members the Agent can select is limited by the Lead Assignment setting in Permission Profile-Advanced Settings.

Lead Routing

Users who have "Manage Lead Distribution" (Enterprise) enabled or "Team Features" (Core/Premier) enabled can manage all users' assignment groups.

Navigate to Settings > Lead Routing > Set up Assignment Groups

Next, click Add new

From here, you will be prompted to select the Agent first, then the other roles may be allocated. When a lead is assigned to this Agent, the other roles will be assigned to the selected users

When the Assignment Group is set, it will automatically assign the roles on the lead's profile, here:

There will also be a notice on the lead's timeline when a role is assigned via the Assignment Group

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com> or by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557.
