name: Form Block
title: Form Block
body:
Introduction

The "Form Block" allows you to embed a contact form (and custom fields) in specific parts of your website where you choose to put the block. The instructions for setting this block up are found below. 

 

Summary

  • Adding the Form Block
  • Form Types
    • (1) Contact Form
    • (2) Sell Form
    • (3) Other Form
  • Form Settings
    • Lead Type
    • Tag
    • Form Questions
      • Email
      • Name
      • Phone
      • Address
      • Message
      • Date
      • Single Line Text
      • Paragraph Text
    • Button

 

Adding the Form Block

To add the Form Block, navigate to CMS > Page Editor > + Blocks:

 

Choose Form, select the style that you would like to add to your page, and then drag it to the right side:

 

Form Types

There are three types of form blocks available in the Block Library. A sample of each style is outlined below:

 

(1) Contact Form

This is the typical contact form that you would see displayed on your website. This type of form also presents the agent profile with their contact information, etc. There are many options for this style of the Form Block, but typically they will look like the following:

 

 

 

(2) Sell Form

This form, when submitted, triggers a request from the site visitor/lead to sell their home. There are a variety of form styles that use this option, but typically they will look like the following:

 

 

(3) Other Form

The "Other Form" is simple and does not have the agent info displayed. Here is what that form typically looks like:

 

 

 

Form Settings

In general, the following are the settings that should be available whenever you edit a Form Block.

 

Lead Type

Choose the lead type that will be assigned to any new leads that are captured via this form. The following are options: 

  • Buyer
  • Seller
  • Renter
  • Investor
  • Agent
  • Homeowner
  • Landlord
  • Other

 

Agent Type Lead

Since agent-type leads are individuals looking for work and only need the ability to leave messages without needing to experience other site features, so we allow you to submit information through forms without login, and the message will still be displayed in the CRM.

When you attempt to log in or use features that require logging in, such as "save search," there will be a relevant prompt. 
 
The lead ownership configuration in the landing page will also be aligned with the CRM. In addition to being able to select Personal and Company, it will also be able to choose a specific office where the site owner belongs.

Tag

Choose tags that will be applied to any leads that complete this form. Use these tags to categorize your leads, trigger automation with Smart Plans, etc.

Note that this feature also works for existing leads. If an existing lead fills out the form on the website that has been edited to include tags, those tags will be added to the existing lead's profile.

 

Form Questions

Though there are a few exceptions within the different form styles (sell my home, for example), for the most part, most of the questions used within the Form Block can be customized to fit your needs and capture the information that you are looking for from site visitors on your site. Currently, there is no limit to the number of questions that can be added to a form. All responses to form questions will feed into the lead's profile page in the CRM and an email will be sent to you as the Lofty user.

 

There are two categories for form questions:

  1. Built-In Fields (can only be added once)
    • Email
    • Name
    • Phone
    • Address
    • Message
    • Date
  2. Additional Fields (can be added multiple times)
    • Single Line Text
    • Paragraph Text

 

Email

This is required for every form.

 

Name

You can choose "Full Name" or "First and Last Name" format. You can also set this field as required or optional.

 

Phone

The phone number for the site visitor. Can be set as required.

 

Address

First, choose the address type.

  • Individual Address: just one address input field and a Google address suggestion will be given when the site visitor inputs an address
  • Full Address: This is divided into four separate fields (Street Address, City, State, and Zip Code). There will be no Google address suggestions with the "Full Address" type selected.

You can set this field as required or optional.

 

If the visitor submits this field on your form, there will be a property generated and associated with the lead’s profile page on the CRM:

 

Message

You can customize the "Field Label" (the field name displayed on the form). You can also set this field as required or optional. If the site visitor submits this field on your form, there will be a "_________ left a message" log generated on the timeline of the lead’s profile page. It will also trigger a notification to the primary agent associated with the lead.

 

Date

This field will let the site visitor choose a date in the form using a calendar picker. You can customize the "Field Label" (the field name displayed on the form) as you want. Also, you can set this field as required or optional. The date info will be recorded as a note in the lead’s profile page of the CRM.

 

Single Line Text

Create a new field that you can name. This field is intended for a small response from the site visitor. You can make it optional or required.

 

Paragraph Text

Create a new field that you can name. This larger paragraph text field is intended for larger responses from the site visitor. Optional/required can also be toggled on or off.

 

Button

With this setting, you can choose to display a "Thank You Message" or to redirect the visitor to a specific URL. If you choose "Thank You Message," you can choose the message that the site visitor will see after submitting the form. If you choose the URL, you can input the URL that the visitor will be redirected to after submission of the form.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by a chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: List Your Home Block
title: List Your Home Block
body:
Introduction

With this block, site visitors complete a form and by doing so add a manual listing (formerly known as pocket listing) directly to your Lofty website. The key part here is the site visitor who is the one adding the manual listing to the website, not you as the agent/user. Once submitted, the property details are added to a manual listing automatically placed on the website–there is no approval process built into this. The site visitor must also submit their contact information when submitting the listing and by doing so their information is captured in the database as a lead.

Summary

  • Add the Block
  • Using the Block
  • Manage Manual Listings

 

Add the Block

The block is added by going to CMS > Page Editor > + Blocks > List Your Home. No settings (other than spacing) can be configured for this block meaning no additional fields can be added to the form. There is also only one style for this block.

 

Using the Block

The best practice on a page that contains this block would be to clearly set expectations for the site visitor so they understand what happens when they submit that manual listing. Could it potentially be deleted? Will it only be the starting point for a conversation? Should they expect communication from the agent whose website it is?

 

Below is what this new block looks like published on a sample website. Email address and other key fields (address, price, status) are required in order for a site visitor (lead) to submit this form. name: Live Call Transferring
title: Live Call Transferring
body:
Introduction

The live transfer feature is built into the Lofty dialer as a way for calls with leads to be transferred to another team member with your Lofty account. This feature is not available on all call packages or all scenarios so please review this document for more information.

 

Summary

  • Requirements
  • How It Works

 

Requirements

Please be aware of the following. . .

  • Only available on the following call packages:
    • Elite
  • Works on both inbound and outbound calls
  • Works on click-to-call functionality (when clicking from a lead profile to call one specific lead) and on call lists.
  • Only able to transfer calls to other agents within your Lofty team, not outside of your Lofty team
  • The agent receiving the call does not need a call package, but they do need to have their Bridge Number set up (CRM > Settings > Manage Dialer > Bridge Number).

 

How It Works

If you are on a call with a lead (that meets all of the requirements above) and you would like to transfer the call to another agent within your team, simply click on the Transfer icon in the bottom-right of the dialer panel:

 

You will then choose who you would like to transfer the call to (that is within your Lofty team):

 

The above action will automatically dial out to the third person (your colleague within your Lofty team), and the call panel will show who you are dialing out to (agent) and who you are already connected to (lead):

 

If the other agent does not pick up, the icon will show as red/orange, and you can transfer again if you would like by clicking the Transfer icon.

 

When it connects to the other agent successfully, it will show up with a green icon. There is no separate conversation that happens before the transfer takes place--it simply adds the agent to the conversation.

 

You then have three options

  1. Stay on the line. There are now three people on the line and the conversation can continue.
  2. Hang up yourself. This will allow for you to leave the conversation but the call will continue between the lead and the agent you connected them with.
  3. Hang up agent. This option will kick the agent off the call who you had connected to originally as the third participant in the call.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by a chat with us through your Lofty CRM. 

 

Related terms: Live transfer, live call transfer

name: Text Templates
title: Text Templates
body:
Introduction

Use Lofty to create text templates that you want to have easy access to in the future. You can build out responses that you find yourself having to repeat over and over again or put together a template that you want to use in a mass text or Smart Plan. All of these are available options.

 

Summary

  • Accessing Text Templates
  • Setting Up Text Templates
    • Auto Welcome Text
    • Text Templates
      • My Text Templates
      • Team Text Templates
  • Using Text Templates

 

Accessing Text Templates

To access your text templates, go to Marketing > Text Messages > Templates:

 

Setting Up Text Templates

Welcome Text

The Welcome Text is a way to automatically text your leads when they first enter your database, when you turn on the toggle button. Any welcome texts built out here are unique to your specific user account and are not shared with others on the team. 

 

*IMPORTANT: If enabled, this Welcome Text will be sent to leads from all incoming lead sources (i.e., Zillow, Realtor.com, etc.), and it cannot be customized to trigger only for specific sources. If you would like a "welcome text" for specific sources, we recommend using Smart Plan auto texts for that purpose.

 

Click on + Add to add a new welcome text. Each welcome text can have a defined time range. So, you could create a welcome text that triggers after hours to let people know you will reach out the next day. If a lead enters the CRM at a time when no corresponding time range is set, no welcome text will be sent to them.

You can also utilize a previously built text template as well as image and variable options (see Email and Text Variables). Type your message and click on Save if you have finished.

Use the on/off switch to enable or disable a certain auto text, the edit option to edit an existing auto text, and then delete if you would like to remove an auto welcome text.

With auto welcome texts configured, any new incoming leads that are assigned to you will receive the welcome text, regardless of source, as long as they are within the defined time range.

 

Text Templates

These are standard text templates that, once created, can be utilized in a variety of ways throughout the Lofty platform (outlined below in Using Text Templates). There are two types of text templates.

 

My Text Templates

Text templates added here will only be visible and accessible to you as an individual user. They are not intended to be shared with others on your team. On the main page, you can preview your templates as well as edit or delete them if you would like. 

Click on the + Add to create a new template that only you can access:

You can add new content or pull in content from an existing template that has already been created. With text templates, we recommend setting up variables (see Email and Text Variables) so that you can easily use them with many different leads but still make them personal.

Company and Office Text Templates

These sections are the same as "My Text Templates" except that these templates are accessible to all users in the Company/Office. However, only those who have been given the permission (see Permissions) will have the option to create, edit, or delete these templates. All other users in the Company/Office can still use these templates!

 

Using Text Templates

You are able to use text templates anywhere a text message can be sent in the Lofty platform. This includes (but is not limited to) the following:

  • Lead detail/profile page
  • People Page
  • Smart Plans
  • Call panel (during or after a call made via Lofty)

Typically, a window like the following will appear, and after clicking Select Template, you will be presented with both My Templates and Company Templates that you can use:

 

Questions?

Introduction

This block type was designed support the addition of vendors on Lofty-built websites. This block type was designed to display vendors/partners and their contact information, etc. directly on your Lofty-built website to make their details accessible to site visitors.

Vendor Block Setup

To add a new vendor, navigate to CMS > Settings > Team Info > Vendors > + Add a Vendor:

 

The following are the fields that can be added to a vendor profile. Company Name is required but you will definitely want to provide as many details as possible.

 

To add a vendor category, click on the settings cog wheel. You can edit, reorder, and delete the categories as needed.

 

Next, to add the block, navigate to the Page Editor > + Blocks > Vendor > Drag the block where you would like to add it on the page:

When a vendor profile is clicked, it will redirect to their website. 

Vendor Block Sorting

As of July 19, 2021, the Vendor Block supports creating a default sort method for the block. When editing the actual Vendor Block, there is a switch. By default, the switch will be ON which means vendors in that block will be sorted A-Z. However, if you turn the switch OFF, the sorting order will reflect exactly what was configured above in Settings > Team Info > Vendors instead of being alphabetical.

name: Reassignment Groups
title: Reassignment Groups
body:
Introduction

Standard lead routing in Lofty works when a brand new lead reaches the CRM and then the lead routing rule kicks in and sends it to a specific assignee. This "Reassignment Groups" feature, however, is different because it is intended to route leads that have already been in the system, not new ones. An example of when to use this could be that an ISA was the original "Agent" assigned to the lead via standard lead routing and then, after qualifying the lead, they want to trigger distribution to a group of agents for someone to take over.

To learn more about lead routing for new leads as they enter the CRM, please see Lead Routing Rules.

 

Summary

  • Setting Up Reassignment Groups
  • Using Reassignment Groups
  • Reassignment: Enterprise

 

Setting Up Reassignment Groups

First, navigate to Company Settings > Lead Settings > Reassignment Groups. Users with the "Manage Lead Distribution" permission (see Organization - Permission Profiles) can edit these reassignment rules. Click on + Add New to add a new reassignment group. There is currently no limit to the number of reassignment groups that can be created.

Give the reassignment group a name. This will be the name that is used to choose this specific group when doing the assignment. 

Enterprise accounts have an additional option called Available To, which allows you to segment which specific groups inside of the Enterprise hierarchy will have access to each reassignment group that is created. 

With this setting, users in the selected groups will be able to see this specific Reassignment Group as an option when reassigning via a lead's profile. If a user is not part of a selected group, they will not see this as an option to reassign in a lead's profile.

Choose the assignees for this re-routing group. These are the agents that will be included in the Reassignment rule. These can be set per individual or agent tag.

Next, choose the default assignee. This will be the individual who gets the lead if no one in the distribution list claims it.

 Finally, select the lead distribution method. These are the same as regular lead routing rule logic.

Using Reassignment Groups

Now that the reassignment groups have been created, you can use them.

*IMPORTANT:

  • The action of actually triggering distribution to a reassignment group can only be done manually at present. 
  • Only available as an action when replacing the primary Agent role on a lead, not for the Assistant role, lender role, or any other custom roles.

Navigate to a lead profile page and select the primary agent role (remember that this action is only supported for the primary agent role).

 

Next, choose which reassignment group you would like to send the lead to:

You will see a confirmation message and will want to click YES if you would like to trigger the reassignment group distribution:

The primary agent role will show Re-Assign in progress until the lead is assigned to the agent via Reassignment Group rules. You will be unable to edit the assignee for this primary agent role while reassignment is in progress.

Once the lead has been reassigned, per the Reassignment Group rule, OR the lead has been assigned to the default assignee, a timeline record will be documented on the lead profile that looks like this one:

Editing a Reassignment Group

If a new user is added to or removed from the Reassignment Group, the assignments will continue without resetting. The current assignment round will complete, to ensure that everyone is getting the appropriate amount of leads.

Permissions

The display of reassignment groups looks like this: 

Only users with the right admin permissions can edit reassignment groups. 

  • "Manage Lead Distribution" permission is required.
    • Those with access to edit lead distribution for "Entire Company" can edit all reassignment groups.
    • Those limited to editing only for "User's Office" will only be able to edit reassignment groups for their office/sub-offices.

Learn More: Organization - Permission Profiles

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

title: Recurring Postcards (Geographic Farming)
body:
Introduction

Work with our team at Geographic Farming to set up ongoing campaigns to cultivate specific farming territories with print advertising. This article outlines what features are available in Lofty to monitor and manage a recurring postcard campaign with Geographic Farming.

To learn more about one-time postcard options, please see Self-Service Postcards.

 

Summary

  • What is Geographic Farming?
  • Sign Up with Geographic Farming
  • Monitoring a Recurring Postcard/Geographic Farming Campaign in Lofty

 

What is Geographic Farming?

 

Sign Up with Geographic Farming

To start with a Geographic Farming postcard campaign, navigate to the Lofty Marketplace > Lofty Products > Listing and Seller Tools. Clicking on the Learn More button will send your contact details to our team at Geographic Farming who will then contact you to talk about whether this is a good fit for your marketing needs.

 

Monitoring a Recurring Postcard/Geographic Farming Campaign in Lofty

If you have signed up to send postcard campaigns with Geographic Farming, you will have immediate insight into your postcard marketing directly in the Lofty platform. 

 

Navigate to Marketing > Print House. On this page, you will have a summary of each campaign that you have coordinated with the Geographic Farming team.

 

Each piece of this dashboard is broken down as follows:

  1. Created: Date campaign was made.
  2. Status: 
    1. Active: The campaign is active and moving forward.
    2. Paused: Printing has been paused per your request
    3. Completed: All deliverables have been finished and delivered
    4. Canceled: The campaign has been canceled
  3. Sent: The total number of postcards that have been sent to print and deliver
  4. Engaged Leads: The total number of leads that have been captured through the QR Code and Text Code engagement mechanisms (see Postcard Engagement: Text Codes and QR Codes).

When any of the individual campaigns are clicked, you will be taken to a Campaign Details page that looks like the following:

  1. A summary of the entire campaign

  2. A breakdown of the individual deliverables

 

All campaigns that have ended will be shown as Finished: 

 

The statuses for the individual deliverables are the following:

  • Inactive
  • Active
  • Waiting for Design
  • Waiting for Review
  • Design Rejected
  • Waiting for Print
  • Printing
  • Delivering

 

Each deliverable can also be clicked and you will be able to access the Deliverable Detail Page. This page is the same as what is outlined under Self-Service Postcards > Postcard Campaign Reporting. 

 

Questions?

name: Transaction Management Documents
title: Transaction Management Documents
body:
Introduction

Transactions always include some sort of documentation or paper trail. There are several ways to save documents in Lofty so that you can access them later as needed. Learn how to upload documents to Lofty here: Uploading Documents to Lofty

Summary

  • Document Instructions
  • Document Folders
  • Bulk Operations
  • FAQs

 

Document Instructions

To access and save a document associated with a transaction, navigate to a Lead Profile > Transactions & Docs > click on the transaction:

 

You can also access a transaction by navigating to Transaction Management > clicking on a transaction:

 

You are now on the transaction detail page. Next, click on Documents:

Use the Click here to upload a document to attach a file:

Upload a file from your computer, Dropbox, Google Drive, send as an email attachment, or DocuSign.

  • Each file that is uploaded can only be a maximum of 70 MB in size.
  • There is currently no limit to the number of files that can be uploaded to a transaction.

Another way to upload a document is via a transaction task. Transaction tasks are accessed on the Checklists page of a transaction. Once you click on a task, you will be presented with four different options. The one related to this topic, of course, is the Upload option:

You will have the same options for uploading a document, and you can toggle on/off the switch that allows you to mark a task as complete once a document is uploaded. 

To learn more about Transaction Checklists, see HERE.

 

Document Folders

Documents are categorized in folders. A default folder will be created on each transaction and lead profile. 

  • There is no limit to the number of folders that can be created.
  • Each file that is uploaded can only be a maximum of 50 MB in size
  • There is no limit to the number of files that can be uploaded to a transaction

The default location for documents uploaded will be the Default folder. Each transaction will have a default folder. This folder cannot be deleted but can be renamed.

You can also rename or delete the other folders at any time if needed. Folders will be categorized by A-Z.

 

Bulk Operations

If you need to take action on multiple documents, select the documents and choose the action from the menu. 

 

Check the box next to one document to access these actions:

  • Preview: This allows you to peek at the document without downloading it.
  • Rename: This allows you to change the name of the document in the folder

Check the box next to one or more documents to access these actions:

  • Download
  • Delete
  • Move: Moves the document(s) to another folder.
  • Send Email: Attaches the document(s) to an email for sending
  • Send to Docusign: Send the document for signature directly from the transaction. Requires an integrated DocuSign account.

FAQs

Are notes in Transactions searchable? 

Yes, the following types of notes can be searched:

  • Manual Notes (including those made for calls, emails, and texts)
  • System Log

Is it possible to upload more than one document to a transaction checklist task before it's marked as completed? 

Yes, you can click the edit button on the checklist and upload the additional document.

 

Questions?

Custom Fields Improvements

As a quick announcement, please be aware that the following features were already released on April 25, 2021 as an additional part to Feature Updates for CRM 3.24 > Custom Fields: Number Data Type.

  • Access Custom Fields Via Columns on People Page
  • Filter by Custom Fields

 

Lead Pond: License ID Field

A small improvement was already released on April 20, 2021 for the lead pond. What has been added is a "License ID" field for the lead pond virtual agent profile. This field is not required. When filled out, this license ID (and the other virtual agent profile info) will appear in auto emails sent to leads in the Lead Pond. If the field is left blank, it will not appear on the auto email signatures.

More about Lead Pond can be found HERE.

 

CRM 3.25

Postcard Optimizations

Prior to this update, only a templated, Lofty -built back page could be used on the postcards in order to make sure that the address, etc. was where it needed to be. With this update, however, you can now select your own designs for the back page and are no longer required to use a Lofty -built back page. 

When postcards are sent via Lofty, the recipient's name and address are always included on the back page at the bottom-right. With this update, that spot will always be blocked and no content added in that area will be printable. As soon as the Order Postcards button is clicked, page 2 of the design will have the blocked address area highlighted on the design. 

To learn more, go to Self-Service Postcards.

 

Lead Generation Reporting: Partial Leads 

Buyer Lead Gen Report

This report, found under Campaigns > Buyer Lead Gen, now includes a Partial Leads field:

A "Partial Lead" here meets all of the following criteria 

  • Source = "Lofty Paid Lead"
  • Email-Only Lead (see HERE)

 

Seller Lead Gen Report

This report, found under Campaigns > Seller Lead Gen, already had a Partial Leads field prior to this new release as shown in the screenshot below:

What has changed with this update is that "Partial Leads" here still include address-only leads that submitted only their address via a Home Valuation page (the original definition of a "Partial Lead") and Email-Only Leads (see HERE) with the source of "Lofty Paid Lead."

 

Site 5.13

MLS Associated Agent ID

This feature was built to make it easier to present featured listings on your IDX website and support other MLS listing feed-dependent features in the CRM. When adding an MLS, part of the process is to include the information for the agent associated with that MLS. That information will now be listed under CMS > Settings > Listings > MLS Integration and under the column for Agent. 

Once this feature goes live, as much information as possible will be mapped to the Agent column for existing MLS connections. However, you will want to check and manually + Add Associated Agent if one has not been added. 

Please note that this is not a requirement--you can leave this blank and continue using the platform as you were before. This is being released to facilitate the efficacy of MLS data for featured listings and other features in the future. 

 

Custom Fields for Agent Website Profiles

A new feature has been added to better build out agent profiles on your Lofty IDX website. These custom fields can be used to present more information about your agents on your website. For example, you could share information about each agent's favorite color or first job, the university they attended, etc.

 

To access the setting, navigate to CMS > Settings > Team Info > Agents > Click on the cog wheel at the top: 

 

You can then create custom fields for agent profiles. They can be text boxes or drop-down lists. You can add a maximum of 15. 

 

Once the fields are added, you can go to the agent list and add or edit an agent. A section will be available for each individual profile to add the information to those fields:

 

When the agent profile is clicked on the About page, etc. that agent's profile will appear and the custom fields are displayed there. Here is a sample of what this might look like:

 

*Note: Custom fields added at the Team Website level are the same available when editing profiles on both Agent Subdomains and Agent Websites. In other words, custom fields are added at the Team Website level and available to use at the Agent Subdomain and Agent Website levels when building agent profiles.

 

Email-Only Lead Registration Optimization

This feature was originally released as part of Site 5.9. 

The following three items have changed with this release:

  1. Source Change. These leads will no longer be their own unique source. Previously, they were marked as source "Site Email Lead," but with this release, this will be a Tag instead of a Source. This will allow for the original source of the lead to be retained while still being able to filter for this specific type of lead in the future as needed.
  2. Toggle On/Off. You can now turn this feature off if you would prefer not to capture this type of lead.
  3. Supported Capture Methods. Leads starting to register with Facebook/Gmail will also be captured. 

You can find the up-to-date logic outlined here: Registration Pop-up Style & Settings > Email-Only Lead Registration.

 

Link Anchor for "Request a Tour" Feature

This anchor was developed to take site visitors to the Request a Tour level on a listing detail page. If you would like for a site visitor to be sent directly to that part of a property detail page, simply add #schedule at the end of your listing detail page URL so that site visitors can be directed to the "Request a Tour" option on that listing. 

 

Here is what it appears as on desktop view:

 

On the mobile view, the site visitor will be taken directly to a pop-up that looks like this one:

 

Breadcrumb for Listing Detail Pages

A "breadcrumb" (location hierarchy links) has been added to every listing detail page. The format will be the following: #State# > #City# > #Subdivision#. All of this information is generated directly from the MLS. This will allow site visitors to easily find other listings in the city, or subdivision without having to back out to generate a separate search. Please note that the state is currently not clickable.

This type of feature on every individual listing detail page also improves the usability of our websites and increases overall SEO value as well.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Billing, Usage, and Availability for Call/Text Packages
title: Billing, Usage, and Availability for Call/Text Packages
body:
Introduction

This article explains how billing, usage, and availability (upgrades, etc.) apply to call/text packages that are added to your account. You are charged on your billing date (this should be on the first of the month) for the call/text package of the current month. 

 

Summary

  • Call/Text Package Pricing
    • Call Packages
    • Text Packages
  • Add / Upgrade / Downgrade
  • Personal Virtual Number
  • Texting Usage Details
  • Call Usage Details

    • Unlimited Call Package Explanation
    • Daily Call Limit

 

Call/Text Package Pricing

Add / Upgrade / Downgrade

The following table outlines what happens when you purchase, upgrade, or cancel a call/text package as associated with availability and billing.

  When are features upgraded/downgraded? Is a charge made at the time the change is made? What is the charge that will be on the following month's billing date?

Texting Usage Details

  • Text usage includes both outbound texts and, only when the option is turned on, inbound texts that are forwarded with the "Forward Received Texts" option. This setting is found where you configure your call/text package settings.
  • If a text goes over the character limit, it will count as multiple text messages. One message can have a maximum of 160 characters, but only 70 characters if special characters are used. 
  • MMS messages are a text message that includes an image. 
    • 1 MMS message = 3 SMS messages
  • If any task reminders (see Task Management) are set up via text message, this will also use the available text allotment on your Text Package.
  • Standard text notifications triggered by Lofty (see Lofty Notifications) do not count as usage.

Practical list of “watch out” characters

Here’s a quick list you can reference when drafting a text message, to ensure you do not use any special characters:

  • Smart quotes: “ ” ‘ ’ → use straight quotes (" and ') instead.

  • Curly apostrophes: ’ → use '.

  • Brackets/braces: { } — use round parentheses ( ) instead.

  • Full-width or other variant symbols: e.g., ＄, ＠, ＃, ％.

  • Other non-standard punctuation: e.g., •, — (em dash), – (en dash) → use - hyphen-minus.

  • Emoji and symbols beyond standard ASCII/punctuation (e.g., 💡, 🎉, ™, ® if not in GSM set).

  • Non-Latin characters even if visually similar.

 

Call Usage Details

General Information

  • Both inbound and outbound calls using the virtual number count toward call package usage
  • You will be charged any additional amount ($0.03/min/call) if the actual call usage exceeds the established amount in the package. This will be added to your bill for the following month as this is not something that can be prepaid.

***⁠All the time between when you start dialing and when the lead hangs up the phone is counted.

 

Daily Call Limit

Please note that the Three Line Dialer has a daily dial limit of 2,000. That limit is specifically when dialing out using 2 or 3-line modes. There is no limit to dialing with just 1 line. There is also no daily dial limit for the Unlimited package either (it just uses one line). 

FAQs

Q: If a lead calls back an agent with no active dialer package, will the call bridge to the agent's cell phone?

A: If a lead calls back the agent's PVN, it will show as a missed call on the agent's CRM, and the lead calling the PVN will hear a message on the other line that the number can only accept text messages and will be asked to send a text to the number instead.

 

Q: How does billing work for overages?

A: If you go over your text plan limit, you will be charged immediately for every 1,000 texts over. This is designed to help you stay informed on your text activity so you can limit your usage if necessary. 


Q: Is there a daily limit for the Growth/Elite text package?
A: They are billed monthly, with an overage fee of $0.02 per additional text. There is no daily cap—just a monthly total.

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Company Number
title: Company Number
body:
Introduction

A "Company Number" is a virtual number that is shared by all users on a Lofty account. This is different from what is referred to as a "Personal Number" which is the virtual number that belongs to and is utilized by an individual user. A "Company Number" is simply a virtual number and does not have its own allocated usage. Usage (call minutes or text messages) is still pulled from an individual user's associated call/text package (included or added-on). Each accounts can have only one personal number, but it can purchase multiple company numbers and be associated with the numbers it bought.

Please also note that in order to have a Personal Number, you will need to upgrade your text/call package which includes the use of a Personal Number.

 

Summary

  • Company Number Settings
    • Purchasing additional Company Numbers
    • Source and Tag for Company Number
  • Outbound Logic
    • Outbound Manual Texts
    • Outbound Auto Texts
    • Outbound Calls
  • Inbound Logic
    • Existing Leads
    • Unknown Leads
    • Duplicate Phone Number

 

Company Number Settings

The Company Number settings are managed by the Team Owner/Admin by navigating to Settings > Company > Communication > Call & Text and selecting the Company Number tab.

Click Select a Number to pick a virtual number to be used as the Company Number. Click Configure Rule to determine how calls and text messages from phone numbers that do not belong to a lead are routed to users on your account. More information on the configuration logic is here: Unknown Leads

 

Purchasing additional Company Numbers

The Account Owner can buy and assign Company Numbers to offices or users within their organization. The cost is $27/month/company number.

To purchase, navigate to Settings > Company > Communication > Call & Text > Company Number> Buy New Company Number:


Only one Company Number can be assigned to each group or agent. 

 

Outbound Logic

Outbound Manual Texts

If you have both a Personal Number and a Company Number, you will be able to choose between both options when sending a manual text message by selecting the From or the Sender Number drop-downs:

 

Outbound Auto Texts

Auto texts are those sent by Smart Plans and Welcome Texts. The setting for Sender ID to Display as connected to your dialer license settings is what determines whether the Company Number or the Personal Number (if you have one) is set to send auto text messages. If you edit this option and choose a "Sender ID to Display," then that is the number that will be used for auto-texts. If you do not choose a "Sender ID to Display," then it will default to use the Personal Number if available and if not, it will use the Company Number as the secondary option.

 

 

Outbound Calls

You can choose to use any of the following when making an outbound call:

  • (a) Company Number
  • (b) Personal Number (requires upgrade)
  • (c) Bridge Number

 

Inbound Logic

Existing Leads

Inbound calls/texts from EXISTING leads will be sent directly to the user listed in the primary "Agent" role of a lead record:

 

Unknown Leads

When a phone number that is not associated with a lead in the CRM calls your Company Number, you can set up rules to determine which agent receives the call.

Click Configure Rule to setup the routing.

Three options are available when configuring routing rules:

1. Blast Alert: Unknown inbound calls and texts will be routed to up to 5 selected agents.

Inbound Calls: The call will ring all available users simultaneously until one answers.
Unavailable users (inactive, without an active call package, on a busy line, or outside business hours) will not be notified. Once the call is answered, it will stop ringing for the others.
Inbound Texts: The text will be sent to all selected users.

2. [Default Option] Specific User: Routes calls and texts to one selected agent, as in the current online version.

3. Another Number: Routes the call or text to a specific bridge number.

Source & Tag

For numbers without a configured 'source' field, a default value of 'Company Number Unknown IB' will be added.

When a phone number that is not associated with a lead calls the Company Number and is not answered by the Agent, the notification will have the following information:

  • Source: (Source added to Company Number)
  • Phone Number:(Phone number that called)
  • An option to click to add as a new lead or associate with an existing lead
    • If this is being added as a New Lead, the lead's Source will be the Source applied to the Company Number and the Tag will be added to the lead's profile
    • If this is being associated with an existing lead, which already has a Source, the Source applied to the Company Number will be added to the lead's profile as a Tag and the Tag will also be added to the lead's profile as a Tag
      Reminder: A Lead may have many Tags, but only one (1) Source.

Chat->Unknown inbound channel

Call Notification

Scenario 1: If a call is answered, only the agent who picks up the call can see the record.
This agent will be the only one able to perform further actions or communications with the unknown number, such as creating a new lead, calling back, or texting back.

Scenario 2: If a call is not answered by any of the selected agents, all users can see the record of the missed call. At this point, the unknown number is considered "unclaimed."

  • Any selected agents can make further operations or communications with the unknown number.
  • Once any agent takes action, it will be considered a "claim", and the notification will be removed for all other users. This ensures that only one agent follows up with the lead, avoiding multiple users contacting the same lead.

Text Notification

The unknown IB text will be sent to all selected routing agents.
The record will be visible for all of them until anyone takes a 'claim' action.

Call and Text Routing Rule

Company Virtual Number and Office Number support customized routing rules for unknown inbound calls and texts. You can add up to 10 custom rules. Working priority: custom→default.

For Active Hours, select a day and time. It is not allowed to choose duplicate time with other rules.

Duplicate Phone Number

There are two different scenarios here:

Scenario 1

  • Multiple leads have the same phone number
  • The primary agent on the leads is the same user

If there are multiple leads with the same phone number and their primary agent is the same, the call/text will be sent to that agent and a timeline record will be made on all the lead records for the leads with that phone number.

 

Scenario 2

  • Multiple leads have the same phone number
  • The primary agent on the leads is not the same user

If there are different primary agents on leads with the same phone number, the call/text will be sent to the agent who owns the lead that was created most recently and a timeline record will be made only on that lead's timeline within their lead profile.

FAQs

  • Because everyone will be using the same Company Number (technically one virtual number), are there any limitations on how many people can use it simultaneously?
  • Is there a permission that can be set so that only certain team members can use the Company Number?
  • How will a Company Number work with listing on a business card or other marketing purposes?
  • Can the Company Number be used for Text Codes via the Campaigns page? Or with Postcards?
  • Is there a permission that allows other users to edit Company Number settings?

Because everyone will be using the same Company Number (technically, one virtual number), are there any limitations on how many people can use it simultaneously?

  • Texting. There is no limit to the number of text messages that can be sent/received simultaneously as the Company Number.
  • Calling. There is a limit (due to provider limitation) that no more than 50 inbound calls can be supported at the same time. If this limit is reached, the Company Number will no longer be able to answer calls. 

 

Is there a permission that can be set so that only certain team members can use the Company Number?

No, currently, there is no permission of this type meaning all users on a team can use it as long as it is configured.

 

How will a Company Number work with listing on a business card or other marketing purposes?

A Company Number would likely not be effective in these scenarios because, according to the logic outlined above for "unknown leads," calls/texts from individuals not in your database will have to be sent to one specific person meaning they would likely not make it to you if you are not that person. A "Personal Number" would be more appropriate for marketing uses.

 

Can the Company Number be used for Text Codes via the Campaigns page? Or with postcard engagement?

No. Currently, the Company Number can only be used for inbound/outbound texts and calls. This means that the ability to send out postcards with a text code engagement mechanism or simply use the text codes on their own will not be accessible without upgrading to a new text package which of course includes access to your Lofty Personal Number.

 

Is there a permission that allows other users to edit Company Number settings?

No. Only the Team Owner/Admin can edit Company Number settings.

 

What number is used by default to send auto-texts?

See Outbound Auto Texts.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@loftycom>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Market Snapshot Block
title: Market Snapshot Block
body:
Introduction

The "Market Snapshot" block can be used to display market trends from the last 30 days on any page that you build. It’s a great tool to attract seller leads and show them what the local market looks like. These blocks are added by default to the following:

  • Market Snapshot Pages (see Market Snapshot Page).
  • Market Insights
  • Listing detail pages
  • Neighborhood pages

Summary

  • Adding the Market Snapshot Block
  • Editing the Market Snapshot Block
  • CTA in Block

 

Adding the Market Snapshot Block

Navigate to the CMS > Page Editor > + Blocks:

Find the Market Snapshot block, choose the style that you would like to use, and drag the block to the right side of the page where you would like to add it: 

 

The Market Snapshot block will now be added directly to your page. Do not forget to click on the blue Publish button in the top-right if you would like this to be pushed to your live site.

 

Editing the Market Snapshot Block

To edit this block, double-click on the block or click on the "Edit" icon in the top-right of that block. The edit panel for that specific block will then appear on the left side:

 

When editing the Market Snapshot block, you can define the following:

  • Preset Filter. Define the preset filters that you want to be pre-populated when a site visitor opens this page and sees the Market Snapshot block. Site visitors can always remove these filters if they want to check data for different locations, but this will give them a starting point.
  • Title. The title of the block.
  • Style. You can choose from the available styles if you would like.
  • Spacing After Block. Add spacing after the block--customize for computer screen size and mobile screen size.

 

CTA in Block

The Market Snapshot block has a CTA allowing the site visitors to save their own Market Snapshot. The saved Market Snapshot by the lead will appear on their lead record within the CRM, but please note that cannot be edited–only deleted or reviewed.

 

FAQ

Q: Can I edit a Saved Market Snapshot by a lead?

A: The saved Market Snapshot by the lead will appear on their lead record within the CRM, but please note that cannot be edited–only deleted or reviewed.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

title: Feature Updates for CRM 3.23, Site 5.11
body:
Introduction

*Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons that you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/agent user). For any questions related to your Lofty package or feature availability, please contact Lofty Support (support@lofty.com). 

 

Release Date

Tuesday, April 6, 2021.

 

Summary

  • CRM 3.23
    • Zillow Leads & Property Information
    • Postcard Print Packages
    • Design Center / Postcards: Upload Design
    • Postcard Campaign Details page
  • Site 5.11
    • Option to Save Market Snapshot on IDX Website

 

CRM 3.23

Zillow Leads & Property Information

A small optimization has been added for Zillow leads that are imported via API using our direct integration. We will now parse the property information sent by Zillow and add a property to the lead record in Lofty under Engagement > Properties:

The additional information that will be added includes the following:

  • Address (street, city, state, zip)
  • Price
  • MLS Number
  • Listing Status
  • Zillow Property URL
  • Bedrooms/Bathrooms

When the address to the property is clicked on the lead record, the user will be redirected to the Zillow listing page.

Here is a sample of what that property would be recorded as:

For more information regarding how to best integrate Zillow with the Lofty platform, please see Zillow Integration.

 

Postcard Print Packages

The following print packages are now available to purchase directly in the CRM when sending postcards. Purchasing a print package is a more economical option than sending out regular postcards using the self-service option in Lofty. If you would like to continue using the pay-per-use option to send only a small amount of postcards, you can continue to do so. 

You will be presented with the option to purchase postcard print packages during the order process of the postcards or on the main Campaigns > Postcards page if you have never used postcards in Lofty before.

Specific Information:

  • Credits are used to purchase postcards.
  • 1 postcard mailed by USPS Standard Mail requires 1 credit.
  • 1 postcard mailed by USPS First Class Mail requires 1.5 credits.
  • All unused credits will be removed after the last day of the package period of validity.

For more information on Lofty Postcards see Self-Service Postcards.

 

Design Center / Postcards: Upload Design

A new option is available in the Design Center or when sending postcards that allow you to upload your design. This adds the uploaded image directly to the design for your use. When uploading an image, the postcard canvas will remain the default size and the image will be added to that canvas size. 

To upload the design an Upload Design button is now available in the template screen:

Please note the following:

  • Only JPG and PNG file types are currently supported. PSD is not supported in this version.
  • The file size must be ≤ 10 MB

For more information on Lofty, postcards see Self-Service Postcards.

For more information on using the Lofty Design Center, see Design Center.

 

Postcard Campaign Details page

Prior to this release, postcard campaign reporting was limited to an overall status for the entire campaign (see Self-Service Postcards: Campaign Reporting). That information will still be available, but now you can click into an individual campaign by clicking on the campaign title under Campaigns > Postcards. You will have to deliver information for every single individual postcard, details on the leads that have engaged with your postcard, etc.

 

For more information on Lofty Postcards see Self-Service Postcards: Campaign Reporting.

 

Site 5.11

Option to Save Market Snapshot on IDX Website

The Market Snapshot block is typically seen on the Market Snapshot page, Market Insights, listing detail pages, and neighborhood pages. The saved Market Snapshot by the lead will then appear on their lead record within the CRM, but please note that cannot be edited–only deleted or reviewed.

name: Feature Updates for CRM 3.22, Site 5.10
title: Feature Updates for CRM 3.22, Site 5.10
body:
Introduction

*Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons that you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/agent user). For any questions related to your Lofty package or feature availability, please contact Lofty Support (support@lofty.com). 

 

Release Date

Monday, March 22, 2021.

 

Summary

  • CRM 3.22
    • Self-Service Postcards
    • Billing Center
  • Site 5.10
    • Listings Block: Market Insights
    • CMS Block Spacing Options
    • Style Recommendations
    • Mortgage Calculator: Tax Amount
    • Listing Detail Page: Property History Block

 

CRM 3.22

Self-Service Postcards

Lofty has released an exciting new feature allowing you to design and print postcards all within the Lofty platform. Use this feature to create designs, configure engagement mechanisms, and send postcards to your database.

Learn more about this feature here: Self-Service Postcards.

 

Billing Center

*Only available via the Lofty Web App (not currently supported via the Lofty Mobile App).

The Lofty Billing Center will now provide you with easy access to review the following directly in the Lofty CRM:

  • Account Status
  • Amount Due (if any)
  • Payment Methods

New pop-ups will appear if any amount is outstanding, a payment has failed, etc. in order to avoid interruption of service.

Future improvements to the Billing Center will include the ability to access previous billing statements and receipts, though that is not part of this initial release.

 

Site 5.10

Listings Block: Market Insights

Your site visitors will now have access to market insights directly in the listing search panel as they search in specific areas. This will be visible inside of all listing blocks. When a lead searches for a specific location (city, county, neighborhood, etc.), the website will display a breadcrumb site map for locations (which is good for SEO) as well as a button to access Market Insights. If a lead searches on the map or by looking for a specific address, this will not be available.

Once clicked, data from the Market Snapshot and Market Trend blocks will be displayed for this area.

*IMPORTANT: Please note that if sold data is unavailable from your MLS, certain aspects of this market insights section will not be visible. 

 

CMS Block Spacing Options

A new configuration has been added to each block allowing for spacing after all blocks on the website. Previously, a configuration was available to add space before/after the block but the space could not be customized. Now, a sliding configuration is available for ease of use when adjusting the spacing. There is no longer an option for space before a block, only after a block. All blocks now have this option with the exception of the Header and Footer blocks. There is a separate configuration for desktop and mobile views of the website.

Default values are the following:

  • Desktop: 30px
  • Mobile: 60px

 

Style Recommendations

You may begin to see style recommendations when choosing blocks for your website build. These recommendations are simply indicating to you that a certain style matches the template chosen for your website so that you can keep things as uniform as possible.

The recommendations will look like this one:

 

Mortgage Calculator: Tax Amount

The mortgage calculator has been improved to allow for a specific amount to be entered for "Property Tax" instead of forcing it to be a percentage. 

 

Listing Detail Page: Property History Block

A new section has been added to the Listing Detail Page. Leads viewing a specific listing page will now be able to see the history of the property which includes the following events: sold, price changed, listed as active, etc. This block is only available as part of a listing detail page and cannot be used elsewhere on the website.

*IMPORTANT: Please note that may not be available for your website if sold listing data is not provided by your MLS connection with Lofty. If unavailable, this block will not appear on a listing detail page. Please also note that because this is a new feature, many listings will not have a history populated. The history will be built up based on its history within the Lofty IDX website specifically as this data is not fed in by the MLS.

If you want to require registration before showing this information, you can navigate to CMS > Page Editor > Pages > Property Detail Page Group > Property History Block:

Edit the Registration Pop-Up Trigger:

 

Questions?
