name: Three Line Dialer Guide
title: Three Line Dialer Guide
body:
Introduction

Lofty's Three Line Dialer was designed to increase calling efficiency. It enables those who purchase the Three Line Dialer package to dial up to three leads at once as a way to get through a long list of contacts in a short period of time. 

 

*IMPORTANT:

  • The three-line dialer is not currently available to be purchased. 
  • This feature is only available if you have purchased the Three Line Dialer package. None of the other call packages include multi-line dialing. For more information on adding a call package, reference the following article: Add Call or Text Packages.
  • You can make up to 2,000 calls per day in the 2 or 3-line modes. There is no limit to the number of calls that can be made in the single-line mode with the Three Line Dialer package. Minutes are not limited.  

 

Summary

  • Call Settings
  • Call Process
  • Sample Video (No Audio)
  • FAQs

Call Settings

To access the call settings for the 2/3-line dialing mode, first click on the Phone icon in the right side panel.

 

Select a list by clicking on any of those that appear right here. Just click right on the grey box:

Next, hit the green Phone button at the bottom of the panel:

If you want to dial out with more than one line, choose either "2" or "3" on the drop-down for Number of Lines to Dial:

You will then be presented with these settings, some of which are the same for a standard call list and others are specific to the Three Line Dialer:

  1. Number of Lines to Dial With. Select the number of lines you want to use when calling (one, two, or three).
  2. Seconds of ringing before the call is considered "No Answer". Select the number of seconds that a call should ring before disconnecting and moving on to the next call. It is important to note that currently, there is no way to identify whether a call is being answered by a real person or a voice machine. 
  3. Callback message to play if multiple lines are answered. Select the message you want to have played if more than one person answers the call at the same time. A callback message is required if you are dialing with more than one line. You can record the message by going to the CRM > Settings > Templates > Call > Voice Message.
  4. Call Script. Select the call script template you want to use during the calling session. See Call Scripts for more information.
  5. Questionnaire. Select the questionnaire template you want to use during the calling session. See Call Questionnaires for more information.
  6. Auto Text After Every Call. Enter or select a text template you want to send automatically to the leads you call after each call is made.

 

Call Process

*IMPORTANT: It is important to note that currently, there is no way to identify whether a call is being answered by a real person or a voice machine. This means that any time a call is answered/picked up as described in the functionality below, it is possible that it is only an automatic voice message machine that answered, not a real person.  

 

Click on the blue Start button in the bottom-right to begin dialing:

The system will start by calling the number you have saved in Settings > Manage Dialer > Dialer License > My Dialer License > Bridge Number. After you answer the bridge phone, the system will begin to call your leads. If you do not receive a call on your bridge number, click the link for "Not receiving a call? Click here to exit" so you can try again to exit the call process and try again.

If you select the 2/3-line mode, the system will call two or three leads at the same time.

 

(a) If your lead does not answer the call within the time you selected in the settings for "Seconds of ringing before the call is considered 'No Answer'," the system will hang up on the lead automatically and move on to the next one and a call log will be generated on the timeline of the lead's profile.

 

(b)  If a lead answers the call within the time you selected in the settings for "Seconds of ringing before the call is considered "No Answer". . .

- The lead card on the top of the panel will turn green and you can start talking to the lead. You are then able to choose the call outcome, take notes, send texts, add a new appointment/task, or leave a voice message during the call. Refer to the “Click to Call” Function for more details on how that part works. That lead's profile will also open on the left side of the window.

-  Once the call ends, the lead card will turn red and show the call as "Disconnected." You can then record any details on the call results page.

After you click on "Save," a call log will be generated on the timeline of the lead’s profile. 

 

(c)  If a lead answers the call within the time you select in "Seconds of ringing before a call is considered 'No Answer'," but you are already talking with another lead. 

- The system will play the voice message to the second or third lead that you set up as the "Callback Message" in the Dialer Settings. This will play automatically if multiple lines answer at the same time.

- After it finishes playing the voice message, the system will hang up the call and generate a call log on the timeline of the lead's profile:

- The leads that picked up (remember that this could be a voice message machine) will be added back to the list to dial again immediately after finishing any current call. There is no manual input required to make this happen, the second person and then the third person will immediately be called back if they have answered more or less at the same time as the first. 

 

(d) To ensure calls can be connected and processed, the system will temporarily stop fetching new leads to call until you finish the current call and save the call result. Then it will continue calling the list.

 

4. To exit the call process while in the 2/3-line mode, click on the "Stop" button, and then you will be prompted with two options outlined below.

- Disconnect all calls and exit immediately. Choose this option if you want to stop the calling immediately. Be careful, this option will result in the immediate termination of calls that have been triggered.

- Exit the dialing process after finishing the current call(s). Choose this option if you want to finish with the calls that have been triggered first. After completion, the call process will end. 

 

Sample Video (No Audio)

 

FAQs

When using the Three Line Dialer, will it dial all of the numbers associated with a lead or just their primary number?

When dialing out using multiple lines (two or three), the call logic will only call the primary number associated with a lead. It will not dial out to any additional phone numbers on file for a lead. If dialing out with only one line, there is a setting that can be enabled to call all associated numbers for a lead, but this feature is not available for the multi-line dialer functionality.

 

Can the three-line dialer be used from the mobile app?

No, the 3-line dialer is only available in the web app.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

 

Related terms: Triple line dialer, power dialer

name: Texting via Lofty
title: Texting via Lofty
body:
Introduction

If you have a Lofty text package, you can send and receive text messages from leads. 

This article will review how to send and receive text messages with Lofty via desktop and the mobile app. 

 

Summary:  

  • Character Limits
  • Virtual Phone Numbers
  • Text Subscription Message 
  • Text Message Quiet Hours
  • Sending Text Messages with Lofty (Desktop)
  • Group Texting
  • Receiving Text Messages from Leads
  • Texting with the Lofty CRM Mobile App
  • Group Texting
  • Receiving text messages from leads
  • Replying to a Lead
  • Texting with the Lofty CRM mobile app

Character Limits

One text message can have up to 160 characters. If Non-GSM-7 Characters are included in the message, you can have up to 70 characters.

Common examples of non-GSM-7 characters:

  • Emoji (😃🔥💯 etc.)

  • Smart quotes: “ ” ‘ ’

  • En dash and em dash: – —

  • Curly brackets or non-standard symbols: • ™ © ® ±

  • Accented letters not in GSM-7: á í ó ú ñ ç ê â ô (many others depending on the accent and language)

  • Non-Latin characters: 你好, مرحبا, नमस्ते, etc.

If the text message exceeds the character limit (160 or 70 characters), it will be sent as two messages.

Virtual Phone Numbers

All text messages through Lofty will be sent from one of the virtual phone numbers set up with the dialer under Personal Settings > Call/Text Settings > My Numbers

There is NOT an option to “mask” the virtual numbers. When you send text messages via Lofty, they will be sent from the virtual number you select. 

For more information on setting up virtual numbers, please see these articles: 

  • Getting Started with a Virtual Number
  • Company Number

Text Subscription Message 

Regulations require that consumers should be able to easily opt-out or unsubscribe from receiving text messages from a business. To support this, the Text Subscription Message will be sent to leads following a text message that meets the following criteria:

  1. The first time the lead is texted
  2. When the lead is texted after having not communicated via text message in the last three (3) months.
    • This is a rolling 3 months, so for example, if the lead is texted for the first time on August 1, they will receive the text subscription message.
    • If the lead is texted or texting back regularly, they will never see this message again.
    • If the lead is not texted again until after November 1, they will receive the text subscription message again.

The Text Subscription Message will be added automatically to the text message that matches the criteria above and will be counted in the text message's total character count. 

This setting is located in Personal Settings > Call & Text > Info & Settings. 

Click Customize to update your name and your company name. By default, the data here will be pulled from your Lofty profile and 10DLC Campaign.

Text Message Quiet Hours

The Quiet Hours setting is a tool to ensure that text messages are not sent to your leads in the middle of the night. Many states have requirements around the times of day that a consumer can be contacted by call or text. We recommend that you get familiar with the regulations in your area.

This setting is located in Personal Settings > Call & Text > Info & Settings

When enabled, mass text messages will not be sent during the quiet hours and will be scheduled to be sent when the quiet hours are over.

The quiet hours do not affect 1:1 text messages or smart plan text messages.

Sending Text Messages with Lofty (Desktop)

To send a text message to a lead via the lead profile, click the "Text" option.

A pop-up window allows you to draft your text message. Click the drop-down menu on the From line to select the virtual phone number the text is sent from.

Select the lead's number that you want to send the text message to on the To line. If your virtual phone number is hosted on Twilio, you have the option to send a group text by clicking the + icon.

While you can enter any message you like in the text box, we also offer several tools to help you craft the best message possible. These icons are defined from left to right below:

  1. AI Writing Assistant
    1. This tool utilizes AI to help you write a text using prompts and keywords.
  2. Insert Listings
    1. This tool allows you to insert a link to your own or your team's listing
  3. Video (Beta Feature)
    1. If you see the Video icon, you have the option to send a video text message. This feature is currently being beta-tested
  4. MMS, Image Messaging
    1. The photo icon allows you to send an image. Your Design Center templates are also available to be sent
  5. Text Templates
    1. Your personal and team text templates are available here
  6. Email and Text Variables
    1. The hashtag icon contains lead and agent variables. This allows you to personalize a text without entering the personal information yourself
  7. Virtual Business Cards
    1. The virtual business card is the contact card for you and your team members. 

 

You can also send mass text messages to leads from the People page.

Learn More: Send Mass Emails & Texts

Group Texting

A group text is a text message that is sent to multiple recipients, and all the recipients can see and reply to each other. Learn more about Group Texting here: Group Texting

Receiving text messages from leads

Replies from the lead will appear in Lofty under the lead profile as well as your Lofty Workspaces.

To receive a notification that you received a message on your mobile phone, enable the option “forward incoming text messages to another number”. 

Please keep in mind that this is not an actual message from the lead; it is only a notification that you have received a new text message.

See this article for more information: Call/Text Package Settings

Replying to a Lead

To reply to a text message, first click on the chat icon. This will open the chat panel with the most recent messages at the top of the list. Select the lead that you want to respond to. The text can be crafted directly in the chat panel.

The same options will be available to select which number to text from, insert variables, and text templates.

Texting with the Lofty CRM mobile app

To send text messages through the Lofty CRM mobile app, start by selecting the lead you want to text, then tap on the messaging icon: 

Be sure to check which number the text message will be sent from. There will be an option to select your virtual phone number, company number, or personal mobile number. 
 

Tap the phone number to select, and the phone number selected will have a check mark.

*Please note that if the text message is sent from your mobile number, it will not be recorded in Lofty.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

 

Related terms: group text

name: Feature Updates for CRM 3.21, Site 5.9
title: Feature Updates for CRM 3.21, Site 5.9
body:
Introduction

*Please note that the features available to you on the Lofty platform will vary depending on the package you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/agent user). For any questions related to your package, please contact our Support Team for more information.

 

Release Date

Monday, March 8, 2021.

 

Summary

  • CRM 3.21
    • Multiple Lead Ponds
    • Lofty Paid Leads Phone Number Insights
  • Site 5.9
    • AI Assistant: Listing Recommendations
    • Market Trends Block: Registration Control
    • Site Email Lead Registration
    • CTA Block Improvements
    • Agent Subdomains: Manual Creation

 

CRM 3.21

Multiple Lead Ponds

We have now released the ability for teams under the Enterprise Lofty package to add and configure multiple lead ponds. For now, all other teams will only have access to some of the new features outlined below (new notifications, auto-email settings, lead routing), but not to create multiple teams.

All information regarding lead ponds, including these new updates, can be found in the following Help Center article: Lead Pond. Below are a few of the highlights:

  • Add multiple lead ponds
  • Assign access to users for specific lead ponds
  • Define individual settings for auto-emails for leads in lead ponds
  • New notification for reassigned leads
  • Set up lead routing directly to a lead pond

 

Lofty Paid Leads Phone Number Insights

For new leads that enter the Lofty CRM via a Lofty-paid channel (i.e. "Lofty Paid Lead" or "Lofty Listing Ads"), an additional section will provide details regarding the phone number. This information will be added to the lead profile under the Social and Phone Info section and will list (if available) the number, the number holder, and the phone carrier name. This information can provide you with additional insight into reaching the customer for the first time. Please note that if you delete or modify a lead's number, this module will disappear as it will only work with the number that was submitted when the lead was captured via the Lofty -paid channel. This information is made available from the provider used for virtual numbers, call packages, etc.

 

Site 5.9

*IMPORTANT: Features are available for New CMS only. If you have questions about CMS versions, please reference this article.

 

AI Assistant: Listing Recommendations

A new "quick reply" option is available to website visitors who engage with the AI Assistant via website chat. The new option is "Search for properties." Previous options were outlined and made available in Feature Updates for CRM 3.19, Site 5.7. If this option is selected by a site visitor, the AI Assistant will ask them a few questions regarding location, price, etc., as well as try to capture their information if they are not yet registered in the database. If results are available for the criteria they have outlined, a link will be provided to them to see the listings as well as a few listing preview cards to get them interested in the results. This is only available on website chat, not via text message.

More information regarding the AI Assistant can be found HERE.

 

Market Trends Block: Registration Control

The Market Trends block has had an additional setting added that allows for you to display market trend data without requiring registration first. Prior to this release, a site visitor had to register no matter what in order to see the market trend data. Now, the following switch can be turned on or off. By default (and as recommended) this is turned on to require registration first.

For more information on this block, please see Market Trends Block.

 

Site Email Lead Registration

More information regarding forced registration can be found here: Registration Pop-up Style & Settings.

Registration Logic

A new logic has been built into the registration pop-up on certain registration styles for your website. This logic is designed to capture additional email addresses during the registration process, even if the site visitor did not provide all of their information. In other words, if a lead provides at least their email address, but backs out of the process before providing their name and phone number, you will be able to capture an email-only lead after a five minute delay.

*IMPORTANT:

  • Leads captured via this method will have the lead source of "Site Email Lead"
  • If no name is captured the lead will be saved as "No Name"
  • A welcome email will be sent to this lead if their email is captured (it will skip the "lead_first_name" variable if no name is available)
  • This logic is not compatible with the "One Step Column" style meaning you will not be able to capture this type of leads if you are using that registration style.
  • This feature is enabled by default for the other two registration styles ("Single Column" and "Two Columns") and there is currently no option to disable it
  • If you plan to market to these leads, please make sure you are aware of how they entered your system. They did not finish the registration process but they did type in their email address and continued to the next step before backing out (and not providing name/phone).

 

Return to Site Logic

If a site visitor had previously provided their email address but did not finalize registration, the next time they are on your Lofty -built site they will be prompted to provide their phone number to finalize registration. This same pop-up will appear one time per day until they provide a phone number.

 

CTA Block Improvements

New Styles

Four new styles have been added to the CTA Block, three of which are three-column styles. 

New Button Action

A new button action has been added that will allow for you to "Trigger Registration" when a site visitor clicks on the CTA button. So, when clicked, the registration pop-up (see Registration Pop-up Style & Settings) will appear. 

For more information about this block, please reference the following: CTA Block.

 

Agent Subdomains: Manual Creation

In addition to allowing for Agent Subdomains to be created automatically (see Automatic Agent Subdomain Creation), this release will also allow for Team Owners and, in some situations, individual team member/agent users, to create Agent Subdomains manually. This is useful in scenarios where an Agent Subdomain has not been created automatically due to the timing of a domain configuration, etc.

Please note that the conditions for an Agent Subdomain to be created still remain the same. Those can be found under Automatic Agent Subdomain Creation. In other words, even though an Agent Subdomain can be created manually as needed, the criteria remains the same for the system to allow it to happen.

 

Team Owner/Admin

A Team Owner/Admin will now have the option to create an Agent Subdomain directly from the site list: 

The system will then check the criteria to make sure the Agent Subdomain can be created. If it cannot be created, specific feedback will be given as to why. Some scenarios include the Team Website not being on a vanity domain, CNAME settings not being configured correctly, etc.

 

Team Member/Agent

If a team member/agent goes to access the landing page tool or clicks on the CMS but they do not have an Agent Subdomain, they will be presented with a screen showing them the benefits of adding a site along with links to add their own Agent Subdomain or upgrade to an Agent Website.

Just like when the Team Owner tries to create an Agent Subdomain, logic will be in place to explain why it is not possible in some scenarios (i.e. third-level domain, CNAME, .lofty.me, etc.).

Another very important piece to this is regarding how a Team Owner/Admin can lock this down if they do not want multiple sites (Agent Subdomain or Agent Website) on their account other than their Team Website. This can be locked down by navigating to Settings > Agent > Agent Permissions and then turning OFF the switch under Edit Own Website:

This will make it unavailable for the agent user to create an Agent Subdomain or Agent Website via the CMS, landing page, or Marketplace entrances. 

If, in this scenario, an Agent Subdomain is still needed, the Team Owner/Admin can create one manually via their interface (explained above) and then they need to make sure to re-enable the Edit Own Website permission so that the individual team member/agent can access their Agent Subdomain and the available features that come with it. If the permission is not enabled, that agent user will have an Agent Subdomain but will be unable to edit the available fields (outlined HERE).

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com> or by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557.

name: Market Trends Block
title: Market Trends Block
body:
Introduction

This block can be used to display market trends based on data from listings that were sold in the last 12 months. You can add this block where you would like on your website using the CMS. It is also present by default on the Listing Detail, Neighborhood, and Market Snapshot pages.

 

Summary

  • Adding a Market Trends Block
  • Editing the Market Trends Block

 

Adding a Market Trends Block

Open CMS > Page Editor > + Blocks:

Navigate to Market Trends and drag the style that you would like to use to the right side where you want it to display:

 

Editing the Market Trends Block

The Market Trends block is displayed by default on the Listing Detail, Neighborhood, and Market Snapshot pages. You can navigate to one of those pages or find the Market Trends block wherever else you have placed it when Adding a Market Trends Block. Then, double-click on the block or click on the "Edit" icon:

 

Listing Search

Preset Filter

In order for the Market Trends block to display data, a site visitor must input some sort of search criteria. If you would like to pre-populate search criteria, you can use the Preset Filter field to do so. Please note that any search criteria added to the "preset filter" field will be reset by site visitor actions in the search bar on this page.

This behaves just like a search on the website (for sold listing data, of course) where you can add criteria for locations, prices, beds, baths, property types, and more. This will be displayed by default on this block but a site visitor can erase the pre-populated criteria and add their own if they would like:

 

Content

Title

Add a title that you would like to display above the Market Trends block:

 

Button Title

Choose the text that will display on the button inside the Market Trends block:

 

Button Color

Choose the button color:

 

Lead Capture

Require registration to view actual data

By default, the block will be locked until a site visitor registers or signs in on your website. This is by design and is intended to encourage lead capture. This is what that looks like:

However, if you would like to unlock it so that any site visitor can access these market trends, you can toggle this option to OFF:

 

Style

If you would like to adjust the style of this block and choose from one of the other available options, you can click on the Change Style button. You can also add spacing before or after this block as needed.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

title: Feature Updates for CRM 3.20
body:
Introduction

*Please note that the features available to you on the Lofty platform will vary depending on the package you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/agent user). For any questions related to your package, please contact our Support Team for more information.

Monday, February 8, 2021.

      • New Lead in the Lead Pond

CRM 3.20

AI Assistant: Additional Existing Leads Triggers

In addition to existing triggers, the AI Assistant will now send out messages to try and engage with existing leads if they match the following criteria: 

  • The lead was marked at some point in time as a "High Interest" opportunity (see Opportunities > High Interest)
  • The lead has been inactive (meaning they have not visited your Lofty -built IDX website) for 2 weeks and then 4 weeks. 

If this criteria is met, the AI Assistant will send out additional text messages with listing links to try and engage with the lead and qualify them.

For more information on the AI Assistant, please reference the following Help Center section: AI Assistant.

 

Lead Export Improvement

With this update, you now have the ability to export leads directly from the People page. This means that you can use a combination of filters, groups, and pipeline stages to find specific leads to export. Prior to this release you were only able to export as To do so, navigate to the People page, apply filters, etc. as needed, select the three dots, and click Export Leads:

A prompt will then appear to confirm you want to export the current selection:

You will then receive an email when the leads are ready to download into a CSV.

For more information on exporting leads, see Lead Export.

 

Open House Tablet App

Lofty has published the first version of an Open House app designed to be used on Apple and Android tablets. 

  • Google Play Store
  • Apple App Store

The features are basically the same as on the Lofty web app (logging in via your computer) with one important difference–you can use the tablet app offline to collect open house registrants and then synchronize them to your Lofty CRM later when you have WiFi, etc.

For more information on how to use this app, please reference the following article: Open House Tablet App.

name: Open House Tablet App
title: Open House Tablet App
body:
Introduction

Lofty has published an Open House app designed to be used on Apple and Android tablets. The features are basically the same as on the Lofty web app (logging in via your computer) with one important difference–you can use the tablet app offline to collect open house registrants and then synchronize them to your Lofty CRM later when you have WiFi, etc.

For more information on using the "online" version of Open Houses via the CRM, see Open House Forms. This article will refer specifically to the tablet app.

 

Summary

  • Setup
  • How It Works
  • FAQ

 

Setup

Download the App

The app can be downloaded for a tablet device using the following links: 

Apple App Store

Click Here.

Google Play Store

Click Here.

 

Log In

Now that the app is downloaded, log in using your Lofty account (email) and password. You will have to be connected to the internet for this part of the app.

 

How It Works

Main Page

Any open houses created via the web or tablet app will be displayed here

Expand and click on the House icon to open up the form for this open house:

Click the Edit or Delete buttons to perform either of those actions:

 

Add New

To add a new Open House form, click on the "+ Add New" button at the bottom. We suggest that you add this when connected to the internet via WiFi as the MLS address suggestions and listing images will only be loaded with an active connection. 

The fields available on the tablet version for adding a new Open House are the same as with the web app version (see Open House Forms). 

 

Open House Form

Expand and click on the House icon to open up the form for this open house:

After launching an open house form, open house visitors can fill out the form to provide their information and then click the "Submit" button:

With the tablet app, there are two different scenarios that can happen when data is submitted:

With an Internet Connection

After submission, the lead's data will be synced to your CRM automatically. Any notes you've added after their submission will also be synced right away.

Without an Internet Connection (Offline Mode)

After submission, the lead's data will be stored on your tablet's local storage. When connecting to the internet later and opening this app, the data (including any notes you've added) will be synced to your Lofty CRM.

Any open houses that are synced with the CRM will show up with the green checkmark. Those that are not synced with the online CRM will have the grey "x" appear:

 

If leads fail to sync, there will be an error visible on the Open House in the web app CRM. 

 

Once you click View Details, you will see the reason (email duplication or "other") and have the chance to re-upload in scenarios where that failed reason has been resolved. 

 

FAQ

How can I see the leads captured via the Open House tablet app?

Please note that in this initial version, the ability to view leads captured via the open house form on the tablet is not available directly on the tablet. You can see any synced leads in the Lofty web app or mobile app. Future versions will likely provide the ability to preview captured leads.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by a chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Feature Updates for CRM 3.19, Site 5.7
title: Feature Updates for CRM 3.19, Site 5.7
body:
Introduction

*Please note that the features available to you on the Lofty platform will vary depending on the package you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/agent user). For any questions related to your package, please contact our Support Team for more information.

 

Release Date

Tuesday, February 2, 2021.

 

Summary

  • CRM 3.19
    • Sharing Saved Filters 
    • Three Line Dialer: Callback Logic Optimization
    • New Smart Plan Actions
      • (1) Change Pipeline
      • (2) Change Group
      • (3) Change Tag
      • (4) Start Smart Plan
      • (5) Buyer Property Alert
    • Listing Ads
  • Site 5.7
    • AI Assistant: Quick Reply for Website
    • Google Chrome One-Click Website Registration: Mobile Support
    • Copy Page
    • Sold Listing Detail Page Improvements

 

CRM 3.19

Sharing Saved Filters 

When saving filters on the People page of the Lofty CRM, a new option is available for sharing. Saving a filter is done by applying the criteria > clicking FILTER > Save Filter:

Saved Filters can now be created and shared by the Team Owner/Admin or those with the "Manage Team" permission (see Team Permissions).

These filters are still found under Saved Filters, but now they can be searched:

And there are three separate categories for how these filters are organized:

  • Default Filters. The pre-built saved filters available to all Lofty users.
  • Team Filters. Can be used by anyone on the team but can only be added by the Team Owner/Admin or those who have the "Manage Team" permission (see Team Permissions).
  • Private Filters. Only visible to individual users who have added them.

 

Three Line Dialer: Callback Logic Optimization

*Only available to users who have purchased the Three Line Dialer package.

For context, the Three Line Dialer has the ability to dial up to three lines at a time. The Lofty user is able to have a conversation with the first person to "pick up" the call. On some calling sessions, one person could pick up the call followed by a second person shortly after. The existing logic in place will simply play a callback message for that second person and a Lofty user must pause the call list, manually find that person in their CRM, and then dial them back if they want to connect to them.

This update allows for the additional individuals who answered the call after the first one to be called immediately after the first call ends. They will still hear a recorded callback message but then they will be called immediately after the first call ends. If a third call happened to be answered as well, it would also add them to the list to call back before it returned to the three line mode. There is no manual input required to make this happen, the second person will immediately be called back if they had answered more or less at the same time as the first. 

*IMPORTANT: With the technology currently available, there is no way to identify whether a call is being answered by a real person or by a voice machine. This means that any time a call is "picked up," it's possible that it is only an automatic voice message machine.

 

New Smart Plan Actions

The most exciting part of this release is the addition of new actions in Smart Plans. Prior to this release, you could do the following with Smart Plans:

  • Auto Email
  • Auto Text
  • Tasks
    • Email
    • Call
    • Text
    • Other
    • Checklist
  • Slybroadcast Voice Message Drop (see Slybroadcast Integration)

With this update, the following new actions have been added to that list:

  1. Change Pipeline
  2. Change Group
  3. Change Tag
  4. Start Smart Plan
  5. Buyer Property Alert

 

(1) Change Pipeline

With this action, the Smart Plan will move leads to the pipeline stage selected using the drop-down menu.

Please note the following:

  • This action cannot be selected if the Smart Plan is set up to auto pause when "The lead's pipeline changes." If this action is selected in the Smart Plan, that auto-pause checkbox will be greyed-out and unavailable.
  • If the selected pipeline stage is renamed, the Smart Plan will auto-adjust to that renamed pipeline stage
  • If the selected pipeline stage is deleted, the system will check to see if that same name has been added again when it gets to the "Change Pipeline" step. If the same name does exist, it will change them to that pipeline stage. If it no longer exists, the Smart Plan will be paused automatically due to the fact that the pipeline stage no longer exists. The plan can then be resumed manually by confirming that the step can be skipped.

Please note that existing plans with the checkbox marked and an action defined at the END of a Smart Plan using the setting for "When this plan ends, automatically move leads to Pipeline" will notice that this will no longer be available and that this will be replaced by this new action type instead as an individual step.

 

(2) Change Group

With this action, the Smart Plan can add or remove a lead from the indicated group(s). 

Please note the following:

  • When adding to a group. . .
    • If the selected group is renamed, the Smart Plan will auto-adjust to that renamed group
    • If the selected group is deleted, the system will check to see if that same group name has been added again when it gets to the "Change Group" step of the Smart Plan. If the same group name does exist, it will add them to that group. If the same name does not exist, but the user is the Team Owner/Admin or a user with the "Manage Team" permission (see Team Permissions), the system will simply create a new group with that same name and add the lead to the new group. Otherwise, the Smart Plan will be paused automatically due to the fact that the group no longer exists. The plan can then be resumed manually by confirming that the step can be skipped.
  • When removing from a group. . .
    • If the selected group is renamed, the Smart Plan will auto-adjust to that renamed group
    • If the selected group is deleted, the Smart Plan will skip this step in the Smart Plan

Please note that existing plans with the checkbox marked and an action defined at the END of a Smart Plan using the setting for "When this plan ends, automatically move leads to Group" will notice that this will no longer be available and that this will be replaced by this new action type instead as an individual step.

 

(3) Change Tag

With this action, the Smart Plan can add or remove the indicated tag(s) to a lead.

Please note the following:

  • This action cannot be selected if the Smart Plan is set up to auto pause when "The tags that triggered the Smart Plan are deleted." If this action is selected in the Smart Plan, that auto-pause checkbox will be greyed-out and unavailable.
  • When adding a tag to a lead. . .
    • If the selected tag is renamed, the Smart Plan will auto-adjust to that renamed tag
    • If the selected tag is deleted, the system will check to see if that same tag name has been added again when it gets to the "Change Tag" step of the Smart Plan. If the same tag name does exist, it will add that tag to the lead. If the same name does not exist, but the user is the Team Owner/Admin or a user with the "Manage Team" permission (see Team Permissions), the system will simply create a new Shared Tag with that same name and add it to the lead. Otherwise, the system will create a Private Tag and apply it to the lead.
  • When removing a tag from a lead. . .
    • If the selected tag is renamed, the Smart Plan will auto-adjust to that renamed tag
    • If the selected tag is deleted, the Smart Plan will skip this step in the Smart Plan

 

(4) Start Smart Plan

With this action, the Smart Plan can trigger the start of another Smart Plan.

Please note the following:

  • If the Lead Type of a lead going through the plan does not match that of the plan being triggered, this action will be skipped.
  • If the Smart Plan being edited is a "My Smart Plan," you will be able to select plans in either "My Plans" or "Team Plans" to trigger after this one ends.
  • If the Smart Plan being edited is a "Team Smart Plan," you will only be able to select other "Team Plans" to trigger after this one ends.
  • A Smart Plan cannot trigger itself.

Please note that existing plans with the checkbox marked and an action defined at the END of a Smart Plan using the setting for "When this plan ends, automatically start another smart plan" will notice that this will no longer be available and that this will be replaced by this new action type instead as an individual step.

 

(5) Buyer Property Alert

With this Smart Plan action, you can set up a specific property alert to apply to the leads that go through the Smart Plan. Once you choose to set the criteria, the interface is just like when you manually create a property alert for leads:

After setting up the alert, a summary will display within the Smart Plan as shown here:

Please note that this will not work if the lead is a SELLER lead type as the system does not allow for buyer alerts to be set up for seller leads. If the lead is a SELLER lead than this step will simply be skipped for them on the Smart Plan. 

 

Listing Ads

Though this Listing Ads feature has been beta testing for a few months now, it is now available for all users. You now have the ability to run listing ad promotions directly via your Campaigns tab in your Lofty CRM. For more information, please check out the following article: Listing Ads.

 

Site 5.7

*IMPORTANT: Features are available for New CMS only. If you have questions about CMS versions, please reference this article.

 

AI Assistant: Quick Reply for Website

If you have it enabled, when site visitors arrive at your Lofty-built IDX website, the AI Assistant will prompt the visitor to engage in a conversation so that it can qualify them. Once they click the dialogue option, the following options will now appear and were built based on common responses that are sent back to the initial prompt:

  • I want to buy
  • I want to rent
  • I want to sell
  • Just browsing

As a reminder, this conversation will only count against the AI Assistant conversation allotment if the site visitor is captured by the AI Assistant. "Capture" means a lead has been obtained with email, phone, or both. For more information regarding the AI Assistant please see AI Assistant in the Help Center.

 

Google Chrome One-Click Website Registration: Mobile Support

Previously, support on the Chrome browser for one-click website registration was added for websites being viewed on desktop Chrome sessions. Now, with this release, Chrome one-click website registration is supported on the mobile version of Chrome.

For more information on how this feature works, please see Google Chrome One-Click Website Registration.

 

Copy Page

Certain pages on your Lofty IDX website can now be copied with the click of a button. Please note that there are other pages that cannot be copied due to their global settings as configured with the remaining aspects of the website.

The pages that cannot be copied are the following:

  • Standard Website Pages
    • All Listings
    • Listing Detail (Property Detail)
    • Neighborhood Groups
    • Agent Detail
    • Blog Detail
  • Landing Pages
    • Single Property Promotion
    • Listing Live Tour

To copy a page, simply find a page (that is supported for copying), hover over it, and click on the "Copy" icon:

 

Sold Listing Detail Page Improvements

In order to improve lead capture on the sold listing detail pages, the following information will now be provided directly on this page:

  • Estimated current property price 
  • CTA (Call To Action) for a home evaluation in multiple locations
  • Trends within the zip code/area
  • Median price
  • Average sold price for the neighborhood
  • Etc.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com> or by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557.

name: Media Blocks
title: Media Blocks
body:
Introduction

The Blocks in the Media category allow you to more effectively display high-quality video and images at full screen width and with different background colors, etc.

Summary

  • Adding Media Blocks
  • Video Block Types
  • Zoom Live Block
  • Youtube Live Block
  • Facebook Live Block

 

Adding Media Blocks

To add Media Blocks, navigate to the CMS > Page Editor > + Blocks:

Scroll down and find "Media".

 

There are multiple types of Media blocks, including Image, Video, and Live. 

 

Video Block Types

There are four different styles available for the video block:

Single Video

The first type of video block is "Single Video." You can input your YouTube URL or upload your video, edit the video title, background color, and style as you would like. This is what these fields look like before editing:

The video settings default to showing a progress bar, so do not forget to choose the other options if you would prefer to adjust this. 

 

Double Videos

The second video block style is called "Double Videos." This style has two columns for displaying the videos (this cannot be customized at present). As you can see in the picture, it is divided into the left and the right, and you can edit them separately.

Here is what the settings for this style look like:

The video play method is forced to play because there are multiple videos. It will also show the progress bar by default and unmute the volume when played. 

 

Video List

The third style of this block is presented as a video list. This is typically used for showing more than two videos, and you can choose the columns (2-5) and spacing (0-50) as you would like. You can set the title and descriptions as well as the background of the block.

Just like with the "Double Videos" style, the video play method is forced to play because there are multiple videos. It will also show the progress bar by default and unmute the volume when played. You can also customize what order in which the videos are displayed on the site.

 

Virtual Tour

The last style of the video block is for displaying virtual tours and videos in a large format:

You can upload multiple videos and multiple virtual tour links using this option. You can also edit the titles of the video and virtual tour sections displayed on the site. The background color can also be adjusted.

 

Zoom Live Block

Here are the different items that can be edited for this block:

  • Live Name: The title of the block.
  • Live Description: The description of the block.
  • API Key: Paste in the "API Key" that was obtained at the beginning of this process
  • API Secret: Paste in the "API Secret" that was obtained at the beginning of this process
  • Meeting ID: Paste in the Zoom "Meeting ID" (for more information on this see What is a Meeting ID?)
  • Meeting Password: Paste in the meeting password (for more information see Meeting and webinar passwords)

*IMPORTANT: Please note that currently all Zoom Meetings that are integrated into the Lofty website will be set to be public so that all leads can participate directly.

 

Schedule a Zoom Live Meeting

Before you start, make sure you have a Zoom Live meeting scheduled and that you have the meeting link available. Click HERE to learn how to schedule a Zoom Live/Meeting.

 

API Key and API Secret

In order to integrate Zoom into a Lofty website, you will first need to obtain the Zoom API Key and API Secret at https://marketplace.zoom.us/. For detailed instructions, please reference the following YouTube video that explains it well: How to Generate Zoom API Key

 

Youtube Live Block

This feature is designed to allow Lofty users to add a YouTube Live stream block to their Lofty website.

The following are the options that can be edited on the YouTube Live block:

  1. Live Name. This is the title of the block.
  2. Live Description. The description of the block.
  3. Live Embed Type. Choose the integrated type for the YouTube Live Block.
    • Live Embed Code: We do not recommend choosing this option.
    • Live URL: Paste the YouTube Live URL that you copied in the "Schedule a YouTube Live Stream" step.

 

Schedule a YouTube Live Stream 

Before you start, make sure that you have a YouTube livestream scheduled and that you have the URL to the live stream ready to go.

  • Click HERE to learn how to schedule a YouTube Live stream
  • Another useful video on this topic can be found HERE

Be sure to click the "share" button and then "COPY" so you can grab the stream URL and add it into Lofty later in the CMS Tool.

 

 

 

Facebook Live Block

This feature is designed to allow Lofty users to add a Facebook Live stream block to their Lofty website.

Before you start, make sure you have a Facebook Live stream scheduled and that you have the Facebook Live embed code. Here are the steps:

  1. Access Facebook Live Producer at facebook.com/live/producer.
  2. Click "Schedule a Live Video" on the left sidebar.
  3. A new window will appear on the left side of the screen. Scroll down and fill in the time and date the video will go live, where the post should appear, and the title and description of the live video.
  4. If all of the previously mentioned fields have been filled out correctly, the grey "Schedule Live Video" button at the bottom of the page will turn blue. Click this button to schedule your broadcast.
  5. Finally, click Settings > Stream > Embed Code, and then copy the embed code to use further along in the process.

 

 

If needed, the video found HERE might provide some useful context on how to set this up.

 

*Please Note* The video will remain on the block if it is not deleted and still set to "public".

 

The following are the options that can be edited on the Facebook Live block:

  1. Live Name. This is the title of the block.
  2. Live Description. The description of the block.
  3. Live Embed Type. Choose the integrated type for the Facebook Live Block.
    • Live Embed Code: This is the recommended option because it's easy to find. Paste the code that was copied at the end of the "Schedule a Facebook Live Stream" step at the beginning of the article.
    • Live URL: Paste the Facebook Live post URL that you copied in the "Schedule a YouTube Live Stream" step.

Troubleshooting Tips

If you are having issues with Facebook Live, try these steps before contacting Lofty support. 

  • Ensure that Facebook Live streaming is set to "public".
  • Make sure you are not using the camera with another application on your device.
  • Use the "embed code" option, please refer to Schedule a Facebook Live stream.
  • Try to copy the "embed code" after successfully scheduling or creating a live stream:

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by a chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

 

Related terms: Gallery, CMS tool, blocks

name: Feature Updates for CRM 3.18 and Site 5.6
title: Feature Updates for CRM 3.18 and Site 5.6
body:
Introduction

*Please note that the features available to you on the Lofty platform will vary depending on the package you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/agent user). For any questions related to your package, please contact our Support Team for more information.

 

Release Date

Tuesday, January 19, 2021.

 

Summary

  • CRM 3.18
    • Integrations Placed in Lofty Marketplace
    • AI Assistant: Follow-Up Optimizations
    • AI Assistant: Mute Optimization
    • Call/Text Timeline Optimization
    • Lead Pond: Visible Pipeline
  • Site 5.6
    • Gallery Block
    • Pocket Listings Image Drag & Drop 
    • Image Previews on Listings Lists
    • Website Agent Settings
    • Agent Block Improvement

 

CRM 3.18

Integrations Placed in Lofty Marketplace

You can now find all of our integrations directly in the Lofty Marketplace:

 

AI Assistant: Follow-Up Optimizations

Increased Number of Follow-Up Texts

This update increases the number of follow-up texts sent by the AI Assistant (for when a new lead does not respond) from two to four. The goal is to improve the text response rate by giving leads more opportunities to engage with the AI Assistant.

New Follow-Up Trigger

A new trigger has been added with this release. When an existing lead is captured via any other source (in Lofty this is considered a "Back On Market" opportunity), the AI Assistant will follow up with this existing lead regarding their new inquiries to try to qualify them and capture their buying/selling preferences.

 

AI Assistant: Mute Optimization

With this update, when clicking on the "Mute" button to stop the AI Assistant from working a lead, there will be a question asked:

"Do you still want the AI Assistant to follow up this lead in the future if they trigger opportunities (requests a showing, saves a listing, etc.)?

Based on the option selected, the following will occur:

  • Yes: The AI Assistant will be muted only while in the "New Leads" pipeline stage. After that, if the lead matches the criteria to be re-engaged, the AI Assistant will still follow up with this lead in the future.
  • No: The AI will be muted permanently (this is what currently happens when clicking "Mute")

The criteria to re-engage is the same as can be seen in the settings for "EXISTING LEAD qualification via text message."

 

Call/Text Timeline Optimization

With this update, you will be able to better distinguish texts and calls between family members on the same lead profile. You will be able to see who sent the message or made the call and from what number, as well as who was called/texted and at what number. Previously, this information would blend together and look as if it was always with the primary lead. Now, it will display which family member the number belongs to. 

Please note that this currently only applies to calls and texts, not emails that are sent/received with family members of leads.

 

Lead Pond: Visible Pipeline

Prior to this update, the pipeline was not visible in the lead pond and could therefore not be used for sorting leads. Now, however, it is visible in the Lead Pond.

More information regarding the lead pond can be found here: Lead Pond.

 

Site 5.6

*IMPORTANT: Features are available for New CMS only. If you have questions about CMS version, please reference this article.

 

Gallery Block

This block allows for you to more effectively display multiple images. There are four different settings that can be adjusted: (1) Content (title, images), background, display mode, and style. It can be full screen width and have different background colors.

When there are more than four images, two display modes are available: (1) Horizontal Slider and (2) Vertical Tiles. There is currently no limit to how many images can be added.

There are two different scenarios where the functionality varies:

  1. Listing details pages. When used on listing details pages, the images for this block will be auto-populated with the property’s images from the MLS. These images cannot be changed so there is no configuration available here.
  2. All other pages (including landing pages). Everywhere else, any image can be uploaded to build out the block. 

For more information about this bloc, please reference: Gallery Block.

 

Pocket Listings Image Drag & Drop 

When adding/editing images for pocket listings (see How to Add Pocket Listings), you can now drag and drop to reorder the images instead of having to re-upload, etc. Simply click and hold anywhere on the image to move it around. 

 

Image Previews on Listings Lists

An exciting improvement has been made on both the desktop and mobile views of lists showing the listings on a Lofty website. In other words, when performing a property search or browsing featured listings, etc., there is a list of properties displayed. Normally, only the first image for the property is displayed right next to the basic property details. Now, however, the rest of the images for those properties can be previewed. On desktop, this is done by clicking on the arrows left/right. On a mobile device, site visitors can swipe with their finger left/right directly on the list. 

 

Website Agent Settings

A change has been made to the CMS for agent settings that will make it more intuitive when adding and maintaining your agent lists on the website. Instead of having two separate lists for the "Creator" and "Agents," this is now all on one list. The list will be in alphabetical order. 

Previous Interface:

Updated Interface:

Now, there is also no separate menu for adding social networks because this is to be done when editing each agent directly instead–along with a different address for their profile if needed:

 

Agent Block Improvement

The following improvements have been made to the Agent Block:

(1) Agent profiles can be edited directly via the "Edit" icon within the block instead of having to navigate back to settings.

(2) If you would like for site visitors to be redirected when they click the headshots for users, you can now add a an external URL in the agent settings.

(3) You can easily arrange all the agents currently selected to display in this block to be rearranged in alphabetical order with a simple switch.

For more information on the Agent Block, please see Agent Block.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com> or by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557.

name: Understanding Website Options: Agent Websites vs. Vanity Domain Sites vs. Full SEO Sites
title: Understanding Website Options: Agent Websites vs. Vanity Domain Sites vs. Full SEO Sites
body:
Introduction

When building your online presence with Lofty, you have three main website options. Each serves a different purpose and offers varying levels of customization, branding, and SEO capabilities. This article covers what you need to know.

Summary

  • Agent Websites
  • Vanity Domain Sites
  • Full SEO Sites
  • Quick Comparison Table
  • Which Option Should You Choose?

Agent Websites

What it is:
An Agent Website is the most basic option, designed to give agents a quick and easy way to establish an online presence. These sites are typically created automatically when an agent activates their Lofty account.

Agent Websites are a carbon copy of its parent website.

Key Features:

  • Domain: Uses a subdomain, like firstname.companyname.com.
  • Cost: Included at no extra charge.
  • Customization: Limited. You can edit basic elements like the header and hero section but cannot add custom pages.
  • MLS Integration: Inherits MLS feeds from the parent site (Full SEO Website).
  • SEO: Minimal. No individual SEO optimization tools.

Best For:
Agents who need a simple, functional site without investing in branding or advanced marketing features. 

Vanity Domain Sites

What it is:
A Vanity Domain upgrade allows you to replace your subdomain with a custom domain, like yourname.com. This is a branding enhancement that makes your site look more professional and easier for clients to remember.

Vanity Domain Sites start as a carbon copy of its parent website, but have a custom domain and can be edited.

Key Features:

  • Domain: Custom vanity domain.
  • Cost: $20/month.
  • Customization: Moderate. You can edit navigation, add custom pages, and personalize templates.
  • MLS Integration: Inherits MLS feeds from the parent site (Full SEO Website).
  • SEO: Basic SEO tools available, but not as comprehensive as Full SEO sites.

Best For:
Agents who want their website to reflect their branding, without customizing an entire website.

Full SEO Sites

What it is:
A Full SEO site is the premium option for agents serious about online marketing. It includes advanced SEO tools, full customization, and enhanced MLS integration.

Full SEO Sites are completely unique and designed by you.

Key Features:

  • Domain: Custom vanity domain required.
  • Cost: $79/month.
  • Customization: Fully editable. Custom pages, blogs, featured areas, scripts, and styles.
  • MLS Integration: Must complete MLS applications.
  • SEO: Comprehensive SEO checklist, meta tags, keyword optimization, and blog capabilities.

Best For:
Agents who want to maximize lead generation, improve search rankings, and build a strong digital brand

Quick Comparison Table

 

Which Option Should You Choose?

  • Agent Website: If you need a quick, no-cost solution.
  • Vanity Domain Site: If branding and professionalism are priorities.
  • Full SEO Site: If you want maximum visibility, lead generation, and customization.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your CRM.

name: Custom Fields
title: Custom Fields
body:
Introduction

Custom fields can be added to your Lofty instance as a way to save information in a pre-planned spot that needs to be available for every lead. When you add a custom field to the settings, you will be able to then add data to that field when editing a lead record.

 

Summary

  • Creating Custom Fields
  • Adding Data to Custom Fields
  • Using Custom Fields
    • Accessing Via Lead Profile Page
    • Access Via Columns on People Page
    • Filter by Custom Fields
    • Using In Email/Text Variables
  • Exporting Custom Fields

 

Creating Custom Fields

To add custom fields, navigate to Settings > Custom Fields > + Add New Field:

Give the field a name that you will recognize later. This field name will appear next to the field when editing the lead record:

Choose the Data Type for the field. You can create 50 of each custom field (a total of 350).

  • Text
  • Date
  • Number
  • Percentage
  • Currency
  • Single-Select
  • Multi-Select

 

Notice: The Starter package is limited to 10 custom fields per type, but the rest is 50 per type. If you are still using a Starter package and are interested in using this feature to its full effect, don't hesitate to contact support(support@lofty.com) to get upgrade options.

 

Adding Data to Custom Fields

To add data to custom fields, simply navigate to a lead profile page > click the three dots > Edit Details:

 

Scroll down and find the custom field(s) where you would like to add data and do so directly in that field. The example below shows "Favorite Color" as a custom field, but you will, of course, be adding the information to whichever fields you have created:

 

Using Custom Fields

Accessing Via Lead Profile Page

When custom field data has been added, it will appear on each lead profile under the Details section. This example below is for a custom field called "Favorite Color," and because it has information in it, the field will appear. If a custom field is left blank on a lead profile, it will not appear:

 

Access Via Columns on the People Page

You can add each custom field as a column on the People page. This allows for more visibility into custom field data across multiple leads, as well as the ability to sort. The sorting logic is as follows, depending on the custom field type:

  • Date: Oldest to Newest, Newest to Oldest
  • Number: Highest to Lowest, Lowest to Highest
  • Text: A-Z, Z-A

Note: Empty custom fields will always be last when sorting.

 

Filter by Custom Fields

You can filter and therefore search your leads by using custom fields. This is accessed via the Custom Fields header under Advanced Filter.

 

Using In Email/Text Variables

For more information on how to use custom field data in email/text variables, please see Email and Text Variables: Custom Fields.

 

Exporting Custom Fields

Custom fields will be available in a CSV export. For more information on exporting leads from Lofty, see Lead Export.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your CRM.

name: Lead Profile Page
title: Lead Profile Page
body:
Introduction

One of the busiest, most-used, and most important pages in the Lofty platform is the Lead Profile Page. This refers to the page where all the information known about a lead is saved, recorded, and utilized in future interactions. The lead profile page is also known as a "contact record" or "lead detail page." 

Summary

  • Accessing a Lead Profile Page
  • Left Panel - Contact Details, Lead Assignment, Etc.
  • Overview
  • Properties
  • Searches
  • Transactions
  • Documents
  • Automations

Accessing a Lead Profile Page

Via People Page

First, click on the People page, apply filters, select segments/pipeline stages, etc. to find the lead that you would like to access, then click on the lead's name to open the lead profile page:

You will then be directed immediately to the lead's profile page whose name you clicked.

 

Via Search Bar

Use the search bar at the top-right of the CRM to search for a lead. You can search by any of the following:

  • Name
  • Email
  • Phone
  • Address

Once you have found the lead whose profile you would like to open, click on their name:

You can also click on the "View More" button to see other potential matches. It will redirect you to the People page with all potential matches. Just make sure that you remove any applied filters to see all the potential matches and not just those that align with the filters applied.

Left Panel - Contact Details, Lead Assignment, Etc.

Name, Lead Type

The lead's name is outlined in the top-left of a lead profile. The lead type of the lead is presented just below the lead's name:

  • Buyer
  • Seller
  • Renter
  • Investor
  • Agent
  • Homeowner
  • Landlord
  • Other

Edit Details, Send Welcome Email, Delete Lead

Click on the three dots to edit a lead's details (add/remove phone numbers, email addresses, etc.), delete a lead, welcome email, or send Mailers.

  • Deleting a lead will only send it to the "Deleted Leads" area accessible via the People page. This serves as a type of "recycle bin." To completely remove the lead from the system, you must go to People > Delete Leads > select the lead and then erase it. 
  • You can add a maximum of five email addresses to a lead
  • You can add a maximum of five phone numbers to a lead
  • For more information regarding the Welcome Email, see Set Up the Welcome Email.
  • You can send direct mail to the lead from this area as well

You can also add more phone numbers or email addresses to a lead by clicking on the + icon that appears when you hover over an existing number:

Change Pipeline or Segment(s)

If you would like to adjust the pipeline stage that this lead is in or choose specific segments to add/remove them to/from, you can do so with this line here.

  • A lead can only be on one pipeline stage at a time
  • A lead can belong to as many segments as you would like
  • Keep in mind that adding a lead to a new pipeline stage or segment could trigger a Smart Plan if that is how you have them set up (see Smart Plans)

 

Call, Text, and Email

*IMPORTANT: You will need the Dialer Package to use the "Call" feature and a Text Package to use the "Text" Feature. For more information please see Add Call or Text Packages.

Call

Calling via the lead profile would fit into the category of "Click to Call" functionality. You can learn more about how this process works by reviewing the following article: "Click to Call" Function. Click on the "Call" button, or you can choose the drop-down to choose a specific number or family member to dial:

Text

To text via a lead profile, hit the "Text" button or click the drop-down to choose the number or family member you want to send a text to. To learn more about sending texts in Lofty, refer to Texting via Lofty.

Email

Click on the "Email" button to send an email to this lead or their family member. 

  • By default, the email will be sent from your integrated email address (see Integrations)
  • If you see a pop-up appear that says you need to integrate your email account, but you do not plan on doing so, you can close out of the pop-up and click the "Email" button again to send the email from the @lofty.com email address (see @lofty.com Email Address)
  • If family members are associated with this lead, their email address will automatically be added to the "To" line.

Family Member Profiles

You can add up to four "family members" to a specific lead. This feature was built to allow for spouses/partners/etc. to be listed together and facilitate communication with both of them. 

To add/edit family members, you can click on the three dots > Edit Details:

It is also possible to add a family member to an existing lead by merging from a separate lead. For more information, see Merging Leads. Family member contact information is available in the call/text/email options. All activity recorded for communication with family members will be recorded on the primary lead's profile, but will indicate which family member was communicated with.

 

Review All Lead Details

All lead details that have had information provided will be displayed in the left column, like so:

  • Source. For more information, see Lead Source Logic.
  • Reg Date. The date the lead was entered into your Lofty database.
  • Other Fields. The other fields will vary depending on which custom fields were completed, whether the lead registered on your website, and indicated if they are a first-time home buyer, etc.

 

Social Network Info

This field is auto-generated based on a third-party source integrated with Lofty. This service will attempt to populate social media profiles for the lead's email address, etc. If none populate, it might be due to privacy settings on that social platform. 

You can always add social network info manually by clicking on the Edit icon.

 

Insight / Lead Score

The lead score can be very valuable when comparing leads and determining whether they have what is needed to close a deal, etc.

If you would like to know what is contributing to a lead's lead score, you can click on the blue Analysis button. You can then review the top indicators, web activities, communication, etc. that have contributed towards the lead score.

This lead score is calculated automatically. You will be unable to edit this score manually.

 

Properties

See below for Engagement > Properties. This section is just a simple version of what is displayed there.

 

Search Criteria

See below for Engagement > Search Criteria. This section is just a simple version of what is displayed there.

 

Assigned To

This section displays who is assigned to the lead. The default roles in this section are the following:

  • Agent. The user listed here is considered the primary owner of the lead for reporting, etc. Property alerts will be sent from the user listed in this slot.
  • Assistant. Any user can be added to this slot. Other than a lender-type account.
  • Lender. Only a lender-type account can be listed here--you cannot add a standard agent/member user to this slot. For more information regarding this type of account, see Being a Lender with Lofty.

Any additional roles that appear are via Custom Roles.

When another user is added to any of these slots, they will receive an email and a push notification informing them that they have been assigned to this lead. The users in any of these slots can edit anything on a lead profile or reassign the lead.

One of the most common reasons to use the Assigned To slot of a lead profile is due to lead privacy (see Lead Privacy: Team Leads vs. Private Leads) because anyone listed on this lead in these slots has access to the lead, even if they do not have admin access to view all leads.

To automatically add users to these Assigned To slots, you will use lead routing. More information regarding lead routing can be found here: Lead Routing Rules.

Lead Sharing Link

The lead's profile can be quickly shared with another user on your account by sending them a link to the lead. Please note:

  • Private leads cannot be shared
  • You can only share a lead that you are assigned to in the primary agent role

To share a lead, click the Share icon on the lead's profile.
 

This functionality is also available in the Lofty mobile app.

When clicking the Share icon, the following pop-up provides the share link, as well as a setting that authorizes who can access the lead via the link.

The options are:

  1. Only users who have permission to view the lead can access it via the link
    1. This means that the Lofty user must either have the Access All Team Leads permission enabled or be assigned to the lead on some level
  2. All users on my account can access it via the link
    1. This means that any user on the Lofty account can access the lead via the share link, regardless of their permission level

When viewing a lead that has been shared with you, a "Shared" tag will be visible in the upper left corner of the lead detail page.

You cannot share a lead that has been shared with you.

 

Overview

This is the first tab of a lead profile. When this tab is selected, the panels explained individually below are visible.

Notes

Use notes to remember important details about your lead. Adding a note will not count towards your Last Touch filter or reporting. You can enter a maximum of 20,000 characters per note. 

Lofty's rich text editor supports formatting through font, bullet points, links, and emojis. 

You can also @tag people, and they will receive notifications. For more information on how to do this, see Agent-to-Agent Lead Collaboration.

 

Manually Logging Communication

Activity done using a Lofty call/text package or via an integrated email account (see above) is all logged automatically on a lead profile. However, if you would like to manually log communication, you can do so right at the top of this section:

Manually logged communication does count toward reporting. 

Use the "Pin to Top" checkbox to save the activity at the top of the activities timeline.

 

Lead Page Overview 

The Lead Page Overview records all communication, lead website activity (search, viewed listing, favorite listing, Request a Showing), and system logs associated with this lead. Use the filters at the top if you would like to specify a certain type of activity that you would like to review:

 

Appointments

For more information on how to use Appointments, please see Appointments.

 

Tasks

For more information on how to use tasks, see Task Management. 

Also related to tasks are Transaction Management Checklists.

 

Properties

The Properties tab stores the leads owned properties. Quick actions allow you to send a CMA, send a Home Report, create a transaction, or edit/delete the property.

Learn more here: How To Add a Property Address Under Lead's Preferences

Searches

The Searches tab provides quick access to viewed and favorited listings, requested showings, and offers.

Preference Profiles

The Preference Profile is the lead's preferences in their home search. The Primary Profile is the lead's primary preferences, and is used by any feature referencing Search Criteria. Learn more here: Lead Preference Profiles

Showings Section:

Includes a centralized list of all logged showings with filters and approval actions (Accept/Delete). The “Log a Showing” button opens the standard showing logging flow.

Transactions

This tab is associated specifically with Transaction Management. A transaction must live on a lead profile (you cannot have a transaction NOT associated with a lead), so this is where you will add them or reference them as needed. For more information regarding transactions, please see Transaction Management Introduction. 

Documents

This section holds the documents associated with the lead. For each file, the limit is 10 MB. There is no limit to the number of files that can be added to one lead.

Automations

 

If you need to resubscribe someone to property alert or market report emails, you can do so from the settings cog wheel.

Property Alerts

See Property Alerts & Market Snapshots (Lead Engagement).

 

Market Snapshots

See Property Alerts & Market Snapshots (Lead Engagement).

 

Market Reports

See Market Reports.

 

Smart Plans

This tab will give you a reference of the Smart Plans that you have applied to this lead, Smart Plans that have ended or paused for some reason, etc. 

You can also manage whether you want to resubscribe someone to Smart Plan auto-texts/emails via this tab:

For more information regarding Smart Plans, see Smart Plans.

 

FAQs

  • Is there a way to connect multiple lead profile pages other than adding them as family members within the same profile?
  • If I am looking at a list of leads, is there an easy way to navigate between lead profiles within that list?
  • Why is there a phone number and information listed in the Social and Phone Info section? 

Is there a way to connect multiple lead profile pages other than adding them as family members within the same profile?

Currently, there is no built-in link option. However, there are a couple of options to link multiple lead profiles together. Typically, the goal of doing so is to document who referred someone, who the agent is they are working with on the buying/selling side, etc. 

First, you need to understand that each lead profile has a unique URL. So, when you are on a lead profile, you can copy that URL and paste it into two different locations. 

 

Option 1: Save and pin a note

Paste the URL for the lead you want to connect to this one into a note? You can just pin it to the top for easy reference in the future if you'd like.

Option 2: Create and use a custom field

Create a custom field for "Referred By" or whatever your use case is. See Custom Fields for more information on how to do so. Then, you can add the URL to that custom field by clicking on the three dots > Edit Details and finding the custom field. This link then becomes clickable. You can also filter by custom fields on the People page.

 

If I am looking at a list of leads, is there an easy way to navigate between lead profiles within that list?

Yes. If you go to the People page and click into a lead profile from a list, you will have an option available in the bottom-left that you can use to open up a list or go back or forward on the existing list to easily view the lead profile and move to the next or previous one in line.

 

Are notes searchable?

Yes, the following types of notes can be searched:

  • Manual Notes (including those made for calls, emails, and texts)
  • System Logs

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

Related terms: lead link, lead detail page, lead sharing link

name: Lead Organization with Filters
title: Lead Organization with Filters
body:
Introduction

The main purpose of any CRM is to provide an organization with what can be done with a typical spreadsheet or contact list. In Lofty, this mainly happens on the People Page and consists of Pipelines, Segments, Tags, and a variety of filters. This article will introduce how to use the available filters.

 

Summary

  • Saved Filters
    • Default Filters
    • Team Filters
    • Private Filters
  • Filter by Address
  • All Filters
    • (1) Agent or Lead Pond
    • (2) Lead Details
      • Lead Type
      • Opportunities
      • Source
      • Tags
      • Reg Date
      • Lead Score
      • Price
      • Profile Details
      • Close Date
      • Contact Info
      • Undelivered Text Date
    • (3) Lead Nurturing
      • Smart Plan
      • Market Report
      • Property Alert
      • Subscription
    • (4) Lead Activity
      • Last Touch
      • Last Website Visit
