name: CTA Block
title: CTA Block
body:
Introduction

CTA stands for "Call To Action" and is well-known among those with experience building websites. A CTA is used to encourage site visitors to visit specific pages and act on what is being suggested to them. The Lofty block library has several types of CTA blocks that can be used on any page. This article explains how these blocks work and can be added/edited via the CMS Tool. 

 

Summary

  • Adding a CTA Block
  • Editing a CTA Block

 

Adding a CTA Block

First, from the Page Editor, click on the "+ Blocks" button.

Choose the CTA option from the library and then drag the desired style to the right side where you would like to place it on the right.

 

Editing a CTA Block

To edit a CTA block, double-click on the block or click on the "Edit" icon in the top-right of that block.

 

Edit Options

When editing a CTA block, the configurable options will vary depending on the style of the block. Across all CTA block styles, you will see a mix of the following settings that can be adjusted:

  • Background
    • Desktop Image
    • Mobile Image
    • Background Type
      • Color 
      • Image
    • Border Color
  • Block Size
    • Desktop Size Type
    • Height
    • Mobile Size Type
    • Mobile Height
  • Style
    • Add spacing before/after the block
  • Opacity Layer
    • Show Opacity Layer
    • Vertical Margin
    • Horizontal Margin
  • Heading and Description
    • Heading
    • Description
  • Button
    • Action Type
      • URL
        • Your site visitors will be redirected to a different URL when they click the button. Please note that if you just want to redirect the visitor to a page on your Lofty site, you only need to enter the "relative URL." For example, enter "/evaluation" to send the site visitor to the Home Evaluation page. If you want to redirect the visitor to an external page (one not part of your Lofty site), you will need to enter the complete URL including https:// (e.g. https://www.google.com/). After entering the URL, you can also choose your "Open Mode" to open the page in a new window/tab or open the page in the current window/tab.
      • Trigger Registration
        • Set the lead type using the Lead Type Settings dropdown menu for this action type.
        • When your site visitor clicks the button, the site global registration pop-up will appear. See Registration Pop-up Style & Settings.

    • Text
    • Color
    • Button Position

The best way to learn about all you can do with a CTA Block is to test it out on your website. The visual builder gives you a great preview that can be used to see how it will work on your website. If it doesn't work out, you can always delete the block and try again.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Calculator Block
title: Calculator Block
body:
Introduction

The "Calculator Block" can be used to provide additional resources to your site visitors in a way that will assist them in their home-buying process. As a block that can be added to specific sections of pages, you are able to customize where you want it to appear. 

  • Note: When using the Calculator Block, the currency will be displayed in USD.

There are two types of calculators available: (1) Mortgage Calculator and (2) Affordability Calculator. Both will be explained in this article.

 

Summary

  • Adding the Calculator Block
  • Mortgage Calculator
  • Affordability Calculator

Adding the Calculator Block

To add the calculator block, go to the Page Editor in the CMS Tool and select the "+ Blocks" button.

Choose the desired calculator that you want to insert and drag it to the right section of the CMS Tool.

 

Mortgage Calculator

The mortgage calculator can be used for website visitors to calculate their monthly payment based on the factors like home price, down payment, interest rate, etc. There are two styles of mortgage calculators:

Style 1

This mortgage calculator style includes a lead capture form. You can click on the "Edit" icon or double-click on the calculator block that you added in order to edit the available options. These options include editing the title and description as well as setting the default calculator values that you would prefer to display (until edited) including home price, down payment (%), loan term, interest rate(%), property tax rate (%), home insurance (per year), condo/HOA fees (per month). 

In this style, you can also change the "Form Settings" including the title (displayed in the colored part to the right), the name format (full name or first and last name), and the phone number as required or optional. Also, if you want the leads to register before using the calculator, you can turn on the "Need to register before using" switch.

 

 

Style 2

This style is just the calculator portion (no lead capture) but has the same values that can be adjusted.

 

Affordability Calculator

The affordability calculator can be used by website visitors to calculate the number of houses they can afford. All of the fields (for which default values can be set) include annual income, down payment ($), other monthly debts, loan term, interest rate, property tax rate, home insurance (per year), condo/HOA fees (per month), and debt ratio (%).

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by a chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

  2. In most instances, Lofty suggests that you use the "Preset Filter" to help you populate the listings for your quick search links and keep the listing source set to "All Listings" unless you want to limit the searchable listings in the link. Adding the Quick Search Block

name: Add / Remove / Edit Blocks on Pages
title: Add / Remove / Edit Blocks on Pages
body:
Introduction

All pages on Lofty websites are composed of blocks. These "blocks" can be combined to build pages with a specific content focus or to provide a certain set of resources to site visitors. These blocks can be customized on every Lofty website page. 

 

Summary

 

Step 1: Select the Page to Edit

Click Pages on the Page Editor and a page list will appear with all of your pages shown. Find and click on the page you want to edit and the Page Editor's interface will switch to that page.

Add Blocks

Click Blocks in the Page Editor, and the block library will appear. 20+ block types can be added to any page by dragging and dropping the block to the right: the type has different styles to choose from.

Edit Blocks

If you want to modify the title, image, data, etc. of a certain block, double-click the block or click the Edit icon that appears when hovering in the top-right of that specific block. Upon doing this, all of the content that can be edited with this block will be displayed.

 

Block Types

The following are the different types of blocks available:

  • Reviews
  • Agent
  • Contact
  • Team Info
  • Featured Areas
  • Partner Links
  • Form
  • Hero
  • Home Evaluation
  • Calculator
  • Banner
  • CTA
  • Content
  • Listings (Featured)
  • Search Bar
  • Quick Search
  • Blog
  • Video
  • Live Blocks
    • YouTube Live Block
    • Facebook Live Block

 

Custom Blocks

Note: Custom blocks can only be created if your website is built off of a custom template. If your website was built off of one of the website templates that Lofty provides, the option to create a custom block will not be available.

To create a custom block, first add a block to your website by dragging the block to the body of the website. Make any necessary edits to the block and click the ... icon and select Custom

 

Note, not all blocks can be customized. Only the following blocks can be customized:

  • Agent
  • Banner
  • Content
  • CTA
  • Embed
  • Form
  • Gallery
  • Team
  • Video

After you have saved your custom block, it can be found at the top of the Block Library in a section called Custom.

 

Remove Blocks

If you need to delete a block, hover over that specific block and click the Trash Can icon in the top-right of that block.

 

Reorder Blocks

You can drag a block to the desired position by clicking on that specific block until it is highlighted and then dragging it to the new destination on that page. You can also reorder by selecting the icon with three lines and dragging it to the spot where you would like it on the page:

 

Copy Blocks

If the block has the capability to be Copy/Pasted, you will see a ... icon next to the other block actions. Click the ... to select Copy or Paste. The block will be copied as is. When you paste a block, it will be pasted directly below the selected block. This is only available to full websites, not to users with subdomain sites. 

Note, not all blocks can be copied. Only the following blocks can be copied:

  • Agent
  • Banner
  • Content
  • CTA
  • Embed
  • Form
  • Gallery
  • Team
  • Video

 

Preview

You can toggle between the desktop view and the mobile view to see what the page will look like on a mobile device versus a laptop or desktop computer.

If you need to experience the effects of button jumps and pop-ups triggered by the website, you can click the preview button to open a new tab that will preview this page.

 

Publish

If you have made any changes on this page by adding, removing, or editing any blocks, be sure to click the Publish button in the top-right corner in order for changes to apply to the live site.

 

Questions?

name: Add / Edit Featured Areas
title: Add / Edit Featured Areas
body:
Introduction

Lofty supports creating a landing page to feature each area in your market to attract more leads using auto-populated local information. Different featured area pages have the same style with content related to that area. Creating them one by one could be a lot of work, so the CMS Tool also supports simultaneously creating a group of featured area pages.

Summary

  • Add a Featured Area
  • Add a Featured Area Page to your Website
  • Edit a Featured Area Page

Add a Featured Area

Navigate to the CMS and select Areas. 

 
Click the + Add New Area button and pick City or Neighborhood.
The cities and neighborhoods available are dependent on the connected MLSs. Use the search bar to type in the area you want to add.
Select the Agent who represents this area.

Featured Area Pages

After the city/neighborhood has been added, 2-3 pages will be created. 

Introduction Page

The Introduction page includes a description of the area, market trends, current listings, amenities and attractions, schools and demographics.

Note: If the region selected lacks data, the Introduction will not be displayed. 
 

Search Page

The Search page lists the homes for sale in the selected area and market insights. 

Market Page

The Market page provides a market snapshot, market trends, and recent listings.

Add a Featured Area Page to your Website

Navigate to the Page Editor and click on the Pages option.
Click the + Add Page button and select the Featured Area page template.
Select a style and click Next. Locate the area you want to add using the search bar and choose it by clicking the box next to it. You can also click the top box to select all areas.
The introductory page navigation for any areas you have chosen and saved will display under Page Editor>Pages>Hidden Navigation and can be personalized like other pages.
To display the area in the navigation bar menu, hover over the box corresponding to the area, click, and hold while moving the pointer to the related folder like "Neighborhoods".
After completing the rest of the configuration, don't forget to click the "Publish" button in the top-right of the CMS Tool for the changes to apply to the live website.

If you want to adjust the page style, please refer to Add / Remove / Edit Blocks on Pages.
*IMPORTANT: Please note that if you edit a Featured Area page group, your modifications will apply to all Featured Areas in this group at the same time.

name: Edit Website Navigation Bar
title: Edit Website Navigation Bar
body:
Introduction

The website navigation is the outline of the available pages on the website for any site visitor to select from. It is very important to have this section up-to-date and customized to present the correct pages and in the correct order. All edits to the navigation will be reflected in this section of the website:

 

Edit Navigation

To edit the navigation, click “Pages” on the Page Editor, and the page list will appear here with all of your pages. The page list consists of two parts: (1) Displayed Navigation and (2) Hidden Navigation.

 

Displayed Navigation vs. Hidden Navigation

Displayed Navigation

This is also called "Menu" and contains all pages displayed on the website navigation bar. If you want to display a page on a website, drag it to this section.

Hidden Navigation

It contains all pages that are not displayed on the website. Hiding a page on the navigation keeps that page as an actual page on the website, but it will not be displayed on the navigation menu. If someone had the direct link to that page, they could still navigate to the page even though it does not appear on the navigation.

 

"Page" vs "Folder" vs "Page Group"

Page

A page is a specific link that connects directly to a specific page with its URL, etc. A page can be listed at the top level of the navigation (i.e., clicking on "Home" takes you directly to the home page) or you can list a page within a folder.

Folder

A folder is a category that can be used to organize the website navigation above and beyond simply having one level of pages. In the example below, "Test Folder" is a folder that is listed directly on the main navigation. When a site visitor hovers over the "Test Folder," they are presented with the content within that folder. In this example, "Blogs" and "Test Subfolder" would be on that list. Folders can also be nested again within another folder (only one more level maximum), as seen in this example.

Page Group

A page group is a group of pages.  The pages in the page group are all at the same level in the navigation menu and have the same style and different content. These are grouped for easy management. There are currently several types of page groups:

  • Neighborhood Detail
  • Property Detail
  • Sold Property Detail
  • Agent Detail
  • Blog Detail

 

Add Pages/Folders

*Please note that all added pages/folders will be in the "Hidden Navigation" section by default.

To add a folder, click on the "+ Add Folder" button, type in the folder name, and click Enter on the keyboard. You can then save pages within the folder as described above.

To add a page, click on the "+ Add Page" button, and you will see the 12 types of page templates, each with different styles available to choose from. For more detailed steps on adding pages, please see the following articles:

  • Add / Edit Website Pages
  • Add / Edit Neighborhood Pages or Groups

 

Reorder Pages/Folders

Reorder the pages on the navigation menu by simply dragging and dropping the page/folder to the location where you would like it to be on the website.

 

Delete Pages/Folders

Click "Delete" to delete the corresponding page/folder. Just so you know, deleting a folder will also delete all pages/subfolders under that folder.

Remove Pages from Agent Subdomains

Click "Settings" to access that page's settings.

 

To remove a page from Agent Subdomains, uncheck the box. This will remove the page from all Agent Subdomains.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your CRM.

name: Add / Edit Website Pages
title: Add / Edit Website Pages
body:
Introduction

Lofty provides a library of page templates to speed up the construction of your professional website. These page templates can serve as a foundation that can then be edited and rearranged according to the theme you are looking to present on your site.

 

Summary

  • Add a Page
    • Part 1: Basic Settings
    • Part 2: Page SEO
    • Part 3: Neighborhood Data 
  • Edit a Page

 

Add a Page

To add a page, click on the “Pages” button while in the Page Editor

 

Then, click on the "+ Add Page" button.

 

You will then need to select a page template. There are currently 12 types of page templates (more on the way). You can choose the template that best matches what you need to accomplish.

Current page templates include the following:

  • Home
  • Listings
  • Sell
  • Home Evaluation
  • Reviews
  • Neighborhood Detail
  • About
  • Contact
  • My Team
  • Mortgage Calculator
  • Affordability Calculator
  • Blank
  • Link

After you have selected the page, you will need to configure the page settings. There are two parts to this process (three if doing a neighborhood page). . .

 

Part 1: Basic Settings

The following are the options that can be configured in the "Basic Settings" section. Default values are provided by Lofty, but you can modify them as needed. 

Page Name: The name of the page that will be displayed on the CMS Tool and the website to distinguish it from other pages.

Page Template: This section will simply display the page template that was selected in the previous step. You can also return to the previous step and select another one by clicking on "Change it."

URL: Define the URL for this page.

Open Style: Configure whether the link, when clicked, will open on the "Current Page" or as a "New Page."

Display Style: Configure whether to show on desktop or mobile view.

Page Style: Setting to turn on/off page header and footer.

 

There is also a setting to hide a page on all Agent Subdomains (see Agent Subdomains). This option will only be available if the page can be hidden. Please note that the following pages cannot be hidden on Agent Subdomains:

  • Home
  • All Listings
  • Sold Listings
  • Home Valuation
  • Blogs
  • Market Snapshot
  • Listing Detail Pages
  • Agent Detail Pages
  • Blog Detail Pages

You may consider using this checkbox if you have a page that makes sense at the Team Website level but does not work as well on an Agent Subdomain. The setting is all or nothing--you are not able to choose which Agent Websites are affected.

 

Part 2: Page SEO

This section can be used to configure the meta title, meta keywords, and meta description of this page. This section also has support for inserting variables (merge fields). As the CMS-related values change, these meta fields can change automatically. 

The "SNS Cover Photo" is the image that is displayed when sharing the link on platforms such as Facebook, etc.

In order to improve your website's SEO, it is recommended that you configure different content on different pages. You will also want to keep the meta content highly summarized. If you want to learn more about meta tags, please reference Edit Website Meta Tags.

 

Part 3: Neighborhood Data 

*This section will only appear if you select the "Neighborhood Detail" page template.

More information about configuring this section can be found here: Add / Edit Neighborhood Pages or Groups.

--- 

*The final step is to click on the "Save" button. Please note that all added pages/folders will be located on the "Hidden Navigation" by default. See this article for more information on editing the navigation: Edit Website Navigation Bar.

 

Edit a Page

If you want to adjust the page style, please refer to Add / Remove / Edit Blocks on Pages.

If you want to modify the content of the page, click on the "Edit" icon on that page. 

 

FAQ

Q: Is there a character limit when adding a Page name?

A: Yes, 50 characters maximum.

 

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Edit Website Meta Tags
title: Edit Website Meta Tags
body:
Introduction

Meta tags are snippets of text that describe a page’s content. The meta tags do not appear on the page itself, only in the page’s source code. Meta tags can help Google and other search engines understand your content and thus help your SEO ranking if adjusted correctly.

Lofty supports the ability to configure the meta title, meta keywords, and meta description for each page.

 

Summary

  • Meta Title
  • Meta Description
  • Meta Keywords
  • Editing Meta Tags

Meta Title

This is the text you will see at the top of your browser. Search engines view this text as the "title" of your page. These tags have a real impact on search rankings and allow visitors to easily distinguish your site from others.

 

Meta Description

Meta Description is a brief description of the page and, put simply, explains to search engines and (sometimes) searchers themselves what your page is about. Please note that the meta description tag will not always show up in the results of a Google search.

 

Meta Keywords

Meta Keywords are a series of keywords you deem relevant to the page in question. Nowadays, they are not as useful as they once were. They no longer provide any real benefit for SEO.

Even though Lofty supports the ability to configure meta keywords, we do not recommend that you configure them.

 

Editing Meta Tags

First of all, find the page that you want to edit on your CMS Tool navigation and then click on the "Edit" icon:

From this section, you can configure the "Page SEO" which includes the meta title, meta keywords, and meta description of the page. This also supports the insertion of variables (merge fields) that will update automatically with adjustments via the CMS Tool. 

The "SNS Cover Photo" is the social media cover photo of this page. This image is also used when sharing this page in iMessage or email.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

 

Related terms: Meta, meta title, meta tags, meta description, meta keywords, SNS

name: Partial Lead Door Knock Feature
title: Partial Lead Door Knock Feature
body:
Introduction

The "Door Knock" feature was built to facilitate the contracting of partial leads (see Partial Leads) that you have collected in your database and in an accessible way while you are on the move. 

*IMPORTANT: Please note that only partial leads will be shown on the Door Knock map. Full leads are not currently available on the map view. 

 

Feature Access

Access the door knock map by clicking the "3 dots" on the Lead List:

 

A map will then appear when you enter this section. There is also a list view that can be used to view all of the partial leads on a list.

On the map, you will be able to see your location as well as any partial leads that are nearby. You can check other locations and the number of partial leads by zooming in and out of the map with your fingers. You can add a new door knock note based on your location by clicking the " + " button at the top-right. This is a great way to record encounters when visiting houses located near a house you are showing, etc. 

You can easily change the door knock status, record contact information or make notes during or after visiting door knock targets. You can save their information and convert them into full leads later on as well. Lofty also provides a ‘Reverse Search’ feature to help you look up the homeowner’s name and phone number associated with the address, though this will cost $0.30 (see Partial Leads).

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@loftycom>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Lofty Lead Generation FAQs
title: Lofty Lead Generation FAQs
body:
Introduction

Thank you for considering advertising with Lofty. Our Digital Marketing Team manages all Lofty advertising campaigns based on the market criteria that you provide. You pay for the advertising and receive all the leads generated within your budget. Combine this with powerful tools like the Lofty AI Assistant for automated lead qualification (provided with the purchase of lead gen packages), a powerful CRM, Smart Plan automation, listing alerts, and more, and you are well on your way to building a strong foundation for your business. 

 

Summary

  • Billing
  • CPL (Cost Per Lead) and Targeting Estimates
  • After Ads Go Live
  • Cancellation
  • Misc Topics

 

Pricing and Package Options

The following packages are available for Lofty lead generation. These are billed on a monthly basis in order to maintain a marketing campaign.

Category Google Ads Bing Ads Facebook Ads Lead Gen AI Assistant Minimum Budget Management Fee* Management Fee for budgets less than $750
Buyer Lead Gen ✅ ✅ ✅ ✅ $600 20% $150
Seller Lead Gen ✅ ✅ ✅ ✅ $600 20% $150
Single Listing Promotion ✅ ✅ ✅ ✅ $99 N/A N/A
Retargeting Ads ❌ ❌ ✅ ✅ $300 20% $150

*If the total ad budget is less than $750, the management fee will be a flat rate of $150/month.

 

Sample Ads

 

Billing

  • When will I be billed?
  • Can I sign up during the middle/end of the month? How will I be billed?

When will I be billed?

If you purchase ads when signing up for Lofty, you will be billed according to the schedule discussed during the sales process (at the first official billing date or when website onboarding is complete). 

Once your Lofty website is ready, the ads can be launched.

 

Can I sign up during the middle/end of the month? How will I be billed?

Yes. If you sign up before the 15th of the month, your ad budget will be used and the amount will not be pro-rated. After the 15th, the first billing cycle can be prorated, with assistance from Lofty's DMA team. The management fee will be billed at the full amount to start the campaign.

 

CPL (Cost Per Lead) and Targeting Estimates

  • How many leads can I get if I pay $300/month for Facebook & Google Ads?
  • Can I ask for a call from the ads team to discuss how my ads are set up?
  • How many cities can I target with my ads
  • How long should I expect to wait for my ads to be set up after I pay?
  • Can I switch my ad platform when ads are running?

How many leads can I get if I pay $300/month for Facebook & Google Ads?

This can vary by market and ad platform. Lofty offers a CPL Report to forecast the number of leads you can expect based on a specific budget and for specific target locations. You can generate this by navigating to Marketing > Lead Generation > Buyer Lead Gen or Seller Lead Gen > See How Many Leads I Can Get.

 

Can I ask for a call from the Ads Team to discuss how my ads are set up?

Yes, absolutely! Please contact us and we can arrange to have a DMA (Digital Marketing Analyst) call you within 48 hours to discuss your ads. When doing so, be sure to provide as much information as possible so that our DMA can be prepared to discuss your specific scenario.

 

How many cities can I target with my ads?

We can target up to two (2) cities with a $600/month budget. We recommend allocating at least $100 each month per target area.

 

How long should I expect to wait for my ads to be set up after I pay?

As long as your website is live, your ads will be set up within 48 hours after payment is processed.

 

Can I switch my ad platform when ads are running?

Yes, you can switch between Facebook and Google platforms before the middle of a month if you would like. If you want to make the switch specifically from Facebook to Google, we will need to check your remaining budget and monthly budget to confirm that you have enough budget to run the ads.
In addition, it would be ideal to walk you through the current ad performance data to see if this will be the best decision for you.

 

After Ads Go Live

  • When will I start getting leads for buyer lead gen?
  • Why are there other agents' listings on my Facebook Dynamic Ads?
  • Can I see an overview of my advertising plan?
  • Can I put my logo and/or team picture on ads? 
  • Can I switch my target areas? And is there a specific time of the month that is best to do so?
  • Where can I check my results for retargeting ads?
  • Can I have tags added to leads from ads campaigns?
  • Why am I receiving leads without a phone number?
  • Can I change my ads by myself?
  • What should I do with new leads once they are captured in my CRM?
  • Can I get an ads review/summary at the end of each month?

When will I start getting leads for buyer lead gen?

For Google ads, leads can be expected within 12-48 hours because the algorithm needs time to accumulate data. Both Google and Facebook must complete a learning phase which is the most important part for campaign initialization.

 

Why are there other agents' listings on my Facebook Dynamic Ads?

For Facebook Dynamic Ads, all the available listings will be uploaded from your Lofty-built website via a catalog. If you only want to show listings based on specific criteria (including only your own listings), please let our team know. Enough listings to generate a catalog must be available to run Facebook Dynamic Ads. 

It's important to note that the Facebook Dynamic Ads will show the agent and brokerage name for the listings on the headline of the ad to ensure MLS compliance.

 

Can I see an overview of my advertising plan?

Yes, a report can be generated to show you marketing performance and average CPL, etc. in your Lofty account Marketing page. Reach out to a DMA or Lofty Support (support@lofty.com) for more assistance.

 

Can I put my logo and/or team picture on ads? 

This is not done by default. Technically speaking, it is possible with Display and Video ads. This could be a useful tool to take advantage of when doing retargeting ads to build brand awareness. Talk to one of our representatives to inform them of how you might like to do this and they will help to start that discussion with the Lofty Ads Team.

Keep in mind that your ads on Facebook are also configured to run from your Facebook Business Page when possible so your brand is represented there as well.

 

Can I switch my target areas? And is there a specific time of the month that is best to do so?

Yes, you can change your target areas. It is best to make this type of change before the third week of the month because the algorithm needs a few days to learn. It would also be useful to review your ad performance data to make sure this is the best decision for you to take.

 

Where can I check my results for retargeting ads?

Retargeting is built into campaigns when possible and thus the data is also available, to some extent, in your CRM > Marketing  > Lead Generation. There is no dedicated section in that report for retargeting specifically, but we do provide the retargeting ad total engagement - that is, how many leads clicked the retargeting ad.

 

Can I have tags added to leads from ads campaigns?

Yes, this is possible. You can add a location tag to distinguish which location the lead comes from. If you have other scenarios that you would like to consider, please contact your Lofty representative to discuss further.

 

Why am I receiving leads without a phone number?

If you received leads without a phone number, these are email-only leads which means a lead only entered their email address but did not provide any information. They backed out of the registration process before finalizing but continued far enough that their email was captured. To learn more, see Registration Pop-up Style & Settings > Email-Only Lead Registration. 

 

Can I change my ads by myself?

No, there is no easy interface for you to change your ads by yourself. However, our DMAs (Digital Marketing Analysts) will gladly make the necessary adjustments. Please provide feedback by reaching out to your Lofty representative or by navigating to CRM > Marketing > Buyer Lead Gen/Seller Lead Gen > Click on a specific campaign > Leave a comment. This feedback will be received directly by the Lofty Ads Team for review.

 

What should I do with new leads once they are captured in my CRM?

When you start getting leads in your Lofty CRM, our Lead Gen AI assistant will contact them automatically (enabled by default for lead gen packages) to qualify them and get more information about them. Learn more about the AI Assistant here. You will be notified when a lead has been qualified, or you can monitor ongoing conversations and reach out to the lead to take it to the next step. There are numerous other tools built into the Lofty platform (consider Smart Plans) that can be utilized to nurture and keep your leads engaged.

 

Can I get an Ad review/summary at the end of each month?

Yes, this is possible. The Lofty Ads Team can provide an Ad Performance Report at the end of each month and a representative from Lofty can discuss this with you regularly as well. This is a great way to explore performance and consider potential changes or optimizations that might be worth considering for higher conversion rates, etc.

 

Cancellation

  • What should I do if I want to cancel my ads?
  • Can I get a refund for my remaining Ads budget?

What should I do if I want to cancel my ads?

If you would like to cancel your Lofty Lead Generation Campaign, a 30-day notice via Lofty Support (support@lofty.com) is required.

 

Can I get a refund for my remaining Ads budget?

No, the remaining ads budget is allocated for each month and ads will be running until the end of the current month. If you cancel your lead generation campaigns, the next month will not continue with ads, but the budget for the current month will be utilized until the budget is spent.

 

General Topics

  • Facebook Lead Generation
    • What is D.A.R.E?
    • Due to Facebook’s recent policy changes, how can Lofty make sure that we will be able to target people who are interested in purchasing a house?
    • How does Lofty target those who want to sell their homes?
  • Google Lead Generation
    • How do Google ads work? Are they the same as Facebook advertising?
    • I’ve done Google ads before with a marketing agency and it did not work well for me. If I advertise with Lofty now, what would be the advantages and differences?
    • What is your optimization strategy to lower costs and increase the number of leads generated from ads?
  • Pre-Lofty Ads Onboarding Questions
    • Facebook Lead Generation
      • Can I use my existing leads for retargeting?
      • Can I use my own ads account and Facebook Pixel for advertising?
      • How do you target the ad's audience?
      • How do you target those who want to sell their homes?
      • How much of the budget is allocated for retargeting?
      • Can you create ads focused solely on retargeting?
      • Can I use my own images and videos in the ads?
    • Google Lead Generation
      • Why can I not advertise with a budget lower than $600?
      • Can I do retargeting ads on Google?
      • Can you access my Google Ads account and use it for advertising?
      • Can I send a list of my own keywords and have them used in the ads?
  • Active Ads with Lofty
    • Facebook Lead Generation
      • How do you make sure that you will not overspend on the budget?
      • Can I have access to the ads?
      • I want to target a very specific location and a group of people. Can you do that with Dynamic Ads?
      • Where are leads routed to when they click on ads?
      • Can I have my landing page used in the ads instead of the Sell My Home page?
      • Why is the estimated number of leads lower for Seller in the CPL report?
    • Google Lead Generation
      • How often can I make changes to the ads?
      • Can I search for my ads in Google?
      • Do you offer banner ads?
  •  Increasing Conversion Rates
    • How can you make sure that the leads will convert into a sale?
    • How can lead quality be increased? 
  •  Add-on service: Phone Verification Service

 

Facebook Lead Generation

What is D.A.R.E?

  • Dynamic Lead Form Campaign or Dynamic Catalog Sales Campaign
  • The ads will show the listings under the Lofty account’s catalog, which are pulled from the MLS. These ads will rotate (moving and changing) depending on who sees them. Special requests can be made to customize the catalog if needed.
  • The campaign will have different ad sets depending on the locations targeted
  • The audience will be based on different criteria (focused on people who are looking to purchase a house or are likely to purchase one based on their interests and demographics)
  • Ads will be shown on the target audience's Facebook newsfeeds


Due to Facebook’s recent policy changes, how can Lofty make sure that we will be able to target people who are interested in purchasing a house?

Even though "out of target leads" is an ongoing issue under current Facebook ad policies, Lofty will do our best to make sure to target the right people by modifying the language and targeting detailed interests. 

 

How does Lofty target those who want to sell their homes?

Lofty can help to target the right audience by grouping people who show interest in selling their homes. In other words, the more precise of an audience that can be determined, the lower the cost per lead.

 

Google Lead Generation

How do Google ads work? Are they the same as Facebook advertising?

Google ads primarily target leads when they are actively searching for something. Google Ads are based on intent, you search for something and Google shows ads that are relevant to that search.

Facebook ads target leads based on their behaviors, interests, and demographics. Facebook Ads are all about pushing content to you based on what you like, share, and engage with, rather than actively searching for something.


I’ve done Google ads before with a marketing agency and it did not work well for me. If I advertise with Lofty now, what would be the advantages and differences?

Aside from dedicated work on keyword optimization, Lofty also sets keyword lists for Property Features, Top Areas, and Neighborhoods. This helps the agent to find leads from niche markets. In this way, Lofty can help you achieve a lower CPL by having the right keywords in the right markets.

 

What is your optimization strategy to lower costs and increase the number of leads generated from ads?

  • Choosing the correct PPC keyword match type is an important aspect of our PPC strategy. As for matching the types of keywords, Lofty recommends using broad or phrase match first. In order to maximize our ROI, we will add other types of keywords based on ad performance.
  • Optimizations on keywords and ad copy are very important with Google PPC ads. Keywords will be expanded from search terms on a regular basis. Bids will be adjusted frequently to obtain a lower cost per lead. Ad copies will be modified to match lead search habits when running long-term ads.

  

Pre-Lofty Ads Onboarding Questions

Facebook Lead Generation

Can I use my existing leads for retargeting?

Yes. As long as the existing lead data meets the promotion requirements of the Facebook ad policy (i.e. file size and format).

 

Can I use my own ads account and Facebook Pixel for advertising?

No. Lofty has to link your Facebook Business page to Lofty Business Manager and then manage the ads on your behalf. The same goes for the Facebook Pixel. Lofty has to use the Lofty Pixel to import leads into the Lofty CRM.

 

How do you target the ad's audience?

The audience can be selected by the different areas, languages, and interests. We will update the most relevant potential leads as the target audience for you.

 

How do you target those who want to sell their homes?

Lofty can help to target the right audience by grouping people who show interest in selling their homes. In other words, the more precise of an audience that can be determined, the lower the cost per lead.

 

How much of the budget is allocated for retargeting?

Usually, we suggest that you as the client allocate 10-20% of your total budget to retargeting ads. However, the budget is not fixed for each client. We can adjust the budget allocation when necessary at any point in time.

 

Can you create ads focused solely on retargeting?

Yes, we can. We can only create the retargeting ads campaign for you with the condition that a qualified existing leads file is provided.

 

Can I use my own images and videos in the ads?

Absolutely. However, on occasion, the ad may not be performing as well as we expect when using customized ad creatives. We need to replace the images or videos when the ads are not producing results.


Google Lead Generation

Why can I not advertise with a budget lower than $600?

Based on our past experience, ad performance will be severely limited if a budget is below $600 when using Google. We suggest you target no more than 2 cities with this budget to maximize the cost-efficiency.

 

Can I do retargeting ads on Google?

It will be very hard to do retargeting ads on Google because we cannot capture the second or duplicate search behavior of the same group of people. Facebook retargeting ads would be a perfect solution for this kind of request.

 

Can you access my Google Ads account and use it for advertising?

No. All the ads Lofty is managing will be under the Lofty advertising account to facilitate quality assurance and budget control.

 

Can I send a list of my own keywords and have them used in the ads?

Yes, you can. You can send us the long-tail keywords you have used in past advertising activities. We will add them to the Lofty keywords list to help improve the ad performance.


Active Ads with Lofty

Facebook Lead Generation

How do you make sure that you will not overspend on the budget?

We have an auto budget calculation system in place to help allocate the budget for each client correctly. Our ads specialists are also monitoring account performance closely. Most importantly, we will pay for every cent if your ads campaigns overspend.

 

Can I have access to the ads?

Unfortunately, you will not be able to edit your ads when they are under Lofty's ads account. This helps to avoid conflicts of operation over one ad account. You are always welcome to contact a DMA if you need to adjust your ads. Or, you can send us a notification by submitting feedback through Campaigns > Lead Engine > Buyer Lead Gen / Seller Lead Gen. 

 

I want to target a very specific location and a group of people. Can you do that with Dynamic Ads?

Under the current Facebook real estate ads policy, we are limited and must apply a 15-mile radius to each city/address we are targeting. 

 

Where are leads routed to when they click on ads?

To answer this question, it is important to consider Facebook ads objectives:

  • For the objectives of "Conversion," "Web click," and "Catalog Sales," leads will be routed to a specific website to complete the registration process on that website.
  • For the "Lead form Ads," leads will be asked to submit their info right after clicking the ads and then they will be directed to your website. 

 

Can I have my landing page used in the ads instead of the Sell My Home page?

Technically, yes you can. However, you have to place your Lofty Pixel on your website so that we can route the leads into your Lofty CRM.

 

Why is the estimated number of leads lower for Seller in the CPL report?

In rare cases, the actual results will be less than the estimated amount in the CPL report. The main reasons include market trends changing and customized ad requirements that cause limitations (i.e. targeting a small group of people). 


Google Lead Generation

How often can I make changes to the ads?

You are welcome to contact a DMA whenever you want to adjust your ads or discuss ad performance. Adjustments can be made including location rotation, budget adjustments, etc.

 

Can I search for my ads in Google?

You can search for your ads, yes. However, they may not show 100% of the time because our ad audience settings are focusing on people who need to buy homes in a short time.

 

Increasing Conversion Rates

How can you make sure that the leads will convert into a sale?

Loft support can help you to learn Lofty  CRM best practices including building Smart Plans in the CRM that can help you to qualify and nurture your leads.

Always making sure to contact your leads quickly and with the information they cannot get from other places will always set you apart from the competition and bring you closer to a successful deal.

Lofty also offers an AI Assistant that might be of interest. Reference this article for more information on how it works: Lofty AI Assistant / Chatbot.

 

How can lead quality be increased? 

  • Change ads objective to "Website Registration".
  • Change ads platform from Facebook to Google.

 

Add-on service: Phone Verification Service

New Add-On Service Details

  • If you purchase a Buyer Lead Gen, Seller Lead Gen, or Re-marketing Ads, and are currently not subscribed to this phone verification service, you will see this add-on option.
  • (B) Price: 5% of the total ads budget (total ads budget = the sum of all ads services that the user is subscribing)
    • If you purchase a $1000 buyer lead gen first, then buy a $800 seller lead gen later, we will charge $50 when buying buyer lead gen, and $40 when buying seller lead gen.
    • If you purchase a buyer lead gen first and choose to start the next billing data, we will not charge any 5% until the next billing date (phone verification service will only be charged after it's valid).
  • Any verified phone number will have this golden mark on the Lead Detail Page.
  • As agents, you can choose to not use the verification service for any specific ad campaign, our DMA can control it.

Lead Registration Process

  • When a lead comes to the listing detail page through ads (leads landing on this page will be marked as "buyers"), they will be guided through the new registration process.
    • They will see the phone verification step if the agent purchased such a service
      1. Lead can skip this step
    • Then, they will be asked: (Question 1) Describe myself
      1. If they choose "own a home", then we will add a new lead type, "homeowner", to this lead.
      2. If they choose"renting", then we will add a new lead type, "renter", to this lead.
        1. A timeline will be generated to record the change in lead type.
    • Then, the pop-up will close automatically.

  • If the lead keeps viewing this page, it will trigger an additional questionnaire 
      1. Listing Images auto scroll 3 OR lead scroll down 1 screen → trigger additional questionnaire
      2. Question 2 (If you chose to own a house last time, ask this question, otherwise not):
        1. I currently own a house and want to sell it
          1. Choose this option add a new lead type to this lead: seller, and will update the timeline.
        2. I currently own a house and want to buy another one
          1. Nothing changes if choose this option.
      3. Question 3: 
        1. I want to buy in 1-2 months
          1. Update Buying Time Frame field to 1-3
        2. Just Looking
          1. Update the Buying Time frame field to Just Looking
      4. Question 4:
        1. I've been pre-qualified for a mortgage
          1. Update the Pre-qualified field to YES
        2. I've not been pre-qualified for a mortgage
          1. Update the Pre-qualified field to NO

If the lead keeps viewing this page, it will trigger an additional questionnaire.

Home Valuation

  • The questionnaire will be triggered starting from Question 1 if the lead doesn't select Question 1 and directly closes the pop-up.

 

Questions?

name: Site Traffic Report
title: Site Traffic Report
body:
Introduction

In this article, we will review how to utilize the Site Traffic Report to have an overview of your Lofty website and traffic status. The data for this report is generated by Lofty's built-in site logs. If you would like a different type of reporting data you may want to consider taking a look at our Google Analytics Integration.

 

Reporting

First, navigate to Reporting > Marketing > Site Traffic. *Please note that you can only view your website traffic, the subdomains are not included.

You can view how many people have viewed your website, how many pages were viewed, and how many pages are viewed on average in the selected timeframe. There is also a trend statistics chart under the overview numbers. The blue line represents current data, which you can compare to the gray line, which represents past historical data.

 

In the Visitor Activity By Hour section, you can have an overview of the traffic pattern, displayed seven days a week in the vertical direction, and also the traffic pattern displayed 24 hours a day in the horizontal direction. Each cell shows the number of visitors that visit your site by hour on a particular day. This dataset will show an aggregate of data over the selected time to give you better overall insights. All data is shown in your CRM's time zone.

In the New vs Returning section, you can see how many new visitors and returning visitors you've had for a selected date range. Please note that new visitors may also be counted as returning visitors if they returned within the selected date range.

In Avg. Visitor Activities section, you can see the average number of properties viewed or searched by visitors from different sources.

  • Paid: Visitors that come from Lofty Paid Lead Generation.
  • Direct: Visitors who type in your site URL.
  • Search Organic: Visitors who find your site from a search engine.
  • Social Organic: Visitors who visit from social media that are not from advertisements.
  • Email: Visitors who come from clicking an emailed link.
  • Other: Visitors from other sources.

 In the Visitors by Source and Pageviews by Device sections, you can see visitor metrics broken down by source and visitor page views broken down by device, respectively.

In the Site Traffic section, you can see the number of visitors, page views, and average page views per visitor for a particular page. You can compare visitor behaviors from different sources as well. Note that return visitors may count multiple times if they use a different source to reach your page.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by a chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

The number next to these time filters is the total number of leads that fall into the corresponding time range.

  2. The second part shows the result of the lead routing rules, rule by rule. The "N" indicates that it was not routed by that rule, the "Y" shows where it matched and was routed, as seen near #3 on the screenshot.

name: Task Management
title: Task Management
body:
Introduction

Lofty Task Management can be used to keep your list of tasks in one place and conveniently associated to lead records with a history of all communication, contact information, and a wealth of other resources at your fingertips. This article will explain exactly how tasks are managed when using Lofty.

 

Summary

  • Overview
  • Dashboard Tasks Display
  • Tasks Page
  • Calendar View 
  • Manually Add Tasks
  • Repeated Tasks
  • Automatically Add Tasks
  • Lender Tasks
  • Finishing Tasks

 

Overview

All tasks in Lofty live on a specific lead profile. No task can be created without connecting it to a specific lead. These leads can be found by navigating to a lead profile (by searching or clicking a name on the People page) and then finding the "Task" section under the "Activities" tab of a lead profile (the default page):

You can filter these tasks by clicking on the Settings Cogwheel icon and selecting to display your tasks, completed tasks, and auto tasks. 

 

Dashboard Tasks Display

The Lofty Dashboard shows a very basic task summary on either the Company/Office Dashboard (for those with admin access) or My Dashboard for all users. When clicked, the user will be taken to the Tasks Page which is outlined next. 

 

Tasks Page

Even though all tasks live on one specific lead profile, there is one location that you can access to see ALL of your upcoming tasks in one place. To access this page, click on the Calendar Menu and select Tasks.

This page is broken down into two sections: My Tasks and Company Tasks. 

Both of these sections are organized the same way. "Showing Requests" (when a lead requests to see a property directly from a listing page) are shown first, followed by "All Tasks" which is the default view of the Tasks page. Next, you have "Scheduled," "Overdue," and then "Finished." 

"All Tasks" is broken down by "Scheduled," "Overdue," and "Finished".

 

Three filters are available to easily find specific tasks:

  1. Task Type
    • All
    • Call
    • Email
    • Text
    • Auto Email (scheduled in a Smart Plan)
    • Auto Text (scheduled in a Smart Plan)
    • Appointment
    • Slybroadcast (scheduled in a Smart Plan)
    • Other
  2. Pipeline
  3. Task Origin
    • Added Manually
    • From Smart Plan
    • Migrate from Action (pulled over from a Smart Plan)

A new task can also be added directly from this page, but you must choose the Lead to whom you want to add the task as a required field.

 

Calendar View

All Lofty-based tasks and appointments can now be displayed on a calendar view within the CRM. Please note that this does not synchronize other calendar events from any integrated calendars at this point in time.

 

  1. The calendar will show the Task and Appointment, but also the birthday of a lead. 
  2. In the top left corner, people with manage user permission can switch to view the calendars of other team members.

 

Manually Add Tasks

To manually add a task, click on the "+" button. You can then write in the task description and choose who the task is assigned to (this user must have access to the lead - reference Lead Privacy: Team Leads vs. Private Leads). The task type can be selected (email, call, text, other) as well. The "Call" type is important to select here if you want this to be added to a Smart Call List (reference Smart Call Lists). The due date is very important as well and choosing a specific time will allow for a reminder to be triggered 30 minutes before the task is due with a push notification on the web and mobile apps. If you want to select an additional reminder option (no reminder, by SMS, by call), you can also do so. 

 

Be sure to click "Save" when you are ready to add the task. The task will then display on the task list for this lead.

 

Edit Tasks

As outlined earlier, there are two locations to find your tasks. To edit a task, simply click on the task row itself (not the checkbox) and make any necessary adjustments.

When clicking on a task, you will see five options available on the Tasks Page:

  1. Action (Email, Call, Text). This will depend on the task type. If it is something that you can complete (email/call), you will have the option to do so directly from this task.
  2. Postpone. Choose from 1, 3, 7, or 30 day(s) later.
  3. Complete. Use this option, or click the checkbox, to mark the task as complete.
  4. Delete. This is only available for manually-created tasks. 
  5. Edit. Use this to change the description, choose a specific due date, etc.

 

Repeated Tasks

Currently, there is no built-in functionality to repeat one specific task. The only way to do this is via a recurring Smart Plan. Please refer to Smart Plans.

 

Automatically Add Tasks

To have tasks added automatically to a lead, this must be done via a Smart Plan. Learn more here: Smart Plans.

 

Lender Tasks

Currently, tasks cannot be added for lenders if the lender is using a lender-type account. Instead, you should communicate with the lender using the @tag method. More information can be found here: Lender and Agent Lead Collaboration.

 

Finishing Tasks

You can only delete manually created tasks. If the task was created manually, click the trash can icon to delete the task. To finish a task, either check the box next to the task or click on the task and click Complete.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by a chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Website SSL Certificates
title: Website SSL Certificates
body:
Introduction

An SSL certificate can help keep your site secure to ensure that it is trusted by the browsers and operating systems of your website visitors. You can purchase an SSL certificate via your domain provider or a third party, and Lofty can help you have it installed on your website.

Installing an SSL certificate is important for the following reasons:

  • Facebook regulations will not allow for unsecured sites to be shared on their platform. Also, without an SSL, the option to "Log in with Facebook" cannot be used on your Lofty website. 
  • Some specific internet browsers will often force a URL typed into the search bar to go to the "https://" which means that a secure site with the SSL certificate is expected. 

Here are a few screenshots to demonstrate the error that might appear when navigating to a site that does not have an SSL Certificate installed:

   

 

Not Required by Lofty

As a note, this is not required by Lofty to use the service. But, it is something that will benefit people browsing your website. If you so desired, you could click on the "ADVANCED" option seen in the bottom-left of the last screenshot, and choose to continue to the website. This would allow your browser to trust the Lofty site. However, this is not acceptable to many who will visit your website and could deter them from using your site.

Any site under a Lofty domain, such as ________.lofty.com, is always secure because we have already installed a wildcard SSL certification for all these sites automatically. You will only need to plan on having a separate SSL certificate installed if you plan to configure your domain to be different from the provided _________.lofty.com domain.

 

SSL Certificate Setup

(1) Did you purchase your domain via Lofty?

If you purchased your domain via Lofty (see Vanity Domain Purchase) then an SSL certificate will be installed on your purchased website automatically and does not require configuration. 

 

(2) Do you have an SSL Certificate already?

Please send us the information below to <support@lofty.com> so that we can generate a CSR file for your SSL certificate:

  • Country Name
  • State or Province Name (complete name)
  • Locality Name (Example: city)
  • Organization Name (Example: company)
  • Organizational Unit Name (Example: section)
  • Common Name (Example: your name or your server host's name)
  • Email Address

After Lofty Support receives the above information, the quickest route is to also provide Lofty Support with the login credentials (login URL, username, email, and password) for your SSL Provider so that configuration can be finalized.  

However, if you are not comfortable with sending your SSL Provider credentials, please follow these steps: 

  1. Upload the CSR file (now generated by Lofty) to your SSL Certificate
  2. Download the certificate file in Apache format
  3. Send the certificate file to <support@lofty.com>

After these steps are complete, the SSL Certification should be installed on your domain.

 

(3) Do you not have an SSL Certificate already?

Lofty offers a free SSL Certificate that can be used to keep your site secure. 

After completing the domain configuration (see Domain Configuration Guide), please send an email to <support@lofty.com> to arrange for the SSL to be installed.  

Please note that if you have many subdomain websites, you will need a wildcard SSL certificate installed, and, depending on the situation, this might require purchasing on your end as it might not be available with the service used by Lofty. Please contact our Support Team to see what can be done in this scenario.

 

Additional Information

If you would like more information regarding the topic of SSL Certificates, please feel free to research the topic further with any domain provider as well as many online resources. Additional information can also be found in this Beginner’s Guide to SSL Certificates as written by Symantec Corporation.

HostGator published this article related to the topic as well: What the July Google Chrome Update Means for Your Website

 

FAQ

Q: Should I call to renew my SSL with Lofty?

A: SSL certificates are set to auto-renew every 90 days. In case of issues, please reach out to our Support Team for immediate assistance.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

Related terms: CSR file, wildcard SSL

name: Lead Organization with Pipeline Stages
title: Lead Organization with Pipeline Stages
body:
Introduction

The main purpose of any CRM is to provide an organization above and beyond what can be done with a typical spreadsheet or contact list. In Lofty, this happens on the People Page and consists of Pipelines, Segments, Tags, and a variety of filters. This article will address the structure from the top level of the organization (pipeline) down to the filters that are made available.

 

Summary

  • Edit Permissions
  • What is a Pipeline?
  • Customizing Pipeline Stages
  • Changing the Pipeline Stages for Leads

 

Edit Permissions

It is important to note that the Pipeline stages are maintained at the team level and cannot vary by user within that team. This means that the Pipeline stages are shared and visible to everyone in the Lofty account. 

The ability to edit the Pipeline stages is controlled by the System Configuration > Pipeline permission toggle. 

What is a Pipeline?

Though this will likely not be a new definition for anyone with sales experience, the pipeline is the top level of organization and indicates the actual stage of the buying or selling process that a lead/client is at as you work with them.

A lead will always start at the left with "New Leads" and end at the right with "Closed."

A lead can only be in one pipeline stage at a time. This is because the pipeline stage should reflect exactly where they are in the buying/selling process.

New UI:

 

Customizing Pipeline Stages

The stages between "New Leads" and "Closed" can vary depending on your specific sales process.

1. These can be adjusted in Lofty by clicking on the "gear" icon to the right of the pipeline:

2. Add a new Pipeline Stage

3. Drag and drop the stages to reorder, but keep in mind that "New Leads" will always be at the front, and "Closed" should always be the finish line for a lead.

4. You can also click the "Trash" icon to delete. 

  *Please keep in mind that Pipelines cannot be deleted if other agents have leads in that Pipeline. 

 

Example Pipeline Stages

When you first activate your Lofty account, the system will already have some default pipeline stages built in. You will want to edit these to reflect your buying/selling process.

Some recommended pipeline names that you might consider adding to your CRM (from left to right):

  • Attempting Contact
  • Hot
  • Nurturing/Cold
  • Currently Showing
  • Under Contract
  • Bad Leads
  • Do Not Contact

All Pipeline Stages can be deleted EXCEPT: 

All Leads

New Leads

Closed 

 

All Pipeline Stages can be rearranged (by order) EXCEPT:

All Leads

New Leads

 

Changing the Pipeline Stages for Leads

*NOTE: Changing the pipeline stage for leads will affect the data on the "Funnel Analysis." Reference Business Summary (Reporting).

Pipeline stages can be changed either one at a time for individual leads or in mass by selecting them from the People Page. Here is where it is changed for one individual lead:

You can also change the pipeline stage for multiple leads at once by

(1) Check the box next to the leads on the People Page 

(2) Select the option to "Change Pipeline."

(3) Select the pipeline stage where you would like to move all the selected leads. Note that this will only work for 200 leads at a time. 

New UI:

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your CRM.
