name: Complete your Lofty Profile, Email Signature
title: Complete your Lofty Profile, Email Signature
body:
Introduction

Setting up the Lofty Profile is a key step in making sure your account is ready to go before interacting with clients via the CRM. The fields that can be edited in this section will be displayed in emails sent from the Lofty CRM, including Property Alerts and Welcome Emails, so it is very important to have your profile set up from the very beginning.

 

Summary

  • Profile Settings
  • Email Signature

 

Profile Settings

To navigate to your profile go to Settings > Profile:

 

Once on this page, you can complete the following profile fields. Each one is defined below. 

Profile Photo

Add your headshot, this will appear in an auto-populated email signature for property alerts, market reports, etc. 

 

First Name / Last Name

No explanation is needed. This is simply your first and last name as the Lofty user. If you need to edit this, here is where it's done!

 

Email Address

This is the email address you will use to log into Lofty. If you change this, it will affect the email on file for billing statements, email notifications, etc.

 

Phone Number

Add the best phone number to reach you here. This will be the phone number that is also placed into the auto-populated email signature for property alert emails, etc. You can always update it as needed.

 

License ID

Add your license ID as an agent. This will also display in auto-populated email signatures for emails sent via Lofty so keep this up-to-date as well.

 

Position

Choose your position within your organization from the pre-populated options or choose the option to Customize if you would like to add your own.

 

MLS Agent ID

This part is very important to get right because this ID is used to pull in your listings for Listing Discovery, Transaction Management, and other Lofty tools. 

These fields will not appear until your MLSs have been connected to your website. Once that happens, you will be able to add only one MLS Agent ID per MLS. Each MLS will be listed. In the sample below, there are four MLSs

 

You will add your MLS ID by searching by either name or email address and the options will then be populated for you to select from:

 

Email Signature

Under Settings > Communication> Email, you will find the Email Signature section. This email signature will be pulled in automatically when you send manual emails in the system and when utilizing the #signature# variable (see Email and Text Variables to learn more about how this works). To attach this signature to Automated Emails, such as the Welcome Email and Property Alert Emails, check the box at the bottom.

 

For your signature, you will want to typically replicate what you have used before in your email, so add your logo, email address, name, phone number, social media links, etc. Take advantage of the hyperlink option, embedding an image, etc.

 

If for whatever reason you would like to make your phone number clickable, follow the steps below. First, edit the code of the email signature:

 

Then add this part (changing both numbers of course to be your own): 

<a href="tel:+1-123-456-7890">123.456.7890</a>

 

Here is what it would look like in the code view:

 

Once you click "Save", this number should now be clickable. Test it to make sure it works, as sometimes copying/pasting, etc. throws off important formatting that could cause it to not work. If for some reason it stops working, something might have been edited in the email signature so check to make sure the same format is in place as described above. 

 

Email Signature Preview 

The email signature shown at the bottom of Settings > Communication> Email> Email Settings is a preview only. To edit the email signature you must click on the Edit icon:

 

Variable Support

Email signatures now support agent variables. When a variable is used, it will show in the "edit experience" but once saved it will have the actual information pulled into the signature preview so that you can make sure it is working correctly. 

 

Apply this signature to ALL outgoing emails

After choosing the option, the Email Signature set in the profile will be applied to all emails being sent from Lofty.

Default Format & Reset Link 

This option will reset the signature in the profile to the signature in the welcome email which is created by the system and consists of variables as stated above. 


You can set the default information for "Reset Signature" as well by following some of the steps below:
  • Location:
  • Email: Choose the email and click the link button.
  • Company: If you want to make sure the lead goes to your site, about your Lofty-Built Website link.

Click here to manage Brand Email Signature

This is a page jump link that will jump to the page setting for the brand email signature template.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Appointments
title: Appointments
body:
Introduction

The "Appointments" feature is used to set and track scheduled appointments with your leads, team members, lenders, vendors, and external contacts. These appointments can be added by you manually, or they can be requested by the lead directly from your IDX website.

*IMPORTANT: Please note that before you can send an appointment invitation to a lead, you need to integrate your Google Calendar or Exchange Calendar (see Google Calendar Integration and Microsoft Outlook Calendar Integration). Lofty uses the integrated calendar to send calendar invitations. If you have not integrated your calendar, the appointment will be created, but the invitation will not be sent to the lead. 

Summary

  • Create an Appointment via the Lead Profile Page
  • Create an Appointment via the Calendar
  • Edit an Appointment
  • Assigning Tasks to Others
  • Showing Requests

Create an Appointment via the Lead Profile Page

Note: These appointments are external invitations to the lead. If you do not want the lead to be aware of the event, create a Task instead. The lead can view the appointment's title and description if you have integrated your calendar.

After integrating your calendar, to create an appointment manually, go to a lead profile page, and click the "+" icon at the top right-hand corner of the "Appointments" section (under the Activities tab, which is the default):

In the pop-up window, enter the description of the appointment

  • If the appointment is created in Lofty without a description, then the description of the appointment synced to Google/Outlook Calendar will be: "Lead Name - New Appointment"
  • If the appointment is created in Lofty with a description, then the description of the appointment synced to Google/Outlook Calendar is: "Lead Name - Description".

Select the Owner, this can be yourself or another Agent on your team:

Select the appointment participants. You may invite leads, agents, lenders, vendors, or external contacts:

Choose the start and end dates/times:

Enter the address where the appointment will take place in the location field. This is an optional field:

If you also want to be reminded of the appointment, call or text message. To schedule a reminder, select "by Call," "By Email," or "by SMS" under the reminder options:

 

After clicking the save button, the newly-created appointment will display on the lead's profile page under the Appointment section, an email will be sent to the lead's primary email address only, and the event will also be synchronized to your integrated calendar:

Note: The concept of supporting the option to "Send" or "Don't Send" when saving an appointment is only for invitation emails & Lofty internal notifications. This does not mean whether or not to sync to participants' third-party calendars. Choosing "Don't Send" does not completely prevent any participant from knowing about the appointment, but is simply choosing not to notify participants by email or notification. Google or Outlook calendar will generate an invitation event on the participants’ calendars.

 

Create an Appointment via the Calendar

Appointments can also be created via the Calendar section of Lofty. To do so, first, click on the Calendar page on the top menu bar:

Hover over the "+ Create" button on the top, and click "Add Appointment."

In the pop-up window, you must select a participant for the appointment by searching for their name, email, or phone. You must also assign an Owner. By default, the owner will be the user scheduling the appointment:

Click the save button, and the appointment will appear in your task list and be added to the calendar:

Appointment Time Zone

When adding a new appointment, the Time Zone will automatically sync to the appointment creator's time zone. The appointment creator has the option to change the Time Zone:


When Appointment participants view the Appointment, the time of the Appointment will be automatically converted according to the viewer's system time zone. This is also available in the mobile app:

 

Edit an Appointment

Via a Lead Profile

Go to the lead's profile/detail page. Any Lofty users who can see the lead have the option to edit or delete the appointment. The appointment will be listed on the right-side panel. Move your cursor to the appointment and click the "edit" icon:

Click "Save" after you have made any adjustments:

Via the Tasks Page

Go to the Task page. You can locate appointments by filtering with "Task Type", selecting "Appointment", and deselecting the others.

Click the whole row of one specific appointment, and then you will notice an "Edit" icon in the top right:

Click "Save" after you make adjustments:

 

Appointment Settings

Appointment settings are accessed by clicking the gear icon.

Appointment reminder notifications can be sent to the participants either via Lofty or via an integrated calendar. If you have integrated a third-party calendar, it will be available here.

By default, if the individual who scheduled the appointment is not an existing lead in the CRM, they will not be captured as a lead. Enable this setting to capture those individuals as leads.

Assigning Tasks to Others

When creating an appointment, you can set any other Agent as the Owner, even if they do not have access to see the lead (see Lead Privacy: Team Leads vs. Private Leads), but note that you cannot currently assign an appointment to a lender-type Lofty account. Here is where you would assign the appointment to someone else:

When assigning an appointment to another user on the team, it will appear on their "Tasks" and on their integrated calendar, if they have it connected. The appointment will only show up on the task list or integrated calendar for the individual in the "Assign To" slot of the appointment. Currently, you can only add ONE owner per appointment. Keep in mind that if a calendar is integrated, it will also send the invite to the lead's email address.

 

Showing Requests

Showing requests are received in real-time based on when a lead schedules a tour from your IDX Website. The Lofty CRM allows you to manage these requests to accept and add them to the calendar or take another appropriate action.

When a lead submits a showing request, you will receive notifications by email and push notifications on your web and mobile app.

*IMPORTANT: This is not like a "Calendly" feature that tracks your availability. The options to tour a property will not be blocked off if your calendar shows you as unavailable. This feature is simply meant as a CTA to get site visitors to engage and request more information.

 

Viewing All Showing Requests

To access the Showings Dashboard, navigate to Calendar → Task View → My Showings → Showings. Showings that lead have requested will be located in the Showing Request column.

Clicking on the Showing Request will open a side panel with actions that can be taken:

  • Accept the Showing
  • Call Lead (if the lead has a valid phone number, opted into calls)
  • Text Lead (if the lead has a valid phone number, opted into texts)
  • Email Lead (if the lead has a valid email address, opted into emails.

The showing can also be accepted on the lead's profile:

When accepting the showing, the first step is to select the date and time. This is optimized to match the lead's requested showing date:

The next step is to contact the Listing Agent to acquire the access code. Once acquired, enter in the Access Instructions box to confirm the showing:

Once the showing is approved, it will move to the Approved column.

If the requested showing listing has been sold, it will be marked with a red Sold banner, and the option to accept the showing request will be removed. If the showing is approved, it will automatically be canceled and all participants will be notified via email. 

Scheduled showings will appear on the Lofty calendar, as well as synchronize to integrated third-party calendars.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Lead Capture - Dave Ramsey
title: Lead Capture - Dave Ramsey
body:
Introduction

In this article, we will review how to set up email parsing in Lofty for Dave Ramsey leads. 

 

What kind of Email will be Parsed?

Lofty is able to parse a new lead into your CRM based on an email alert that comes from Dave Ramsey to your Lofty-integrated email. Here are the common items that Lofty searches for in Email Parsing:

From Address: elp.support@daveramsey.com
Subject: New ELP Lead
Email Body: 

Note: There are two lead notification emails in Dave Ramsey. When you receive the first lead notification email (shown below), you will still need to click the link in the email they send you to get the lead information (the second lead notification) which will then be sent to Lofty.

 

How to Set it Up

Enter your Lofty-integrated email address as the email that receives lead notifications in your Dave Ramsey settings.

Note: The fields parsed from Dave Ramsey are Full Name, Email, and Phone. Any other fields will be parsed as Notes in Lofty. 

 

How to find your unique Lofty email address in Lofty?

Go to the Settings page, and under the Features section on the right of the page, click Integration to Integration page and then click Lead Capture.

On the bottom of this page, you will see Auto-import Lead via third-party providers. Here, you will see your Lofty email, which you will use to auto-import leads from Realtor.com. In this section, click Copy.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Social Media Feed Block
title: Social Media Feed Block
body:
Introduction

The social media feed block is a feature available to advanced social studio users. This feature will display your social media feed on your IDX website.

 

Instructions

To add the social media feed block to your Lofty website, navigate to the CMS tool and open the website editor. More information on editing your Lofty website can be found here: Add / Edit Website Pages

 

The social media feed block is located in the Block Library.

When the block is added, it will automatically add any social media posts that have been shared. To edit the feed sources, click the edit icon on the block to open the block editor panel:

Please note:

  • When a site visitor clicks on any of the posts, it will redirect them to the details on that social platform.
  • This Social Feed will show existing posts from connected social pages, even if they were not published via the Lofty Social Studio (except LinkedIn).
  • Video posts will not display
  • Link-only posts will not generate a preview

 

Questions?

name: Print House: Mailers
title: Print House: Mailers
body:
Introduction

Design and print postcards and letters all within the Lofty platform! Use this feature to create designs, configure engagement mechanisms, and send mailers to your database or an uploaded list of recipients. The Print Center can be used as a tool that compliments the rest of the digital automation features in Lofty to make sure you have all your marketing and lead generation covered.

 

Summary

  • Postcard Product Information
  • Letter Product Information
  • Sending Mailers Manually
  • Sending Mailers Automatically via Smart Plans
  • Create Mailing Label
  • FAQs

 

Postcard Product Information

Sizes

Only the following postcard sizes are available:

  • 4" x 6"
  • 6" x 9"
  • 6" x 11"

Materials

  • Basis Weight: 100# - 120# Cover
  • GSM: 255 - 325
  • Full Bleed 1 Side UV Gloss
  • 10% PCW Product
  • FSC Certified

Mailing Options

All postcards are sent via the United States Postal Service (USPS).

First Class Mail 

  • Supported Postcard Sizes
    • 4" x 6"
    • 6" x 9"
    • 6" x 11"
  • Estimated Delivery Time
    • 4 - 6 business days

Standard Mail 

  • Supported Postcard Sizes
    • 6" x 9"
    • 6" x 11"
  • Estimated Delivery Time
    • 7 - 21 business days

Postcard Cost

You can choose to (a) pay-per-use on a postcard, or you can (b) purchase postcard print packages to save money by purchasing in bulk.

 

(a) Pay-Per-Use Cost

(b) Print Package Cost

You will be presented with the option to purchase postcard print packages during the order process of the postcards or on the main Marketing > Print House page if you have never used postcards in Lofty before.

NOTE: Please note that refunds are not available for successful top-up transactions.


Specific Information:

  • Credits are used to purchase postcards.
  • 1 postcard mailed by USPS Standard Mail requires 1 credit.
  • 1 postcard mailed by USPS First Class Mail requires 1.5 credits.
  • All unused credits will be removed after the last day of the package period of validity.

 

Letter Product Information

Size

There is only one size: 8.5" x 11"

Letter Cost

Just like with postcards, you can use a print package to pay for letters or you can use a pay-per-use option instead.

(a) Pay-Per-Use Cost

The cost will vary depending on (1) the color and (2) the total number of pages.

(b) Print Package Cost

You will be presented with the option to purchase postcard print packages during the order process of the postcards or on the main Campaigns > Print Center page if you have never used postcards in Lofty before.

Printing Process Time Frame (Letters and Postcards)

1. After mailers are approved, we only send them to the print house the following day.
2. For mailers scheduled ahead of time, we'll send them to the print house on the Scheduled Print Date
3. It will take 24-48 business hours for the mailers to be printed before they are sent out to the Courier.

 

Sending Mailers Manually

Navigate to Marketing  > Print House:

 

Click Print Mailers to start the purchase process:

 

STEP 1: Select the Mailer Type:

We currently offer postcards or Letters. Click "Discard" to exit and "Next" to continue to the next step.

STEP 2: Select the Design

Note: Postcards have a Front and Back design, while Letters only have a Front design

Option 1: Use a Lofty Design

  1. Browse through the available Lofty design options
  2. Click "Preview" to expand or "Edit Design" to adjust the design
  3. Click "Advanced Edit" to customize the design or "Confirm" to select it

Option 2: Upload Your Design

  1. Click "Upload" in the upper right corner in the Select Design section
  2. Crop to highlight the print area of the design
  3. Access the design editor by clicking "Edit Design" on the pop-up window

 

 

STEP 3: If sending Postcards, choose the back design and set up the tracking tool.

STEP 4: Set up the Recipients

Here, you can select leads from the CRM, upload a mailing list, or purchase homeowner data using the Geographic Farming tool.

 

STEP 5: Review the order and pay:

 

Sending Mailers Automatically via Smart Plans

Postcards and letters can be sent as part of a Smart Plan. Note: all letters sent via a Smart Plan will be printed in color only.

Billing Logic

The following is the logic for the mailer billing

  • If the Smart Plan is a My Smart Plan, you will be responsible for paying the fees associated with the mailers. You can add your payment method directly to the Smart Plan if you do not already have one on file.
  • if the Smart Plan is a Team, Group, or Company Smart Plan, the responsible payer will be determined on the Smart Plan's settings page.
    • *Only those with admin-level access and the "Team Templates" permission can create Team/Company/Group Smart Plans (see Team Permissions)
  • If there is no card on file, the Smart Plan cannot be saved successfully.

After a mailer is sent, the total accrued fees will be recorded. The total cost for mailers sent in the previous month will be billed on the scheduled billing date of the following month. 

  • Please note, the postcards and letters sent via Smart Plans do not pull from any credit packages that you might have purchased. The cost is always the same for postcards sent via Smart Plans and will be billed separately on any billing statements.

Pricing is as follows:

  • Postcards
    • Standard Mail: $1.15
    • First Class Mail: $1.20
  • Letters
    • Standard Mail:
      • B&W one-page: $1.10
      • Color one-page: $1.15
      • Extra pages (maximum of 6): $0.20-$0.80
    • First Class Mail:
      • B&W one-page: $1.49
      • Color one-page: $1.55
      • Extra pages (maximum of 6): $0.20-$0.80

Setup Steps

For more general information regarding Smart Plans, please visit HERE.

To send a postcard via a Smart Plan, navigate to the CRM > Marketing > Automations > Smart Plans. Create a new Smart Plan.

If you would like to add a postcard or letter step (or multiple) as part of your Smart Plan, choose Postcard or Letter from the action drop-down:

The next step is to go ahead and design the mailer that you'd like to send. Use the available option and Click on Design Postcard:

You will then be presented with the option to either use a system template or your own template, or you can upload a design. 

You can create custom designs in the Lofty Design Center. Learn more about the Lofty Design Center here: Design Center

 

After you have selected your design, you can preview it and make any necessary edits. 

Remember to add your return address and select the delivery option (Standard Mail vs. First Class Mail). The price is outlined in the notes at the bottom of the Smart Plan step. If you only see one of the options (First Class Mail), it is because the postcard size you selected is not available via Standard Mail.

Navigate to the Smart Plan Settings tab to determine who is responsible for the fees incurred by this Smart Plan.

  • Smart Plan Creator is the Lofty user who created this Smart Plan
  • Smart Plan Users are any Lofty users who add a lead to this Smart Plan

IMPORTANT NOTES:

  • All postcards designed within Smart Plan steps are accessible via Design Center > My Designs > Lofty Postcards. You can use this to copy a postcard, but you will not be able to edit it from there. If you need to edit a postcard, you must do so via the Smart Plan where it resides.

 

Mailer Campaign Reporting

After campaigns are built, navigate back to Marketing > Print House to see any campaigns that are being run. Click on the name of any campaign to open up the specific information regarding that campaign. 

After clicking into an individual campaign, the following information is available:

SECTION 1

  • Campaign Name. The name was given automatically to the campaign when created, as well as the date the campaign was created (YYYYMMDD)
  • Campaign Status
    • Scheduled: You have paid, but the scheduled print date has not yet been reached.
    • Delivering: The postcard designs have been sent to the printer to process and send the postcards. The cards are still in transit.
    • Finished: If the delivery status of all recipients in the mailing list is in a "final" status, this status will be displayed. "Final" means any of the following: Delivered, Re-Routed, “Returned To Sender.
    • Delayed: If the scheduled print date has been reached or passed, but the client has not completed the engagement setup, which is a requirement to send if that element was added.
  • Last Updated. The last time this campaign report was updated.
  • Settings. This will only appear if the Campaign Status = "Scheduled". With this option, you can (1) edit the design or (2) change the engagement settings:

SECTION 2

  • Postcard Preview. A thumbnail preview of the front page of the postcard design.
  • Total Sent. The total number of postcards sent.
  • Delivering. Postcard with any of the following delivery statuses:
    • In Transit
    • In Local Area
    • Processed for Delivery
  • Delivered. Postcard with any of the following delivery statuses:
    • Delivered
    • Re-routed
    • Returned
  • Engaged Leads / New Leads. If an existing lead is engaged, it will show up in the large number, but only newly captured leads will display in the "New Leads" number

SECTION 3

Delivery Report

  • Download. Use this option to download a delivery report for this postcard campaign in CSV format, including the following fields:
    • Lead Full Name
    • Mailing Address
    • Status
  • Lead Name. This column refers to the specific lead in your database who was sent a postcard. Clicking on the lead name will take you to the lead profile. This column will not be visible if the postcards are sent to uploaded addresses via CSV.
  • Mailing Address. The mailing address that the postcard was sent to for that lead. This column will be changed to the name of "Recipients" if postcards are sent to uploaded addresses via CSV.
  • Status. The following statuses are possible:
    • Scheduled. The postcard has been paid for and is scheduled to be sent on the defined print date.
    • Invalid Address.
    • Printing. The printer is working on printing the postcard. 
    • In Transit. The postcard is being processed at the entry/origin facility.
    • In the Local Area. The postcard is being processed at the destination facility.
    • Processed for Delivery. The postcard has been given the green light for delivery at the recipient's nearest postal facility. The postcard should reach the mailbox within 1 business day of this status being shown.
    • Delivered. The postcard is marked as "Delivered" one business day after the "Processed for Delivery" status.
    • Re-Routed. The postcard was rerouted due to the recipient's change of address, address errors, or USPS relabeling of the barcode/ID tag area.
    • Returned. The postcard is being returned to the sender due to barcode, ID tag area, or address errors.

Smart Plan Mailer Reporting

Reporting for Smart Plan mailers can be accessed by going to Marketing > Print House> Smart Plans:

A Smart Plan "Mailer Campaign" (whose name will be auto-generated) is equivalent to one specific postcard or letter step in a Smart Plan. In other words, if you have one Smart Plan with multiple postcard/letter steps, each one of those individual postcard/letter steps would have its own mailer campaign.

The name of the Smart Plan that the step belongs to will be listed underneath the campaign name, along with the type of Smart Plan that it is (My Smart Plan vs. Team Smart Plan)

The status of mailers for that campaign is displayed in the middle columns:

Remember that Smart Plan mailers are charged separately from any pre-purchased mailer packages (Standard Mail = $0.99/postcard, First Class Mail = $1.49/postcard). The total spent for each campaign (Smart Plan postcard step) will be listed in the Total Spent column at the right.

Pausing a Smart Plan

 

Because letters have variable data support for the agent or lead information, we do not want those to be sent if that information is not available. The logic is as follows:

  • Smart Plan Campaigns
    • If variables in the letter/postcard are for data that is not available, the Smart Plan will auto-pause for any leads where that data is not available
    • If the system recognizes that the data is available now, the Smart Plan will reactivate automatically.
  • Manual Campaigns
    • If agent variables (agent data) have data that is not available, the whole campaign will be paused
    • If lead variables have data that is not available, the postcard/letter will not be sent to just that recipient

Create Mailing Label

Lofty supports printing up to 30 Mailing Labels on one sheet. Up to 250 leads can be selected at once to create mailing labels for leads with a mailing address. 


Navigate to People Page > select at least one lead > click the More button > select Mailing label. 

To create a mailing label for one specific lead, navigate to the Lead Detail page > 3 dots > Mailing Label.
Note: The leads has to have a valid mailing address for the button to be available in the lead profile. 

  • A pop-up window will show how many valid leads are able to generate a mailing label. You may choose to include spouses and eliminate duplicate leads. 
  • For spouse, we will take the lead who are described as: wife, husband, Spouse, Life partner, Companion, Consort, or Marriage Partner in the lead profile. Those leads can be identified as a spouse.

  • A PDF will be generated based on the selected leads. 
    • 30 mailing labels on one page.
      • If you choose only 1 lead, we will generate 30 identical labels to fill out one page.
      • If you choose multiple leads, each lead will get 1 label in the PDF file.
      • Size: Avery 5160：2.625 x 1 inches（66.675 x 25.4 mm）
      • Info on mailing label:
        • First & Last name, street, city, state, zip code

FAQs

  • Can I send postcards to Canada?
  • Can I send postcards directly from the People page? 
  • If I schedule a postcard to be sent, is it possible to edit the design before it is sent?
  • Can I upload my designs and mail postcards via Lofty?
  • If I want to cancel a postcard campaign that has not yet been sent, how can I do that?
  • Can I purchase more than one print package at a time?
  • Will I be notified before my print package credits expire?
  • What are the exact triggers for the engagement mechanisms?
  • Can I edit recipients on an ongoing print campaign?
  • Why can't I upload my Company Logo in the Personal Information?

Can I send postcards to Canada?

No, currently we do not support sending postcards to addresses located in Canada. Other limitations for Canada are documented HERE.

 

Can I send postcards directly from the People page? 

Yes, you can choose an audience for your postcards by navigating to the People page, selecting the leads you want to send postcards to, and then clicking on the button to Send Postcards. Only leads that have mailing addresses on their lead profile will be able to receive postcards.

You may receive a warning informing you that only a certain number of the leads selected have a mailing address associated with their profile. In other words, the exact number of leads that you selected will only be sent postcards if they all have mailing addresses.

 

If I schedule a postcard to be sent, is it possible to edit the design before it is sent?

No, not at present.

 

Can I upload my designs and mail postcards via Lofty?

Yes, to some extent. An Upload Design button is available on the template screen:

This adds the uploaded image directly to the design for your use. When uploading an image, the postcard canvas will remain the default size, and the image will be added to that canvas size. 

Please note the following:

  • Only JPG and PNG file types are currently supported. PSD is not supported in this version.
  • The file size must be ≤ 10 MB

If I want to cancel a postcard campaign that has not yet been sent, how can I do that?

If you would like to cancel a postcard campaign that is scheduled to be sent on a future date, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com> or by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557.

You cannot cancel a campaign that has already been started.

Currently, there is no option to cancel a campaign directly on the platform.

 

Can I purchase more than one print package at a time?

No, the entire credit balance of an existing package must be used before another package can be purchased. However, if you are sending a campaign that would use up the entire balance, the option will be available for you to purchase another print package during the final order process for the postcards.

 

Will I be notified before my print package credits expire?

Currently, there is no reminder configured. However, this is being considered for future optimizations here. For now, you will want to pay attention to the expiration date (AKA "Period of Validity") for each postcard print package. 

 

What are the exact triggers for the engagement mechanisms

See Postcard Engagement: Text Codes and QR Codes.

 

Can I edit recipients on an ongoing print campaign?

To add or remove recipients from an ongoing print campaign, navigate to the campaign in the Print Center and click Update Plan Settings. New recipients can be added by clicking + Add New. Click the Trash Can icon to remove a recipient from the list. 

Why can't I upload my Company Logo in the Personal Information?

Your account admin may have set up the company branding details for you. If you would like to change your own design center branding, please ask your account admin to toggle off the setting that you would like to change.

Will the order for the postcard reflect in the lead's timeline?

Yes, there is an activity recorded in the lead's timeline of activities.

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Registration Pop-up Style & Settings
title: Registration Pop-up Style & Settings
body:
Introduction

This section of the Lofty CMS allows you to choose from the available options for the registration pop-up appearance. This registration pop-up is a very important part of the Lofty IDX website as well as any marketing strategies, etc. that you are putting in place. 

This pop-up will be triggered based on the settings established in a separate section. For more information on this related topic, please reference the Registration Pop-up Trigger Rule. 

 

Summary

  • Settings Location
  • Style
    • Single Column
    • Two Columns
    • One Step Column
  • Content
  • Registration Settings
  • Add Third-Party Registration
  • Allow for Pop-Up to be Closed
  • Email-Only Lead Registration

 

Settings Location

To edit this setting, navigate to the CMS (website editor) > Lead Capture > Pop-up Style & Settings:

 

Style

There are three different styles that can be used and the content settings will vary depending on the style selected. Choose the style right at the top:

 

Single Column

 

Two Columns

One Step Column

 

Content

If you choose either the "Single Column" or the "Two Columns" style, you will be presented with two different steps where you will need to configure the content:

If you choose the "One Step Column," you will only have to configure the content for that one step.

 

To configure the content, simply complete the fields which include the following:

  • Background Color
  • Title
  • Description
  • Button Text
  • Thank you Message

 

Registration Settings

Here you will edit whether you will set the name and phone number as "Required" or "Optional." Please note that email is always going to be marked as required.

 

Please note that the configuration of this setting can affect Google Chrome One-Click Website Registration. For more information on this topic, please reference the following article: Google Chrome One-Click Website Registration.

 

Add Third-Party Registration

In order for these options to be available, a manual configuration by the Lofty Support Team will have to take place when your website is set up. This is built into the onboarding and account creation process, but if you do not see these options for some reason, please reach out to the Lofty Support Team for further assistance (support@lofty.com). 

 

Please note that in order to use the "Google Chrome One-Click Website Registration" you will need to have the "Google" box checked and enabled on your forced registration. For more information on this topic, please reference the following article: Google Chrome One-Click Website Registration.

 

Email-Only Lead Registration

  • Registration Logic
  • Turn On/Off
  • Additional Info
  • Return to Site Logic

 

Registration Logic

A specific logic has been built into the registration pop-up on certain registration styles for your website. This logic is designed to capture email addresses during the registration process, even if the site visitor did not provide all of their information (name, phone).

If a lead provides at least their email address but backs out of the full registration process before providing their name and phone number, you will capture an email-only lead after a five-minute built-in delay.

This is only supported in the following scenarios:

  1. When a lead fills out their email address in the built-in field of the Single Column registration style but does not provide their name or phone number in the second step.
  2. When a lead fills out their email address in the built-in field of the Two Columns registration style but does not provide their name or phone number in the second step.
  3. When a lead clicks on the Continue with Facebook or Continue with Gmail button on any of the registration styles. When they do so, they will be asked to provide their phone number. If they back out of the process before providing their phone number, their email address will be captured.

 

Turn On/Off

If you would like to turn this feature on/off, you can now navigate to CMS > Settings > Lead Capture > Site Email Lead and toggle this feature on/off. It will be enabled by default.

 

Additional Info

It is very important that you are aware of the following information:

  • If no name is captured the lead will be saved as "No Name" in your CRM
  • Leads captured via this method will maintain their original source depending on how they found your website. They were previously saved as the lead source of "Site Email Lead" but that logic was discontinued on May 8, 2021.
  • Leads captured will all be tagged with a private tag called "Lofty Email Lead" so that you can easily filter by these specific leads in the future.
  • By default, these leads are considered as "opted-out" which means auto email communication can not be sent to them until they are opted-in. See Email Opt-In Status for more information.
  • If you plan to market to these leads, please make sure you are aware of how they entered your system. They did not finish the registration process but they did type in their email address and continued to the next step before backing out (and not providing name/phone).

 

Return to Site Logic

If a site visitor had previously provided their email address but did not finalize registration, the next time they are on your Lofty-built site, they will be prompted to provide their phone number to finalize registration. This same pop-up will appear one time per day until they provide a phone number.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by a chat with us through your Lofty CRM. 

Related terms: site email lead,

name: Design Center
title: Design Center
body:
Introduction

 

The Lofty Design Center is a tool that can be used to create images with designs, logos, text, etc. to include in emails, flyers, social media posts, or even your IDX website. This article will outline how to use the Lofty Design Center which is found in the CRM > Marketing > Design Center: 

Summary

  • Organization
    • Lofty Designs
    • My Designs
  • Starting a Design
    • Modifying a Lofty Design
    • Building on an existing design
    • Starting with a blank canvas
    • Utilizing Lofty's Design Service
  • Design Editor
    • Adding Content
    • Editing Content
    • Adding Pages
    • General Controls
  • Previewing, Saving, and Exporting a Design
    • Previewing a Design
    • Saving a Design
    • Exporting a Design
      • Export via Editor
      • Export via folder action
    • Embedding Designs
  • FAQs

 

Organization

When you first access the Design Center, you will be able to see a folder hierarchy available to access and organize your designs.

 

Lofty Designs

The first tab you will see is Lofty Designs. On this tab, you will have access to designs that have been provided by us for your use. They are separated into "All," "Postcards," "Flyers," and "Social Media" categories.

If you would like to build on top of one of these designs (using it as a starting point) then you can simply hover over the one you like and then click on the large "+" button and you will be able to edit the design.

 

My Designs

The second tab is the My Designs tab. Here you can access the content that you have put together or that is made available on your team. 

Click on the blue button to Create New Folder, decide on a folder name, and then choose permissions for the folder.

  • Private folders can only be viewed by yourself.
  • Shared folders
    • can be viewed by all other users on your team
    • only those with the "Team Template" permission (see Permissions) can edit the files in this type of folder

When Enterprise account users create a new folder, they can choose which groups to share the folder with.

  • Users with the "Manage Template —— Entire Company" permission can share folders with all groups built out in the account.
  • Users with the "Manage Template —— User's Group" permission can only share folders with their group and any subgroups.
  • Please see Enterprise Permissions for more information on these permissions.

If you want to edit (rename, change permissions) or delete your folders you can always do so with the icons on the right side in the Actions column:

Inside a folder, you can perform the following actions:

  • Edit. Change the name of the file or the folder that it is saved in.
  • Copy. Give it a new name and choose the folder where you would like to copy it.
  • Download. You can download it in the following formats: PDF, PNG, and JPG.
  • Delete. Remove the file from the design center. Note that there is no "recycle bin" or backup copy of your design unless you made a copy with the copy action.

Starting a Design

To create a design you can do so in four (4) different ways:

  1. Modifying a Lofty design
  2. Building on an existing design
  3. Starting with a blank canvas
  4. Utilizing Lofty's Design Service

*IMPORTANT: Your designs do not auto-save. Be sure to save any design that you built as often as necessary in case you have internet connection issues.

 

Modifying a Lofty Design

Lofty provides a library of designs. Hover over a design and click Edit to get started. 

Here, you can edit that design and all of its elements, including photos, text, etc.

Building on an existing design

If your team has already created designs, you can access them via the My Designs tab at the top of the Design Center: 

Once you have entered a folder, you can then click the name of the design to edit (if you have permission to edit) or you can click the copy icon to make your copy and then adjust it on your own:

 

Starting with a blank canvas

To start your design from scratch, click on the blue "Create New Design" button in the top-right:

A new tab of your browser will then open with the editor:

Utilizing Lofty's Design Service

Click Need a Better Design? to get started. Lofty offers a design service, where you select your format: Post Card, Letter, or Flyer, provide our design team with your needs, and checkout. Two (2) rounds of revisions are included and the design is delivered in two (2) business days.

Design Editor

Once you are in the design editor, there are some important tools that you will want to know how to use. 

 

Adding Content

To add content, click on the type of content that you would like on the left side. You can choose from text, photos, elements, icons, and logos.

Once you have found content that you would like to add to your design, you can either click what you want to add and it will appear on the design or you can drag and drop it on your design:

You can upload additional images/photos or icons by selecting that content type and then clicking to browse:

 

You can access your listings to pull their images into your designs within the Design Center. You can access the following:

  • My Listings
  • Team Listings
  • Manual Listings (formerly known as pocket listings)

You will not be able to access all the listings on the MLS.

 

Editing Content

To edit content, simply click on the content that you would like to edit within your design and then adjust accordingly. For example, selecting this text content allows me to edit the font, size, color, etc. If you double-click the text content box, you will be able to type in what you would like to replace the filler text:

Editing an element or an icon will allow you to change opacity and fill color:

 

Adding Pages

To add additional pages to your design, click on the two arrows in the top left:

And then click on the large + icon:

Alternatively, you can also right-click on an existing page to copy that page or delete it:

 

General Controls

Keyboard Shortcuts

The following keyboard shortcuts are now supported when interacting with elements in the Design Center:

(a) CTRL/CMD+C (Copy)

(b) CTRL/CMD+V (Paste)

(c) CTRL/CMD+Z (Undo)

 

UI Buttons

Use this icon in the top-right to do the following:

  • Adjust canvas size
  • Add canvas image
  • Review content layers

Use this toolbar to do the following when selecting a specific object in your design:

  • Bring forward
  • Send backward
  • Bring to front
  • Send to back
  • Align left
  • Align center
  • Align right
  • Group
  • Ungroup
  • Crop image, save, cancel
  • Clone
  • Delete

With an object selected, you can also open up the side menu to adjust shadows, styles, and many more items. The menu will change slightly depending on the content of the object that you have selected.

Image Replacement

You can select an image and replace it with another one with the click of a button:

 

Agent Profile Photo

When designs are added to the Design Center, images can be tagged as an agent's profile photo. This means that when the design is used, the system will automatically check the CRM first and then the CMS (Site) for a headshot profile photo and automatically use that one in the design. These images can only be tagged on upload by Lofty. If there is no profile photo available in the CRM or CMS then it will not replace it at all.

Previewing, Saving, and Exporting a Design

*IMPORTANT: Your designs do not auto-save. Be sure to save any design that you built as often as necessary in case you have internet connection issues.

Previewing a Design

To preview a design, simply click on the blue "Preview" button at the top-right:

If you have multiple pages to your design, the pages will be clickable at the bottom:

 

Saving a Design

To save a design, click the blue "Save" button in the top-right:

Give the design a name and choose the folder where you want it to live:

Exporting a Design

First of all, you must note that currently, to use your design anywhere else in the Lofty platform, you must first export your design. There is no existing feature that can pull the designs in automatically.

There are two ways to export a design: (1) via the editor or (2) via a folder action:

 

Export via Editor

To export a design via the editor, simply click on the blue "Download" button in the top-right:

You can export in the following formats:

  • PDF
  • PNG
  • JPG

 

Export via folder action

When browsing your folders in the Design Center, you will find the "Download" icon in the Actions column. When clicked, you will be able to export in PDF, PNG, or JPG format:

 

Embedding Designs

Users can create a design in the Lofty Design Center and generate an HTML embed code that they can place on their website(s).

Click the three dots in the top-right corner and then choose Embed:

 

An embed code will be produced for you automatically. Click the Copy button to get the code and use it elsewhere.

 

This can, of course, be used to embed the design in a Lofty-built website using the Code block:

 

Additional information:

  • Multiple pages are supported when generating the HTML code
  • If the design HTML is already added to a webpage but is later updated, a new embed code will need to be generated and used to replace the original design for the update to be visible.
  • URLs added to elements within the design are not clickable

FAQs

  • Is there a limit to the number of files that I can create?
  • Is there a limit to the size of the files that I create?
  • Can I print postcards from the Design Center?
  • Can I upload my designs to the Design Center?

Is there a limit to the number of files that I can create?

No. There is no current limit to the number of files you can create.

 

Is there a limit to the size of the files that I create?

No, not at present.

 

Can I print postcards from the Design Center?

Yes, see Self-Service Postcards.

 

Can I upload my designs to the Design Center?

Yes, to some extent. An Upload Design button is available on the template screen:

This adds the uploaded image directly to the design for your use. When uploading an image, the canvas will remain the default size and the image will be added to that canvas size. 

Please note the following:

  • Only JPG and PNG file types are currently supported. PSD is not supported in this version.
  • The file size must be ≤ 10 MB

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Feature Updates for CRM 3.3.0
title: Feature Updates for CRM 3.3.0
body:
Introduction

*Please note that the features available to you on the Lofty platform will vary depending on the package you have purchased. For any questions in this regard, please reach out to your assigned Customer Success Manager or our Support Team for more information.

Release Date

The release date for these features is Tuesday, March 31, 2020.

Summary

  • Support for up to 50 Custom Fields
  • New "All" Option for Lead Profile Activity Search
  • Google/Outlook Calendar Integration Optimization 
  • Enterprise Admin Access to Lead Gen Report
  • Team Member Access to Individual Lead Gen Report
  • Realtor.com Connections℠ Plus Leads via API

 

Support for up to 50 Custom Fields 

With this update, teams can now add up to 50 custom fields via Settings > Features > Custom Fields. This change has been made to support additional information being documented in specific fields that are consistent across lead profiles. More information regarding custom fields can be found here: How to use Custom Fields.

*IMPORTANT: Please keep in mind that custom fields are not searchable and should not replace tags and segments which are designed for filtering (see Lead Organization with Tags and Lead Organization with Segments)

Because the number has increased to 50, the way they display is also different when adding a lead because there will now be a menu that has to be expanded:

All of these custom fields are also available for import which can be very useful when importing information into Lofty that should be consistent across all leads:

 

New "All" Option for Lead Profile Activity Search 

A new checkbox is now available when filtering activity on a lead profile. This is a simple improvement that allows for users to simply click on "All" instead of manually checking each box separately.

 

Google/Outlook Calendar Integration Optimization 

The appointment functionality (see Appointments) has been improved so that events will display with the lead's name on the integrated Google or Outlook Calendar. Here is how it will work:

  1. If the appointment is created inLofty without a description, then the description of the appointment synced to Google/Outlook Calendar will be: "Lead Name - New Appointment"
  2. If the appointment is created in Lofty with a description, then the description of the appointment synced to Google/Outlook Calendar is: "Lead Name - Description"

 

Enterprise Admin Access to Lead Gen Report

*Only available for lead gen being run by the Lofty Ads Team 

At the present time, lead generation campaigns can only be run to either the team website or individual agent subdomain websites. With this update, users of the Enterprise product will have the option to log into the teams on their accounts to view ad performance for that specific team. This was previously only available to the Team Owner/Admin of that time. 

To access, an Enterprise Admin will use the Enterprise Back-End to log in to the team and then click on the Campaigns tab at the top for that team. They will then see the ad campaigns for that team:

 

Team Member Access to Individual Lead Gen Report

If an individual Team Member is running a lead generation campaign with the Lofty Ads Team, they will now have access to their own individual report under the Campaigns section. This type of report was previously only accessible to the Team Admins/Owners and for team campaigns. With this update, an individual member can have insight into their own personal campaign that they can run with Lofty .

 

Realtor.com Connections℠ Plus Leads via API

A new direct integration has been released with Realtor.com and is only for Connections℠ Plus Leads and works via Realtor.com's lead delivery API (eLeads). If you have a Pro account with Realtor.com, you can have your Connections℠ Plus leads imported into Lofty automatically when a new lead is generated.

To learn more about how to set up this integration, please reference the following Help Center article: Realtor.com Integration.

*IMPORTANT: Please note that this connection method is available for Connections℠ Plus leads only. It is not currently available for other leads, including Advantage℠ Pro and Profile leads. These kinds of leads can only be imported through email parsing mentioned previously.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com> or by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557.

name: Website SEO (Search Engine Optimization)
title: Website SEO (Search Engine Optimization)
body:
Introduction

SEO stands for “search engine optimization.” It is the process of getting traffic from the “free,” “organic,” “editorial,” or “natural” search results on search engines.

Your Lofty site has been built using SEO best practices, but there are things that you can be doing to help increase site validity and reputation in the eyes of Google. Remember, SEO is a marathon, not a sprint! You must be consistent with your efforts over long periods for SEO to be improved and harnessed as a tool. SEO is about building your relationship with search engines as a valuable and reliable website and resource.

 

 

Summary


This article will review a few important ways you can begin your SEO journey with Lofty websites.

  • Add Unique Meta Data to Every Page on Your Website
  • Start Relevant and Regular Blogging
  • Add Reviews to your Website
  • Increase Backlinking to Your Site
  • Additional Resources
  • 301 Redirects
  • Image and Content Hosting

 

Add Unique Meta Data to Every Page on Your Website

A "meta description" is a snippet of up to about 155 characters – a tag in HTML – which summarizes a page's content. Search engines show the meta description in search results mostly when the searched-for phrase is within the description, so optimizing the meta descriptions is crucial.

 

Best Practices

  • Add an accurate name for each page
  • Create separate pages for different products, services, and topics
  • Stay between 50 and 160 characters for your Meta Page Descriptions
  • Stay under 60 characters for your Meta Page Titles
  • Put important keywords first
  • Do not overdo SEO keywords. While there is no penalty built into Google's algorithm for long titles, you can run into trouble if you start stuffing your title full of keywords in a way that creates a bad user experience
  • Give every page a unique title. Unique titles help search engines understand that your content is unique and valuable, and also drive higher click-through rates
  • Write for your customers. While title tags are very important to SEO, remember that your first job is attracting clicks from well-targeted visitors who will likely find your content valuable.
  • Add an appropriate cover image that relates to your content
  • Put the most important information in writing. Using rich content, including videos, audio clips, animations, etc., can help to maintain the attention of your site visitors for a longer period, but search engines do not understand videos, audio, etc. So, use text for important information as much as possible.
  • Make sure to add alt text with your site's name for your logo on your website. It would also be a good idea to include your website's name in the text somewhere else on that page.
  • Add heading tags. The H1 tag (a.k.a "heading tag") serves as the title for each page. This tag should be like the headline of a page, just like you have a headline on a page within the newspaper, etc. At Lofty, we have already populated the H1 to H5 tags for each page for you. 

 

How to Use Lofty CMS to Make Changes

To make changes to existing pages in Lofty using the New CMS, do the following:

 

To edit the logo and alt text, please reference the Header.

 

Start Relevant and Regular Blogging

Blogging, when done regularly and with relevant information, can help boost your SEO rankings. There are many ways you can use blogging as a Real Estate Agent.

You can use blogging to help establish yourself as an area expert, provide helpful information to future residents, or help educate your Buyers and Sellers on buying and selling in today's market. People investigate the areas they are moving to and want to understand what there is to do in the area, where the best places to eat might be, or how walkable the area is.

You can even use blogging to help increase Backlinking, which is explained more in-depth in the following section. For example, if you learn about an amazing restaurant in the area, blog about it and let that restaurant know. Chances are, they will use your link and post it to their social media or site to let their audience know they were featured. This is one way to increase your Backlinking. 

 

To learn how to use Lofty to blog, please reference the following article: Blog Page.

 

Add Reviews to Your Website

One thing that site visitors will expect to see on your website is reviews of your services and organization. You will want to do your best to meet that expectation by adding reviews to different pages on your website. Learn more about how to do this with the following articles:

  • Reviews Page
  • Reviews Block

 

Increase Backlinking to Your Site

Backlinks are when you are listed on another site and are especially valuable for SEO. They represent a "vote of confidence" from one site to another. In essence, backlinks to your website are a signal to search engines that others vouch for your content. If many sites link to the same webpage or website, search engines can infer that the content is worth linking to, and therefore also worth surfacing on a search engine results page. So, earning these backlinks can have a positive effect on a site's ranking position or search visibility.

Add backlinks to your website on your social media pages, and other real estate websites where you have a profile (Trulia, Realtor.com, brand websites, etc.).

  • How many sites are currently backlinking to your site, and what can you do to increase that number?

 

Additional Resources

Below are a couple of additional resources to keep in your back pocket. They were created to help you understand the basics of SEO and how it relates to Lofty.

  • SEO for Real Estate Webinar Series

 

301 Redirects

Setting up 301 redirects is like forwarding your mail after a move. If you are migrating from an old website to a Lofty website, you might have heard about 301 redirects and have a few questions about how they work at Lofty. For all inquiries in this area, please submit a request via your Onboarding Specialist, Customer Success Manager (CSM), or our Support Team (support@lofty.com) for additional assistance.

Please note that all 301 redirects have to be done manually. Because of this, Lofty is not able to do this on an individual, page-by-page basis. If you have pages that you want to be redirected, a request can be submitted to redirect multiple pages to one page on Lofty. In most scenarios, redirecting to your Lofty IDX website home page is sufficient, as it keeps site visitors from getting lost.

If you are bringing over your domain to Lofty, you can also work on recreating the same pages on Lofty. This can work, but it will depend on the page structure that you are trying to create.

If you are concerned about how a large number of "dead links" will affect your SEO, Lofty can help to submit a request to Google to help remove the dead links to avoid potential problems here.

 

Image and Content Hosting

Though not specifically "SEO," page load time is extremely important for your site's reputation. One question that has been asked before is how images are hosted on Lofty websites. The answer is that this is done via CDN (Content Delivery Network), which improves load speed overall.

To learn more about CDN, see What is a CDN? | How do CDNs work?

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM. 

 

Related terms: SEO, search engine, indexing, meta, meta tags, site header, page load time

name: Working Hours & Vacation Mode
title: Working Hours & Vacation Mode
body:
Introduction

Working Hours and Vacation Mode are settings that can be adjusted by individual Lofty users and Team Owners/Admins in order to keep leads from being sent when a specific Lofty user is unavailable. If Working Hours are established and a lead comes in outside of those hours, it will not be sent to those who are marked as unavailable per the Working Hours or whose Vacation Mode is toggled on.

For more information on lead routing rules, see this article: Lead Routing Rules.

 

Summary

  • Individual Lofty User Setup
  • Office Owner/Admin Setup
  • FAQ
    • Is it possible to set up working hours that are on a night shift or cross-day schedule?

 

Individual Lofty User Setup

Individual Lofty users can set this up from their Lofty accounts by doing the following:

  1. Navigate to Settings
  2. Click on Profile under My User Settings
  3. In the Working Hours section, adjust the schedule and/or toggle on/off Vacation Mode.

 

Office Owner/Admin Setup

An Office Owner/Admin can adjust the schedule for themselves by following the steps outlined above in "Individual User Setup." However, if they wish to adjust the settings for their team members, they can do the following:

  1. Navigate to Settings
  2. Click on My Organization under the My User Settings section
  3. In the Working Hours column, adjust the schedule and/or toggle on/off Vacation Mode for the corresponding team member.

 

FAQ

Is it possible to set up working hours that are on a night shift or cross-day schedule?

No, this is currently not feasible with the working hour function. Currently, the "end time" always needs to be later than the "start time," meaning you cannot go from PM to AM with the current logic in place.

 

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: How to Manage the Family Members of a Lead
title: How to Manage the Family Members of a Lead
body:
Introduction

Purchasing a home is usually a family decision, thus, all the decision-makers in a family need to be considered and contacted by real estate agents. Lofty supports easy management of leads' family member info. Follow this guide to learn how to create and manage a lead's family members.

 

Create Family Members For A Lead

To create family members for a lead, click  in the Lead Details section of a lead's profile page.

 

Enter the family member's information in the fields on the right side. You may want to input, e.g., husband or son, in the Relationship field to note the family member's relationship to the lead.

Auto Emails in the Smart Plans, Auto Property Alerts, and Market Reports will also be sent to the family members of a lead. If you want the family member to not receive these kinds of automated emails set up for the lead, check the corresponding option in the Family Member Unsubscribe options.

 

Click "Save" when you finish. Shortly after, you will see the family member's information on the left side of the lead's profile page. You can add up to four family members.

Contacting a Lead's Family Member

To contact a lead's family member via call, email, or text message, click the down arrow on the right of the Call, Email, or Text button on the top left of the lead's profile page. The emails or phone numbers of the family members will be shown in the menu that appears. Click the one you want to contact the family member with.

 

*IMPORTANT:

  • Please note that currently, any communication made to a family member on a lead will show up on the lead profile as if you are contacting the primary lead. Keep that in mind if you plan on merging leads. You can always reference the email address and/or phone number and who it belongs to to distinguish who the communication was with, but it will display as if it was always to the primary lead. If that will not work for your established workflow, an alternative option of connecting two leads could be to copy the URL for one lead, add it as a note in another lead, and pin that note to the top. Repeat the other way around. By doing this, you have connected the two leads, who are completely separate, but you do have a pinned note pointing out their relationship.
  • Currently, any mass email sent to leads will only be sent to the primary lead, not the family members of that lead.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM. 

 

Related terms: family member

name: Vendor and Partner Management
title: Vendor and Partner Management
body:
Introduction

Real Estate agents and teams work with a variety of vendors, partners, and contacts while in the process of closing deals with their clients. Lofty built the Vendor/Partner feature with that in mind. Though future improvements to this feature are planned, the current functionality allows for Team Owners/Admins to add contact information for their trusted vendors and partners and to then share lead information with these individuals so that they can follow up and assist in their respective roles. A vendor/partner can be added as a contact for any of the vendor/partner roles on a transaction.

 

Setting Up Vendors / Partners

Follow these steps to find this setting in your CRM:

  1. Navigate to Settings > Company 
  2. Click on Vendor / Partner found under the Company User Settings section
  3. Choose to + Add A Vendor / Partner or Edit or Delete those currently on the list

*Only Team Owners/Admins are able to add vendors and partners. The setup portion will be unavailable for all other users.

 

Add a New Vendor / Partner

Currently, Vendors/Partners can be added for the following roles:

  • Utilities
  • Home Improvement
  • Home Warranty
  • Escrow/Title
  • Home Insurance
  • Home Inspection
  • Agent
  • *Custom Role. A custom role can be created for whatever purpose is needed.

To add, follow these steps:

  1. Navigate to Settings
  2. Click on Vendor / Partner under the Team section
  3. Select the button to + Add A Vendor / Partner
  4. Select a role or create a new role

 

Setting Up a Custom Role

Follow these steps to find this setting in your CRM:

  1. Navigate to Settings > Company 
  2. Click on Vendor / Partner found under the Company User Settings section
  3. Choose to + Add Role or Edit or Delete those currently on the list

When adding a new role you will assign a name and a type which has four options:

  1. Lead/Client - Only leads can be assigned to this role
  2. Agent - Only another user on the Lofty account can be assigned to this role
  3. Lender - Only a lender-type account can be assigned to this role
  4. Vendor/Partner - Only a vendor/partner can be assigned to this role

 

Assigning Vendors/Partners or Contacts to Transactions

After a Vendor/Partner is added via Settings, you have the ability to assign them to a transaction. In order to do so, you must first add a transaction to a lead. To add a transaction, do the following:

  1. Navigate to the lead profile of the person you want to send to the vendor/partner by searching for their name or clicking on their name from the People Page
  2. Click on the Transactions & Docs tab at the top
  3. If you do not have a transaction, add one with all applicable information. The address is the only required field. 
  4. Click on the transaction
  5. Select the Contacts Tab
  6. Choose the Contact  you want to assign
  7. Select whether you want to "Send Introduction Email on Assignment"
  8. Click the Add a Contact button. 

 

 

Questions?

name: Being a Lender with Lofty
title: Being a Lender with Lofty
body:
Introduction

You may be interested in adding a preferred lender to your Lofty account. This would allow the preferred lender to access information associated with the leads assigned to them.

Summary

  • Plans
  • Ads Landing Pages
  • Lender Profiles
  • Lender Page
  • Marketplace
  • Lender Billing Page
  • Lender Account Limitations

 

Plans

Lofty has one plan option for inviting a lender:

 

Multiple Flex Plan lenders can be added. This plan does not share any of the costs. 

You will have the option to send the lender a link to upload a payment method:

 

This option is also available for Lenders who have already added but do not have a payment method.

 

Once the lender has been invited, they will receive a Welcome Email that looks something like this:

 

If the lender agrees, they can provide payment information, and the account will be created. 

 

Ads Landing Pages

Lead gen campaigns that are being cost-shared and that use Lofty landing pages will now feature the lender's contact information as well as the agent's information. 

 

 

If you are cost-sharing a lead generation campaign with multiple lenders, the campaigns will be separate. Therefore, the lender featured on the landing page will be different as well.

 

Lender Profiles

Lender profiles are now listed directly on the CMS Editor. This gives easy access to display the lenders associated with an account on the website. 

 

By default, this content will synchronize from the lender's Lofty account profile. So, a headshot and contact information need to be added to that profile. 

You can edit the introduction for the lender if you would like, but all other details will be locked down. The lender would change/add a headshot and contact information from their lender CRM. 

 

Lender Page

A Partner Lender Page will be added to all websites by default, but will be in the "Hidden Navigation" by default unless there is a cost-sharing lender. If there is a cost-sharing lender, it will force the Lender Page to display and cannot be hidden to help maintain RESPA compliance.

 

Marketplace

When accessing Lofty via a lender-type account, you will also have access to the Lofty Marketplace. You will currently only see the following options: 

  • Facebook Dynamic Ads
  • Google PPC Ads
  • Facebook Seller Ads

Lender Billing Page

If you have a lender-type account, you will now have access to the Lofty Billing Center by clicking your profile image in the top-right of your CRM and then clicking Billing. 

 

 

This will give you access to update your billing card on file. Currently, this does not display any additional information and is only for adding a new billing card if necessary.

 

Lender Account Type Limitations

The lender account type is not designed to work independently of agents originally, but has been optimized in the October 2022 version update. See the following for more information about Lender CRM - Ability to Add Leads: Feature Updates for Lofty 3.55

 

What lenders can do is use the Lofty platform to collaborate on leads. See the following for more information: Lender and Agent Lead Collaboration.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Call/Text Package Settings
title: Call/Text Package Settings
body:
Introduction

There are some important settings to be aware of with the call/text packages in the Lofty CRM. This article will explain exactly how these work. 

*IMPORTANT: You need to add a Lofty Call/Text Package to use these features. Please refer to the following article for more information on doing so: Adding / Removing Call or Text Packages.

 

Call & Text Settings

This section will be available to all users with a call/text package added to their seat. Access by navigating to Personal Settings > Communication > Call & Text > Info& Settings.

Settings

1. Manage My Call/Text License. This allows you to upgrade your current call or text package.

2. My Numbers. These are the virtual phone numbers that you own. 

3. Calling Method. Outbound calls can be made using VoIP or a Bridge number.

  • The Bridge number is the phone number that will be used to make the call physically — typically a cell phone or desktop phone, although it could also be a Google Voice number. When a call is triggered via Lofty, the virtual number (b) will first call this bridge number and then connect to the person being called.
  • Calling via VoIP will connect the call directly through your browser

4. Incoming Call Type. Set your physical phone number here to receive any calls that you miss through your browser.

5. Displayed Call and Sender ID. The Outbound Caller ID MUST NOT be the same as the bridge number. When an outbound call is initiated from the CRM, it connects to the bridge number, and the Caller ID shows the originating number. The Sender ID is the phone number displayed on outgoing text messages.

6. Audio Settings. Verify that your computer speakers and microphone are working.

7. Advanced Settings.

  • Call Recording. This is OFF by default, but can be turned on to add call recordings to the lead profiles when a call is sent/received using the Lofty virtual number. Just so you know, you are responsible for any two-party states and any other legal requirements associated with those you are calling. No automatic/pre-recorded disclaimer will be played on a call when this option is turned on.
  • Forward Received Texts. Use this option if you would like to receive text notifications from your Personal Virtual Number. This includes certain notification types of standard notifications, as well as actual leads texting your virtual number. However, keep in mind that if a text is forwarded to your cell number, you will not be able to respond directly through the forwarded text, as you will only be texting your virtual number, not the lead. To respond, you must open your mobile app or do so from the web app.
    • *IMPORTANT: Any additional texts sent via "Forward Received Texts" will also use your established daily text usage and therefore count towards your limit.

8. Text Subscription Message. The text subscription message helps you meet consumer opt-in requirements. Here, you can make sure the correct information is shared with the leads you text, so they always know who they are communicating with.

Reporting

The top section shows you what call and text package you currently have, along with your usage for the month.

 

Account Call & Text Licenses

Account owners and admins have access to this section in the settings will only be available to those with the "Manage Team" admin permission (see Team Permissions). Access by navigating to Company/Team Settings > Communication > Call & Text > Company/Team Call/Text License

The following can be adjusted here:

1. Manage Call/Text License. This button will allow you to purchase a call or text package for your users.

2. Personal Virtual Number. This is the number that is purchased through Lofty and is used to trigger the call. When the account admin/owner purchases these numbers (see Adding / Removing Call or Text Packages), they can choose the area code to be a local one. For users, those with admin access can click the "Edit" icon to change the virtual number by typing in a new area code and selecting from the available options.
3. Caller ID. This section will show "Upgrade to Access" if no call package has been added to this user.

4. Manage. If you have purchased this call/text license, you will have the option to delete or transfer it to another user.


5. Call Recording. This is OFF by default but can be turned on to have call recordings added to the lead profiles when a call is sent/received using the Lofty virtual number. Please note that you are responsible for any two-party states and any other legal requirements associated with those you are calling. No automatic/pre-recorded disclaimer will be played on a call when this option is turned on.
6. Forward Received Texts. Use this option if you would like to receive text notifications from your virtual number. This includes certain notification types of standard notifications as well as actual leads texting your virtual number. However, keep in mind that if a text is forwarded to your cell number, you will not be able to respond directly through the forwarded text as you will only be texting your own virtual number, not the lead. To respond, you must open your mobile app or do so from the web app. *IMPORTANT: any additional texts sent via "Forward Received Texts" will also use your established daily text usage and therefore count towards your limit.

  

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.
