name: How to Set Up Caller Identification
title: How to Set Up Caller Identification
body:
Introduction

As a real estate agent, you have hundreds of contacts and these contacts are the most important part of your business. With Lofty’s Caller ID, you will know whether one of your Lofty contacts is calling you so you are prepared before you pick up the phone.

Here is what this will look like on your phone:

 

Download the App, Sign In

In order for this feature to work, make sure to download the Lofty CRM app in the Google Play Store (Android) or the Apple App Store (iPhone). After downloading the app, sign in with your Lofty login credentials.

*Please note that this feature will only work for your contacts whose phone numbers are attached to leads in your Lofty CRM database.

 

iOS Setup

  1. Navigate to your iPhone settings
  2. Select "Phone"
  3. Select "Call Blocking & Identification"
  4. Locate the "Lofty CRM" option and slide the switch to the "On" position.
  5. Open your Lofty CRM app
  6. At the bottom of the screen, click the 3 dots option
  7. Click on "Settings".
  8. Click on the refresh icon to the right of the Update Contacts line and follow any steps that appear.

 

 

Android Setup

Google recently changed its requirements for this type of feature to work. This being the case, Lofty is actively working on gaining access to enable this feature again for Android devices. Until this is resolved, this feature will be unavailable on Android phones.

When this is enabled again, these will be the steps to follow:

By default, devices using Android have Caller ID set up through the Lofty CRM app. To see how to manually set up a Caller ID, simply follow these steps:

     1. Open your Lofty CRM app, and at the bottom of the screen, click More.

     2. Click on Settings.

     3. Click on the refresh icon to the right of the Update Contacts tab and follow the steps that appear.

 

FAQ

Q: When calling from the dialer, when the number shows up on the recipient's phone on the caller ID, the number is displayed, does the location where the number is based show up as well? 

A: Yes, it does show the location.

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

body:
Introduction

In this article, we will review how to set up email parsing in Lofty for HomeSpotter leads. 

 

What kind of Email will be Parsed?

From Address: no-reply@homespotter.com
Subject: xxx(lead name) unlocked listing information from a Boosted listing
Email Body: 

 

How to Set it Up

name: Offer Management
title: Offer Management
body:
Introduction

Offer Management allows listing agents to create an "offer link" that is then listed in the MLS instructions for accepting offers from potential buyers. MLS listings do not display this link publicly; it is only accessible via the MLS to the buyer's agent who will submit the offer on behalf of the buyer. The offer link will then outline all of the required information and documents needed in order for an offer to be accepted. Offer Management allows you to track the offers and compare them to find the best one with the seller.

 

 

Summary

  • How to Create an Offer Link
  • How to Add an Offer
  • Reviewing and Comparing Offers
  • Notifications

How to Create an Offer Link

In Lofty, offers will be tracked on the related transaction. If you are the listing agent, the first step is to create an offer form. Navigate to the listing transaction and select Offers. 

Next, add instructions or an introduction for the offer form which will be displayed at the top. Required documents that need to be attached to the form need to be uploaded in this step using the "attachments" icon. Click on Preview to continue.

The form itself cannot be edited.

Once you save the offer form, you will be taken to a page where the offer link is available to copy and then paste into the MLS portal to add as the next step for potential buyers to submit offers via their buyer's agent. 

When the buyer's agent uses the link to submit an offer, all required fields are marked with a red asterisk. After submitting an offer, the buyer's agent is provided with a link that will allow them to see what they submitted as well as preview any status changes, etc. Multiple offers from the same buyer's agent email address will not be accepted by the system. If the buyer's agent would like to upload additional documents, this is not currently supported, but they can communicate directly with the Listing Agent via email if necessary.

Once offers are received, the listing agent will be able to review these as part of a transaction on the Offers tab. Offers can be reviewed here or the offers form can be edited as necessary. The newest offer will appear at the top. Rejected offers are hidden at the bottom.

 

How to Add an Offer

To submit an offer for your buyer lead, navigate to the lead's profile, select Searches, and scroll to the bottom.

All of the lead's offers will be visible in this section.

Reviewing and Comparing Offers

Navigate to Sales -> Offers to review and compare offers for all of your listings and buyers. 

Listing Side Offers

The Listing Side Offers are offers on your listings. These offers are organized by listing, and all offers for that listing are grouped together. Click the drop down arrow to view all offers.

Check the box next to at least one offer and click the Compare Offer button to get an AI generated analysis of the selected offer(s). This tool tells you which offers are the strongest match for your listing, based on the AI analysis.

Navigate to the transaction Offers tab to update the offer status. The available statuses are Pending (default status when created), Accepted, Rejected, and Withdrawn.

Buyer Side Offers

The Buyer Side Offers are your leads' offers on properties. The offers on this page are organized by lead, and all of the offers a lead has submitted are grouped together. 

Like with Listing Side Offers, you can select at least one offer to generate an AI analysis of the offer(s). When comparing Buyer offers, the offers are not compared against each other, but against the property listing price. 

The lead's offers are also visible in their profile, under Searches. Here, the offer status can be updated. The available statuses are Submitted (default when created), Accepted, Declined, Lost, and Withdrawn.

 

Notifications

The following are the email notifications that will be triggered during this entire process. These emails will be sent from the client's Lofty sending email address.

The link for submitting an offer will be disabled when the transaction is closed or deleted.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Listing Blast
title: Listing Blast
body:
Introduction

Listing Blast (formerly Listing Promotion Ads) is a tool designed to save time and simplify your digital marketing efforts--all directly in the Lofty platform. This tool is designed to promote your listings on Facebook and Instagram. With this tool, you can:

  • Capture buyer and seller leads
  • Create beautiful, optimized Facebook Lead Ad campaigns on your own
  • Change ad creatives and content whenever you want
  • Run an auto-promotion campaign that will automatically adjust the ad as the listing status changes
  • Stay in total control of your listing blast ads

If you have any listings that come to mind that you would like to promote on Facebook, try the Listing Ads tool which you can access via Lofty > Marketplace > Listing Ads or in the Marketing tab.

 

Summary

  • Start a Campaign
    • Choose a Listing
    • Choose the Duration
    • Confirm Payment Information and "Checkout"
    • Connect Facebook Business Page
    • Choose Ad Copy and Images
    • Define Lead Capture Settings
    • Review Website Registration Settings
  • Review Ad Performance
  • How to Cancel
  • FAQ

 

Start a Campaign

To start a listing ads campaign, navigate to Marketing > Lead Generation > Listing Blast > + Promote a Listing:

 

Confirm your Listing

Select a listing to promote. The listing may be either a listing on the MLS or a manual listing, but you cannot create a promotion if it is not one of those two. Your active listings will be provided here.

*IMPORTANT: To promote this listing, you must be the listing agent or have permission from the listing agent to do so.

 

Choose a Duration

Select the number of weeks that you want to promote the listing:

Auto Promotion allows listings in different statuses to have different ad content and will automatically switch the ad content based on the change in the status of the listing.

  • The default price for this package is $79 per week but you can input a custom budget.
    • The minimum allowed price is $69 per week.
  • You must have a Lofty IDX website to select this package
  • Unable to promote manual listings (formerly known as pocket listing)
  • The higher the ad spend budget, the more ads will be viewed. You will see the estimated number of views calculated based on the budget provided.

 

The Duration is set to four weeks by default, but can run from one to four weeks.

  • If the duration is too long for the ad spend specified, more ad spend will have to be added and the system will prompt you. Lofty recommends at least $5/day for effective advertising

 

Confirm Payment Information and "Checkout"

If you are ready to proceed and purchase this promotion, review (or add) your payment information and then click on the "Checkout" button:

 

 

Connect Facebook Business Page

First of all, you will want to make sure your Facebook Business page is connected to run the promotions. Do so by clicking on the "Select Page" button and following the provided steps:

 

Choose Ad Copy and Images

After choosing the listing, AI will attempt to choose images automatically (you can override it if you would like) that include swimming pools, living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, etc.).

 

Once images are selected, you can choose the copy used. You will see that you can choose the copy that will be advertised at each stage of the listing (and will change automatically). 

To choose images, click on the "Select Images" button:

A new window will then appear, where you will first choose the images you would like to use from the MLS, or you can upload better images from your computer if you prefer. If you are uploading images, here are the technical rules and recommendations:

  • Image File Type: JPG or PNG
  • Ratio: 1.91:1 to 1:1
  • Number of Images: 1 to 10
  • Image Maximum File Size: 30MB
  • Minimum Width/Height: 600 pixels

After having the images selected, you can then choose the headline and description for each image used:

And finally, you can choose what the CTA (Call To Action) button will display as by clicking the dropdown menu:

 

Define Lead Capture Settings

Finally, you will define the lead capture settings:

  • Lead Type - Do you want the ad to be seen by more buyers or more sellers?
    • Buyer
    • Seller
  • Lead Privacy (see Lead Privacy: Team Leads vs. Private Leads)
    • Team Lead
    • Private Lead
  • Assignment Method
    • Direct Assignment --> Assign to Agent _____________
    • Assign via Lead Routing Rules
  • Source (cannot be changed)
    • Lofty Listing Ads
  • Tag
    • Currently, only one tag can be selected

When you are ready to finalize the setup, click "Submit":

Review Website Registration Settings

Keep in mind that leads that register via Listing Ads will only do so if your website-forced registration is configured to capture their information. In other words, when a lead registers from a listing ad, they will be redirected to your website. So, check your Registration settings to make sure that they are set up for this type of campaign and will trigger a forced registration if that is your goal.

To find this setting, navigate to CMS > Settings > Lead Capture > Registration Pop-up Trigger Rule and Pop-up Style & Settings:

 

Review Ad Performance

Under Marketing > Lead Generation> Listing Blast, you will see the performance for any listing ads that are running:

A summary of all listing ads is provided at the top:

Choose from the different campaign statuses to find your campaigns:

  1. Active. Listing Ads that are active and running.
  2. Pending. Listing Ads that are scheduled to run on a future date.
  3. Completed. Listing Ads that have finished their scheduled run time. 

Clicking on one specific Listing Ad campaign will show the performance of that campaign as well as a history of leads that are engaged. An "Engaged Lead" is anyone who goes to the landing page or detail page through this ad and fills out certain information to create a lead in the CRM:

Click the Edit button to edit the ad that is live if you would like to make any changes. This includes editing the copy as well as editing the images used:

 

Upgrade Your Budget (Optional)

You can choose to upgrade your budget after the payment.

You may upgrade your budget after the purchase payment, but before setting up the listing ads. By expanding the "Quickly Upgrade Your Budget" module, you can upgrade your budget. The difference between your old budget and the new budget will be deducted. 

You can also choose to upgrade your budget when the ad is active.

By clicking the editing icon, you can upgrade your budget in the pop-up window. The difference between your old budget and the new budget will be deducted and allocated to your ads. 

How to Cancel

To cancel your listing ads, navigate to Marketing > Lead Generation > Listing Blast and find the campaign that you want to cancel. Click the [...] icon and select Cancel. 

A pop-up will confirm that you want to cancel the listing ad. Here, you can change your mind and keep the ad running or continue to cancel the ad. 

If you cancel the ad, the remaining ad budget will be moved to your listing budget wallet to use on another advertising option. Note: It will take one business day for the budget to be moved to your wallet.

 

FAQs

  • How long does it take for an ad to be created and/or edited?
  • If I pay for a Listing Ad but do not finish the setup process, what happens?
  • Can ads be run for properties that are not on the MLS or manual listings?
  • What type of targeting is in place with these ads?
  • Is this accessible to all users on an account?
  • Which packages can access this feature?
  • Can the "Auto Promotion" package be run with a Manual Listing?

How long does it take for an ad to be created and/or edited?

Typically, a 30-minute delay should be expected. While it is still not live, it will display under the "Pending" tab:

If I pay for a Listing Ad but do not finish the setup process, what happens?

The promotion will be saved under the "Pending" tab, where you can click edit to continue configuration:

Can ads be run for properties that are not on the MLS or manual listings?

No. The listing must either be a Manual Listing or one fed into Lofty via MLS data. This ad type is specifically for promoting listings, not running other types of Facebook ads. A listing must have a listing details page to have an associated ad.

 

What type of targeting is in place with these ads?

The Lofty Ads Team will manage to target based on a combination of criteria used to generate buyer leads. We do not support the ability of users to configure their audiences. 

 

Is this accessible to all users on an account?

Yes. All users on an account with access to this feature can run Listing Ads. This includes Team Owners/Admins as well as individual team members/agents. The Basic Promotion can be run by anyone, but the Auto Promotion requires an IDX website (Team Website, Agent Subdomain, or Agent Website).

 

Can Listing Ads be seen in my Facebook Manager? 

Yes. During the setup process for Listing Blast, you have to connect your Facebook Business Page. If you want to see your ads on Facebook, you can access them via your business page as well. All the important reporting leads captured, previews, etc., will be displayed in the Lofty Marketing tab for your review, so there is no real need to log in to Facebook to see them there.

 

What website is used to run the listing ads? 

If the Team Owner/Admin runs Listing Ads, they will be connected to the Team Website. If an individual agent runs Listing Ads it will default to their Agent Subdomain or Agent Website, and if neither of those has been created, it will use the Team Website.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Send Mass Emails & Texts
title: Send Mass Emails & Texts
body:
Introduction

One of many reasons you likely use the Lofty CRM is to maintain contact with your database. Utilize the mass emails and texts in Lofty to do so.

 

Summary

  • Limitations
    • Mass Email Limitations
    • Mass Text Limitations
  • Mass Emails
  • Mass Texts
  • Smart Plans

 

Limitations

There are a few limitations to be aware of when sending out mass emails and texts. These are all outlined below.

 

Mass Email Limitations

Leads Without Email Addresses

This is an obvious one, but the system will make you aware of how many leads do not have valid email addresses to send emails to. "Valid" is a keyword here, as any invalid emails that have been marked as such will not be available to send emails to with the mass email action.

 

Unsubscribed Leads

You will be unable to email leads who have unsubscribed from receiving emails from you.

 

Maximum Number of Email Recipients

You can only send a mass email to up to 5,000 leads at one time. 
Please note, for all packages with a monthly email limit, it costs $1 for 5,000 additional emails.

 

Mass Text Limitations

Leads Without Valid Phone Numbers

The system will make you aware of how many leads do not have valid phone numbers to send text messages. "Valid" is a keyword here as any invalid phone numbers that have been marked as such will not be available to send texts to with the mass text action.

 

Maximum Number of Text Recipients

Special upper limit, a maximum of 500 leads can be processed at a time. If you select more than that many leads (with valid phone numbers), you will see a warning that says "You can only Mass Text 500 leads at a time"

 

Mass Emails

*Note: Mass emails are sent from your @lofty.com email address. Learn more HERE.

To send a mass email, navigate to the People page, select the leads that you would like to email, and then click on the Mass Email button:

After choosing the Mass Email option, you can edit the email before sending it. It will be sent as an individual conversation to every lead, not a mass email with everyone copied. You will want to take advantage of any templates that you have pre-built, as well as variables that can be used to reference a specific lead's name, etc. Learn more about variables HERE.

If you have family members associated with a lead and would like to copy (CC) them on an email that you are sending out via the Mass Email function, you can do so by clicking on the CC all family members checkbox. Those family members will be added to the email sent to that lead.

To edit a mass email, click the bell icon in the upper right-hand of your CRM.


Click the mass action that requires editing from your Notifications list.

Click the pencil icon to make the changes.

Mass Texts

To send a mass text to your leads, simply navigate to the People page, select the leads you would like to mass-text, and then click the Mass Text button.

 

The mass text message will be sent as individual conversations, not one group text. You will also want to take advantage of any text templates you have created as well as variables that can make the message more personal.

 

*Important note* 

Sending the same content to many leads’ phone numbers at the same time may reduce the delivery rate of SMS and cause your virtual number to be blocked by your leads' carrier. We have added a timestamp at the end of each message to avoid getting the same content and avoid any issues with their carrier. 

 

Smart Plans

Another important tool is Smart Plans. Smart Plans are used to automatically send out content.

For example, you can set up a Smart Plan and then adjust the Application Conditions to target the specific leads that you want to send a mass email or text message. The Smart Plan will send the message automatically, so you don't have to worry about it. Learn more about Smart Plans here: Smart Plans FAQs

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM. 

 

Related terms: mass options, bulk email, bulk text

name: How to Save / Restore Website Versions
title: How to Save / Restore Website Versions
body:
Introduction

Many users constantly adjust the website style in order to get more website traffic and higher conversion rates but sometimes find that better results were seen on previous website versions. In this scenario, being able to easily go back to a previous version would be ideal. This CMS Tool feature makes this possible without having to do so one by one.

 

*IMPORTANT:

  • Currently, Lofty only allows for managing six (6) website versions. You will need to delete any unnecessary website versions in order to use those slots for other versions. You can always edit the name of the versions should you want to make changes and re-use it as something new.
  • We recommend that before switching between versions you save the current version as a new one in case you need to "undo" the change you just made.
  • If you build landing pages (see Landing Pages), these are not affected by this site version tool. In other words, if you create a landing page but then make a change on your website by restoring it to a previous version, it will not delete the landing page.

 

Step 1: Save Website Version

After completing any website edits and deciding that the current website version is an important one to keep track of, you can click on the "Save" icon in the top-right. 

You will then need to give the version a name: 

The version will then appear on the list of site versions.

 

Step 2: Restore Website Version

To restore a previously saved website version, click on the "website version" icon on the top menu in the middle: 

After clicking on this section, you can see all the saved website versions. Select the version of the website you want to restore and click "Restore."

After clicking "Restore," the website preview will be restored to the selected website version, and all current operations will be overwritten. 

Please note that this website version will not take effect until you click "Publish." If you no longer want to restore to this website version, click the "Undo" icon on the top bar.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM. 

 

Related terms: site version, restore site

name: Inbound Call Forwarding
title: Inbound Call Forwarding
body:
Introduction

Lofty provides a solution for making sure incoming phone calls are not missed. With this feature, incoming calls to Lofty virtual numbers will be forwarded to a specific phone number if the agent is not available or does not pick up the phone within a specified time.

*This feature is available on all Lofty call packages.

 

Settings

The following is a screenshot of what the settings look like under Settings > Call/Text> Info & Settings> Advanced Settings:



Important Definitions

Bridge Number: The number that is connected to the Lofty virtual number. For example, if you call a lead via click-to-call, the virtual number will call this number so you can answer, and then a call will be made to the person you are calling. 

Forwarding Number: This is the number that will be called when the bridge number is unavailable or the agent does not answer the call for the indicated time.

Transfer to Forwarding Number after If a call is not answered within the defined time limit, the call will be transferred to the Transfer Number. This will also happen if the agent’s bridge number is busy, has no signal, etc. If the latter is the case, we will transfer the call immediately without waiting for the defined period.

Apply the rule to team members: The switch is only available with “Manage Team” permission (see Team Permissions). They can easily apply all the calls to the same phone number (maybe a company number) by this setting in case of changing the number of every account one by one.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Creating Custom Roles
title: Creating Custom Roles
body:
Introduction

Account Owners/admins can create additional custom roles for their members to fill when working with individual leads. Each additional role will appear in the bottom-left section of a lead profile called "Assigned to".

Three roles are in this section by default:

(1) Agent
(2) Assistant
(3) Lender

Please note that agent users cannot be assigned to the "Lender" role. An additional TEN agent role can be created. All users assigned to a lead will be able to have access to view the lead, receive opportunity notifications, etc. A new filter on the People Page is also created for each new role.

If you want to learn more about how to add a lender, please see: How to Invite a Lender

*Please note that the primary owner of the lead (associated with reporting, transaction management, property alerts, etc.) is always going to be the Lofty user in the "Agent" slot, which is always first on the list:

 

Adding Additional Roles

To add additional roles, follow these steps:

  1. Navigate to Settings
  2. Click on Users under the Company User Settings section
  3. Select the Agent Roles tab at the top
  4. Click on the Add A Role button
  5. Type in the new "Role Name"
  6. Click Add
  7. A new role has now been added to every lead profile

Editing or Deleting Additional Roles

To edit or delete an additional role, follow these steps:

  1. Navigate to Settings
  2. Click on Users under the Company User Settings section
  3. Select the Agent Roles tab at the top
  4. Select either the Edit icon or the Delete icon to adjust the roles as desired

 

*IMPORTANT: Custom Role should not be confused with or replace the idea of Office/Personal Leads and Team Permissions. For more information on this topic, please reference this article: Lead Ownership as well as Permissions.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Add an additional email address to receive new lead alerts
title: Add an additional email address to receive new lead alerts
body:
This feature allows the account to have multiple email addresses to receive new lead alerts. In case the account owner is not available, an admin or assistant can help distribute and track all incoming leads for their account.

 

To add an email address to receive Lofty’s new lead alert, please follow the steps below:

name: How to Delete/Erase Leads
title: How to Delete/Erase Leads
body:
Introduction

To protect valuable lead information, there is an important mechanism built into Lofty so that all deleted leads will first be moved to a list named “Deleted leads.” Information on deleting leads permanently will also be outlined in this article. 

To temporarily delete leads, log in to your Lofty CRM and follow the steps outlined below. There are two ways to delete leads in Lofty CRM.  

 

Via Lead List Page

Log in to your CRM account and click on People. Select the leads you want to delete by ticking the checkbox next to the lead’s name, and click Delete.

New UI:

When the alert window appears, type in the delete reason (optional), click OK, and the leads will be deleted.

       

Via Lead Detail Page

Click on a lead’s name to get to their info page. Move your cursor to the "more" button on the top left of a lead's profile page, and click "Delete Lead" in the menu that appears.

When the alert window appears, click YES, and the leads will be deleted.

Recover Leads / Delete Leads Permanently

To recover leads or delete leads permanently, click People on the page menu to go to the lead list page. Then click the Deleted Leads tab, and you'll be taken to the DELETED LEADS list page.

New UI:

   

On the DELETED LEADS page, select the leads you want to recover/erase by ticking the checkbox next to the lead’s name. Click Recover or Erase, depending on the action you wish to take.

New UI:

To recover your leads, choose the pipeline and click OK.

   

To permanently delete leads, click Erase. When the alert window appears, click YES, and the leads will be permanently deleted.

   

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Lead Capture - Homesnap
title: Lead Capture - Homesnap
body:
Introduction

In this article, we will review how to set up email parsing in Lofty for Homesnap leads. 

 

What kind of Email will be Parsed?

Lofty is able to parse a new lead into your CRM based on an email alert that comes from Homesnap to your Lofty-integrated email. Here are the common items that Lofty searches for in Email Parsing:

From Address: noreply@homesnap.com
Subject:  HOMESNAP LEAD: Lead submitted via xxx
Email Body: 

 

How to Set it Up

Enter your Lofty-integrated email address as the email that receives lead notifications in your Homesnap settings.

Note: The fields parsed from Homesnap are Full Name, Email, and Phone. Any other fields will be parsed as Notes in Lofty. 

 

How to find your unique Lofty email address in Lofty?

Go to the Settings page, and under the Features section on the right of the page, click Integration to Integration page and then click Lead Capture.

On the bottom of this page, you will see Auto-import Lead via third-party providers. Here, you will see your Lofty email, which you will use to auto-import leads from Realtor.com. In this section, click Copy.

name: White Label
title: White Label
body:
Introduction

We offer White Labeling for our Enterprise and Multi-Team Clients. There are five settings that will be available: Brand Logo, Brand Domain, Brand Login Page, Company/Brand Name, and Brand Email Signature Template. These will allow for multiple assets to be edited to match your organization's theme. 
Note: Current logic does not support lenders logging in via white label domain.

 

Usage

A new setting is available under Settings > White Label.

Enterprise Account View:

Multi-Team Account View:

 

Five settings will be available here–each outlined below.

(1) Brand Logo

Use this setting to add/edit your logos in the following locations within the Lofty platform:

  • Main Logo
    • CRM
    • CMS (website editor)
    • Brand login page (see #3 below)
    • All email notifications sent from the system to users on this account 
  • Favicon
    • Small logo displayed in browser tabs
    • It will not display in Safari due to browser limitations

 

Here are samples of the Main Logo being changed:

 

And another sample of the Favicon that is changed:

 

(2) Brand Domain

By default, the Lofty platform is accessed by navigating to https://lofty.com/. With this update, you can now access Lofty via a custom URL for a domain that you already own or one that you want to purchase.

 

*NOTE: This will change the entire URL structure for pages in your account, so please be aware of how this might affect direct links to lead profiles, etc. 

 

Click the Configure button to start this setup. 

 

Choose either "Use Your Own Domain" or "Get a New Domain" and then click the Next button.

 

If you choose to set up your domain, you will be guided through the steps to configure your domain.
***DNS Note: Update the A-record of the chosen domain and point to 184.169.237.53 or 13.52.69.132.

 

If you pause in the middle of the process, it will allow you to "Continue the Setup" at any time.

 

Once you have configured your domain, you can deactivate it at any time if you would like. You will see a prompt warning you of what this will change if you continue.

 

You can also change the domain if you would like to use a different one: 

 

(3) Brand Login Page

Once the Brand Domain is configured as outlined above, a new setting for the Brand Login Page will be available to edit. This is the page that users on your account will use to access Lofty instead of https://lofty.com/.

*Note: Even with a custom brand login page configured, users can still access their account via https://lofty.com/ if needed.

 

Click on the Edit icon to make changes to the login page. Currently, the last part of the URL cannot be customized and is auto-populated.

 

The following can be edited for the login page:

  • Page Title
  • Background
    • System Default
    • Color
    • Image
  • "Sign In" Button Text
  • "Sign In" Button Text Color
  • "Sign In" Button Color

*Note: The logo will sync from the logo settings configured in #1.

 

Users will then use their Lofty account credentials (email + password) to log in to the Lofty platform via this Brand Login Page.

 

(4) Company/Brand Name

Here is where you can change/add the company/brand name and this will sync to the mobile app display along with your logo.

 

(5)Brand Email Signature Template

This setting allows you to create a custom signature template that your agent's email signature will be generated based on.

Preview the email signature by clicking the Preview button.

name: Email Templates
title: Email Templates
body:
Introduction

Building out email templates at a personal or team level can be an extremely valuable way to save your time later. With a template, you can easily put together your content for easy access in the future.

 

Summary

  • Where to Add/Edit Email Templates
  • Email Templates Folder
  • Team and Office Email Templates
  • Using My Team and Office Email Templates
  • Automated Emails
    • Welcome Email
    • Property Alert, Market Snapshot, Market Report, and Double Opt-In
  • Email Templates Report
  • FAQs

 

Where to Add/Edit Email Templates

Navigate to Marketing > Email > Templates

Each of the available template types will be reviewed in detail below.

 

Email Template Folders

Email Template Folders help organize your email templates. 


 

Add a New Folder

Everyone can add 'My Folder', but users must have the following permission enabled to create a 'Team Folder':

  • Enterprise:
    • Manage Templates - Entire Company: Can create Folders for the entire company
    • Manage Templates - User's Group: Can create Folders for their group

If users do not have the permission enabled, they can only create 'My Folder':

Use the search bar to search by folders that you have created in 'My Folders' as well as 'Office or Team Folders' that have been shared with you.

When creating a new email template, you have the option to select which folder the template belongs in. The template does not have to be put in a folder.

You will be given the option to create one of two types of templates: 

  1. Classic Email Editor
  2. Drag-and-Drop Email Editor

Plain Text will look familiar, as it uses the old editor.

The Rich Text editor is an all-new interface allowing more dynamic, modern designs. You can add text, images, buttons, social media, dividers, tables, and listings to your templates. Learn more about the Drag-and-Drop Email Editor here: How to Use the Drag-and-Drop Email Editor 

 

Navigate to the List view and click the Settings Cog Wheel next to an existing template to move it into a folder:

When adding an email template to a Smart Plan or when emailing a lead, the email template can be searched by Folder.
 

 

Add an internal name to remember the email template, give the email a subject (customer-facing), and then add your content. You can do all of the following within an email template:

  • Edit font type, color, size, and style
  • Add bullet lists
  • Adjust alignment
  • Add hyperlinks
  • Insert images
  • Attach files (see below for size limits) 
  • Add horizontal lines
  • Embed a source code with a custom design
  • Add a BombBomb video (see BombBomb Integration)
  • Insert a YouTube video
  • Add basic emojis
  • Embed listings into the email
  • Add custom variables for both lead data (name, contact information, preferences, etc.) as well as agent data (name, contact information, signature, etc.). See Email and Text Variables.

 

Click on the Preview button to preview the email. The preview will not replace the variable information, so don't worry if you don't see what you expect in those spots, but the preview will allow you to see the email without the editor options. It's always a good idea to send an email template to yourself to make sure it looks like expected.

 

 

If you are ready to save the email template, click on the blue Save button and it will be added to your list of templates for future use.

 

Edit/Manage an Existing Template

Use the icons on the far-right side to copy, edit, or delete an email template. If you copy a template, you can only copy it within the My Email Templates section, not to Team or Office Email Templates.

 

Team and Office Email Templates

This section contains email templates that are available for all users in an office or team to use, but only those with the "Team or Office Templates" permission (see Permissions) can add or edit new templates. 

All other options to add, edit, or manage templates in this section are the same as with My Email Templates outlined above.

 

Using My Team and Office Email Templates

It's important to know where you can use email templates. They can be used in the following locations.

 

Individual Emails

From a lead profile page, click on the Email option:

Click on the Template drop-down to choose from either a "My Template" or a "Team or Office Template."

 

Mass Emails

Navigate to People and apply any filters, etc., and select the leads that you would like to send a mass email to, then click Mass Email:

Select the email template that you would like to use:

 

Smart Plans

While editing a Smart Plan, you can choose the option to send an Auto Email. Select the Template drop-down and select the template you would like to use here. 

*IMPORTANT: Please note that when you pull a template into a Smart Plan it brings in a copy of that template. This means that if you were to go and edit the original email template, it would not edit the email content wherever used in a Smart Plan.

 

 

For more information regarding Smart Plans, see Smart Plans. 

 

Automated Emails

There are four different types of automated email templates that you can edit and each is reviewed in detail below.

 

Welcome Email

More information on working with the Welcome Email can be found here: Set Up the Welcome Email.

 

Property Alert, Market Snapshot, Market Report, and Double Opt-In

As a quick summary, these are all emails that are sent out to home buyers/sellers to make them aware of new listings, sold properties (if MLS data is available and accessible to Lofty), and the general state of the market. Double Opt-In is automated emails verifying with your lead that they want to be contacted.

 

For "Property Alert" and "Market Snapshot," there are two templates here--one for when only a "single property" is being sent to them (only one property matches their criteria) and one for when there are "multiple properties."

Click on the Edit icon at the right to edit each template:

 

 

You will notice that there are many different variables in the "Subject" line. Normally, you will want to leave those alone. But if you would like to customize the subject to something different, you can go ahead and do so.

You will find the variables under "Agent Variables" if you need to use them again in the future:

 

 

When editing any of these email templates, you are only able to edit the "Subject" and the initial message.

What is included after the initial message cannot be edited and will include any matching listings for the type of email that it is as well as a pre-populated signature based on the information provided in your Profile (see Complete your Lofty Profile, Email Signature).

For example, below is a property alert email and the only parts of the template that you can edit are those highlighted in the red boxes--everything else is populated automatically by the system.

 

 

For more information on property alerts, see Property Alerts & Market Snapshots (Lead Engagement).

More information regarding market reports can be found here: Market Reports.

 

Email Templates Report

This report simply shows the different email templates, the name of the template, the total sent, and the open rate for that template. It can be utilized to track the effectiveness of an email template based on the open rate.

 

FAQs

Q: What is the maximum file size for an email attachment?

A: The maximum size limit for email attachments is 2 MB. Depending on the size of the file, however, Lofty has two different methods of attachment outlined here:

  1.  
    1. If the attachments uploaded are less than 2 MB, the email attachments will be added directly to the email.
    2. If the attachments uploaded are more than 2 MB, Lofty will convert the attachments into download links that are then inserted into the email.

Q: Can I update the header on automated emails?

A: No, the header on automated emails is synced with the website header.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please get in touch with our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your CRM.

 

Related terms: email attachment, maximum file size, email link, file size

name: Location Search Bar Settings
title: Location Search Bar Settings
body:
Introduction

The LoftyIDX website Search Bar logic can be set to force the site visitor to choose from the provided suggestions in order to better narrow down their searches. This means that if a site visitor simply presses "Enter" on the keyboard or clicks the "Search" icon on the website, it will use the first suggestion as the default input value. When combined with the additional setting to determine what displays at the top (see below), this will increase the accuracy of listings shown when searching.

 

Summary

  • Search Bar Location Logic Optimization
  • Search Bar Location Type Options
  • Search Bar Suggestions
  • Questions?

 

Search Bar Location Logic Optimization

By default, when a lead hits "Enter" or clicks on the "Search" icon, they will be sent to a results page showing listings associated with the first category (city, neighborhood, county, etc.) displayed. This is what is called an "Exact Search."

  1. Exact Search. If you choose one of the provided suggestions from the drop-down menu, the search will show listings based on the category chosen (city, zip code, etc.).
  2. Fuzzy Search. If you type in a value and press the “Enter” button on the keyboard or click the "Search" icon, listings will be shown without category restrictions (city, zip code, etc.). 

If you would like to adjust this setting so that it is not "Exact Search" by default, you can change this setting in CMS Tool > Listings >Listing Settings >  Location Search Bar: 

 

Search Bar Location Type Options

You can also access settings to customize what categories (city, neighborhood, zip code, etc.) appear when a site visitor uses the search bar on your Lofty IDX website. Perhaps you do not want to display a certain category, or you would like to change the order, or rename them. This is all possible with the available settings.

The setting is located under CMS Tool > Settings > Listings > Location Search Bar. With these settings, you can do the following:

  • Hide/Display
  • Reorder (determines which one displays first, second, etc.)
  • Rename

 

Search Bar Suggestions

name: Feature Updates for CRM 3.2.0
title: Feature Updates for CRM 3.2.0
body:
Introduction

*Please note that the features available to you on the Lofty platform will vary depending on the package you have purchased. For any questions in this regard, please reach out to your assigned Customer Success Manager or our Support Team for more information.

Release Date

The release date for these features is Tuesday, March 17, 2020.

Summary

  • Website Updates
  • AI Assistant: Existing Lead Qualification
  • AI Assistant: Extra Engagement Cap
  • Add Agents as Leads
  • Sort Vendor / Partner List

 

Website Updates

As you may already be aware, Lofty is working on releasing a New CMS Tool that will allow for our users to better control the framework of their website block by block and take advantage of many new features that will be made available with the new website structure. This has been in the works for some time and the transition is beginning now. This note is to inform you of the existence of the New CMS that will be made available to you at some point in the upcoming months.

Please reference this article for more information on the transition process: CMS Tool Versions (Original CMS vs. New CMS).

 

AI Assistant: Existing Lead Qualification 

*IMPORTANT: The number of “Engagements” available with your AI Assistant package will also be used to engage existing leads in addition to new leads.

The AI Assistant can now work to qualify existing leads in the following scenarios. Future releases will also include additional scenarios.

  • Leads who have registered in the past 30-60 days, opened property alert emails, but never clicked a link in the emails
  • Leads who go back to the site with incomplete inquiries/search criteria
  • Leads who go back to the site and make a request that triggers an opportunity. For more information regarding Opportunities, please reference Opportunities

With this improved functionality, the AI Assistant will ask questions to determine the preferences of leads (under the assumption that the information captured for this lead may not be complete or accurate). It will also confirm opportunities and notify agent users about these leads just like it currently does with new lead qualifications.

The following are the new settings available to determine what leads the AI Assistant will work in Lofty. These are available to view and edit under Settings > Features > AI Assistant. 

 

AI Assistant: Extra Engagement Cap

For clients with the Premium AI Assistant package, Lofty now supports the ability to set a monthly dollar amount as a spending cap. This was designed because the Premium package allows for users to pay for extra engagements beyond the package allotment. With the new feature to work existing leads, you may find that additional engagements would be beneficial to your business model and can use the Premium package to accomplish this. 

For billing, the payment on the first of each month will be the recurring monthly fee plus the extra amount used in the last month. Keep in mind that if the AI Assistant has not reached the limit established with the engagement cap, you will only be billed for the actual usage.

When AI Assistant engagements reach the upper limit for a month, the AI Assistant will stop working until the following month.

To edit this setting, go to Settings > Features > AI Assistant > Extra Engagement Cap:

 

Add Agents as Leads

Prior to this release, a Lofty user's email address could not be used on a lead at the same time within the same team. With this update, this is now possible. An email address can now be used as both an agent/user login as well as an email address assigned to a lead. Admins may be interested in adding their new team members as a way to provide them with training via an automated Smart Plan, for example. 

 

Sort Vendor / Partner List

The Vendor / Partner feature now has the ability to sort by name. To learn more about how to use the Vendor / Partner feature, please read the following article: How to Assign a Vendor/Partner to a Transaction.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com> or by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557.

name: “Click to Call” Function
title: “Click to Call” Function
body:
Introduction

The "Click-To-Call" function within Lofty will allow users to call leads directly from their lead profiles easily. For this feature to work, the user must have a Call Package associated with their account. For more information on getting a Call Package added, please see this article: How to add a call or text package to your CRM.

Summary

  • Call from People Page
  • Call from the Lead Profile / Contact Record
  • Call Process
    • Calling in Bridge Mode
    • Calling in VOIP Mode
  • Best Practices

Call from People Page

The most accessible option is to navigate to the People page and then click on the "phone" icon in the "Communications" column. This will allow you to trigger a phone call directly to that lead.

 

Call from the Lead Profile / Contact Record

  1. Navigate to a lead profile/contact record by going to the People page and clicking on a name or by searching for the lead using the search bar at the top-right
  2. Click on the green "Call" button in the top-left. If there is more than one number, you can click the drop-down arrow to select the number you would like to call first.

Call Process

Calling in Bridge Mode

When calling in Bridge Mode, the system will first call the number you saved in Settings > Communication > Call & Text > Info & Settings > Outbound Call Type and then connect you to the lead's number you are calling. In other words, the system will call you first at the Bridge Number, and then it will call the lead's number.

Once the call has started, a call panel will appear on the right side. You can click the minimize option in the top-right to minimize the panel if needed. Here you will see the lead’s name, number, and call status. Below, you will see notes on all of the sections visible in the call panel.

  • (A) Outcome:
    • Talked - Call connected successfully and you spoke to the lead
    • Voice Message - Left a voice message
    • No Answer - The lead did not answer the call
    • Bad Number – Invalid number
    • DNC Number - Do Not Call number
    • DNC Contact - Do Not Call contacts
  • (B) Note. You can add a note for this phone call with any important information you want to save for later. You can edit/add this note later if necessary.
  • (C) Send a Text. You can send a text during the call by typing in the message or clicking Select Template to choose a saved text template.
  • (D) New Appointment. This will add a task to your Google Calendar (if integrated) and will also send out an external invite to the lead at their email address.
  • (E) Add a Task. This is an internal task for you to remember to follow up, etc.
  • (F) Leave a Voice Message. You can choose to drop a pre-recorded voice message with this option so that you can continue calling additional leads without delay.

Once you click the End Call icon, the Call Result window will appear. Here you can view call details, call recordings, call outcomes, notes, texts, appointments, and tasks. You can change call outcomes after the call as well as send additional text messages and add new tasks and appointments.

Before you save the Call Result please rate the quality of the call so that we can work on improving things if necessary.

 

After you click Save you can view the Call Result on the lead’s timeline. You can listen to the recorded call if the feature is turned on as well as make any additional notes if so desired.

 

Calling in VOIP Mode

The calling mode can be switched freely between Bridge and VOIP before each call is made. VOIP can be set by navigating to Settings > Communication > Call & Text > Info & Settings > Outbound Call Type

Calling over VOIP Mode is the same as calling over Bridge Mode; however, the call will connect directly via your browser, rather than connecting to your bridge number first. VOIP is currently only available for outbound calls. All inbound calls will still ring to the number provided under Incoming Call Type. 

VOIP Mode calls are made through the browser, so an internet connection is required. If the internet connection is weak, we recommend switching to Bridge Mode before making a call. While you can navigate around the CRM without disrupting the call, if the browser is refreshed or closed during a VOIP call, the call will be disconnected.

The Audio Settings are available to set the microphone and speakers when calling over VOIP mode. The microphone and speakers can be changed mid-call, without disruption.

Best Practices

There are advantages and disadvantages to both Bridge and VOIP calling modes. Please use the chart below to help you decide which mode is best for you.

  Bridge VOIP
Cost Effective No Yes
User Friendly No Yes
Call Stability Yes No

Remember, you can change the calling mode before each call. As long as you have a stable internet connection, we recommend utilizing VOIP mode.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

 

Related terms: click to call, CRM call, call button, VOIP, Bridge
