name: Feature Updates for CRM 2.9.8, Site 3.6.2
title: Feature Updates for CRM 2.9.8, Site 3.6.2
body:
Introduction

*Please note that the features available to you on the Lofty platform will vary depending on the package you have purchased. For any questions in this regard, please reach out to your assigned Customer Success Manager or our Support Team for more information.

Release Date

The release date for this set of features is Wednesday, October 9, 2019.

Summary

  • Team Site and Subdomain Site Lead Login Credentials
  • Zip Code/City Setting for Auto Alerts
  • Add/Edit/Delete Alerts from Mobile App

 

Team Site and Subdomain Site Lead Login Credentials

With this update, a lead can continue to browse the main website even if they are working with an individual agent who has their own subdomain and all their activity/triggers will go to that individual agent even if they have a subdomain that the lead is not looking at. Prior to this update, the only way for an individual agent to get notifications and records of a lead's website activity would be if (a) the team website was the only website being used or (b) the lead was browsing their individual websites. 

If a lead registered on a subdomain website, he/she can now sign in on the main site using the same login credentials.

The only exception to this is with the website chat box. The website chat messages sent will go to the website's owner. If it is the team's website, the chat goes to the main seat on the account (Team Admin/Owner). If a subdomain website, the chat goes to the individual agent whose website it is.

Currently, the lead’s login credentials can be logged in both in main site and its related subdomains in one team. All lead’s activities can be recorded on to lead detail page in CRM and the assigned agent can receive the corresponding notification (except live chat, still sent to the site owner). Lofty will work on optimizing this in the future.

 

Zip Code/City Setting for Auto Alerts

This option will be located under Settings > Features > Auto Property Alerts > Buyer Property Alert/Seller Property Alert/Auto Market Report > Location Criteria.

This update will allow you to set a default location setting for Auto Buyer/Seller Alerts/Market Reports. You can set the auto alert to only trigger based off of the "Inquired City" or "Inquired Zip Code." If you choose "Any," the system will trigger based on both city and zip code.

This information is typically gathered when the lead is imported via email parsing and the city or zip code are provided in the email or, if the lead registered on a Lofty website, their activity will be recorded for this purpose.

 

Add/Edit/Delete Alerts from Mobile App

After many client requests, the Lofty  Mobile App will now allow Lofty users to add/edit/delete Buyer/Seller Property Alerts on their mobile phones. The filters available on the mobile app will be synced with the web app meaning if users have specific filters from their MLS set up on the mobile app and Lofty website, they will also be available on the mobile app. 

Limitations include the following: 

  1. We do not support the option to "plot" an area on a map when using the mobile app
  2. The ability to send individual listings is not supported--only the creation of an alert using the available criteria. This can be done on the web app using Listing Discovery but is not currently available on the mobile app. 
  3. Market Reports cannot be created with this feature, only Buyer/Seller Property Alerts

      

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com> or by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557.

name: Property Alerts & Market Snapshots
title: Property Alerts & Market Snapshots
body:
Introduction

The Lofty alerts function includes Property Alerts and Market Snapshots. Property Alerts engage leads automatically by emailing them new listings that fit the criteria that have been set up. Market Snapshots send nearby newly-listed and sold properties to buyer/seller leads to inform them about what is going on in their market and encourage them to buy and/or sell. Generally, we can display as far back as 3 years of sold listings, depending on the MLS. These tools can help you automatically nurture leads that are not currently ready to buy or sell, and allow you to focus on the leads that you are actively interacting with as well.

 

Summary

  • Steps to Set Up Property Alerts/Market Snapshots
  • Saved Searches
  • Pausing Alerts
  • User Experience

Steps to Set Up Property Alerts/Market Snapshots

The steps are the same for both Property Alerts and Market Snapshots.

Step 1

On the lead’s profile page, you will see the "Engagement" tab at the top of the page. In this section, you can see the current status of the Property Alerts or Market Snapshots that exist for this lead. If there are active property alerts, you can see the total number of alerts in green. If the numbers are grayed out, the property alerts have not been set up yet or are inactive. Each alert shows basic search criteria in blue that can be clicked on to view more in-depth information. You can also see the alert frequency on the right side. 

 

Step 2

To create a new Property Alert, click on + New Alert under the Property Alerts section. You will be directed to the Property Alert Page.

 

Step 3

On the Property Alert Page, you can see the criteria that can be set to filter the property alert, based on the lead’s initial inquiry when they came into the CRM. It's optional, but you can select the ones that you want to apply to this alert by checking the box next to the criteria and then clicking on the "Fill into fields" button at the bottom. 

Click the "Notes" tab to see all the notes in this lead’s timeline.

 

Step 4

You can see all the available filters on the right side of the page. The results will be updated instantly when these fields are changed. You can find the number of results from the applied filter at the top of the page. The more criteria you select, the fewer results you will receive.

 

Step 5

To select a specific area on the map to be used in search criteria, click on the "Draw" icon in the lower right corner of the map. If you need to plot multiple areas, you will need to create a separate alert for each area.

Drag and click to mark the area you want. End on the same dot you started with. If you want to remove this filter, click the "Clear" icon in the upper-right corner of the map.

*IMPORTANT:

Please note that when adding search criteria, the more filters you apply, the fewer results you will receive. However, it is the opposite case when it comes to the Location filters. You can enter multiple locations. The more locations and zip codes you enter, the more results you will receive.

 

Step 6

Click the "____ Results" tab on the upper right corner of the page to see if all the listings on the market meet the criteria.

You can click on these listings to see their details. When you find a listing that the lead might be interested in right away, you can select the listing by checking the box and clicking "Send listings" to send all the selected listings to the lead. Note that this is an optional action that can be taken when creating a property alert. You can only send up to 25 listings at a time.

 

Step 7

Return to the Filters tab, and click Next when you are ready to continue. Keep in mind that you can always come back and edit this later.

 

Step 8

A pop-up window will now appear with additional settings for this property alert. A summary of the filters for this property alert is located on the left side.

Next, you can choose to name this property alert. This is a useful way to keep things organized. This alert and name are not visible to the client, though this is planned in future improvements.

Choose from the options (not required):

  • Handpick listings: You will be notified by email when new listings that fit the criteria enter the market. Listings will NOT be sent to the lead without your approval.
  • Send a copy to myself
    • Note: This will cc you on the alert email, and you will receive a copy in your inbox.
  • Send alert immediately
  • Use listings on the market as a supplement: If no new listings that fit the criteria come to the market, listings on the market will be sent instead.
  • Include open house info

Choose to whom the property alert emails will be sent. If there are family members with valid emails on file, you can select them from the list: 


Customize the email subject (not required) to include your alert name as well as any lead or agent variables (merge fields):

 

Decide on the frequency at which you would like to send out the emails. This will depend on how hot the market is, how engaged the lead is, etc. 

When the rest of the settings are set up, click on the blue "Save" button in the bottom-right to save the alert and turn it on:


For new alerts created, you will get this additional prompt to sync search criteria, but if you have chosen Handpicked in the previous step, this window will not show up.


NOTE: Updating the search criteria section in the lead profile will not update the set criteria on a property alert. Please see the Lead Profile Page for more info about search criteria.

Step 9

You can keep track of the sent property alert emails in the lead’s timeline, or click any alert you’ve created under the "Property Alert" in the Engagement section of the lead’s profile.

 

Saved Searches

When leads visit Lofty sites and save a search, it will look like this to them on your Lofty site under the "My Searches" section of their profile:

This saved search also sets up a property alert for the lead with their search criteria.

Users can click on the "view" icon for those saved searches under the "Engagement" tab of a lead profile. Doing so will take the Lofty user to the listings search results page on the Lofty site--the same page the lead would be viewing with all current matches.

You can also click on the "trash can" icon to delete the lead's saved search if you would prefer to set up your own.

*IMPORTANT: Please note that any property alerts or market snapshots set up by you as the Lofty user will not display on the lead's profile. In other words, you can delete their saved searches, but you cannot replace or edit them at present.


Mobile version

When you adjust the Location or Filter settings, the [[Save]] button will appear, allowing you to save the changes to the settings you just made. The [[Save]] button will only appear once you have made a change to either the Location or Filter.


Name of Saved Searches

After clicking the [[Save]] button, you will be asked to specify a name for your search. The Name of a search is a required field for you to save.

You should be able to use letters, numbers, special symbols, and such to name your saved search.

The mobile feature should check for duplicates in the Names of searches. If you give a new saved search the same name as a previously saved search, there should be a pop-up that says “This saved search name already exists”, and you won’t be able to save it.

When you click on the small “x” next to the search name, you can remove the entire name and fill in a new one. This allows you to quickly change the name of the search if you choose.

The character limit for a Saved Search name is 30. When the limit is reached, you will not be able to enter more characters in the name, and a pop-up will appear telling them the limit has been reached.

Clear Button

  • After you save a search, the “Clear” button will appear.
  • Clicking the clear button will reset all the settings for Location, Filter, and Sort.
  • The clear button will disappear after you click.
  • If you readjust the settings for Location or Filter, the Save button will reappear.
  • The “New Matches” banner should disappear since the search filter no longer applies to the listings.

Map View Search

  • When on the Listings page, the user can click on the Map icon to toggle to Map View.
  • When they make a change with either Location, Filters, or Draw, the Save Search button should appear.

Note: When you use the Draw function, the Location will automatically be marked as “Custom Boundary”. Even if you had a Location selected before, once you use the Draw function, the previous Location will be replaced with “Custom Boundary”. Thus, we cannot have Location and Draw be used together at once. Only Location and Filter can be blue at the same time, and Filter and Draw.


When creating a new saved search on Map View, you will also need to give the new saved search a unique name.


Access Saved Searches

  • You can access all their previously saved searches by clicking on the top-right button. This opens a pop-up with all the saved searches.
  • The searches should be ordered such that the searches with the most recently updated listings should be on top, and then the newly created saved searches will be ordered from newest to oldest. You can scroll down continuously to view the saved searches until they reach the end.

View Saved Search

  • When the user clicks on a saved search, the filters for the search that were saved will apply on the listing page
  • New matched listings that fit search criteria go on top, ordered from newest to oldest.
    • New match refers to ones the user hasn’t seen since they last clicked on the listing page.
    • New and old matches are separated with a horizontal line “New Matches Above”.
      • Any listing that was NOT in the saved search results before is a “New Match”
      • If a user adjusts the Sort filter, then the horizontal line dividing new and old matches will disappear. The listings should be sorted according to the Sort conditions. The New Match banner remains on the listing until the user leaves the listing page.

Favorites

  • You can select favorites, and these will then become visible in the Favorites folder. In the future, we can let you view your favorites on the listing page of the search.


Editing + Creating New Search from Location/Filter Settings - LIST VIEW

  • You can edit an existing saved search by changing the Location and Filter settings.
  • When you tap the “Save” button, a pop-up asks if you want to “Save as New Search” or “Update Existing Search”.
    • Tapping “Save as New Search”: opens a pop-up for you to enter a name for the search.
    • Once you save the new search, it will appear as a new entry in the Saved Search pop-up.
  • When you tap “Update Existing Search”, they will be back on the listing page.

If you tap on the saved searches icon, you will see that your search criteria have changed on the entry for that search.


Editing + Creating New Search from Location/Filter Settings - MAP VIEW

  • You can save on an existing saved search from Map View by clicking on the [[Save Search]] button after adjusting Location, Filters, or Draw.
  • Same process as saving from the listing page view.


Deleting a Saved Search

  • You can delete an already saved search via the Save Search pop-up. Clicking “Edit” allows you to select the searches you want to delete.

Pausing Alerts

Currently, there is no standalone "Pause" option for property alerts. However, if you would like to accomplish this, you can simply turn off the lead's subscription for property alerts (it will stop all of them) and then turn it back on when they are ready to go.

 

User Experience

To further enhance the user experience, we've implemented an automatic login feature for leads who click on our alert emails. This means that when a lead clicks on a property alert or market snapshot in their email, they will be seamlessly logged into our website without the need to enter their credentials again. This not only saves time but also encourages more frequent interaction with our listings, as leads can access information with greater ease and fewer barriers.

Additionally, it's important to note that if an agent user accesses the alert email through the lead timeline record, the system will not automatically log them in. This is to prevent any confusion regarding lead activities and to maintain a clear distinction between agent access and lead interactions. This ensures that agents can view the alerts as they appear to the lead, without altering the lead's experience or engagement data.

 

FAQs

Q: What is the difference between "Send Immediately" and "Instantly" in the Alert Frequency?

A: "Send alert immediately" is a one-time setting (initial setup), which triggers the alert to run the listings from the last email time. It does take some time to find proper listings on site (property alert sent listings new on-site within 10 days for the first time.) Although the client selected "Send alert immediately" if there is no matched listing at that time, an alert email will not be sent to the lead immediately.

 

For property alerts that are set as INSTANTLY, the alert runs every 2-4 hours to check if there are new listings that meet the criteria. Once there are listings in the result, an alert will be sent to the lead.

 

Q: How do you batch property alerts or mass send property alerts?

A: The ability to mass or batch-send property alerts is not currently supported.

 

Q: When listings are being duplicated in property alerts because the listings are in multiple MLSs. How can this be fixed?

A: Our tech team can perform a deduplication operation, the duplicate listings can be removed, and you can submit a ticket to Support to request this. Please note that the system does not consider a listing duplicate if there is a difference in how addresses are entered in the MLS, i.e., Ave vs Avenue and the like.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

 

Related terms: sold listing, seller alert, buyer alert, property alert, auto property alerts

body:
Introduction

*Please note that the features available to you on the Lofty platform will vary depending on the package you have purchased. With any questions in this regard, please reach out to your assigned Customer Success Manager or our Support Team for more information.

Release Date

The release date for this set of features is Tuesday, September 17, 2019.

Summary

  • Email Accountability Report
  • New Opportunity Notifications
  • New Message Notifications
  • Additional Sold Listings Settings
  • Co-Listing Agent Display
  • Zapier Improvements

 

Email Accountability Report

This new report will be found under Reporting > Email Accountability. 

There are now options to view this report "By Email" and "By Lead." The "Unsubscribed" data can only be calculated based on the number of leads so will be the same whether you are looking at "By Email" or "By Lead."

Filters can also be applied for different time periods (e.g. this month, this quarter, etc.) as well as email type (e.g. property alert, Welcome Email, etc.). The main view is by chart but there is also a table view.

All reports include both Team Leads + Private Leads.  

Team Owner/Admin View

The Team Admin/Owner and any users who have the "Manage Team" permission will have the report view for the whole team (see Team Permissions). Three sections will display for these users: Overview / Email Performance / Email Performance by Agent.

Clicking on an a user's name in the "Email Performance by Agent" section will show a report for just that user.

Standard User View

Users without admin privileges will only have access to their data in these two sections: Overview / Email Performance.

Here is an example of what this report will look like:

New Opportunity Notifications

Currently, all Opportunities are outlined here: Opportunities. Additional opportunity notifications will be added to this list under the "High Interest" category with this update:

  1. When a lead saves a search on your Lofty IDX website
  2. When a lead uses the mortgage calculator 3+ times in one day

With each "Opportunity," a notification will be triggered in the Web App as well as on the Mobile App.

 

New Message Notifications

The Lofty Mobile App already has the notification for a new message being received--but this notification was previously unavailable on the Web App. With this update, when a lead sends either a text message to the Lofty virtual number or types a message into the chat box of the website, there will be a web notification as well so that no conversations are missed.

The notification title will vary depending on what type of message is received: "New Text Msg" or "New Chatbox Msg."

If this notification becomes annoying in any way, it can be turned off via the mobile app. Keep in mind that this setting adjusts both the Web App notification as well as the Mobile App notification:

Also, this is what the new message notification looks like on the mobile app:

 

Additional Sold Listings Settings

Lofty now allows users to set up additional criteria for Sold Listings displayed on the Lofty IDX websites via the listing filters. These new options are available for the "Office" and "Agent" criteria as seen here:

The following are the new options that are opened for clients:

 

Co-Listing Agent Display

For Lofty users who are on teams and want to make sure the listing agent is displayed with their property on their Lofty IDX website, this is possible via the CMS Tool. With this update, co-listing agents can also be displayed as well.

To find this setting, access the CMS Tool > Page Editor > Property Details > Listing Detail Agent.

If "Yes" is selected here, Lofty will review all agent profile settings for their MLS Agent ID and License ID to attempt to match the agent with any active listings displayed on the Lofty website. If a match is found, the listing agent and any co-listing agent will be displayed on the listing detail page in the "Schedule a Tour" section as well as the "MLS Info" section. 

*IMPORTANT: Please note that the displaying of the listing agent and co-listing agent does not affect the actual lead routing of the lead as it comes into the system nor any messages sent, etc. In other words, only the display of the listing/co-listing agent(s) are presented here but any leads that register would not be sent to the listing agent unless the lead routing was set up to assign to them.

 

Zapier Improvements

Lofty's Zapier integration will continue to improve in future releases. One improvement made in this release is the support for more fields when Lofty is the "Trigger." All fields that were available for the "Action" are now on the "Trigger" menu as well. Here are the supported fields for Lofty as the "Trigger."

  • Source
  • Group
  • Tag
  • Note
  • Subscription - Smart Plans
  • Subscription - Property Alert
  • Subscription - Market Report
  • Min Price (Buyer)
  • Max Price (Buyer)
  • City (Buyer)
  • State (Buyer)
  • Zipcode (Buyer)
  • Address (Buyer)
  • Min Beds (Buyer)
  • Min Baths (Buyer)
  • Beds (Seller)
  • Baths (Seller)
  • Price (Seller)
  • SqFt (Seller) (optional)
  • City (Seller) (optional)
  • State (Seller) (optional)
  • Zipcode (Seller) (optional)

This means that all of these fields can be sent out of Lofty when Lofty is triggering a corresponding action in another app. 

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com> or by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557.

name: Questionnaire Settings
title: Questionnaire Settings
body:
Introduction

The "Questionnaire" whose settings you can adjust consists of the questions asked of a lead after they already provide their information. With "Questionnaire Settings," you can edit whether the questions will appear, whether they can be skipped, and then the style. You can also customize the questions that will appear.

For context, the questions asked of a lead after they register consist of the following:

  • Buyer
    1. Are you a first-time home buyer?
    2. Within how many months do you plan to buy a home?
    3. Have you been pre-qualified for a mortgage?
    4. Do you have a house to sell first?
    5. Are you already working with an agent?
  • Seller
    1. Within how many months do you plan to sell a home?
    2. Is there a mortgage on your house now?
    3. Do you want to buy a house?
    4. Do you have an agent already?

More information regarding the prior step to this questionnaire (registration pop-up) can be found in these two articles: Registration Pop-up Trigger Rule and Registration Pop-up Style.

 

Summary

  • Edit Questionnaire Settings 
  • Customize Questions

 

Edit Questionnaire Settings 

To access the settings, click on the "Settings" icon on the left menu when in the CMS Tool, select "Lead Capture," and finally "Questionnaire Settings."

Note that there are technically two forms: (1) Buyer and (2) Seller. Each has its settings, though they are the same settings that can be adjusted. Click on the tab for the one that you want to edit:

Choose whether you want to have this questionnaire appear or not (remember this would have to be turned off for both buyer and seller separately). You can also choose whether you want to allow leads to close the form with an "x" that will be in the top-right:

You can then edit the background color, title, description, and button text for both forms. Please note that the button color will use the global button color set in the Style Settings of the Page Editor.

 

Customize Questions

To customize the questions, you can click on the options to edit, drag/drop to reorder, and the "eyeball" icon to hide. The contents of all custom questions will be added to the lead's profile in the CRM as a note.

When editing a question, it will look like this:

 

Questions?

Increased Capacity for Mass Texts

Lofty users who want to send mass texts via the Lofty Web App can now send up to 200 texts at once. Previously, the limit was 50 texts at once.

*Be mindful of your text package daily limit when sending out mass texts!

 

New Permission: Edit Own Website

Team Owners/Admins now have the access to turn on/off access for users on their team to be able to edit their corresponding subdomain website. If the permission is turned OFF, that Lofty user will be unable to edit their CMS Tool (). The Team Owner/Admin can still control these websites.

 Turn "Manage Team" ON This permission cannot be turned on until you turn on the "Edit Own Website" permission first.

Embed Video

1.  Find and copy the embed link from the YouTube video:

 

2. Click the Video button in the email editor:

Introduction

*Please note that the features available to you on the Lofty platform will vary depending on the package you have purchased. With any questions in this regard, please reach out to your assigned Customer Success Manager or our Support Team for more information.

Release Date

The release date for this set of features is Tuesday, Aug 20th, 2019.

Summary

  • Mass Welcome Email
  • Blog Search Feature
  • Blog Categories
  • Improved WordPress Blog Compatibility

 

 

Mass Welcome Email

Lofty has now released a new feature to be able to manually send Welcome Emails for leads that are already in the database but have never received one. This option can be found under Settings > Email Templates > Automated Emails > Welcome Email. Keep in mind that this will not replace the standard process of auto-triggering a Welcome Email when a new lead enters the database.

When accessing this feature, there are two scenarios to be aware of. Hovering over the  "send" icon will provide an explanation: 

  1. "All leads have been sent login credentials"
    • All leads in the database have received a Welcome Email at some point in time. This means that no Welcome Emails can be triggered using this feature.
  2. "A Welcome Email is currently being sent for some leads. Try back later to review the status"
    • Welcome Emails are pending delivery. Check back later to make sure all Welcome Emails have been sent to your leads.

 

Blog Search Feature

Website visitors who choose to view your blog will now have the option to search for any keywords that are contained within the post titles or content.

 

Blog Categories

Blog visitors can also browse articles by category which is now synchronized with the WordPress account. 

 

Improved WordPress Blog Compatibility

The overall compatibility between WordPress and the Lofty presentation of the blog content has been improved. Here are a few items of those improvements:

  • Additional Plug-in support including Yoast SEO, WP Classic Editor, etc.
  • Post Style: Including font size, font color, content title, subtitle hyperlink, etc. Lofty’s blog will now be more compatible with the style of WordPress.

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com> or by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557.

name: How to Add a Video to Emails
title: How to Add a Video to Emails
body:
Introduction

Everyone will agree that videos are a great form of communication that can more easily reach a target audience by grabbing their attention. Currently, the ability to embed a video is not a feature in the Lofty CRM. This decision is mainly due to our intent to avoid various spam and security risks that have caused many major email systems to not allow for videos to be played directly from an email. The recommended workaround, however, is to insert a screenshot image of your video (ideally with a video "play" symbol on it) and hyperlink it so that it goes directly to the video for easy viewing. This will also allow you to upload bigger videos to your video server without having to worry about attachment size limitations for emails.

With Lofty's email template editor, you can add a video URL to your email templates to market to your customers. Below are the steps to do so.

Please reference the following article if the video is hosted on YouTube: How to Add a YouTube Video to Emails.

 

Take a Screenshot of the Video

Go to your video, take a screenshot of the video at a point where you like the image that appears, and then save that screenshot to your desktop. With this image, you can use it as is, or you can consider putting a "play" button on top of it to make it more video-like when added to an email. There are lots of ways to do this, but we found this free service called Create Play Button to Image Online with a quick internet search.

 

Insert Hyperlink

In your email template, click on the hyperlink icon and add the link for your video.

  

Upload Your Image

Insert the video preview image by clicking on the image icon with the inserted link still selected. Remember that the inserted link has to be selected for the hyperlink to become part of the image.

 

Adjust, Preview, and Save

Adjust the size of the image and add the rest of the content to the template. Click Preview to ensure it worked properly, then click Save. You can now proceed to send your video directly to your clients.

 

 

FAQ

What is the maximum file size for an email attachment?

The maximum size limit for email attachments is 2 MB. Depending on the size of the file, however, Lofty has two different methods of attachment outlined here:

    1. If the attachments uploaded are less than 2 MB, the email attachments will be added directly as an attachment to the email.
    2. If the attachments uploaded are more than 2 MB, Lofty will convert the attachments into download links that are then inserted into the email.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by a chat with us through your Lofty CRM. 

Related terms: email attachment, maximum file size, email link, file size

name: Lead Capture - Redfin
title: Lead Capture - Redfin
body:
Introduction

This article will review how to set up email parsing in Lofty for Redfin leads. 

 

What kind of Email will be Parsed?

Lofty is able to parse a new lead into your CRM based on an email alert that comes from Redfin to your Lofty-integrated email. Here are the common items that Lofty searches for in Email Parsing:

From Address: partner-agents@redfin.com
Subject: xxx(lead name), meet xxx(agent name), the agent you requested
Email Body: 

 

How to Set it Up

Enter your Lofty-integrated email address as the email that receives lead notifications in your Redfin settings.

Note: The fields parsed from Redfin are Full Name, Email, and Phone. Any other fields will be parsed as Notes in Lofty. 

 

How to find your unique Lofty email address in Lofty?

Go to the Settings page, and under the Features section on the right, click Integration to Integration page and then click Lead Capture.

On the bottom of this page, you will see Auto-import Lead via third-party providers. Here, you will see your Lofty email, which you will use to auto-import leads from Realtor.com. In this section, click Copy.

 

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Feature Updates for CRM 2.9.0
title: Feature Updates for CRM 2.9.0
body:
Introduction

*Please note that the features available to you on the Lofty platform will vary depending on the package you have purchased. With any questions in this regard, please reach out to your assigned Customer Success Manager or our Support Team for more information.

Release Date

The release date for this set of features is Aug 6th, 2019.

Summary 

  • Lofty Community
  • Lofty Paid Lead Tags
  • Team Leads
  • Mobile App Improvement: Duplicate Leads
  • Listing Discovery
  • Landing Page Editors
  • Frequency Reduction for Auto Property Alerts

 

Lofty Community

Lofty has launched a new Community page! Please join the Community, follow the topics that you are interested in, and participate in product discussions with other Lofty users. Here is how you can access this:

 

Lofty Paid Lead Tags

All leads that enter Lofty from one of our marketing campaigns currently have the Source of “Lofty Paid Lead.” Now, with this update, Lofty users will be able to see whether they came from one of the following in addition to that source: 

  1. Lofty Paid - Google
  2. Lofty Paid - FB
  3. Lofty Paid - FBform

 One of the above will be added as a shared tag on the lead in addition to the source being Lofty Paid Lead.

  • The tags can now be used for filtering specific sources even more granular, Smart Plans, etc.
  • The tags can be added/removed manually if needed

 

Team Leads

Previously, we used three different terms (Shared Leads, Team Leads, and Public Leads) to refer to the same type of lead privacy in Lofty. Everything is now consistent and will be referred to as “Team Leads” in the CRM, CMS Tool, and all Help Center documentation.

 *No functionality has changed with this update--only the language used.

As a review. . .

A “Team Lead” is any lead that is not a Private Lead. Just because it is a “Team Lead” does not mean that anyone can access that lead. Only those (a) listed in the “Assigned To” section of a lead profile or (b) given permission to “Access All Team Leads” can view Team Leads.

(a)

(b)

 

Mobile App Improvement: Duplicate Leads

Lofty now supports the ability to more easily merge leads from the mobile app.

When a lead is a duplicate, a message will appear at the top of the lead detail page:

By clicking the “Merge” button, the following options will appear at the bottom of the screen:

  • Merge as Duplicates
  • Merge as Family Members
  • View Lead Detail
  • Ignore

 

 

 

Listing Discovery

Previously known as Listing Management.

Important changes include the following:

1. You can now search for ANY listings from the MLS database, not just new listings that Lofty recommended (Open House, Back on Market, Price Reduced, etc.)

2. You can easily save any search criteria you like as a hot sheet. The filters available are the same as those used for website searches and property alerts.

The top three hot sheets will be displayed on the dashboard page:

 

Landing Page Editors

Lofty users with the “Manage Team” permission now have the ability to create and edit landing pages on subdomains for other users on the team.

The option to select the landing page site is found here:

 

Frequency Reduction for Auto Property Alerts

In order to improve email deliverability, auto property alert email frequency will be adjusted for leads who never open them. Lofty will now automatically adjust the frequency of auto property alerts by doing the following: 

  1. If auto alerts are set to “Daily” or “Instantly” frequencies, auto alerts will be sent out for 30 days daily/instantly per the settings.
  2. If a lead who is set to receive these auto alerts does not open even one alert for 30 days, the frequency will be adjusted for that lead to “Weekly.” 
  3. If, after the auto property alert has been adjusted to a “Weekly” (per #2), a lead opens the auto property alert email, the frequency of their emails will revert back to the frequency set up in Settings > Auto Property Alerts, daily, instantly, etc.

*Note that this only applies to auto property alerts. Manual property alerts are not affected.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com> or by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557.

name: All Listings & Hot Sheets
title: All Listings & Hot Sheets
body:
Introduction

If you have a Lofty IDX Website (and the website is active), you can enter Listing Discovery by clicking the icon next to the CMS Tool (website editor). The red dot on the icon means there are new listings today. We have also made a number of changes that improve the way Listing Discovery works for you, through Smart Listings. 

 

 

 

Summary

  • All Listings
    • Send to Leads
  • Hot Sheets
    • Adding a Hot Sheet
    • Default Hot Sheets
    • Manage Hot Sheets
  • FAQ
    • Is there a way to reduce the total number of listings that show up on the Listings Discovery page? 

 

All Listings

Lofty has integrated all of your MLS databases into the Listing Discovery section. Users can view all MLS listings and search for any listings from the MLS:

The first column shows the address, image, bedrooms/bathrooms, type, and square footage. Clicking on the address will take you to your Lofty IDX website and the listing page for that specific property. 

The next column shows the "List Price". If the price has increased or decreased, it will be represented with an up/down arrow. The MLS info will show the status of the listing (pending, active, etc.) and, when clicked will display additional details available from the MLS.

 

Buyer Matching

"Buyer Matching" is one of the most useful columns on Listing Discovery. Based on basic search criteria (beds, baths, price range, etc.) that have been saved by leads registered in your database, leads will be matched with listings showing up on Listing Discovery. In other words, the leads found in "Buyer Matching" are those that would be a good fit for that property based on the search criteria in their lead profile. Depending on your permissions, these leads can include leads in the Lead Pond or those assigned to your team. 

When "View Matched Leads(#)" is clicked, the matched leads will display. Hovering over the "Matching Inquiries" will show which factors have matched the leads for them to show up in this category. You can use this section to send the listing directly to the leads that match.

The "Action" column has the option to send the listing directly to leads (in individual conversations) as represented by the first icon. An option is also available to add a text code for that listing (reference Text Codes for Lead Capture). The final option is for sharing directly on Facebook, Twitter, or LinkedIn. 

Send to Leads

You can click Send to Leads to send a particular listing to the leads of your choice. Choose the listing that you want to send, and click Send to Lead. 

A popup will appear where you can search for the lead(s) to whom you want to send the listing. You can search for leads with Basic Search (by name, email, or phone), Address Search (by city, county, or zip code), or use Advanced Filters such as Segment, Pipeline, Tag, Price, etc. Once the search results are displayed, select the lead(s) that you want to receive the listing by clicking the checkbox, then click Email or Text to select how you would like to send the listings. 

The listings will be displayed in the email editor in the next step. From here, you can also edit your email subject and email content. After editing your email content, you can preview and click Send.

The "Listing Agent" column shows the listing agent for that property. Some MLSs do not provide Lofty with this information. However, when available, users will no longer have to go to the MLS to find contact details for a listing that is on the MLS that they need to set up a tour for, make an offer, etc. If you have a call/text package, you can also trigger a call or a text to be made directly from the available options. 

If the Listing Agent's email address is available in Lofty, the Lofty user can send them an email directly through Lofty but this will only work if the Lofty user has their email integrated (Gmail, Exchange, etc.). Clicking on the "email" icon will open up a new email that looks like this:

Finally, the "View" column will show the leads from your CRM database who have (a) viewed, (b) saved, (c) sent a message, or (d) requested a showing on this specific listing. Currently, these fields are not clickable. The "Updated Time" column shows the last time the listing details were updated. 

 

Hot Sheets

You can easily filter using desired search criteria and then save it as a hot sheet. This is intended to be a convenient way for you to access the same set of criteria in the future. You can have up to 100 total hot sheets.

*Currently, there is no option to share hot sheets with other users on your team.

 

Adding a Hot Sheet

To add Hot Sheets after narrowing down the results with the option to filter, you can directly save them as a new Hot Sheet by clicking on the disc icon to SAVE Sheet or clicking the button on the left panel to add a sheet. Then, provide a unique name for the new Hot Sheet in the “CUSTOMIZE HOT SHEET” pop-up window. You can also choose to delete certain criteria from this pop-up window.  

Updating Existing Hot Sheet

If you do not check the box “Save as New Hot Sheet”, the change you made to the existing Hot Sheet will replace the previous settings, including the name.

Saving as New Hot Sheet

If you check the box “Save as New Hot Sheet”, a separate Hot Sheet with the new name and settings will be created.


Default Hot Sheets

In Listing Discovery, three types of recommended hot sheets are provided by default:

  1. New Listings: These listings are new to the market and on your site
  2. Price Reduced: The prices of these listings have been reduced recently
  3. Back on Market: The status of these listings became “Back on Market” recently. Please note that many MLSs do not provide us with this status in their data--meaning that this may not populate any results.

 

Manage Hot Sheets

You can edit your hot sheets and manage their order by clicking on the Settings cog-wheel icon to the right of the HOT SHEETS title. From here, you can drag and drop to reorder, edit, and delete.

*The top three Hot Sheets will display on your Dashboard page (see My Vs. Team Dashboards).

 

FAQ

Is there a way to reduce the total number of listings that show up on the Listings Discovery page? 

No, there is no way to reduce the total number of listings showing here. This is fed in from all of the MLSs that you have connected to your Team Website. This is the total number of listings in the MLSs for your review. If your MLS connection provides data that is too extensive, consider creating Hot Sheets (see the applicable topic in this article) for specific areas, etc.

 

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Feature Updates for CRM 2.8.8, Site 3.5.2
title: Feature Updates for CRM 2.8.8, Site 3.5.2
body:
Introduction

*Please note that the features available to you on the Lofty platform will vary depending on the package you have purchased. With any questions in this regard, please reach out to your assigned Customer Success Manager or our Support Team for more information.

Release Date

The release date for this set of features is July 18th, 2019.

Summary 

  • Inbound Call Forwarding
  • Support Purchasing Call/Text Packages on Teams Under Enterprise Package
  • Enterprise / Broker Edition IDX Website (Beta Testing)
  • Team Lead Routing for Enterprise Edition (Beta Testing)
  • Bounced Email Timeline Optimization
  • Search Optimization on Mobile Devices
  • Landing Page Optimizations
  • More Lead-Related Settings in Landing Pages

 

Inbound Call Forwarding 

As a feature that has been requested by many of our users, Lofty now provides a solution for making sure incoming phone calls are not missed! Incoming calls to Lofty virtual numbers will be forwarded to a specific phone number if the agent is not unavailable or does not pick up the phone for a specified time. 

Team Owners/Admins can easily apply all the calls to the same phone number (e.g. a company number) by applying the rule to all the team members using the switch at the bottom. Otherwise, this setting is managed by each individual user.  

Want to know more？You can refer to this Help Center article: Inbound Call Forwarding.

 

Support Purchasing Call/Text Packages on Teams Under Enterprise Package

Many Team Admins under Enterprise Accounts have requested the ability to purchase call/text packages in their CRMs. Lofty now supports this feature with this release. They can choose to use their own payment card (if on file via the Support Team or assigned CSM) or the Enterprise Account Admin’s card. If they want to use the Enterprise Account Admin’s card, an email will be sent to the Enterprise Account Admin requesting approval after the Team Admin submits the order. Once the Enterprise Account Admin approves the request via email, the requested call/text packages will be made available to the Team Admin for distribution among agents. 

This is a screenshot of what the Team Admin would see when setting up the request to add call/text packages via Settings > Manage Dialer.

This is an example of the approval request email that the Enterprise Account Admin will receive and has to approve before billing is updated:

 

Enterprise / Broker Edition IDX Website (Beta Testing)

Lofty clients with the Enterprise Edition now have the ability to beta test a new "Broker" IDX Website which, when leads register, can distribute leads to individual teams. This website must be set up like any other IDX website (requiring MLS data integration, quality review of data, etc.). Here is a glimpse of what it will look like:

 

Team Lead Routing for Enterprise Edition (Beta Testing)

For clients currently using the Enterprise Edition (Broker Edition), we are releasing a feature for beta testing that allows you to set up lead routing rules to distribute leads from a main Enterprise/Broker IDX website to different teams. Lead routing from this top level website can only be assigned to teams, not individual agents, and is only able to use the "Round Robin" option.

 

Bounced Email Timeline Optimization

In order to better troubleshoot bounced emails, this update will allow for a more detailed description to be documented in the lead's profile. The bounced reason is defined according to the SMTP code in the bounced notification Lofty receives in our email server. Below are the main types that can be listed:

  • The email address does not exist
  • The email server does not exist
  • Rejected by recipient
  • Mailbox unavailable
  • Blocked due to spam content
  • Connection timed out
  • Unknown failure

 The following is a screenshot of how this will appear (within the red box): 

 

Search Optimization on Mobile Devices

This update provides some improvements on the "Listing" page on the mobile view:

  • Now you can search the listings by address directly
  • The filter now displays the number of applied filters
  • Searches can now be saved on mobile devices now

  

 

Landing Page Optimizations

As an additional Landing Page optimization, there are now seven new block types that can be added when adjusting the available content:

  1. Lead Form
  2. Call to Action
  3. Listing Search (Address)
  4. Listing Search (Advanced)
  5. Header (Menu)
  6. Header (Simple)
  7. Footer

Some of the new block types can be adjusted in the following ways:

Lead Form

Users can edit the title, banner, field, and button action of the block in content. 

The "Lead Form" block supports adding the full name field and configuring the button action from one of the below options:

  • Jump Link: After clicking the button, the page jumps to the corresponding URL.
  • Thank You Message: After clicking the button, the page pops up the toast popup.

*Lofty will support additional custom fields in future planned releases. 

Call to Action

Users can edit the title, banner, button number, and button link of the block content:

The "Call to Action" block supports configuration for the number of buttons and the link destination of the buttons. However, only a total of three buttons can be added:

Listing Search (Address)

Currently, no content can be configured with this block.

Listing Search (Advanced)

Currently, no content can be configured with this block.

Header (Menu)

Currently, no content can be configured with this block.

Header (Simple)

Users can choose the agent to be displayed on the banner in the top-right.

Footer

Currently, no content can be configured with this block.

 

In addition, there is now a new option to create a "Blank Template" for Landing Pages so that users can create their own landing page by adding blocks of their choice. A total of 15 blocks can be added per landing page.

 

All templates also support the customization of URLs when they are created.

 

All templates also support the configuration of SEO tools including the commonly-used "SEO Cover Photo" which is the image that will appear when the link is shared on social media.

 

More Lead Related Settings in Landing Page

Lead Type

Users can now select the lead type that is going to come in via the "Lead Generation" type landing pages This is found under Landing Page Editor > Settings > Basic Settings.

 

Lead Privacy and Assignment

Users can control whether the leads registered on the landing pages are Team Leads or Private Leads. Only users given the "Add Private Leads" permission can choose the option for Private Leads. 

You can also choose to Directly Assign leads or do so via Lead Routing rules in the Assignment Method section. If you choose Private Lead in Lead Privacy, you can only choose Directly Assign and the Assignee can only be yourself.

 

Add Tags and Notes for Leads Registered on Your Landing Pages

With this update, you can choose tags and add notes in Landing Page Settings > Additional Actions. All leads registered on this landing page will have these tags and notes added automatically.

 

Control Welcome Emails/Texts or not

In Landing Page Settings > Additional Actions, you can also choose whether to send welcome emails/texts to the leads who register via the landing pages.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com> or by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557.

name: My/Team Listings
title: My/Team Listings
body:
Introduction

My Listings and Team Listings can be viewed on the Listing Discovery page. We collect your team listings using the License ID or MLS Agent ID field on the profile page of each member of your team. Some MLS systems do not provide an Agent License ID, so we can only match your listings by the MLS Agent ID. If your MLS does not provide either an Agent License or MLS Agent ID, then Lofty will not be able to collect the listings in one place for you.

Teams can switch to "Team Listing - Closed" in the Listing Discovery to view their Team's sold listings. The sold/closed team listings will be displayed but are neither searchable nor selectable. Additionally, the "Action" options are currently unavailable.

Summary

  • Add Your MLS Agent ID to your Profile
  • Smart Listings
    • Listings Discovery Page
    • MLS Application Dashboard
    • Sending your Listings to Leads

Add Your MLS Agent ID to your Profile

You can enter your MLS Agent ID in Settings-Profile. Your MLS Agent ID is commonly the Identifier you use as the username or login for your MLS system and may include letters, numbers, or a combination of both. This differs from an MLS Listing Number and may also vary from your NRDS ID.

You will add your MLS ID by searching by either name or email address, and the options will then be populated for you to select from:

If you still can’t find your MLS Agent ID, please contact our support team.

 

MLSs that do not provide Agent License or MLS Agent ID:

Central Jersey MLS (CJMLS)
Hudson County MLS (HCMLS)
Toronto Real Estate Board Serving Greater Toronto REALTORS® (TREB)
Hilton Head Island MLS (HHIMLS)
Real Estate Board of New York-RETS(REBNY-RETS)

 

Smart Listings

We have made additional changes to the way the listing discovery page works for the user. Smart Listings help you organize and find listings to share with your leads more conveniently. For more information on this, click here.

Listings Discovery Page

The listings discovery page is located in the Listings tab:



When clicking on a listing, the listing details will slide out from the right side:

The user may click through Media, Details, Map, History, and Mortgage to see all of the listing information.

Click the 3 dots to open the listing page on the Lofty website:

Click the arrow icon in the middle to create a social media post:

Click the "..." icon to send the listing to leads, create a CMA, or create a text code:

When clicking the listing agent's name, the user may email, call, or text the agent directly through the Lofty CRM, or click the agent's name to see additional information:

When checking the box next to a listing, the options menu opens on the top:

Here, you may select multiple listings to send to leads, create a CMA Tool / Lofty CMA, or create a Buyer Home Tour.

 

MLS Application Dashboard

If you have not yet submitted your MLS application, please see the Start IDX Website. You can review the progress of your MLS applications in your CMS Settings. The MLSs can be sorted by All, Awaiting Signature, MLS Processing, Lofty Processing, Incomplete Application, and Active, as well as by specific Agent, MLS, and application start time.

 

Sending your Listings to Leads

From the Smart Listing page, click the Actions menu and select Send to Leads to send the listing to your leads. 

A pop-up window allows you to filter for the leads you want to send the listing to. You can send the listing via email or text message.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM. 

 

Related terms: share a listing
