Improvements for the family member feature (Web & App)

 

  • For the emails with a lead’s family member, records and notifications will show the family member’s name instead of the lead’s name. (Web & App)
  • When composing an email, names in the email template will change according to the recipient selected. (Web)
  • Caller ID now shows the family member’s name when receiving an inbound call from a lead’s family member. (App)

 

 

Open Transaction Management to Accelerator and Enterprise Users (Web)

 

Transaction management is a tab for agents to manage all their transactions in one place. In this version, we open transaction management to Accelerator and Enterprise users.

 

Plus, Accelerator and Enterprise users can add vendors & partners through Settings->Team->Vendor/Partner, and assign transactions to vendors & partners in Lead Profile page.

 

 

 

New Types of Text Alerts (Web)

 

There are more text templates available when leads are assigned to agents. Agents will be able to get text alerts from Lofty when one or multiple leads are assigned to you manually or by lead routing rules. In this way, you can nurture your leads faster and miss no opportunities.   

 

Open Multiple Assistants to Accelerator Users (Web&App)

 

Accelerator users can now add multiple assistants in Settings->Team->Role Settings and assign multiple users to one lead as Enterprise users can.

 

 

Open House Questionnaire Optimization (Web)

 

  • Pre-set six standard questions related with ‘Inquiries’ fields，such as FTHB、Pre-qual、Time Frame、House to Sell、With Agent and Price. If a lead fills in these questions, the answers will be imported into his corresponding ‘Inquiries’ fields.
  • Allow users to edit Name, Email, Phone question.

 

Only Show My Leads option for admins (Web)

 

Team admins can view all the leads in a team. Some may prefer to view only the leads assigned to them so that it is more convenient to follow up. Now a switch is available for them to control the default filter of the Lead List page and see their own leads only.

 

 

Zapier Optimization (Web)

 

In a Zap, you can choose the Lofty Trigger “Change Pipeline”, so when leads are moved to one specific pipeline in Lofty, they can be exported to another product.

 

 

Ability to filter leads by whether they have a Market Report set up (Web & App)

 

A new type of filter called ‘Market Report’ has been added to the lead list page.

 

 

Ability to sort leads by last call (Web)

 

Now you can sort leads by the time they were last called in the ‘Last Touch’ column.

 

Ability to sort leads by last name (Web)

 

Now you can sort leads by their last name.

 

Remember Last Choices of Tasks and Appointment Settings (Web)

 

For task and appointment settings on lead profile page, the system will remember last choices of the user on the same browser.

 

Opt-out leads assignment  (Web & App)

 

You have the ability to manually assign opt-out leads to lenders if you are sure that the lead wants to share info with lenders.

name: Lead Capture/Email Parsing
title: Lead Capture/Email Parsing
body:
Introduction

Lofty has made it easy for you to capture new leads from many other lead sources and automatically add their information directly into the Lofty CRM. The primary method to make this happen is via email parsing which means we train Lofty to recognize a new lead notification email and pull out as much information as possible into a lead profile in Lofty.

Summary

  • Email Parsing vs. Direct Integration
  • Email Parsing
    • (1) Lofty Parsing Email
    • (2) Integrated Email Address
  • Supported Lead Sources (via Email Parsing)
  • Additional Settings
    • Auto-Import: Yes/No
    • Auto-Import as Team Leads: Yes/No
    • Send Welcome Email

Email Parsing vs. Direct Integration

Please note that some services are connected directly to Lofty via API. Anything connected via API would be referred to as a direct integration and would not require email parsing configuration. Examples of this type of integration include Zillow, Facebook, Realtor.com, etc. Direct integrations are less common and require a much more involved setup process between Lofty and that organization. Email parsing is a very simple thing to set up in comparison.

 

Email Parsing

Email parsing can happen via two different methods in Lofty, both of which are outlined below. The basic concept is that you will take one of the supported email addresses and add it to the lead source settings to receive any lead notification emails. Technically speaking, you could use both your Lofty parsing email and your integrated email at the same time to receive emails and parse them if you would like to.

As mentioned in the introduction, this allows Lofty to receive the lead notification email and, assuming we can recognize it, pull out information to combine into a new lead for you in the Lofty CRM. 

 

(1) Lofty Parsing Email 

When you create your account with Lofty, you will be assigned a parsing email address. Your parsing email address will always be in the format of "first_last@lofty.me".

To access your parsing email address, navigate to Lead Settings > Lead Capture:

 

(2) Integrated Email Address

Integrate your email account from a supported source (Gmail, Office365, IMAP/SMTP, etc.), and by doing so you will give your CRM access to read incoming emails and parse them into your database as new leads as long as we can recognize the email. 

  

Supported Lead Sources (via Email Parsing)

The number of supported lead sources is always growing. The best place to find supported lead sources will be to log into your Lofty CRM > Settings > Lead Settings> Lead Capture Settings.  The lead sources presented on this list are all supported for email parsing. 

*IMPORTANT: If you subscribe to a lead source that is not currently listed on this list, please send a copy of a lead notification email to our Support Team (support@lofty.com) and let them know you would like help in configuring email parsing for that type of email. In a matter of days, Lofty can be configured to recognize that type of email.

 

Additional Settings

The following additional settings can be edited for each lead source that is brought into Lofty via email parse. To edit these settings, go to Settings > Lead Settings> Lead Capture Settings:

 

Auto-Import: Yes/No

Toggle the switch in the "Auto-Import" column on/off depending on whether you would like leads from these sources to be parsed into Lofty. They will be ON by default:

 

Ownership Level

Company/Team Leads: Leads are generated from a Company/Team lead capture channel. The lead owner is the Company/Team.

Office Leads: Leads are generated from an Office lead capture channel. The lead owner is the Office.

Personal Leads: Leads are generated from an individual user's lead capture channel. The lead owner is the individual.

Reference this article for more information: Lead Ownership

 

Send Welcome Email

Though this is turned OFF by default, this is a tool that can be used to automatically send a welcome email from your Lofty IDX website to leads entering from other sources so they can begin browsing listings on your IDX website. Keep in mind any other automatic content that they will be sent as you do not want to overwhelm the lead. The welcome email can always be sent later. Reference this article for more information: Set Up the Welcome Email.

 

  

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, don't hesitate to get in touch with our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM. 

 

Related terms: lead parsing, email parsing

name: Lead Capture - Realty.com
title: Lead Capture - Realty.com
body:
Introduction

In this article, we will review the steps necessary to integrate Lofty with Realty.com. This will allow Realty.com leads to be sent directly to Lofty the moment they are generated on the Realty.com platform.

 

Locating Your API Key 

  1. Log in to your Lofty account.
  2. Select “Settings” in the menu bar. 

  3. Select “Integrations” on the left-hand menu bar.
  4. Scroll to the very bottom & “Copy” the API Key

     
  5. Once you have the Lofty API Key, go to your Realty.com portal located at: https://portal.realty.com.
  6. Once logged in, find Integrations in the menu on the left. Expand and select All Integrations. 

     
  7. Select Lofty from the list of possible CRMs.

  8. Paste the API Key that you got from your Lofty CRM, and paste it in the empty field. Then click 'Add Integration'.

9. You may receive a final pop-up asking to send test leads. You can verify that your CRM is connected by sending the test leads from your Realty.com portal and verifying they have arrived in your Lofty CRM.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Feature Updates for CRM Version 2.4.4
title: Feature Updates for CRM Version 2.4.4
body:
Key Takeaways

 

  • Listing Management (Web) - Only for whitelist users
  • Allow Enterprise team admins to add multiple roles (Web&App)
  • Smart Plan - Custom Field - Date (Web)
  • Allow users to add multiple transactions to one lead (Web)
  • Market Report optimization (Web)
  • New Lead email notification optimization (Web)
  • Lead Routing optimization (Web)
  • Communications with leads that are not assigned to the user count in Accountability report (Web)

 

 

Listing Management (Web) - Only for whitelist users



If users have an IDX Website, they can enter Listing Management by hovering on the Website tab.

 

In Listing Management, users can view three types of recommended listings:

 

  1. New Listing: These listings are new on market on their site.
  2. Price Reduced: The prices of these listings have been  reduced recently.
  3. Back on Market: The status of these listings became Back on Market recently. Note that some MLS don’t give us this status, so we only support this type of listing for a few MLS.

 

When viewing these types of listings, users can manage these listings by Filters(City, Type and Price) and Sort (by Price or Days listed).

For each listing, we will calculate the matched(best-fit) leads by Inquiries. They can view these matched leads and have a direct insights which tell users which leads may be interested in which properties. And also they can send the listing to interested leads via mass emails or texts.

 

 

Allow Enterprise team admins to add multiple roles (Web&App)

Allow team admins with Enterprise package to add multiple roles in Settings->Team->Role Settings. In this way, a lead can be assigned to multiple assignees.

 

Roles added by the admins have the same permissions as Assistant. Assignees on these roles have full access to the lead profile and can handle tasks and appointments.

 

Admins can change the role name and delete the role whenever s/he wants.

 

 

 

Smart Plan - Custom Field - Date (Web)

 

Agents can set up smart plans associated with Custom Fields (date type), like Close Date and Anniversary. This feature enables you to always apply relevant plans to leads. Additionally, you can choose to recur Yearly, Monthly and Weekly for this kind of plan.

 

 

 

Allow users to add multiple transactions to one lead (Web)

 

Now users are able to add multiple transactions to one lead in Lead Profile page. Still, for leads in Closed pipeline, the transaction data would be automatically collected and calculated in Business Reporting.

 

 

Market Report Optimization (Web)

 

  1. Replace Median Price / Properties Sold / Sold Listings by Price Range data sources to Home Junction (More stable)

 

  1. For the agents without an IDX website, they can use the (auto) market report

 

  1. Optimize market report email sending time

 

New Lead email notification optimization (Web)

 

The New Lead Alert and Reassign Lead Alert Email will contain more details about this lead. You’ll see how our AI system evaluates this lead and what he has done since his date was captured.

 

Also, the new subjects of Round Robin reassign and Blast Alert reassign give you a clear look at what type of lead is coming through and what  you should do to get it.

 

 

Lead Routing optimization (Web)



  1. When setting up routing rules for lenders, you are able to select “No lender” in the Default Rule.

 

  1. The way that Lofty Paid Leads are routed is optimized. If the Cost Sharing Lender only pays for the Buyer Package, then Seller Package leads can be routed by routing rules to any lenders besides manually assigning.

 

 

 

Communications with leads that are not assigned to the user count in Accountability report (Web)

 

The Accountability report now includes all communications done by a user, even if the communication is with a lead that is not assigned to him/her (calculated based on communication logs). In this way, the system is able to show all communication work done by the agent.

name: Managing Authorization by Third-Party Apps & Services

body:
Introduction

Third-party apps and services (also referred to as "vendors") are created by companies or developers that are separate from Lofty. You can give them access to your data by authorizing their application to connect to your Lofty account. You should likely be able to cancel the authorization in your third-party platform settings, however, you are also provided access to do so within the Lofty platform if needed. 

 

Summary

  • Connection Process
  • Reviewing and Editing Access

 

Connection Process

When connecting your third-party application to Lofty, you will typically click some form of a Connect to Lofty button within that application's integration settings.

Once you click the Connect to Lofty button (or similar) in the third-party application, you will be presented with a screen that looks something like the following. This is essentially your opportunity to give access to this third party to access Lofty if you would like. Click Authorize if you would like to do so.

 

You should then see some sort of confirmation page from the third party confirming that authorization has been provided.

 

Reviewing and Editing Access

Log into your Lofty CRM and navigate to My USer Settings > Integrations > Other Integrations > Manage My Authorizations:

 

You will then see a list of any applications to which you have given access to your Lofty account. You can click on the Disconnect button if you would like to revoke that access at any time.

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Realtor.com Integration
title: Realtor.com Integration
body:
Introduction

In this article, we will review how to set up email parsing in Lofty for Realtor.com leads or a direct/automatic lead import into Lofty of Connections℠ Plus or Market VIP leads from Realtor.com via API.

  • Email Parsing Method 
  • Connections℠ Plus Leads via API
  • Market VIP Leads via API

Email Parsing Method

What kind of Email will be parsed?

Lofty can parse a new lead into your CRM based on an email alert that comes from Realtor.com to your Lofty-integrated email. Here are the common items that Lofty searches for in Email Parsing:

From address: leads@email.realtor.com


How to Set it Up

Go to https://dashboard.realtor.com/ and use your agent login details to sign in. This will take you to the Realtor.com agent dashboard.

 

 

Click the Settings in the dropdown menu of your profile photo.

 

Click Lead Settings.

 

In ConnectionsSM for Buyers, Profile leads and Courtesy leads, click on Change to open the Send leads to the dropdown menu.

 

In the dropdown menu, select CRM. To the right, enter your integrated email address (with Lofty) or your unique Lofty email address.

 

In Email format, please choose HTML emails. Finally, click Save, and your Realtor.com leads will now be forwarded directly into your CRM.

Note: We suggest that you also add your email to Realtor.com to receive leads. In this way, you can test whether a lead has been imported to your CRM after you receive the lead notification email.  

 

How to find your unique lofty email address in Lofty

Go to the Settings page, and under the Features section on the right of the page, click Lead Capture.

At the bottom of this page, you will find the option to auto-import leads via third-party providers. Here, you will see your Lofty email, which you will use to auto-import leads from Realtor.com. In this section, click the Copy. 

 

Connections℠ Plus Leads via API

This connection is only for Connections℠ Plus Leads and works via Realtor.com's lead delivery API (eLeads). If you have a Pro account with Realtor.com, you can have your Connections℠ Plus leads imported into Lofty automatically when a new lead is generated. 

Any lead added to Lofty via the API will have a tag added to it of "Realtor API". 

*IMPORTANT: Please note that this connection method is available for Connections℠ Plus leads only. It is not currently available for other leads, including Advantage℠ Pro and Profile leads. These kinds of leads can only be imported through the email parsing mentioned previously.

 

Lofty Setup

This connection is found under Settings >Lead Settings > Lead Capture > Lofty CRM Preferred Lead Providers: 

The "Imported as Company Leads" option can be used to bring the lead in as either a Company Lead or a Personal Lead (see Lead Ownership). If turned off, the lead will come in as a Personal Lead and will not be distributed via lead routing.

If the lead comes in as a Company Lead, it will be distributed according to lead routing as long as "Third Party Providers" is checked under Settings > Lead Distribution > Lead Routing: 

 

 

If you would like to send a Welcome Email to the leads imported via this method, you can do so via the option seen below. You can always manually invite these leads to view your website later, so this is not a requirement. See Set Up the Welcome Email for more information.

 

Realtor.com Setup

This setup is mainly done in the settings of your Realtor Pro account. Navigate to Realtor.com and log in via your Pro account. Then, in your Realtor.com account, go to Settings > Lead Settings > ConnectionsSM Plus > Add Lead Delivery API. You can also click THIS link to go there directly. 

In this section, you have to complete the four different fields seen in the screenshot below:

1. Under "API source application," choose "Other application" 
2. For "Application URL," copy the URL found in Lofty under Settings > Features > Lead Capture Lofty CRM Preferred Lead Providers > Realtor.com > Webhook Link. 

3. For "API Key," copy the key found in Lofty under Settings > Features > Integrations > API (at the bottom):

4. For "Application login name," add the email address you use to log into Lofty.

FINISHED

Once the above steps have been completed, click 'Test Connection' and then click 'Save'. New Connections℠ Plus leads should automatically begin triggering into Lofty via the API.

name: Slybroadcast Integration
title: Slybroadcast Integration
body:
Introduction

Slybroadcast is a service that can be used to send pre-recorded “ringless voicemails” one at a time, in batches, or via a Smart Plan schedule. You can subscribe to Slybroadcast through THIS LINK. 

After you get your Slybroadcast account information, follow the steps below to integrate Slybroadcast with Lofty.

First, you need to go to the Integration Section to bind your account. Navigate to Settings > Integrations to find the option to connect Slybroadcast.

*The same single Slybroadcast account can be connected to multiple Lofty accounts.

After clicking “Connect,” enter the account login and password to complete the integration. Remember to update your account info if you ever change the account or password at Slybroadcast, otherwise, the integration will break and you will be unable to send pre-recorded voice messages through Lofty. 


Click “Disconnect” and re-enter your account login and password if you want to update your account if needed.

After the integration is complete, you can send pre-recorded voice messages in mass via the People Page--the process is basically the same as sending mass texts/emails using Lofty. Please note that Lofty will automatically remove leads with invalid numbers.

Be aware that you are not able to send an individual message directly from a lead profile, but you can still do so from the People page (by selecting only one lead instead of multiple) as described here.


When using the integration, the system requires a “Caller ID” to be selected as well as the selection of a pre-recorded voice message to work. The “Caller ID” will be shown as the number on the lead’s voicemail thus a business number would be ideal.


If you do not have any voice recordings ready to use, you can create one with this link: https://www.slybroadcast.com/addnewrecording.php.

Once you send the pre-recorded voice messages, the activity will be documented on the timeline of the lead(s). The system will update the status of the delivery of the voice message(s) as feedback is provided by Slybroadcast.

Lofty also supports sending pre-recorded voice messages with Smart Plans, but only for the “My Smart Plan” type.

The voice message(s) will be sent to the lead according to the Smart Plan steps. If the voice message delivery fails (based on the feedback from Slybroadcast), the system will convert the step to a “Call” task for manual completion.

Finally, it’s important to remember that the sending of pre-recorded voice messages can produce a variety of errors--especially when related to doing so via an automated Smart Plan. Lofty has added an email notification for abnormal situations such as incorrect account info, insufficient usage, and unavailable voice templates. Each email will outline the error for further follow-up. Please follow the suggestions when receiving the email.

*IMPORTANT: The Slybroadcast account should not be charged for failed deliveries. 

 

Questions?

If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

name: Feature Updates for CRM Version 2.3.6
title: Feature Updates for CRM Version 2.3.6
body:
Key Takeaways

 

  • Custom Field (Web&App)
  • Smart Plan - Recurring Plans Optimization (Web&App)
  • Lead Routing Optimization (Web)
  • Optimization of email parsing (Web)
  • Optimization of email editor (Web)
  • Export Leads (Web)
  • Send welcome email to manually added leads (Web&App)
  • Support for lead import from Google Contacts (Web)

 

 

Custom Field (Web)

 

Team admins can add custom fields in Settings->Features->Custom Field, with data types of Text and Date. These fields will be added to the Details section of Lead Profile Page.

 

Smart Plan - Recurring Plans Optimization 

 

1. In this version, we add Birthday and Specific Date plans to Recurring Plans. You are also able to add a plan triggered on leads’ Birthday or just a specific date. This way, the plan will be automatically applied to leads every year on Birthday or specific dates.

 

If you have set up a Recurring Plan for Birthday and the first step is to act on the day of Birthday, and apply to a lead whose birthday is Nov 8, 1991 (which can be added in the lead’s details page). Then the first step in this plan will act on Nov 8 yearly.

If you want to set up a Recurring Plan for Specific Date, you can simply select any date by clicking the Calendar icon. This way you will never miss any important events.

2. Besides in people listing page and the lead details page, you will know where each applied plan is from at a glance, so that you will never be misled by the similar plan name. In the lead details page, you will notice all plans are followed with a different description.

 

  • Team Plan:  The plan is a Team Plan which is created by Admins or the Team Owner as Team Plan.
  • Team Recurring Plan: The plan is of Recurring Plan type and created by Admins or the Team Owner as Team Plan.
  • My Plan-[Agent Full Name]: The plan is saved as My Plan, followed by its creator.
  • My Recurring Plan-[Agent Full Name]: The plan is of Recurring Plan type and saved as My Plan.

 

3. In some circumstances, the plan’s status will be changed and cannot keep running, like Paused or Terminated. In this update, we will tell the reason for each status. You can simply hover the plan name on the lead details page and the specific reason will display for you.

 

Lead Routing Optimization

 

1. Set longer time both for Reassign Rule and Default Rule. You have options to choose 1-59 minutes or 1-24 hours for Blast Alert and Round Robin rule. This way, you can decide the best fit time for lead distribution.

 

2. Be able to set the time separately for the first assignee and the remaining in the Reassign Rule. Specifically, If the first assignee does not make contact with the lead in a designated time, like 5 mins, then you can decide to route lead by Round Robin rule/Blast Alert rule and each assignee have 10 mins to follow up. 

 

3. Empty or Match exactly

In this new vision, we make some adjustments to the “Empty or Match exactly” principle.

For “Location” field, when “Empty or Match Exactly” is chosen, a lead will match the “Location” field if either the lead has no location specified or the lead's city/county info is acceptable empty but nothing is contradictory with the "Location" field in the rule.

 

4. You can also choose any team member as the default assignee when all rules fail to route leads. For agent routing rule, you are able to choose any agent team member; for lender routing rule, you can also choose any lender.

5. The Cost Sharing Lender is also able to be added to a Routing Rule for Lender. This means, your cost sharing lender like other free plan lenders, can receive lead by the routing rules, too. 

 

Optimization of email parsing

 

More third-party lead providers are supported by email parsing:

Agent Image, Agentology, Bold Leads, Dave Ramsey, Flipt, Geographic Farming, Homesnap, Homespotter, Home Value Leads, Instapage, Lead Pages, Listing to Leads, Offrs, Referral Exchange, Redfin, Re/Max LeadStreet, Street Easy, 55 Places

To set up email parsing auto-import, our users should make sure to that they are using their integrated email to receive lead notification emails directly from the lead providers above.

 

 

Optimization of email editor

 

The editor of email (single mail, mass mail, email template) has been optimized in this version.

Users can search for a template by template name when inserting email template.  Variable (such as #Lead_Name#) has been folded in Insert Variable.

 

 

Export Lead

 

Uses can export their leads now.

In Settings - Lead Export, they can export all of the leads in CRM or Base on search criteria which include Group, Pipeline, Lead Type, Tag, Source, Agent & Assistant.

 

After submitting the export request, it will take a few minutes to generate a .csv file. The user will receive an email when export is finished, and .csv file can be downloaded in this email.

 

 

Support for lead import from Google Contacts

 

Lead import function now supports Google Contacts. Visit ‘Settings’ - ‘Lead Import’ and you will see the option to import from Google Contacts.

name: Feature Updates for CRM Version 2.3.4
title: Feature Updates for CRM Version 2.3.4
body:
Key Takeaways in Version 2.3.4

 

• Redefined Tag Function

• Improvements to Property Alert Function

• Improved Buyer Lead Inquiries Algorithm

• Privacy control for sync sent and received emails in integrated email

• Email notification of authorization failure with integration email

• Bounced status of lead’s email can be changed

• Smart Plan - New Recurring Features

• Zapier Optimization

 

 

Redefined Tag Feature

 

Tags are now divided into 2 types — ‘Private Tags’ and ‘Shared Tags’. Private Tags are for personal use and are invisible to other team members. Shared Tags are public to all team members, but can only be created and managed by team admins. Shared Tags will be marked with a ‘Team’ icon.

 

Improvements to Property Alert Function

 

  1. ‘ASAP’ Frequency of Property Alert has been renamed to ‘Instantly’
  2. Added a ‘Send new property alert after saving’ option to send a property alert email immediately after setting up the property alert.
  3. Lot Size field now supports both Sqft and Acre as unit types.
  4. Property alerts created by a lead’s saved searches will be shown along with the ones created by agents. They will be marked as ‘Saved Search’. Property alerts like this can not be edited but can be deleted (the lead’s saved search will remain).

 

 

Improved Buyer Lead Inquiries Algorithm

 

  1. Search activities of buyer leads are now factored into the algorithm that distributes property alerts.
  2. Now the system will try to fill in the fields that are missing data in lead inquiries for leads imported from third-party sources, according to the lead’s activities on the agent’s website.

 

 

Privacy control for sync sent and received emails in integrated email

 

We set a privacy control for syncing emails. Now only the ‘Assigned To’ agents sent and received emails with corresponding leads will be synchronized and shown in the lead’s timeline.

 

 

Email notification of authorization failure with integration email

 

When users change the password of their integrated emails or Lofty’s access to their Gmail, the integrated email will be disconnected and they will receive a notification email like this:

 

Bounced status of lead’s email can be changed

 

The Bounced status of lead’s email can be changed now in detail page. After changing the status, you can send emails to this address as normal (however the email may still bounce).

 

Smart Plan - New Recurring Features

 

In this version, Smart Plans have been improved with recurring features. You are able to add a Smart Plan that triggers on New Year, Christmas, and Valentine’s Day with the option to set it to recur yearly. This way, the plan will automatically apply to specific leads every year on the date.

 

When adding a new recurring plan, you can apply to new incoming leads, reassigned leads, or existing leads for a greater degree of control over how you nurture your leads.

After setting a time, you can choose whether to send it on or before/after the holiday.

On the Smart Plans listing page, there are two more columns added: Category and For.

 

 

Zapier Optimization

 

When choosing Lofty as Action in a zap, “Update the Lead’s Info” has now been added. You have options to choose whether to create a new lead or update the existing lead’s info when triggered.

When choosing “Update the Lead’s Info”, it will update the lead’s chosen fields in Lofty. For fields with multiple values, like Phone or Email, the new data will be added instead of replacing the existing ones. You can also find the record in the timeline on the lead’s details page.

 

As for the matching fields, we have added three more fields: Source, Group, and Tag.

name: Feature Updates for CRM Version 2.3.0
title: Feature Updates for CRM Version 2.3.0
body:
Key Takeaways in Version 2.3.0

 

• Property Alert & Market Report Subscription Control (Web)  

• New Duplicate Detection Function (Web)  

• Improved Look for App Lead List(App)

• Task Management V2.0 (Web)

• New Smart Plans Features V2.0 (Web)  

• Smart Plans (Web & App) - Open for all users

• Lender Assignment (Web & App)  

• Dotloop Integration (Web)  

• Task and Appointment page redesign  (App)  

• New Showing Request page(App)

• New Dashboard (Web)  

• Optimization of Open House (Web & App)  

• Notification types added (Web & App)  

• Ticket submission direct from CRM  (Web)  

 

 

Property Alert & Market Report Subscription Control (Web)

 

In a lead’s profile page, now users can disable/enable a lead’s subscriptions to Property Alert & Market Reports.

 

New Duplicate Detection Function (Web)

 

When a new lead is being created or users are viewing a lead’s profile, the system will detect if this lead is a possible duplicate.

 

Improved Look for App Lead List (App)

 

Leads’ pipeline and groups are shown on the lead list.

 

Task Management V2.0 (Web)

 

In the updated Task Management, admin users can notify team members to follow up with tasks. After clicking the Notify Agent button, the assignee will receive a notification in their Lofty CRM.

 

Smart Plans (Web & App) - Open for all users

 

Smart Plan feature will be open for all users.

• In the Settings page, you will find Smart Plans;

• In the lead details page, you can add smart plans and our smart suggestions feature to intelligently choose the best fit plans for your leads;

• In the people listing page, you are able to mass add smart plans.

 

Smart Plans V2.0 (Web)

 

You are able to assign tasks in Smart Plans to different roles, namely Agent and Assistant. When the task is assigned to an assistant, the task will go to the agent if the lead doesn’t have an assistant.

 

Also, you are able to edit all tasks from smart plans even after they have been generated. For auto emails and auto texts, you can edit the descriptions and scheduled time.

 

Lender Assignment (Web & App)

 

In this updated version, team members can assign another lender to their leads. This way, they can choose a lender they want to co-work with, and it’s time-saving for admin users.  All users are able to mass assign leads to a lender in the People Listing Page.

 

Dotloop Integration (Web & App)

 

Lofty’s integration with Dotloop enables you to close deals faster. You can export leads to Dotloop and create a loop.

In the Settings>Integrations page, you will find Dotloop Integration available to connect.

After you connected with Dotloop, open a lead details page, and then you will notice the Export icon at the top.

After clicking, a pop-up window will appear. A lead’s full name, lead role, and email will be populated if the information is available.

After filling in the required fields and clicking Create, you can find “View in Dotloop” in transaction module on the left corner. You will be directed to the loop in Dotloop.

 

Tasks and Appointments page redesign  (App)

 

We integrate task and appointment into one page with week/month view  calendar.

1.Agent filter

2.Week/month view  calendar selector

3.Weekly-view calendar with task/appointment quantity reminder

4.Tasks and appointment  filter

5.Optimization of list UI

6.New task edit entrance.

 

  1. New smart month calendar with task/and appointment number reminder which can be changed along with the chosen filter combination.
  2. Optimization of empty status. 
  3. Add new task/appointment by clicking the plus sign icon on the top right side of the page.
  4. Fast return to current month by clicking the corresponding screen header.

 

New Showing request page (App)

 

1.New showing request will show when there's at least one showing request for the agent.

2.Optimization of the appointment and task UI

3.After clicking appointments or tasks, both go to "tasks and appointments" page, but with different default filter settings.

 A new individual display page for showing request.

New Dashboard (Web)

 

We have finished a new design for Lofty Dashboard.

• Four kinds of data are displayed at the top of the Dashboard:

1. The number of Today’s New Leads (also with a Not Contact lead number)

2. The number of Today’s Opportunities (also with a number of leads with a lead score>70 among today’s opportunities)

3. The number of Incomplete Tasks (also with the number of tasks today and overdue tasks)

4.Business Goal process (same as the Business Goal by Volume in Reporting)

 

Team admins can see the entire team data when changing the dashboard to Team dashboard, members can only see their own data.

•  Get Started: For new users, a Get Started tutorial will guide them through Lofty basic settings.


• Lofty Activity: Activity within Lofty CRM will also be displayed in the dashboard (referral activity is now displayed).

 

• Account Usage: Users will now be able to see how much of their email and dialer (or virtual number) plan has been used.

 

• Training:We will now display online training to introduce functions to users.

 

Optimization of Open House (Web & App)

 

Open House is now editable, agents that create an open house will be marked. The leads created via this open house will be assigned to the open house creator directly (except in the case of team owners, whose leads created via open house will be assigned through lead routing rule).

Users can customize their own Open House Questionnaire.  The default questionnaire will contain previously used questions, users can now edit questionnaires as needed. Questionnaire results will be saved as notes in the lead’s details page.

 

Notification type added (Web&App)

 

When the lofty.me mail or integrated mail of users receives a new email from the lead, they will now get a New Email notification and Push with the lead’s name, email subject, and preview of email content.

When assigning leads to agents manually, the notification title is changed to Reassign Lead Alert.

 

Directly submit tickets in CRM  (Web)

 

We integrated the Zendesk contact form function with Lofty. Now, users can click ‘Submit a Ticket’ and fill in the form with their questions. If they need face-to-face help, they can click ‘Schedule a Meeting’ to schedule an online meeting with our support team.
